PAG2::Kl.text:
noncomputable def Kl (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (r : ℕ) (c : ZMod N) : ℂ :=
  ∑ x : Fin r → ZMod N, if ∏ i, x i = c then ψ (∑ i, x i) else 0

PAG2::addChar_sum.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
lemma addChar_sum {ι : Type*} (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (s : Finset ι) (x : ι → ZMod N) :
    ψ (∑ i ∈ s, x i) = ∏ i ∈ s, ψ (x i)

PAG2::gaussSum_pow.text:
lemma gaussSum_pow (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (r : ℕ) :
    gaussSum χ ψ ^ r = ∑ x : Fin r → ZMod N, χ (∏ i, x i) * ψ (∑ i, x i)

PAG2::charSum_gaussSum_pow.text:
theorem charSum_gaussSum_pow (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (r : ℕ) {a : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N, χ a⁻¹ * gaussSum χ ψ ^ r = N.totient * Kl ψ r a

PAG2::inv_neg_unit.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
lemma inv_neg_unit {a : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) : (-a)⁻¹ = a⁻¹ * (-1)

PAG2::charSum_parity.text:
theorem charSum_parity (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (r : ℕ) (we wo : ℂ)
    {a : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N,
        χ a⁻¹ * ((we * (1 + χ (-1)) + wo * (1 - χ (-1))) / 2) * gaussSum χ ψ ^ r
      = N.totient / 2 * ((we + wo) * Kl ψ r a + (we - wo) * Kl ψ r (-a))

PAG2::conj_Kl.text:
theorem conj_Kl (r : ℕ) (c : ZMod N) :
    starRingEnd ℂ (Kl ZMod.stdAddChar r c) = Kl ZMod.stdAddChar r ((-1) ^ r * c)

PAG2::Kl_neg_of_odd.text:
theorem Kl_neg_of_odd {r : ℕ} (hr : Odd r) (c : ZMod N) :
    Kl ZMod.stdAddChar r (-c) = starRingEnd ℂ (Kl ZMod.stdAddChar r c)

PAG2::Kl_real_of_even.text:
theorem Kl_real_of_even {r : ℕ} (hr : Even r) (c : ZMod N) :
    (Kl ZMod.stdAddChar r c).im = 0

PAG2::cas.text: noncomputable def cas (z : ℂ) : ℂ := ((z.re + z.im : ℝ) : ℂ)

PAG2::Wpow.text:
noncomputable def Wpow (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (r : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ((1 + χ (-1)) + (-I) ^ r * (1 - χ (-1))) / 2 * gaussSum χ ZMod.stdAddChar ^ r
    / (Real.sqrt N : ℂ) ^ r

PAG2::parity_weight.text:
lemma parity_weight (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (r : ℕ) :
    ((1 + χ (-1)) + (-I) ^ r * (1 - χ (-1))) / 2 = if χ.Even then 1 else (-I) ^ r

PAG2::S_eq.text:
lemma S_eq (r : ℕ) {a : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N, χ a⁻¹ * Wpow χ r
      = N.totient / 2 / (Real.sqrt N : ℂ) ^ r
          * ((1 + (-I) ^ r) * Kl ZMod.stdAddChar r a
              + (1 - (-I) ^ r) * Kl ZMod.stdAddChar r (-a))

PAG2::S_odd.text:
theorem S_odd (k : ℕ) {a : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N, χ a⁻¹ * Wpow χ (2 * k + 1)
      = N.totient / (Real.sqrt N : ℂ) ^ (2 * k + 1)
          * cas (Kl ZMod.stdAddChar (2 * k + 1) ((-1) ^ k * a))

PAG2::S_even.text:
theorem S_even (k : ℕ) {a : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N, χ a⁻¹ * Wpow χ (2 * k)
      = N.totient / (Real.sqrt N : ℂ) ^ (2 * k)
          * Kl ZMod.stdAddChar (2 * k) ((-1) ^ k * a)

PAG2::cas_Kl_even.text:
theorem cas_Kl_even (k : ℕ) (c : ZMod N) :
    cas (Kl ZMod.stdAddChar (2 * k) c) = Kl ZMod.stdAddChar (2 * k) c

PAG3::conj_apply_eq_inv.text:
theorem conj_apply_eq_inv (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (a : ZMod N) :
    starRingEnd ℂ (χ a) = χ⁻¹ a

PAG3::apply_inv_eq_inv_apply.text:
theorem apply_inv_eq_inv_apply (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) {a : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    χ a⁻¹ = χ⁻¹ a

PAG3::apply_inv_eq_conj.text:
theorem apply_inv_eq_conj (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) {a : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    χ a⁻¹ = starRingEnd ℂ (χ a)

PAG3::wsum.text:
noncomputable def wsum (w : DirichletCharacter ℂ N → ℂ) (a : ZMod N) : ℂ :=
  ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N, χ a⁻¹ * w χ

PAG3::wsum_conj_of_symm.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
theorem wsum_conj_of_symm (w : DirichletCharacter ℂ N → ℂ)
    (hw : ∀ χ, w χ⁻¹ = starRingEnd ℂ (w χ)) (a : ZMod N) :
    starRingEnd ℂ (wsum w a) = wsum w a

PAG3::wsum_im_of_symm.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
theorem wsum_im_of_symm (w : DirichletCharacter ℂ N → ℂ)
    (hw : ∀ χ, w χ⁻¹ = starRingEnd ℂ (w χ)) (a : ZMod N) :
    (wsum w a).im = 0

PAG3::apply_mul_apply_inv.text:
lemma apply_mul_apply_inv (ψ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (a : ZMod N) :
    ψ a * χ a⁻¹ = (ψ * χ⁻¹) a

PAG3::sum_apply_mul_apply_inv.text:
lemma sum_apply_mul_apply_inv (ψ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    ∑ a : ZMod N, ψ a * χ a⁻¹ = if χ = ψ then (N.totient : ℂ) else 0

PAG3::sum_mul_wsum.text:
theorem sum_mul_wsum (w : DirichletCharacter ℂ N → ℂ) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    ∑ a : ZMod N, ψ a * wsum w a = N.totient * w ψ

PAG3::symm_of_wsum_conj.text:
theorem symm_of_wsum_conj (w : DirichletCharacter ℂ N → ℂ)
    (hreal : ∀ a : ZMod N, IsUnit a → starRingEnd ℂ (wsum w a) = wsum w a)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    w ψ⁻¹ = starRingEnd ℂ (w ψ)

PAG3::prop46.text:
theorem prop46 (w : DirichletCharacter ℂ N → ℂ) :
    (∀ χ, w χ⁻¹ = starRingEnd ℂ (w χ)) ↔ ∀ a : ZMod N, IsUnit a → (wsum w a).im = 0

PAG3::casK.text: noncomputable def casK (t : ZMod N) : ℂ := PAG.Kloosterman.cas (ZMod.stdAddChar t)

PAG3::casK_even_part.text:
lemma casK_even_part (t : ZMod N) :
    casK t + casK (-t) = ZMod.stdAddChar t + ZMod.stdAddChar (-t)

PAG3::casK_odd_part.text:
lemma casK_odd_part (t : ZMod N) :
    casK t - casK (-t) = -I * (ZMod.stdAddChar t - ZMod.stdAddChar (-t))

PAG3::sum_neg_twist.text:
lemma sum_neg_twist (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (x : ZMod N) :
    ∑ y : ZMod N, ZMod.stdAddChar (-(x * y)) * χ y
      = χ (-1) * ∑ y : ZMod N, ZMod.stdAddChar (x * y) * χ y

PAG3::hartley_char.text:
theorem hartley_char (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (x : ZMod N) :
    ∑ y : ZMod N, casK (x * y) * χ y
      = (if χ.Even then 1 else -I) * ∑ y : ZMod N, ZMod.stdAddChar (x * y) * χ y

PAG3::rev_charFun.text: theorem rev_charFun (χ : G →* ℂˣ) : PAG.rev (PAG.charFun χ) = PAG.charFun χ⁻¹

PAG3::rev_not_eigen.text:
theorem rev_not_eigen (χ : G →* ℂˣ) (hχ : χ⁻¹ ≠ χ) (c : ℂ) :
    PAG.rev (PAG.charFun χ) ≠ c • PAG.charFun χ

PAG3::rev_not_commute.text:
theorem rev_not_commute (χ : G →* ℂˣ) (hχ : χ⁻¹ ≠ χ) :
    ¬ ∀ h : G, PAG.rev ∘ₗ PAG.transl h = PAG.transl h ∘ₗ PAG.rev

PAG3::rev_charFun_real.text:
theorem rev_charFun_real (χ : G →* ℂˣ) (hχ : χ⁻¹ = χ) :
    PAG.rev (PAG.charFun χ) = PAG.charFun χ

PAG4::T.text:
def T (a : ZMod N) : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun f x := f (x + a)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

PAG4::M.text:
noncomputable def M (b : ZMod N) : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun f x := ZMod.stdAddChar (b * x) * f x
  map_add' f g := by funext x; simp [mul_add]
  map_smul' c f := by funext x; simp; ring

PAG4::F.text:
noncomputable def F : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun f y := ∑ x, ZMod.stdAddChar (x * y) * f x
  map_add' f g := by funext y; simp [mul_add, sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' c f := by funext y; simp [mul_sum]; refine sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring

PAG4::F_comm_T.text: theorem F_comm_T (a : ZMod N) : F ∘ₗ T a = M (-a) ∘ₗ F

PAG4::F_comm_M.text: theorem F_comm_M (b : ZMod N) : F ∘ₗ M b = T b ∘ₗ F

PAG4::heisenberg_unique.text:
theorem heisenberg_unique (U : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (h1 : ∀ a, U ∘ₗ T a = M (-a) ∘ₗ U) (h2 : ∀ b, U ∘ₗ M b = T b ∘ₗ U) :
    ∃ c : ℂ, U = c • F

PAG5::Rc.text: def Rc (L v : ℤ) : ℤ := L - v

PAG5::Rg_invol.text: theorem Rg_invol (v : ℤ) : Rg (Rg v) = v

PAG5::Rc_invol.text: theorem Rc_invol (L v : ℤ) : Rc L (Rc L v) = v

PAG5::Rg_comp_Rc.text: theorem Rg_comp_Rc (L v : ℤ) : Rg (Rc L v) = v - L

PAG5::Rc_comp_Rg.text: theorem Rc_comp_Rg (L v : ℤ) : Rc L (Rg v) = v + L

PAG5::comm_iff.text: theorem comm_iff (L : ℤ) : (∀ v, Rg (Rc L v) = Rc L (Rg v)) ↔ L = 0

PAG5::iterate_comp.text:
theorem iterate_comp (L : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (v : ℤ) :
    (fun w => Rg (Rc L w))^[n] v = v - n * L

PAG5::comp_infinite_order.text:
theorem comp_infinite_order {L : ℤ} (hL : L ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (fun w => Rg (Rc L w))^[n] ≠ id

PAG5::Rc_maps_interval.text: theorem Rc_maps_interval {L v : ℤ} (h0 : 0 ≤ v) (h1 : v ≤ L) : 0 ≤ Rc L v ∧ Rc L v ≤ L

PAG5::comp_maps_south_to_north.text:
theorem comp_maps_south_to_north {L v : ℤ} (h0 : 0 ≤ v) (h1 : v ≤ L) :
    -L ≤ Rg (Rc L v) ∧ Rg (Rc L v) ≤ 0

PAG5::sum_totient_prime_pow.text:
theorem sum_totient_prime_pow (p m : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    (∑ j ∈ range m, Nat.totient (p ^ (j + 1))) + 1 = p ^ m

PAG5::shell_count.text:
theorem shell_count (p m : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    Nat.totient (p ^ (m + 1)) + 2 * (∑ j ∈ range m, Nat.totient (p ^ (j + 1))) + 2
      = p ^ (m + 1) + p ^ m

PAG6::D.text: def D (p K : ℕ) : ℤ := ∑ v ∈ range (K + 1), cv p K v

PAG6::D_eq_sum_dj.text: theorem D_eq_sum_dj (p K : ℕ) : D p K = ∑ j ∈ range (K + 1), dj p K j

PAG6::sum_totient_int.text:
theorem sum_totient_int (p m : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    (∑ i ∈ range m, (Nat.totient (p ^ (i + 1)) : ℤ)) = (p : ℤ) ^ m - 1

PAG6::inner_sum.text:
theorem inner_sum (p K m : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hm : 2 * m ≤ K) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (m + 1), dj p K j) = (p : ℤ) ^ m

PAG6::D_even.text: theorem D_even (p m : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : D p (2 * m) = (p : ℤ) ^ m

PAG6::D_odd.text: theorem D_odd (p m : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : D p (2 * m + 1) = 0

PAG6::legFixed.text: def legFixed (K : ℕ) : ℕ := ((range K).filter (fun v => v + v + 1 = K)).card

PAG6::legFixed_eq.text: theorem legFixed_eq (K : ℕ) : legFixed K = if K % 2 = 1 then 1 else 0

PAG6::seesaw.text:
theorem seesaw (p K : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    (K % 2 = 0 → D p K = (p : ℤ) ^ (K / 2) ∧ legFixed K = 0) ∧
    (K % 2 = 1 → D p K = 0 ∧ legFixed K = 1)

PAG6::trace_seesaw.text:
theorem trace_seesaw (p K : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    (D p K : ℝ) / (Real.sqrt p) ^ K + (legFixed K : ℝ) = 1

PAG7::Meq_cube.text: theorem Meq_cube : Meq * Meq * Meq = 2 • Meq

PAG7::EqData.text:
structure EqData (H0 Hi : V →ₗ[R] V) (e0 : V) (κ : R) : Prop where
  h0sq : H0 (H0 e0) = e0
  hisq : Hi (Hi e0) = e0
  h0_on_um : H0 (Hi e0) = κ • H0 e0
  hi_on_up : Hi (H0 e0) = κ • Hi e0

PAG7::cube_e0.text:
theorem cube_e0 (h : EqData H0 Hi e0 κ) :
    (H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) e0)) = (2 + κ ^ 2) • (H0 + Hi) e0 + (2 * κ) • e0

PAG7::cube_eq_two_of_kappa_zero.text:
theorem cube_eq_two_of_kappa_zero (h : EqData H0 Hi e0 0) :
    (H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) e0)) = (2 : R) • (H0 + Hi) e0 ∧
    (H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) (H0 e0))) = (2 : R) • (H0 + Hi) (H0 e0) ∧
    (H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) (Hi e0))) = (2 : R) • (H0 + Hi) (Hi e0)

PAG7::block_action.text:
theorem block_action (h : EqData H0 Hi e0 0) :
    (H0 + Hi) e0 = H0 e0 + Hi e0 ∧ (H0 + Hi) (H0 e0) = e0 ∧ (H0 + Hi) (Hi e0) = e0

PAG7::J.text: noncomputable def J (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) : ℂ := ∑ x, χ₁ x * χ₂ (1 - x)

PAG7::J_eq_jacobiSum.text: theorem J_eq_jacobiSum (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) : J χ₁ χ₂ = jacobiSum χ₁ χ₂

PAG7::fiber.text: noncomputable def fiber (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (s : ZMod N) : ℂ := ∑ x, χ₁ x * χ₂ (s - x)

PAG7::gauss_mul_gauss_eq_sum_fiber.text:
theorem gauss_mul_gauss_eq_sum_fiber (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ) :
    gaussSum χ₁ ψ * gaussSum χ₂ ψ = ∑ s, ψ s * fiber χ₁ χ₂ s

PAG7::fiber_one.text: theorem fiber_one (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) : fiber χ₁ χ₂ 1 = J χ₁ χ₂

PAG7::fiber_unit.text:
theorem fiber_unit (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (s : (ZMod N)ˣ) :
    fiber χ₁ χ₂ s = (χ₁ * χ₂) s * J χ₁ χ₂

PAG7::gauss_mul_gauss_eq_jacobi_mul.text:
theorem gauss_mul_gauss_eq_jacobi_mul (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ)
    (hnon : ∀ s : ZMod N, ¬ IsUnit s → fiber χ₁ χ₂ s = 0) :
    gaussSum χ₁ ψ * gaussSum χ₂ ψ = J χ₁ χ₂ * gaussSum (χ₁ * χ₂) ψ

PAG7::gauss_sq_prime.text:
theorem gauss_sq_prime {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hχ : χ * χ ≠ 1)
    (ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ) :
    gaussSum χ ψ ^ 2 = J χ χ * gaussSum (χ * χ) ψ

PAG7::W_sq.text:
theorem W_sq (τ τ₂ Jv : ℂ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (a : ℕ) (h : τ ^ 2 = Jv * τ₂) :
    (τ / (I ^ a * (Real.sqrt q : ℂ))) ^ 2 = (-1) ^ a * (Jv / (Real.sqrt q : ℂ)) * (τ₂ / (Real.sqrt q : ℂ))

PAG7::push.text:
noncomputable def push (p : ZMod N) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (w : ZMod N) : ℂ :=
  ∑ z, if p * z = w then f z else 0

PAG7::pull.text: def pull (p : ZMod N) (g : ZMod N → ℂ) (z : ZMod N) : ℂ := g (p * z)

PAG7::F_push.text:
theorem F_push (p : ZMod N) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part4.F (push p f) = pull p (PAG.Part4.F f)

PAG8::fiber_eq_mul_of_stabilizer.text:
theorem fiber_eq_mul_of_stabilizer (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (s : ZMod N) (u : (ZMod N)ˣ)
    (hu : (u : ZMod N) * s = s) :
    fiber χ₁ χ₂ s = (χ₁ * χ₂) u * fiber χ₁ χ₂ s

PAG8::fiber_eq_zero_of_stabilizer.text:
theorem fiber_eq_zero_of_stabilizer (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (s : ZMod N) (u : (ZMod N)ˣ)
    (hu : (u : ZMod N) * s = s) (hne : (χ₁ * χ₂) u ≠ 1) :
    fiber χ₁ χ₂ s = 0

PAG8::fiber_zero_of_ne_one.text:
theorem fiber_zero_of_ne_one (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (h : χ₁ * χ₂ ≠ 1) :
    fiber χ₁ χ₂ 0 = 0

PAG8::gauss_mul_gauss_eq_jacobi_mul_of_s.text:
theorem gauss_mul_gauss_eq_jacobi_mul_of_stab (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ)
    (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ)
    (hstab : ∀ s : ZMod N, ¬ IsUnit s → ∃ u : (ZMod N)ˣ, (u : ZMod N) * s = s ∧ (χ₁ * χ₂) u ≠ 1) :
    gaussSum χ₁ ψ * gaussSum χ₂ ψ = J χ₁ χ₂ * gaussSum (χ₁ * χ₂) ψ

PAG8::p_dvd_val_of_not_isUnit.text: theorem p_dvd_val_of_not_isUnit (s : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) (hs : ¬ IsUnit s) : p ∣ s.val

PAG8::unit_mul_eq_of_ker.text:
theorem unit_mul_eq_of_ker (u : (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))ˣ)
    (hu : ZMod.unitsMap (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) u = 1)
    (s : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) (hs : ¬ IsUnit s) : (u : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) * s = s

PAG8::exists_ker_ne_one_of_primitive.text:
theorem exists_ker_ne_one_of_primitive (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ u : (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))ˣ,
      ZMod.unitsMap (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) u = 1 ∧ χ u ≠ 1

PAG8::gauss_mul_gauss_eq_jacobi_mul_prim.text:
theorem gauss_mul_gauss_eq_jacobi_mul_primitive (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hprim : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) (ψ : AddChar (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ℂ) :
    gaussSum χ₁ ψ * gaussSum χ₂ ψ = J χ₁ χ₂ * gaussSum (χ₁ * χ₂) ψ

PAG8::gauss_sq_primitive.text:
theorem gauss_sq_primitive (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hprim : (χ * χ).IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : AddChar (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ℂ) :
    gaussSum χ ψ ^ 2 = J χ χ * gaussSum (χ * χ) ψ

PAG9::D.text: def D (K c v : ℤ) : ℤ := K - c - v

PAG9::D_comp.text: theorem D_comp (K c c' v : ℤ) : D K c' (D K c v) = v + (c - c')

PAG9::D_comp_mem.text:
theorem D_comp_mem {K c c' v : ℤ} (h0 : 0 ≤ v) (h1 : v ≤ K - c) (_hc : c' ≤ c) :
    c - c' ≤ D K c' (D K c v) ∧ D K c' (D K c v) ≤ K - c'

PAG9::D_mem.text:
theorem D_mem {K c c' v : ℤ} (h0 : 0 ≤ v) (h1 : v ≤ K - c) (_hc : c' ≤ c) :
    0 ≤ D K c v ∧ D K c v ≤ K - c'

PAG9::chi_neg_one_sq.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
theorem chi_neg_one_sq (χ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) : χ (-1) * χ (-1) = 1

PAG9::inv_apply_neg_one.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
theorem inv_apply_neg_one (χ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) : χ⁻¹ (-1) = χ (-1)

PAG9::conj_gaussSum.text:
theorem conj_gaussSum (χ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) :
    starRingEnd ℂ (gaussSum χ ZMod.stdAddChar) = χ (-1) * gaussSum χ⁻¹ ZMod.stdAddChar

PAG9::gauss_mul_gauss_inv.text:
theorem gauss_mul_gauss_inv (χ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) :
    gaussSum χ ZMod.stdAddChar * gaussSum χ⁻¹ ZMod.stdAddChar
      = χ (-1) * (Complex.normSq (gaussSum χ ZMod.stdAddChar) : ℂ)

PAG9::gauss_mul_gauss_inv_of_norm.text:
theorem gauss_mul_gauss_inv_of_norm (χ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (M : ℝ)
    (hM : Complex.normSq (gaussSum χ ZMod.stdAddChar) = M) :
    gaussSum χ ZMod.stdAddChar * gaussSum χ⁻¹ ZMod.stdAddChar = χ (-1) * M

PAG9::one_add_pow_of_sq_zero.text:
theorem one_add_pow_of_sq_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (d : R) (hd : d * d = 0) (m : ℕ) :
    (1 + d) ^ m = 1 + (m : R) * d

PAG9::eq_one_of_sq_of_pow_odd.text:
omit hp in
theorem eq_one_of_sq_of_pow_odd {z : ℂ} (hodd : Odd p) (h2 : z ^ 2 = 1) (hp' : z ^ p = 1) : z = 1

PAG10::ind.text:
def ind {X W : Type*} [DecidableEq W] (shell : X → W) (a : W → R) (w : W) : X → R :=
  fun x => if shell x = w then a w else 0

PAG10::ind_mul_ind.text:
theorem ind_mul_ind {X W : Type*} [DecidableEq W] (shell : X → W) (a : W → R) (w₀ w₁ : W) :
    ind shell a w₀ * ind shell a w₁ = if w₀ = w₁ then a w₀ • ind shell a w₀ else 0

PAG10::Bcv.text: def Bcv (F : A ≃ₗ[R] A) (α : R) (f g : A) : A := α • F.symm (F f * F g)

PAG10::Bcv_comm.text: theorem Bcv_comm (F : A ≃ₗ[R] A) (α : R) (f g : A) : Bcv F α f g = Bcv F α g f

PAG10::Bcv_assoc.text:
theorem Bcv_assoc (F : A ≃ₗ[R] A) (α : R) (f g h : A) :
    Bcv F α (Bcv F α f g) h = Bcv F α f (Bcv F α g h)

PAG10::Bcv_dual.text:
theorem Bcv_dual {W : Type*} [DecidableEq W] (F : A ≃ₗ[R] A) (α : R) (e : W → A) (c : W → R)
    (he : ∀ w₀ w₁, e w₀ * e w₁ = if w₀ = w₁ then c w₀ • e w₀ else 0) (w₀ w₁ : W) :
    Bcv F α (F.symm (e w₀)) (F.symm (e w₁)) =
      if w₀ = w₁ then (α * c w₀) • F.symm (e w₀) else 0

PAG10::cvpow.text:
def cvpow (F : A ≃ₗ[R] A) (α : R) (f : A) : ℕ → A
  | 0 => f
  | n + 1 => Bcv F α f (cvpow F α f n)

PAG10::cvpow_dual.text:
theorem cvpow_dual (F : A ≃ₗ[R] A) (α : R) (e : A) (c : R) (he : e * e = c • e) (n : ℕ) :
    cvpow F α (F.symm e) n = (α * c) ^ n • F.symm e

PAG10::Bcv_idempotent.text:
theorem Bcv_idempotent {K : Type*} [Field K] {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra K B]
    (F : B ≃ₗ[K] B) (α : K) (e : B) (c : K) (he : e * e = c • e) :
    Bcv F α ((α * c)⁻¹ • F.symm e) ((α * c)⁻¹ • F.symm e) = (α * c)⁻¹ • F.symm e

PAG10::Bcv_dual_ind.text:
theorem Bcv_dual_ind {X W : Type*} [DecidableEq W] (shell : X → W) (a : W → R)
    (F : (X → R) ≃ₗ[R] (X → R)) (α : R) (w₀ w₁ : W) :
    Bcv F α (F.symm (ind shell a w₀)) (F.symm (ind shell a w₁)) =
      if w₀ = w₁ then (α * a w₀) • F.symm (ind shell a w₀) else 0

PAG10::eq_one_of_pow_coprime.text:
theorem eq_one_of_pow_coprime {M : Type*} [Monoid M] {z : M} {m q : ℕ} (hc : Nat.Coprime m q)
    (hm : z ^ m = 1) (hq : z ^ q = 1) : z = 1

PAG10::pow_isPrimitive_of_coprime.text:
theorem pow_isPrimitive_of_coprime (hn : 1 ≤ n) {m : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime m p)

PAG10::sq_isPrimitive'.text:
theorem sq_isPrimitive' (hodd : Odd p) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))

PAG10::pow_p_factorsThrough.text:
theorem pow_p_factorsThrough (hn : 1 ≤ n) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    (χ ^ p).FactorsThrough (p ^ n)

PAG10::pow_p_not_isPrimitive.text:
theorem pow_p_not_isPrimitive (hn : 1 ≤ n) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    ¬ (χ ^ p).IsPrimitive

PAG11::ind_sum_eq_one.text:
theorem ind_sum_eq_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {X W : Type*} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (shell : X → W) : ∑ w : W, ind shell (fun _ => (1 : R)) w = 1

PAG11::Bcv_idempotent_orthogonal.text:
theorem Bcv_idempotent_orthogonal {W : Type*} [DecidableEq W] (F : B ≃ₗ[K] B) (α : K)
    (e : W → B) (c : W → K) (he : ∀ w₀ w₁, e w₀ * e w₁ = if w₀ = w₁ then c w₀ • e w₀ else 0)
    {w₀ w₁ : W} (h : w₀ ≠ w₁) :
    Bcv F α ((α * c w₀)⁻¹ • F.symm (e w₀)) ((α * c w₁)⁻¹ • F.symm (e w₁)) = 0

PAG11::Bcv_unit.text:
theorem Bcv_unit (F : B ≃ₗ[K] B) {α : K} (hα : α ≠ 0) (f : B) :
    Bcv F α (α⁻¹ • F.symm 1) f = f

PAG11::sum_idempotent_eq_unit.text:
theorem sum_idempotent_eq_unit {X W : Type*} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] (shell : X → W)
    (F : (X → K) ≃ₗ[K] (X → K)) (α : K) :
    ∑ w : W, (α * 1)⁻¹ • F.symm (ind shell (fun _ => (1 : K)) w) = α⁻¹ • F.symm 1

PAG11::one_add_pow_of_cube_zero.text:
theorem one_add_pow_of_cube_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (d : R) (hd : d * d * d = 0) (m : ℕ) :
    (1 + d) ^ m = 1 + (m : R) * d + (m.choose 2 : R) * (d * d)

PAG11::one_add_pow_p.text:
omit hp in
theorem one_add_pow_p (hodd : Odd p) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (q : ℕ) :
    (1 + ((q * p ^ (n - 1) : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))) ^ p
      = 1 + ((q * p ^ n : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))

PAG11::pow_p_not_factorsThrough_le.text:
theorem pow_p_not_factorsThrough_le (hodd : Odd p) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n - 1) :

PAG11::pow_p_not_factorsThrough_pred.text:
theorem pow_p_not_factorsThrough_pred (hodd : Odd p) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ¬ (χ ^ p).FactorsThrough (p ^ (n - 1))

PAG11::conductor_pow_p_eq.text:
theorem conductor_pow_p_eq (hodd : Odd p) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (χ ^ p).conductor = p ^ n

PAG12::one_add_pow_expand.text:
theorem one_add_pow_expand (hp2 : 2 ≤ p) (d : ℤ) :
    (1 + d) ^ p = 1 + p * d + ∑ m ∈ range (p - 1), d ^ (m + 2) * (p.choose (m + 2) : ℤ)

PAG12::key_binom.text:
theorem key_binom (hp : p.Prime) (hodd : Odd p) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (d : ℤ)
    (hd : (p : ℤ) ^ k ∣ d) : (p : ℤ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (1 + d) ^ p - 1 - p * d

PAG12::pow_p_congr.text:
theorem pow_p_congr (hp : p.Prime) (hodd : Odd p) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x t : ℤ)
    (hx : x - 1 = (p : ℤ) ^ k * t) : ∃ s, x ^ p - 1 = (p : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) * t + (p : ℤ) ^ (k + 2) * s

PAG12::pow_p_pow_congr.text:
theorem pow_p_pow_congr (hp : p.Prime) (hodd : Odd p) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x t s₀ : ℤ)
    (hx : x - 1 = (p : ℤ) ^ k * t + (p : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) * s₀) (r : ℕ) :
    ∃ s, x ^ (p ^ r) - 1 = (p : ℤ) ^ (k + r) * t + (p : ℤ) ^ (k + r + 1) * s

PAG12::pow_p_pow_dvd.text:
theorem pow_p_pow_dvd (hp : p.Prime) (hodd : Odd p) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x : ℤ)
    (hx : (p : ℤ) ^ k ∣ x - 1) (r : ℕ) : (p : ℤ) ^ (k + r) ∣ x ^ (p ^ r) - 1

PAG12::zmod_pow_pr_eq_one.text:
theorem zmod_pow_pr_eq_one (hodd : Odd p) {j r : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjr : n + 1 ≤ j + r)
    (hdj : p ^ j ∣ p ^ (n + 1)) (u : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hu : ZMod.castHom hdj (ZMod (p ^ j)) u = 1) : u ^ (p ^ r) = 1

PAG12::pow_pr_factorsThrough.text:
theorem pow_pr_factorsThrough (hodd : Odd p) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ n) (m : ℕ)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).FactorsThrough (p ^ (n + 1 - r))

PAG12::pow_pr_factorsThrough_p.text:
theorem pow_pr_factorsThrough_p (hodd : Odd p) {r : ℕ} (hr : n ≤ r) (m : ℕ)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) : (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).FactorsThrough p

PAG12::pow_pr_not_factorsThrough.text:
theorem pow_pr_not_factorsThrough (hodd : Odd p) (hn : 1 ≤ n) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ n - 1)
    {m : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime m p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n - r) : ¬ (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).FactorsThrough (p ^ j)

PAG12::conductor_pow_pr.text:
theorem conductor_pow_pr (hodd : Odd p) (hn : 1 ≤ n) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ n - 1)
    {m : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime m p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).conductor = p ^ (n + 1 - r)

PAG12::conductor_pow_pr_dvd_p.text:
theorem conductor_pow_pr_dvd_p (hodd : Odd p) {r : ℕ} (hr : n ≤ r) (m : ℕ)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) : (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).conductor ∣ p

PAG12::conductor_pow_pr_tame.text:
theorem conductor_pow_pr_tame (hodd : Odd p) {r : ℕ} (hr : n ≤ r) (m : ℕ)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h : χ ^ (p ^ r * m) ≠ 1) :
    (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).conductor = p

PAG13::pow_totient_eq_one.text:
theorem pow_totient_eq_one (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    χ ^ (p ^ n * (p - 1)) = 1

PAG13::orderOf_dvd_totient.text:
theorem orderOf_dvd_totient (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    orderOf χ ∣ p ^ n * (p - 1)

PAG13::orderOf_ne_zero.text: theorem orderOf_ne_zero (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) : orderOf χ ≠ 0

PAG13::pow_dvd_orderOf.text:
theorem pow_dvd_orderOf (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : p ^ n ∣ orderOf χ

PAG13::tameOrder.text: noncomputable def tameOrder (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) : ℕ := orderOf χ / p ^ n

PAG13::orderOf_eq.text:
theorem orderOf_eq (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    orderOf χ = p ^ n * tameOrder χ

PAG13::tameOrder_dvd.text:
theorem tameOrder_dvd (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    tameOrder χ ∣ p - 1

PAG13::tameOrder_coprime.text:
theorem tameOrder_coprime (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : Nat.Coprime (tameOrder χ) p

PAG13::pow_eq_one_iff.text:
theorem pow_eq_one_iff (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    {r m : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime m p) :
    χ ^ (p ^ r * m) = 1 ↔ n ≤ r ∧ tameOrder χ ∣ m

PAG13::conductor_wild.text:
theorem conductor_wild (hodd : Odd p) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {r m : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime m p) (hr : r < n) :
    (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).conductor = p ^ (n + 1 - r)

PAG13::conductor_tame_one.text:
theorem conductor_tame_one (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {r m : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime m p) (hr : n ≤ r) (hd : ¬ tameOrder χ ∣ m) :
    (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).conductor = p

PAG13::conductor_tame_zero.text:
theorem conductor_tame_zero (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {r m : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime m p) (hr : n ≤ r) (hd : tameOrder χ ∣ m) :
    (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).conductor = 1

PAG14::orderOf_pow_pn_eq_tameOrder.text:
theorem orderOf_pow_pn_eq_tameOrder (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : orderOf (χ ^ (p ^ n)) = tameOrder χ

PAG14::tameOrder_pos.text:
theorem tameOrder_pos (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : 0 < tameOrder χ

PAG14::conductor_pow_pn_dvd_p.text:
theorem conductor_pow_pn_dvd_p (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    (χ ^ (p ^ n)).conductor ∣ p

PAG14::tameOrder_eq_one_iff.text:
theorem tameOrder_eq_one_iff (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : tameOrder χ = 1 ↔ χ ^ (p ^ n) = 1

PAG14::tameOrder_eq_one_iff_conductor.text:
theorem tameOrder_eq_one_iff_conductor (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : tameOrder χ = 1 ↔ (χ ^ (p ^ n)).conductor = 1

PAG14::one_lt_tameOrder_iff.text:
theorem one_lt_tameOrder_iff (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : 1 < tameOrder χ ↔ (χ ^ (p ^ n)).conductor = p

PAG14::cascade_wild.text:
theorem cascade_wild (hodd : Odd p) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {r m : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime m p) (hr : r < n)
    {K v : ℤ} (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hvK : v + (n + 1) ≤ K) :
    (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).conductor = p ^ (n + 1 - r) ∧
      D K ((n + 1 - r : ℕ) : ℤ) (D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v) = v + r ∧
      (r : ℤ) ≤ D K ((n + 1 - r : ℕ) : ℤ) (D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v) ∧
      D K ((n + 1 - r : ℕ) : ℤ) (D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v) ≤ K - ((n + 1 - r : ℕ) : ℤ)

PAG14::cascade_tame.text:
theorem cascade_tame (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {r m : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime m p) (hr : n ≤ r) (hd : ¬ tameOrder χ ∣ m)
    {K v : ℤ} (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hvK : v + (n + 1) ≤ K) :
    (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).conductor = p ∧
      D K 1 (D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v) = v + n ∧
      (n : ℤ) ≤ D K 1 (D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v) ∧ D K 1 (D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v) ≤ K - 1

PAG14::cascade_radial.text:
theorem cascade_radial (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {r m : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime m p) (hr : n ≤ r) (hd : tameOrder χ ∣ m)
    {K v : ℤ} (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hvK : v + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    {R A : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (F : A ≃ₗ[R] A) (α : R) (e : A) (c : R)
    (he : e * e = c • e) :
    χ ^ (p ^ r * m) = 1 ∧ (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).conductor = 1 ∧
      0 ≤ D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v ∧ D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v ≤ K - ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, PAG.Part10.cvpow F α (F.symm e) k = (α * c) ^ k • F.symm e

PAG14::epsBall.text: def epsBall (P : ℕ → R) (K w : ℕ) : R := if w < K then P w - P (w + 1) else P K

PAG14::sum_epsBall.text: theorem sum_epsBall (P : ℕ → R) (K : ℕ) : ∑ w ∈ range (K + 1), epsBall P K w = P 0

PAG14::epsBall_mul.text:
theorem epsBall_mul (P : ℕ → R) (K : ℕ) (habs : ∀ a b, a ≤ b → b ≤ K → P a * P b = P b)
    {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ K) (hb : b ≤ K) :
    epsBall P K a * epsBall P K b = if a = b then epsBall P K a else 0

PAG14::sum_epsBall_eq_one.text:
theorem sum_epsBall_eq_one (P : ℕ → R) (K : ℕ) (h0 : P 0 = 1) :
    ∑ w ∈ range (K + 1), epsBall P K w = 1

PAG14::stationary_phase.text:
theorem stationary_phase (A y : ZMod M) :
    ∑ t : ZMod M, ZMod.stdAddChar (-A * t) * ZMod.stdAddChar (y * t)
      = if y = A then (M : ℂ) else 0

PAG14::lift_invariance.text:
theorem lift_invariance (A : (ZMod M)ˣ) (r : ZMod M) :
    ZMod.stdAddChar (-(A : ZMod M) * (r * ((A⁻¹ : (ZMod M)ˣ) : ZMod M))) * ZMod.stdAddChar r = 1

PAG15::conv.text: def conv (f g : G → K) : G → K := fun x => ∑ y, f y * g (x - y)

PAG15::conv_comm.text: theorem conv_comm (f g : G → K) : conv f g = conv g f

PAG15::convL.text:
def convL : (G → K) →ₗ[K] (G → K) →ₗ[K] (G → K) :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ K conv
    (fun f₁ f₂ g => by funext x; simp [conv, add_mul, sum_add_distrib])
    (fun c f g => by funext x; simp [conv, mul_sum, mul_assoc])
    (fun f g₁ g₂ => by funext x; simp [conv, mul_add, sum_add_distrib])
    (fun c f g => by funext x; simp [conv, mul_sum, mul_left_comm])

PAG15::convL_apply.text: theorem convL_apply (f g : G → K) : convL f g = conv f g

PAG15::conv_smul_smul.text: theorem conv_smul_smul (a b : K) (f g : G → K) : conv (a • f) (b • g) = (a * b) • conv f g

PAG15::indH.text:
open Classical in
noncomputable def indH (H : AddSubgroup G) : G → K := fun x => if x ∈ H then 1 else 0

PAG15::cardH.text:
open Classical in
noncomputable def cardH (H : AddSubgroup G) : ℕ := (univ.filter (fun y => y ∈ H)).card

PAG15::cardH_pos.text: theorem cardH_pos (H : AddSubgroup G) : 0 < cardH H

PAG15::conv_ind_addSubgroup.text:
theorem conv_ind_addSubgroup {H₁ H₂ : AddSubgroup G} (h : H₁ ≤ H₂) (x : G) :
    conv (indH (K := K) H₁) (indH H₂) x = (cardH H₁ : K) * indH H₂ x

PAG15::ballAvg.text: noncomputable def ballAvg (H : AddSubgroup G) : G → K := ((cardH H : K))⁻¹ • indH H

PAG15::ball_avg_absorb.text:
theorem ball_avg_absorb [CharZero K] {H₁ H₂ : AddSubgroup G} (h : H₁ ≤ H₂) :
    conv (ballAvg (K := K) H₁) (ballAvg H₂) = ballAvg H₂

PAG15::ball_avg_absorb'.text:
theorem ball_avg_absorb' [CharZero K] {H₁ H₂ : AddSubgroup G} (h : H₁ ≤ H₂) :
    conv (ballAvg (K := K) H₂) (ballAvg H₁) = ballAvg H₂

PAG15::epsBall_bilin.text:
theorem epsBall_bilin {M : Type*} [CommRing M] [Module K M] (μ : M →ₗ[K] M →ₗ[K] M)
    (P : ℕ → M) (Kc : ℕ) (habs : ∀ a b, a ≤ b → b ≤ Kc → μ (P a) (P b) = P b ∧ μ (P b) (P a) = P b)
    {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ Kc) (hb : b ≤ Kc) :
    μ (epsBall P Kc a) (epsBall P Kc b) = if a = b then epsBall P Kc a else 0

PAG15::ballEps_conv.text:
theorem ballEps_conv [CharZero K] (H : ℕ → AddSubgroup G) (hH : Monotone H) (Kc : ℕ)
    {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ Kc) (hb : b ≤ Kc) :
    conv (epsBall (fun w => ballAvg (K := K) (H w)) Kc a) (epsBall (fun w => ballAvg (H w)) Kc b)
      = if a = b then epsBall (fun w => ballAvg (H w)) Kc a else 0

PAG15::ballAvg_bot_conv.text: theorem ballAvg_bot_conv [CharZero K] (f : G → K) : conv (ballAvg (K := K) ⊥) f = f

PAG15::shellSize.text: def shellSize (p K v : ℕ) : ℕ := p ^ (K - 1 - v) * (p - 1)

PAG15::shellSize_eq.text: theorem shellSize_eq (p K v : ℕ) : shellSize p K v = p ^ (K - 1 - v) * shellSize p K (K - 1)

PAG15::shellSize_zero_mul.text: theorem shellSize_zero_mul (p K : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) : shellSize p K 0 * p = p ^ K * (p - 1)

PAG15::shellSize_ratio.text:
theorem shellSize_ratio (p K v : ℕ) (hv : v < K) :
    shellSize p K v * p ^ (2 * v) * p = p ^ K * shellSize p K (K - 1 - v)

PAG15::F_sq_eq_inv_p.text:
theorem F_sq_eq_inv_p (p K v : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hv : v < K) :
    ((shellSize p K v : ℝ) / shellSize p K (K - 1 - v)) * (p : ℝ) ^ (2 * v) / (p : ℝ) ^ K = 1 / p

PAG15::abs_F_eq.text:
theorem abs_F_eq (p K v : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hv : v < K) :
    Real.sqrt (((shellSize p K v : ℝ) / shellSize p K (K - 1 - v)) * (p : ℝ) ^ (2 * v) / (p : ℝ) ^ K)
      = (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹

PAG15::radial_column_unitary.text:
theorem radial_column_unitary (p : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (L : ℕ) :
    (1 : ℝ) / p + ∑ k ∈ range L, ((p : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 / (p : ℝ) ^ (k + 2) + ((p : ℝ) - 1) / (p : ℝ) ^ (L + 1) = 1

PAG15::Bcv_shift.text:
theorem Bcv_shift (F : A ≃ₗ[ℂ] A) (α c τ₁ τ₂ τ₁₂ : ℂ) (f₁ f₂ f₁₂ g₁ g₂ g₁₂ : A)
    (h₁ : F f₁ = τ₁ • g₁) (h₂ : F f₂ = τ₂ • g₂) (hg : g₁ * g₂ = c • g₁₂)
    (h₁₂ : F f₁₂ = τ₁₂ • g₁₂) (hτ : τ₁₂ ≠ 0) :
    PAG.Part10.Bcv F α f₁ f₂ = (α * c * (τ₁ * τ₂ / τ₁₂)) • f₁₂

PAG15::gauss_ratio_eq_jacobi.text:
theorem gauss_ratio_eq_jacobi (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hprim : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) (ψ : AddChar (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ℂ)
    (h12 : gaussSum (χ₁ * χ₂) ψ ≠ 0) :
    gaussSum χ₁ ψ * gaussSum χ₂ ψ / gaussSum (χ₁ * χ₂) ψ = PAG.Part7.J χ₁ χ₂

PAG15::Bcv_shift_jacobi.text:
theorem Bcv_shift_jacobi (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hprim : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) (ψ : AddChar (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ℂ)
    (h12 : gaussSum (χ₁ * χ₂) ψ ≠ 0) (F : A ≃ₗ[ℂ] A) (α c : ℂ) (f₁ f₂ f₁₂ g₁ g₂ g₁₂ : A)
    (h₁ : F f₁ = gaussSum χ₁ ψ • g₁) (h₂ : F f₂ = gaussSum χ₂ ψ • g₂) (hg : g₁ * g₂ = c • g₁₂)
    (h₁₂ : F f₁₂ = gaussSum (χ₁ * χ₂) ψ • g₁₂) :
    PAG.Part10.Bcv F α f₁ f₂ = (α * c * PAG.Part7.J χ₁ χ₂) • f₁₂

PAG16::isPrimitive_inv.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
theorem isPrimitive_inv {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : χ⁻¹.IsPrimitive

PAG16::gaussSum_ne_zero.text:
theorem gaussSum_ne_zero {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    gaussSum χ stdAddChar ≠ 0

PAG16::gauss_mul_gauss_inv_eq.text:
theorem gauss_mul_gauss_inv_eq {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    gaussSum χ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ⁻¹ stdAddChar = χ (-1) * N

PAG16::normSq_gaussSum.text:
theorem normSq_gaussSum {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    Complex.normSq (gaussSum χ stdAddChar) = N

PAG16::dft_conv.text: theorem dft_conv (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) : 𝓕 (PAG.Part15.conv f g) = 𝓕 f * 𝓕 g

PAG16::conv_eq_Bcv.text: theorem conv_eq_Bcv (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) : PAG.Part15.conv f g = PAG.Part10.Bcv 𝓕 1 f g

PAG16::conv_chars_eq_jacobi.text:
theorem conv_chars_eq_jacobi (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (h₁₂ : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (χ₁ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)) → ℂ) χ₂ = PAG.Part7.J χ₁ χ₂ • ((χ₁ * χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)) → ℂ)

PAG16::conv_char_inv.text:
omit hp in
theorem conv_char_inv (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (x : ZMod N) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (χ : ZMod N → ℂ) (χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) x
      = χ (-1) * ∑ k : ZMod N, stdAddChar (k * x) * (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (-k)

PAG17::block_sum_orth.text:
theorem block_sum_orth {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (B : M →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] R) (x y z : M) (c : R) (hx : B x z = c) (hy : B y z = -c) :
    B (x + y) z = 0

PAG17::glue_identity.text:
theorem glue_identity (p q : K) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) (s n u : M) :
    q⁻¹ • (s + u) - q⁻¹ • (n + u) = p⁻¹ • ((q / p)⁻¹ • s - (q / p)⁻¹ • n)

PAG17::equator_from_south.text:
theorem equator_from_south (p q : K) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) (s u : M) :
    q • (q⁻¹ • (s + u)) - (q / p) • ((q / p)⁻¹ • s) = u

PAG17::AS.text:
def AS {X : Type*} (Nn : Set X) : Submodule K (X → K) where
  carrier := {f | ∀ x ∈ Nn, f x = 0}
  add_mem' ha hb x hx := by simp [ha x hx, hb x hx]
  zero_mem' x _ := rfl
  smul_mem' c f hf x hx := by simp [hf x hx]

PAG17::AS_sup_AN.text:
theorem AS_sup_AN {X : Type*} (S Nn : Set X) (hdisj : Disjoint S Nn) :
    AS (K := K) Nn ⊔ AS S = ⊤

PAG17::AS_inf_AN.text:
theorem AS_inf_AN {X : Type*} (S E Nn : Set X) (hcover : ∀ x, x ∈ S ∨ x ∈ E ∨ x ∈ Nn)
    (hES : Disjoint E S) (hEN : Disjoint E Nn)
    (f : X → K) : f ∈ AS (K := K) Nn ⊓ AS S ↔ ∀ x, x ∉ E → f x = 0

PAG17::push.text: noncomputable def push (ι : H →+ G) (f : H → ℂ) : G → ℂ := Function.extend ι f 0

PAG17::sum_push_mul.text:
theorem sum_push_mul (ι : H →+ G) (hι : Function.Injective ι) (f : H → ℂ) (h : G → ℂ) :
    ∑ z : G, push ι f z * h z = ∑ y : H, f y * h (ι y)

PAG17::push_conv.text:
theorem push_conv (ι : H →+ G) (hι : Function.Injective ι) (f g : H → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (push ι f) (push ι g) = push ι (PAG.Part15.conv f g)

PAG17::sum_comp_surj.text:
theorem sum_comp_surj [DecidableEq H] (π : G →+ H) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (F : H → ℂ) :
    ∑ z : G, F (π z) = ((univ.filter (fun z : G => π z = 0)).card : ℂ) * ∑ h : H, F h

PAG17::conv_pullback.text:
theorem conv_pullback [DecidableEq H] (π : G →+ H) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (f g : H → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (f ∘ π) (g ∘ π)
      = ((univ.filter (fun z : G => π z = 0)).card : ℂ) • (PAG.Part15.conv f g ∘ π)

PAG17::dft_pullback_eq_zero.text:
theorem dft_pullback_eq_zero (h : M ∣ M') (f : ZMod M → ℂ) (k : ZMod M')
    (hk : (M : ZMod M') * k ≠ 0) : 𝓕 (fun x => f (ZMod.castHom h (ZMod M) x)) k = 0

PAG17::conv_shell_chars.text:
theorem conv_shell_chars {L : Type*} [AddCommGroup L] [Fintype L]
    (ι : L →+ G) (hι : Function.Injective ι) (π : L →+ ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (h₁₂ : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (push ι (χ₁ ∘ π)) (push ι (χ₂ ∘ π))
      = (((univ.filter (fun z : L => π z = 0)).card : ℂ) * PAG.Part7.J χ₁ χ₂) •
          push ι ((χ₁ * χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) ∘ π)

PAG17::shellEmb.text:
noncomputable def shellEmb (K v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ K) : ZMod (p ^ (K - v)) →+ ZMod (p ^ K) :=
  ZMod.lift (p ^ (K - v)) ⟨(p ^ v : ZMod (p ^ K)) • (Int.castAddHom (ZMod (p ^ K))), by
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.smul_apply, Int.castAddHom, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk,
      Int.cast_natCast, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← Nat.cast_pow, ← Nat.cast_mul, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hv, ZMod.natCast_self]⟩

PAG17::shellEmb_apply.text:
theorem shellEmb_apply (K v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ K) (x : ZMod (p ^ (K - v))) :
    shellEmb (p := p) K v hv x = ((p ^ v * x.val : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ K))

PAG17::shellEmb_injective.text: theorem shellEmb_injective (K v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ K) : Function.Injective (shellEmb (p := p) K v hv)

PAG17::conv_shell_chars_zmod.text:
theorem conv_shell_chars_zmod (K v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ K) (hc : p ^ (n + 1) ∣ p ^ (K - v))
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (h₁₂ : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) :
    let π

PAG17::conv_normalized.text:
theorem conv_normalized {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Fintype X] (a qJ : ℂ) (F₁ F₂ F₁₂ : X → ℂ)
    (h : PAG.Part15.conv F₁ F₂ = qJ • F₁₂) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (a • F₁) (a • F₂) = (a * qJ) • (a • F₁₂)

PAG18::stdAddChar_scale.text:
theorem stdAddChar_scale (N M d : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero M] (hN : N = M * d) (hd : d ≠ 0) (j : ℤ) :
    stdAddChar (((d : ℤ) * j : ℤ) : ZMod N) = stdAddChar ((j : ℤ) : ZMod M)

PAG18::dft_push.text:
theorem dft_push (K v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ K) (f : ZMod (p ^ (K - v)) → ℂ) (k : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    have : NeZero (p ^ K)

PAG18::inv_pullback.text:
theorem inv_pullback {N M : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (π : ZMod N →+* ZMod M) (h : ∀ x, χ x = ψ (π x)) (x : ZMod N) : χ⁻¹ x = ψ⁻¹ (π x)

PAG18::conv_chars_descent.text:
theorem conv_chars_descent (n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (χ₁ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)) → ℂ) χ₂
      = (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar / gaussSum ψ stdAddChar) •
          push (shellEmb (p := p) (n + 1) v (by omega)) (ψ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1 - v)) → ℂ)

PAG18::normSq_descent_coef.text:
theorem normSq_descent_coef (n v : ℕ) (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    Complex.normSq (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar / gaussSum ψ stdAddChar)
      = ((p ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((p ^ (n + 1 - v) : ℕ) : ℝ)

PAG18::push_smul.text:
theorem push_smul {G H : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup H] (ι : H →+ G)
    (hι : Function.Injective ι) (a : ℂ) (f : H → ℂ) : push ι (a • f) = a • push ι f

PAG18::conv_shell_general.text:
theorem conv_shell_general {G L H : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [AddCommGroup L] [Fintype L]
    [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H]
    (ι : L →+ G) (hι : Function.Injective ι) (π : L →+ H) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (f g : H → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (push ι (f ∘ π)) (push ι (g ∘ π))
      = ((univ.filter (fun z : L => π z = 0)).card : ℂ) • push ι (PAG.Part15.conv f g ∘ π)

PAG18::conv_shell_descent.text:
theorem conv_shell_descent {G L : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [AddCommGroup L] [Fintype L]
    (ι : L →+ G) (hι : Function.Injective ι) (n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n)
    (π : L →+ ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (push ι ((χ₁ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)) → ℂ) ∘ π)) (push ι ((χ₂ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)) → ℂ) ∘ π))
      = (((univ.filter (fun z : L => π z = 0)).card : ℂ) *
          (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar / gaussSum ψ stdAddChar)) •
        push ι (push (shellEmb (p := p) (n + 1) v (by omega)) (ψ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1 - v)) → ℂ) ∘ π)

PAG19::ram.text:
noncomputable def ram (x : ZMod N) : ℂ :=
  ∑ k : ZMod N, stdAddChar (k * x) * (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (-k)

PAG19::conv_char_inv_fun.text:
theorem conv_char_inv_fun (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (χ : ZMod N → ℂ) (χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) = χ (-1) • (ram (N := N))

PAG19::conv_shell_inv.text:
theorem conv_shell_inv {G L : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [AddCommGroup L] [Fintype L]
    (ι : L →+ G) (hι : Function.Injective ι) (π : L →+ ZMod N) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (push ι ((χ : ZMod N → ℂ) ∘ π)) (push ι (((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : ZMod N → ℂ) ∘ π))
      = (((univ.filter (fun z : L => π z = 0)).card : ℂ) * χ (-1)) • push ι (ram (N := N) ∘ π)

PAG19::card_eq_ker_mul.text:
theorem card_eq_ker_mul {G H : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H]
    [DecidableEq H] (π : G →+ H) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) :
    (Fintype.card G : ℂ) = ((univ.filter (fun z : G => π z = 0)).card : ℂ) * Fintype.card H

PAG19::card_ker_castHom.text:
theorem card_ker_castHom (p m c : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hc : c ≤ m) :
    have : NeZero (p ^ m)

PAG19::sz.text: def sz (p K u : ℕ) : ℕ := p ^ (K - 1 - u) * (p - 1)

PAG19::coef_identity.text:
theorem coef_identity (p K c w v c'' a : ℕ) (hc : c = v + c'' + 1) (hK : K = w + c + a) :
    sz p K (w + v) * (p ^ (K - w - c)) ^ 2 * p ^ (c + v) * sz p K (K - c - w) = p ^ K * (sz p K w) ^ 2

PAG19::coef_identity_real.text:
theorem coef_identity_real (p K c w v c'' a : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hc : c = v + c'' + 1) (hK : K = w + c + a) :
    (sz p K (w + v) : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) ^ (K - w - c)) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ) ^ (c + v) / (sz p K w : ℝ) ^ 2
      = (p : ℝ) ^ K / sz p K (K - c - w)

PAG19::not_isUnit_iff_mem_range.text:
theorem not_isUnit_iff_mem_range (k : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    ¬ IsUnit k ↔ ∃ j, shellEmb (p := p) (n + 1) 1 (by omega) j = k

PAG19::one_neg_eq.text:
theorem one_neg_eq (k : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (-k)
      = 1 - push (shellEmb (p := p) (n + 1) 1 (by omega)) (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) k

PAG20::coef_sqrt.text:
theorem coef_sqrt (p K c w v c'' a : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hc : c = v + c'' + 1) (hK : K = w + c + a) :
    ((p : ℝ) ^ (K - w - c)) * Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (c + v)) / (sz p K w : ℝ)
      = Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - c - w) : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt (sz p K (w + v) : ℝ)

PAG20::thmA_normalized.text:
theorem thmA_normalized (K w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    have : NeZero (p ^ (K - w))

PAG20::normSq_Jt.text:
theorem normSq_Jt (n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    Complex.normSq (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar /
      (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar * ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 + v)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) = 1

PAG20::thmB_normalized.text:
theorem thmB_normalized (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    have : NeZero (p ^ (K - w))

PAG21::castHom_eq_natCast.text:
theorem castHom_eq_natCast {m n : ℕ} (h : m ∣ n) (y : ZMod n) [NeZero n] :
    ZMod.castHom h (ZMod m) y = ((y.val : ℕ) : ZMod m)

PAG21::push_apply_emb.text:
theorem push_apply_emb {G H : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup H] (ι : H →+ G)
    (hι : Function.Injective ι) (f : H → ℂ) (y : H) : push ι f (ι y) = f y

PAG21::push_apply_not.text:
theorem push_apply_not {G H : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup H] (ι : H →+ G)
    (f : H → ℂ) (x : G) (hx : ¬ ∃ y, ι y = x) : push ι f x = 0

PAG21::push_comp.text:
theorem push_comp (K w c v : ℕ) (hw : w + c ≤ K) (hv : v ≤ c) (f : ZMod (p ^ (c - v)) → ℂ) :
    push (shellEmb (p := p) K w (by omega))
        (push (shellEmb (p := p) c v hv) f ∘
          (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c ≤ K - w)) (ZMod (p ^ c))).toAddMonoidHom)
      = push (shellEmb (p := p) K (w + v) (by omega))
          (f ∘ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c - v ≤ K - (w + v))) (ZMod (p ^ (c - v)))).toAddMonoidHom)

PAG21::ket.text:
noncomputable def ket (K u c : ℕ) (huc : u + c ≤ K) (χ : ZMod (p ^ c) → ℂ) : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  have : NeZero (p ^ (K - u)) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hp.out.ne_zero⟩
  (((Real.sqrt (sz p K u))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    push (shellEmb (p := p) K u (by omega))
      (χ ∘ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c ≤ K - u)) (ZMod (p ^ c))).toAddMonoidHom)

PAG21::thmA_ket.text:
theorem thmA_ket (K w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)
      = ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)) : ℝ) *
          (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar /
            (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar * ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 + v)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) : ℂ) •
        ket K (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) ψ

PAG22::ball.text: noncomputable def ball (K j : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ := fun x => if p ^ j ∣ x.val then 1 else 0

PAG22::val_shellEmb.text:
theorem val_shellEmb (K w : ℕ) (hw : w ≤ K) (y : ZMod (p ^ (K - w))) :
    (shellEmb (p := p) K w hw y).val = (p ^ w * y.val) % p ^ K

PAG22::dvd_val_shellEmb.text:
theorem dvd_val_shellEmb (K w j : ℕ) (hw : w ≤ K) (hj : w + j ≤ K) (y : ZMod (p ^ (K - w))) :
    p ^ (w + j) ∣ (shellEmb (p := p) K w hw y).val ↔ p ^ j ∣ y.val

PAG22::mem_range_iff.text:
theorem mem_range_iff (K w : ℕ) (hw : w ≤ K) (x : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    (∃ y, shellEmb (p := p) K w hw y = x) ↔ p ^ w ∣ x.val

PAG22::push_ball.text:
theorem push_ball (K w j : ℕ) (hw : w ≤ K) (hj : w + j ≤ K) (a : ℂ) :
    push (shellEmb (p := p) K w hw) (fun y : ZMod (p ^ (K - w)) => if p ^ j ∣ y.val then a else 0)
      = a • ball (p := p) K (w + j)

PAG22::ram_pull.text:
theorem ram_pull (M n : ℕ) (hM : n + 1 ≤ M) (y : ZMod (p ^ M)) :
    ram (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p hM) (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) y)
      = (if p ^ (n + 1) ∣ y.val then ((p ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0)
        - (if p ^ (n + 1 - 1) ∣ y.val then ((p ^ (n + 1 - 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0)

PAG22::push_sub.text:
theorem push_sub {G H : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup H] (ι : H →+ G)
    (hι : Function.Injective ι) (f g : H → ℂ) : push ι (f - g) = push ι f - push ι g

PAG22::thmB_balls.text:
theorem thmB_balls (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      = (((p : ℂ) ^ (K - w - (n + 1)) / (sz p K w : ℂ)) * χ (-1)) •
          (((p ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) • ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1))
            - ((p ^ (n + 1 - 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) • ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1 - 1)))

PAG22::thmB_closed.text:
theorem thmB_closed (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      = χ (-1) • (ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1))
          - ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹ • (ball (p := p) K (w + n) - ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1))))

PAG23::P1F.text: abbrev P1F (N : ℕ) := (ZMod N → ℂ) × (ZMod N → ℂ)

PAG23::Compat.text: def Compat (F : P1F N) : Prop := ∀ y : ZMod N, IsUnit y → F.2 y = F.1 y⁻¹

PAG23::W.text: def W (F : P1F N) : P1F N := (F.2, F.1)

PAG23::W_W.text: theorem W_W (F : P1F N) : W (W F) = F

PAG23::inv_inv_of_unit.text: theorem inv_inv_of_unit {y : ZMod N} (hy : IsUnit y) : IsUnit y⁻¹ ∧ (y⁻¹)⁻¹ = y

PAG23::compat_W.text: theorem compat_W {F : P1F N} (hF : Compat F) : Compat (W F)

PAG23::extS.text:
open Classical in
noncomputable def extS (h : ZMod N → ℂ) : P1F N := (h, fun y => if IsUnit y then h y⁻¹ else 0)

PAG23::extN.text:
open Classical in
noncomputable def extN (h : ZMod N → ℂ) : P1F N := (fun x => if IsUnit x then h x⁻¹ else 0, h)

PAG23::compat_extS.text: theorem compat_extS (h : ZMod N → ℂ) : Compat (extS h)

PAG23::compat_extN.text: theorem compat_extN (h : ZMod N → ℂ) : Compat (extN h)

PAG23::W_extS.text: theorem W_extS (h : ZMod N → ℂ) : W (extS h) = extN h

PAG23::extS_smul.text: theorem extS_smul (a : ℂ) (h : ZMod N → ℂ) : extS (a • h) = a • extS h

PAG23::extN_smul.text: theorem extN_smul (a : ℂ) (h : ZMod N → ℂ) : extN (a • h) = a • extN h

PAG23::BS.text: noncomputable def BS (F G : P1F N) : P1F N := extS (PAG.Part15.conv F.1 G.1)

PAG23::BN.text: noncomputable def BN (F G : P1F N) : P1F N := W (BS (W F) (W G))

PAG23::BN_eq.text: theorem BN_eq (F G : P1F N) : BN F G = extN (PAG.Part15.conv F.2 G.2)

PAG23::kS.text:
noncomputable def kS (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) : P1F (p ^ K) :=
  extS (ket K w c h χ)

PAG23::kN.text:
noncomputable def kN (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) : P1F (p ^ K) :=
  extN (ket K w c h ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) : ZMod (p ^ c) → ℂ))

PAG23::W_kS.text:
theorem W_kS (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    W (kS K w c h χ) = kN K w c h χ⁻¹

PAG23::Jt_inv.text:
theorem Jt_inv (n v : ℕ) (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v)))
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    gaussSum χ₁⁻¹ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂⁻¹ stdAddChar /
        (gaussSum ψ⁻¹ stdAddChar * ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 + v)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      = starRingEnd ℂ (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar /
        (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar * ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 + v)) : ℝ) : ℂ)))

PAG23::mirror_thmA.text:
theorem mirror_thmA (K w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    BN (kN K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (kN K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)
      = ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)) : ℝ) *
          starRingEnd ℂ (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar /
            (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar * ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 + v)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) : ℂ) •
        kN K (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) ψ

PAG24::isUnit_of_castHom.text:
theorem isUnit_of_castHom {K c : ℕ} (hc1 : 1 ≤ c) (hcK : c ≤ K) (x : ZMod (p ^ K))
    (h : IsUnit (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p hcK) (ZMod (p ^ c)) x)) : IsUnit x

PAG24::ket0_apply.text:
theorem ket0_apply (K c : ℕ) (h : 0 + c ≤ K) (f : ZMod (p ^ c) → ℂ) (x : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    ket K 0 c h f x = (((Real.sqrt (sz p K 0))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      f (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c ≤ K)) (ZMod (p ^ c)) x)

PAG24::chi_cast_inv.text:
omit hp in
theorem chi_cast_inv {K c : ℕ} (hcK : c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) {x : ZMod (p ^ K)}
    (hx : IsUnit x) :
    χ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p hcK) (ZMod (p ^ c)) x⁻¹)
      = χ⁻¹ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p hcK) (ZMod (p ^ c)) x)

PAG24::chi_cast_nonunit.text:
theorem chi_cast_nonunit {K c : ℕ} (hc1 : 1 ≤ c) (hcK : c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    {x : ZMod (p ^ K)} (hx : ¬ IsUnit x) : χ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p hcK) (ZMod (p ^ c)) x) = 0

PAG24::kS0_eq_kN0.text:
theorem kS0_eq_kN0 (K c : ℕ) (hc1 : 1 ≤ c) (h : 0 + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    kS K 0 c h χ = kN K 0 c h χ

PAG24::J_inv.text:
theorem J_inv {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    PAG.Part7.J χ₁⁻¹ χ₂⁻¹ = starRingEnd ℂ (PAG.Part7.J χ₁ χ₂)

PAG24::equator_south.text:
theorem equator_south (K : ℕ) (h : 0 + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (h₁₂ : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) :
    BS (kS K 0 (n + 1) h χ₁) (kS K 0 (n + 1) h χ₂)
      = ((((Real.sqrt (sz p K 0))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((p ^ (K - (n + 1)) : ℕ) : ℂ) * PAG.Part7.J χ₁ χ₂)) •
          kS K 0 (n + 1) h (χ₁ * χ₂)

PAG24::equator_north.text:
theorem equator_north (K : ℕ) (h : 0 + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (h₁₂ : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) :
    BN (kN K 0 (n + 1) h χ₁) (kN K 0 (n + 1) h χ₂)
      = ((((Real.sqrt (sz p K 0))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (((p ^ (K - (n + 1)) : ℕ) : ℂ) * starRingEnd ℂ (PAG.Part7.J χ₁ χ₂))) •
          kN K 0 (n + 1) h (χ₁ * χ₂)

PAG24::equator_intertwine.text:
theorem equator_intertwine (K : ℕ) (h : 0 + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (h₁₂ : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) :
    BN (kS K 0 (n + 1) h χ₁) (kS K 0 (n + 1) h χ₂)
      = (starRingEnd ℂ (PAG.Part7.J χ₁ χ₂) / PAG.Part7.J χ₁ χ₂) •
          BS (kS K 0 (n + 1) h χ₁) (kS K 0 (n + 1) h χ₂)

PAG25::normSq_J.text:
theorem normSq_J (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (h₁₂ : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) :
    Complex.normSq (PAG.Part7.J χ₁ χ₂) = ((p ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)

PAG25::Jhat.text:
noncomputable def Jhat (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) : ℂ :=
  PAG.Part7.J χ₁ χ₂ / ((Real.sqrt ((p ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)

PAG25::normSq_Jhat.text:
theorem normSq_Jhat (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (h₁₂ : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) :
    Complex.normSq (Jhat χ₁ χ₂) = 1

PAG25::conjJ_div_J.text:
theorem conjJ_div_J (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (h₁₂ : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) :
    starRingEnd ℂ (PAG.Part7.J χ₁ χ₂) / PAG.Part7.J χ₁ χ₂ = (starRingEnd ℂ (Jhat χ₁ χ₂)) ^ 2

PAG25::equator_intertwine_hat.text:
theorem equator_intertwine_hat (K : ℕ) (h : 0 + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (h₁₂ : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) :
    BN (kS K 0 (n + 1) h χ₁) (kS K 0 (n + 1) h χ₂)
      = (starRingEnd ℂ (Jhat χ₁ χ₂)) ^ 2 • BS (kS K 0 (n + 1) h χ₁) (kS K 0 (n + 1) h χ₂)

PAG25::chi_inv_neg_one.text:
omit hp in
theorem chi_inv_neg_one {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : χ⁻¹ (-1) = χ (-1)

PAG25::cascade.text:
noncomputable def cascade (K w n : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1)) - ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹ • (ball (p := p) K (w + n) - ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1)))

PAG25::thmB_south.text:
theorem thmB_south (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    BS (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ) (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ⁻¹) = χ (-1) • extS (cascade (p := p) K w n)

PAG25::mirror_thmB.text:
theorem mirror_thmB (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    BN (kN K w (n + 1) hK χ) (kN K w (n + 1) hK χ⁻¹) = χ (-1) • extN (cascade (p := p) K w n)

PAG25::mirror_thmB_eq_W.text:
theorem mirror_thmB_eq_W (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    BN (W (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ⁻¹)) (W (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ))
      = W (χ (-1) • extS (cascade (p := p) K w n))

PAG25::isUnit_iff_not_dvd.text: theorem isUnit_iff_not_dvd {K : ℕ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (x : ZMod (p ^ K)) : IsUnit x ↔ ¬ p ∣ x.val

PAG25::Eq1.text:
open Classical in
noncomputable def Eq1 (N : ℕ) : P1F N := (fun x => if IsUnit x then 1 else 0, fun y => if IsUnit y then 1 else 0)

PAG25::extS_cascade00.text:
theorem extS_cascade00 (K : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) :
    extS (cascade (p := p) K 0 0) = extS (ball (p := p) K 1) - ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹ • Eq1 (p ^ K)

PAG25::extN_cascade00.text:
theorem extN_cascade00 (K : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) :
    extN (cascade (p := p) K 0 0) = extN (ball (p := p) K 1) - ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹ • Eq1 (p ^ K)

PAG25::equator_residue.text:
theorem equator_residue (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 + (0 + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (0 + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    BS (kS K 0 (0 + 1) hK χ) (kS K 0 (0 + 1) hK χ⁻¹) - χ (-1) • extS (ball (p := p) K 1)
      = -(χ (-1) * ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹) • Eq1 (p ^ K) ∧
    BN (kN K 0 (0 + 1) hK χ) (kN K 0 (0 + 1) hK χ⁻¹) - χ (-1) • extN (ball (p := p) K 1)
      = -(χ (-1) * ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹) • Eq1 (p ^ K)

PAG26::Pt.text: abbrev Pt (N : ℕ) := ZMod N ⊕ {y : ZMod N // ¬ IsUnit y}

PAG26::toP1.text:
noncomputable def toP1 (f : Pt N → ℂ) : P1F N :=
  (fun x => f (Sum.inl x), fun y => if h : IsUnit y then f (Sum.inl y⁻¹) else f (Sum.inr ⟨y, h⟩))

PAG26::ofP1.text:
def ofP1 (F : P1F N) : Pt N → ℂ
  | Sum.inl x => F.1 x
  | Sum.inr y => F.2 y.1

PAG26::compat_toP1.text: theorem compat_toP1 (f : Pt N → ℂ) : Compat (toP1 f)

PAG26::ofP1_toP1.text: theorem ofP1_toP1 (f : Pt N → ℂ) : ofP1 (toP1 f) = f

PAG26::toP1_ofP1.text: theorem toP1_ofP1 {F : P1F N} (hF : Compat F) : toP1 (ofP1 F) = F

PAG26::compatSub.text:
def compatSub (N : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ (P1F N) where
  carrier := {F | Compat F}
  add_mem' := fun {F G} hF hG y hy => by
    simp only [Prod.snd_add, Prod.fst_add, Pi.add_apply, hF y hy, hG y hy]
  zero_mem' := fun y _ => rfl
  smul_mem' := fun a {F} hF y hy => by
    simp only [Prod.smul_snd, Prod.smul_fst, Pi.smul_apply, hF y hy]

PAG26::ptEquiv.text:
noncomputable def ptEquiv (N : ℕ) : (Pt N → ℂ) ≃ₗ[ℂ] compatSub N where
  toFun f := ⟨toP1 f, compat_toP1 f⟩
  invFun F := ofP1 F.1
  map_add' f g := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext y
    · rfl
    · simp only [toP1, Pi.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add, Prod.snd_add]
      split_ifs <;> rfl
  map_smul' a f := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext y
    · rfl
    · simp only [toP1, Pi.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, Prod.smul_snd, RingHom.id_apply]
      split_ifs <;> rfl
  left_inv f := ofP1_toP1 f
  right_inv F := Subtype.ext (toP1_ofP1 F.2)

PAG26::Wpt.text:
noncomputable def Wpt : Pt N → Pt N
  | Sum.inl x => if h : IsUnit x then Sum.inl x⁻¹ else Sum.inr ⟨x, h⟩
  | Sum.inr y => Sum.inl y.1

PAG26::Wpt_Wpt.text: theorem Wpt_Wpt (z : Pt N) : Wpt (Wpt z) = z

PAG26::WptEquiv.text:
noncomputable def WptEquiv (N : ℕ) : Equiv.Perm (Pt N) :=
  Function.Involutive.toPerm Wpt Wpt_Wpt

PAG26::toP1_comp_Wpt.text: theorem toP1_comp_Wpt (f : Pt N → ℂ) : toP1 (f ∘ Wpt) = W (toP1 f)

PAG26::ofP1_W.text: theorem ofP1_W {F : P1F N} (hF : Compat F) : ofP1 (W F) = ofP1 F ∘ Wpt

PAG26::isUnitEquiv.text:
noncomputable def isUnitEquiv (N : ℕ) : {x : ZMod N // IsUnit x} ≃ (ZMod N)ˣ where
  toFun x := x.2.unit
  invFun u := ⟨u, u.isUnit⟩
  left_inv x := by simp
  right_inv u := by ext; simp

PAG26::card_Pt.text: theorem card_Pt (K : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) : Fintype.card (Pt (p ^ K)) = p ^ K + p ^ (K - 1)

PAG27::Unimod.text: def Unimod (N : ℕ) := {v : ZMod N × ZMod N // ∃ s t : ZMod N, s * v.1 + t * v.2 = 1}

PAG27::projSetoid.text:
def projSetoid (N : ℕ) : Setoid (Unimod N) where
  r v w := ∃ u : (ZMod N)ˣ, w.1.1 = u * v.1.1 ∧ w.1.2 = u * v.1.2
  iseqv := {
    refl := fun v => ⟨1, by simp, by simp⟩
    symm := fun {v w} ⟨u, h1, h2⟩ => ⟨u⁻¹, by rw [h1, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul],
      by rw [h2, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]⟩
    trans := fun {v w z} ⟨u, h1, h2⟩ ⟨u', h1', h2'⟩ => ⟨u' * u, by rw [h1', h1, Units.val_mul, mul_assoc],
      by rw [h2', h2, Units.val_mul, mul_assoc]⟩ }

PAG27::mk.text: def mk (v : Unimod N) : ProjLine N := Quotient.mk (projSetoid N) v

PAG27::mk_eq_mk.text:
theorem mk_eq_mk {v w : Unimod N} (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) (h1 : w.1.1 = u * v.1.1) (h2 : w.1.2 = u * v.1.2) :
    mk v = mk w

PAG27::unimod_iff.text:
theorem unimod_iff {K : ℕ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (a b : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    (∃ s t : ZMod (p ^ K), s * a + t * b = 1) ↔ IsUnit a ∨ IsUnit b

PAG27::isUnit_units_mul_iff.text:
omit hp in
theorem isUnit_units_mul_iff (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) (x : ZMod N) : IsUnit ((u : ZMod N) * x) ↔ IsUnit x

PAG27::scale_div.text:
omit hp in
theorem scale_div {u : (ZMod N)ˣ} {b : ZMod N} (hb : IsUnit b) (a : ZMod N) :
    (u * a) * ((u : ZMod N) * b)⁻¹ = a * b⁻¹

PAG27::nonunit_div.text:
omit hp in
theorem nonunit_div {a b : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) (hb : ¬ IsUnit b) : ¬ IsUnit (b * a⁻¹)

PAG27::toProj.text:
def toProj : Pt (p ^ K) → ProjLine (p ^ K)
  | Sum.inl x => mk ⟨(x, 1), 0, 1, by simp⟩
  | Sum.inr y => mk ⟨(1, y.1), 1, 0, by simp⟩

include hK in

PAG27::a_unit_of.text: theorem a_unit_of {v : Unimod (p ^ K)} (hb : ¬ IsUnit v.1.2) : IsUnit v.1.1

PAG27::ofRep.text:
noncomputable def ofRep (v : Unimod (p ^ K)) : Pt (p ^ K) :=
  if h : IsUnit v.1.2 then Sum.inl (v.1.1 * v.1.2⁻¹)
  else Sum.inr ⟨v.1.2 * v.1.1⁻¹, nonunit_div (a_unit_of K hK h) h⟩

include hK in

PAG27::ofRep_resp.text:
theorem ofRep_resp (v w : Unimod (p ^ K)) (hvw : (projSetoid (p ^ K)) v w) :
    ofRep K hK v = ofRep K hK w

PAG27::ofProj.text:
noncomputable def ofProj : ProjLine (p ^ K) → Pt (p ^ K) :=
  Quotient.lift (ofRep K hK) (ofRep_resp K hK)

PAG27::ofProj_toProj.text: theorem ofProj_toProj (z : Pt (p ^ K)) : ofProj K hK (toProj K z) = z

PAG27::toProj_ofProj.text: theorem toProj_ofProj (q : ProjLine (p ^ K)) : toProj K (ofProj K hK q) = q

PAG27::projEquiv.text:
noncomputable def projEquiv : Pt (p ^ K) ≃ ProjLine (p ^ K) where
  toFun := toProj K
  invFun := ofProj K hK
  left_inv := ofProj_toProj K hK
  right_inv := toProj_ofProj K hK

include hK in

PAG27::card_ProjLine.text: theorem card_ProjLine : Nat.card (ProjLine (p ^ K)) = p ^ K + p ^ (K - 1)

PAG27::swap_unimod.text:
omit hp in
theorem swap_unimod (v : Unimod N) : ∃ s t : ZMod N, s * v.1.2 + t * v.1.1 = 1

PAG27::Wproj_Wproj.text:
omit hp in
theorem Wproj_Wproj (q : ProjLine N) : Wproj (Wproj q) = q

PAG27::toProj_Wpt.text: theorem toProj_Wpt (K : ℕ) (z : Pt (p ^ K)) : toProj K (Wpt z) = Wproj (toProj K z)

PAG28::neZeroPow.text: instance neZeroPow (K : ℕ) : NeZero (p ^ K) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hp.out.ne_zero⟩

PAG28::projFunEquiv.text:
noncomputable def projFunEquiv : (ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) ≃ₗ[ℂ] compatSub (p ^ K) :=
  (LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft ℂ ℂ (projEquiv K hK)).trans (ptEquiv (p ^ K))

PAG28::projFun_eq.text:
theorem projFun_eq (Φ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    (projFunEquiv K hK Φ).1 = toP1 (Φ ∘ toProj K)

PAG28::projFun_south.text:
theorem projFun_south (Φ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) (x : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    (projFunEquiv K hK Φ).1.1 x = Φ (mk ⟨(x, 1), 0, 1, by simp⟩)

PAG28::mk_inv_eq.text:
omit hp in
theorem mk_inv_eq {N : ℕ} {y : ZMod N} (hy : IsUnit y) :
    (mk ⟨(y⁻¹, 1), 0, 1, by simp⟩ : ProjLine N) = mk ⟨(1, y), 1, 0, by simp⟩

PAG28::projFun_north.text:
theorem projFun_north (Φ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) (y : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    (projFunEquiv K hK Φ).1.2 y = Φ (mk ⟨(1, y), 1, 0, by simp⟩)

PAG28::Wpull.text: def Wpull {N : ℕ} (Φ : ProjLine N → ℂ) : ProjLine N → ℂ := Φ ∘ Wproj

PAG28::Wpull_Wpull.text:
omit hp in
theorem Wpull_Wpull {N : ℕ} (Φ : ProjLine N → ℂ) : Wpull (Wpull Φ) = Φ

PAG28::projFun_Wpull.text:
theorem projFun_Wpull (Φ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    (projFunEquiv K hK (Wpull Φ)).1 = W (projFunEquiv K hK Φ).1

PAG28::BSproj.text:
noncomputable def BSproj (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  (projFunEquiv K hK).symm
    ⟨BS (projFunEquiv K hK Φ).1 (projFunEquiv K hK Ψ).1, compat_extS _⟩

PAG28::BNproj.text:
noncomputable def BNproj (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  (projFunEquiv K hK).symm
    ⟨BN (projFunEquiv K hK Φ).1 (projFunEquiv K hK Ψ).1, compat_extN _⟩

PAG28::BSproj_south.text:
theorem BSproj_south (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) (x : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    BSproj K hK Φ Ψ (mk ⟨(x, 1), 0, 1, by simp⟩)
      = PAG.Part15.conv (fun z => Φ (mk ⟨(z, 1), 0, 1, by simp⟩))
          (fun z => Ψ (mk ⟨(z, 1), 0, 1, by simp⟩)) x

PAG28::BNproj_eq.text:
theorem BNproj_eq (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    BNproj K hK Φ Ψ = Wpull (BSproj K hK (Wpull Φ) (Wpull Ψ))

PAG28::shellInd.text:
noncomputable def shellInd (K u : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  if u < K then ball (p := p) K u - ball (p := p) K (u + 1) else ball (p := p) K K

PAG28::ball_eq_sum_shellInd.text:
omit hp in
theorem ball_eq_sum_shellInd (K m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ K) :
    ball (p := p) K m = ∑ u ∈ Ico m K, shellInd (p := p) K u + shellInd (p := p) K K

PAG28::eu.text:
noncomputable def eu (K u : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  if u < K then ((Real.sqrt (sz p K u) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ • shellInd (p := p) K u else shellInd (p := p) K K

PAG28::sqrt_sz_ne_zero.text: theorem sqrt_sz_ne_zero (K u : ℕ) : ((Real.sqrt (sz p K u) : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0

PAG28::shellInd_eq_eu.text:
theorem shellInd_eq_eu {K u : ℕ} (hu : u < K) :
    shellInd (p := p) K u = ((Real.sqrt (sz p K u) : ℝ) : ℂ) • eu (p := p) K u

PAG28::cascade_eu.text:
theorem cascade_eu (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) :
    cascade (p := p) K w n
      = (-(((Real.sqrt (sz p K (w + n)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹)) • eu (p := p) K (w + n)
        + ∑ u ∈ Ico (w + (n + 1)) K, ((Real.sqrt (sz p K u) : ℝ) : ℂ) • eu (p := p) K u
        + eu (p := p) K K

PAG28::thmB_eu.text:
theorem thmB_eu (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      = χ (-1) • ((-(((Real.sqrt (sz p K (w + n)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹)) • eu (p := p) K (w + n)
        + ∑ u ∈ Ico (w + (n + 1)) K, ((Real.sqrt (sz p K u) : ℝ) : ℂ) • eu (p := p) K u
        + eu (p := p) K K)

PAG28::Pavg.text: noncomputable def Pavg (K u : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ := ((p : ℂ) ^ u)⁻¹ • ball (p := p) K (K - u)

PAG28::cascade_eps.text:
theorem cascade_eps (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) :
    cascade (p := p) K w n
      = ((p : ℂ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℂ)) •
          PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K (K - (n + 1) - w)

PAG28::ket_eq_zero_of_isUnit.text:
theorem ket_eq_zero_of_isUnit (K u c' : ℕ) (h : u + c' ≤ K) (hu : 1 ≤ u) (ψ : ZMod (p ^ c') → ℂ)
    {x : ZMod (p ^ K)} (hx : IsUnit x) : ket K u c' h ψ x = 0

PAG28::kS_equator_zero.text:
theorem kS_equator_zero (K u c' : ℕ) (h : u + c' ≤ K) (hu : 1 ≤ u) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c'))
    {x : ZMod (p ^ K)} (hx : IsUnit x) : (kS K u c' h ψ).1 x = 0 ∧ (kS K u c' h ψ).2 x = 0

PAG28::kN_equator_zero.text:
theorem kN_equator_zero (K u c' : ℕ) (h : u + c' ≤ K) (hu : 1 ≤ u) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c'))
    {x : ZMod (p ^ K)} (hx : IsUnit x) : (kN K u c' h ψ).1 x = 0 ∧ (kN K u c' h ψ).2 x = 0

PAG28::thmA_south.text:
theorem thmA_south (K w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    BS (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)
      = ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)) : ℝ) *
          (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar /
            (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar * ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 + v)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) : ℂ) •
        kS K (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) ψ

PAG28::descent_equator_zero.text:
theorem descent_equator_zero (K w n v : ℕ) (hv1 : 1 ≤ v) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x))
    {x : ZMod (p ^ K)} (hx : IsUnit x) :
    (BS (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)).1 x = 0 ∧
    (BS (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)).2 x = 0 ∧
    (BN (kN K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (kN K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)).1 x = 0 ∧
    (BN (kN K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (kN K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)).2 x = 0

PAG29::ketS_proj.text:
noncomputable def ketS_proj (w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  (projFunEquiv K hK).symm ⟨kS K w c h χ, compat_extS _⟩

PAG29::ketN_proj.text:
noncomputable def ketN_proj (w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  (projFunEquiv K hK).symm ⟨kN K w c h χ, compat_extN _⟩

PAG29::epsS_proj.text:
noncomputable def epsS_proj (a : ℕ) : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  (projFunEquiv K hK).symm ⟨extS (PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K a), compat_extS _⟩

PAG29::epsN_proj.text:
noncomputable def epsN_proj (a : ℕ) : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  (projFunEquiv K hK).symm ⟨extN (PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K a), compat_extN _⟩

PAG29::BSproj_symm.text:
theorem BSproj_symm {F G : P1F (p ^ K)} (hF : Compat F) (hG : Compat G) :
    BSproj K hK ((projFunEquiv K hK).symm ⟨F, hF⟩) ((projFunEquiv K hK).symm ⟨G, hG⟩)
      = (projFunEquiv K hK).symm ⟨BS F G, compat_extS _⟩

PAG29::BNproj_symm.text:
theorem BNproj_symm {F G : P1F (p ^ K)} (hF : Compat F) (hG : Compat G) :
    BNproj K hK ((projFunEquiv K hK).symm ⟨F, hF⟩) ((projFunEquiv K hK).symm ⟨G, hG⟩)
      = (projFunEquiv K hK).symm ⟨BN F G, compat_extN _⟩

PAG29::symm_smul.text:
theorem symm_smul (a : ℂ) {F : P1F (p ^ K)} (hF : Compat F) (haF : Compat (a • F)) :
    (projFunEquiv K hK).symm ⟨a • F, haF⟩ = a • (projFunEquiv K hK).symm ⟨F, hF⟩

PAG29::projFun_BSproj.text:
theorem projFun_BSproj (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    (projFunEquiv K hK (BSproj K hK Φ Ψ)).1 = BS (projFunEquiv K hK Φ).1 (projFunEquiv K hK Ψ).1

PAG29::projFun_BNproj.text:
theorem projFun_BNproj (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    (projFunEquiv K hK (BNproj K hK Φ Ψ)).1 = BN (projFunEquiv K hK Φ).1 (projFunEquiv K hK Ψ).1

PAG29::projFun_ketS.text:
theorem projFun_ketS (w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    (projFunEquiv K hK (ketS_proj K hK w c h χ)).1 = kS K w c h χ

PAG29::projFun_ketN.text:
theorem projFun_ketN (w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    (projFunEquiv K hK (ketN_proj K hK w c h χ)).1 = kN K w c h χ

PAG29::projFun_epsS.text:
theorem projFun_epsS (a : ℕ) :
    (projFunEquiv K hK (epsS_proj K hK a)).1 = extS (PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K a)

PAG29::projFun_epsN.text:
theorem projFun_epsN (a : ℕ) :
    (projFunEquiv K hK (epsN_proj K hK a)).1 = extN (PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K a)

PAG29::Wpull_ketS_proj.text:
theorem Wpull_ketS_proj (w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    Wpull (ketS_proj K hK w c h χ) = ketN_proj K hK w c h χ⁻¹

PAG29::ketS0_eq_ketN0_proj.text:
theorem ketS0_eq_ketN0_proj (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (h : 0 + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    ketS_proj K hK 0 c h χ = ketN_proj K hK 0 c h χ

PAG29::thmA_BSproj.text:
theorem thmA_BSproj (w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    BSproj K hK (ketS_proj K hK w (n + 1) h χ₁) (ketS_proj K hK w (n + 1) h χ₂)
      = ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)) : ℝ) *
          (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar /
            (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar * ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 + v)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) : ℂ) •
        ketS_proj K hK (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) ψ

PAG29::mirror_thmA_BNproj.text:
theorem mirror_thmA_BNproj (w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    BNproj K hK (ketN_proj K hK w (n + 1) h χ₁) (ketN_proj K hK w (n + 1) h χ₂)
      = ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)) : ℝ) *
          starRingEnd ℂ (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar /
            (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar * ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 + v)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) : ℂ) •
        ketN_proj K hK (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) ψ

PAG29::equator_intertwine_proj.text:
theorem equator_intertwine_proj {n : ℕ} (h : 0 + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (h₁₂ : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) :
    BNproj K hK (ketS_proj K hK 0 (n + 1) h χ₁) (ketS_proj K hK 0 (n + 1) h χ₂)
      = (starRingEnd ℂ (Jhat χ₁ χ₂)) ^ 2 •
          BSproj K hK (ketS_proj K hK 0 (n + 1) h χ₁) (ketS_proj K hK 0 (n + 1) h χ₂)

PAG29::Hs.text:
noncomputable def Hs (K u : ℕ) : AddSubgroup (ZMod (p ^ K)) :=
  (shellEmb (p := p) K (K - u) (Nat.sub_le K u)).range

PAG29::mem_Hs.text: theorem mem_Hs (K u : ℕ) (x : ZMod (p ^ K)) : x ∈ Hs (p := p) K u ↔ p ^ (K - u) ∣ x.val

PAG29::indH_Hs.text: theorem indH_Hs (K u : ℕ) : indH (K := ℂ) (Hs (p := p) K u) = ball (p := p) K (K - u)

PAG29::cardH_Hs.text: theorem cardH_Hs (K u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ K) : cardH (Hs (p := p) K u) = p ^ u

PAG29::ballAvg_Hs.text: theorem ballAvg_Hs (K u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ K) : ballAvg (K := ℂ) (Hs (p := p) K u) = Pavg (p := p) K u

PAG29::Hs_mono.text: theorem Hs_mono (K : ℕ) : Monotone (Hs (p := p) K)

PAG29::Pavg_absorb.text:
theorem Pavg_absorb (K a b : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ K) :
    conv (Pavg (p := p) K a) (Pavg (p := p) K b) = Pavg (p := p) K b

PAG29::epsBall_Pavg_eq.text:
theorem epsBall_Pavg_eq (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) :
    PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K a
      = PAG.Part14.epsBall (fun w => ballAvg (K := ℂ) (Hs (p := p) K w)) K a

PAG29::eps_conv.text:
theorem eps_conv (K a b : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (hb : b ≤ K) :
    conv (PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K a) (PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K b)
      = if a = b then PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K a else 0

PAG29::cB.text:
noncomputable def cB (K w n : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) : ℂ :=
  χ (-1) * ((p : ℂ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℂ))

PAG29::thmB_eps.text:
theorem thmB_eps (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      = cB K w n χ • PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K (K - (n + 1) - w)

PAG29::thmB_select.text:
theorem thmB_select (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ K) :
    conv (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ)))
        (PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K u)
      = if u = K - (n + 1) - w then
          conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        else 0

PAG29::chi_neg_one_sq'.text: theorem chi_neg_one_sq' {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : χ (-1) * χ (-1) = 1

PAG29::thmB_self.text:
theorem thmB_self (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    conv (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ)))
        (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ)))
      = cB K w n χ • conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ)
          (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ))

PAG29::thmB_self_sq.text:
theorem thmB_self_sq (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    conv (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ)))
        (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ)))
      = ((p : ℂ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℂ)) ^ 2 •
          PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K (K - (n + 1) - w)

    conv (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ)))
        (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ)))
      = ((p : ℂ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℂ)) •
          conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ))

        (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ)))
      = (-((p : ℂ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℂ))) •
          conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ))

PAG32::negProj.text:
def negProj : ProjLine N → ProjLine N :=

      obtain ⟨s, t, h⟩ := v.2; exact ⟨-s, t, by rw [neg_mul_neg]; exact h⟩⟩)
    (fun _v _w ⟨u, h1, h2⟩ => mk_eq_mk u (by simp [h1]) h2)

PAG32::chi_gp_pow.text:
omit hp in
theorem chi_gp_pow (hc : 1 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : χ (gp p c) ^ p = 1

PAG32::mul_not_prim_iff.text:
theorem mul_not_prim_iff (hc : 1 ≤ c) (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) :
    ¬ (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive ↔ χ₂ (gp p c) = (χ₁ (gp p c))⁻¹

PAG32::prim_level_p_iff.text: theorem prim_level_p_iff (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) : χ.IsPrimitive ↔ χ ≠ 1

PAG33::factorsEquiv.text:
noncomputable def factorsEquiv {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (hd : d ∣ N) :
    DirichletCharacter ℂ d ≃ {ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N // ψ.FactorsThrough d} :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (fun χ₀ => ⟨DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hd χ₀, ⟨hd, χ₀, rfl⟩⟩)
    ⟨fun a b h => DirichletCharacter.changeLevel_injective hd (congrArg Subtype.val h),
     fun ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ => by
       obtain ⟨h', χ₀, e⟩ := hψ
       exact ⟨χ₀, Subtype.ext e.symm⟩⟩

PAG33::card_chars.text: theorem card_chars (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Fintype.card (DirichletCharacter ℂ N) = N.totient

PAG33::card_factors.text:
theorem card_factors {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (hd : d ∣ N) :
    Fintype.card {ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N // ψ.FactorsThrough d} = d.totient

PAG33::inv_mul_prim.text:
theorem inv_mul_prim (hc : 1 ≤ c) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ c) (χ₁ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hψ : ψ.FactorsThrough (p ^ m)) : (χ₁⁻¹ * ψ).IsPrimitive

PAG33::shiftEquiv.text:
noncomputable def shiftEquiv (hc : 1 ≤ c) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ c) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) :
    {χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) // χ₂.IsPrimitive ∧ (χ₁ * χ₂).FactorsThrough (p ^ m)}
      ≃ {ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) // ψ.FactorsThrough (p ^ m)} where
  toFun χ₂ := ⟨χ₁ * χ₂.1, χ₂.2.2⟩
  invFun ψ := ⟨χ₁⁻¹ * ψ.1, inv_mul_prim hc hm χ₁ ψ.1 h₁ ψ.2, by rw [mul_inv_cancel_left]; exact ψ.2⟩
