  left_inv χ₂ := Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel_left χ₁ χ₂.1)
  right_inv ψ := Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel_left χ₁ ψ.1)

PAG33::card_mul_factors.text:
theorem card_mul_factors (hc : 1 ≤ c) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ c) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) :
    Fintype.card {χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) // χ₂.IsPrimitive ∧ (χ₁ * χ₂).FactorsThrough (p ^ m)}
      = (p ^ m).totient

PAG33::card_split.text:
theorem card_split {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (P Q : α → Prop) :
    Fintype.card {x // P x ∧ Q x} + Fintype.card {x // P x ∧ ¬ Q x} = Fintype.card {x // P x}

PAG33::conductor_eq_iff.text:
theorem conductor_eq_iff {m : ℕ} (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ c + 1) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) :
    ψ.conductor = p ^ m ↔ ψ.FactorsThrough (p ^ m) ∧ ¬ ψ.FactorsThrough (p ^ (m - 1))

PAG33::card_mul_conductor.text:
theorem card_mul_conductor (hc : 1 ≤ c) {m : ℕ} (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ c)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) :
    Fintype.card {χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) // χ₂.IsPrimitive ∧ (χ₁ * χ₂).conductor = p ^ m}
      = (p ^ m).totient - (p ^ (m - 1)).totient

PAG33::card_mul_trivial.text:
theorem card_mul_trivial (hc : 1 ≤ c) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) :
    Fintype.card {χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) // χ₂.IsPrimitive ∧ (χ₁ * χ₂).FactorsThrough (p ^ 0)} = 1

PAG33::ratio_mul_prim.text:
theorem ratio_mul_prim (hc : 1 ≤ c) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) :
    Fintype.card {χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) // χ₂.IsPrimitive ∧ (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive} * (p - 1)
      = Fintype.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) // χ.IsPrimitive} * (p - 2)

PAG34::card_prim_level_p.text:
theorem card_prim_level_p :
    Fintype.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p // χ.IsPrimitive} = p - 2

PAG34::card_level_p_trivial.text:
theorem card_level_p_trivial (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) :
    Fintype.card {χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p // χ₂.IsPrimitive ∧ ¬ (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive} = 1

PAG34::card_level_p_mul_prim.text:
theorem card_level_p_mul_prim (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) :
    Fintype.card {χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p // χ₂.IsPrimitive ∧ (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive} = p - 3

PAG34::card_pairs.text:
theorem card_pairs {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (P : α → Prop) (R : α → α → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    [∀ a, DecidablePred (R a)] (k : ℕ)
    (hk : ∀ a, P a → Fintype.card {b // R a b} = k) :
    Fintype.card {x : α × α // P x.1 ∧ R x.1 x.2} = Fintype.card {a // P a} * k

PAG34::card_pairs_conductor.text:
theorem card_pairs_conductor (hc : 1 ≤ c) {m : ℕ} (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ c) :
    Fintype.card {x : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) × DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) //
        x.1.IsPrimitive ∧ (x.2.IsPrimitive ∧ (x.1 * x.2).conductor = p ^ m)}
      = ((p ^ (c + 1)).totient - (p ^ c).totient) * ((p ^ m).totient - (p ^ (m - 1)).totient)

PAG34::card_pairs_prim.text:
theorem card_pairs_prim (hc : 1 ≤ c) :
    Fintype.card {x : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) × DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) //
        x.1.IsPrimitive ∧ (x.2.IsPrimitive ∧ (x.1 * x.2).IsPrimitive)}
      = ((p ^ (c + 1)).totient - (p ^ c).totient)
          * ((p ^ (c + 1)).totient - (p ^ c).totient - (p ^ c).totient)

PAG34::card_pairs_trivial.text:
theorem card_pairs_trivial (hc : 1 ≤ c) :
    Fintype.card {x : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) × DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) //
        x.1.IsPrimitive ∧ (x.2.IsPrimitive ∧ (x.1 * x.2).FactorsThrough (p ^ 0))}
      = (p ^ (c + 1)).totient - (p ^ c).totient

PAG34::sym.text:
noncomputable def sym (s t : Bool) (Φ : ProjLine N → ℂ) : ProjLine N → ℂ :=
  (if s then Wpull else id) ((if t then tildePull else id) Φ)

PAG34::sym_ff.text: theorem sym_ff (Φ : ProjLine N → ℂ) : sym false false Φ = Φ

PAG34::sym_mul.text:
theorem sym_mul (s t s' t' : Bool) (Φ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    sym s t (sym s' t' Φ) = sym (xor s s') (xor t t') Φ

PAG34::Bb.text:
noncomputable def Bb (b : Bool) : (ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) → (ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) → ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  if b then BNproj K hK else BSproj K hK

PAG34::BSproj_W.text:
theorem BSproj_W (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    BSproj K hK (Wpull Φ) (Wpull Ψ) = Wpull (BNproj K hK Φ Ψ)

PAG34::BNproj_W.text:
theorem BNproj_W (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    BNproj K hK (Wpull Φ) (Wpull Ψ) = Wpull (BSproj K hK Φ Ψ)

PAG34::B_equivariant.text:
theorem B_equivariant (b s t : Bool) (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    Bb K hK (xor b s) (sym s t Φ) (sym s t Ψ) = sym s t (Bb K hK b Φ Ψ)

PAG34::sym_ketS.text:
theorem sym_ketS (w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    sym false false (ketS_proj K hK w c h χ) = ketS_proj K hK w c h χ ∧
    sym false true (ketS_proj K hK w c h χ) = χ (-1) • ketS_proj K hK w c h χ⁻¹ ∧
    sym true false (ketS_proj K hK w c h χ) = ketN_proj K hK w c h χ⁻¹ ∧
    sym true true (ketS_proj K hK w c h χ) = χ (-1) • ketN_proj K hK w c h χ

PAG35::BS_smul.text: theorem BS_smul (a b : ℂ) (F G : P1F (p ^ K)) : BS (a • F) (b • G) = (a * b) • BS F G

PAG35::BN_smul.text: theorem BN_smul (a b : ℂ) (F G : P1F (p ^ K)) : BN (a • F) (b • G) = (a * b) • BN F G

PAG35::BSproj_smul.text:
theorem BSproj_smul (a b : ℂ) (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    BSproj K hK (a • Φ) (b • Ψ) = (a * b) • BSproj K hK Φ Ψ

PAG35::BNproj_smul.text:
theorem BNproj_smul (a b : ℂ) (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    BNproj K hK (a • Φ) (b • Ψ) = (a * b) • BNproj K hK Φ Ψ

PAG35::tildePull_smul.text:
omit hp in
theorem tildePull_smul {N : ℕ} (a : ℂ) (Φ : ProjLine N → ℂ) :
    tildePull (a • Φ) = starRingEnd ℂ a • tildePull Φ

PAG35::Wpull_smul.text:
omit hp in
theorem Wpull_smul {N : ℕ} (a : ℂ) (Φ : ProjLine N → ℂ) : Wpull (a • Φ) = a • Wpull Φ

PAG35::sym_tt_smul.text:
omit hp in
theorem sym_tt_smul {N : ℕ} (a : ℂ) (Φ : ProjLine N → ℂ) :
    sym true true (a • Φ) = starRingEnd ℂ a • sym true true Φ

PAG35::psi_neg_one.text:
omit hp in
theorem psi_neg_one {n v : ℕ} (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v)))
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    ψ (-1) = χ₁ (-1) * χ₂ (-1)

PAG35::mirror_thmA_via_sym.text:
theorem mirror_thmA_via_sym (w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    BNproj K hK (ketN_proj K hK w (n + 1) h χ₁) (ketN_proj K hK w (n + 1) h χ₂)
      = ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)) : ℝ) *
          starRingEnd ℂ (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar /
            (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar * ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 + v)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) : ℂ) •
        ketN_proj K hK (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) ψ

PAG35::negPt.text:
def negPt {N : ℕ} : Pt N → Pt N
  | Sum.inl x => Sum.inl (-x)
  | Sum.inr y => Sum.inr ⟨-y.1, fun h => y.2 (by simpa using h.neg)⟩

PAG35::negPt_negPt.text: theorem negPt_negPt {N : ℕ} (z : Pt N) : negPt (negPt z) = z

PAG35::toProj_negPt.text:
omit hp in
theorem toProj_negPt (z : Pt (p ^ K)) : toProj K (negPt z) = negProj (toProj K z)

PAG35::inner.text:
noncomputable def inner (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ z : Pt (p ^ K), starRingEnd ℂ (Φ (toProj K z)) * Ψ (toProj K z)

PAG35::inner_Wpull.text: theorem inner_Wpull (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) : inner K (Wpull Φ) (Wpull Ψ) = inner K Φ Ψ

PAG35::inner_tildePull.text:
theorem inner_tildePull (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    inner K (tildePull Φ) (tildePull Ψ) = starRingEnd ℂ (inner K Φ Ψ)

PAG35::inner_sym.text:
theorem inner_sym (s t : Bool) (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    inner K (sym s t Φ) (sym s t Ψ) = if t then starRingEnd ℂ (inner K Φ Ψ) else inner K Φ Ψ

PAG36::Wpull_epsS.text: theorem Wpull_epsS (a : ℕ) : Wpull (epsS_proj (p := p) K hK a) = epsN_proj (p := p) K hK a

PAG36::conj_cB.text:
omit hp in
theorem conj_cB (w n : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    starRingEnd ℂ (cB K w n χ) = cB K w n χ

PAG36::mirror_thmB_via_sym.text:
theorem mirror_thmB_via_sym (w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    BNproj K hK (ketN_proj K hK w (n + 1) h χ) (ketN_proj K hK w (n + 1) h χ⁻¹)
      = cB K w n χ • epsN_proj K hK (K - (n + 1) - w)

PAG36::conv_adjoint.text:
omit hp in
theorem conv_adjoint {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (φ f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (φ x) * conv f g x = ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (conv φ (tilde g) x) * f x

PAG36::BSproj_north_interior.text:
theorem BSproj_north_interior (Φ Ψ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) (y : {y : ZMod (p ^ K) // ¬ IsUnit y}) :
    BSproj K hK Φ Ψ (toProj K (Sum.inr y)) = 0

PAG36::inner_BSproj.text:
theorem inner_BSproj (Φ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part35.inner K Φ (BSproj K hK Ψ₁ Ψ₂) = PAG.Part35.inner K (BSproj K hK Φ (tildePull Ψ₂)) Ψ₁

PAG36::inner_BNproj.text:
theorem inner_BNproj (Φ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part35.inner K Φ (BNproj K hK Ψ₁ Ψ₂) = PAG.Part35.inner K (BNproj K hK Φ (tildePull Ψ₂)) Ψ₁

PAG37::five_pow_two_pow.text: theorem five_pow_two_pow (k : ℕ) : ∃ u : ℕ, Odd u ∧ 5 ^ (2 ^ k) = 1 + 2 ^ (k + 2) * u

PAG37::five.text: def five (m : ℕ) : (ZMod (2 ^ m))ˣ := ZMod.unitOfCoprime 5 (Nat.Coprime.pow_right m (by norm_num))

PAG37::five_val.text: theorem five_val (m : ℕ) : ((five m : (ZMod (2 ^ m))ˣ) : ZMod (2 ^ m)) = 5

PAG37::unitsMap_five.text:
theorem unitsMap_five {m c : ℕ} (h : m ≤ c) :
    ZMod.unitsMap (pow_dvd_pow 2 h) (five c) = five m

PAG37::five_pow_val.text:
theorem five_pow_val (m k : ℕ) :
    ∃ u : ℕ, Odd u ∧ (((five m) ^ (2 ^ k) : (ZMod (2 ^ m))ˣ) : ZMod (2 ^ m)) = ((1 + 2 ^ (k + 2) * u : ℕ) : ZMod _)

PAG37::orderOf_five_ge3.text: theorem orderOf_five_ge3 {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) : orderOf (five m) = 2 ^ (m - 2)

PAG37::orderOf_five.text: theorem orderOf_five {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) : orderOf (five m) = 2 ^ (m - 2)

PAG37::unitsMap_neg_one.text: theorem unitsMap_neg_one {m n : ℕ} (h : m ∣ n) : ZMod.unitsMap h (-1) = -1

PAG37::toFour.text:
noncomputable def toFour (d : ℕ) : (ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3)))ˣ →* (ZMod (2 ^ 2))ˣ :=
  ZMod.unitsMap (pow_dvd_pow 2 (show 2 ≤ d + 3 by omega))

PAG37::units_pm5.text: theorem units_pm5 (u : (ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3)))ˣ) : ∃ a b : ℕ, u = (-1) ^ a * (five (d + 3)) ^ b

PAG37::ker_five.text:
theorem ker_five {m : ℕ} (hm2 : 2 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ d + 3) (u : (ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3)))ˣ)
    (hu : u ∈ (ZMod.unitsMap (pow_dvd_pow 2 hm)).ker) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, u = (five (d + 3)) ^ (2 ^ (m - 2) * t)

PAG37::factors_iff_five.text:
theorem factors_iff_five {m : ℕ} (hm2 : 2 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ d + 3) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (d + 3))) :
    ψ.FactorsThrough (2 ^ m) ↔ ψ 5 ^ (2 ^ (m - 2)) = 1

PAG37::eq_one_iff_five.text: theorem eq_one_iff_five (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (d + 3))) : ψ = 1 ↔ ψ (-1) = 1 ∧ ψ 5 = 1

PAG37::prim_iff_five.text: theorem prim_iff_five (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (d + 3))) : ψ.IsPrimitive ↔ ψ 5 ^ (2 ^ d) ≠ 1

PAG37::conductor_eq_iff_five.text:
theorem conductor_eq_iff_five {m : ℕ} (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ d + 3) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (d + 3))) :
    ψ.conductor = 2 ^ m ↔ ψ 5 ^ (2 ^ (m - 2)) = 1 ∧ ψ 5 ^ (2 ^ (m - 3)) ≠ 1

PAG37::conductor_eq_four_iff.text:
theorem conductor_eq_four_iff (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (d + 3))) :
    ψ.conductor = 2 ^ 2 ↔ ψ 5 = 1 ∧ ψ (-1) ≠ 1

PAG37::mul_conductor_eq_iff_five.text:
theorem mul_conductor_eq_iff_five {m : ℕ} (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ d + 3) (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (d + 3))) :
    (χ₁ * χ₂).conductor = 2 ^ m ↔
      (χ₁ 5 * χ₂ 5) ^ (2 ^ (m - 2)) = 1 ∧ (χ₁ 5 * χ₂ 5) ^ (2 ^ (m - 3)) ≠ 1

PAG38::inner_smul_left.text:
theorem inner_smul_left (a : ℂ) (Φ Ψ : PAG.Part27.ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part35.inner K (a • Φ) Ψ = starRingEnd ℂ a * PAG.Part35.inner K Φ Ψ

PAG38::inner_smul_right.text:
theorem inner_smul_right (a : ℂ) (Φ Ψ : PAG.Part27.ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part35.inner K Φ (a • Ψ) = a * PAG.Part35.inner K Φ Ψ

PAG38::adjoint_ketS.text:
theorem adjoint_ketS (w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (Φ Ψ : PAG.Part27.ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part35.inner K Φ (BSproj K hK Ψ (ketS_proj K hK w c h χ))
      = χ (-1) * PAG.Part35.inner K (BSproj K hK Φ (ketS_proj K hK w c h χ⁻¹)) Ψ

PAG38::adjoint_ketN.text:
theorem adjoint_ketN (w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (Φ Ψ : PAG.Part27.ProjLine (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part35.inner K Φ (BNproj K hK Ψ (ketN_proj K hK w c h χ))
      = χ (-1) * PAG.Part35.inner K (BNproj K hK Φ (ketN_proj K hK w c h χ⁻¹)) Ψ

PAG38::dft_tilde.text:
theorem dft_tilde {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (k : ZMod N) :
    𝓕 (tilde f) k = starRingEnd ℂ (𝓕 f k)

PAG38::dft_auto_eq_normSq.text:
theorem dft_auto_eq_normSq (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (k : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    𝓕 (auto K w c h χ) k = (Complex.normSq (𝓕 (ket K w c h χ) k) : ℂ)

PAG38::normSq_dft_ket.text:
theorem normSq_dft_ket (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (k : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    Complex.normSq (𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) k) = 0 ∨
      Complex.normSq (𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) k) = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)

PAG38::normSq_dft_conv_ket_le.text:
theorem normSq_dft_conv_ket_le (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (k : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    Complex.normSq (𝓕 (conv f (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ)) k)
      ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) * Complex.normSq (𝓕 f k)

PAG39::sum_dft.text: theorem sum_dft (h : ZMod N → ℂ) : ∑ k, 𝓕 h k = (N : ℂ) * h 0

PAG39::plancherel.text:
theorem plancherel (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ k, starRingEnd ℂ (𝓕 f k) * 𝓕 g k = (N : ℂ) * ∑ j, starRingEnd ℂ (f j) * g j

PAG39::plancherel_normSq.text:
theorem plancherel_normSq (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ k, Complex.normSq (𝓕 f k) = (N : ℝ) * ∑ j, Complex.normSq (f j)

PAG39::norm_ket.text:
theorem norm_ket (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ x) = 1

PAG39::norm_conv_ket_le.text:
theorem norm_conv_ket_le (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (conv f (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) x)
      ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) * ∑ x, Complex.normSq (f x)

PAG39::norm_conv_ket_self.text:
theorem norm_conv_ket_self (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) x)
      = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)

PAG40::norm_ket'.text:
theorem norm_ket' (K w c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (h : w + c ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (ket K w c h χ x) = 1

PAG40::thmA_norm.text:
theorem thmA_norm (K w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₂) x)
      = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)

PAG40::thmB_norm.text:
theorem thmB_norm (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ)
        (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ)) x)
      = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)

PAG40::thmA_saturates.text:
theorem thmA_saturates (K w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₂) x)
      = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) * ∑ x, Complex.normSq (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁ x)

PAG41::normSq_dft_ket_eq.text:
theorem normSq_dft_ket_eq (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (k : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    (Complex.normSq (𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) k) : ℂ)
      = ((p : ℂ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℂ)) *
          𝓕 (PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) k

PAG41::dft_eps_mul_eq_zero.text:
theorem dft_eps_mul_eq_zero (K a b : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (hb : b ≤ K) (hab : a ≠ b) (k : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    𝓕 (PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K a) k * 𝓕 (PAG.Part14.epsBall (Pavg (p := p) K) K b) k = 0

PAG41::conv_ket_eq_zero.text:
theorem conv_ket_eq_zero (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (hab : K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁ ≠ K - (n₂ + 1) - w₂) :
    conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = 0

PAG41::norm_conv_ket_same.text:
theorem norm_conv_ket_same (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (hab : K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁ = K - (n₂ + 1) - w₂) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) x)
      = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁) : ℝ)

PAG42::conv_mixed_top.text:
theorem conv_mixed_top (n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, ψ x = χ₁ x * χ₂ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    conv (χ₁ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)) → ℂ) (push (shellEmb (p := p) (n + 1) v (by omega)) (χ₂ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1 - v)) → ℂ))
      = (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar / gaussSum ψ stdAddChar) • (ψ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)) → ℂ)

PAG42::conv_ket_mixed.text:
theorem conv_ket_mixed (K w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, ψ x = χ₁ x * χ₂ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) χ₂)
      = (((Real.sqrt (sz p K (w + v)))⁻¹ : ℝ) * (((p ^ (K - w - (n + 1)) : ℕ) : ℂ) *
          (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar / gaussSum ψ stdAddChar)) : ℂ) •
        ket K w (n + 1) hK ψ

PAG42::mixed_prim.text:
theorem mixed_prim (n v : ℕ) (hv1 : 1 ≤ v) (hv : v ≤ n)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v)))
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hprod : ∀ x, ψ x = χ₁ x * χ₂ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    ψ.IsPrimitive

PAG42::normSq_mixed_coef.text:
theorem normSq_mixed_coef (K w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    Complex.normSq ((((Real.sqrt (sz p K (w + v)))⁻¹ : ℝ) * (((p ^ (K - w - (n + 1)) : ℕ) : ℂ) *
          (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar / gaussSum ψ stdAddChar)) : ℂ))
      = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)

PAG43::Cmix.text:
noncomputable def Cmix (K w n v : ℕ) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) : ℂ :=
  (((Real.sqrt (sz p K (w + v)))⁻¹ : ℝ) * (((p ^ (K - w - (n + 1)) : ℕ) : ℂ) *
    (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar / gaussSum ψ stdAddChar)) : ℂ)

PAG43::mixed_BSproj.text:
theorem mixed_BSproj (w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, ψ x = χ₁ x * χ₂ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    BSproj K hK1 (ketS_proj K hK1 w (n + 1) h χ₁) (ketS_proj K hK1 (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) χ₂)
      = Cmix K w n v χ₁ χ₂ ψ • ketS_proj K hK1 w (n + 1) h ψ

PAG43::psi_neg_one_mixed.text:
omit hp in
theorem psi_neg_one_mixed {n v : ℕ} (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hprod : ∀ x, ψ x = χ₁ x * χ₂ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    ψ (-1) = χ₁ (-1) * χ₂ (-1)

PAG43::mixed_BNproj.text:
theorem mixed_BNproj (w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, ψ x = χ₁ x * χ₂ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    BNproj K hK1 (ketN_proj K hK1 w (n + 1) h χ₁) (ketN_proj K hK1 (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) χ₂)
      = starRingEnd ℂ (Cmix K w n v χ₁ χ₂ ψ) • ketN_proj K hK1 w (n + 1) h ψ

PAG44::neg_one_pow_mod.text: theorem neg_one_pow_mod {G : Type*} [Monoid G] [HasDistribNeg G] (a : ℕ) : (-1 : G) ^ a = (-1) ^ (a % 2)

PAG44::neg_one_pow_eq_iff.text:
theorem neg_one_pow_eq_iff (a a' : ℕ) :
    ((-1 : (ZMod (2 ^ 2))ˣ) ^ a = (-1) ^ a' ↔ a % 2 = a' % 2)

PAG44::zeta.text: noncomputable def zeta (d : ℕ) : ℂ := exp (2 * Real.pi * I / ((2 ^ (d + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ))

PAG44::zeta_pow_mod.text: theorem zeta_pow_mod (b : ℕ) : zeta d ^ b = zeta d ^ (b % 2 ^ (d + 1))

PAG44::rep.text:
noncomputable def rep (d : ℕ) (u : (ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3)))ˣ) : Fin 2 × Fin (2 ^ (d + 1)) :=
  (Equiv.ofBijective (pm5 d) pm5_bijective).symm u

PAG44::rep_spec.text:
theorem rep_spec (u : (ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3)))ˣ) :
    u = (-1) ^ ((rep d u).1 : ℕ) * (five (d + 3)) ^ ((rep d u).2 : ℕ)

PAG44::val.text:
noncomputable def val (d s j : ℕ) (u : (ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3)))ˣ) : ℂ :=
  (-1) ^ (s * ((rep d u).1 : ℕ)) * zeta d ^ (j * ((rep d u).2 : ℕ))

PAG44::val_formula.text:
theorem val_formula (s j a b : ℕ) :
    val d s j ((-1) ^ a * (five (d + 3)) ^ b) = (-1) ^ (s * a) * zeta d ^ (j * b)

PAG44::val_ne_zero.text: theorem val_ne_zero (s j : ℕ) (u : (ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3)))ˣ) : val d s j u ≠ 0

PAG44::unitHom.text:
noncomputable def unitHom (d s j : ℕ) : (ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3)))ˣ →* ℂˣ where
  toFun u := Units.mk0 (val d s j u) (val_ne_zero s j u)
  map_one' := by
    ext
    have := val_formula (d := d) s j 0 0
    simp only [pow_zero, mul_one, mul_zero] at this
    simp [this]
  map_mul' u u' := by
    ext
    simp only [Units.val_mk0, Units.val_mul]
    rw [rep_spec u, rep_spec u']
    rw [show (-1 : (ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3)))ˣ) ^ ((rep d u).1 : ℕ) * five (d + 3) ^ ((rep d u).2 : ℕ) *
        ((-1) ^ ((rep d u').1 : ℕ) * five (d + 3) ^ ((rep d u').2 : ℕ))
        = (-1) ^ (((rep d u).1 : ℕ) + ((rep d u').1 : ℕ)) * five (d + 3) ^ (((rep d u).2 : ℕ) + ((rep d u').2 : ℕ)) by
      rw [pow_add (-1 : (ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3)))ˣ), pow_add (five (d + 3))]; exact mul_mul_mul_comm _ _ _ _]
    rw [val_formula, val_formula, val_formula, mul_add, mul_add, pow_add (-1 : ℂ), pow_add (zeta d)]
    ring

PAG44::chiSJ.text: noncomputable def chiSJ (d s j : ℕ) : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (d + 3)) := MulChar.ofUnitHom (unitHom d s j)

PAG44::chiSJ_unit.text: theorem chiSJ_unit (s j : ℕ) (u : (ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3)))ˣ) : chiSJ d s j (u : ZMod _) = val d s j u

PAG44::chiSJ_five.text: theorem chiSJ_five (s j : ℕ) : chiSJ d s j 5 = zeta d ^ j

PAG44::chiSJ_neg_one.text: theorem chiSJ_neg_one (s j : ℕ) : chiSJ d s j (-1) = (-1) ^ s

PAG44::chiSJ_mul.text: theorem chiSJ_mul (s j s' j' : ℕ) : chiSJ d s j * chiSJ d s' j' = chiSJ d (s + s') (j + j')

PAG44::two_pow_dvd_mul_iff.text: theorem two_pow_dvd_mul_iff {a b j : ℕ} (hb : b ≤ a) : 2 ^ a ∣ j * 2 ^ b ↔ 2 ^ (a - b) ∣ j

PAG44::chiSJ_prim_iff.text: theorem chiSJ_prim_iff (s j : ℕ) : (chiSJ d s j).IsPrimitive ↔ Odd j

PAG44::chiSJ_conductor_iff.text:
theorem chiSJ_conductor_iff (s j : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ d + 3) :
    (chiSJ d s j).conductor = 2 ^ m ↔ 2 ^ (d + 3 - m) ∣ j ∧ ¬ 2 ^ (d + 4 - m) ∣ j

PAG44::chiSJ_mul_conductor_iff.text:
theorem chiSJ_mul_conductor_iff (s j s' j' : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ d + 3) :
    (chiSJ d s j * chiSJ d s' j').conductor = 2 ^ m ↔
      2 ^ (d + 3 - m) ∣ (j + j') ∧ ¬ 2 ^ (d + 4 - m) ∣ (j + j')

PAG44::chiSJ_conductor_four_iff.text:
theorem chiSJ_conductor_four_iff (s j : ℕ) :
    (chiSJ d s j).conductor = 2 ^ 2 ↔ 2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j ∧ Odd s

PAG45::char_ext.text:
theorem char_ext (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (d + 3)))
    (h5 : χ 5 = χ' 5) (h1 : χ (-1) = χ' (-1)) : χ = χ'

PAG45::neg_one_pow_C.text: theorem neg_one_pow_C (s : ℕ) : (-1 : ℂ) ^ s = if s % 2 = 0 then 1 else -1

PAG45::chiSJ_surj.text:
theorem chiSJ_surj (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (d + 3))) :
    ∃ s < 2, ∃ j < 2 ^ (d + 1), χ = chiSJ d s j

PAG45::chiSJ_eq_iff.text:
theorem chiSJ_eq_iff (s j s' j' : ℕ) :
    chiSJ d s j = chiSJ d s' j' ↔ s % 2 = s' % 2 ∧ j % 2 ^ (d + 1) = j' % 2 ^ (d + 1)

PAG45::chiSJ_bijective.text:
theorem chiSJ_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (fun x : Fin 2 × Fin (2 ^ (d + 1)) => chiSJ d (x.1 : ℕ) (x.2 : ℕ))

PAG45::chiSJ_eq_one_iff.text: theorem chiSJ_eq_one_iff (s j : ℕ) : chiSJ d s j = 1 ↔ Even s ∧ 2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j

PAG45::chiSJ_conductor_one_iff.text: theorem chiSJ_conductor_one_iff (s j : ℕ) : (chiSJ d s j).conductor = 1 ↔ Even s ∧ 2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j

PAG46::lam_pos.text: theorem lam_pos (K u : ℕ) : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K u : ℝ)

PAG46::conv_ket_eq_zero_iff.text:
theorem conv_ket_eq_zero_iff (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = 0 ↔
      K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁ ≠ K - (n₂ + 1) - w₂

PAG46::psiMix.text:
noncomputable def psiMix {n v : ℕ} (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)) :=
  χ₁ * DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) χ₂

PAG46::psiMix_apply.text:
theorem psiMix_apply {n v : ℕ} (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (x : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    psiMix χ₁ χ₂ x = χ₁ x * χ₂ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)

PAG46::conv_ket_mixed_exists.text:
theorem conv_ket_mixed_exists (K w n v : ℕ) (hv1 : 1 ≤ v) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
      Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) χ₂) = C • ket K w (n + 1) hK ψ

PAG46::conv_ket_mixed_exists'.text:
theorem conv_ket_mixed_exists' (K w n v : ℕ) (hv1 : 1 ≤ v) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
      Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket K (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) χ₂) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) = C • ket K w (n + 1) hK ψ

PAG46::psiMix_neg_one.text:
theorem psiMix_neg_one {n v : ℕ} (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) :
    psiMix χ₁ χ₂ (-1) = χ₁ (-1) * χ₂ (-1)

PAG47::exists_prim_of_conductor.text:
omit hp in
theorem exists_prim_of_conductor {M : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) {N : ℕ} (hN : χ.conductor = N) :
    ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N, ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ h : N ∣ M, DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h ψ = χ

PAG47::changeLevel_apply_cast.text:
theorem changeLevel_apply_cast {K c : ℕ} (hc1 : 1 ≤ c) (hcK : c ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (x : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow p hcK) ψ x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p hcK) (ZMod (p ^ c)) x)

PAG47::conductor_eq_pow.text:
theorem conductor_eq_pow {n : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    ∃ i ≤ n + 1, χ.conductor = p ^ i

PAG47::normSq_coef_of.text:
theorem normSq_coef_of {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (F k : ZMod N → ℂ) (C : ℂ) (lam : ℝ) (hF : F = C • k)
    (hk : ∑ x, Complex.normSq (k x) = 1) (hn : ∑ x, Complex.normSq (F x) = lam) : Complex.normSq C = lam

PAG47::thmA_exists.text:
theorem thmA_exists (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (hne : χ₁ * χ₂ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ v, ∃ hv : v ≤ n, ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v)), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
      Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₂) = C • ket K (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) ψ

PAG47::thmB_of_mul_eq_one.text:
theorem thmB_of_mul_eq_one (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h1 : χ₁ * χ₂ = 1) :
    conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)
      = χ₁ (-1) • (PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1))
          - ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹ • (PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K (w + n) - PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1))))

PAG47::same_shell_classify.text:
theorem same_shell_classify (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    (∃ v, ∃ hv : v ≤ n, ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v)), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
      Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₂) = C • ket K (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) ψ) ∨
    (χ₂ = χ₁⁻¹ ∧ conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)
      = χ₁ (-1) • (PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1))
          - ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹ • (PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K (w + n) - PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1)))))

PAG48::ballB.text:
noncomputable def ballB (K w n : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1))
    - ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹ • (PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K (w + n) - PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1)))

PAG48::mixed_general.text:
theorem mixed_general (K w n v w₂ c₂ : ℕ) (hv1 : 1 ≤ v) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (hw : w + v = w₂) (hc : n + 1 - v = c₂) (h₂ : w₂ + c₂ ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c₂)) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
      Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w₂ c₂ h₂ χ₂) = C • ket K w (n + 1) hK ψ

PAG48::conv_ket_classification.text:
theorem conv_ket_classification (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    (K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁ ≠ K - (n₂ + 1) - w₂ ∧ conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = 0) ∨
    (K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁ = K - (n₂ + 1) - w₂ ∧
      ∃ w c, ∃ h : w + c ≤ K, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
        Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁) : ℝ) ∧
        conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = C • ket K w c h ψ) ∨
    (w₁ = w₂ ∧ n₁ = n₂ ∧
      conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = χ₁ (-1) • ballB (p := p) K w₁ n₁)

PAG48::conv_ket_norm_dichotomy.text:
theorem conv_ket_norm_dichotomy (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) x)
      = if K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁ = K - (n₂ + 1) - w₂ then (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁) : ℝ) else 0

PAG49::ket_apply_zero.text:
theorem ket_apply_zero (K w c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    ket K w c h χ 0 = 0

PAG49::ball_apply_zero.text:
omit hp in
theorem ball_apply_zero (K j : ℕ) : PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K j 0 = 1

PAG49::ballB_apply_zero.text:
omit hp in
theorem ballB_apply_zero (K w n : ℕ) : ballB (p := p) K w n 0 = 1

PAG49::caseII.text:
def caseII (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1))) : Prop :=
  K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁ = K - (n₂ + 1) - w₂ ∧
    ∃ w c, ∃ h : w + c ≤ K, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
      Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = C • ket K w c h ψ

PAG49::classification.text:
theorem classification (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    caseI K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂ ∨ caseII K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂ ∨ caseIII K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂

PAG49::not_I_and_II.text: theorem not_I_and_II : ¬ (caseI K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂ ∧ caseII K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂)

PAG49::not_I_and_III.text: theorem not_I_and_III : ¬ (caseI K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂ ∧ caseIII K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂)

PAG49::not_II_and_III.text: theorem not_II_and_III : ¬ (caseII K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂ ∧ caseIII K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂)

PAG49::classification_exactly_one.text:
theorem classification_exactly_one (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    (caseI K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂ ∨ caseII K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂ ∨ caseIII K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂) ∧
    ¬ (caseI K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂ ∧ caseII K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂) ∧
    ¬ (caseI K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂ ∧ caseIII K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂) ∧
    ¬ (caseII K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂ ∧ caseIII K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ h₁ h₂ χ₁ χ₂)

PAG49::caseIII_iff_inv.text:
theorem caseIII_iff_inv (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    caseIII K w n w n h h χ₁ χ₂ ↔ χ₂ = χ₁⁻¹

PAG50::thmA_of_conductor.text:
theorem thmA_of_conductor {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (K w n u c : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (hc1 : 1 ≤ c) (hcn : c ≤ n + 1) (hu : u + c = w + (n + 1)) (huK : u + c ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (hcond : (χ₁ * χ₂).conductor = p ^ c) :
    ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
      Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₂) = C • ket K u c huK ψ

PAG50::p2_caseB.text:
theorem p2_caseB (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K) (s j s' j' : ℕ) (hj : Odd j)
    (hs : Even (s + s')) (hM : 2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j') :
    conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s' j'))
      = ((-1 : ℂ) ^ s) • ballB (p := 2) K w (d + 2)

PAG50::p2_caseA.text:
theorem p2_caseA (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K) (s j s' j' : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) (hj' : Odd j')
    {m : ℕ} (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ d + 3)
    (hν : 2 ^ (d + 3 - m) ∣ (j + j') ∧ ¬ 2 ^ (d + 4 - m) ∣ (j + j')) :
    ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ m), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
      Complex.normSq C = (2 : ℝ) ^ K / (sz 2 K (K - (d + 3) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s' j'))
        = C • ket (p := 2) K (w + (d + 3 - m)) m (by omega) ψ

PAG50::p2_caseA_shift.text:
theorem p2_caseA_shift (j j' : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) (hj' : Odd j') {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ d + 3)
    (hν : ¬ 2 ^ (d + 4 - m) ∣ (j + j')) : m ≤ d + 2

PAG50::p2_caseA4.text:
theorem p2_caseA4 (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K) (s j s' j' : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) (hj' : Odd j')
    (hs : Odd (s + s')) (hM : 2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j') :
    ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ 2), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
      Complex.normSq C = (2 : ℝ) ^ K / (sz 2 K (K - (d + 3) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s' j'))
        = C • ket (p := 2) K (w + (d + 1)) 2 (by omega) ψ

PAG51::coef_ne_zero.text: theorem coef_ne_zero (K w : ℕ) : ((((Real.sqrt (sz p K w))⁻¹ : ℝ)) : ℂ) ≠ 0

PAG51::ket_apply_emb.text:
theorem ket_apply_emb (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : ZMod (p ^ c) → ℂ) (y : ZMod (p ^ (K - w))) :
    ket K w c h χ (shellEmb (p := p) K w (by omega) y)
      = (((Real.sqrt (sz p K w))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c ≤ K - w)) _ y)

PAG51::shellEmb_pow.text:
theorem shellEmb_pow (K w w' : ℕ) (hw' : w' ≤ w) (hw : w < K) :
    shellEmb (p := p) K w' (by omega) ((p ^ (w - w') : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ (K - w')))
      = shellEmb (p := p) K w hw.le 1

PAG51::not_isUnit_pow.text: theorem not_isUnit_pow (k c : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hc : 1 ≤ c) : ¬ IsUnit ((p ^ k : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ c))

PAG51::ket_lower_shell_zero.text:
theorem ket_lower_shell_zero (K w w' c' : ℕ) (hw' : w' < w) (hw : w < K) (hc' : 1 ≤ c') (h' : w' + c' ≤ K)
    (ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c')) :
    ket K w' c' h' ψ' (shellEmb (p := p) K w hw.le 1) = 0

PAG51::ket_own_shell.text:
theorem ket_own_shell (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    ket K w c h ψ (shellEmb (p := p) K w (by omega) 1) = (((Real.sqrt (sz p K w))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)

PAG51::shell_le.text:
theorem shell_le (K w c w' c' : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hc' : 1 ≤ c') (h : w + c ≤ K) (h' : w' + c' ≤ K)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c')) (C C' : ℂ) (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (H : C • ket K w c h ψ = C' • ket K w' c' h' ψ') : w ≤ w'

PAG51::shell_eq.text:
theorem shell_eq (K w c w' c' : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hc' : 1 ≤ c') (h : w + c ≤ K) (h' : w' + c' ≤ K)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c')) (C C' : ℂ) (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (H : C • ket K w c h ψ = C' • ket K w' c' h' ψ') : w = w' ∧ C' ≠ 0

PAG51::same_shell_values.text:
theorem same_shell_values (K w c c' : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (h' : w + c' ≤ K)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c')) (C C' : ℂ) (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (H : C • ket K w c h ψ = C' • ket K w c' h' ψ') :
    C = C' ∧ ∀ y : ZMod (p ^ (K - w)), ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c ≤ K - w)) _ y)
      = ψ' (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c' ≤ K - w)) _ y)

PAG51::prim_not_changeLevel.text:
theorem prim_not_changeLevel {c c' : ℕ} (hlt : c' < c) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c')) (hdvd : p ^ c' ∣ p ^ c) :
    ψ ≠ DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hdvd ψ'

PAG51::cond_le.text:
theorem cond_le (K w c c' : ℕ) (hc' : 1 ≤ c') (h : w + c ≤ K) (h' : w + c' ≤ K)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c'))
    (C C' : ℂ) (hC : C ≠ 0) (H : C • ket K w c h ψ = C' • ket K w c' h' ψ') : c ≤ c'

PAG51::ket_rep_unique.text:
theorem ket_rep_unique (K w c w' c' : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hc' : 1 ≤ c') (h : w + c ≤ K) (h' : w' + c' ≤ K)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c'))
    (hψ' : ψ'.IsPrimitive) (C C' : ℂ) (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (H : C • ket K w c h ψ = C' • ket K w' c' h' ψ') : w = w' ∧ c = c' ∧ C = C'

PAG51::ket_char_unique.text:
theorem ket_char_unique (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (ψ ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (C C' : ℂ) (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (H : C • ket K w c h ψ = C' • ket K w c h ψ') : ψ = ψ'

PAG51::caseII_target_unique.text:
theorem caseII_target_unique (K : ℕ) (w c w' c' : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hc' : 1 ≤ c') (h : w + c ≤ K) (h' : w' + c' ≤ K)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c'))
    (hψ' : ψ'.IsPrimitive) (C C' : ℂ) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hCl : Complex.normSq C = lam)
    (F : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hF : F = C • ket K w c h ψ) (hF' : F = C' • ket K w' c' h' ψ') :
    w = w' ∧ c = c' ∧ C = C'

PAG52::ip.text: noncomputable def ip {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) : ℂ := ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (f x) * g x

PAG52::ip_eq_conv.text: theorem ip_eq_conv {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) : ip f g = conv g (tilde f) 0

PAG52::conv_smul_right.text: theorem conv_smul_right {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a : ℂ) (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) : conv g (a • f) = a • conv g f

PAG52::ip_ket.text:
theorem ip_ket (K w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + c₁ ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + c₂ ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c₁)) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c₂)) :
    ip (ket K w₁ c₁ h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ c₂ h₂ χ₂)
      = χ₁ (-1) * conv (ket K w₂ c₂ h₂ χ₂) (ket K w₁ c₁ h₁ ((χ₁⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ)) 0

PAG52::ip_ket_cases.text:
theorem ip_ket_cases (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    ip (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = 0 ∨
      caseIII K w₂ n₂ w₁ n₁ h₂ h₁ χ₂ χ₁⁻¹

PAG52::ip_ket_eq_zero_of_ne.text:
theorem ip_ket_eq_zero_of_ne (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (hne : w₁ ≠ w₂ ∨ n₁ ≠ n₂) :
    ip (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = 0

PAG52::ip_ket_eq_zero_of_char_ne.text:
theorem ip_ket_eq_zero_of_char_ne (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (hne : χ₁ ≠ χ₂) :
    ip (ket K w (n + 1) h χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) h χ₂) = 0

PAG52::ip_ket_self.text:
theorem ip_ket_self (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : ip (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) = 1

PAG52::ket_orthonormal.text:
open Classical in
theorem ket_orthonormal (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    (w₁ ≠ w₂ ∨ n₁ ≠ n₂ → ip (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = 0) ∧
    (w₁ = w₂ → ∀ hn : n₁ = n₂, ip (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂)
      = if (hn ▸ χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1))) = χ₂ then 1 else 0)

PAG53::p2_classification.text:
theorem p2_classification (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K) (s j s' j' : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) (hj' : Odd j') :
    (Even (s + s') ∧ 2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j' ∧
      conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s' j'))
        = ((-1 : ℂ) ^ s) • ballB (p := 2) K w (d + 2)) ∨
    (¬ 2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j' ∧ 1 ≤ padicValNat 2 (j + j') ∧ padicValNat 2 (j + j') ≤ d ∧
      ∃ u c, ∃ h : u + c ≤ K, u = w + padicValNat 2 (j + j') ∧ c = d + 3 - padicValNat 2 (j + j') ∧
        ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ c), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
          Complex.normSq C = (2 : ℝ) ^ K / (sz 2 K (K - (d + 3) - w) : ℝ) ∧
          conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s' j'))
            = C • ket (p := 2) K u c h ψ) ∨
    (2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j' ∧ Odd (s + s') ∧
      ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ 2), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
        Complex.normSq C = (2 : ℝ) ^ K / (sz 2 K (K - (d + 3) - w) : ℝ) ∧
        conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s' j'))
          = C • ket (p := 2) K (w + (d + 1)) 2 (by omega) ψ)

PAG53::p2_mod8_no_b.text:
theorem p2_mod8_no_b (j j' : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) (hj' : Odd j') :
    ¬ (¬ 2 ^ (0 + 1) ∣ j + j')

PAG54::shellInd.text:
noncomputable def shellInd (K w : ℕ) (hw : w < K) : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  have : NeZero (p ^ (K - w)) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hp.out.ne_zero⟩
  push (shellEmb (p := p) K w hw.le) ((1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (K - w))) : ZMod (p ^ (K - w)) → ℂ)

PAG54::exists_shell.text:
theorem exists_shell (K : ℕ) (x : ZMod (p ^ K)) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ w, ∃ hw : w < K, ∃ y : ZMod (p ^ (K - w)), IsUnit y ∧ shellEmb (p := p) K w hw.le y = x

PAG54::delta_expand.text:
theorem delta_expand (K w : ℕ) (hw : w < K) (y : ZMod (p ^ (K - w))) (hy : IsUnit y) :
    have : NeZero (p ^ (K - w))

PAG54::push_char_mem.text:
theorem push_char_mem (K w : ℕ) (hw : w < K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (K - w))) :
    push (shellEmb (p := p) K w hw.le) (χ : ZMod (p ^ (K - w)) → ℂ) ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (family (p := p) K)

PAG54::span_family_eq_top.text: theorem span_family_eq_top (K : ℕ) : Submodule.span ℂ (family (p := p) K) = ⊤

PAG55::ip_conj.text: theorem ip_conj {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) : ip g f = starRingEnd ℂ (ip f g)

PAG55::ip_smul_left.text:
theorem ip_smul_left {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a : ℂ) (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ip (a • f) g = starRingEnd ℂ a * ip f g

PAG55::ip_smul_right.text:
theorem ip_smul_right {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a : ℂ) (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ip f (a • g) = a * ip f g

PAG55::ip_self_ne_zero.text: theorem ip_self_ne_zero {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : f ≠ 0) : ip f f ≠ 0

PAG55::ip_delta.text: theorem ip_delta {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (g : ZMod N → ℂ) : ip (Pi.single 0 1) g = g 0

PAG55::conj_push.text:
theorem conj_push {G H : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup H] (ι : H →+ G) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (f : H → ℂ) (z : G) :
    starRingEnd ℂ (push ι f z) = push ι (fun y => starRingEnd ℂ (f y)) z

PAG55::ip_push_same.text:
theorem ip_push_same (K w : ℕ) (hw : w ≤ K) (f g : ZMod (p ^ (K - w)) → ℂ) :
    ip (push (shellEmb (p := p) K w hw) f) (push (shellEmb (p := p) K w hw) g)
      = ∑ y, starRingEnd ℂ (f y) * g y

PAG55::shellEmb_lower.text:
theorem shellEmb_lower (K w w' : ℕ) (hw' : w' < w) (hw : w < K) (y : ZMod (p ^ (K - w))) :
    shellEmb (p := p) K w hw.le y
      = shellEmb (p := p) K w' (by omega) ((p ^ (w - w') * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ (K - w')))

PAG55::VanishNU.text: def VanishNU {N : ℕ} (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : Prop := ∀ y, ¬ IsUnit y → f y = 0

PAG55::ip_push_lower.text:
theorem ip_push_lower (K w w' : ℕ) (hw' : w' < w) (hw : w < K)
    (f : ZMod (p ^ (K - w)) → ℂ) (g : ZMod (p ^ (K - w')) → ℂ) (hf : VanishNU f) (hg : VanishNU g) :
    ip (push (shellEmb (p := p) K w hw.le) f) (push (shellEmb (p := p) K w' (by omega)) g) = 0

PAG55::ip_push_ne.text:
theorem ip_push_ne (K w w' : ℕ) (hne : w ≠ w') (hw : w < K) (hw' : w' < K)
    (f : ZMod (p ^ (K - w)) → ℂ) (g : ZMod (p ^ (K - w')) → ℂ) (hf : VanishNU f) (hg : VanishNU g) :
    ip (push (shellEmb (p := p) K w hw.le) f) (push (shellEmb (p := p) K w' hw'.le) g) = 0

PAG55::ket_eq_push.text:
theorem ket_eq_push (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    ket K w c h ψ = (((Real.sqrt (sz p K w))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
      push (shellEmb (p := p) K w (by omega))
        (fun y => ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c ≤ K - w)) (ZMod (p ^ c)) y))

PAG55::vanish_ket.text:
theorem vanish_ket (K w c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (h : w + c ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    VanishNU (fun y : ZMod (p ^ (K - w)) => ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c ≤ K - w)) (ZMod (p ^ c)) y))

PAG55::vanish_one.text:
theorem vanish_one (K w : ℕ) (hw : w < K) :
    VanishNU (((1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (K - w))) : ZMod (p ^ (K - w)) → ℂ))

PAG55::ip_ket_shellInd.text:
theorem ip_ket_shellInd (K w c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (h : w + c ≤ K) (hw : w < K)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    ip (ket K w c h ψ) (shellInd K w hw) = 0

PAG55::shellInd_zero.text: theorem shellInd_zero (K w : ℕ) (hw : w < K) : shellInd (p := p) K w hw 0 = 0

PAG55::ne_zero_of_mem.text: theorem ne_zero_of_mem (K : ℕ) (v : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hv : v ∈ family (p := p) K) : v ≠ 0

PAG55::ip_ket_other.text:
theorem ip_ket_other (K w c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (h : w + c ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (v : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hv : v ∈ family (p := p) K) (hne : ket K w c h ψ ≠ v) :
    ip (ket K w c h ψ) v = 0

PAG55::family_orthogonal.text:
theorem family_orthogonal (K : ℕ) (u v : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hu : u ∈ family (p := p) K) (hv : v ∈ family (p := p) K)
    (hne : u ≠ v) :
    ip u v = 0

PAG55::ip_sum_right.text:
theorem ip_sum_right {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (g : ι → ℂ)
    (v : ι → ZMod N → ℂ) : ip f (∑ i ∈ s, g i • v i) = ∑ i ∈ s, g i * ip f (v i)

PAG55::family_linearIndependent.text:
theorem family_linearIndependent (K : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (fun v : family (p := p) K => (v : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ))

PAG55::familyBasis.text:
noncomputable def familyBasis (K : ℕ) : Module.Basis (family (p := p) K) ℂ (ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :=
  Module.Basis.mk (family_linearIndependent K) (by
    rw [Subtype.range_coe_subtype, Set.ofPred_mem_eq, span_family_eq_top])

PAG55::card_family.text: theorem card_family (K : ℕ) : Nat.card (family (p := p) K) = p ^ K

PAG56::ip_shellInd_self.text:
theorem ip_shellInd_self (K w : ℕ) (hw : w < K) :
    ip (shellInd (p := p) K w hw) (shellInd (p := p) K w hw) = (sz p K w : ℂ)

PAG56::ip_normalized_shellInd.text:
theorem ip_normalized_shellInd (K w : ℕ) (hw : w < K) :
    ip ((((Real.sqrt (sz p K w))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • shellInd (p := p) K w hw)
      ((((Real.sqrt (sz p K w))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • shellInd (p := p) K w hw) = 1

PAG56::ip_delta_self.text: theorem ip_delta_self (K : ℕ) : ip (Pi.single (0 : ZMod (p ^ K)) (1 : ℂ)) (Pi.single 0 1) = 1

PAG56::.text:
noncomputable instance (K : ℕ) : Fintype (family (p := p) K) :=
  have : Finite (family (p := p) K) :=
    Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [card_family]; exact pow_ne_zero _ hp.out.ne_zero)
  Fintype.ofFinite _

PAG56::familyBasis_apply.text: theorem familyBasis_apply (K : ℕ) (b : family (p := p) K) : familyBasis (p := p) K b = b

PAG56::repr_eq.text:
theorem repr_eq (K : ℕ) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (b : family (p := p) K) :
    (familyBasis (p := p) K).repr f b = ip (b : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) f / ip (b : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) b

PAG56::expand.text:
theorem expand (K : ℕ) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    f = ∑ b : family (p := p) K,
      (ip (b : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) f / ip (b : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) b) • (b : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ)

PAG56::parseval.text:
theorem parseval (K : ℕ) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    ip f f = ∑ b : family (p := p) K,
      ((Complex.normSq (ip (b : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) f) : ℝ) : ℂ) / ip (b : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) b

PAG57::not_dvd_val_of_unit.text: theorem not_dvd_val_of_unit {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (y : ZMod (p ^ m)) (hy : IsUnit y) : ¬ p ∣ y.val

PAG57::shellInd_apply.text:
theorem shellInd_apply (K w v : ℕ) (hw : w < K) (hv : v < K) (y : ZMod (p ^ (K - v))) (hy : IsUnit y) :
    shellInd (p := p) K w hw (shellEmb (p := p) K v hv.le y) = if w = v then 1 else 0

PAG57::ball_apply_shell.text:
theorem ball_apply_shell (K j v : ℕ) (hv : v < K) (y : ZMod (p ^ (K - v))) (hy : IsUnit y) :
    PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K j (shellEmb (p := p) K v hv.le y) = if j ≤ v then 1 else 0

PAG57::shellSum.text:
noncomputable def shellSum (K j : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  ∑ w : Fin K, if j ≤ (w : ℕ) then shellInd (p := p) K w w.2 else 0

PAG57::ball_decomp.text:
theorem ball_decomp (K j : ℕ) :
    PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K j = shellSum (p := p) K j + Pi.single 0 1

PAG57::IndSpan.text:
def IndSpan (K : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ (ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :=
  Submodule.span ℂ {f | (∃ w, ∃ hw : w < K, f = shellInd (p := p) K w hw) ∨ f = Pi.single 0 1}

PAG57::ball_mem.text: theorem ball_mem (K j : ℕ) : PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K j ∈ IndSpan (p := p) K

PAG57::ballB_mem.text: theorem ballB_mem (K w n : ℕ) : ballB (p := p) K w n ∈ IndSpan (p := p) K

PAG57::conv_ket_action.text:
theorem conv_ket_action (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = 0 ∨
    (∃ b ∈ family (p := p) K, ∃ C : ℂ, C ≠ 0 ∧
      conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = C • b) ∨
    conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) ∈ IndSpan (p := p) K

PAG57::conv_delta.text: theorem conv_delta (K : ℕ) (g : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) : conv (Pi.single 0 1) g = g

PAG58::conv_sum_right.text:
theorem conv_sum_right {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (g : ι → ZMod N → ℂ) :
    conv f (∑ i ∈ s, g i) = ∑ i ∈ s, conv f (g i)

PAG58::conv_sub_right.text: theorem conv_sub_right {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f g h : ZMod N → ℂ) : conv f (g - h) = conv f g - conv f h

PAG58::conv_smul_right'.text: theorem conv_smul_right' {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a : ℂ) (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) : conv f (a • g) = a • conv f g

PAG58::ket_conv_eps_self.text:
theorem ket_conv_eps_self (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K (K - (n + 1) - w))
      = ket K w (n + 1) hK χ

PAG58::ket_conv_eps_ne.text:
theorem ket_conv_eps_ne (K w n b : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (hb : b ≤ K) (hne : b ≠ K - (n + 1) - w)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K b) = 0

PAG58::Pavg_eq_sum_eps.text:
omit hp in
theorem Pavg_eq_sum_eps (K u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ K) :
    PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K u = ∑ b ∈ Ico u (K + 1), PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K b

PAG58::ket_conv_Pavg.text:
theorem ket_conv_Pavg (K w n u : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (hu : u ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K u)
      = if u ≤ K - (n + 1) - w then ket K w (n + 1) hK χ else 0

PAG58::ball_eq_Pavg.text:
theorem ball_eq_Pavg (K j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ K) :
    PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K j = ((p : ℂ) ^ (K - j)) • PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K (K - j)

PAG58::ket_conv_ball.text:
theorem ket_conv_ball (K w n j : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (hj : j ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K j)
      = (if w + (n + 1) ≤ j then (p : ℂ) ^ (K - j) else 0) • ket K w (n + 1) hK χ

PAG58::shellInd_eq_ball_sub.text:
theorem shellInd_eq_ball_sub (K v : ℕ) (hv : v < K) :
    shellInd (p := p) K v hv = PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K v - PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K (v + 1)

PAG58::ket_conv_shellInd.text:
theorem ket_conv_shellInd (K w n v : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (hv : v < K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (shellInd (p := p) K v hv)
      = ((if w + (n + 1) ≤ v then (p : ℂ) ^ (K - v) else 0)
          - (if w + (n + 1) ≤ v + 1 then (p : ℂ) ^ (K - (v + 1)) else 0)) • ket K w (n + 1) hK χ

PAG58::ball_conv_ball_mem.text:
theorem ball_conv_ball_mem (K i j : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ K) (hj : j ≤ K) :
    conv (PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K i) (PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K j) ∈ IndSpan (p := p) K

PAG58::shellInd_conv_mem.text:
theorem shellInd_conv_mem (K v u : ℕ) (hv : v < K) (hu : u < K) :
    conv (shellInd (p := p) K v hv) (shellInd (p := p) K u hu) ∈ IndSpan (p := p) K

PAG58::Good.text:
def Good (K : ℕ) (F : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) : Prop :=
  F = 0 ∨ (∃ b ∈ family (p := p) K, ∃ C : ℂ, C ≠ 0 ∧ F = C • b) ∨ F ∈ IndSpan (p := p) K

PAG58::good_smul_ket.text:
theorem good_smul_ket (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (C : ℂ) : Good (p := p) K (C • ket K w c h ψ)

PAG58::good_of_mem_family.text: theorem good_of_mem_family (K : ℕ) (b : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hb : b ∈ family (p := p) K) : Good (p := p) K b

PAG58::good_ket_ket.text:
theorem good_ket_ket (K w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + c₁ ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + c₂ ≤ K) (hc₁ : 1 ≤ c₁) (hc₂ : 1 ≤ c₂)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c₁)) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c₂))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    Good (p := p) K (conv (ket K w₁ c₁ h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ c₂ h₂ χ₂))

PAG58::good_ket_shellInd.text:
theorem good_ket_shellInd (K w c v : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hv : v < K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    Good (p := p) K (conv (ket K w c h χ) (shellInd (p := p) K v hv))

PAG58::conv_family_good.text:
theorem conv_family_good (K : ℕ) (f g : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ family (p := p) K) (hg : g ∈ family (p := p) K) :
    Good (p := p) K (conv f g)

PAG59::eps.text: noncomputable abbrev eps (K b : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ := PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K b

PAG59::EpsSpan.text:
noncomputable def EpsSpan (K : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ (ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :=
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (fun b : Fin (K + 1) => eps (p := p) K b))

PAG59::Pavg_mem_IndSpan.text: theorem Pavg_mem_IndSpan (K u : ℕ) : PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K u ∈ IndSpan (p := p) K

PAG59::eps_mem_IndSpan.text: theorem eps_mem_IndSpan (K b : ℕ) : eps (p := p) K b ∈ IndSpan (p := p) K

PAG59::Pavg_mem_EpsSpan.text:
omit hp in
theorem Pavg_mem_EpsSpan (K u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ K) : PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K u ∈ EpsSpan (p := p) K

PAG59::ball_mem_EpsSpan.text: theorem ball_mem_EpsSpan (K j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ K) : PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K j ∈ EpsSpan (p := p) K

PAG59::delta_eq_ball.text: theorem delta_eq_ball (K : ℕ) : (Pi.single (0 : ZMod (p ^ K)) (1 : ℂ)) = PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K K

PAG59::IndSpan_eq_EpsSpan.text: theorem IndSpan_eq_EpsSpan (K : ℕ) : IndSpan (p := p) K = EpsSpan (p := p) K

PAG59::eps_conv_eps.text:
theorem eps_conv_eps (K a b : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (hb : b ≤ K) :
    conv (eps (p := p) K a) (eps (p := p) K b) = if a = b then eps (p := p) K a else 0

PAG59::conv_mem_IndSpan.text:
theorem conv_mem_IndSpan (K : ℕ) (f g : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ IndSpan (p := p) K)
    (hg : g ∈ IndSpan (p := p) K) : conv f g ∈ IndSpan (p := p) K

PAG59::eps_ne_zero.text: theorem eps_ne_zero (K b : ℕ) : eps (p := p) K b ≠ 0

PAG59::eps_linearIndependent.text:
theorem eps_linearIndependent (K : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (fun b : Fin (K + 1) => eps (p := p) K b)

PAG59::finrank_IndSpan.text: theorem finrank_IndSpan (K : ℕ) : Module.finrank ℂ (IndSpan (p := p) K) = K + 1

PAG59::ket_conv_IndSpan.text:
theorem ket_conv_IndSpan (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ IndSpan (p := p) K) :
    ∃ c : ℂ, conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) f = c • ket K w (n + 1) hK χ

PAG60::ket_conv_eps_sum.text:
theorem ket_conv_eps_sum (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (g : Fin (K + 1) → ℂ) :
    conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (∑ b : Fin (K + 1), g b • eps (p := p) K b)
      = g ⟨K - (n + 1) - w, by omega⟩ • ket K w (n + 1) hK χ

PAG60::eps_coeff_unique.text:
theorem eps_coeff_unique (K : ℕ) (g g' : Fin (K + 1) → ℂ)
    (h : ∑ b : Fin (K + 1), g b • eps (p := p) K b = ∑ b : Fin (K + 1), g' b • eps (p := p) K b) : g = g'

PAG60::ket_eigenvalue_unique.text:
theorem ket_eigenvalue_unique (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (g : Fin (K + 1) → ℂ) (c : ℂ)
    (hc : conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (∑ b : Fin (K + 1), g b • eps (p := p) K b) = c • ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) :
    c = g ⟨K - (n + 1) - w, by omega⟩

PAG61::zeta.text: noncomputable def zeta : ℂ := exp (2 * Real.pi * I / (phi (p := p) c : ℂ))

PAG61::zeta_prim.text: theorem zeta_prim : IsPrimitiveRoot (zeta (p := p) c) (phi (p := p) c)

PAG61::zetaU.text: noncomputable def zetaU : ℂˣ := Units.mk0 (zeta (p := p) c) ((zeta_prim (p := p) c).ne_zero (phi_pos (p := p) c).ne')

PAG61::zetaU_mem.text: theorem zetaU_mem : zetaU (p := p) c ∈ rootsOfUnity (phi (p := p) c) ℂ

PAG61::gen.text:
noncomputable def gen : (ZMod (p ^ (c + 1)))ˣ :=
  have := isCyclic_units c hp2
  Classical.choose (IsCyclic.exists_generator (α := (ZMod (p ^ (c + 1)))ˣ))

PAG61::gen_spec.text: theorem gen_spec : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (gen c hp2)

PAG61::orderOf_gen.text: theorem orderOf_gen : orderOf (gen c hp2) = phi (p := p) c

PAG61::omega.text:
noncomputable def omega : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) :=
  MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (zetaU_mem (p := p) c) (gen_spec c hp2)

PAG61::omega_gen.text: theorem omega_gen : omega c hp2 (gen c hp2) = zeta (p := p) c

PAG61::exists_pow_gen.text: theorem exists_pow_gen (u : (ZMod (p ^ (c + 1)))ˣ) : ∃ k : ℕ, gen c hp2 ^ k = u

PAG61::omega_faithful.text: theorem omega_faithful (u : (ZMod (p ^ (c + 1)))ˣ) (h : omega c hp2 u = 1) : u = 1

PAG61::char_ext_gen.text:
theorem char_ext_gen (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)))
    (h : χ (gen c hp2) = χ' (gen c hp2)) : χ = χ'

PAG61::exists_eq_omega_pow.text:
theorem exists_eq_omega_pow (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) :
    ∃ j < phi (p := p) c, χ = omega c hp2 ^ j

PAG61::omega_gp_prim.text: theorem omega_gp_prim (hc : 1 ≤ c) : IsPrimitiveRoot (omega c hp2 (gp p c)) p

PAG61::omega_pow_prim_iff.text: theorem omega_pow_prim_iff (hc : 1 ≤ c) (j : ℕ) : (omega c hp2 ^ j).IsPrimitive ↔ ¬ p ∣ j

PAG61::omega_mul_prim_iff.text:
theorem omega_mul_prim_iff (hc : 1 ≤ c) (j j' : ℕ) :
    (omega c hp2 ^ j * omega c hp2 ^ j').IsPrimitive ↔ ¬ p ∣ j + j'

PAG61::odd_same_shell_no_descent.text:
theorem odd_same_shell_no_descent (hc : 1 ≤ c) (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (c + 1) ≤ K) (j j' : ℕ)
    (hj : ¬ p ∣ j) (hj' : ¬ p ∣ j') (hjj : ¬ p ∣ j + j') :
    ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
      Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (c + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        = C • ket K w (c + 1) hK ψ

PAG62::card_ker_mul.text:
theorem card_ker_mul (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ c + 1) :
    Nat.card (ZMod.unitsMap (pow_dvd_pow p hm)).ker * (p ^ m).totient = (p ^ (c + 1)).totient

PAG62::card_ker.text:
theorem card_ker (m : ℕ) (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ c + 1) :
    Nat.card (ZMod.unitsMap (pow_dvd_pow p hm)).ker = p ^ (c + 1 - m)

PAG62::card_ker_zero.text: theorem card_ker_zero : Nat.card (ZMod.unitsMap (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.zero_le (c + 1)))).ker = phi (p := p) c

PAG62::omega_pow_factors_iff.text:
theorem omega_pow_factors_iff (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ c + 1) (j : ℕ) :
    (omega c hp2 ^ j).FactorsThrough (p ^ m) ↔ Nat.card (ZMod.unitsMap (pow_dvd_pow p hm)).ker ∣ j

PAG62::omega_pow_factors_iff'.text:
theorem omega_pow_factors_iff' (m : ℕ) (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ c + 1) (j : ℕ) :
    (omega c hp2 ^ j).FactorsThrough (p ^ m) ↔ p ^ (c + 1 - m) ∣ j

PAG62::omega_pow_factors_zero.text:
theorem omega_pow_factors_zero (j : ℕ) :
    (omega c hp2 ^ j).FactorsThrough (p ^ 0) ↔ phi (p := p) c ∣ j

PAG62::omega_pow_conductor_iff.text:
theorem omega_pow_conductor_iff (m : ℕ) (hm2 : 2 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ c + 1) (j : ℕ) :
    (omega c hp2 ^ j).conductor = p ^ m ↔ p ^ (c + 1 - m) ∣ j ∧ ¬ p ^ (c + 1 - m + 1) ∣ j

PAG62::omega_pow_conductor_p_iff.text:
theorem omega_pow_conductor_p_iff (j : ℕ) :
    (omega c hp2 ^ j).conductor = p ^ 1 ↔ p ^ c ∣ j ∧ ¬ phi (p := p) c ∣ j

PAG62::omega_mul_conductor_iff.text:
theorem omega_mul_conductor_iff (m : ℕ) (hm2 : 2 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ c + 1) (j j' : ℕ) :
    (omega c hp2 ^ j * omega c hp2 ^ j').conductor = p ^ m ↔
      p ^ (c + 1 - m) ∣ (j + j') ∧ ¬ p ^ (c + 1 - m + 1) ∣ (j + j')

PAG63::eq_one_of_factors_one.text:
omit hp in
theorem eq_one_of_factors_one {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (h : χ.FactorsThrough 1) : χ = 1

PAG63::odd_classification.text:
theorem odd_classification (hc : 1 ≤ c) (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (c + 1) ≤ K) (j j' : ℕ)
    (hj : ¬ p ∣ j) (hj' : ¬ p ∣ j') :
    (phi (p := p) c ∣ j + j' ∧
      conv (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        = (omega c hp2 ^ j) (-1) • ballB (p := p) K w c) ∨
    (padicValNat p (j + j') ≤ c - 1 ∧
      ∃ u m, ∃ h : u + m ≤ K, u = w + padicValNat p (j + j') ∧ m = c + 1 - padicValNat p (j + j') ∧
        ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ m), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
          Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (c + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
          conv (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
            (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
            = C • ket K u m h ψ) ∨
    (c ≤ padicValNat p (j + j') ∧ ¬ phi (p := p) c ∣ j + j' ∧
      ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ 1), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
        Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (c + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
        conv (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
          (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
          = C • ket K (w + c) 1 (by omega) ψ)

PAG64::unified_classification.text:
theorem unified_classification (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : (χ₁ * χ₂).conductor = p ^ i) :
    (i = 0 ∧ conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₂) = χ₁ (-1) • ballB (p := p) K w n) ∨
    (1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ n + 1 ∧ ∃ h : w + (n + 1 - i) + i ≤ K, ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ i), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧
      ∃ C : ℂ, Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
        conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₂) = C • ket K (w + (n + 1 - i)) i h ψ)

PAG64::exists_conductor_pow.text: theorem exists_conductor_pow {n : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) : ∃ i, χ.conductor = p ^ i

PAG64::p2_instance.text:
theorem p2_instance {d : ℕ} (s j s' j' : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ d + 3)
    (hν : 2 ^ (d + 3 - m) ∣ (j + j') ∧ ¬ 2 ^ (d + 4 - m) ∣ (j + j')) :
    (PAG.Part44.chiSJ d s j * PAG.Part44.chiSJ d s' j').conductor = 2 ^ m

PAG64::odd_instance.text:
theorem odd_instance (c : ℕ) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {m : ℕ} (hm2 : 2 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ c + 1) (j j' : ℕ)
    (hν : p ^ (c + 1 - m) ∣ (j + j') ∧ ¬ p ^ (c + 1 - m + 1) ∣ (j + j')) :
    (PAG.Part61.omega c hp2 ^ j * PAG.Part61.omega c hp2 ^ j').conductor = p ^ m

PAG65::mixed_general_psi.text:
theorem mixed_general_psi (K w n v w₂ c₂ : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (hw : w + v = w₂) (hc : n + 1 - v = c₂) (h₂ : w₂ + c₂ ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c₂)) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, ψ x = χ₁ x * χ₂ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c₂ ≤ n + 1)) _ x)) :
    ∃ C : ℂ, Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w₂ c₂ h₂ χ₂) = C • ket K w (n + 1) hK ψ

PAG65::changeLevel_omega.text:
theorem changeLevel_omega (c c' : ℕ) (hcc : c' ≤ c) :
    ∃ r, p ^ (c - c') ∣ r ∧
      DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c' + 1 ≤ c + 1)) (omega c' hp2) = omega c hp2 ^ r

PAG65::changeLevel_omega_pow.text:
theorem changeLevel_omega_pow (c c' : ℕ) (hcc : c' ≤ c) (r : ℕ)
    (hr : DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c' + 1 ≤ c + 1)) (omega c' hp2) = omega c hp2 ^ r)
    (j' : ℕ) :
    DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c' + 1 ≤ c + 1)) (omega c' hp2 ^ j')
      = omega c hp2 ^ (r * j')

PAG65::mixed_index_apply.text:
theorem mixed_index_apply (c c' : ℕ) (hcc : c' ≤ c) (r : ℕ)
    (hr : DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c' + 1 ≤ c + 1)) (omega c' hp2) = omega c hp2 ^ r)
    (j j' : ℕ) (x : ZMod (p ^ (c + 1))) :
    (omega c hp2 ^ (j + r * j')) x
      = (omega c hp2 ^ j) x * (omega c' hp2 ^ j') (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c' + 1 ≤ c + 1)) _ x)

PAG65::mixed_index_prim.text:
theorem mixed_index_prim (c c' : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hcc : c' < c) (r : ℕ) (hr : p ^ (c - c') ∣ r)
    (j j' : ℕ) (hj : ¬ p ∣ j) : (omega c hp2 ^ (j + r * j')).IsPrimitive

PAG65::mixed_ket_index.text:
theorem mixed_ket_index (c c' : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hcc : c' < c) (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (c + 1) ≤ K)
    (h₂ : w + (c - c') + (c' + 1) ≤ K) (j j' : ℕ) (hj : ¬ p ∣ j) (hc'1 : (omega c' hp2 ^ j').IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ r, p ^ (c - c') ∣ r ∧ ∃ C : ℂ, Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (c + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        (ket K (w + (c - c')) (c' + 1) h₂ ((omega c' hp2 ^ j' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c' + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        = C • ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ (j + r * j') : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ)

PAG66::zeta_pow_sub.text: theorem zeta_pow_sub (d d' : ℕ) (h : d' ≤ d) : zeta d ^ (2 ^ (d - d')) = zeta d'

PAG66::changeLevel_chiSJ.text:
theorem changeLevel_chiSJ (d d' : ℕ) (h : d' ≤ d) (s' j' : ℕ) :
    DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow 2 (by omega : d' + 3 ≤ d + 3)) (chiSJ d' s' j')
      = chiSJ d s' (2 ^ (d - d') * j')

PAG66::mixed_chiSJ_apply.text:
theorem mixed_chiSJ_apply (d d' : ℕ) (h : d' ≤ d) (s j s' j' : ℕ) (x : ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3))) :
    chiSJ d (s + s') (j + 2 ^ (d - d') * j') x
      = chiSJ d s j x * chiSJ d' s' j' (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow 2 (by omega : d' + 3 ≤ d + 3)) _ x)

PAG66::mixed_chiSJ_prim.text:
theorem mixed_chiSJ_prim (d d' : ℕ) (h : d' < d) (s j s' j' : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) :
    (chiSJ d (s + s') (j + 2 ^ (d - d') * j')).IsPrimitive

PAG66::mixed_ket_chiSJ.text:
theorem mixed_ket_chiSJ (d d' : ℕ) (h : d' < d) (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K)
    (h₂ : w + (d - d') + (d' + 3) ≤ K) (s j s' j' : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) (hj' : Odd j') :
    ∃ C : ℂ, Complex.normSq C = (2 : ℝ) ^ K / (sz 2 K (K - (d + 3) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K (w + (d - d')) (d' + 3) h₂ (chiSJ d' s' j'))
        = C • ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d (s + s') (j + 2 ^ (d - d') * j'))

PAG67::red.text:
noncomputable abbrev red : (ZMod (p ^ (c + 1)))ˣ →* (ZMod (p ^ (c' + 1)))ˣ :=
  ZMod.unitsMap (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c' + 1 ≤ c + 1))

include hp2 hcc

PAG67::red_gen_spec.text: theorem red_gen_spec : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (red c c' hcc (gen c hp2))

PAG67::phi_dvd.text:
omit hp2 in
theorem phi_dvd : phi (p := p) c' ∣ phi (p := p) c

PAG67::phi_div.text:
omit hp2 in
theorem phi_div : phi (p := p) c / phi (p := p) c' = p ^ (c - c')

PAG67::zeta_pow_mem.text:
omit hp2 in
theorem zeta_pow_mem : zetaU (p := p) c ^ (phi (p := p) c / phi (p := p) c') ∈ rootsOfUnity (phi (p := p) c') ℂ

PAG67::omegaLow.text:
noncomputable def omegaLow : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c' + 1)) :=
  MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (zeta_pow_mem c c' hcc) (red_gen_spec hp2 c c' hcc)

PAG67::omegaLow_gen.text:
theorem omegaLow_gen : omegaLow hp2 c c' hcc (red c c' hcc (gen c hp2))
    = zeta (p := p) c ^ (phi (p := p) c / phi (p := p) c')

PAG67::changeLevel_omegaLow.text:
theorem changeLevel_omegaLow :
    DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c' + 1 ≤ c + 1)) (omegaLow hp2 c c' hcc)
      = omega c hp2 ^ (p ^ (c - c'))

PAG67::omegaLow_faithful.text: theorem omegaLow_faithful (u : (ZMod (p ^ (c' + 1)))ˣ) (h : omegaLow hp2 c c' hcc u = 1) : u = 1

PAG67::mixed_ket_exact.text:
theorem mixed_ket_exact (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hlt : c' < c) (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (c + 1) ≤ K)
    (h₂ : w + (c - c') + (c' + 1) ≤ K) (j j' : ℕ) (hj : ¬ p ∣ j)
    (hc'1 : (omegaLow hp2 c c' hcc ^ j').IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ C : ℂ, Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (PAG.Part19.sz p K (K - (c + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      PAG.Part15.conv (PAG.Part21.ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        (PAG.Part21.ket K (w + (c - c')) (c' + 1) h₂
          ((omegaLow hp2 c c' hcc ^ j' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c' + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        = C • PAG.Part21.ket K w (c + 1) hK
          ((omega c hp2 ^ (j + p ^ (c - c') * j') : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ)

PAG68::Faithful.text: def Faithful {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : Prop := ∀ u : (ZMod N)ˣ, χ u = 1 → u = 1

PAG68::faithful_gp_prim.text:
theorem faithful_gp_prim {c : ℕ} (hc : 1 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : Faithful χ) :
    IsPrimitiveRoot (χ (gp p c)) p

PAG68::faithful_pow_prim_iff.text:
theorem faithful_pow_prim_iff {c : ℕ} (hc : 1 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : Faithful χ)
    (j : ℕ) : (χ ^ j).IsPrimitive ↔ ¬ p ∣ j

PAG68::faithful_pow_factors_iff.text:
theorem faithful_pow_factors_iff (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {c : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : Faithful χ)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ c + 1) (j : ℕ) :
    (χ ^ j).FactorsThrough (p ^ m) ↔ Nat.card (ZMod.unitsMap (pow_dvd_pow p hm)).ker ∣ j

PAG68::faithful_pow_conductor_iff.text:
theorem faithful_pow_conductor_iff (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {c : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : Faithful χ)
    (m : ℕ) (hm2 : 2 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ c + 1) (j : ℕ) :
    (χ ^ j).conductor = p ^ m ↔ p ^ (c + 1 - m) ∣ j ∧ ¬ p ^ (c + 1 - m + 1) ∣ j

PAG68::faithful_pow_conductor_p_iff.text:
theorem faithful_pow_conductor_p_iff (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {c : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)))
    (hχ : Faithful χ) (j : ℕ) :
    (χ ^ j).conductor = p ^ 1 ↔ p ^ c ∣ j ∧ ¬ phi (p := p) c ∣ j

PAG68::omega_isFaithful.text: theorem omega_isFaithful (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (c : ℕ) : Faithful (omega c hp2)

PAG68::omegaLow_isFaithful.text: theorem omegaLow_isFaithful (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (c c' : ℕ) (hcc : c' ≤ c) : Faithful (omegaLow hp2 c c' hcc)

PAG68::tower_compat.text:
theorem tower_compat (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (c c' c'' : ℕ) (h1 : c'' ≤ c') (h2 : c' ≤ c) :
    DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c'' + 1 ≤ c' + 1)) (omegaLow hp2 c c'' (by omega))
      = omegaLow hp2 c c' h2 ^ (p ^ (c' - c''))

PAG68::omegaLow_top.text: theorem omegaLow_top (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (c : ℕ) : omegaLow hp2 c c le_rfl = omega c hp2

PAG69::thmA_with_psi.text:
theorem thmA_with_psi (K w n v u m : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (hu : u = w + v)
    (hm : n + 1 - v = m) (huK : u + m ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ m)) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : m ≤ n + 1)) _ x)) :
    ∃ C : ℂ, Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₂) = C • ket K u m huK ψ

PAG69::table_zero.text:
theorem table_zero (K w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ : ℕ) (hc₁ : 1 ≤ c₁) (hc₂ : 1 ≤ c₂) (h₁ : c₁ ≤ c) (h₂ : c₂ ≤ c)
    (hK₁ : w₁ + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (hK₂ : w₂ + (c₂ + 1) ≤ K) (j₁ j₂ : ℕ) (hj₁ : ¬ p ∣ j₁) (hj₂ : ¬ p ∣ j₂)
    (hab : K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁ ≠ K - (c₂ + 1) - w₂) :
    conv (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) hK₁ ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      (ket K w₂ (c₂ + 1) hK₂ ((omegaLow hp2 c c₂ h₂ ^ j₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₂ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ)) = 0

PAG69::table_mixed.text:
theorem table_mixed (K w₁ c₁ c₂ : ℕ) (hc₁ : 1 ≤ c₁) (hlt : c₂ < c₁) (h₁ : c₁ ≤ c)
    (hK₁ : w₁ + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (hK₂ : w₁ + (c₁ - c₂) + (c₂ + 1) ≤ K) (j₁ j₂ : ℕ) (hj₁ : ¬ p ∣ j₁)
    (hψ₂ : (omegaLow hp2 c c₂ (by omega) ^ j₂).IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ C : ℂ, Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) hK₁ ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        (ket K (w₁ + (c₁ - c₂)) (c₂ + 1) hK₂
          ((omegaLow hp2 c c₂ (by omega) ^ j₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₂ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        = C • ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) hK₁
          ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ (j₁ + p ^ (c₁ - c₂) * j₂) : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ)

PAG69::table_descent.text:
theorem table_descent (K w c₁ : ℕ) (hc₁ : 1 ≤ c₁) (h₁ : c₁ ≤ c) (hK : w + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (j₁ j₂ : ℕ)
    (hj₁ : ¬ p ∣ j₁) (hj₂ : ¬ p ∣ j₂) (hν : padicValNat p (j₁ + j₂) ≤ c₁ - 1)
    (hK' : w + padicValNat p (j₁ + j₂) + (c₁ - padicValNat p (j₁ + j₂) + 1) ≤ K) :
    ∃ C : ℂ, Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket K w (c₁ + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        (ket K w (c₁ + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        = C • ket K (w + padicValNat p (j₁ + j₂)) (c₁ - padicValNat p (j₁ + j₂) + 1) hK'
          ((omegaLow hp2 c (c₁ - padicValNat p (j₁ + j₂)) (by omega) ^ ((j₁ + j₂) / p ^ padicValNat p (j₁ + j₂)) :
            DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ - padicValNat p (j₁ + j₂) + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ)

PAG69::table_B.text:
theorem table_B (K w c₁ : ℕ) (hc₁ : 1 ≤ c₁) (h₁ : c₁ ≤ c) (hK : w + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (j₁ j₂ : ℕ)
    (hj₁ : ¬ p ∣ j₁) (hφ : phi (p := p) c₁ ∣ j₁ + j₂) :
    conv (ket K w (c₁ + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      (ket K w (c₁ + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      = (omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₁) (-1) • ballB (p := p) K w c₁

theorem phi_eq (c₁ : ℕ) : phi (p := p) c₁ = p ^ c₁ * phi (p := p) 0

PAG70::table_bottom.text:
theorem table_bottom (c K w c₁ : ℕ) (hc₁ : 1 ≤ c₁) (h₁ : c₁ ≤ c) (hK : w + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (j₁ j₂ : ℕ)
    (hj₁ : ¬ p ∣ j₁) (hj₂ : ¬ p ∣ j₂) (hν : c₁ ≤ padicValNat p (j₁ + j₂)) (hφ : ¬ phi (p := p) c₁ ∣ j₁ + j₂)
    (hK' : w + c₁ + (0 + 1) ≤ K) :
    ∃ C : ℂ, Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket K w (c₁ + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        (ket K w (c₁ + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        = C • ket K (w + c₁) (0 + 1) hK'
          ((omegaLow hp2 c 0 (Nat.zero_le _) ^ ((j₁ + j₂) / p ^ c₁) :
            DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (0 + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ)

PAG70::same_shell_cases.text:

theorem p2_table_descent (K w d : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K) (s j s' j' : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) (hj' : Odd j')
    (hν1 : 1 ≤ padicValNat 2 (j + j')) (hνd : padicValNat 2 (j + j') ≤ d)
    (hK' : w + padicValNat 2 (j + j') + (d - padicValNat 2 (j + j') + 3) ≤ K) :
    ∃ C : ℂ, Complex.normSq C = (2 : ℝ) ^ K / (sz 2 K (K - (d + 3) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s' j'))
        = C • ket (p := 2) K (w + padicValNat 2 (j + j')) (d - padicValNat 2 (j + j') + 3) hK'
          (chiSJ (d - padicValNat 2 (j + j')) (s + s') ((j + j') / 2 ^ padicValNat 2 (j + j')))

    (hs : Odd (s + s')) (hM : 2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j') :

PAG74::levelp_B.text:
theorem levelp_B (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (0 + 1) ≤ K) (j₁ j₂ : ℕ) (hj₁ : ¬ phi (p := p) 0 ∣ j₁)
    (hφ : phi (p := p) 0 ∣ j₁ + j₂) :

theorem levelp_A (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (0 + 1) ≤ K) (j₁ j₂ : ℕ) (hj₁ : ¬ phi (p := p) 0 ∣ j₁)
