theorem odd_outcome_determines (K w c₁ : ℕ) (hc₁ : 1 ≤ c₁) (h₁ : c₁ ≤ c) (hK : w + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (j₁ j₂ : ℕ)
    (hj₁ : ¬ p ∣ j₁) (hj₂ : ¬ p ∣ j₂)
    (u m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hu : u + m ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ m)) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (C : ℂ) (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (hF : conv (ket K w (c₁ + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      (ket K w (c₁ + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      = C • ket K u m hu ψ) :
    ¬ phi (p := p) c₁ ∣ j₁ + j₂ ∧
      u = w + min (padicValNat p (j₁ + j₂)) c₁ ∧ m = c₁ + 1 - min (padicValNat p (j₁ + j₂)) c₁

theorem odd_B_not_ket (K w c₁ : ℕ) (hc₁ : 1 ≤ c₁) (h₁ : c₁ ≤ c) (hK : w + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (j₁ j₂ : ℕ)
    (hj₁ : ¬ p ∣ j₁) (hφ : phi (p := p) c₁ ∣ j₁ + j₂)
    (u m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hu : u + m ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ m)) (C : ℂ) :
    conv (ket K w (c₁ + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      (ket K w (c₁ + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      ≠ C • ket K u m hu ψ

PAG76::p2_outcome_determines.text:
theorem p2_outcome_determines {d : ℕ} (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K) (s j s' j' : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) (hj' : Odd j')
    (u m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hu : u + m ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ m)) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (C : ℂ)
    (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (hF : conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s' j'))
      = C • ket (p := 2) K u m hu ψ) :
    ¬ (2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j' ∧ Even (s + s')) ∧
    (¬ 2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j' → u = w + padicValNat 2 (j + j') ∧ m = d - padicValNat 2 (j + j') + 3) ∧
    (2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j' → u = w + (d + 1) ∧ m = 2)

theorem dual_shell_conservation (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (hab : K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁ = K - (n₂ + 1) - w₂)
    (u n : ℕ) (hu : u + (n + 1) ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (C : ℂ)
    (hF : conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = C • ket K u (n + 1) hu ψ) :
    K - (n + 1) - u = K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁

PAG77::odd_mixed_determines.text:
theorem odd_mixed_determines (K w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ : ℕ) (hc₁ : 1 ≤ c₁) (hc₂ : 1 ≤ c₂) (h₁ : c₁ ≤ c) (h₂ : c₂ ≤ c)
    (hK₁ : w₁ + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (hK₂ : w₂ + (c₂ + 1) ≤ K) (j₁ j₂ : ℕ) (hj₁ : ¬ p ∣ j₁) (hj₂ : ¬ p ∣ j₂)
    (hw : w₁ < w₂) (hab : w₁ + c₁ = w₂ + c₂)
    (u n : ℕ) (hu : u + (n + 1) ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (C : ℂ)
    (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (hF : conv (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) hK₁ ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      (ket K w₂ (c₂ + 1) hK₂ ((omegaLow hp2 c c₂ h₂ ^ j₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₂ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      = C • ket K u (n + 1) hu ψ) :
    u = w₁ ∧ n = c₁

PAG78::p2_mixed_determines.text:
theorem p2_mixed_determines (d d' : ℕ) (h : d' < d) (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K)
    (h₂ : w + (d - d') + (d' + 3) ≤ K) (s j s' j' : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) (hj' : Odd j')
    (u m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hu : u + m ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ m)) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (C : ℂ)

      (ket (p := 2) K (w + (d - d')) (d' + 3) h₂ (chiSJ d' s' j')) = C • ket (p := 2) K u m hu ψ) :
    u = w ∧ m = d + 3

PAG78::p2_mixed_determines'.text:
theorem p2_mixed_determines' (d d' : ℕ) (h : d' < d) (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K)

theorem dual_shell_conservation_add (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)

PAG78::diff_dual_not_ket.text:
theorem diff_dual_not_ket (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)

PAG79::dft_ket_eq_zero.text:
theorem dft_ket_eq_zero (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))

PAG79::ip_ket_conv_eq_zero.text:
theorem ip_ket_conv_eq_zero (K w' n' : ℕ) (h' : w' + (n' + 1) ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n' + 1)))
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (w₁ n₁ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1)))

PAG79::repr_conv_eq_zero.text:
theorem repr_conv_eq_zero (K w' n' : ℕ) (h' : w' + (n' + 1) ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n' + 1)))
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (w₁ n₁ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hne : K - (n' + 1) - w' ≠ K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁) (g : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ)
    (hmem : ket K w' (n' + 1) h' ψ ∈ family (p := p) K) :
    (familyBasis (p := p) K).repr (conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) g) ⟨_, hmem⟩ = 0

PAG79::ket_mem_family.text:
theorem ket_mem_family (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) : ket K w (n + 1) h ψ ∈ family (p := p) K

PAG79::conv_component_dual.text:
theorem conv_component_dual (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (w' n' : ℕ) (h' : w' + (n' + 1) ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n' + 1))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hnz : ip (ket K w' (n' + 1) h' ψ) (conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂)) ≠ 0) :
    K - (n' + 1) - w' = K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁ ∧ K - (n' + 1) - w' = K - (n₂ + 1) - w₂

PAG80::tilde_ball.text: theorem tilde_ball (K j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ K) : tilde (PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K j) = PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K j

PAG80::tilde_shellInd.text: theorem tilde_shellInd (K v : ℕ) (hv : v < K) : tilde (shellInd (p := p) K v hv) = shellInd (p := p) K v hv

PAG80::conv_right_comm.text: theorem conv_right_comm {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f g h : ZMod N → ℂ) : conv (conv f g) h = conv (conv f h) g

PAG80::mu.text:
noncomputable def mu (K w c v : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (if w + c ≤ v then (p : ℂ) ^ (K - v) else 0) - (if w + c ≤ v + 1 then (p : ℂ) ^ (K - (v + 1)) else 0)

PAG80::ip_shellInd_conv.text:
theorem ip_shellInd_conv (K w n v : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (hv : v < K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (g : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    ip (shellInd (p := p) K v hv) (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) g)
      = mu (p := p) K w (n + 1) v * conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) g 0

PAG80::ip_delta_conv.text: theorem ip_delta_conv (K : ℕ) (F : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) : ip (Pi.single (0 : ZMod (p ^ K)) (1 : ℂ)) F = F 0

PAG80::ip_shellInd_conv_low.text:
theorem ip_shellInd_conv_low (K w n v : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (hv : v < K) (hlow : v + 1 < w + (n + 1))
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (g : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    ip (shellInd (p := p) K v hv) (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) g) = 0

PAG80::ip_ind_conv_zero.text:
theorem ip_ind_conv_zero (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (g : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ)
    (h0 : conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) g 0 = 0) :
    ip (Pi.single (0 : ZMod (p ^ K)) (1 : ℂ)) (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) g) = 0 ∧
    ∀ v (hv : v < K), ip (shellInd (p := p) K v hv) (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) g) = 0

PAG81::conv_zero_ip.text:
theorem conv_zero_ip (K w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + c₁ ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + c₂ ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c₁)) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c₂)) :
    χ₁⁻¹ (-1) * conv (ket K w₁ c₁ h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ c₂ h₂ χ₂) 0
      = ip (ket K w₁ c₁ h₁ ((χ₁⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ)) (ket K w₂ c₂ h₂ χ₂)

PAG81::inv_neg_one.text: theorem inv_neg_one {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : χ⁻¹ (-1) = χ (-1)

PAG81::conv_zero_eq_zero_of_ne.text:
theorem conv_zero_eq_zero_of_ne (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (hne : w₁ ≠ w₂ ∨ n₁ ≠ n₂) :
    conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) 0 = 0

PAG81::conv_zero_same.text:
open Classical in
theorem conv_zero_same (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    conv (ket K w (n + 1) h χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) h χ₂) 0 = if χ₂ = χ₁⁻¹ then χ₁ (-1) else 0

PAG81::ind_components_zero_same.text:
open Classical in
theorem ind_components_zero_same (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (hc : χ₂ ≠ χ₁⁻¹) :
    ip (Pi.single (0 : ZMod (p ^ K)) (1 : ℂ)) (conv (ket K w (n + 1) h χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) h χ₂)) = 0 ∧
    ∀ v (hv : v < K), ip (shellInd (p := p) K v hv) (conv (ket K w (n + 1) h χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) h χ₂)) = 0

PAG81::ind_components_zero_ne.text:
theorem ind_components_zero_ne (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (hne : w₁ ≠ w₂ ∨ n₁ ≠ n₂) :
    ip (Pi.single (0 : ZMod (p ^ K)) (1 : ℂ)) (conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂)) = 0 ∧
    ∀ v (hv : v < K), ip (shellInd (p := p) K v hv)
      (conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂)) = 0

PAG82::conv_zero_ne_iff.text:
theorem conv_zero_ne_iff (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    conv (ket K w (n + 1) h χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) h χ₂) 0 ≠ 0 ↔ χ₂ = χ₁⁻¹

PAG82::odd_B_iff_conv_zero.text:
theorem odd_B_iff_conv_zero (K w c₁ : ℕ) (hc₁ : 1 ≤ c₁) (h₁ : c₁ ≤ c) (hK : w + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (j₁ j₂ : ℕ)
    (hj₁ : ¬ p ∣ j₁) (hj₂ : ¬ p ∣ j₂) :
    phi (p := p) c₁ ∣ j₁ + j₂ ↔
      conv (ket K w (c₁ + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        (ket K w (c₁ + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ)) 0
        ≠ 0

PAG82::odd_three_equiv.text:
theorem odd_three_equiv (K w c₁ : ℕ) (hc₁ : 1 ≤ c₁) (h₁ : c₁ ≤ c) (hK : w + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (j₁ j₂ : ℕ)
    (hj₁ : ¬ p ∣ j₁) (hj₂ : ¬ p ∣ j₂) :
    (phi (p := p) c₁ ∣ j₁ + j₂ ↔
      conv (ket K w (c₁ + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        (ket K w (c₁ + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ)) 0
        ≠ 0) ∧
    (phi (p := p) c₁ ∣ j₁ + j₂ ↔ omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₂ = (omegaLow hp2 c c₁ h₁ ^ j₁)⁻¹)

PAG82::p2_B_iff_conv_zero.text:
theorem p2_B_iff_conv_zero {d : ℕ} (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K) (s j s' j' : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) (hj' : Odd j') :
    (2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j' ∧ Even (s + s')) ↔
      conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s' j')) 0 ≠ 0

PAG82::p2_three_equiv.text:
theorem p2_three_equiv {d : ℕ} (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K) (s j s' j' : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) (hj' : Odd j') :
    ((2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j' ∧ Even (s + s')) ↔
      conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s' j')) 0 ≠ 0) ∧
    ((2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j' ∧ Even (s + s')) ↔ chiSJ d s' j' = (chiSJ d s j)⁻¹)

PAG83::changeLevel_chi4.text:
theorem changeLevel_chi4 (d : ℕ) :
    DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow 2 (by omega : 2 ≤ d + 3)) chi4 = chiSJ d 1 0

PAG83::mixed_chi4_apply.text:
theorem mixed_chi4_apply (d s j : ℕ) (x : ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3))) :
    chiSJ d (s + 1) j x = chiSJ d s j x * chi4 (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow 2 (by omega : 2 ≤ d + 3)) _ x)

PAG83::mixed_ket_chi4.text:
theorem mixed_ket_chi4 (d : ℕ) (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K) (h₂ : w + (d + 1) + 2 ≤ K)
    (s j : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) :
    ∃ C : ℂ, Complex.normSq C = (2 : ℝ) ^ K / (sz 2 K (K - (d + 3) - w) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K (w + (d + 1)) 2 h₂ chi4)
        = C • ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d (s + 1) j)

PAG83::mixed_chi4_determines.text:
theorem mixed_chi4_determines (d : ℕ) (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K) (h₂ : w + (d + 1) + 2 ≤ K)
    (s j : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) (u m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hu : u + m ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ m))
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (C : ℂ) (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (hF : conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K (w + (d + 1)) 2 h₂ chi4)
      = C • ket (p := 2) K u m hu ψ) :
    u = w ∧ m = d + 3

PAG83::mixed_chi4_determines'.text:
theorem mixed_chi4_determines' (d : ℕ) (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K) (h₂ : w + (d + 1) + 2 ≤ K)
    (s j : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) (u m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hu : u + m ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ m))
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (C : ℂ) (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (hF : conv (ket (p := 2) K (w + (d + 1)) 2 h₂ chi4) (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j))
      = C • ket (p := 2) K u m hu ψ) :
    u = w ∧ m = d + 3

PAG84::chi4_conv_self.text:
theorem chi4_conv_self (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (1 + 1) ≤ K) :
    conv (ket (p := 2) K w (1 + 1) hK chi4) (ket (p := 2) K w (1 + 1) hK chi4) = (-1 : ℂ) • ballB (p := 2) K w 1

PAG84::chi4_conv_self_zero.text:
theorem chi4_conv_self_zero (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (1 + 1) ≤ K) :
    conv (ket (p := 2) K w (1 + 1) hK chi4) (ket (p := 2) K w (1 + 1) hK chi4) 0 = -1

PAG84::levelp_three_equiv.text:
theorem levelp_three_equiv (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (0 + 1) ≤ K) (j₁ j₂ : ℕ) (hj₁ : ¬ phi (p := p) 0 ∣ j₁)
    (hj₂ : ¬ phi (p := p) 0 ∣ j₂) :
    (phi (p := p) 0 ∣ j₁ + j₂ ↔
      conv (ket K w (0 + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c 0 (Nat.zero_le _) ^ j₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (0 + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        (ket K w (0 + 1) hK ((omegaLow hp2 c 0 (Nat.zero_le _) ^ j₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (0 + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        0 ≠ 0) ∧
    (phi (p := p) 0 ∣ j₁ + j₂ ↔
      omegaLow hp2 c 0 (Nat.zero_le _) ^ j₂ = (omegaLow hp2 c 0 (Nat.zero_le _) ^ j₁)⁻¹)

PAG85::p2_mixed_general.text:
theorem p2_mixed_general (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (hab : K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁ = K - (n₂ + 1) - w₂)
    (hw : w₁ < w₂) :
    ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (n₁ + 1)), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
      Complex.normSq C = (2 : ℝ) ^ K / (sz 2 K (K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁) : ℝ) ∧
      conv (ket (p := 2) K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket (p := 2) K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂)
        = C • ket (p := 2) K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ ψ

PAG85::p2_mixed_general_determines.text:
theorem p2_mixed_general_determines (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (hab : K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁ = K - (n₂ + 1) - w₂)
    (hw : w₁ < w₂) (u m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hu : u + m ≤ K) (ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ m))
    (hψ' : ψ'.IsPrimitive) (C' : ℂ) (hC' : C' ≠ 0)
    (hF : conv (ket (p := 2) K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket (p := 2) K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂)
      = C' • ket (p := 2) K u m hu ψ') :
    u = w₁ ∧ m = n₁ + 1

PAG86::inv_pair_ballB.text:
theorem inv_pair_ballB {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hinv : χ₂ = χ₁⁻¹) :
    conv (ket K w (n + 1) h χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) h χ₂) = χ₁ (-1) • ballB (p := p) K w n

PAG87::odd_mixed_general.text:

PAG88::norm_conv_ket.text:
theorem norm_conv_ket (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (hab : K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁ = K - (n₂ + 1) - w₂) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) x)

PAG88::norm_conv_ket_ne.text:
theorem norm_conv_ket_ne (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)

    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    let F

PAG89::conv_assoc'.text: theorem conv_assoc' {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f g h : ZMod N → ℂ) : conv (conv f g) h = conv f (conv g h)

PAG89::adjoint_mul.text:
theorem adjoint_mul (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    conv (tilde (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ)) (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) f)
      = ((p : ℂ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℂ)) • conv (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) f

PAG89::normSq_dft_ket_cases.text:
theorem normSq_dft_ket_cases (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    𝓕 (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) t = 0 ∧ Complex.normSq (𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) t) = 0 ∨
    𝓕 (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) t = 1 ∧
      Complex.normSq (𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) t) = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)

PAG89::lam_nonneg.text:
omit hp in
theorem lam_nonneg (K a : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K a : ℝ)

PAG89::norm_conv_le.text:
theorem norm_conv_le (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) f x)
      ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) * ∑ x, Complex.normSq (f x)

PAG89::norm_conv_eq_of_mem.text:
theorem norm_conv_eq_of_mem (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hf : conv (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) f = f) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) f x)
      = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) * ∑ x, Complex.normSq (f x)

PAG89::conv_eq_zero_of_perp.text:
theorem conv_eq_zero_of_perp (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hf : conv (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) f = 0) :
    conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) f = 0

PAG90::prodConv.text:
noncomputable def prodConv {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (k : ZMod N → ℂ) : List (ZMod N → ℂ) → ZMod N → ℂ
  | [] => k
  | k' :: l => conv k (prodConv k' l)

PAG90::KetDual.le.text: theorem KetDual.le {K a : ℕ} {f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ} (hf : KetDual (p := p) K a f) : a ≤ K

PAG90::KetDual.eps.text:
theorem KetDual.eps {K a : ℕ} {f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ} (hf : KetDual (p := p) K a f) :
    conv (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K a) f = f

PAG90::KetDual.norm.text:
theorem KetDual.norm {K a : ℕ} {f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ} (hf : KetDual (p := p) K a f) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (f x) = 1

PAG90::KetDual.dft_zero.text:
theorem KetDual.dft_zero {K a : ℕ} {f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ} (hf : KetDual (p := p) K a f) (t : ZMod (p ^ K))
    (h0 : 𝓕 (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K a) t = 0) : 𝓕 f t = 0

PAG90::prodConv_same_dual.text:
theorem prodConv_same_dual (K a : ℕ) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (l : List (ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ))
    (hk : KetDual (p := p) K a k) (hl : ∀ g ∈ l, KetDual (p := p) K a g) :
    conv (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K a) (prodConv k l) = prodConv k l ∧
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (prodConv k l x) = ((p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K a : ℝ)) ^ l.length

PAG90::dft_prodConv.text:
theorem dft_prodConv (K : ℕ) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (l : List (ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ)) (t : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    𝓕 (prodConv k l) t = ((k :: l).map (fun g => 𝓕 g t)).prod

PAG90::prodConv_diff_dual.text:
theorem prodConv_diff_dual (K a b : ℕ) (hab : a ≠ b) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (l : List (ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ))
    (g₁ g₂ : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (h₁ : g₁ ∈ k :: l) (h₂ : g₂ ∈ k :: l)
    (hg₁ : KetDual (p := p) K a g₁) (hg₂ : KetDual (p := p) K b g₂) :
    prodConv k l = 0

PAG91::norm_eps.text:
theorem norm_eps (K a : ℕ) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hk : KetDual (p := p) K a k) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K a x)
      = (sz p K a : ℝ) / (p : ℝ) ^ K

PAG91::ip_eps.text:
theorem ip_eps (K a : ℕ) (F : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    ip (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K a) F
      = conv F (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K a) 0

PAG91::ip_eps_ket.text:
theorem ip_eps_ket (K a : ℕ) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hk : KetDual (p := p) K a k) :
    ip (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K a) k = 0

PAG91::T_eps.text:
theorem T_eps (K a : ℕ) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hk : KetDual (p := p) K a k) :
    conv k (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K a) = k

PAG91::ip_eps_T.text:
theorem ip_eps_T (K a : ℕ) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hk : KetDual (p := p) K a k) (g : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    ip (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K a) (conv k g) = conv k g 0

PAG91::ip_eps_T_ket.text:
open Classical in
theorem ip_eps_T_ket (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ χ'' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ'' : χ''.IsPrimitive) :
    ip (PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K (K - (n + 1) - w))
      (conv (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) (ket K w (n + 1) h χ'')) = if χ'' = χ⁻¹ then χ (-1) else 0

PAG92::T_conj.text:
theorem T_conj (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    conv (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) (ket K w (n + 1) h ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      = (χ (-1) * ((p : ℂ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℂ))) •
          PAG.Part14.epsBall (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K) K (K - (n + 1) - w)

PAG92::T_other_shell.text:
theorem T_other_shell (K w n w'' n'' : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (h'' : w'' + (n'' + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (χ'' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n'' + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ'' : χ''.IsPrimitive) (hab : K - (n + 1) - w = K - (n'' + 1) - w'')
    (hw : w ≠ w'') :
    ∃ u m : ℕ, ∃ hu : u + (m + 1) ≤ K, ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (m + 1)), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧
      ∃ C : ℂ, Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
        conv (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) (ket K w'' (n'' + 1) h'' χ'') = C • ket K u (m + 1) hu ψ

PAG92::T_same_shell.text:
theorem T_same_shell (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ χ'' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ'' : χ''.IsPrimitive) (hne : χ'' ≠ χ⁻¹) :
    ∃ u m : ℕ, ∃ hu : u + (m + 1) ≤ K, ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (m + 1)), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧
      ∃ C : ℂ, Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
        conv (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) (ket K w (n + 1) h χ'') = C • ket K u (m + 1) hu ψ ∧
        u + (m + 1) = w + (n + 1)

PAG93::Bset.text: noncomputable def Bset (K a : ℕ) : Set (ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) := {g | KetDual (p := p) K a g} ∪ {eps (p := p) K a}

PAG93::conv_add_right'.text: theorem conv_add_right' {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f g h : ZMod N → ℂ) : conv f (g + h) = conv f g + conv f h

PAG93::eps_conv_mem.text:
theorem eps_conv_mem (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (g : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hg : g ∈ IndSpan (p := p) K) :
    conv (eps (p := p) K a) g ∈ Submodule.span ℂ {eps (p := p) K a}

PAG93::mem_span_of_eps.text:
theorem mem_span_of_eps (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ)
    (hf : conv (eps (p := p) K a) f = f) : f ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Bset (p := p) K a)

PAG93::eps_of_mem_span.text:
theorem eps_of_mem_span (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ)
    (hf : f ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Bset (p := p) K a)) : conv (eps (p := p) K a) f = f

PAG93::Va_eq_span.text:
theorem Va_eq_span (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    conv (eps (p := p) K a) f = f ↔ f ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Bset (p := p) K a)

PAG94::sum_eps.text: theorem sum_eps (K : ℕ) : ∑ a ∈ range (K + 1), eps (p := p) K a = Pi.single (0 : ZMod (p ^ K)) (1 : ℂ)

PAG94::decomp.text: theorem decomp (K : ℕ) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) : f = ∑ a ∈ range (K + 1), conv (eps (p := p) K a) f

PAG94::comp_mem.text:
theorem comp_mem (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    conv (eps (p := p) K a) (conv (eps (p := p) K a) f) = conv (eps (p := p) K a) f

PAG94::comp_orth.text:
theorem comp_orth (K a b : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (hb : b ≤ K) (hab : a ≠ b) (f g : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    ip (conv (eps (p := p) K a) f) (conv (eps (p := p) K b) g) = 0

PAG94::pythagoras.text:
theorem pythagoras (K : ℕ) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    ip f f = ∑ a ∈ range (K + 1), ip (conv (eps (p := p) K a) f) (conv (eps (p := p) K a) f)

PAG95::Tset.text:
noncomputable def Tset (K a : ℕ) : Finset (ZMod (p ^ K)) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun t => 𝓕 (eps (p := p) K a) t = 1)

PAG95::card_Tset.text:
theorem card_Tset (K a : ℕ) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hk : KetDual (p := p) K a k) :
    (Tset (p := p) K a).card = sz p K a

PAG95::Va.text: noncomputable abbrev Va (K a : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ (ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) := Submodule.span ℂ (Bset (p := p) K a)

PAG95::Phi.text:
noncomputable def Phi (K a : ℕ) : Va (p := p) K a →ₗ[ℂ] (Tset (p := p) K a → ℂ) where
  toFun f := fun t => 𝓕 (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) t
  map_add' f g := by funext t; simp [map_add]
  map_smul' c f := by funext t; simp

PAG95::dft_eps_conv.text:
theorem dft_eps_conv (K a : ℕ) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (t : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    𝓕 (conv (eps (p := p) K a) f) t = 𝓕 (eps (p := p) K a) t * 𝓕 f t

PAG95::Phi_bijective.text: theorem Phi_bijective (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) : Function.Bijective (Phi (p := p) K a)

PAG95::finrank_Va.text:
theorem finrank_Va (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Va (p := p) K a) = (Tset (p := p) K a).card

PAG95::J.text: def J (K a : ℕ) := {x : (n : Fin K) × DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ ((n : ℕ) + 1)) // x.2.IsPrimitive ∧ (x.1 : ℕ) + 1 ≤ K - a}

PAG95::.text:
noncomputable instance (K a : ℕ) : Fintype (J (p := p) K a) := by
  unfold J
  exact Fintype.ofFinite _

PAG95::ketJ.text:
noncomputable def ketJ (K a : ℕ) (x : J (p := p) K a) : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  ket K (K - a - ((x.1.1 : ℕ) + 1)) ((x.1.1 : ℕ) + 1) (by have := x.1.1.2; omega) x.1.2

PAG95::fam.text:
noncomputable def fam (K a : ℕ) : Option (J (p := p) K a) → ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ
  | none => eps (p := p) K a
  | some x => ketJ K a x

PAG95::ketJ_dual.text: theorem ketJ_dual (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (x : J (p := p) K a) : KetDual (p := p) K a (ketJ K a x)

PAG95::fam_orth.text:
theorem fam_orth (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (i j : Option (J (p := p) K a)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ip (fam K a i) (fam K a j) = 0

PAG95::fam_ne_zero.text: theorem fam_ne_zero (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (i : Option (J (p := p) K a)) : fam K a i ≠ 0

PAG95::fam_linIndep.text: theorem fam_linIndep (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) : LinearIndependent ℂ (fam (p := p) K a)

PAG95::range_fam.text: theorem range_fam (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) : Set.range (fam (p := p) K a) = Bset (p := p) K a

PAG95::card_J_add_one.text:
theorem card_J_add_one (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hk : KetDual (p := p) K a k) :
    Fintype.card (J (p := p) K a) + 1 = sz p K a

PAG96::Np.text: noncomputable def Np (c : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c) // χ.IsPrimitive}

PAG96::card_J.text:
omit hp in
theorem card_J (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) :
    Fintype.card (J (p := p) K a) = ∑ n ∈ range (K - a), Np (p := p) (n + 1)

PAG96::exists_ket_odd.text: theorem exists_ket_odd (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (K a : ℕ) (ha : a < K) : ∃ k, KetDual (p := p) K a k

PAG96::exists_ket_two.text: theorem exists_ket_two (K a : ℕ) (ha : a + 2 ≤ K) : ∃ k, KetDual (p := 2) K a k

PAG96::sum_Np.text:
theorem sum_Np (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ∑ n ∈ range m, Np (p := p) (n + 1) + 1 = p ^ (m - 1) * (p - 1)

PAG96::Np_succ_succ.text: theorem Np_succ_succ (m : ℕ) : Np (p := p) (m + 2) = p ^ m * (p - 1) ^ 2

PAG97::echar.text: noncomputable def echar (K : ℕ) (t : ZMod (p ^ K)) : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ := fun x => stdAddChar (x * t)

PAG97::conv_echar.text:
theorem conv_echar (K : ℕ) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (t : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    conv f (echar K t) = 𝓕 f t • echar K t

PAG97::eigen_abs.text:
theorem eigen_abs (K a : ℕ) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hk : KetDual (p := p) K a k) (t : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    (t ∈ Tset (p := p) K a → Complex.normSq (𝓕 k t) = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K a : ℝ)) ∧
    (t ∉ Tset (p := p) K a → 𝓕 k t = 0)

PAG97::sum_dft_Tset.text:
theorem sum_dft_Tset (K a : ℕ) (g : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hg : ∀ t, t ∉ Tset (p := p) K a → 𝓕 g t = 0) :
    ∑ t ∈ Tset (p := p) K a, 𝓕 g t = (p ^ K : ℕ) * g 0

PAG97::trace_zero.text:
theorem trace_zero (K a : ℕ) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hk : KetDual (p := p) K a k) :
    ∑ t ∈ Tset (p := p) K a, 𝓕 k t = 0

PAG97::trace_pow.text:
theorem trace_pow (K a : ℕ) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hk : KetDual (p := p) K a k) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ t ∈ Tset (p := p) K a, 𝓕 k t ^ (n + 1) = (p ^ K : ℕ) * prodConv k (List.replicate n k) 0

PAG98::natCast_mul_shellEmb.text:
omit hp in
theorem natCast_mul_shellEmb (K w : ℕ) (hw : w ≤ K) (m : ℕ) (y : ZMod (p ^ (K - w))) :
    (m : ZMod (p ^ K)) * shellEmb (p := p) K w hw y = shellEmb (p := p) K w hw ((m : ZMod (p ^ (K - w))) * y)

PAG98::Equivariant.text:
def Equivariant (K : ℕ) (α : (ZMod (p ^ K))ˣ → ℂ) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (u : (ZMod (p ^ K))ˣ) (x : ZMod (p ^ K)), f (u * x) = α u * f x

PAG98::ket_equivariant.text:
theorem ket_equivariant (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    Equivariant (p := p) K (fun u => χ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c ≤ K)) (ZMod (p ^ c)) u))
      (ket K w c h χ)

PAG98::conv_equivariant.text:
theorem conv_equivariant (K : ℕ) (α β : (ZMod (p ^ K))ˣ → ℂ) (f g : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ)
    (hf : Equivariant (p := p) K α f) (hg : Equivariant (p := p) K β g) :
    Equivariant (p := p) K (fun u => α u * β u) (conv f g)

PAG98::prodConv_equivariant.text:
theorem prodConv_equivariant (K : ℕ) (α : (ZMod (p ^ K))ˣ → ℂ) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ)
    (hk : Equivariant (p := p) K α k) (n : ℕ) :
    Equivariant (p := p) K (fun u => α u ^ (n + 1)) (prodConv k (List.replicate n k))

PAG98::shell_point_eq_unit_mul.text:
theorem shell_point_eq_unit_mul (K w : ℕ) (hw : w < K) (y : ZMod (p ^ (K - w))) (hy : IsUnit y) :
    ∃ u : (ZMod (p ^ K))ˣ, shellEmb (p := p) K w hw.le y = u * shellEmb (p := p) K w hw.le 1

PAG98::invariant_mem_IndSpan.text:
theorem invariant_mem_IndSpan (K : ℕ) (F : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ (u : (ZMod (p ^ K))ˣ) (x : ZMod (p ^ K)), F (u * x) = F x) : F ∈ IndSpan (p := p) K

PAG98::pow_eigen_const.text:
theorem pow_eigen_const (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (n : ℕ) (ho : χ ^ (n + 1) = 1) (t t' : ZMod (p ^ K))
    (ht : t ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - c - w)) (ht' : t' ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - c - w)) :
    𝓕 (ket K w c h χ) t ^ (n + 1) = 𝓕 (ket K w c h χ) t' ^ (n + 1)

PAG99::eps_invariant.text:
theorem eps_invariant (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u : (ZMod (p ^ K))ˣ) (x : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    eps (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w) (u * x) = eps (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w) x

PAG99::pow_eigen_nonconst.text:
theorem pow_eigen_nonconst (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (m : ℕ) (hne : χ ^ (m + 1) ≠ 1) :
    ∃ t ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w), ∃ t' ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w),
      𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t ^ (m + 1) ≠ 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t' ^ (m + 1)

PAG100::equivariant_compare.text:
theorem equivariant_compare (K : ℕ) (α β : (ZMod (p ^ K))ˣ → ℂ) (F b : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ)
    (hF : Equivariant (p := p) K α F) (hb : Equivariant (p := p) K β b) (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (he : F = c • b) (hb0 : b ≠ 0) (u : (ZMod (p ^ K))ˣ) : α u = β u

PAG100::char_eq_one_of_units.text:
theorem char_eq_one_of_units (K n : ℕ) (h : n + 1 ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (H : ∀ u : (ZMod (p ^ K))ˣ, ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p h) (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) u) = 1) : ψ = 1

PAG100::cycle_ket.text:
theorem cycle_ket (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (w' n' : ℕ) (h' : w' + (n' + 1) ≤ K) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n' + 1))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (m : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (he : conv (prodConv (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) (List.replicate m (ket K w (n + 1) h χ))) (ket K w' (n' + 1) h' ψ)
      = c • ket K w' (n' + 1) h' ψ) :
    χ ^ (m + 1) = 1

PAG100::cycle_eps.text:
theorem cycle_eps (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (m : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (he : conv (prodConv (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) (List.replicate m (ket K w (n + 1) h χ)))
      (eps (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) = c • eps (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) :
    χ ^ (m + 1) = 1

PAG101::quad_scalar.text:
theorem quad_scalar (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hq : χ * χ = 1) (t : ZMod (p ^ K))
    (ht : t ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) :
    𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t ^ 2 = χ (-1) * ((p : ℂ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℂ))

PAG102::prodConv_zero_vanish.text:
theorem prodConv_zero_vanish (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (m : ℕ) (hne : χ ^ (m + 1) ≠ 1) :
    prodConv (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) (List.replicate m (ket K w (n + 1) h χ)) 0 = 0

PAG102::trace_pow_vanish.text:
theorem trace_pow_vanish (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (m : ℕ) (hne : χ ^ (m + 1) ≠ 1) :
    ∑ t ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w), 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t ^ (m + 1) = 0

PAG102::trace_pow_const.text:
theorem trace_pow_const (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (m : ℕ) (ho : χ ^ (m + 1) = 1) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K))
    (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) :
    ∑ t ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w), 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t ^ (m + 1)
      = ((Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)).card : ℂ) * 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀ ^ (m + 1)

PAG103::geom_indicator.text:
theorem geom_indicator (o : ℕ) (y : ℂ) (hy : y ^ o = 1) :
    ∑ j ∈ range o, y ^ j = if y = 1 then (o : ℂ) else 0

PAG103::eigen_multiplicity.text:
theorem eigen_multiplicity (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w))
    (ξ : ℂ) (hξ : ξ ^ orderOf χ = 1) :
    (orderOf χ : ℂ) * (((Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)).filter
        (fun t => 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t = 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀ * ξ)).card : ℂ)
      = ((Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)).card : ℂ)

PAG104::structure_theorem.text:
theorem structure_theorem (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    let a

PAG105::proj.text:
noncomputable def proj (K : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) →+ ZMod (p ^ K) :=
  (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ K)) (ZMod (p ^ K))).toAddMonoidHom

PAG105::proj_apply.text:
omit hp in
theorem proj_apply (K : ℕ) (x : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1))) :
    proj (p := p) K x = ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ K)) (ZMod (p ^ K)) x

PAG105::proj_surjective.text: theorem proj_surjective (K : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (proj (p := p) K)

PAG105::pull.text: noncomputable def pull (K : ℕ) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) → ℂ := f ∘ proj (p := p) K

PAG105::card_ker.text:
theorem card_ker (K : ℕ) :
    ((univ.filter (fun z : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) => proj (p := p) K z = 0)).card : ℂ) = p

PAG105::conv_pull.text:
theorem conv_pull (K : ℕ) (f g : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    conv (pull (p := p) K f) (pull (p := p) K g) = (p : ℂ) • pull (p := p) K (conv f g)

PAG105::norm_pull.text:
theorem norm_pull (K : ℕ) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (pull (p := p) K f x) = p * ∑ x, Complex.normSq (f x)

PAG105::pull_ball.text:
theorem pull_ball (K j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ K) :
    pull (p := p) K (PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) K j) = PAG.Part22.ball (p := p) (K + 1) j

PAG105::pull_Pavg.text:
theorem pull_Pavg (K u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ K) :
    pull (p := p) K (PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) K u) = (p : ℂ) • PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) (K + 1) (u + 1)

PAG105::pull_eps.text:
theorem pull_eps (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) :
    pull (p := p) K (eps (p := p) K a) = (p : ℂ) • eps (p := p) (K + 1) (a + 1)

PAG105::pull_Va.text:
theorem pull_Va (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hf : conv (eps (p := p) K a) f = f) :
    conv (eps (p := p) (K + 1) (a + 1)) (pull (p := p) K f) = pull (p := p) K f

PAG106::proj_shellEmb.text:
theorem proj_shellEmb (K v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ K) (y : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1 - v))) :
    proj (p := p) K (shellEmb (p := p) (K + 1) v (by omega) y)
      = shellEmb (p := p) K v hv (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : K - v ≤ K + 1 - v)) _ y)

PAG106::push_shell_ne.text:
theorem push_shell_ne (K w v : ℕ) (hw : w < K) (hv : v < K) (hne : v ≠ w)
    (f : ZMod (p ^ (K - w)) → ℂ) (hf : VanishNU f) (y : ZMod (p ^ (K - v))) (hy : IsUnit y) :
    push (shellEmb (p := p) K w hw.le) f (shellEmb (p := p) K v hv.le y) = 0

PAG106::ket_shell_ne.text:
theorem ket_shell_ne (K w c v : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (h : w + c ≤ K) (hv : v < K) (hne : v ≠ w)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (y : ZMod (p ^ (K - v))) (hy : IsUnit y) :
    ket K w c h χ (shellEmb (p := p) K v hv.le y) = 0

PAG106::sz_succ.text:
omit hp in
theorem sz_succ (K w : ℕ) (hw : w < K) : sz p (K + 1) w = p * sz p K w

PAG106::pull_ket.text:
theorem pull_ket (K w c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    pull (p := p) K (ket K w c h χ) = ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ) • ket (K + 1) w c (by omega) χ

PAG106::pull_conv_ket.text:
theorem pull_conv_ket (K w c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    (Real.sqrt p : ℂ) • pull (p := p) K (conv (ket K w c h χ) f)
      = conv (ket (K + 1) w c (by omega) χ) (pull (p := p) K f)

PAG107::pullL.text:
noncomputable def pullL (K : ℕ) : (ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) → ℂ) where
  toFun := pull (p := p) K
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

PAG107::pull_injective.text: theorem pull_injective (K : ℕ) : Function.Injective (pull (p := p) K)

PAG107::pull_delta.text:
theorem pull_delta (K : ℕ) :
    pull (p := p) K (Pi.single (0 : ZMod (p ^ K)) (1 : ℂ)) = (p : ℂ) • PAG.Part28.Pavg (p := p) (K + 1) 1

PAG107::eps0_pull.text:
theorem eps0_pull (K : ℕ) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    conv (eps (p := p) (K + 1) 0) (pull (p := p) K f) = 0

PAG107::E0.text:
noncomputable def E0 (K : ℕ) : (ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) → ℂ) :=
  convL (eps (p := p) (K + 1) 0)

PAG107::range_E0.text: theorem range_E0 (K : ℕ) : LinearMap.range (E0 (p := p) K) = Va (p := p) (K + 1) 0

PAG107::range_pull_eq_ker.text: theorem range_pull_eq_ker (K : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) : LinearMap.range (pullL (p := p) K) = LinearMap.ker (E0 (p := p) K)

PAG107::pull_eps_conv.text:
theorem pull_eps_conv (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    pull (p := p) K (conv (eps (p := p) K a) f) = conv (eps (p := p) (K + 1) (a + 1)) (pull (p := p) K f)

PAG107::Va_succ_eq_pull.text:
theorem Va_succ_eq_pull (K a : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (ha : a ≤ K) (g : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) → ℂ) :
    conv (eps (p := p) (K + 1) (a + 1)) g = g ↔
      ∃ f, conv (eps (p := p) K a) f = f ∧ pull (p := p) K f = g

PAG108::tens.text: def tens (f : G → ℂ) (g : H → ℂ) : G × H → ℂ := fun z => f z.1 * g z.2

PAG108::conv_tens.text:
theorem conv_tens (f₁ g₁ : G → ℂ) (f₂ g₂ : H → ℂ) :
    conv (tens f₁ f₂) (tens g₁ g₂) = tens (conv f₁ g₁) (conv f₂ g₂)

PAG108::normSq_tens.text:
omit [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup H] in
theorem normSq_tens (f : G → ℂ) (g : H → ℂ) :
    ∑ z, Complex.normSq (tens f g z) = (∑ x, Complex.normSq (f x)) * ∑ y, Complex.normSq (g y)

PAG108::tens_single.text:
omit [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H] in
theorem tens_single [DecidableEq G] [DecidableEq H] (a : G) (b : H) :
    tens (Pi.single a (1 : ℂ)) (Pi.single b (1 : ℂ)) = Pi.single (a, b) 1

PAG108::tens_add_left.text:
omit [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H] in
theorem tens_add_left (f₁ f₂ : G → ℂ) (g : H → ℂ) : tens (f₁ + f₂) g = tens f₁ g + tens f₂ g

PAG108::tens_sum.text:
omit [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H] in
theorem tens_sum {ι κ : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (f : ι → G → ℂ) (g : κ → H → ℂ) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ t, tens (f i) (g j) = tens (∑ i ∈ s, f i) (∑ j ∈ t, g j)

PAG108::conv_tens_apply.text:
theorem conv_tens_apply (k₁ : G → ℂ) (k₂ : H → ℂ) (g : G × H → ℂ) (x : G) (y : H) :
    conv (tens k₁ k₂) g (x, y) = conv k₁ (fun x' => conv k₂ (fun y' => g (x', y')) y) x

PAG108::slice_preserved.text:
theorem slice_preserved (e₁ : G → ℂ) (k₂ : H → ℂ) (g : G × H → ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ y, conv e₁ (fun x => g (x, y)) = fun x => g (x, y)) (y : H) :
    conv e₁ (fun x' => conv k₂ (fun y' => g (x', y')) y) = fun x' => conv k₂ (fun y' => g (x', y')) y

PAG108::tens_fix.text:
theorem tens_fix (e₁ : G → ℂ) (e₂ : H → ℂ) (g : G × H → ℂ)
    (h₁ : ∀ y, conv e₁ (fun x => g (x, y)) = fun x => g (x, y))
    (h₂ : ∀ x, conv e₂ (fun y => g (x, y)) = fun y => g (x, y)) :
    conv (tens e₁ e₂) g = g

PAG108::norm_conv_tens.text:
theorem norm_conv_tens (e₁ k₁ : G → ℂ) (e₂ k₂ : H → ℂ) (l₁ l₂ : ℝ)
    (hk₁ : ∀ f, conv e₁ f = f → ∑ x, Complex.normSq (conv k₁ f x) = l₁ * ∑ x, Complex.normSq (f x))
    (hk₂ : ∀ f, conv e₂ f = f → ∑ y, Complex.normSq (conv k₂ f y) = l₂ * ∑ y, Complex.normSq (f y))
    (g : G × H → ℂ)
    (h₁ : ∀ y, conv e₁ (fun x => g (x, y)) = fun x => g (x, y))
    (h₂ : ∀ x, conv e₂ (fun y => g (x, y)) = fun y => g (x, y)) :
    ∑ z, Complex.normSq (conv (tens k₁ k₂) g z) = l₁ * l₂ * ∑ z, Complex.normSq (g z)

PAG108::conv_comp_equiv.text:
theorem conv_comp_equiv (φ : G ≃+ H) (f g : H → ℂ) :
    conv (f ∘ φ) (g ∘ φ) = conv f g ∘ φ

PAG108::normSq_comp_equiv.text:
theorem normSq_comp_equiv (φ : G ≃+ H) (f : H → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq ((f ∘ φ) x) = ∑ y, Complex.normSq (f y)

PAG108::crt.text:
noncomputable def crt (K L : ℕ) (hpq : p ≠ q) : ZMod (p ^ K * q ^ L) ≃+ ZMod (p ^ K) × ZMod (q ^ L) :=
  (ZMod.chineseRemainder (Nat.Coprime.pow K L ((Nat.coprime_primes hp.out hq.out).mpr hpq))).toAddEquiv

PAG108::sum_tens_eps.text:
theorem sum_tens_eps (K L : ℕ) :
    ∑ a ∈ range (K + 1), ∑ b ∈ range (L + 1), tens (eps (p := p) K a) (eps (p := q) L b) = Pi.single 0 1

PAG108::tens_eps_conv.text:
theorem tens_eps_conv (K L a b a' b' : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (ha' : a' ≤ K) (hb : b ≤ L) (hb' : b' ≤ L) :
    conv (tens (eps (p := p) K a) (eps (p := q) L b)) (tens (eps (p := p) K a') (eps (p := q) L b'))
      = if a = a' ∧ b = b' then tens (eps (p := p) K a) (eps (p := q) L b) else 0

PAG108::norm_conv_tens_ket.text:
theorem norm_conv_tens_ket (K w₁ n₁ L w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ L)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (g : ZMod (p ^ K) × ZMod (q ^ L) → ℂ)
    (hg₁ : ∀ y, conv (eps (p := p) K (K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁)) (fun x => g (x, y)) = fun x => g (x, y))
    (hg₂ : ∀ x, conv (eps (p := q) L (L - (n₂ + 1) - w₂)) (fun y => g (x, y)) = fun y => g (x, y)) :
    ∑ z, Complex.normSq (conv (tens (PAG.Part21.ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (PAG.Part21.ket L w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂)) g z)
      = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (PAG.Part19.sz p K (K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁) : ℝ)
        * ((q : ℝ) ^ L / (PAG.Part19.sz q L (L - (n₂ + 1) - w₂) : ℝ)) * ∑ z, Complex.normSq (g z)

PAG108::conv_crt.text:
theorem conv_crt (K L : ℕ) (hpq : p ≠ q) (k g : ZMod (p ^ K) × ZMod (q ^ L) → ℂ) :
    conv (k ∘ crt (p := p) (q := q) K L hpq) (g ∘ crt K L hpq) = conv k g ∘ crt K L hpq

PAG109::conv_assoc_gen.text: theorem conv_assoc_gen (f g h : G → ℂ) : conv (conv f g) h = conv f (conv g h)

PAG109::conv_tens_apply'.text:
theorem conv_tens_apply' (k₁ : G → ℂ) (k₂ : H → ℂ) (g : G × H → ℂ) (x : G) (y : H) :
    conv (tens k₁ k₂) g (x, y) = conv k₂ (fun y' => conv k₁ (fun x' => g (x', y')) x) y

PAG109::tens_fix_iff.text:
theorem tens_fix_iff (e₁ : G → ℂ) (e₂ : H → ℂ) (h₁ : conv e₁ e₁ = e₁) (h₂ : conv e₂ e₂ = e₂)
    (g : G × H → ℂ) :
    conv (tens e₁ e₂) g = g ↔
      (∀ y, conv e₁ (fun x => g (x, y)) = fun x => g (x, y)) ∧
      (∀ x, conv e₂ (fun y => g (x, y)) = fun y => g (x, y))

PAG109::tens_idem.text:
theorem tens_idem (e₁ : G → ℂ) (e₂ : H → ℂ) (h₁ : conv e₁ e₁ = e₁) (h₂ : conv e₂ e₂ = e₂) :
    conv (tens e₁ e₂) (tens e₁ e₂) = tens e₁ e₂

PAG109::IsoOn.text:
def IsoOn {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Fintype X] (e k : X → ℂ) (l : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ f, conv e f = f → ∑ x, Complex.normSq (conv k f x) = l * ∑ x, Complex.normSq (f x)

PAG109::isoOn_tens.text:
theorem isoOn_tens (e₁ k₁ : G → ℂ) (e₂ k₂ : H → ℂ) (l₁ l₂ : ℝ)
    (h₁ : conv e₁ e₁ = e₁) (h₂ : conv e₂ e₂ = e₂)
    (hk₁ : IsoOn e₁ k₁ l₁) (hk₂ : IsoOn e₂ k₂ l₂) :
    IsoOn (tens e₁ e₂) (tens k₁ k₂) (l₁ * l₂)

PAG109::isoOn_tens3.text:
theorem isoOn_tens3 (e₁ k₁ : G → ℂ) (e₂ k₂ : H → ℂ) (e₃ k₃ : I → ℂ) (l₁ l₂ l₃ : ℝ)
    (h₁ : conv e₁ e₁ = e₁) (h₂ : conv e₂ e₂ = e₂) (h₃ : conv e₃ e₃ = e₃)
    (hk₁ : IsoOn e₁ k₁ l₁) (hk₂ : IsoOn e₂ k₂ l₂) (hk₃ : IsoOn e₃ k₃ l₃) :
    IsoOn (tens (tens e₁ e₂) e₃) (tens (tens k₁ k₂) k₃) (l₁ * l₂ * l₃)

PAG109::isoOn_comp_equiv.text:
theorem isoOn_comp_equiv (φ : G ≃+ H) (e k : H → ℂ) (l : ℝ) (h : IsoOn e k l) :
    IsoOn (e ∘ φ) (k ∘ φ) l

PAG109::crtN.text:
noncomputable def crtN (m n : ℕ) (h : m.Coprime n) : ZMod (m * n) ≃+ ZMod m × ZMod n :=
  (ZMod.chineseRemainder h).toAddEquiv

PAG109::isoOn_crtN.text:
theorem isoOn_crtN (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (h : m.Coprime n) (e₁ k₁ : ZMod m → ℂ) (e₂ k₂ : ZMod n → ℂ)
    (l₁ l₂ : ℝ) (h₁ : conv e₁ e₁ = e₁) (h₂ : conv e₂ e₂ = e₂) (hk₁ : IsoOn e₁ k₁ l₁) (hk₂ : IsoOn e₂ k₂ l₂) :
    IsoOn (tens e₁ e₂ ∘ crtN m n h) (tens k₁ k₂ ∘ crtN m n h) (l₁ * l₂)

PAG109::isoOn_ket.text:
theorem isoOn_ket (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    IsoOn (eps (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) (PAG.Part21.ket K w (n + 1) hK χ)
      ((p : ℝ) ^ K / (PAG.Part19.sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ))

PAG109::eps_idem.text: theorem eps_idem (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) : conv (eps (p := p) K a) (eps (p := p) K a) = eps (p := p) K a

PAG110::ptens.text: def ptens (f : ∀ i, G i → ℂ) : (∀ i, G i) → ℂ := fun x => ∏ i, f i (x i)

PAG110::conv_ptens.text:
theorem conv_ptens (f g : ∀ i, G i → ℂ) :
    conv (ptens f) (ptens g) = ptens (fun i => conv (f i) (g i))

PAG110::normSq_ptens.text:
omit [∀ i, AddCommGroup (G i)] in
theorem normSq_ptens (f : ∀ i, G i → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (ptens f x) = ∏ i, ∑ y, Complex.normSq (f i y)

PAG110::ptens_single.text:
omit [∀ i, Fintype (G i)] in
theorem ptens_single [∀ i, DecidableEq (G i)] :
    ptens (fun i => Pi.single (0 : G i) (1 : ℂ)) = Pi.single 0 1

PAG110::consAdd.text:
def consAdd (G : Fin (n + 1) → Type) [∀ i, AddCommGroup (G i)] :
    (∀ i, G i) ≃+ G 0 × (∀ i : Fin n, G i.succ) where
  toEquiv := (Fin.consEquiv G).symm
  map_add' _ _ := rfl

PAG110::ptens_succ.text:
omit [∀ i, AddCommGroup (G i)] [∀ i, Fintype (G i)] in
theorem ptens_succ {G : Fin (n + 1) → Type} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (G i)] (f : ∀ i, G i → ℂ) :
    ptens f = tens (f 0) (ptens (fun i => f i.succ)) ∘ consAdd G

PAG110::isoOn_ptens.text:
theorem isoOn_ptens : ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Type) [∀ i, AddCommGroup (G i)] [∀ i, Fintype (G i)]
    (e k : ∀ i, G i → ℂ) (l : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, conv (e i) (e i) = e i) →
      (∀ i, IsoOn (e i) (k i) (l i)) → IsoOn (ptens e) (ptens k) (∏ i, l i)

PAG110::sum_ptens_eps.text:
theorem sum_ptens_eps :
    ∑ a : ∀ i, Fin (K i + 1), ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (a i)) = Pi.single 0 1

PAG110::ptens_eps_conv.text:
theorem ptens_eps_conv (a b : ∀ i, Fin (K i + 1)) :
    conv (ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (a i))) (ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (b i)))
      = if a = b then ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (a i)) else 0

PAG110::isoOn_ptens_ket.text:
theorem isoOn_ptens_ket (w c : Fin n → ℕ) (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive) :
    IsoOn (ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)))
      (ptens (fun i => PAG.Part21.ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)))
      (∏ i, (p i : ℝ) ^ K i / (PAG.Part19.sz (p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i) : ℝ))

PAG110::instNeZeroProd.text:
instance instNeZeroProd : NeZero (∏ i, p i ^ K i) :=
  ⟨Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => pow_ne_zero _ (hp i).out.ne_zero⟩

PAG110::crtPi.text:
noncomputable def crtPi (hinj : Function.Injective p) : ZMod (∏ i, p i ^ K i) ≃+ ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i) :=
  (ZMod.prodEquivPi (fun i => p i ^ K i) (fun i j hij =>
    Nat.Coprime.pow _ _ ((Nat.coprime_primes (hp i).out (hp j).out).mpr (hinj.ne hij)))).toAddEquiv

PAG110::isoOn_crtPi_ket.text:
theorem isoOn_crtPi_ket (hinj : Function.Injective p) (w c : Fin n → ℕ) (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive) :
    IsoOn (ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) ∘ crtPi p K hinj)
      (ptens (fun i => PAG.Part21.ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) ∘ crtPi p K hinj)
      (∏ i, (p i : ℝ) ^ K i / (PAG.Part19.sz (p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i) : ℝ))

PAG110::pullEquiv.text:
noncomputable def pullEquiv (K a : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (ha : a ≤ K) :
    Va (p := p) K a ≃ₗ[ℂ] Va (p := p) (K + 1) (a + 1) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective
    (LinearMap.codRestrict (Va (p := p) (K + 1) (a + 1)) ((pullL (p := p) K).domRestrict (Va (p := p) K a))
      (fun f => (Va_eq_span (K + 1) (a + 1) (by omega) (pull K (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ))).mp
        (PAG.Part105.pull_Va K a ha (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) ((Va_eq_span K a ha (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ)).mpr f.2))))
    ⟨fun x y hxy => Subtype.ext (pull_injective K (congrArg Subtype.val hxy)), fun g => by
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfg⟩ := (Va_succ_eq_pull K a hK ha (g : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) → ℂ)).mp
        ((Va_eq_span (K + 1) (a + 1) (by omega) (g : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) → ℂ)).mpr g.2)
      exact ⟨⟨f, (Va_eq_span K a ha f).mp hf⟩, Subtype.ext hfg⟩⟩

PAG110::pullEquiv_apply.text:
theorem pullEquiv_apply (K a : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (ha : a ≤ K) (f : Va (p := p) K a) :
    ((pullEquiv K a hK ha f : Va (p := p) (K + 1) (a + 1)) : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) → ℂ) = pull K (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ)

PAG110::finrank_Va_succ.text:
theorem finrank_Va_succ (K a : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (ha : a ≤ K) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Va (p := p) K a) = Module.finrank ℂ (Va (p := p) (K + 1) (a + 1))

PAG111::conv_smul_gen.text:
omit [DecidableEq G] in
theorem conv_smul_gen (f g : G → ℂ) (c : ℂ) : conv f (c • g) = c • conv f g

PAG111::conv_single_gen.text: theorem conv_single_gen (g : G → ℂ) : conv (Pi.single 0 1) g = g

PAG111::cpow.text:
noncomputable def cpow (k : G → ℂ) : ℕ → G → ℂ
  | 0 => Pi.single 0 1
  | m + 1 => conv k (cpow k m)

PAG111::cpow_tens.text:
theorem cpow_tens (k₁ : G → ℂ) (k₂ : H → ℂ) (m : ℕ) :
    cpow (tens k₁ k₂) m = tens (cpow k₁ m) (cpow k₂ m)

PAG111::fix_conv.text:
omit [DecidableEq G] in
theorem fix_conv (e k f : G → ℂ) (hf : conv e f = f) : conv e (conv k f) = conv k f

PAG111::isoOn_cpow.text: theorem isoOn_cpow (e k : G → ℂ) (l : ℝ) (hk : IsoOn e k l) (m : ℕ) : IsoOn e (cpow k m) (l ^ m)

PAG111::Scalar.text:
def Scalar {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Fintype X] (e k : X → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℂ, ∀ f, conv e f = f → conv k f = c • f

PAG111::scalar_tens_iff.text:
omit [DecidableEq G] [DecidableEq H] in
theorem scalar_tens_iff (e₁ A : G → ℂ) (e₂ B : H → ℂ) (h₁ : conv e₁ e₁ = e₁) (h₂ : conv e₂ e₂ = e₂)
    (hA : ∀ f, conv e₁ f = f → conv A f = 0 → f = 0) (hB : ∀ f, conv e₂ f = f → conv B f = 0 → f = 0)
    (f₁ : G → ℂ) (hf₁ : conv e₁ f₁ = f₁) (hf₁0 : f₁ ≠ 0) (f₂ : H → ℂ) (hf₂ : conv e₂ f₂ = f₂) (hf₂0 : f₂ ≠ 0) :
    Scalar (tens e₁ e₂) (tens A B) ↔ Scalar e₁ A ∧ Scalar e₂ B

PAG111::dft_cpow.text:
theorem dft_cpow (K : ℕ) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (m : ℕ) (t : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    𝓕 (cpow k m) t = 𝓕 k t ^ m

PAG111::Tset_nonempty.text:
theorem Tset_nonempty (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : (Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)).Nonempty

PAG111::scalar_cpow_iff.text:
theorem scalar_cpow_iff (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (m : ℕ) :
    Scalar (eps (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) (cpow (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) (m + 1)) ↔ χ ^ (m + 1) = 1

PAG111::cpow_inj.text:
theorem cpow_inj (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (m : ℕ) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hf : conv (eps (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) f = f)
    (h0 : conv (cpow (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) m) f = 0) : f = 0

PAG111::eps_ne_zero.text:
theorem eps_ne_zero (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : eps (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w) ≠ 0

PAG111::scalar_tens_lcm.text:
theorem scalar_tens_lcm (K w₁ n₁ L w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ L)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (m : ℕ) :
    Scalar (tens (eps (p := p) K (K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁)) (eps (p := q) L (L - (n₂ + 1) - w₂)))
        (cpow (tens (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket L w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂)) (m + 1))
      ↔ Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂) ∣ m + 1

PAG112::scalar_comp_equiv.text: theorem scalar_comp_equiv (φ : G ≃+ H) (e k : H → ℂ) : Scalar (e ∘ φ) (k ∘ φ) ↔ Scalar e k

PAG112::inj_of_isoOn.text:
theorem inj_of_isoOn (e k : G → ℂ) (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (hk : IsoOn e k l) (f : G → ℂ)
    (hf : conv e f = f) (h0 : conv k f = 0) : f = 0

PAG112::ptens_ne_zero.text: theorem ptens_ne_zero {n : ℕ} {G : Fin n → Type} (f : ∀ i, G i → ℂ) (hf : ∀ i, f i ≠ 0) : ptens f ≠ 0

PAG112::scalar_ptens_iff.text:
theorem scalar_ptens_iff : ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Type) [∀ i, AddCommGroup (G i)] [∀ i, Fintype (G i)]
    (e A : ∀ i, G i → ℂ) (l : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, conv (e i) (e i) = e i) → (∀ i, 0 < l i) →
      (∀ i, IsoOn (e i) (A i) (l i)) → (f : ∀ i, G i → ℂ) → (∀ i, conv (e i) (f i) = f i) → (∀ i, f i ≠ 0) →
      (Scalar (ptens e) (ptens A) ↔ ∀ i, Scalar (e i) (A i))

PAG112::cpow_ptens.text:
theorem cpow_ptens {n : ℕ} {G : Fin n → Type} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (G i)] [∀ i, Fintype (G i)]
    [∀ i, DecidableEq (G i)] (k : ∀ i, G i → ℂ) (m : ℕ) :
    cpow (ptens k) m = ptens (fun i => cpow (k i) m)

PAG112::scalar_ptens_lcm.text:
theorem scalar_ptens_lcm (w c : Fin n → ℕ) (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive) (m : ℕ) :
    Scalar (ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)))
        (cpow (ptens (fun i => ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i))) (m + 1))
      ↔ (Finset.univ.lcm fun i => orderOf (χ i)) ∣ m + 1

PAG113::trace_convL.text:
theorem trace_convL (e : G → ℂ) :
    LinearMap.trace ℂ (G → ℂ) (convL e) = (Fintype.card G : ℂ) * e 0

PAG113::idem_convL.text:
omit [DecidableEq G] in
theorem idem_convL (e : G → ℂ) (he : conv e e = e) : IsIdempotentElem (convL e)

PAG113::mem_range_convL.text:
omit [DecidableEq G] in
theorem mem_range_convL (e : G → ℂ) (he : conv e e = e) (f : G → ℂ) :
    f ∈ LinearMap.range (convL e) ↔ conv e f = f

PAG113::finrank_fix.text:
theorem finrank_fix (e : G → ℂ) (he : conv e e = e) :
    (Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range (convL e)) : ℂ) = (Fintype.card G : ℂ) * e 0

PAG113::finrank_ptens.text:
theorem finrank_ptens (e : ∀ i, G i → ℂ) (he : ∀ i, conv (e i) (e i) = e i) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range (convL (ptens e)))
      = ∏ i, Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range (convL (e i)))

PAG113::finrank_tens.text:
theorem finrank_tens (e₁ : G → ℂ) (e₂ : H → ℂ) (h₁ : conv e₁ e₁ = e₁) (h₂ : conv e₂ e₂ = e₂) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range (convL (tens e₁ e₂)))
      = Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range (convL e₁)) * Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range (convL e₂))

PAG113::range_convL_eps.text:
theorem range_convL_eps {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) :
    LinearMap.range (convL (eps (p := p) K a)) = Va (p := p) K a

PAG113::finrank_eps_ket.text:
theorem finrank_eps_ket {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + (c + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range (convL (eps (p := p) K (K - (c + 1) - w)))) = sz p K (K - (c + 1) - w)

PAG113::finrank_ptens_eps.text:
theorem finrank_ptens_eps {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → ℕ) [hp : ∀ i, Fact (p i).Prime] (K w c : Fin n → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i) (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ (c i + 1)))
    (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range (convL (ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)))))
      = ∏ i, sz (p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)

PAG113::eps_zero_val.text:
theorem eps_zero_val {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + (c + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    eps (p := p) K (K - (c + 1) - w) 0 = (sz p K (K - (c + 1) - w) : ℂ) / (p : ℂ) ^ K

PAG114::proj1.text:
noncomputable def proj1 (K : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) × H →+ ZMod (p ^ K) × H :=
  (proj (p := p) K).prodMap (AddMonoidHom.id H)

PAG114::pull1.text: noncomputable def pull1 (K : ℕ) (F : ZMod (p ^ K) × H → ℂ) : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) × H → ℂ := F ∘ proj1 (p := p) K

PAG114::proj1_surjective.text:
omit [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] in
theorem proj1_surjective (K : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (proj1 (p := p) (H := H) K)

PAG114::card_ker1.text:
theorem card_ker1 (K : ℕ) :
    ((univ.filter (fun z : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) × H => proj1 (p := p) K z = 0)).card : ℂ) = p

PAG114::conv_pull1.text:
theorem conv_pull1 (K : ℕ) (F G : ZMod (p ^ K) × H → ℂ) :
    conv (pull1 (p := p) K F) (pull1 (p := p) K G) = (p : ℂ) • pull1 (p := p) K (conv F G)

PAG114::tens_pull.text:
omit hp [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] in
theorem tens_pull (K : ℕ) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (g : H → ℂ) :
    tens (pull (p := p) K f) g = pull1 (p := p) K (tens f g)

PAG114::tens_smul_left.text:
omit hp [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] in
theorem tens_smul_left (c : ℂ) (f : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) → ℂ) (g : H → ℂ) :
    tens (c • f) g = c • tens f g

PAG114::pull1_tens_eps.text:
omit [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] in
theorem pull1_tens_eps (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (e : H → ℂ) :
    pull1 (p := p) K (tens (eps (p := p) K a) e) = (p : ℂ) • tens (eps (p := p) (K + 1) (a + 1)) e

PAG114::pull1_fix.text:
theorem pull1_fix (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (e : H → ℂ) (G : ZMod (p ^ K) × H → ℂ)
    (hG : conv (tens (eps (p := p) K a) e) G = G) :
    conv (tens (eps (p := p) (K + 1) (a + 1)) e) (pull1 (p := p) K G) = pull1 (p := p) K G

PAG114::pull1_injective.text:
omit [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] in
theorem pull1_injective (K : ℕ) : Function.Injective (pull1 (p := p) (H := H) K)

PAG114::pull1L.text:
noncomputable def pull1L (K : ℕ) : (ZMod (p ^ K) × H → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) × H → ℂ) where
  toFun := pull1 (p := p) K
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

PAG114::Va_tens_succ.text:
theorem Va_tens_succ (K a : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (ha : a ≤ K) (e : H → ℂ) (he : conv e e = e)
    (g : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) × H → ℂ) :
    conv (tens (eps (p := p) (K + 1) (a + 1)) e) g = g ↔
      ∃ G, conv (tens (eps (p := p) K a) e) G = G ∧ pull1 (p := p) K G = g

PAG114::crtRing.text:
noncomputable def crtRing (hinj : Function.Injective p) : ZMod (∏ i, p i ^ K i) ≃+* ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i) :=
  ZMod.prodEquivPi (fun i => p i ^ K i) (fun i j hij =>
    Nat.Coprime.pow _ _ ((Nat.coprime_primes (hp i).out (hp j).out).mpr (hinj.ne hij)))

PAG114::unitComp.text:
noncomputable def unitComp (hinj : Function.Injective p) (i : Fin n) :
    (ZMod (∏ i, p i ^ K i))ˣ →* (ZMod (p i ^ K i))ˣ :=
  Units.map ((Pi.evalRingHom (fun i => ZMod (p i ^ K i)) i).comp (crtRing p K hinj).toRingHom).toMonoidHom

PAG114::ptens_ket_equivariant.text:
theorem ptens_ket_equivariant (hinj : Function.Injective p) (w c : Fin n → ℕ) (h : ∀ i, w i + c i ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ c i)) (u : (ZMod (∏ i, p i ^ K i))ˣ) (x : ZMod (∏ i, p i ^ K i)) :
    (ptens (fun i => ket (K i) (w i) (c i) (h i) (χ i)) ∘ crtRing p K hinj) (u * x)
      = (∏ i, χ i (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow (p i) (by have := h i; omega : c i ≤ K i)) (ZMod (p i ^ c i))
            (unitComp p K hinj i u))) *
        (ptens (fun i => ket (K i) (w i) (c i) (h i) (χ i)) ∘ crtRing p K hinj) x

PAG114::prodChar_mul.text:
theorem prodChar_mul (hinj : Function.Injective p) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (hc : ∀ i, c i ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ c i)) (u v : (ZMod (∏ i, p i ^ K i))ˣ) :
    (∏ i, χ i (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow (p i) (hc i)) (ZMod (p i ^ c i)) (unitComp p K hinj i (u * v))))
      = (∏ i, χ i (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow (p i) (hc i)) (ZMod (p i ^ c i)) (unitComp p K hinj i u)))
        * ∏ i, χ i (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow (p i) (hc i)) (ZMod (p i ^ c i)) (unitComp p K hinj i v))

PAG115::conv_mem_Va.text:
theorem conv_mem_Va (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (k f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ Va (p := p) K a) :
    conv k f ∈ Va (p := p) K a

PAG115::Tk.text:
noncomputable def Tk (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) : Module.End ℂ (Va (p := p) K a) :=
  (convL k).restrict (fun f hf => conv_mem_Va K a ha k f hf)

PAG115::PhiE.text:
noncomputable def PhiE (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) : Va (p := p) K a ≃ₗ[ℂ] (Tset (p := p) K a → ℂ) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective (Phi K a) (Phi_bijective K a ha)

PAG115::conj_Tk.text:
theorem conj_Tk (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    (PhiE (p := p) K a ha).conj (Tk K a ha k)
      = Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.diagonal (fun t : Tset (p := p) K a => 𝓕 k (t : ZMod (p ^ K))))

PAG115::charpoly_Tk.text:
theorem charpoly_Tk (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    (Tk (p := p) K a ha k).charpoly = ∏ t ∈ Tset (p := p) K a, (X - C (𝓕 k t))

PAG115::charpoly_Tk_closed.text:
theorem charpoly_Tk_closed (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) :
    (Tk (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w) (by omega) (ket K w (n + 1) h χ)).charpoly
      = (X ^ orderOf χ - C (𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀ ^ orderOf χ)) ^ (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) / orderOf χ)

PAG116::prod_closed.text:
theorem prod_closed {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (T : Finset α) (F : α → ℂ) (t₀ : α) (o : ℕ) (ho : 0 < o)
    (hF0 : F t₀ ≠ 0) (hpow : ∀ t ∈ T, (F t / F t₀) ^ o = 1)
    (hfib : ∀ ξ : ℂ, ξ ^ o = 1 → o * (T.filter (fun t => F t = F t₀ * ξ)).card = T.card) :
    ∏ t ∈ T, (X - C (F t)) = (X ^ o - C (F t₀ ^ o)) ^ (T.card / o)

PAG116::lam_pos.text: theorem lam_pos (K a : ℕ) : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K a : ℝ)

PAG116::ket_root_facts.text:
theorem ket_root_facts (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) :
    𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀ ≠ 0 ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w),
      (𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t / 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀) ^ orderOf χ = 1) ∧
    (∀ ξ : ℂ, ξ ^ orderOf χ = 1 → orderOf χ * ((Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)).filter
        (fun t => 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t = 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀ * ξ)).card
        = (Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)).card)

PAG116::cnorm.text: noncomputable def cnorm (p K a : ℕ) : ℂ := (((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K a : ℝ)))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)

PAG116::cnorm_ne_zero.text: theorem cnorm_ne_zero (K a : ℕ) : cnorm p K a ≠ 0

PAG116::Uk.text:
noncomputable def Uk (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) : Module.End ℂ (Va (p := p) K a) :=
  cnorm p K a • Tk K a ha k

PAG116::conj_Uk.text:
theorem conj_Uk (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    (PhiE (p := p) K a ha).conj (Uk K a ha k)
      = Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.diagonal (fun t : Tset (p := p) K a => cnorm p K a * 𝓕 k (t : ZMod (p ^ K))))

PAG116::charpoly_Uk.text:
theorem charpoly_Uk (K a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (k : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :
    (Uk (p := p) K a ha k).charpoly = ∏ t ∈ Tset (p := p) K a, (X - C (cnorm p K a * 𝓕 k t))

PAG116::charpoly_Uk_closed.text:
theorem charpoly_Uk_closed (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) :
    (Uk (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w) (by omega) (ket K w (n + 1) h χ)).charpoly
      = (X ^ orderOf χ - C ((cnorm p K (K - (n + 1) - w) * 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀) ^ orderOf χ))
          ^ (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) / orderOf χ)

PAG116::norm_zeta.text:
theorem norm_zeta (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) :
    Complex.normSq ((cnorm p K (K - (n + 1) - w) * 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀) ^ orderOf χ) = 1

PAG117::stdAddChar_mul_cast.text:
theorem stdAddChar_mul_cast (h : M ∣ M') (d : ℕ) (hd : M' = M * d) (z : ZMod M') :
    stdAddChar ((d : ZMod M') * z) = stdAddChar (ZMod.castHom h (ZMod M) z)

PAG117::dft_pullback_mul.text:
theorem dft_pullback_mul (h : M ∣ M') (d : ℕ) (hd : M' = M * d) (f : ZMod M → ℂ) (k : ZMod M') :
    𝓕 (fun x => f (ZMod.castHom h (ZMod M) x)) ((d : ZMod M') * k)
      = (d : ℂ) * 𝓕 f (ZMod.castHom h (ZMod M) k)

PAG117::dft_ket_pa.text:
theorem dft_ket_pa (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) ((p : ZMod (p ^ K)) ^ (K - (n + 1) - w))
      = ((((Real.sqrt (sz p K w))⁻¹ * (p : ℝ) ^ (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)) : ℂ)
          * (χ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum χ stdAddChar)

PAG117::inv_neg_one_pow.text:
omit hp in
theorem inv_neg_one_pow {n : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) : (χ⁻¹ (-1)) ^ orderOf χ = 1

PAG117::normSq_inv_neg_one.text:
omit hp in
theorem normSq_inv_neg_one {n : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) : Complex.normSq (χ⁻¹ (-1)) = 1

PAG117::pa_mem_Tset.text:
theorem pa_mem_Tset (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : ((p : ZMod (p ^ K)) ^ (K - (n + 1) - w)) ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)

PAG117::zeta_eq_gauss.text:
theorem zeta_eq_gauss (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) :
    (cnorm p K (K - (n + 1) - w) * 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀) ^ orderOf χ
      = (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ

PAG117::zeta_root_iff.text:
theorem zeta_root_iff (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ((cnorm p K (K - (n + 1) - w) * 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀) ^ orderOf χ) ^ N = 1) ↔
      (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = 1)

PAG118::sum_mult_eq_zero.text:
theorem sum_mult_eq_zero (g : G → ℂ) (hg : ∀ y z, g (y + z) = g y * g z) (h : ¬ ∀ y, g y = 1) :
    ∑ y, g y = 0

PAG118::P_sq.text: theorem P_sq : ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m) * ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m) = 0

PAG118::dvd_of_P_mul.text:
theorem dvd_of_P_mul (w : ZMod (p ^ c)) (h : (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * w = 0) :
    ∃ z : ZMod (p ^ c), w = (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * z

PAG118::phi.text:
noncomputable def phi (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (y : ZMod (p ^ c)) : ℂ :=
  χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * y)

PAG118::phi_add.text:
theorem phi_add (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (y z : ZMod (p ^ c)) :
    phi (m := m) χ (y + z) = phi (m := m) χ y * phi (m := m) χ z

PAG118::one_add_P_unit.text: theorem one_add_P_unit (y : ZMod (p ^ c)) : IsUnit (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * y)

PAG118::gauss_eq_sum_S.text:
theorem gauss_eq_sum_S (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    gaussSum χ stdAddChar = ∑ u ∈ univ.filter (fun u : ZMod (p ^ c) =>
      ∀ y, phi (m := m) χ y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * u * y) = 1), χ u * stdAddChar u

PAG118::const_on_S.text:
theorem const_on_S (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (u₀ u : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hu₀ : IsUnit u₀)
    (hS₀ : ∀ y, phi (m := m) χ y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * u₀ * y) = 1)
    (hS : ∀ y, phi (m := m) χ y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * u * y) = 1) :
    χ u * stdAddChar u = χ u₀ * stdAddChar u₀

PAG118::gauss_even_root.text:
theorem gauss_even_root (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, 0 < M ∧ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ M = 1

PAG118::zeta_root_even.text:
theorem zeta_root_even (K w n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K))
    (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ((cnorm p K (K - (n + 1) - w) * 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀) ^ orderOf χ) ^ N = 1

PAG119::Lc.text:
noncomputable def Lc (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ :=
  (quadraticChar (ZMod p)).ringHomComp (Int.castRingHom ℂ)

PAG119::Lc_apply.text: theorem Lc_apply (a : ZMod p) : Lc p a = ((quadraticChar (ZMod p) a : ℤ) : ℂ)

PAG119::Lc_sq.text: theorem Lc_sq (a : ZMod p) (ha : a ≠ 0) : Lc p a ^ 2 = 1

PAG119::sum_sq_char.text:
theorem sum_sq_char (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (A : ZMod p) (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    ∑ t : ZMod p, stdAddChar (A * t ^ 2) = Lc p A * gaussSum (Lc p) stdAddChar

PAG119::complete_square.text:
theorem complete_square (A B : ZMod p) (hA : A ≠ 0) (h2 : (2 : ZMod p) ≠ 0) :
    ∑ t : ZMod p, stdAddChar (A * t ^ 2 + B * t)
      = stdAddChar (-(A * (B * (2 * A)⁻¹) ^ 2)) * ∑ t : ZMod p, stdAddChar (A * t ^ 2)

PAG119::psi_one_primitive.text: theorem psi_one_primitive : IsPrimitiveRoot (stdAddChar (1 : ZMod p)) p

PAG119::quad_closed.text:
theorem quad_closed (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (F : ZMod p → ℂ) (a : ZMod p) (hF0 : F 0 = 1)
    (hF : ∀ t s, F (t + s) = F t * F s * stdAddChar (a * t * s)) :
    ∃ b : ZMod p, ∀ t, F t = stdAddChar (a * 2⁻¹ * t ^ 2 + b * t)

PAG119::quad_root.text:
theorem quad_root (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (F : ZMod p → ℂ) (a : ZMod p) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hF0 : F 0 = 1)
    (hF : ∀ t s, F (t + s) = F t * F s * stdAddChar (a * t * s)) :
    (∑ t, F t) ^ (4 * p) = (p : ℂ) ^ (2 * p)

PAG119::quad_root'.text:
theorem quad_root' (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (F : ZMod p → ℂ) (a : ZMod p) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hF0 : F 0 = 1)
    (hF : ∀ t s, F (t + s) = F t * F s * stdAddChar (a * t * s)) :
    ((∑ t, F t) / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ (4 * p) = 1

PAG120::quad_root_two.text:
theorem quad_root_two (F : ZMod 2 → ℂ) (a : ZMod 2) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hF0 : F 0 = 1)
    (hF : ∀ t s, F (t + s) = F t * F s * stdAddChar (a * t * s)) :
    ((∑ t, F t) / ((Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ (4 * 2) = 1

PAG120::quad_root_all.text:
theorem quad_root_all (F : ZMod p → ℂ) (a : ZMod p) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hF0 : F 0 = 1)
    (hF : ∀ t s, F (t + s) = F t * F s * stdAddChar (a * t * s)) :
    ((∑ t, F t) / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ (4 * p) = 1

PAG120::phiP.text: noncomputable def phiP (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (P y : ZMod (p ^ c)) : ℂ := χ (1 + P * y)

PAG120::phiP_add.text:
omit hp in
theorem phiP_add (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (P : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hP : P * P = 0) (y z : ZMod (p ^ c)) :
    phiP χ P (y + z) = phiP χ P y * phiP χ P z

PAG120::one_add_unit.text:
omit hp in
theorem one_add_unit (P : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hP : P * P = 0) (y : ZMod (p ^ c)) : IsUnit (1 + P * y)

PAG120::gauss_eq_sum_SP.text:
theorem gauss_eq_sum_SP (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (P : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hP : P * P = 0) :
    gaussSum χ stdAddChar = ∑ u ∈ univ.filter (fun u : ZMod (p ^ c) =>
      ∀ y, phiP χ P y * stdAddChar (P * u * y) = 1), χ u * stdAddChar u

PAG120::pow_zero_of_le.text:
omit hp in
theorem pow_zero_of_le (k : ℕ) (hk : c ≤ k) : (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k = 0

PAG120::divQ.text:
theorem divQ (w : ZMod (p ^ c)) (h : (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ (m + 1) * w = 0) :
    ∃ z : ZMod (p ^ c), w = (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * z

PAG120::gauss_odd_root.text:
theorem gauss_odd_root (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, 0 < M ∧ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ M = 1

PAG120::gauss_root_ge_two.text:
theorem gauss_root_ge_two (c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, 0 < M ∧ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ M = 1

PAG120::zeta_root_ge_two.text:
theorem zeta_root_ge_two (K w n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K))
    (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ((cnorm p K (K - (n + 1) - w) * 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀) ^ orderOf χ) ^ N = 1

PAG121::chr.text: noncomputable def chr (s : ZMod N) : ZMod N → ℂ := fun x => stdAddChar (s * x)

PAG121::conv_chr.text: theorem conv_chr (k : ZMod N → ℂ) (s : ZMod N) : conv k (chr s) = 𝓕 k s • chr s

PAG121::sum_chr_mul.text:
theorem sum_chr_mul (s s' : ZMod N) :
    ∑ x, chr s x * chr (-s') x = if s = s' then (N : ℂ) else 0

PAG121::Psi.text: noncomputable def Psi (st : ZMod N₁ × ZMod N₂) : ZMod N₁ × ZMod N₂ → ℂ := tens (chr st.1) (chr st.2)

PAG121::sum_Psi_mul.text:
theorem sum_Psi_mul (st st' : ZMod N₁ × ZMod N₂) :
    ∑ z, Psi st z * Psi (-st') z = if st = st' then ((N₁ * N₂ : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0

PAG121::Psi_linearIndependent.text:
theorem Psi_linearIndependent {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (v : ι → ZMod N₁ × ZMod N₂) (hv : Function.Injective v) :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (fun i => Psi (v i))

PAG121::conv_tens_Psi.text:
theorem conv_tens_Psi (k₁ : ZMod N₁ → ℂ) (k₂ : ZMod N₂ → ℂ) (st : ZMod N₁ × ZMod N₂) :
    conv (tens k₁ k₂) (Psi st) = (𝓕 k₁ st.1 * 𝓕 k₂ st.2) • Psi st

PAG121::V12.text:
noncomputable abbrev V12 (K L a b : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ (ZMod (p ^ K) × ZMod (q ^ L) → ℂ) :=
  LinearMap.range (convL (tens (eps (p := p) K a) (eps (p := q) L b)))

PAG121::Idx.text: abbrev Idx (K L a b : ℕ) := (Tset (p := p) K a) × (Tset (p := q) L b)

PAG121::Psi_mem.text:
theorem Psi_mem (K L a b : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (hb : b ≤ L) (i : Idx (p := p) (q := q) K L a b) :
    Psi ((i.1 : ZMod (p ^ K)), (i.2 : ZMod (q ^ L))) ∈ V12 (p := p) (q := q) K L a b

PAG121::basis12.text:
noncomputable def basis12 (K L a b : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (hb : b ≤ L)
    (hcard : Fintype.card (Idx (p := p) (q := q) K L a b) = Module.finrank ℂ (V12 (p := p) (q := q) K L a b)) :
    Module.Basis (Idx (p := p) (q := q) K L a b) ℂ (V12 (p := p) (q := q) K L a b) :=
  basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank'
    (fun i => ⟨Psi ((i.1 : ZMod (p ^ K)), (i.2 : ZMod (q ^ L))), Psi_mem K L a b ha hb i⟩)
    (by
      apply LinearIndependent.of_comp (V12 (p := p) (q := q) K L a b).subtype
      exact Psi_linearIndependent (fun i : Idx (p := p) (q := q) K L a b => ((i.1 : ZMod (p ^ K)), (i.2 : ZMod (q ^ L))))
        (fun i j h => by
          obtain ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, ⟨t, ht⟩⟩ := i; obtain ⟨⟨s', hs'⟩, ⟨t', ht'⟩⟩ := j
          simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h; obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h; rfl))
    hcard

PAG121::card_Idx.text:
theorem card_Idx (K L w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (c₂ + 1) ≤ L)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (c₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    Fintype.card (Idx (p := p) (q := q) K L (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂))
      = Module.finrank ℂ (V12 (p := p) (q := q) K L (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂))

PAG121::T12.text:
noncomputable def T12 (K L a b : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (hb : b ≤ L) (k₁ : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) (k₂ : ZMod (q ^ L) → ℂ) :
    Module.End ℂ (V12 (p := p) (q := q) K L a b) :=
  (convL (tens k₁ k₂)).restrict (fun f hf => by
    have hi := tens_idem _ _ (eps_idem (p := p) K a ha) (eps_idem (p := q) L b hb)
    exact (mem_range_convL _ hi _).mpr (PAG.Part111.fix_conv _ _ f ((mem_range_convL _ hi f).mp hf)))

PAG121::charpoly_T12.text:
theorem charpoly_T12 (K L w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (c₂ + 1) ≤ L)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (c₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    (T12 (p := p) (q := q) K L (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂) (by omega) (by omega)
        (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂)).charpoly
      = ∏ s ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁), ∏ t ∈ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂),
          (X - C (𝓕 (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) s * 𝓕 (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) t))

PAG122::closed_of_unif.text:
theorem closed_of_unif {T : Finset α} {F : α → ℂ} {t₀ : α} {o : ℕ} (h : Unif T F t₀ o) :
    ∏ t ∈ T, (X - C (F t)) = (X ^ o - C (F t₀ ^ o)) ^ (T.card / o)

PAG122::dvd_card.text:
omit [DecidableEq α] in
theorem dvd_card {T : Finset α} {F : α → ℂ} {t₀ : α} {o : ℕ} (h : Unif T F t₀ o) : o ∣ T.card

PAG122::unif_smul.text:
omit [DecidableEq α] in
theorem unif_smul {T : Finset α} {F : α → ℂ} {t₀ : α} {o : ℕ} (h : Unif T F t₀ o) (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Unif T (fun t => a * F t) t₀ o

PAG122::card_mod_eq.text:
theorem card_mod_eq (o' g r : ℕ) (hr : r < o') :
    ((range (o' * g)).filter (fun j => j % o' = r)).card = g

PAG122::unif_pow.text:
theorem unif_pow {T : Finset α} {F : α → ℂ} {t₀ : α} {o : ℕ} (h : Unif T F t₀ o) (k : ℕ) :
    Unif T (fun t => F t ^ k) t₀ (o / Nat.gcd o k)

PAG122::ket_unif.text:
theorem ket_unif {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) :
    Unif (Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) (fun t => 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t) t₀ (orderOf χ)

PAG122::unif_ne_zero.text:
theorem unif_ne_zero {α : Type*} {T : Finset α} {F : α → ℂ} {t₀ : α} {o : ℕ} (h : Unif T F t₀ o)
    (t : α) (ht : t ∈ T) : F t ≠ 0

PAG122::charpoly_T12_closed.text:
theorem charpoly_T12_closed (K L w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (c₂ + 1) ≤ L)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (c₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (t₁ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁))
    (t₂ : ZMod (q ^ L)) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂)) :
    (T12 (p := p) (q := q) K L (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂) (by omega) (by omega)
        (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂)).charpoly
      = (X ^ Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂)
          - C ((𝓕 (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) t₁ * 𝓕 (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) t₂) ^ Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂)))
        ^ (sz p K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) * sz q L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂) / Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂))

PAG123::unif_mul.text:
omit [DecidableEq β] in
theorem unif_mul {T₁ : Finset α} {T₂ : Finset β} {F₁ : α → ℂ} {F₂ : β → ℂ} {t₁ : α} {t₂ : β} {o₁ o₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁ : Unif T₁ F₁ t₁ o₁) (h₂ : Unif T₂ F₂ t₂ o₂) :
    Unif (T₁ ×ˢ T₂) (fun z => F₁ z.1 * F₂ z.2) (t₁, t₂) (Nat.lcm o₁ o₂)

PAG123::ket_spec_unif.text:
theorem ket_spec_unif (K L w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (c₂ + 1) ≤ L)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (c₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (t₁ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁))
    (t₂ : ZMod (q ^ L)) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂)) :
    Unif (Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) ×ˢ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂))
      (fun z => 𝓕 (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) z.1 * 𝓕 (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) z.2) (t₁, t₂)
      (Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂))

PAG123::ket_spec_unif3.text:
theorem ket_spec_unif3 (K L M w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ w₃ c₃ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (c₂ + 1) ≤ L)
    (h₃ : w₃ + (c₃ + 1) ≤ M)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (c₂ + 1)))
    (χ₃ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (r ^ (c₃ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (hχ₃ : χ₃.IsPrimitive)
    (t₁ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁))
    (t₂ : ZMod (q ^ L)) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂))
    (t₃ : ZMod (r ^ M)) (ht₃ : t₃ ∈ Tset (p := r) M (M - (c₃ + 1) - w₃)) :
