    Unif ((Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) ×ˢ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂)) ×ˢ
        Tset (p := r) M (M - (c₃ + 1) - w₃))
      (fun z => 𝓕 (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) z.1.1 * 𝓕 (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) z.1.2
        * 𝓕 (ket M w₃ (c₃ + 1) h₃ χ₃) z.2) ((t₁, t₂), t₃)
      (Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂)) (orderOf χ₃))

PAG123::spec_poly3.text:
theorem spec_poly3 (K L M w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ w₃ c₃ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (c₂ + 1) ≤ L)
    (h₃ : w₃ + (c₃ + 1) ≤ M)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (c₂ + 1)))
    (χ₃ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (r ^ (c₃ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (hχ₃ : χ₃.IsPrimitive)
    (t₁ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁))
    (t₂ : ZMod (q ^ L)) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂))
    (t₃ : ZMod (r ^ M)) (ht₃ : t₃ ∈ Tset (p := r) M (M - (c₃ + 1) - w₃)) :
    ∏ z ∈ (Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) ×ˢ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂)) ×ˢ
        Tset (p := r) M (M - (c₃ + 1) - w₃),
      (X - C (𝓕 (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) z.1.1 * 𝓕 (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) z.1.2
        * 𝓕 (ket M w₃ (c₃ + 1) h₃ χ₃) z.2))
      = (X ^ Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂)) (orderOf χ₃)
          - C ((𝓕 (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) t₁ * 𝓕 (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) t₂ * 𝓕 (ket M w₃ (c₃ + 1) h₃ χ₃) t₃)
            ^ Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂)) (orderOf χ₃)))
        ^ (sz p K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) * sz q L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂) * sz r M (M - (c₃ + 1) - w₃)
            / Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂)) (orderOf χ₃))

PAG124::pchr.text: noncomputable def pchr (v : ∀ i, ZMod (N i)) : (∀ i, ZMod (N i)) → ℂ := ptens (fun i => chr (v i))

PAG124::ptens_smul.text:
omit [∀ i, NeZero (N i)] in
theorem ptens_smul (c : Fin n → ℂ) (f : ∀ i, ZMod (N i) → ℂ) :
    ptens (fun i => c i • f i) = (∏ i, c i) • ptens f

PAG124::conv_ptens_pchr.text:
theorem conv_ptens_pchr (k : ∀ i, ZMod (N i) → ℂ) (v : ∀ i, ZMod (N i)) :
    conv (ptens k) (pchr v) = (∏ i, 𝓕 (k i) (v i)) • pchr v

PAG124::sum_pchr_mul.text:
theorem sum_pchr_mul (v w : ∀ i, ZMod (N i)) :
    ∑ x, pchr v x * pchr (-w) x = if v = w then ((∏ i, N i : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0

PAG124::pchr_linearIndependent.text:
theorem pchr_linearIndependent {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (u : ι → ∀ i, ZMod (N i)) (hu : Function.Injective u) :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (fun j => pchr (u j))

PAG124::Vn.text:
noncomputable abbrev Vn : Submodule ℂ ((∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i)) → ℂ) :=
  LinearMap.range (convL (ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (a i))))

PAG124::Idxn.text: abbrev Idxn := ∀ i, (Tset (p := p i) (K i) (a i))

PAG124::pchr_mem.text:
theorem pchr_mem (ha : ∀ i, a i ≤ K i) (v : Idxn p K a) :
    pchr (N := fun i => p i ^ K i) (fun i => (v i : ZMod (p i ^ K i))) ∈ Vn p K a

PAG124::card_Idxn.text:
theorem card_Idxn (ha : ∀ i, a i ≤ K i) :
    Fintype.card (Idxn p K a) = Module.finrank ℂ (Vn p K a)

PAG124::basisN.text:
noncomputable def basisN (ha : ∀ i, a i ≤ K i)
    (hcard : Fintype.card (Idxn p K a) = Module.finrank ℂ (Vn p K a)) :
    Module.Basis (Idxn p K a) ℂ (Vn p K a) :=
  basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank'
    (fun v => ⟨pchr (N := fun i => p i ^ K i) (fun i => (v i : ZMod (p i ^ K i))), pchr_mem p K a ha v⟩)
    (by
      apply LinearIndependent.of_comp (Vn p K a).subtype
      exact pchr_linearIndependent (N := fun i => p i ^ K i)
        (fun v : Idxn p K a => fun i => (v i : ZMod (p i ^ K i)))
        (fun v v' hv => funext fun i => Subtype.ext (congrFun hv i)))
    hcard

PAG124::Tn.text:
noncomputable def Tn (ha : ∀ i, a i ≤ K i) (k : ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i) → ℂ) : Module.End ℂ (Vn p K a) :=
  (convL (ptens k)).restrict (fun f hf => by
    have hidem : conv (ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (a i))) (ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (a i)))
        = ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (a i)) := by
      rw [conv_ptens]; simp only [fun i => eps_idem (p := p i) (K i) (a i) (ha i)]
    exact (mem_range_convL _ hidem _).mpr (PAG.Part111.fix_conv _ _ f ((mem_range_convL _ hidem f).mp hf)))

PAG124::charpoly_Tn.text:
theorem charpoly_Tn (haK : ∀ i, a i ≤ K i) (k : ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i) → ℂ) :
    (Tn p K a haK k).charpoly = ∏ v : Idxn p K a, (X - C (∏ i, 𝓕 (k i) (v i : ZMod (p i ^ K i))))

PAG125::lcmF.text:
def lcmF : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → ℕ) → ℕ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | n + 1, o => Nat.lcm (o 0) (lcmF n (fun i => o i.succ))

PAG125::unif_map.text:
omit [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] in
theorem unif_map (e : β ↪ γ) (S : Finset β) (G : γ → ℂ) (t₀ : β) (o : ℕ) :
    Unif (S.map e) G (e t₀) o ↔ Unif S (fun x => G (e x)) t₀ o

PAG125::unif_pi.text:
theorem unif_pi : ∀ (n : ℕ) (β : Fin n → Type) [∀ i, DecidableEq (β i)] [∀ i, Fintype (β i)]
    (F : ∀ i, β i → ℂ) (t₀ : ∀ i, β i) (o : Fin n → ℕ),
    (∀ i, Unif (univ : Finset (β i)) (F i) (t₀ i) (o i)) →
      Unif (univ : Finset (∀ i, β i)) (fun v => ∏ i, F i (v i)) t₀ (lcmF n o)

PAG125::charpoly_Tn_closed.text:
theorem charpoly_Tn_closed (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (t : ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i)) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Tset (p := p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) :
    (Tn p K (fun i => K i - (c i + 1) - w i) (fun i => by omega)
        (fun i => ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i))).charpoly
      = (X ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))
          - C ((∏ i, 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i)) ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))))
        ^ ((∏ i, sz (p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) / lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)))

PAG126::dvd_lcmF.text: theorem dvd_lcmF : ∀ (n : ℕ) (o : Fin n → ℕ) (i : Fin n), o i ∣ lcmF n o

PAG126::lcmF_dvd.text: theorem lcmF_dvd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (o : Fin n → ℕ) (m : ℕ), (∀ i, o i ∣ m) → lcmF n o ∣ m

PAG126::lcmF_eq.text: theorem lcmF_eq (n : ℕ) (o : Fin n → ℕ) : lcmF n o = (univ : Finset (Fin n)).lcm o

PAG126::zeta_root_prod.text:
theorem zeta_root_prod (hc : ∀ i, 1 ≤ c i) (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (t : ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i)) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Tset (p := p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, 0 < M ∧
      ((∏ i, cnorm (p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i) * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i))
        ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))) ^ M = 1

PAG127::stdAddChar_pow_eq_one_iff.text:
theorem stdAddChar_pow_eq_one_iff {c : ℕ} (u : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hu : IsUnit u) (n : ℕ) :
    stdAddChar u ^ n = 1 ↔ p ^ c ∣ n

PAG127::chi_pow_totient.text:
omit hp in
theorem chi_pow_totient {c : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (u : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hu : IsUnit u) :
    χ u ^ Nat.totient (p ^ c) = 1

PAG127::pdvd_of_mul.text:
theorem pdvd_of_mul (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (x y : ℂ) (hx : ∀ n, x ^ n = 1 ↔ p ^ c ∣ n)
    (hy : y ^ (p ^ (c - 1) * (p - 1)) = 1) (d : ℕ) (hd : (y * x) ^ d = 1) : p ^ c ∣ d

PAG127::gauss_even_phase.text:
theorem gauss_even_phase (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c), IsUnit u₀ ∧
      gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ) = χ u₀ * stdAddChar u₀

PAG127::orderOf_gauss_even.text:
theorem orderOf_gauss_even (hm : 1 ≤ m) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c), IsUnit u₀ ∧
      orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        = Nat.lcm (orderOf (χ u₀)) (p ^ c)

PAG127::orderOf_gauss_even_bounds.text:
theorem orderOf_gauss_even_bounds (hm : 1 ≤ m) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    p ^ c ∣ orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∣ Nat.lcm (orderOf χ) (p ^ c)

PAG128::pdvd_of_mul_gen.text:
theorem pdvd_of_mul_gen (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (x y : ℂ) (hx : ∀ n, x ^ n = 1 ↔ p ^ c ∣ n)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : ¬ p ∣ r) (hy : y ^ (p ^ (c - 1) * r) = 1) (d : ℕ) (hd : (y * x) ^ d = 1) : p ^ c ∣ d

PAG128::gauss_odd_phase.text:
theorem gauss_odd_phase (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c), IsUnit u₀ ∧ ∃ q : ℂ, q ^ (4 * p) = 1 ∧
      gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ) = χ u₀ * stdAddChar u₀ * q

PAG128::orderOf_gauss_odd.text:
theorem orderOf_gauss_odd (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c), IsUnit u₀ ∧ ∃ q : ℂ, q ^ (4 * p) = 1 ∧
      gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ) = χ u₀ * stdAddChar u₀ * q ∧
      orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        = Nat.lcm (orderOf (χ u₀ * q)) (p ^ c)

PAG128::orderOf_gauss_odd_bounds.text:
theorem orderOf_gauss_odd_bounds (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    p ^ c ∣ orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      ∣ Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm (orderOf χ) (p ^ c)) 4

PAG128::orderOf_gauss_bounds.text:
theorem orderOf_gauss_bounds (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    p ^ c ∣ orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      ∣ Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm (orderOf χ) (p ^ c)) 4

PAG129::quad_pow_2p.text:
theorem quad_pow_2p (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (F : ZMod p → ℂ) (a : ZMod p) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hF0 : F 0 = 1)
    (hF : ∀ t s, F (t + s) = F t * F s * stdAddChar (a * t * s)) :
    ((∑ t, F t) / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ (2 * p) = Lc p (-1)

PAG129::gauss_odd_phase2.text:
theorem gauss_odd_phase2 (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c), IsUnit u₀ ∧ ∃ q : ℂ, q ^ (4 * p) = 1 ∧ (p ≠ 2 → q ^ (2 * p) = Lc p (-1)) ∧
      gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ) = χ u₀ * stdAddChar u₀ * q

PAG129::orderOf_gauss_odd_one_mod_four.text:
theorem orderOf_gauss_odd_one_mod_four (h4 : p % 4 = 1) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      ∣ Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm (orderOf χ) (p ^ c)) 2

PAG129::four_dvd_orderOf_gauss_odd.text:
theorem four_dvd_orderOf_gauss_odd (h4 : p % 4 = 3) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    4 ∣ orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ))

PAG130::chi_pow_two_pow.text:
theorem chi_pow_two_pow (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ c)) (u : ZMod (2 ^ c))
    (hu : IsUnit u) : χ u ^ (2 ^ (c - 1)) = 1

PAG130::orderOf_gauss_two_even.text:
theorem orderOf_gauss_two_even (c m : ℕ) (hc : c = 2 * m) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ c))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 2 ^ c

PAG130::orderOf_gauss_two_odd.text:
theorem orderOf_gauss_two_odd (c m : ℕ) (hc : c = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ c))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 2 ^ c

PAG131::prod_dvd_of_coprime_nat.text:
theorem prod_dvd_of_coprime_nat {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (t : Finset ι) (s : ι → ℕ) (n : ℕ)
    (hco : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ j ∈ t, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (s i) (s j)) (h : ∀ i ∈ t, s i ∣ n) :
    ∏ i ∈ t, s i ∣ n

PAG131::dvd_orderOf_mul.text:
theorem dvd_orderOf_mul (A B : ℂ) (k M : ℕ) (hk : k ∣ orderOf B) (hA : A ^ M = 1) (hco : Nat.Coprime k M) :
    k ∣ orderOf (A * B)

PAG131::dvd_orderOf_prod.text:
theorem dvd_orderOf_prod (z : ι → ℂ) (B k : ι → ℕ) (hB : ∀ j, z j ^ B j = 1) (hk : ∀ i, k i ∣ orderOf (z i))
    (hco : ∀ i, Nat.Coprime (k i) (∏ j ∈ univ.erase i, B j)) (i : ι) :
    k i ∣ orderOf (∏ j, z j)

PAG131::prod_dvd_orderOf_prod.text:
theorem prod_dvd_orderOf_prod (z : ι → ℂ) (B k : ι → ℕ) (hB : ∀ j, z j ^ B j = 1)
    (hk : ∀ i, k i ∣ orderOf (z i)) (hco : ∀ i, Nat.Coprime (k i) (∏ j ∈ univ.erase i, B j))
    (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (k i) (k j)) :
    ∏ i, k i ∣ orderOf (∏ j, z j)

PAG131::orderOf_prod_dvd_lcm.text:
omit [DecidableEq ι] in
theorem orderOf_prod_dvd_lcm (z : ι → ℂ) : orderOf (∏ j, z j) ∣ (univ : Finset ι).lcm (fun j => orderOf (z j))

PAG131::orderOf_prod_coprime.text:
theorem orderOf_prod_coprime (z : ι → ℂ) (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (orderOf (z i)) (orderOf (z j))) :
    orderOf (∏ j, z j) = ∏ j, orderOf (z j)

PAG131::gauss_prod_pdvd.text:
theorem gauss_prod_pdvd (p c : ι → ℕ) [hp : ∀ i, Fact (p i).Prime] (hp2 : ∀ i, p i ≠ 2) (hinj : Function.Injective p)
    (hc : ∀ i, 2 ≤ c i) (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ c i)) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (hcond : ∀ i, ¬ p i ∣ ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i, Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm (orderOf (χ j)) (p j ^ c j)) 4) :
    ∏ i, p i ^ c i ∣ orderOf (∏ j, gaussSum (χ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p j : ℝ) ^ c j) : ℝ) : ℂ))

PAG131::pdvd_orderOf_mul.text:
theorem pdvd_orderOf_mul (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (c : ℕ) (A B : ℂ) (hB : p ^ c ∣ orderOf B)
    (M : ℕ) (hM0 : M ≠ 0) (hA : A ^ M = 1) (hMc : ¬ p ^ c ∣ M) : p ^ c ∣ orderOf (A * B)

PAG131::gauss_prod_pdvd_sharp.text:
theorem gauss_prod_pdvd_sharp (p c : ι → ℕ) [hp : ∀ i, Fact (p i).Prime] (hp2 : ∀ i, p i ≠ 2)
    (hc : ∀ i, 2 ≤ c i) (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ c i)) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive) (i : ι)
    (hcond : ¬ p i ^ c i ∣ ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i,
      orderOf (gaussSum (χ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p j : ℝ) ^ c j) : ℝ) : ℂ))) :
    p i ^ c i ∣ orderOf (∏ j, gaussSum (χ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p j : ℝ) ^ c j) : ℝ) : ℂ))

PAG132::lcmF_ne_zero.text: theorem lcmF_ne_zero : ∀ (n : ℕ) (o : Fin n → ℕ), (∀ i, o i ≠ 0) → lcmF n o ≠ 0

PAG132::p_dvd_div_gcd.text:
theorem p_dvd_div_gcd (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (e a b : ℕ) (ha : p ^ e ∣ a) (hb : ¬ p ^ e ∣ b) :
    p ∣ a / Nat.gcd a b

PAG132::zeta_prod_eq_pow.text:
theorem zeta_prod_eq_pow (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (t : ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i)) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Tset (p := p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) :
    (∏ i, cnorm (p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i) * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i))
        ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))
      = (∏ i, gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p i : ℝ) ^ (c i + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))

PAG132::orderOf_zeta_prod.text:
theorem orderOf_zeta_prod (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (t : ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i)) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Tset (p := p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) :
    orderOf ((∏ i, cnorm (p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i) * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i))
        ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)))
      = orderOf (∏ i, gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p i : ℝ) ^ (c i + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        / Nat.gcd (orderOf (∏ i, gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p i : ℝ) ^ (c i + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
          (lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)))

PAG132::p_dvd_orderOf_zeta_prod.text:
theorem p_dvd_orderOf_zeta_prod (hp2 : ∀ i, p i ≠ 2) (hc : ∀ i, 1 ≤ c i) (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (t : ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i)) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Tset (p := p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) (i : Fin n)
    (hcond : ¬ p i ^ (c i + 1) ∣ ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i,
      orderOf (gaussSum (χ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p j : ℝ) ^ (c j + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    (hL : ¬ p i ^ (c i + 1) ∣ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))) :
    p i ∣ orderOf ((∏ i, cnorm (p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)
        * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i)) ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)))

PAG133::Pc_sq.text: theorem Pc_sq : ((p : ZMod (p ^ (c + 1))) ^ c) * ((p : ZMod (p ^ (c + 1))) ^ c) = 0

PAG133::one_add_Pc_pow.text:
theorem one_add_Pc_pow (s : ZMod (p ^ (c + 1))) (k : ℕ) :
    (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ (c + 1))) ^ c * s) ^ k = 1 + (k : ZMod (p ^ (c + 1))) * (p : ZMod (p ^ (c + 1))) ^ c * s

PAG133::one_add_p_pow.text:
theorem one_add_p_pow (hodd : Odd p) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, ¬ p ∣ s ∧ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ (c + 1)))) ^ (p ^ (c - 1) * (p - 1))
      = 1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ (c + 1))) ^ c * s

PAG133::exists_ker_ne.text:
theorem exists_ker_ne (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ v : (ZMod (p ^ (c + 1)))ˣ, ZMod.unitsMap (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ c)) v = 1 ∧ χ v ≠ 1

PAG133::pc_dvd_orderOf.text:
theorem pc_dvd_orderOf (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    p ^ c ∣ orderOf χ

PAG133::not_sq_dvd_div_gcd.text:
theorem not_sq_dvd_div_gcd (p c a L : ℕ) (ha : p ^ c ∣ a) (hL : p ^ c ∣ L) (ha2 : ¬ p ^ (c + 2) ∣ a) :
    ¬ p ^ 2 ∣ a / Nat.gcd a L

PAG133::zeta_prod_ppart.text:
theorem zeta_prod_ppart (hp2 : ∀ i, p i ≠ 2) (hc : ∀ i, 1 ≤ c i) (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (t : ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i)) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Tset (p := p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) (i : Fin n)
    (hcond : ¬ p i ^ (c i + 1) ∣ ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i,
      orderOf (gaussSum (χ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p j : ℝ) ^ (c j + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    (hL : ¬ p i ^ (c i + 1) ∣ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)))
    (hw2 : ¬ p i ^ (c i + 2) ∣ orderOf (∏ j, gaussSum (χ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p j : ℝ) ^ (c j + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) :
    p i ∣ orderOf ((∏ i, cnorm (p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)
        * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i)) ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))) ∧
    ¬ p i ^ 2 ∣ orderOf ((∏ i, cnorm (p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)
        * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i)) ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)))

PAG134::pow_dvd_lcm_two.text:
theorem pow_dvd_lcm_two {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {e a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : p ^ e ∣ Nat.lcm a b) : p ^ e ∣ a ∨ p ^ e ∣ b

PAG134::pow_dvd_finset_lcm.text:
theorem pow_dvd_finset_lcm {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {e : ℕ} (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℕ) (hf : ∀ j ∈ s, f j ≠ 0) (h : p ^ e ∣ s.lcm f) : ∃ j ∈ s, p ^ e ∣ f j

PAG134::orderOf_dvd_totient.text: theorem orderOf_dvd_totient {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : orderOf χ ∣ Nat.totient N

PAG134::not_pow_succ_dvd.text: theorem not_pow_succ_dvd {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (c : ℕ) : ¬ p ^ (c + 1) ∣ p ^ c * (p - 1)

PAG134::not_dvd_div_gcd.text:
theorem not_dvd_div_gcd {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (e a L : ℕ) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hL : p ^ e ∣ L)
    (ha : ¬ p ^ (e + 1) ∣ a) : ¬ p ∣ a / Nat.gcd a L

PAG134::not_pow_dvd_gauss.text:
theorem not_pow_dvd_gauss (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ¬ p ^ (c + 2) ∣ orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (c + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ))

PAG134::hw2_of_hcond.text:
theorem hw2_of_hcond (hq2 : ∀ i, q i ≠ 2) (hc : ∀ i, 1 ≤ c i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (q i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive) (i : Fin n)
    (hcond : ¬ q i ^ (c i + 1) ∣ ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i,
      orderOf (gaussSum (χ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((q j : ℝ) ^ (c j + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) :
    ¬ q i ^ (c i + 2) ∣ orderOf (∏ j, gaussSum (χ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((q j : ℝ) ^ (c j + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ))

PAG134::hL_of_chi.text:
theorem hL_of_chi (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (q i ^ (c i + 1))) (i : Fin n)
    (hχj : ∀ j, j ≠ i → ¬ q i ^ (c i + 1) ∣ orderOf (χ j)) :
    ¬ q i ^ (c i + 1) ∣ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))

PAG134::zeta_prod_ppart'.text:
theorem zeta_prod_ppart' (hq2 : ∀ i, q i ≠ 2) (hc : ∀ i, 1 ≤ c i) (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (q i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (t : ∀ i, ZMod (q i ^ K i)) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Tset (p := q i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) (i : Fin n)
    (hcond : ¬ q i ^ (c i + 1) ∣ ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i,
      orderOf (gaussSum (χ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((q j : ℝ) ^ (c j + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    (hχj : ∀ j, j ≠ i → ¬ q i ^ (c i + 1) ∣ orderOf (χ j)) :
    q i ∣ orderOf ((∏ i, cnorm (q i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)
        * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i)) ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))) ∧
    ¬ q i ^ 2 ∣ orderOf ((∏ i, cnorm (q i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)
        * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i)) ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)))

PAG134::zeta_ppart_iff.text:
theorem zeta_ppart_iff (hq2 : ∀ i, q i ≠ 2) (hc : ∀ i, 1 ≤ c i) (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (q i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (t : ∀ i, ZMod (q i ^ K i)) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Tset (p := q i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) (i : Fin n)
    (hcond : ¬ q i ^ (c i + 1) ∣ ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i,
      orderOf (gaussSum (χ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((q j : ℝ) ^ (c j + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) :
    q i ∣ orderOf ((∏ i, cnorm (q i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)
        * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i)) ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)))
      ↔ ∀ j, j ≠ i → ¬ q i ^ (c i + 1) ∣ orderOf (χ j)

PAG135::chi_pow_ne_one.text:
theorem chi_pow_ne_one (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (b : ZMod (p ^ (c + 1))) (m s : ℕ) (hs : ¬ p ∣ s)
    (hg : b ^ m = 1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ (c + 1))) ^ c * s) : χ b ^ m ≠ 1

PAG135::five_pow.text: theorem five_pow : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ s : ℕ, Odd s ∧ 5 ^ (2 ^ k) = 1 + 2 ^ (k + 2) * s

PAG135::odd_pow_sub_one.text: theorem odd_pow_sub_one (u : ℤ) (hu : Odd u) : ∀ k : ℕ, (2 : ℤ) ^ (k + 3) ∣ u ^ (2 ^ (k + 1)) - 1

PAG135::orderOf_chi_two_dvd.text:
theorem orderOf_chi_two_dvd (c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (c + 1))) :
    orderOf χ ∣ 2 ^ (c - 1)

PAG135::orderOf_chi_two.text:
theorem orderOf_chi_two (c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    orderOf χ = 2 ^ (c - 1)

PAG135::orderOf_zeta_single.text:
theorem orderOf_zeta_single (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + (c + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (c + 1) - w)) :
    orderOf ((cnorm p K (K - (c + 1) - w) * 𝓕 (ket K w (c + 1) h χ) t₀) ^ orderOf χ)
      = orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (c + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        / Nat.gcd (orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (c + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) (orderOf χ)

PAG135::zeta_single_odd.text:
theorem zeta_single_odd (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (K w c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (h : w + (c + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K))
    (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (c + 1) - w)) :
    p ∣ orderOf ((cnorm p K (K - (c + 1) - w) * 𝓕 (ket K w (c + 1) h χ) t₀) ^ orderOf χ) ∧
    ¬ p ^ 2 ∣ orderOf ((cnorm p K (K - (c + 1) - w) * 𝓕 (ket K w (c + 1) h χ) t₀) ^ orderOf χ)

PAG135::zeta_single_two.text:
theorem zeta_single_two (K w c : ℕ) (hc : 3 ≤ c) (h : w + (c + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (2 ^ K))
    (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := 2) K (K - (c + 1) - w)) :
    orderOf ((cnorm 2 K (K - (c + 1) - w) * 𝓕 (ket K w (c + 1) h χ) t₀)
      ^ orderOf χ) = 4

PAG136::ppart_div_gcd.text:
theorem ppart_div_gcd {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (a L E F : ℕ) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hL0 : L ≠ 0)
    (haE : p ^ E ∣ a) (haE' : ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ a) (hLF : p ^ F ∣ L) (hLF' : ¬ p ^ (F + 1) ∣ L) (hFE : F ≤ E) :
    p ^ (E - F) ∣ a / Nat.gcd a L ∧ ¬ p ^ (E - F + 1) ∣ a / Nat.gcd a L

PAG136::ppart_prod.text:
theorem ppart_prod {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (z : ι → ℂ) (hz0 : ∀ j, orderOf (z j) ≠ 0) (i : ι) (E : ℕ)
    (hE : p ^ E ∣ orderOf (z i)) (hE' : ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ orderOf (z i))
    (hcond : ¬ p ^ E ∣ ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i, orderOf (z j)) :
    p ^ E ∣ orderOf (∏ j, z j) ∧ ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ orderOf (∏ j, z j)

PAG136::ppart_prod_pow.text:
theorem ppart_prod_pow {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (z : ι → ℂ) (hz0 : ∀ j, orderOf (z j) ≠ 0) (i : ι) (E F L : ℕ)
    (hL0 : L ≠ 0) (hE : p ^ E ∣ orderOf (z i)) (hE' : ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ orderOf (z i))
    (hcond : ¬ p ^ E ∣ ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i, orderOf (z j))
    (hLF : p ^ F ∣ L) (hLF' : ¬ p ^ (F + 1) ∣ L) (hFE : F ≤ E) :
    p ^ (E - F) ∣ orderOf ((∏ j, z j) ^ L) ∧ ¬ p ^ (E - F + 1) ∣ orderOf ((∏ j, z j) ^ L)

PAG136::orderOf_gauss_ne_zero.text:
theorem orderOf_gauss_ne_zero {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (c + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ≠ 0

PAG136::two_facts.text:
theorem two_facts {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : p = 2) (c : ℕ) (hc : 3 ≤ c)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (c + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 2 ^ (c + 1) ∧
    orderOf χ = 2 ^ (c - 1)

PAG136::zeta_prod_two_part.text:
theorem zeta_prod_two_part (hc : ∀ i, 1 ≤ c i) (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (q i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (t : ∀ i, ZMod (q i ^ K i)) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Tset (p := q i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) (i : Fin n)
    (hqi : q i = 2) (hci : 3 ≤ c i)
    (hcond : ¬ 2 ^ (c i + 1) ∣ ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i,
      orderOf (gaussSum (χ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((q j : ℝ) ^ (c j + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    (hχj : ∀ j, j ≠ i → ¬ 2 ^ (c i) ∣ orderOf (χ j)) :
    4 ∣ orderOf ((∏ i, cnorm (q i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)
        * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i)) ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))) ∧
    ¬ 8 ∣ orderOf ((∏ i, cnorm (q i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)
        * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i)) ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)))

PAG137::not_pow_dvd_mul.text:
theorem not_pow_dvd_mul (A B : ℂ) (hA0 : orderOf A ≠ 0) (hB0 : orderOf B ≠ 0) (E : ℕ)
    (hA : ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ orderOf A) (hB : ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ orderOf B) : ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ orderOf (A * B)

PAG137::ppart_mul_lt.text:
theorem ppart_mul_lt (A B : ℂ) (hA0 : orderOf A ≠ 0) (hB0 : orderOf B ≠ 0) (a E : ℕ) (haE : a < E)
    (hA' : ¬ p ^ (a + 1) ∣ orderOf A) (hB : p ^ E ∣ orderOf B) (hB' : ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ orderOf B) :
    p ^ E ∣ orderOf (A * B) ∧ ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ orderOf (A * B)

PAG137::ppart_mul_eq.text:
theorem ppart_mul_eq (A B : ℂ) (hA0 : orderOf A ≠ 0) (hB0 : orderOf B ≠ 0) (E : ℕ)
    (hA' : ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ orderOf A) (hB' : ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ orderOf B) :
    ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ orderOf (A * B)

PAG137::dvd_pred_of_not.text:
theorem dvd_pred_of_not (o E M' : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E) (ho0 : o ≠ 0) (hM' : ¬ p ∣ M') (h : o ∣ p ^ E * M')
    (hn : ¬ p ^ E ∣ o) : o ∣ p ^ (E - 1) * M'

PAG137::ppart_mul_criterion.text:
theorem ppart_mul_criterion (A B : ℂ) (E M' : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E) (hM' : ¬ p ∣ M')
    (hlcm : Nat.lcm (orderOf A) (orderOf B) = p ^ E * M') :
    p ^ E ∣ orderOf (A * B) ↔ (A * B) ^ (p ^ (E - 1) * M') ≠ 1

PAG137::digit_pow_p.text:
omit hp in
theorem digit_pow_p (A B : ℂ) (E M' : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E)
    (hlcm : Nat.lcm (orderOf A) (orderOf B) = p ^ E * M') :
    (A ^ (p ^ (E - 1) * M')) ^ p = 1

PAG137::digit_ne_one.text:
theorem digit_ne_one (A : ℂ) (E M' : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E) (hM' : ¬ p ∣ M') (hA : p ^ E ∣ orderOf A) :
    A ^ (p ^ (E - 1) * M') ≠ 1

PAG137::ppart_mul_digit.text:
theorem ppart_mul_digit (A B : ℂ) (E M' : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E) (hM' : ¬ p ∣ M')
    (hlcm : Nat.lcm (orderOf A) (orderOf B) = p ^ E * M') :
    p ^ E ∣ orderOf (A * B) ↔ A ^ (p ^ (E - 1) * M') * B ^ (p ^ (E - 1) * M') ≠ 1

PAG137::two_always_cancel.text:
theorem two_always_cancel (A B : ℂ) (E M' : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E) (hM' : ¬ 2 ∣ M')
    (hlcm : Nat.lcm (orderOf A) (orderOf B) = 2 ^ E * M')
    (hA : 2 ^ E ∣ orderOf A) (hB : 2 ^ E ∣ orderOf B) : ¬ 2 ^ E ∣ orderOf (A * B)

PAG138::exists_stationary.text:
theorem exists_stationary (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c), IsUnit u₀ ∧
      ∀ y, phi (m := m) χ y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * u₀ * y) = 1

PAG138::gauss_twist.text:
theorem gauss_twist (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (hψ : ∀ y : ZMod (p ^ c), ψ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * y) = 1)
    (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hu₀ : IsUnit u₀)
    (hS₀ : ∀ y, phi (m := m) χ y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * u₀ * y) = 1) :
    gaussSum (χ * ψ) stdAddChar = ψ u₀ * gaussSum χ stdAddChar

PAG138::lift_trivial.text:
omit hc in
theorem lift_trivial (hm : 1 ≤ m) (ψ₀ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (hpc : p ∣ p ^ c)
    (y : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hu : IsUnit (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * y)) :
    DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hpc ψ₀ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * y) = 1

PAG138::phase_twist.text:
theorem phase_twist (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (hψ : ∀ y : ZMod (p ^ c), ψ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * y) = 1)
    (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hu₀ : IsUnit u₀)
    (hS₀ : ∀ y, phi (m := m) χ y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * u₀ * y) = 1) :
    gaussSum (χ * ψ) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      = ψ u₀ * (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ))

PAG139::cast_eq_of_P.text:
theorem cast_eq_of_P (u u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c)) (h : (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * u = (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * u₀) :
    ((u : ZMod (p ^ c)).cast : ZMod p) = (u₀.cast : ZMod p)

PAG139::gauss_twist_gen.text:
theorem gauss_twist_gen (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (ψ₀ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (hpc : p ∣ p ^ c)
    (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hu₀ : IsUnit u₀)
    (hS₀ : ∀ y, phiP χ ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k) y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * u₀ * y) = 1) :
    gaussSum (χ * DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hpc ψ₀) stdAddChar
      = DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hpc ψ₀ u₀ * gaussSum χ stdAddChar

PAG139::exists_unit_SP.text:
theorem exists_unit_SP (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c), IsUnit u₀ ∧
      ∀ y, phiP χ ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k) y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * u₀ * y) = 1

PAG139::gauss_twist_all.text:
theorem gauss_twist_all (c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hpc : p ∣ p ^ c) :
    ∃ u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c), IsUnit u₀ ∧ ∀ ψ₀ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p,
      gaussSum (χ * DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hpc ψ₀) stdAddChar
        = DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hpc ψ₀ u₀ * gaussSum χ stdAddChar

PAG140::mem_S_twist.text:
theorem mem_S_twist (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hψ : ∀ y, ψ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * δ * y)) (u : ZMod (p ^ c)) :
    (∀ y, phi (m := m) (χ * ψ) y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * u * y) = 1) ↔
      (∀ y, phi (m := m) χ y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * (u + δ) * y) = 1)

PAG140::stdAddChar_one_primitive.text: theorem stdAddChar_one_primitive (c : ℕ) : IsPrimitiveRoot (stdAddChar (1 : ZMod (p ^ c))) (p ^ c)

PAG140::exists_delta.text:
theorem exists_delta (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    ∃ δ : ZMod (p ^ c), ∀ y, ψ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * δ * y)

PAG140::gauss_twist_wild.text:
theorem gauss_twist_wild (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hψ : ∀ y, ψ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * δ * y))
    (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hu₀ : IsUnit u₀) (hu₀' : IsUnit (u₀ - δ))
    (hS₀ : ∀ y, phi (m := m) χ y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * u₀ * y) = 1) :
    gaussSum (χ * ψ) stdAddChar * (χ u₀ * stdAddChar u₀)
      = gaussSum χ stdAddChar * ((χ * ψ) (u₀ - δ) * stdAddChar (u₀ - δ))

PAG140::isUnit_iff_cast_ne_zero.text:
theorem isUnit_iff_cast_ne_zero (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (x : ZMod (p ^ c)) :
    IsUnit x ↔ ((x.cast : ZMod p) ≠ 0)

PAG140::gauss_twist_wild_zero.text:
theorem gauss_twist_wild_zero (hm : 1 ≤ m) (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hψ : ∀ y, ψ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * δ * y))
    (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hu₀' : ¬ IsUnit (u₀ - δ))
    (hS₀ : ∀ y, phi (m := m) χ y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * u₀ * y) = 1) :
    gaussSum (χ * ψ) stdAddChar = 0

PAG141::exists_delta_gen.text:
theorem exists_delta_gen (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    ∃ δ : ZMod (p ^ c), ∀ y, ψ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ * y)

PAG141::mem_SP_twist.text:
theorem mem_SP_twist (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hψ : ∀ y, ψ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ * y)) (u : ZMod (p ^ c)) :
    (∀ y, phiP (χ * ψ) ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k) y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * u * y) = 1) ↔
      (∀ y, phiP χ ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k) y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * (u + δ) * y) = 1)

PAG141::gauss_twist_shift.text:
theorem gauss_twist_shift (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hψ : ∀ y, ψ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ * y)) :
    gaussSum (χ * ψ) stdAddChar = ∑ v ∈ univ.filter (fun v : ZMod (p ^ c) =>
      ∀ y, phiP χ ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k) y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * v * y) = 1),
        (χ * ψ) (v - δ) * stdAddChar (v - δ)

PAG141::gauss_twist_zero_gen.text:
theorem gauss_twist_zero_gen (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hψ : ∀ y, ψ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ * y))
    (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hu₀' : ¬ IsUnit (u₀ - δ))
    (hS₀ : ∀ y, phiP χ ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k) y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * u₀ * y) = 1) :
    gaussSum (χ * ψ) stdAddChar = 0

PAG141::unit_of_primitive.text:
theorem unit_of_primitive (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hψ : ∀ y, ψ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ * y))
    (hχψ : (χ * ψ).IsPrimitive) (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hS₀ : ∀ y, phiP χ ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k) y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * u₀ * y) = 1) :
    IsUnit (u₀ - δ)

PAG141::primitive_iff_unit.text:
theorem primitive_iff_unit (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hψ : ∀ y, ψ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ * y))
    (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hS₀ : ∀ y, phiP χ ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k) y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * u₀ * y) = 1) :
    (χ * ψ).IsPrimitive ↔ IsUnit (u₀ - δ)

PAG142::freq_mul.text:
theorem freq_mul (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ₁ δ₂ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (h₁ : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ₁ * y))
    (h₂ : ∀ y, ψ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ₂ * y)) :
    ∀ y, (χ * ψ) (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * (δ₁ + δ₂) * y)

PAG142::mem_SP_iff_freq.text:
theorem mem_SP_iff_freq (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hδ : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ * y)) (u : ZMod (p ^ c)) :
    (∀ y, phiP χ ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k) y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * u * y) = 1) ↔
      (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * (u + δ) = 0

PAG142::stationary_cast.text:
theorem stationary_cast (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hδ : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ * y)) (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hS₀ : ∀ y, phiP χ ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k) y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * u₀ * y) = 1) :
    ((u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c)).cast : ZMod p) = ((-δ : ZMod (p ^ c)).cast : ZMod p)

PAG142::primitive_iff_freq.text:
theorem primitive_iff_freq (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hδ : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ * y)) :
    χ.IsPrimitive ↔ IsUnit δ

PAG142::primitive_mul_iff.text:
theorem primitive_mul_iff (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ₁ δ₂ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (h₁ : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ₁ * y))
    (h₂ : ∀ y, ψ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ₂ * y)) :
    (χ * ψ).IsPrimitive ↔ IsUnit (δ₁ + δ₂)

PAG143::P_mul_eq_zero_iff.text:
theorem P_mul_eq_zero_iff (x : ZMod (p ^ c)) :
    (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * x = 0 ↔ ((x.cast : ZMod (p ^ (c - k))) = 0)

PAG143::freq_unique.text:
theorem freq_unique (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ δ' : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (h : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ * y))
    (h' : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ' * y)) :
    ((δ.cast : ZMod (p ^ (c - k)))) = (δ'.cast : ZMod (p ^ (c - k)))

PAG143::freq_exists.text:
theorem freq_exists (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    ∃ δ : ZMod (p ^ c), ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ * y)

PAG143::freq.text:
noncomputable def freq (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) : ZMod (p ^ (c - k)) :=
  ((Classical.choose (freq_exists hkc h2k χ)).cast : ZMod (p ^ (c - k)))

PAG143::freq_spec.text:
theorem freq_spec (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (δ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (h : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * δ * y)) :
    freq hkc h2k χ = (δ.cast : ZMod (p ^ (c - k)))

PAG143::freq_mul.text:
theorem freq_mul (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    freq hkc h2k (χ * ψ) = freq hkc h2k χ + freq hkc h2k ψ

PAG143::freq_one.text: theorem freq_one : freq hkc h2k (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) = 0

PAG143::freq_eq_zero_iff.text:
theorem freq_eq_zero_iff (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    freq hkc h2k χ = 0 ↔ ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ k * y) = 1

PAG143::primitive_iff_freq_unit.text:
theorem primitive_iff_freq_unit (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    χ.IsPrimitive ↔ IsUnit (freq hkc h2k χ)

PAG143::freqHom.text:
noncomputable def freqHom : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c) →* Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ (c - k))) where
  toFun χ := Multiplicative.ofAdd (freq hkc h2k χ)
  map_one' := by rw [freq_one]; rfl
  map_mul' χ ψ := by rw [freq_mul]; rfl

PAG144::primitive_of_ne.text:
theorem primitive_of_ne (c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (h : χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ (c - 1)) ≠ 1) : χ.IsPrimitive

PAG144::.text:
instance (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : NeZero ((Monoid.exponent (ZMod N)ˣ : ℕ) : ℂ) :=
  ⟨Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Monoid.exponent_ne_zero_of_finite⟩

PAG144::exists_primitive.text: theorem exists_primitive (c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) : ∃ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c), χ.IsPrimitive

PAG144::freq_pow.text: theorem freq_pow (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) : ∀ n : ℕ, freq hkc h2k (χ ^ n) = n * freq hkc h2k χ

PAG144::freq_surjective.text: theorem freq_surjective : Function.Surjective (freq hkc h2k : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c) → ZMod (p ^ (c - k)))

PAG145::fiber_card.text:
theorem fiber_card :
    p ^ (c - k) * #{χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c) | freq hkc h2k χ = 0} = Nat.totient (p ^ c)

PAG145::card_units_filter.text: theorem card_units_filter (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : #{x : ZMod n | IsUnit x} = Nat.totient n

PAG145::card_primitive_mul.text:
theorem card_primitive_mul :
    #{χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c) | χ.IsPrimitive} * p ^ (c - k)
      = Nat.totient (p ^ (c - k)) * Nat.totient (p ^ c)

PAG145::card_primitive.text: theorem card_primitive : #{χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c) | χ.IsPrimitive} = p ^ (c - 2) * (p - 1) ^ 2

PAG146::evalHom.text:
noncomputable def evalHom (a : ZMod p) (ha : IsUnit a) : DirichletCharacter ℂ p →* ℂ where
  toFun ψ := ψ a
  map_one' := MulChar.one_apply ha
  map_mul' ψ ψ' := MulChar.mul_apply ψ ψ' a

PAG146::digitHom.text:
noncomputable def digitHom (a : ZMod p) (ha : IsUnit a) (N : ℕ) : DirichletCharacter ℂ p →* ℂ :=
  (powMonoidHom N).comp (evalHom a ha)

PAG146::phase_twist_cast.text:
theorem phase_twist_cast (c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hpc : p ∣ p ^ c) :
    ∃ u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c), IsUnit u₀ ∧ ∀ ψ₀ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p,
      gaussSum (χ * DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hpc ψ₀) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        = ψ₀ (u₀.cast : ZMod p) * (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ))

PAG146::twist_digit_uniform.text:
theorem twist_digit_uniform (c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hpc : p ∣ p ^ c) :
    ∃ u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c), IsUnit u₀ ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ) (x y : ℂ),
      x ∈ Set.range (fun ψ₀ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p =>
        (gaussSum (χ * DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hpc ψ₀) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N) →
      y ∈ Set.range (fun ψ₀ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p =>
        (gaussSum (χ * DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hpc ψ₀) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N) →
      #{ψ₀ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p |
          (gaussSum (χ * DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hpc ψ₀) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = x}
        = #{ψ₀ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p |
          (gaussSum (χ * DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hpc ψ₀) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = y}

PAG147::eq_of_dvd_not_dvd_div.text:
theorem eq_of_dvd_not_dvd_div (e d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (he : e ∣ d)
    (h : ∀ q, q.Prime → q ∣ d → ¬ e ∣ d / q) : e = d

PAG147::evalUnits.text:
noncomputable def evalUnits (a : ZMod p) (ha : IsUnit a) : DirichletCharacter ℂ p →* ℂˣ :=
  (PAG.Part146.evalHom a ha).toHomUnits

PAG147::evalUnits_val.text:
theorem evalUnits_val (a : ZMod p) (ha : IsUnit a) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) :
    ((evalUnits a ha ψ : ℂˣ) : ℂ) = ψ a

PAG147::card_range_eval.text:
theorem card_range_eval (a : (ZMod p)ˣ) :
    Nat.card (evalUnits (a : ZMod p) a.isUnit).range = orderOf a

PAG147::exists_primitive_value.text:
theorem exists_primitive_value (a : (ZMod p)ˣ) :
    ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p, IsPrimitiveRoot (ψ a) (orderOf a)

PAG148::ncard_range_eval.text:
theorem ncard_range_eval (a : (ZMod p)ˣ) :
    (Set.range fun ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p => ψ (a : ZMod p)).ncard = orderOf a

PAG148::ncard_range_digit.text:
theorem ncard_range_digit (a : (ZMod p)ˣ) (N : ℕ) :
    (Set.range fun ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p => ψ (a : ZMod p) ^ N).ncard = orderOf a / Nat.gcd (orderOf a) N

PAG148::ncard_twist_digit.text:
theorem ncard_twist_digit (c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hpc : p ∣ p ^ c) :
    ∃ ū : (ZMod p)ˣ, ∀ N : ℕ,
      (Set.range fun ψ₀ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p =>
        (gaussSum (χ * DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hpc ψ₀) stdAddChar
          / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N).ncard = orderOf ū / Nat.gcd (orderOf ū) N

PAG149::criterion_gen.text:
theorem criterion_gen {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (X : ℂ) (E M' : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E) (hM' : ¬ p ∣ M')
    (hdvd : orderOf X ∣ p ^ E * M') :
    p ^ E ∣ orderOf X ↔ X ^ (p ^ (E - 1) * M') ≠ 1

PAG149::fiber_digit.text:
theorem fiber_digit (a : (ZMod q)ˣ) (N : ℕ) (x : ℂ)
    (hx : x ∈ Set.range fun ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q => ψ (a : ZMod q) ^ N) :
    #{ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q | ψ (a : ZMod q) ^ N = x} * (orderOf a / Nat.gcd (orderOf a) N) = q - 1

PAG149::cancel_count.text:
theorem cancel_count {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (a : (ZMod q)ˣ) (A₀ B : ℂ) (hAB : A₀ * B ≠ 0)
    (E M' : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E) (hM' : ¬ p ∣ M')
    (hdvd : ∀ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, orderOf (ψ (a : ZMod q) * A₀ * B) ∣ p ^ E * M') :
    let K

PAG150::ncard_roots_le.text: theorem ncard_roots_le (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : ({x : ℂ | x ^ m = 1} : Set ℂ).ncard ≤ m

PAG150::cancel_ne_zero_iff.text:
theorem cancel_ne_zero_iff {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (a : (ZMod q)ˣ) (A₀ B : ℂ) (hAB : A₀ * B ≠ 0)
    (E M' : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E) (hM' : ¬ p ∣ M')
    (hdvd : ∀ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, orderOf (ψ (a : ZMod q) * A₀ * B) ∣ p ^ E * M') :
    #{ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q | ¬ p ^ E ∣ orderOf (ψ (a : ZMod q) * A₀ * B)} ≠ 0 ↔
      (A₀ * B) ^ (p ^ (E - 1) * M' * (orderOf a / Nat.gcd (orderOf a) (p ^ (E - 1) * M'))) = 1

PAG151::real_gauss_sq.text:
theorem real_gauss_sq {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (h2 : χ ^ 2 = 1) :

PAG151::real_phase_sq.text:
theorem real_phase_sq {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (h2 : χ ^ 2 = 1) :
    (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 2 = χ (-1)

PAG151::zeta_real.text:
theorem zeta_real (K w c : ℕ) (h : w + (c + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (h2 : χ ^ 2 = 1) (h1 : χ ≠ 1) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K))
    (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (c + 1) - w)) :
    (cnorm p K (K - (c + 1) - w) * 𝓕 (ket K w (c + 1) h χ) t₀) ^ orderOf χ = χ (-1)

PAG151::neg_one_mod4.text: theorem neg_one_mod4 (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 4) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : χ (-1) = -1

PAG151::phase_mod4.text:
theorem phase_mod4 (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 4) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :

PAG151::phase_mod8.text:
theorem phase_mod8 (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 8) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :

PAG152::gauss_mod4.text: theorem gauss_mod4 (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 4) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : gaussSum χ stdAddChar = 2 * I

PAG152::phase_mod4_eq.text:
theorem phase_mod4_eq (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 4) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :

PAG152::e8_one.text: theorem e8_one : stdAddChar (1 : ZMod 8) = ((Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (1 + I)

PAG152::e8_pow.text: theorem e8_pow (k : ℕ) : stdAddChar ((k : ZMod 8)) = stdAddChar (1 : ZMod 8) ^ k

PAG152::five_mod8.text: theorem five_mod8 (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 8) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : χ 5 = -1

PAG152::gauss_mod8.text:
theorem gauss_mod8 (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 8) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :

PAG153::orderOf_of_sq_neg_one.text: theorem orderOf_of_sq_neg_one (z : ℂ) (h : z ^ 2 = -1) : orderOf z = 4

PAG153::small_two_facts.text:
theorem small_two_facts {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : p = 2) (c : ℕ) (hc : c = 1 ∨ c = 2)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hodd : χ (-1) = -1) :
    orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (c + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 4 ∧ orderOf χ = 2

PAG153::zeta_prod_small_two.text:
theorem zeta_prod_small_two (hc : ∀ i, 1 ≤ c i) (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (q i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (t : ∀ i, ZMod (q i ^ K i)) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Tset (p := q i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) (i : Fin n)
    (hqi : q i = 2) (hci : c i = 1 ∨ c i = 2) (hodd : χ i (-1) = -1)
    (hcond : ¬ 2 ^ 2 ∣ ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i,
      orderOf (gaussSum (χ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((q j : ℝ) ^ (c j + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    (hχj : ∀ j, j ≠ i → ¬ 2 ^ 2 ∣ orderOf (χ j)) :
    2 ∣ orderOf ((∏ i, cnorm (q i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)
        * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i)) ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))) ∧
    ¬ 4 ∣ orderOf ((∏ i, cnorm (q i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)
        * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i)) ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)))

PAG154::phase_of_S.text:
theorem phase_of_S (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hunit : IsUnit u₀) (hS₀ : ∀ y, phi (m := m) χ y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * u₀ * y) = 1) :
    gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ) = χ u₀ * stdAddChar u₀

PAG154::ord_of_phase.text:
theorem ord_of_phase {c : ℕ} (hc1 : 1 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hu : IsUnit u₀) :
    orderOf (χ u₀ * stdAddChar u₀) = Nat.lcm (orderOf (χ u₀)) (p ^ c)

PAG154::lcm_tame.text:
theorem lcm_tame (c : ℕ) (hc1 : 1 ≤ c) (x : ℂ) (hx : x ^ (p ^ (c - 1) * (p - 1)) = 1) :
    Nat.lcm (orderOf x) (p ^ c) = p ^ c * orderOf (x ^ (p ^ (c - 1)))

PAG154::card_ker_unitsMap.text:
theorem card_ker_unitsMap (c : ℕ) (hc1 : 1 ≤ c) :
    Nat.card (ZMod.unitsMap (dvd_pow_self p (by omega : c ≠ 0))).ker = p ^ (c - 1)

PAG154::pow_eq_of_cast_eq.text:
theorem pow_eq_of_cast_eq (c : ℕ) (hc1 : 1 ≤ c) (u v : (ZMod (p ^ c))ˣ)
    (h : ((u : ZMod (p ^ c)).cast : ZMod p) = ((v : ZMod (p ^ c)).cast : ZMod p)) :

PAG154::chi_pow_of_cast_eq.text:
theorem chi_pow_of_cast_eq (c : ℕ) (hc1 : 1 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (u v : ZMod (p ^ c))

PAG154::orderOf_gauss_freq.text:
theorem orderOf_gauss_freq {c m : ℕ} (hc : c = 2 * m) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (δ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hδ : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ m * δ * y)) :
    orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      = p ^ c * orderOf (χ (-δ) ^ (p ^ (c - 1)))

PAG155::lcm_tame_gen.text:
theorem lcm_tame_gen (c : ℕ) (hc1 : 1 ≤ c) (x : ℂ) (r : ℕ) (hr0 : ¬ p ∣ r) (hx : x ^ (p ^ (c - 1) * r) = 1) :

PAG155::ord_mul_e.text:
theorem ord_mul_e (c : ℕ) (hc1 : 1 ≤ c) (y : ℂ) (r : ℕ) (hr0 : ¬ p ∣ r) (hy : y ^ (p ^ (c - 1) * r) = 1)
    (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c)) (hu : IsUnit u₀) :
    orderOf (y * stdAddChar u₀) = Nat.lcm (orderOf y) (p ^ c)

PAG155::orderOf_gauss_odd_formula.text:
theorem orderOf_gauss_odd_formula {c m : ℕ} (hc : c = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hp2 : p ≠ 2)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c), IsUnit u₀ ∧ ∃ q : ℂ, q ^ (2 * p) = Lc p (-1) ∧
      orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        = p ^ c * orderOf (χ u₀ ^ (p ^ (c - 1)) * q ^ (p ^ (c - 1)))

PAG156::phase_of_SP.text:
theorem phase_of_SP (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hunit : IsUnit u₀)
    (hS₀ : ∀ y, phiP χ ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ (m + 1)) y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ (m + 1) * u₀ * y) = 1) :
    ∃ q : ℂ, q ^ (4 * p) = 1 ∧ (p ≠ 2 → q ^ (2 * p) = Lc p (-1)) ∧
      gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ) = χ u₀ * stdAddChar u₀ * q

PAG156::orderOf_gauss_odd_freq.text:
theorem orderOf_gauss_odd_freq (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (δ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hδ : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ (m + 1) * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ (m + 1) * δ * y)) :
    ∃ q : ℂ, q ^ (2 * p) = Lc p (-1) ∧
      orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        = p ^ c * orderOf (χ (-δ) ^ (p ^ (c - 1)) * q ^ (p ^ (c - 1)))

PAG157::order_chi_split.text:
theorem order_chi_split (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : ∃ s' : ℕ, orderOf χ = p ^ n * s' ∧ ¬ p ∣ s' ∧ s' ∣ p - 1

PAG157::zeta_order_even.text:
theorem zeta_order_even (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) = p

PAG157::zeta_order_odd.text:
theorem zeta_order_odd (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) ^ (4 * p) = 1 ∧
    p ∣ orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) ∧
    (p % 4 = 1 → ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) ^ (2 * p) = 1)

PAG158::four_not_dvd_ord_chi.text:
theorem four_not_dvd_ord_chi (h4 : p % 4 = 3) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : ¬ 4 ∣ orderOf χ

PAG158::zeta_order_three_mod_four.text:
theorem zeta_order_three_mod_four (h4 : p % 4 = 3) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    2 ∣ orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) ∧
    2 * p ∣ orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) ∧
    orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) ∣ 4 * p

PAG159::Q_sq.text:
theorem Q_sq (h4 : p % 4 = 3) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (q : ℂ) (hq : q ^ (2 * p) = PAG.Part119.Lc p (-1)) :
    (q ^ (p ^ n)) ^ 2 = -1

PAG159::zeta_order_parity.text:
theorem zeta_order_parity (h4 : p % 4 = 3) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (2 ∣ orderOf χ → orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) = 2 * p) ∧
    (¬ 2 ∣ orderOf χ → orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) = 4 * p)

PAG159::Q_sq_one.text:
theorem Q_sq_one (h4 : p % 4 = 1) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (q : ℂ) (hq : q ^ (2 * p) = PAG.Part119.Lc p (-1)) :
    (q ^ (p ^ n)) ^ 2 = 1

PAG159::zeta_order_one_even.text:
theorem zeta_order_one_even (h4 : p % 4 = 1) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hev : 2 ∣ orderOf χ) :
    orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) = p

PAG160::epsG.text: noncomputable def epsG (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : ℂ := gaussSum (Lc p) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)

PAG160::epsG_sq.text: theorem epsG_sq (hp2 : p ≠ 2) : epsG p ^ 2 = Lc p (-1)

PAG160::quad_explicit.text:
theorem quad_explicit (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (F : ZMod p → ℂ) (a : ZMod p) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hF0 : F 0 = 1)
    (hF : ∀ t s, F (t + s) = F t * F s * stdAddChar (a * t * s)) :
    ∃ κ : ZMod p, (∑ t, F t) / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ) = stdAddChar κ * Lc p (a * 2⁻¹) * epsG p

PAG160::phase_explicit.text:
theorem phase_explicit (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ c))
    (hunit : IsUnit u₀)
    (hS₀ : ∀ y, phiP χ ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ (m + 1)) y * stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ c)) ^ (m + 1) * u₀ * y) = 1) :
    ∃ κ : ZMod p, gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      = χ u₀ * stdAddChar u₀ * (stdAddChar κ * Lc p ((u₀.cast : ZMod p) * 2⁻¹) * epsG p)

PAG160::pow_odd_of_sq_one.text: theorem pow_odd_of_sq_one (x : ℂ) (hx : x ^ 2 = 1) (k : ℕ) (hk : Odd k) : x ^ k = x

PAG160::Q_explicit.text:
theorem Q_explicit (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (κ A : ZMod p) (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    (stdAddChar κ * Lc p A * epsG p) ^ (p ^ n) = Lc p A * epsG p ^ (p ^ n)

PAG160::zeta_pow_p.text:
theorem zeta_pow_p (n : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (u₀ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) (hu : IsUnit u₀)
    (q : ℂ) (s' : ℕ) (hs : orderOf χ = p ^ n * s') :
    ((χ u₀ * stdAddChar u₀ * q) ^ orderOf χ) ^ p = (q ^ (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ s'

PAG160::zeta_p_one_odd.text:
theorem zeta_p_one_odd (h4 : p % 4 = 1) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (δ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hδ : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (m + 1) * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (m + 1) * δ * y))
    (hodd : ¬ 2 ∣ orderOf χ) :
    ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) ^ p
      = Lc p (((-δ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))).cast : ZMod p) * 2⁻¹) * epsG p ∧ epsG p ^ 2 = 1

PAG160::zeta_order_one_odd_iff.text:
theorem zeta_order_one_odd_iff (h4 : p % 4 = 1) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (δ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hδ : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (m + 1) * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (m + 1) * δ * y))
    (hodd : ¬ 2 ∣ orderOf χ) :
    orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) = p ↔
      Lc p (((-δ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))).cast : ZMod p) * 2⁻¹) = epsG p

PAG161::zeta_p_formula.text:
theorem zeta_p_formula (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (δ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hδ : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (m + 1) * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (m + 1) * δ * y))
    (s' : ℕ) (hs : orderOf χ = p ^ n * s') :
    ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) ^ p
      = (Lc p (((-δ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))).cast : ZMod p) * 2⁻¹) * epsG p ^ (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ s'

PAG161::orderOf_zeta_formula.text:
theorem orderOf_zeta_formula (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (δ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hδ : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (m + 1) * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (m + 1) * δ * y))
    (s' : ℕ) (hs : orderOf χ = p ^ n * s') :
    orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ)
      = p * orderOf ((Lc p (((-δ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))).cast : ZMod p) * 2⁻¹) * epsG p ^ (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ s')

PAG162::fp.text: noncomputable def fp (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) : ZMod p := ((freq hkc h2k χ).cast : ZMod p)

PAG162::fp_mul.text: theorem fp_mul (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) : fp hkc h2k (χ * ψ) = fp hkc h2k χ + fp hkc h2k ψ

PAG162::fp_one.text: theorem fp_one : fp hkc h2k (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) = 0

PAG162::fp_inv.text: theorem fp_inv (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) : fp hkc h2k χ⁻¹ = - fp hkc h2k χ

PAG162::fp_pow.text: theorem fp_pow (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (j : ℕ) : fp hkc h2k (χ ^ j) = j * fp hkc h2k χ

PAG162::fp_ne_zero_iff.text: theorem fp_ne_zero_iff (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) : χ.IsPrimitive ↔ fp hkc h2k χ ≠ 0

PAG162::exists_omega.text:
theorem exists_omega (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (n : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hkc : k < n + 1) (h2k : n + 1 ≤ 2 * k)
    (v o : ℕ) (hvo : p - 1 = 2 ^ v * o) (t : ZMod p) :
    ∃ ω : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)), ω ^ (p ^ n * o) = 1 ∧ fp hkc h2k ω = t

PAG163::isCyclic_chars.text: theorem isCyclic_chars (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (c : ℕ) : IsCyclic (DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))

PAG163::card_pow_eq_one.text:
open Classical in
theorem card_pow_eq_one (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (c : ℕ) (N : ℕ) (hN : N ∣ Nat.totient (p ^ c)) :
    #{χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c) | χ ^ N = 1} = N

PAG163::count_closed.text:
open Classical in
theorem count_closed (h4 : p % 4 = 1) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (v o : ℕ)
    (ho : Odd o) (hvo : p - 1 = 2 ^ v * o) :
    #{χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)) | ¬ 2 ∣ orderOf χ ∧ χ.IsPrimitive ∧
        orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) = p}
      = (p - 1) / 2 * (p ^ (n - 1) * o)

PAG164::zeta.text:
noncomputable def zeta (n : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) : ℂ :=
  (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ

PAG164::odd_iff_pow.text:
theorem odd_iff_pow (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (n v o : ℕ) (ho : Odd o) (hvo : p - 1 = 2 ^ v * o)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) : ¬ 2 ∣ orderOf χ ↔ χ ^ (p ^ n * o) = 1

PAG164::fiber_size.text:
open Classical in
theorem fiber_size (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) {k : ℕ} (hkc : k < n + 1) (h2k : n + 1 ≤ 2 * k)
    (v o : ℕ) (hvo : p - 1 = 2 ^ v * o) :
    #{χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)) | χ ^ (p ^ n * o) = 1 ∧ fp hkc h2k χ = 0} = p ^ (n - 1) * o

PAG164::card_prim_odd.text:
open Classical in
theorem card_prim_odd (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) {k : ℕ} (hkc : k < n + 1) (h2k : n + 1 ≤ 2 * k)
    (v o : ℕ) (ho : Odd o) (hvo : p - 1 = 2 ^ v * o) :
    #{χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)) | ¬ 2 ∣ orderOf χ ∧ χ.IsPrimitive} = (p - 1) * (p ^ (n - 1) * o)

PAG164::count_one.text:
open Classical in
theorem count_one (h4 : p % 4 = 1) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (v o : ℕ)
    (ho : Odd o) (hvo : p - 1 = 2 ^ v * o) :
    #{χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)) | χ.IsPrimitive ∧ orderOf (zeta n χ) = 2 * p}
        = (p - 1) / 2 * (p ^ (n - 1) * o) ∧
      #{χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)) | χ.IsPrimitive ∧ orderOf (zeta n χ) = p}
        + (p - 1) / 2 * (p ^ (n - 1) * o) = p ^ (n - 1) * (p - 1) ^ 2

PAG165::prod_X_sub.text:
theorem prod_X_sub (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (ω : ℂ) (hω : IsPrimitiveRoot ω n) :

PAG165::zp.text: noncomputable def zp : ℂ := Complex.exp (2 * π * I / p)

PAG165::zp_ne_zero.text:

PAG165::gb.text: noncomputable def gb (b : ℕ) : ℂ := zp p ^ b - (zp p ^ b)⁻¹

PAG165::Pi.text: noncomputable def Pi (m : ℕ) : ℂ := ∏ a ∈ Ico 1 (m + 1), gb p a

PAG165::gb_reflect.text: theorem gb_reflect (a : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ p) : gb p (p - a) = - gb p a

PAG165::prod_gb.text: theorem prod_gb (hp2 : p ≠ 2) : ∏ b ∈ Ico 1 p, gb p b = p

PAG165::gb_sin.text:

PAG165::Pi_eq.text: theorem Pi_eq (m : ℕ) (hpm : p = 2 * m + 1) : Pi p m = I ^ m * (Real.sqrt p : ℂ)

PAG166::T.text: noncomputable def T (f : ℤ[X]) : (ZMod p)[X] := (f.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod p))).comp (X + 1)

PAG166::T_mul.text: theorem T_mul (f g : ℤ[X]) : T p (f * g) = T p f * T p g

PAG166::T_sub.text: theorem T_sub (f g : ℤ[X]) : T p (f - g) = T p f - T p g

PAG166::T_cyclotomic.text: theorem T_cyclotomic : T p (cyclotomic p ℤ) = X ^ (p - 1)

PAG166::Pz.text: noncomputable def Pz : ℤ[X] := ∑ a ∈ range p, C (quadraticChar (ZMod p) (a : ZMod p)) * X ^ a

PAG166::Qz.text: noncomputable def Qz (m : ℕ) : ℤ[X] := ∏ a ∈ Ico 1 (m + 1), (X ^ a - X ^ (p - a))

PAG166::coeff_TP.text: theorem coeff_TP (m : ℕ) (hpm : p = 2 * m + 1) : (m.factorial : ZMod p) * (T p (Pz p)).coeff m = -1

PAG166::factorial_sq.text: theorem factorial_sq (m : ℕ) (hpm : p = 2 * m + 1) : ((m.factorial : ZMod p)) ^ 2 = (-1) ^ (m + 1)

PAG167::Pi_eq_aeval.text: theorem Pi_eq_aeval (m : ℕ) (hpm : p = 2 * m + 1) : Pi p m = aeval (zp p) (Qz p m)

PAG167::Lc_neg_one_pow.text: theorem Lc_neg_one_pow (m : ℕ) (hpm : p = 2 * m + 1) : (PAG.Part119.Lc p (-1) : ℂ) = (-1) ^ m

PAG167::zeta_order_one_odd_iff'.text:
theorem zeta_order_one_odd_iff' (h4 : p % 4 = 1) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (δ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hδ : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (m + 1) * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (m + 1) * δ * y))
    (hodd : ¬ 2 ∣ orderOf χ) :
    orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) = p ↔
      PAG.Part119.Lc p (((-δ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))).cast : ZMod p) * 2⁻¹) = 1

PAG168::Lc_neg_half.text: theorem Lc_neg_half (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (x : ZMod p) : Lc p (-x * 2⁻¹) = Lc p (-1) * Lc p (2 * x)

PAG168::zeta_p_explicit.text:
theorem zeta_p_explicit (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (δ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hδ : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (m + 1) * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (m + 1) * δ * y))
    (s' : ℕ) (hs : orderOf χ = p ^ n * s') :
    ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) ^ p
      = (epsG p * Lc p (2 * (δ.cast : ZMod p))) ^ s'

PAG168::orderOf_zeta_explicit.text:
theorem orderOf_zeta_explicit (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (δ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hδ : ∀ y, χ (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (m + 1) * y) = stdAddChar ((p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (m + 1) * δ * y))
    (s' : ℕ) (hs : orderOf χ = p ^ n * s') :
    orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ)
      = p * orderOf ((epsG p * Lc p (2 * (δ.cast : ZMod p))) ^ s')

PAG169::ord_split.text:

PAG169::ord_prod_primes.text:
theorem ord_prod_primes {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (q : ι → ℕ) (hq : ∀ i, (q i).Prime) (u : ι → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ i, u i ^ q i = 1) :
    ∀ s : Finset ι, Set.InjOn q s → orderOf (∏ i ∈ s, u i) = ∏ i ∈ s.filter (fun i => u i ≠ 1), q i

PAG169::ord_prod_general.text:
theorem ord_prod_general {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → ℕ) (hpr : ∀ i, (p i).Prime) (hp2 : ∀ i, p i ≠ 2)
    (hinj : Function.Injective p) (ζ : Fin n → ℂ) (h4 : ∀ i, ζ i ^ (4 * p i) = 1)
    (hpd : ∀ i, p i ∣ orderOf (ζ i)) (e : Fin n → ℕ) :
    orderOf (∏ i, ζ i ^ e i)
      = (∏ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => ¬ p i ∣ e i), p i)
        * orderOf (∏ i, (ζ i ^ p i) ^ (e i * ((∏ j, p j) / p i)))

PAG169::single_facts.text:
theorem single_facts {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c)

    ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (c + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) ^ (4 * p) = 1 ∧
      p ∣ orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (c + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ)

PAG169::zeta_prod_split.text:
theorem zeta_prod_split (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (t : ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i)) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Tset (p := p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) :
    (∏ i, cnorm (p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i) * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i))
        ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))
      = ∏ i, ((gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p i : ℝ) ^ (c i + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf (χ i))
          ^ (lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)) / orderOf (χ i))

PAG169::orderOf_zeta_prod_formula.text:
theorem orderOf_zeta_prod_formula (hp2 : ∀ i, p i ≠ 2) (hinj : Function.Injective p) (hc : ∀ i, 1 ≤ c i)
    (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (t : ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i)) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Tset (p := p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) :
    orderOf ((∏ i, cnorm (p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i) * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i))
        ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)))
      = (∏ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => ¬ p i ∣ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)) / orderOf (χ i)), p i)
        * orderOf (∏ i, (((gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p i : ℝ) ^ (c i + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
            ^ orderOf (χ i)) ^ p i)
            ^ ((lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)) / orderOf (χ i)) * ((∏ j, p j) / p i)))

PAG170::ord_prod_mixed.text:
theorem ord_prod_mixed {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → ℕ) (hpr : ∀ i, (p i).Prime) (ζ : Fin n → ℂ)

    orderOf (∏ i, ζ i ^ e i)
