PAG173::zeta_prod_infinite.text:
theorem zeta_prod_infinite (i₀ : Fin n) (hc : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → 1 ≤ c i) (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (t : ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i)) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Tset (p := p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i))
    (hbad : ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N →
      ((gaussSum (χ i₀) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p i₀ : ℝ) ^ (c i₀ + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf (χ i₀)) ^ N ≠ 1) :
    orderOf ((∏ i, cnorm (p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i) * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i))
        ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))) = 0

PAG173::bad_cubic.text:
theorem bad_cubic (i₀ : Fin n) (hc0 : c i₀ = 0) (h3p : p i₀ % 3 = 1)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i₀ ^ (c i₀ + 1))) (h3 : orderOf χ = 3) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N →
      ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p i₀ : ℝ) ^ (c i₀ + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG173::bad_quartic.text:
theorem bad_quartic (i₀ : Fin n) (hc0 : c i₀ = 0)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i₀ ^ (c i₀ + 1))) (h4 : orderOf χ = 4) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N →
      ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p i₀ : ℝ) ^ (c i₀ + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG174::z6_eq.text:
theorem z6_eq (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h3 : orderOf χ = 3) :
    (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 6 = jacobiSum χ χ ^ 2 / p

PAG174::trace_identity.text:
theorem trace_identity (a b c d : ℤ) :
    ((a : ℂ) + b * ω) ^ 2 * ((c : ℂ) + d * ω) ^ 2 + ((a : ℂ) + b * (-1 - ω)) ^ 2 * ((c : ℂ) + d * (-1 - ω)) ^ 2
      = (Tpoly a b c d : ℂ)

PAG174::T_not_dvd.text:
theorem T_not_dvd {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p ≠ q) (h3p : p % 3 = 1) (a b c d : ℤ)
    (hab : a ^ 2 - a * b + b ^ 2 = p) (hcd : c ^ 2 - c * d + d ^ 2 = q) : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ Tpoly a b c d

PAG174::not_root_mul.text:
theorem not_root_mul (A B : ℂ) (hA : ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → A ^ N ≠ 1) (M : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (hB : B ^ M = 1) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → (A * B) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG174::jacobi_data.text:
theorem jacobi_data (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h3 : orderOf χ = 3) :
    ∃ a b : ℤ, jacobiSum χ χ = a + b * ω ∧ (starRingEnd ℂ) (jacobiSum χ χ) = a + b * (-1 - ω) ∧
      a ^ 2 - a * b + b ^ 2 = p

PAG174::cubic_pair_not_root.text:
theorem cubic_pair_not_root {q : ℕ} [hq : Fact q.Prime] (hpq : p ≠ q) (h3p : p % 3 = 1)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (h3 : orderOf χ = 3) (h3' : orderOf ψ = 3) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N →
      ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) * (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt q : ℝ) : ℂ))) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG175::z4_eq.text:
theorem z4_eq (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h4 : orderOf χ = 4) :
    (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 4 = (χ * χ) (-1) * jacobiSum χ χ ^ 2 / p

PAG175::trace4_identity.text:
theorem trace4_identity (a b c d : ℤ) :
    ((a : ℂ) + b * I) ^ 2 * ((c : ℂ) + d * I) ^ 2 + ((a : ℂ) - b * I) ^ 2 * ((c : ℂ) - d * I) ^ 2
      = (T4 a b c d : ℂ)

PAG175::T4_not_dvd.text:
theorem T4_not_dvd {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p ≠ q) (hp5 : 5 ≤ p) (a b c d : ℤ)
    (hab : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = p) (hcd : c ^ 2 + d ^ 2 = q) : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ T4 a b c d

PAG175::jacobi_data4.text:
theorem jacobi_data4 (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h4 : orderOf χ = 4) :
    ∃ a b : ℤ, jacobiSum χ χ = a + b * I ∧ (starRingEnd ℂ) (jacobiSum χ χ) = a - b * I ∧
      a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = p

PAG175::p_ge_five.text: theorem p_ge_five (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h4 : orderOf χ = 4) : 5 ≤ p

PAG175::quartic_pair_not_root.text:
theorem quartic_pair_not_root {q : ℕ} [hq : Fact q.Prime] (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (h4 : orderOf χ = 4) (h4' : orderOf ψ = 4) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N →
      ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) * (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt q : ℝ) : ℂ))) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG176::InQω.text: def InQω (y : ℂ) : Prop := ∃ A B : ℚ, y = A + B * ω

PAG176::InQi.text: def InQi (y : ℂ) : Prop := ∃ A B : ℚ, y = A + B * I

PAG176::InQω_mul.text: theorem InQω_mul {y y' : ℂ} (h : InQω y) (h' : InQω y') : InQω (y * y')

PAG176::InQi_mul.text: theorem InQi_mul {y y' : ℂ} (h : InQi y) (h' : InQi y') : InQi (y * y')

PAG176::InQω_pow.text:
theorem InQω_pow {y : ℂ} (h : InQω y) : ∀ n : ℕ, InQω (y ^ n)
  | 0 => ⟨1, 0, by simp⟩
  | n + 1 => by rw [pow_succ]; exact InQω_mul (InQω_pow h n) h

PAG176::InQi_pow.text:
theorem InQi_pow {y : ℂ} (h : InQi y) : ∀ n : ℕ, InQi (y ^ n)
  | 0 => ⟨1, 0, by simp⟩
  | n + 1 => by rw [pow_succ]; exact InQi_mul (InQi_pow h n) h

PAG176::inter_rat.text: theorem inter_rat {y : ℂ} (h : InQω y) (h' : InQi y) : ∃ r : ℚ, y = r

PAG176::cubic_quartic_not_root.text:
theorem cubic_quartic_not_root (h3p : p % 3 = 1) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (h3 : orderOf χ = 3) (h4 : orderOf ψ = 4) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N →
      ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) * (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt q : ℝ) : ℂ))) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG177::Tlin.text: def Tlin (a b C D : ℤ) : ℤ := 2*C*a^2 - 2*C*a*b - C*b^2 - D*a^2 - 2*D*a*b + 2*D*b^2

PAG177::trace_lin.text:
theorem trace_lin (a b C D : ℤ) :
    ((a : ℂ) + b * ω) ^ 2 * ((C : ℂ) + D * ω) + ((a : ℂ) + b * (-1 - ω)) ^ 2 * ((C : ℂ) + D * (-1 - ω))
      = (Tlin a b C D : ℂ)

PAG177::Tlin_not_dvd.text:
theorem Tlin_not_dvd {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (h3p : p % 3 = 1) (a b C D : ℤ)
    (hab : a ^ 2 - a * b + b ^ 2 = p) (hCD : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ C ^ 2 - C * D + D ^ 2) : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ Tlin a b C D

PAG177::prod_repr.text:
theorem prod_repr {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ) (c d m : ι → ℤ)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, f i = c i + d i * ω) (hm : ∀ i ∈ s, c i ^ 2 - c i * d i + d i ^ 2 = m i) :
    ∃ C D : ℤ, ∏ i ∈ s, f i = C + D * ω ∧ C ^ 2 - C * D + D ^ 2 = ∏ i ∈ s, m i

PAG177::cubic_multi_not_root.text:
theorem cubic_multi_not_root (hn : 0 < n) (hinj : Function.Injective p) (h3p : ∀ i, p i % 3 = 1)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i)) (h3 : ∀ i, orderOf (χ i) = 3) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → (∏ i, gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (p i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG178::Tlin4.text: def Tlin4 (a b C D : ℤ) : ℤ := 2 * ((a ^ 2 - b ^ 2) * C - 2 * a * b * D)

PAG178::trace_lin4.text:
theorem trace_lin4 (a b C D : ℤ) :
    ((a : ℂ) + b * I) ^ 2 * ((C : ℂ) + D * I) + ((a : ℂ) - b * I) ^ 2 * ((C : ℂ) - D * I) = (Tlin4 a b C D : ℂ)

PAG178::Tlin4_not_dvd.text:
theorem Tlin4_not_dvd {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hp5 : 5 ≤ p) (a b C D : ℤ)
    (hab : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = p) (hCD : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ C ^ 2 + D ^ 2) : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ Tlin4 a b C D

PAG178::prod_repr4.text:
theorem prod_repr4 {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ) (c d m : ι → ℤ)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, f i = c i + d i * I) (hm : ∀ i ∈ s, c i ^ 2 + d i ^ 2 = m i) :
    ∃ C D : ℤ, ∏ i ∈ s, f i = C + D * I ∧ C ^ 2 + D ^ 2 = ∏ i ∈ s, m i

PAG178::sign_int.text:
theorem sign_int {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    ∃ σ : ℤ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧ (φ * φ) (-1) = σ

PAG178::quartic_multi_not_root.text:
theorem quartic_multi_not_root (hn : 0 < n) (hinj : Function.Injective p)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i)) (h4 : ∀ i, orderOf (χ i) = 4) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → (∏ i, gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (p i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG179::InQω_prod.text: theorem InQω_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, InQω (f i)) : InQω (∏ i ∈ s, f i)

PAG179::InQi_prod.text: theorem InQi_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, InQi (f i)) : InQi (∏ i ∈ s, f i)

PAG179::InQω_conj.text: theorem InQω_conj {y : ℂ} (h : InQω y) : InQω ((starRingEnd ℂ) y)

PAG179::InQi_conj.text: theorem InQi_conj {y : ℂ} (h : InQi y) : InQi ((starRingEnd ℂ) y)

PAG179::conj_prod_inv.text:
theorem conj_prod_inv {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, (starRingEnd ℂ) (f i) = (f i)⁻¹) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = (∏ i ∈ s, f i)⁻¹

PAG179::z6_facts.text:
theorem z6_facts (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h3 : orderOf χ = 3) :
    InQω ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 6) ∧
      (starRingEnd ℂ) ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 6)
        = ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 6)⁻¹

PAG179::z4_facts.text:
theorem z4_facts (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h4 : orderOf ψ = 4) :
    InQi ((gaussSum ψ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 4) ∧
      (starRingEnd ℂ) ((gaussSum ψ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 4)
        = ((gaussSum ψ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 4)⁻¹

PAG179::key_lemma.text:
theorem key_lemma (u v : ℂ) (hu : InQω u) (hv : InQi v) (hu' : (starRingEnd ℂ) u = u⁻¹)
    (hv' : (starRingEnd ℂ) v = v⁻¹) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : u ^ (2 * N) * v ^ (3 * N) = 1) :
    u ^ (4 * N) = 1 ∧ v ^ (6 * N) = 1

PAG179::split_pow.text: theorem split_pow (Zc Zq : ℂ) (N : ℕ) (hX : (Zc * Zq) ^ N = 1) : (Zc ^ 6) ^ (2 * N) * (Zq ^ 4) ^ (3 * N) = 1

PAG179::mixed_not_root_c.text:
theorem mixed_not_root_c (hnc : 0 < nc) (hinjc : Function.Injective pc) (h3p : ∀ i, pc i % 3 = 1)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (pc i)) (h3 : ∀ i, orderOf (χ i) = 3)
    (ψ : ∀ j, DirichletCharacter ℂ (pq j)) (h4 : ∀ j, orderOf (ψ j) = 4) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → ((∏ i, gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (pc i) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      * (∏ j, gaussSum (ψ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (pq j) : ℝ) : ℂ))) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG179::mixed_not_root_q.text:
theorem mixed_not_root_q (hnq : 0 < nq) (hinjq : Function.Injective pq)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (pc i)) (h3 : ∀ i, orderOf (χ i) = 3)
    (ψ : ∀ j, DirichletCharacter ℂ (pq j)) (h4 : ∀ j, orderOf (ψ j) = 4) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → ((∏ i, gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (pc i) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      * (∏ j, gaussSum (ψ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (pq j) : ℝ) : ℂ))) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG180::Rep2.text:
def Rep2 (w : ℂ) (e e' : ZMod P) : Prop :=
  ∃ C D : ℤ, w = C + D * ω ∧ ((C : ZMod P) + D * μ = e) ∧ ((C : ZMod P) + D * (-1 - μ) = e')

PAG180::Rep2_mul.text:
theorem Rep2_mul (hμ : μ ^ 2 + μ + 1 = 0) {w w' : ℂ} {e f e' f' : ZMod P}
    (h : Rep2 μ w e e') (h' : Rep2 μ w' f f') : Rep2 μ (w * w') (e * f) (e' * f')

PAG180::Rep2_pow.text:
theorem Rep2_pow (hμ : μ ^ 2 + μ + 1 = 0) {w : ℂ} {e e' : ZMod P} (h : Rep2 μ w e e') :
    ∀ m : ℕ, Rep2 μ (w ^ m) (e ^ m) (e' ^ m)
  | 0 => by simpa using Rep2_one
  | m + 1 => by rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, pow_succ]; exact Rep2_mul hμ (Rep2_pow hμ h m) h

PAG180::Rep2_prod.text:
theorem Rep2_prod (hμ : μ ^ 2 + μ + 1 = 0) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℂ) (e e' : ι → ZMod P)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, Rep2 μ (w i) (e i) (e' i)) : Rep2 μ (∏ i ∈ s, w i) (∏ i ∈ s, e i) (∏ i ∈ s, e' i)

PAG180::zpow_nonneg'.text: theorem zpow_nonneg' (x : ℂ) (k : ℤ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) : x ^ k = x ^ k.natAbs

PAG180::zpow_neg'.text: theorem zpow_neg' (x : ℂ) (k : ℤ) (hk : k < 0) : x ^ k = (x ^ k.natAbs)⁻¹

PAG180::zpow_six_comm.text: theorem zpow_six_comm (z : ℂ) (k : ℤ) : (z ^ k) ^ 6 = (z ^ 6) ^ k

PAG180::cubic_zpow_not_root.text:
theorem cubic_zpow_not_root (hinj : Function.Injective p) (h3p : ∀ i, p i % 3 = 1)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i)) (h3 : ∀ i, orderOf (χ i) = 3) (k : Fin n → ℤ) (i₀ : Fin n)
    (hk : k i₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → (∏ i, (gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (p i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ k i) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG180::cubic_zpow_root_iff.text:
theorem cubic_zpow_root_iff (hinj : Function.Injective p) (h3p : ∀ i, p i % 3 = 1)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i)) (h3 : ∀ i, orderOf (χ i) = 3) (k : Fin n → ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (∏ i, (gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (p i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ k i) ^ N = 1)
      ↔ ∀ i, k i = 0

PAG181::Rep4.text:
def Rep4 (w : ℂ) (e e' : ZMod P) : Prop :=
  ∃ C D : ℤ, w = C + D * I ∧ ((C : ZMod P) + D * μ = e) ∧ ((C : ZMod P) - D * μ = e')

PAG181::Rep4_mul.text:
theorem Rep4_mul (hμ : μ ^ 2 + 1 = 0) {w w' : ℂ} {e f e' f' : ZMod P}
    (h : Rep4 μ w e e') (h' : Rep4 μ w' f f') : Rep4 μ (w * w') (e * f) (e' * f')

PAG181::Rep4_pow.text:
theorem Rep4_pow (hμ : μ ^ 2 + 1 = 0) {w : ℂ} {e e' : ZMod P} (h : Rep4 μ w e e') :
    ∀ m : ℕ, Rep4 μ (w ^ m) (e ^ m) (e' ^ m)
  | 0 => by simpa using Rep4_one
  | m + 1 => by rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, pow_succ]; exact Rep4_mul hμ (Rep4_pow hμ h m) h

PAG181::Rep4_prod.text:
theorem Rep4_prod (hμ : μ ^ 2 + 1 = 0) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℂ) (e e' : ι → ZMod P)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, Rep4 μ (w i) (e i) (e' i)) : Rep4 μ (∏ i ∈ s, w i) (∏ i ∈ s, e i) (∏ i ∈ s, e' i)

PAG181::zpow_four_comm.text: theorem zpow_four_comm (z : ℂ) (k : ℤ) : (z ^ k) ^ 4 = (z ^ 4) ^ k

PAG181::quartic_zpow_not_root.text:
theorem quartic_zpow_not_root (hinj : Function.Injective p)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i)) (h4 : ∀ i, orderOf (χ i) = 4) (k : Fin n → ℤ) (i₀ : Fin n)
    (hk : k i₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → (∏ i, (gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (p i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ k i) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG181::quartic_zpow_root_iff.text:
theorem quartic_zpow_root_iff (hinj : Function.Injective p)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i)) (h4 : ∀ i, orderOf (χ i) = 4) (k : Fin n → ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (∏ i, (gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (p i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ k i) ^ N = 1)
      ↔ ∀ i, k i = 0

PAG181::InQω_zpow.text:
theorem InQω_zpow {u : ℂ} (hu : InQω u) (hu' : (starRingEnd ℂ) u = u⁻¹) (k : ℤ) :
    InQω (u ^ k) ∧ (starRingEnd ℂ) (u ^ k) = (u ^ k)⁻¹

PAG181::InQi_zpow.text:
theorem InQi_zpow {u : ℂ} (hu : InQi u) (hu' : (starRingEnd ℂ) u = u⁻¹) (k : ℤ) :
    InQi (u ^ k) ∧ (starRingEnd ℂ) (u ^ k) = (u ^ k)⁻¹

PAG181::mixed_zpow_root_iff.text:
theorem mixed_zpow_root_iff (hinjc : Function.Injective pc) (h3p : ∀ i, pc i % 3 = 1)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (pc i)) (h3 : ∀ i, orderOf (χ i) = 3) (k : Fin nc → ℤ)
    (hinjq : Function.Injective pq) (ψ : ∀ j, DirichletCharacter ℂ (pq j)) (h4 : ∀ j, orderOf (ψ j) = 4)
    (l : Fin nq → ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ((∏ i, (gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (pc i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ k i)
        * (∏ j, (gaussSum (ψ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (pq j) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ l j)) ^ N = 1)
      ↔ (∀ i, k i = 0) ∧ (∀ j, l j = 0)

PAG182::count_fiber.text:
open Classical in
theorem count_fiber (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (t : ZMod p) :
    ((#{x : ZMod p | x * (1 - x) = t} : ℕ) : ℤ) = quadraticChar (ZMod p) (1 - 4 * t) + 1

PAG182::jacobi_dh.text:
theorem jacobi_dh (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hχ : χ ≠ 1) :
    jacobiSum χ χ = (χ 4)⁻¹ * jacobiSum χ (Lc p)

PAG182::hasse_davenport2.text:
theorem hasse_davenport2 (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (hχ2 : χ * χ ≠ 1)
    (hχL : χ * Lc p ≠ 1) :
    gaussSum χ stdAddChar * gaussSum (χ * Lc p) stdAddChar
      = (χ 4)⁻¹ * gaussSum (χ * χ) stdAddChar * gaussSum (Lc p) stdAddChar

PAG182::Lc_mul_self.text: theorem Lc_mul_self : Lc p * Lc p = 1

PAG182::sextic_relation.text:
theorem sextic_relation (h3p : p % 3 = 1) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h3 : orderOf ψ = 3) :
    (gaussSum (ψ * Lc p) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ))
        * (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 2 = (ψ 4)⁻¹ * epsG p

PAG182::sextic_not_root.text:
theorem sextic_not_root (h3p : p % 3 = 1) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h3 : orderOf ψ = 3) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → (gaussSum (ψ * Lc p) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG182::sq_one_cases.text:
open Classical in
theorem sq_one_cases (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h : φ ^ 2 = 1) : φ = 1 ∨ φ = Lc p

PAG182::sextic_general.text:
theorem sextic_general (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h6 : orderOf χ = 6) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG183::root_mul_iff.text:
theorem root_mul_iff (C Y : ℂ) (M : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (hC : C ^ M = 1) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (C * Y) ^ N = 1) ↔ (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ Y ^ N = 1)

PAG183::c12.text:
theorem c12 (h3p : p % 3 = 1) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h3 : orderOf ψ = 3) :
    ((ψ 4)⁻¹ * epsG p) ^ 12 = 1

PAG183::sextic_zpow.text:
theorem sextic_zpow (h3p : p % 3 = 1) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h3 : orderOf ψ = 3) (b : ℤ) :
    (gaussSum (ψ * Lc p) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ b
      = ((ψ 4)⁻¹ * epsG p) ^ b * (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ (-2 * b)

PAG183::full_root_iff.text:
theorem full_root_iff (hinjc : Function.Injective pc) (h3p : ∀ i, pc i % 3 = 1)
    (ψ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (pc i)) (h3 : ∀ i, orderOf (ψ i) = 3) (a b : Fin nc → ℤ)
    (hinjq : Function.Injective pq) (φ : ∀ j, DirichletCharacter ℂ (pq j)) (h4 : ∀ j, orderOf (φ j) = 4)
    (l : Fin nq → ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ((∏ i, (gaussSum (ψ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (pc i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a i
          * (gaussSum (ψ i * Lc (pc i)) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (pc i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ b i)
        * (∏ j, (gaussSum (φ j) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (pq j) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ l j)) ^ N = 1)
      ↔ (∀ i, a i = 2 * b i) ∧ (∀ j, l j = 0)

PAG184::prod_zpow_same.text:
theorem prod_zpow_same {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (x : ℂ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (w : ι → ℤ) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, x ^ w i = x ^ (∑ i ∈ s, w i)

PAG184::zOf.text: noncomputable def zOf (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) : ℂ := gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)

PAG184::zOf_ne_zero.text: theorem zOf_ne_zero (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (hχ : χ ≠ 1) : zOf χ ≠ 0

PAG184::chiOf.text:
noncomputable def chiOf (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) : Fin 4 → DirichletCharacter ℂ p :=
  ![ψ, ψ⁻¹, ψ * Lc p, ψ⁻¹ * Lc p]

PAG184::chiOf4.text: noncomputable def chiOf4 (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) : Fin 2 → DirichletCharacter ℂ p := ![φ, φ⁻¹]

PAG184::inv_order3.text:
omit hp in
theorem inv_order3 (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h3 : orderOf ψ = 3) : orderOf ψ⁻¹ = 3

PAG184::val_cubic.text:
theorem val_cubic (h3p : p % 3 = 1) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h3 : orderOf ψ = 3) (t : Fin 4) :
    ∃ r : ℂ, r ^ 12 = 1 ∧ zOf (chiOf ψ t) = r * zOf ψ ^ wt t

PAG184::val_quartic.text:
theorem val_quartic (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h4 : orderOf φ = 4) (t : Fin 2) :
    ∃ r : ℂ, r ^ 12 = 1 ∧ zOf (chiOf4 φ t) = r * zOf φ ^ wt4 t

PAG184::cubic_cases.text:
theorem cubic_cases (ψ φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h3 : orderOf ψ = 3) (h3' : orderOf φ = 3) :
    φ = ψ ∨ φ = ψ⁻¹

PAG184::quartic_cases.text:
theorem quartic_cases (φ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h4 : orderOf φ = 4) (h4' : orderOf χ = 4) :
    χ = φ ∨ χ = φ⁻¹

PAG184::exists_type3.text:
theorem exists_type3 (ψ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h3 : orderOf ψ = 3) (h3' : orderOf χ = 3) :
    (∃ t : Fin 4, chiOf ψ t = χ) ∧ (∃ t : Fin 4, chiOf ψ t = χ * Lc p)

PAG184::exists_type4.text:
theorem exists_type4 (φ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h4 : orderOf φ = 4) (h4' : orderOf χ = 4) :
    ∃ t : Fin 2, chiOf4 φ t = χ

PAG184::sextic_decomp.text:
theorem sextic_decomp (η : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h6 : orderOf η = 6) :
    orderOf (η ^ 4) = 3 ∧ η = η ^ 4 * Lc p

PAG184::exists_type6.text:
theorem exists_type6 (ψ η : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h3 : orderOf ψ = 3) (h6 : orderOf η = 6) :
    ∃ t : Fin 4, chiOf ψ t = η

PAG184::prod_owner.text:
theorem prod_owner {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (o : ι → κ) (x : κ → ℂ)
    (hx : ∀ j, x j ≠ 0) (w : ι → ℤ) :
    ∏ i, x (o i) ^ w i = ∏ j, x j ^ (∑ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => o i = j), w i)

PAG184::wsum.text:
def wsum {m : ℕ} (oc : Fin m → Fin nc) (tc : Fin m → Fin 4) (j : Fin nc) : ℤ :=
  ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => oc i = j), wt (tc i)

PAG184::wsum4.text:
def wsum4 {m : ℕ} (oq : Fin m → Fin nq) (tq : Fin m → Fin 2) (j : Fin nq) : ℤ :=
  ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => oq i = j), wt4 (tq i)

PAG184::zOf_congr.text:
theorem zOf_congr {n : ℕ} (P : Fin n → ℕ) [∀ j, Fact (P j).Prime] (χ : ∀ j, DirichletCharacter ℂ (P j))
    (f : ∀ j, DirichletCharacter ℂ (P j) → DirichletCharacter ℂ (P j)) (j j' : Fin n) (h : j = j') :
    zOf (f j (χ j)) = zOf (f j' (χ j'))

PAG184::list_root_iff.text:
theorem list_root_iff (hinjc : Function.Injective pc) (h3p : ∀ i, pc i % 3 = 1)
    (ψ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (pc i)) (h3 : ∀ i, orderOf (ψ i) = 3)
    (hinjq : Function.Injective pq) (φ : ∀ j, DirichletCharacter ℂ (pq j)) (h4 : ∀ j, orderOf (φ j) = 4)
    {m m' : ℕ} (oc : Fin m → Fin nc) (tc : Fin m → Fin 4) (oq : Fin m' → Fin nq) (tq : Fin m' → Fin 2) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ((∏ i, zOf (chiOf (ψ (oc i)) (tc i))) * ∏ k, zOf (chiOf4 (φ (oq k)) (tq k))) ^ N = 1)
      ↔ (∀ j, wsum oc tc j = 0) ∧ (∀ j, wsum4 oq tq j = 0)

PAG185::sum_pow_lt.text: theorem sum_pow_lt (e : ℕ) (he : e < p - 1) : ∑ x : ZMod p, x ^ e = 0

PAG185::sum_pow_card_sub_one.text: theorem sum_pow_card_sub_one : ∑ x : ZMod p, x ^ (p - 1) = -1

PAG185::sum_pow_eq.text:
theorem sum_pow_eq (e : ℕ) (he0 : 0 < e) (he : e < 2 * (p - 1)) :
    ∑ x : ZMod p, x ^ e = if e = p - 1 then -1 else 0

PAG185::powChar.text:
noncomputable def powChar (k : ℕ) : MulChar (ZMod p) (ZMod p) :=
  MulChar.ofUnitHom (powMonoidHom k)

PAG185::powChar_apply.text: theorem powChar_apply (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (x : ZMod p) : powChar k x = x ^ k

PAG185::powChar_pow.text: theorem powChar_pow (k m : ℕ) : powChar (p := p) k ^ m = powChar (k * m)

PAG185::jacobi_powChar.text:
theorem jacobi_powChar (u v : ℕ) (hu : 0 < u) (hv : 0 < v) :
    jacobiSum (powChar (p := p) u) (powChar v) = ∑ x : ZMod p, x ^ u * (1 - x) ^ v

PAG185::sum_mul_one_sub_pow.text:
theorem sum_mul_one_sub_pow (u v : ℕ) :
    ∑ x : ZMod p, x ^ u * (1 - x) ^ v =
      ∑ m ∈ range (v + 1), (-1) ^ m * (v.choose m : ZMod p) * ∑ x : ZMod p, x ^ (u + m)

PAG185::jacobi_powChar_eq_zero.text:
theorem jacobi_powChar_eq_zero (u v : ℕ) (hu : 0 < u) (hv : 0 < v) (huv : u + v < p - 1) :
    jacobiSum (powChar (p := p) u) (powChar v) = 0

PAG185::choose_ne_zero_mod.text: theorem choose_ne_zero_mod (v j : ℕ) (hv : v < p) (hj : j ≤ v) : (v.choose j : ZMod p) ≠ 0

PAG185::jacobi_powChar_eq.text:
theorem jacobi_powChar_eq (u v : ℕ) (hu : 0 < u) (hv : 0 < v) (hu' : u < p - 1) (hv' : v < p - 1)
    (huv : p - 1 ≤ u + v) :
    jacobiSum (powChar (p := p) u) (powChar v)
      = -((-1) ^ (p - 1 - u) * (v.choose (p - 1 - u) : ZMod p))

PAG185::jacobi_powChar_ne_zero.text:
theorem jacobi_powChar_ne_zero (u v : ℕ) (hu : 0 < u) (hv : 0 < v) (hu' : u < p - 1) (hv' : v < p - 1)
    (huv : p - 1 ≤ u + v) :
    jacobiSum (powChar (p := p) u) (powChar v) ≠ 0

PAG185::exists_gen.text: theorem exists_gen : ∃ a : (ZMod p)ˣ, ∀ x : (ZMod p)ˣ, ∃ j : ℕ, a ^ j = x

PAG185::orderOf_gen.text:
theorem orderOf_gen (a : (ZMod p)ˣ) (ha : ∀ x : (ZMod p)ˣ, ∃ j : ℕ, a ^ j = x) :
    orderOf a = p - 1

PAG185::isPrimitiveRoot_gen.text:
theorem isPrimitiveRoot_gen (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (a : (ZMod p)ˣ)
    (ha : ∀ x : (ZMod p)ˣ, ∃ j : ℕ, a ^ j = x) : IsPrimitiveRoot (χ a) (orderOf χ)

PAG185::orderOf_dvd_sub_one.text: theorem orderOf_dvd_sub_one (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) : orderOf χ ∣ p - 1

PAG185::orderOf_pos_chi.text: theorem orderOf_pos_chi (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) : 0 < orderOf χ

PAG185::chiA.text:
noncomputable def chiA (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) {μ : ℂ} (hμ : IsPrimitiveRoot μ (orderOf χ)) :
    MulChar (ZMod p) (Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({μ} : Set ℂ)) where
  toFun x := ⟨χ x, by
    have : NeZero (orderOf χ) := ⟨(orderOf_pos_chi χ).ne'⟩
    exact MulChar.apply_mem_algebraAdjoin_of_pow_eq_one (pow_orderOf_eq_one χ) hμ x⟩
  map_one' := Subtype.ext (map_one χ)
  map_mul' x y := Subtype.ext (map_mul χ x y)
  map_nonunit' x hx := Subtype.ext (χ.map_nonunit hx)

PAG185::chiA_apply.text:
@[simp] theorem chiA_apply (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) {μ : ℂ} (hμ : IsPrimitiveRoot μ (orderOf χ))
    (x : ZMod p) : ((chiA χ hμ x : Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({μ} : Set ℂ)) : ℂ) = χ x

PAG185::exists_eval.text:
theorem exists_eval (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) :
    ∃ (A : Subalgebra ℤ ℂ) (χA : MulChar (ZMod p) A) (ev : A →+* ZMod p),
      A ≤ integralClosure ℤ ℂ ∧ χA.ringHomComp A.val.toRingHom = χ ∧
        χA.ringHomComp ev = powChar ((p - 1) / orderOf χ)

PAG185::sqrt_sq_cast.text:
omit hp in
theorem sqrt_sq_cast : ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 = (p : ℂ)

PAG185::pow_two_mul_of_root.text:
theorem pow_two_mul_of_root (x : ℂ) (N : ℕ) (h : (x / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = 1) :
    x ^ (2 * N) = (p : ℂ) ^ N

PAG185::ringChar_ne.text: theorem ringChar_ne : ringChar ℂ ≠ ringChar (ZMod p)

PAG185::Pj.text:
noncomputable def Pj (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∏ i ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ - 1), jacobiSum χ (χ ^ i)

PAG185::Pjbar.text:
noncomputable def Pjbar (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∏ i ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ - 1), jacobiSum (χ ^ (orderOf χ - 1)) (χ ^ (orderOf χ - i))

PAG185::inv_pow_eq.text:
omit hp in
theorem inv_pow_eq (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ orderOf χ) :
    (χ ^ i)⁻¹ = χ ^ (orderOf χ - i)

PAG185::gauss_pow_order.text:
theorem gauss_pow_order (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hn : 2 ≤ orderOf χ) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ}
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) : gaussSum χ ψ ^ orderOf χ = χ (-1) * p * Pj χ

PAG185::Pj_mul_Pjbar.text:
theorem Pj_mul_Pjbar (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hn : 3 ≤ orderOf χ) :
    Pj χ * Pjbar χ = (p : ℂ) ^ (orderOf χ - 2)

PAG185::aux_ineq.text:
theorem aux_ineq (k n i : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hi1 : 1 ≤ i) (hin : i + 2 ≤ n) :
    0 < k * (n - 1) ∧ 0 < k * (n - i) ∧ k * (n - 1) < k * n ∧ k * (n - i) < k * n ∧
      k * n ≤ k * (n - 1) + k * (n - i)

PAG185::exists_eval_Pj.text:
theorem exists_eval_Pj (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hn : 3 ≤ orderOf χ) :
    ∃ (A : Subalgebra ℤ ℂ) (ev : A →+* ZMod p) (x y : A), A ≤ integralClosure ℤ ℂ ∧
      (x : ℂ) = Pj χ ∧ (y : ℂ) = Pjbar χ ∧ ev x = 0 ∧ ev y ≠ 0

PAG185::jacobi_not_root.text:
theorem jacobi_not_root (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hn : 3 ≤ orderOf χ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (jacobiSum χ χ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG185::gauss_root_iff.text:
theorem gauss_root_iff (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (gaussSum χ ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = 1) ↔ orderOf χ = 2

PAG185::zOf_not_root.text:
theorem zOf_not_root (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (hn : 3 ≤ orderOf χ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG185::zOf_root_iff.text:
theorem zOf_root_iff (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = 1) ↔ orderOf χ = 2

PAG185::zeta_infinite.text:
theorem zeta_infinite (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (hn : 3 ≤ orderOf χ) :
    orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) = 0

PAG185::quintic_not_root.text:
theorem quintic_not_root (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (h5 : orderOf χ = 5) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG185::zOf_not_root_chain.text:
theorem zOf_not_root_chain (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (hn : 3 ≤ orderOf χ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    PAG.Part184.zOf χ ^ N ≠ 1

PAG185::zOf_root_iff_chain.text:
theorem zOf_root_iff_chain (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ PAG.Part184.zOf χ ^ N = 1) ↔ orderOf χ = 2

PAG186::Pj_mem.text: theorem Pj_mem (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hn : 3 ≤ orderOf χ) : Pj χ ∈ integralClosure ℤ ℂ

PAG186::Pjbar_mem.text: theorem Pjbar_mem (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hn : 3 ≤ orderOf χ) : Pjbar χ ∈ integralClosure ℤ ℂ

PAG186::exists_prime_over.text:
theorem exists_prime_over (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hn : 3 ≤ orderOf χ) :
    ∃ Q : Ideal (integralClosure ℤ ℂ), Q.IsPrime ∧
      (⟨Pj χ, Pj_mem χ hn⟩ : integralClosure ℤ ℂ) ∈ Q ∧
      (⟨Pjbar χ, Pjbar_mem χ hn⟩ : integralClosure ℤ ℂ) ∉ Q ∧
      ((p : ℕ) : integralClosure ℤ ℂ) ∈ Q

PAG186::natPow_not_mem.text:
theorem natPow_not_mem {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (Q : Ideal B) (hQ : Q.IsPrime) {p q : ℕ}
    (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p ≠ q) (hpQ : (p : B) ∈ Q) (e : ℕ) : (q : B) ^ e ∉ Q

PAG186::z_pow_eq_div.text:
theorem z_pow_eq_div {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hn : 3 ≤ orderOf χ)
    {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    (gaussSum χ ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ (2 * orderOf χ) = Pj χ / Pjbar χ

PAG186::zpow_div_split.text:
theorem zpow_div_split (x y : ℂ) (c : ℤ) :
    (x / y) ^ c = (x ^ c.toNat * y ^ (-c).toNat) / (x ^ (-c).toNat * y ^ c.toNat)

PAG186::zpow_aux.text:
theorem zpow_aux (w : ℂ) (n q : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (N : ℕ) :
    (w ^ (2 * n)) ^ (a * N * (q : ℤ)) = (w ^ a) ^ (N * (2 * (n * q)))

PAG186::prod_mem_of_mem.text:
theorem prod_mem_of_mem {B : Type*} [CommRing B] {Q : Ideal B} (hQ : Q.IsPrime) {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → B) : (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ∈ Q ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, f i ∈ Q

PAG186::multi_not_root.text:
theorem multi_not_root (hinj : Function.Injective P) (χ : ∀ i, MulChar (ZMod (P i)) ℂ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 3 ≤ orderOf (χ i)) (ψ : ∀ i, AddChar (ZMod (P i)) ℂ) (hψ : ∀ i, (ψ i).IsPrimitive)
    (a : Fin m → ℤ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (h : (∏ i, (gaussSum (χ i) (ψ i) / ((Real.sqrt (P i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a i) ^ N = 1) : ∀ j, a j = 0

PAG186::multi_root_iff.text:
theorem multi_root_iff (hinj : Function.Injective P) (χ : ∀ i, MulChar (ZMod (P i)) ℂ)
    (hn : ∀ i, 3 ≤ orderOf (χ i)) (ψ : ∀ i, AddChar (ZMod (P i)) ℂ) (hψ : ∀ i, (ψ i).IsPrimitive)
    (a : Fin m → ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (∏ i, (gaussSum (χ i) (ψ i) / ((Real.sqrt (P i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a i) ^ N = 1)
      ↔ ∀ i, a i = 0

PAG186::multi_root_iff_std.text:
theorem multi_root_iff_std (hinj : Function.Injective P) (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (P i))
    (hn : ∀ i, 3 ≤ orderOf (χ i)) (a : Fin m → ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      (∏ i, (gaussSum (χ i) (ZMod.stdAddChar (N := P i)) / ((Real.sqrt (P i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a i) ^ N = 1)
      ↔ ∀ i, a i = 0

PAG186::multi_root_iff_chain.text:
theorem multi_root_iff_chain (hinj : Function.Injective P) (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (P i))
    (hn : ∀ i, 3 ≤ orderOf (χ i)) (a : Fin m → ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (∏ i, PAG.Part184.zOf (χ i) ^ a i) ^ N = 1) ↔ ∀ i, a i = 0

PAG187::root_pow_iff.text:
theorem root_pow_iff (x : ℂ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (x ^ k) ^ N = 1) ↔ (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ x ^ N = 1)

PAG187::orderOf_ne_zero_iff_root.text: theorem orderOf_ne_zero_iff_root (x : ℂ) : orderOf x ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ x ^ N = 1

PAG187::root_of_two_le_odd.text:
theorem root_of_two_le_odd (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = 1

PAG187::units_eight_sq.text:
omit hp in
theorem units_eight_sq (u : (ZMod (2 ^ 3))ˣ) : u ^ 2 = 1

PAG187::chi_sq_eight.text:
omit hp in
theorem chi_sq_eight (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ 3)) : χ ^ 2 = 1

PAG187::root_eight.text:
omit hp in
theorem root_eight (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ 3)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ 3) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 4 = 1

PAG187::root_of_two_le_two.text:
omit hp in
theorem root_of_two_le_two (c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = 1

PAG187::root_iff_c_one.text:
theorem root_iff_c_one (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ 1)) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = 1)
      ↔ orderOf χ = 2

PAG187::single_root_iff.text:
theorem single_root_iff (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = 1)
      ↔ (2 ≤ c ∨ orderOf χ = 2)

PAG187::single_zeta_root_iff.text:
theorem single_zeta_root_iff (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) ^ N = 1)
      ↔ (2 ≤ c ∨ orderOf χ = 2)

PAG187::single_orderOf_ne_zero_iff.text:
theorem single_orderOf_ne_zero_iff (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    orderOf ((gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ orderOf χ) ≠ 0
      ↔ (2 ≤ c ∨ orderOf χ = 2)

PAG187::root_iff_eq_L.text:
theorem root_iff_eq_L (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ PAG.Part184.zOf χ ^ N = 1) ↔ χ = PAG.Part119.Lc p

PAG188::multi_root_iff_fintype.text:
theorem multi_root_iff_fintype {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (P : ι → ℕ) [hP : ∀ i, Fact (P i).Prime]
    (hinj : Function.Injective P) (χ : ∀ i, MulChar (ZMod (P i)) ℂ) (hn : ∀ i, 3 ≤ orderOf (χ i))
    (ψ : ∀ i, AddChar (ZMod (P i)) ℂ) (hψ : ∀ i, (ψ i).IsPrimitive) (a : ι → ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (∏ i, (gaussSum (χ i) (ψ i) / ((Real.sqrt (P i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a i) ^ N = 1)
      ↔ ∀ i, a i = 0

PAG188::zpow_root.text: theorem zpow_root (x : ℂ) (k : ℤ) (h : ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ x ^ N = 1) : ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (x ^ k) ^ N = 1

PAG188::prod_root_of_root.text:
theorem prod_root_of_root {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ f i ^ N = 1) : ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ^ N = 1

PAG188::ord_ge_two.text:
theorem ord_ge_two {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : 2 ≤ orderOf χ

PAG188::prod_root_iff.text:
theorem prod_root_iff (hinj : Function.Injective P) (c : ι → ℕ) (hc : ∀ i, 1 ≤ c i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (P i ^ c i)) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive) (a : ι → ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      (∏ i, (gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((P i : ℝ) ^ c i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a i) ^ N = 1)
      ↔ ∀ i, 2 ≤ c i ∨ orderOf (χ i) = 2 ∨ a i = 0

PAG188::prod_root_iff_ones.text:
theorem prod_root_iff_ones (hinj : Function.Injective P) (c : ι → ℕ) (hc : ∀ i, 1 ≤ c i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (P i ^ c i)) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      (∏ i, gaussSum (χ i) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((P i : ℝ) ^ c i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = 1)
      ↔ ∀ i, 2 ≤ c i ∨ orderOf (χ i) = 2

PAG189::exists_padic_root.text:
theorem exists_padic_root (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hnp : (n : ZMod p) ≠ 0) (y : ZMod p)
    (hy : IsPrimitiveRoot y n) : ∃ z : ℤ_[p], IsPrimitiveRoot z n ∧ PadicInt.toZMod z = y

PAG189::exists_padic_embedding.text:
theorem exists_padic_embedding (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (c : ℕ) (hc : c.Coprime (orderOf χ)) :
    ∃ (A : Subalgebra ℤ ℂ) (χA : MulChar (ZMod p) A) (ι : A →+* ℤ_[p]),
      χA.ringHomComp A.val.toRingHom = χ ∧
        χA.ringHomComp (PadicInt.toZMod.comp ι) = powChar ((p - 1) / orderOf χ * c)

PAG189::val_of_mul_eq_p.text:
theorem val_of_mul_eq_p (x y : ℤ_[p]) (h : x * y = p) :
    x ≠ 0 ∧ x.valuation ≤ 1 ∧ (x.valuation = 1 ↔ PadicInt.toZMod x = 0)

PAG189::valuation_prod.text:
theorem valuation_prod {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (x y : κ → ℤ_[p]) (m m' : κ → ℕ)
    (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, x i ≠ 0) (hy : ∀ i ∈ s, y i ≠ 0) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, x i ^ m i * y i ^ m' i).valuation
      = ∑ i ∈ s, (m i * (x i).valuation + m' i * (y i).valuation)

PAG189::val_relation.text:
theorem val_relation {A : Subalgebra ℤ ℂ} (ι : A →+* ℤ_[p]) {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ)
    (α β : κ → A) (b : κ → ℤ) (hα : ∀ i ∈ s, ι (α i) ≠ 0) (hβ : ∀ i ∈ s, ι (β i) ≠ 0)
    (h : ∏ i ∈ s, ((α i : ℂ) / (β i : ℂ)) ^ b i = 1) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, b i * (((ι (α i)).valuation : ℤ) - (ι (β i)).valuation) = 0

PAG189::mul_mod_ne_zero.text:
omit hp in
theorem mul_mod_ne_zero (c n x : ℕ) (hc : c.Coprime n) (hx0 : 0 < x) (hxn : x < n) : c * x % n ≠ 0

PAG189::add_mod_cases.text:
omit hp in
theorem add_mod_cases (n x y : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ((x + y) % n = x % n + y % n ∧ x % n + y % n < n) ∨
      ((x + y) % n + n = x % n + y % n ∧ n ≤ x % n + y % n)

PAG189::powChar_mod.text: theorem powChar_mod (m : ℕ) : powChar (p := p) m = powChar (m % (p - 1))

PAG189::jacobi_pair.text:
theorem jacobi_pair (hval : χA.ringHomComp A.val.toRingHom = χ) (i : ℕ) (hi1 : 1 ≤ i)
    (hi2 : i + 2 ≤ orderOf χ) :
    jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i) * jacobiSum (χA ^ (orderOf χ - 1)) (χA ^ (orderOf χ - i)) = (p : A)

PAG189::val_jacobi.text:
theorem val_jacobi (hc : c.Coprime (orderOf χ)) (i : ℕ) (hi1 : 1 ≤ i) (hi2 : i + 2 ≤ orderOf χ) :
    ι (jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i)) ≠ 0 ∧
      (ι (jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i))).valuation
        = if c % orderOf χ + c * i % orderOf χ < orderOf χ then 1 else 0

PAG189::val_QA.text:
theorem val_QA (hc : c.Coprime (orderOf χ)) (j : ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j + 1 ≤ orderOf χ) :
    ι (∏ i ∈ Ico 1 j, jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i)) ≠ 0 ∧
      (orderOf χ : ℤ) * (ι (∏ i ∈ Ico 1 j, jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i))).valuation
        = ((j : ℤ) - 1) * orderOf χ - j * ((c % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ)
          + ((c * j % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ)

PAG189::val_PA.text:
theorem val_PA (hc : c.Coprime (orderOf χ)) (hn : 2 ≤ orderOf χ) :
    ι (∏ i ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ - 1), jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i)) ≠ 0 ∧
      ((ι (∏ i ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ - 1), jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i))).valuation : ℤ)
        = orderOf χ - 1 - ((c % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ)

PAG189::W_eq.text:
theorem W_eq (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hn : 2 ≤ orderOf χ) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ}
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (j : ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j < orderOf χ) :
    (gaussSum (χ ^ j) ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ (2 * orderOf χ) *
        ((p : ℂ) ^ orderOf χ * (∏ i ∈ Ico 1 j, jacobiSum χ (χ ^ i)) ^ (2 * orderOf χ))
      = ((p : ℂ) * PAG.Part185.Pj χ) ^ (2 * j)

PAG189::same_prime_necessary.text:
theorem same_prime_necessary (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (a : ℕ → ℤ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (h : (∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), (gaussSum (χ ^ j) ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a j) ^ N = 1)
    (c : ℕ) (hc : c.Coprime (orderOf χ)) :
    ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), a j * ((orderOf χ : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * j % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0

PAG189::single_power_root_iff.text:
theorem single_power_root_iff (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (j : ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j < orderOf χ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (gaussSum (χ ^ j) ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = 1) ↔ 2 * j = orderOf χ

PAG189::quintic_pair_root_iff.text:
theorem quintic_pair_root_iff (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (h5 : orderOf χ = 5) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ}
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (a b : ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ((gaussSum χ ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a *
      (gaussSum (χ ^ 2) ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ b) ^ N = 1) ↔ a = 0 ∧ b = 0

PAG189::same_prime_necessary_chain.text:
theorem same_prime_necessary_chain (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (a : ℕ → ℤ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (h : (∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), PAG.Part184.zOf (χ ^ j) ^ a j) ^ N = 1) (c : ℕ)
    (hc : c.Coprime (orderOf χ)) :
    ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), a j * ((orderOf χ : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * j % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0

PAG190::exists_lift.text:
theorem exists_lift {A : Subalgebra ℤ ℂ} (pb : PowerBasis ℤ A) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hmin : minpoly ℤ pb.gen = cyclotomic n ℤ) {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (ζ : R)
    (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n) : ∃ f : A →+* R, f pb.gen = ζ

PAG190::lift_chiA_pow.text:
theorem lift_chiA_pow (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (a : (ZMod p)ˣ) (hμ : IsPrimitiveRoot (χ a) (orderOf χ))
    (pb : PowerBasis ℤ (Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({(χ a : ℂ)} : Set ℂ))) (hgen : (pb.gen : ℂ) = χ a)
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({(χ a : ℂ)} : Set ℂ) →+* R) (j : ℕ) :
    f (PAG.Part185.chiA χ hμ ((a ^ j : (ZMod p)ˣ) : ZMod p)) = f pb.gen ^ j

PAG190::hev_of_lift.text:
theorem hev_of_lift (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (a : (ZMod p)ˣ) (ha : ∀ x : (ZMod p)ˣ, ∃ j : ℕ, a ^ j = x)
    (hμ : IsPrimitiveRoot (χ a) (orderOf χ))
    (pb : PowerBasis ℤ (Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({(χ a : ℂ)} : Set ℂ))) (hgen : (pb.gen : ℂ) = χ a)
    (ι : Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({(χ a : ℂ)} : Set ℂ) →+* ℤ_[p]) (m : ℕ)
    (hι : PadicInt.toZMod (ι pb.gen) = (a : ZMod p) ^ m) :
    (PAG.Part185.chiA χ hμ).ringHomComp (PadicInt.toZMod.comp ι) = powChar m

PAG190::hsig_of_lift.text:
theorem hsig_of_lift (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (a : (ZMod p)ˣ) (ha : ∀ x : (ZMod p)ˣ, ∃ j : ℕ, a ^ j = x)
    (hμ : IsPrimitiveRoot (χ a) (orderOf χ))
    (pb : PowerBasis ℤ (Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({(χ a : ℂ)} : Set ℂ))) (hgen : (pb.gen : ℂ) = χ a)
    (σ : Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({(χ a : ℂ)} : Set ℂ) →+* ℂ) (c : ℕ) (hσ : σ pb.gen = χ a ^ c) :
    (PAG.Part185.chiA χ hμ).ringHomComp σ = χ ^ c

PAG190::eval_repr.text:
theorem eval_repr {A : Subalgebra ℤ ℂ} (pb : PowerBasis ℤ A) {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : A →+* R)
    (y : A) : f y = ∑ i : Fin pb.dim, ((pb.basis.repr y i : ℤ) : R) * f pb.gen ^ (i : ℕ)

PAG190::vandermonde_solve.text:
theorem vandermonde_solve {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {d : ℕ} (v w : Fin d → R) :
    (vandermonde v).det • w = (vandermonde v).adjugate *ᵥ (vandermonde v *ᵥ w)

PAG190::int_dvd_of_padic.text:
theorem int_dvd_of_padic {d : ℕ} (v : Fin d → ℤ_[p]) (hv : IsUnit (vandermonde v).det) (w : Fin d → ℤ)
    (m : ℕ) (h : ∀ k, (p : ℤ_[p]) ^ m ∣ ∑ i, ((w i : ℤ) : ℤ_[p]) * v k ^ (i : ℕ)) :
    ∀ i, (p : ℤ) ^ m ∣ w i

PAG190::coord_bound.text:
theorem coord_bound {d : ℕ} (v : Fin d → ℂ) (hv : (vandermonde v).det ≠ 0) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ w : Fin d → ℂ, (∀ k, ‖(vandermonde v *ᵥ w) k‖ ≤ 1) → ∀ i, ‖w i‖ ≤ B

PAG190::finite_of_bounded.text:
theorem finite_of_bounded {A : Subalgebra ℤ ℂ} (pb : PowerBasis ℤ A) (σ : Fin pb.dim → (A →+* ℂ))
    (hv : (vandermonde (fun k => σ k pb.gen)).det ≠ 0) :
    {y : A | ∀ k, ‖σ k y‖ ≤ 1}.Finite

PAG190::root_of_norm_eq_one.text:
theorem root_of_norm_eq_one {A : Subalgebra ℤ ℂ} (pb : PowerBasis ℤ A) (σ : Fin pb.dim → (A →+* ℂ))
    (hv : (vandermonde (fun k => σ k pb.gen)).det ≠ 0) (y : A) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (hy : ∀ k, ‖σ k y‖ = 1) : ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ y ^ N = 1

PAG190::exists_nodes.text:
omit hp in
theorem exists_nodes (n d : ℕ) (hd : d = n.totient) :
    ∃ cc : Fin d → ℕ, Function.Injective cc ∧ ∀ k, cc k < n ∧ (cc k).Coprime n

PAG190::det_ne_zero_complex.text:
omit hp in
theorem det_ne_zero_complex {n d : ℕ} {μ : ℂ} (hμ : IsPrimitiveRoot μ n) (cc : Fin d → ℕ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective cc) (hlt : ∀ k, cc k < n) :
    (vandermonde (fun k => μ ^ cc k)).det ≠ 0

PAG190::det_isUnit_padic.text:
theorem det_isUnit_padic {n d : ℕ} {z : ℤ_[p]} (hz : IsPrimitiveRoot (PadicInt.toZMod z) n)
    (cc : Fin d → ℕ) (hinj : Function.Injective cc) (hlt : ∀ k, cc k < n) :
    IsUnit (vandermonde (fun k => z ^ cc k)).det

PAG190::alphaA.text:
noncomputable def alphaA (χA : MulChar (ZMod p) A) (n j : ℕ) : A :=
  ((p : A) * ∏ i ∈ Ico 1 (n - 1), jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i)) ^ (2 * j)

PAG190::betaA.text:
noncomputable def betaA (χA : MulChar (ZMod p) A) (n j : ℕ) : A :=
  (p : A) ^ n * (∏ i ∈ Ico 1 j, jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i)) ^ (2 * n)

PAG190::alphaB.text:
noncomputable def alphaB (χA : MulChar (ZMod p) A) (n j : ℕ) : A :=
  ((p : A) * ∏ i ∈ Ico 1 (n - 1), jacobiSum (χA ^ (n - 1)) (χA ^ (n - i))) ^ (2 * j)

PAG190::betaB.text:
noncomputable def betaB (χA : MulChar (ZMod p) A) (n j : ℕ) : A :=
  (p : A) ^ n * (∏ i ∈ Ico 1 j, jacobiSum (χA ^ (n - 1)) (χA ^ (n - i))) ^ (2 * n)

PAG190::prod_pair.text:
theorem prod_pair (hval : χA.ringHomComp A.val.toRingHom = χ) (m : ℕ) (hm : m + 1 ≤ orderOf χ) :
    (∏ i ∈ Ico 1 m, jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i)) *
        (∏ i ∈ Ico 1 m, jacobiSum (χA ^ (orderOf χ - 1)) (χA ^ (orderOf χ - i)))
      = (p : A) ^ (m - 1)

PAG190::alpha_mul_alphaB.text:
theorem alpha_mul_alphaB (hval : χA.ringHomComp A.val.toRingHom = χ) (hn : 2 ≤ orderOf χ) (j : ℕ) :
    alphaA χA (orderOf χ) j * alphaB χA (orderOf χ) j = (p : A) ^ (2 * orderOf χ * j)

PAG190::beta_mul_betaB.text:
theorem beta_mul_betaB (hval : χA.ringHomComp A.val.toRingHom = χ) (j : ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j)
    (hjn : j + 1 ≤ orderOf χ) :
    betaA χA (orderOf χ) j * betaB χA (orderOf χ) j = (p : A) ^ (2 * orderOf χ * j)

PAG190::val_alpha_beta.text:
theorem val_alpha_beta {c : ℕ} {ι : A →+* ℤ_[p]} (hval : χA.ringHomComp A.val.toRingHom = χ)
    (hev : χA.ringHomComp (PadicInt.toZMod.comp ι) = powChar ((p - 1) / orderOf χ * c))
    (hc : c.Coprime (orderOf χ)) (hn : 2 ≤ orderOf χ) (j : ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j < orderOf χ) :
    ι (alphaA χA (orderOf χ) j) ≠ 0 ∧ ι (betaA χA (orderOf χ) j) ≠ 0 ∧
      ((ι (alphaA χA (orderOf χ) j)).valuation : ℤ) - (ι (betaA χA (orderOf χ) j)).valuation
        = (orderOf χ : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * j % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ)

PAG190::prod_zpow_div.text:
theorem prod_zpow_div {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (x y : κ → ℂ) (b : κ → ℤ) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, (x i / y i) ^ b i
      = (∏ i ∈ s, x i ^ (b i).toNat * y i ^ (-b i).toNat) / ∏ i ∈ s, x i ^ (-b i).toNat * y i ^ (b i).toNat

PAG190::val_split.text:
theorem val_split {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (x y : κ → ℤ_[p]) (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, x i ≠ 0)
    (hy : ∀ i ∈ s, y i ≠ 0) (b : κ → ℤ) :
    ((∏ i ∈ s, x i ^ (b i).toNat * y i ^ (-b i).toNat).valuation : ℤ)
      - (∏ i ∈ s, x i ^ (-b i).toNat * y i ^ (b i).toNat).valuation
      = ∑ i ∈ s, b i * (((x i).valuation : ℤ) - (y i).valuation)

PAG190::norm_z.text:
theorem norm_z (φ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hφ : φ ≠ 1) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    ‖gaussSum φ ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = 1

PAG190::V_mul_Vb.text:
theorem V_mul_Vb (hval : χA.ringHomComp A.val.toRingHom = χ) (hn : 2 ≤ orderOf χ) (a : ℕ → ℤ) :
    (∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), alphaA χA (orderOf χ) j ^ (-a j).toNat * betaA χA (orderOf χ) j ^ (a j).toNat) *
      (∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), alphaB χA (orderOf χ) j ^ (-a j).toNat * betaB χA (orderOf χ) j ^ (a j).toNat)
      = (p : A) ^ (∑ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), 2 * orderOf χ * j * ((a j).toNat + (-a j).toNat))

PAG190::padic_dvd_T.text:
theorem padic_dvd_T {c : ℕ} {ι : A →+* ℤ_[p]} (hval : χA.ringHomComp A.val.toRingHom = χ)
    (hev : χA.ringHomComp (PadicInt.toZMod.comp ι) = powChar ((p - 1) / orderOf χ * c))
    (hc : c.Coprime (orderOf χ)) (hn : 2 ≤ orderOf χ) (a : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hSc : ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), a j * ((orderOf χ : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * j % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0) :
    (p : ℤ_[p]) ^ (∑ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), 2 * orderOf χ * j * ((a j).toNat + (-a j).toNat)) ∣
      ι ((∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ),
          alphaA χA (orderOf χ) j ^ (a j).toNat * betaA χA (orderOf χ) j ^ (-a j).toNat) *
        ∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ),
          alphaB χA (orderOf χ) j ^ (-a j).toNat * betaB χA (orderOf χ) j ^ (a j).toNat)

PAG190::map_alpha_eq.text:
theorem map_alpha_eq (f : A →+* ℂ) {χ' : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ} (hf : χA.ringHomComp f = χ') (n : ℕ)
    (hord : orderOf χ' = n) (hn : 2 ≤ n) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (j : ℕ)
    (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j < n) :
    f (alphaA χA n j) = (gaussSum (χ' ^ j) ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ (2 * n) * f (betaA χA n j)

PAG190::map_U_div_V.text:
theorem map_U_div_V (f : A →+* ℂ) {χ' : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ} (hf : χA.ringHomComp f = χ') (n : ℕ)
    (hord : orderOf χ' = n) (hn : 2 ≤ n) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (a : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hβ : ∀ j ∈ Ico 1 n, f (betaA χA n j) ≠ 0) :
    f (∏ j ∈ Ico 1 n, alphaA χA n j ^ (a j).toNat * betaA χA n j ^ (-a j).toNat) /
        f (∏ j ∈ Ico 1 n, alphaA χA n j ^ (-a j).toNat * betaA χA n j ^ (a j).toNat)
      = ∏ j ∈ Ico 1 n, ((gaussSum (χ' ^ j) ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ (2 * n)) ^ a j

PAG190::map_betaA_ne_zero.text:
theorem map_betaA_ne_zero (hval : χA.ringHomComp A.val.toRingHom = χ) (f : A →+* ℂ) (j : ℕ)

PAG190::same_prime_sufficient.text:
theorem same_prime_sufficient (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (a : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hS : ∀ c : ℕ, c.Coprime (orderOf χ) →
      ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), a j * ((orderOf χ : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * j % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      (∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), (gaussSum (χ ^ j) ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a j) ^ N = 1

PAG190::same_prime_root_iff.text:
theorem same_prime_root_iff (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (a : ℕ → ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      (∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), (gaussSum (χ ^ j) ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a j) ^ N = 1) ↔
      ∀ c : ℕ, c.Coprime (orderOf χ) →
        ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), a j * ((orderOf χ : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * j % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0

theorem same_prime_root_iff_chain (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (a : ℕ → ℤ) :

      ∀ c : ℕ, c.Coprime (orderOf χ) →
        ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), a j * ((orderOf χ : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * j % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0

theorem mul_pred_mod (c n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hc : c.Coprime n) : c * (n - 1) % n + c % n = n

PAG190::inverse_pair_root_iff.text:
theorem inverse_pair_root_iff (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hn : 3 ≤ orderOf χ) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ}
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (a b : ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ((gaussSum χ ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a *
      (gaussSum (χ ^ (orderOf χ - 1)) ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ b) ^ N = 1) ↔ a = b

PAG190::sextic_hd_root.text:
theorem sextic_hd_root (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (h6 : orderOf χ = 6) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ}

    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ((gaussSum χ ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) *

PAG191::val_le_of_isIntegral.text:
theorem val_le_of_isIntegral {A : Subalgebra ℤ ℂ} (ι : A →+* ℤ_[p]) (U V : A) (hU : ι U ≠ 0)
    (hV : ι V ≠ 0) (h : IsIntegral ℤ ((U : ℂ) / (V : ℂ))) : (ι V).valuation ≤ (ι U).valuation

PAG191::isIntegral_of_coprime.text:
theorem isIntegral_of_coprime (z : ℂ) (m₁ m₂ : ℤ) (hcop : IsCoprime m₁ m₂)
    (h₁ : IsIntegral ℤ ((m₁ : ℂ) * z)) (h₂ : IsIntegral ℤ ((m₂ : ℂ) * z)) : IsIntegral ℤ z

PAG191::exists_UV.text:
theorem exists_UV (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hn : 2 ≤ orderOf χ) (a : ℕ → ℤ) :
    ∃ (A : Subalgebra ℤ ℂ) (U V : A) (M : ℕ),
      (∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), (gaussSum (χ ^ j) ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a j) ^ (2 * orderOf χ)
        = (U : ℂ) / (V : ℂ) ∧
      IsIntegral ℤ ((p : ℂ) ^ M * ((U : ℂ) / (V : ℂ))) ∧
      IsIntegral ℤ ((p : ℂ) ^ M * ((V : ℂ) / (U : ℂ))) ∧ (U : ℂ) ≠ 0 ∧ (V : ℂ) ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ c : ℕ, c.Coprime (orderOf χ) → ∃ ι : A →+* ℤ_[p], ι U ≠ 0 ∧ ι V ≠ 0 ∧
        ((ι U).valuation : ℤ) - (ι V).valuation
          = ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ), a j * ((orderOf χ : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * j % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ))

PAG191::separate_core.text:
theorem separate_core {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (P : ι → ℕ) (hP : ∀ i, (P i).Prime)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn P s) (Y : ι → ℂ) (M e : ι → ℕ)
    (h1 : ∀ i ∈ s, IsIntegral ℤ ((P i : ℂ) ^ M i * Y i))
    (h2 : ∀ i ∈ s, IsIntegral ℤ ((P i : ℂ) ^ M i * (Y i)⁻¹))
    (hrel : ∏ i ∈ s, Y i ^ e i = 1) (i₀ : ι) (hi₀ : i₀ ∈ s) :
    IsIntegral ℤ (Y i₀ ^ e i₀) ∧ IsIntegral ℤ ((Y i₀ ^ e i₀)⁻¹)

PAG191::multi_same_necessary.text:
theorem multi_same_necessary (hinj : Function.Injective P) (χ : ∀ i, MulChar (ZMod (P i)) ℂ)
    (ψ : ∀ i, AddChar (ZMod (P i)) ℂ) (hψ : ∀ i, (ψ i).IsPrimitive) (a : ι → ℕ → ℤ) (N : ℕ)
    (hN : 0 < N)
    (h : (∏ i, ∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf (χ i)),
      (gaussSum (χ i ^ j) (ψ i) / ((Real.sqrt (P i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a i j) ^ N = 1)
    (i₀ : ι) (c : ℕ) (hc : c.Coprime (orderOf (χ i₀))) :
    ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf (χ i₀)),
      a i₀ j * ((orderOf (χ i₀) : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * j % orderOf (χ i₀) : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0

PAG191::multi_same_root_iff.text:
theorem multi_same_root_iff (hinj : Function.Injective P) (χ : ∀ i, MulChar (ZMod (P i)) ℂ)
    (ψ : ∀ i, AddChar (ZMod (P i)) ℂ) (hψ : ∀ i, (ψ i).IsPrimitive) (a : ι → ℕ → ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (∏ i, ∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf (χ i)),
      (gaussSum (χ i ^ j) (ψ i) / ((Real.sqrt (P i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a i j) ^ N = 1) ↔
      ∀ i, ∀ c : ℕ, c.Coprime (orderOf (χ i)) →
        ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf (χ i)), a i j * ((orderOf (χ i) : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * j % orderOf (χ i) : ℕ) : ℤ))
          = 0

PAG191::multi_same_root_iff_each.text:
theorem multi_same_root_iff_each (hinj : Function.Injective P) (χ : ∀ i, MulChar (ZMod (P i)) ℂ)
    (ψ : ∀ i, AddChar (ZMod (P i)) ℂ) (hψ : ∀ i, (ψ i).IsPrimitive) (a : ι → ℕ → ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (∏ i, ∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf (χ i)),
      (gaussSum (χ i ^ j) (ψ i) / ((Real.sqrt (P i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a i j) ^ N = 1) ↔
      ∀ i, ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf (χ i)),
        (gaussSum (χ i ^ j) (ψ i) / ((Real.sqrt (P i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a i j) ^ N = 1

PAG191::full_root_iff.text:
theorem full_root_iff (hinj : Function.Injective P) (χ : ∀ i, MulChar (ZMod (P i)) ℂ)
    (ψ : ∀ i, AddChar (ZMod (P i)) ℂ) (hψ : ∀ i, (ψ i).IsPrimitive) (a : ι → ℕ → ℤ)
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (Q : κ → ℕ) [hQ : ∀ k, Fact (Q k).Prime] (e : κ → ℕ) (he : ∀ k, 2 ≤ e k)
    (φ : ∀ k, DirichletCharacter ℂ (Q k ^ e k)) (hφ : ∀ k, (φ k).IsPrimitive) (b : κ → ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ((∏ i, ∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf (χ i)),
        (gaussSum (χ i ^ j) (ψ i) / ((Real.sqrt (P i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ a i j) *
      ∏ k, (gaussSum (φ k) ZMod.stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((Q k : ℝ) ^ e k) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ b k) ^ N = 1) ↔
      ∀ i, ∀ c : ℕ, c.Coprime (orderOf (χ i)) →
        ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf (χ i)), a i j * ((orderOf (χ i) : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * j % orderOf (χ i) : ℕ) : ℤ))
          = 0

PAG192::family_root_iff.text:
theorem family_root_iff (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (f : κ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ t ∈ s, ¬ orderOf χ ∣ f t) (b : κ → ℤ) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (∏ t ∈ s, (gaussSum (χ ^ f t) ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ b t) ^ N = 1) ↔
      ∀ c : ℕ, c.Coprime (orderOf χ) →
        ∑ t ∈ s, b t * ((orderOf χ : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * f t % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0

theorem add_mul_mod_mul (r d x m : ℕ) (hr : r < d) (hm : 0 < m) :

theorem sum_affine_mod (m c q : ℕ) (hc : c.Coprime m) :

PAG192::frac_identity.text:
omit hp in
theorem frac_identity (m d k c : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hd : 0 < d) (hc : c.Coprime (m * d)) :
    ∑ a ∈ range m, c * (k + d * a) % (m * d)
      = c * (k * m) % (m * d) + ∑ a ∈ Ico 1 m, c * (d * a) % (m * d)

PAG192::hasse_davenport_root.text:
theorem hasse_davenport_root (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (m d k : ℕ) (hmd : m * d = orderOf χ) (hk : ¬ orderOf χ ∣ k * m) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      ((∏ a ∈ range m, gaussSum (χ ^ k * (χ ^ d) ^ a) ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) /
        ((gaussSum ((χ ^ k) ^ m) ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          ∏ a ∈ Ico 1 m, gaussSum ((χ ^ d) ^ a) ψ / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ))) ^ N = 1

PAG192::hasse_davenport_root_chain.text:
theorem hasse_davenport_root_chain (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (m d k : ℕ) (hmd : m * d = orderOf χ)
    (hk : ¬ orderOf χ ∣ k * m) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      ((∏ a ∈ range m, PAG.Part184.zOf (χ ^ k * (χ ^ d) ^ a)) /
        (PAG.Part184.zOf ((χ ^ k) ^ m) * ∏ a ∈ Ico 1 m, PAG.Part184.zOf ((χ ^ d) ^ a))) ^ N = 1

theorem mul_changeLevel_apply (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₁)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₂) (x : ZMod (N₁ * N₂)) :
    (χ₁.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right N₁ N₂) * χ₂.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left N₂ N₁)) x
      = χ₁ (ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right N₁ N₂) (ZMod N₁) x) *

PAG193::gaussSum_mul_coprime.text:
theorem gaussSum_mul_coprime (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₁)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₂) :
    gaussSum (χ₁.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right N₁ N₂) * χ₂.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left N₂ N₁)) stdAddChar
      = χ₁ (N₂ : ZMod N₁) * χ₂ (N₁ : ZMod N₂) * gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar

theorem chi_unit_root {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) :

PAG193::z_mul_coprime.text:
theorem z_mul_coprime (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₁)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₂) :
    gaussSum (χ₁.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right N₁ N₂) * χ₂.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left N₂ N₁)) stdAddChar
        / ((Real.sqrt ((N₁ * N₂ : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      = χ₁ (N₂ : ZMod N₁) * χ₂ (N₁ : ZMod N₂) *
        ((gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (N₁ : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          (gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (N₂ : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
      ∃ M : ℕ, 0 < M ∧ (χ₁ (N₂ : ZMod N₁) * χ₂ (N₁ : ZMod N₂)) ^ M = 1

PAG193::composite_root_iff.text:
theorem composite_root_iff (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₁)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₂) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (gaussSum (χ₁.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right N₁ N₂) *
        χ₂.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left N₂ N₁)) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((N₁ * N₂ : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N
          = 1) ↔
      ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ((gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (N₁ : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
        (gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (N₂ : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) ^ N = 1

PAG193::pq_root_iff.text:
theorem pq_root_iff {p q : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [hq : Fact q.Prime] (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (h₁ : χ₁ ≠ 1) (h₂ : χ₂ ≠ 1) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (gaussSum (χ₁.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right p q) *
        χ₂.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left q p)) stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p * q : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N
          = 1) ↔ orderOf χ₁ = 2 ∧ orderOf χ₂ = 2

PAG194::crt_apply.text:
theorem crt_apply (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (x : ZMod (N₁ * N₂)) :
    crt hcop x = (ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right N₁ N₂) (ZMod N₁) x,
      ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_left N₂ N₁) (ZMod N₂) x)

PAG194::comp₁.text:
noncomputable def comp₁ (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (N₁ * N₂)) :
    DirichletCharacter ℂ N₁ where
  toFun a := χ ((crt hcop).symm (a, 1))
  map_one' := by
    show χ ((crt hcop).symm 1) = 1
    rw [map_one, map_one]
  map_mul' a b := by
    show χ ((crt hcop).symm (a * b, 1)) = χ ((crt hcop).symm (a, 1)) * χ ((crt hcop).symm (b, 1))
    rw [show ((a * b, 1) : ZMod N₁ × ZMod N₂) = (a, 1) * (b, 1) by simp, map_mul, map_mul]
  map_nonunit' a ha := by
    apply MulChar.map_nonunit
    intro hu
    apply ha
    have := hu.map (crt hcop)
    rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
    exact (Prod.isUnit_iff.mp this).1

PAG194::comp₂.text:
noncomputable def comp₂ (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (N₁ * N₂)) :
    DirichletCharacter ℂ N₂ where
  toFun b := χ ((crt hcop).symm (1, b))
  map_one' := by
    show χ ((crt hcop).symm 1) = 1
    rw [map_one, map_one]
  map_mul' a b := by
    show χ ((crt hcop).symm (1, a * b)) = χ ((crt hcop).symm (1, a)) * χ ((crt hcop).symm (1, b))
    rw [show ((1, a * b) : ZMod N₁ × ZMod N₂) = (1, a) * (1, b) by simp, map_mul, map_mul]
  map_nonunit' b hb := by
    apply MulChar.map_nonunit
    intro hu
    apply hb
    have := hu.map (crt hcop)
    rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
    exact (Prod.isUnit_iff.mp this).2

theorem comp₁_apply (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (N₁ * N₂)) (a : ZMod N₁) :

PAG194::changeLevel_mul_split.text:
omit [NeZero N₁] [NeZero N₂] in
theorem changeLevel_mul_split {d₁ d₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : d₁ ∣ N₁) (h₂ : d₂ ∣ N₂)
    (ψ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₁) (ψ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₂) :
    DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (Nat.mul_dvd_mul h₁ h₂)
        (ψ₁.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right d₁ d₂) * ψ₂.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left d₂ d₁)) =
      (ψ₁.changeLevel h₁).changeLevel (dvd_mul_right N₁ N₂) *
        (ψ₂.changeLevel h₂).changeLevel (dvd_mul_left N₂ N₁)

PAG194::factorsThrough_mul_iff.text:
theorem factorsThrough_mul_iff (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) {d₁ d₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : d₁ ∣ N₁) (h₂ : d₂ ∣ N₂)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₁) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₂) :
    (χ₁.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right N₁ N₂) * χ₂.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left N₂ N₁)).FactorsThrough
        (d₁ * d₂) ↔ χ₁.FactorsThrough d₁ ∧ χ₂.FactorsThrough d₂

PAG194::isPrimitive_mul.text:
theorem isPrimitive_mul (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₁)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₂) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    (χ₁.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right N₁ N₂) * χ₂.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left N₂ N₁)).IsPrimitive

PAG194::isPrimitive_iff.text:
theorem isPrimitive_iff (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (N₁ * N₂)) :
    χ.IsPrimitive ↔ (comp₁ hcop χ).IsPrimitive ∧ (comp₂ hcop χ).IsPrimitive

PAG194::isIntegral_gaussSum.text:
theorem isIntegral_gaussSum {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    IsIntegral ℤ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar)

PAG194::sep_not_root.text:
theorem sep_not_root {q M : ℕ} [hq : Fact q.Prime] [NeZero M] (hqM : q.Coprime M)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hn : 3 ≤ orderOf χ₁) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ((gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      (gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (M : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) ^ N ≠ 1

PAG194::peel_root_iff.text:
theorem peel_root_iff {p M : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [NeZero M] (e : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (hcop : (p ^ e).Coprime M) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ e)) (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (gaussSum (χ₁.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right (p ^ e) M) *
        χ₂.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left M (p ^ e))) stdAddChar /
          ((Real.sqrt ((p ^ e * M : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = 1) ↔
      (2 ≤ e ∨ orderOf χ₁ = 2) ∧
        ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (M : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = 1

PAG194::two_prime_power_root_iff.text:
theorem two_prime_power_root_iff {p q : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [hq : Fact q.Prime] (e f : ℕ)
    (he : 1 ≤ e) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hcop : (p ^ e).Coprime (q ^ f))
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ e * q ^ f)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p ^ e * q ^ f : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = 1) ↔
      (2 ≤ e ∨ orderOf (comp₁ hcop χ) = 2) ∧ (2 ≤ f ∨ orderOf (comp₂ hcop χ) = 2)

PAG195::RootCrit.text:
def RootCrit {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N → ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N → (χ ^ 2).FactorsThrough (N / q)

PAG195::z_level_one.text:
theorem z_level_one (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) :
    gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) = 1

PAG195::sq_mul_changeLevel.text:
theorem sq_mul_changeLevel {N₁ N₂ : ℕ} (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₁) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₂) :
    (χ₁.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right N₁ N₂) * χ₂.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left N₂ N₁)) ^ 2 =
      (χ₁ ^ 2).changeLevel (dvd_mul_right N₁ N₂) * (χ₂ ^ 2).changeLevel (dvd_mul_left N₂ N₁)

PAG195::rootCrit_mul_iff.text:
theorem rootCrit_mul_iff {p e M : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [NeZero M] (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (hcop : (p ^ e).Coprime M) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ e)) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) :
    RootCrit (χ₁.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right (p ^ e) M) * χ₂.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left M (p ^ e))) ↔
      (e = 1 → χ₁ ^ 2 = 1) ∧ RootCrit χ₂

PAG195::ne_one_of_isPrimitive.text:
theorem ne_one_of_isPrimitive {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : 2 ≤ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : χ ≠ 1

PAG195::local_cond_iff.text:
theorem local_cond_iff {p e : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (he : 1 ≤ e) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ e))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) : (2 ≤ e ∨ orderOf χ₁ = 2) ↔ (e = 1 → χ₁ ^ 2 = 1)

PAG195::general_root_iff_aux.text:
theorem general_root_iff_aux (N : ℕ) : ∀ (_ : NeZero N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N), χ.IsPrimitive →
    ((∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ K = 1) ↔
      RootCrit χ)

PAG195::general_root_iff.text:
theorem general_root_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ K = 1) ↔
      RootCrit χ

PAG195::factorsThrough_sq_iff_units.text:
theorem factorsThrough_sq_iff_units {N d : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hd : d ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    (χ ^ 2).FactorsThrough d ↔ ∀ u : (ZMod N)ˣ, ZMod.unitsMap hd u = 1 → χ u ^ 2 = 1

PAG195::general_root_iff_units.text:
theorem general_root_iff_units (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ K = 1) ↔
      ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → ∀ hq : q ∣ N, ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N →
        ∀ u : (ZMod N)ˣ, ZMod.unitsMap (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hq) u = 1 → χ u ^ 2 = 1

PAG195::squarefull_root.text:
theorem squarefull_root (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hN : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N → q ^ 2 ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ K = 1

PAG195::squarefree_root_iff.text:
theorem squarefree_root_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hN : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N → ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ K = 1) ↔
      χ ^ 2 = 1

PAG196::zN.text:
noncomputable def zN {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : ℂ :=
  gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)

PAG196::crt_unique.text:
theorem crt_unique {N A B : ℕ} [NeZero A] [NeZero B] (hAB : A * B = N) (hcop : A.Coprime B)
    (hA : A ∣ N) (hB : B ∣ N) {x y : ZMod N}
    (h₁ : ZMod.castHom hA (ZMod A) x = ZMod.castHom hA (ZMod A) y)
    (h₂ : ZMod.castHom hB (ZMod B) x = ZMod.castHom hB (ZMod B) y) : x = y

PAG196::crt_exists.text:
theorem crt_exists {N A B : ℕ} [NeZero A] [NeZero B] (hAB : A * B = N) (hcop : A.Coprime B)
    (hA : A ∣ N) (hB : B ∣ N) (a : ZMod A) (b : ZMod B) :
    ∃ x : ZMod N, ZMod.castHom hA (ZMod A) x = a ∧ ZMod.castHom hB (ZMod B) x = b

PAG196::castHom_castHom.text:
theorem castHom_castHom {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ∣ b) (hbc : b ∣ c) (hac : a ∣ c) (x : ZMod c) :
    ZMod.castHom hab (ZMod a) (ZMod.castHom hbc (ZMod b) x) = ZMod.castHom hac (ZMod a) x

PAG196::lift.text:
noncomputable def lift {N : ℕ} (A B : ℕ) [NeZero A] [NeZero B] (hAB : A * B = N)
    (hcop : A.Coprime B) (a : ZMod A) : ZMod N :=
  Classical.choose (crt_exists hAB hcop ⟨B, hAB.symm⟩ ⟨A, by rw [← hAB, mul_comm]⟩ a 1)

PAG196::lift_spec.text:
theorem lift_spec {N : ℕ} (A B : ℕ) [NeZero A] [NeZero B] (hAB : A * B = N) (hcop : A.Coprime B)
    (hA : A ∣ N) (hB : B ∣ N) (a : ZMod A) :
    ZMod.castHom hA (ZMod A) (lift A B hAB hcop a) = a ∧
      ZMod.castHom hB (ZMod B) (lift A B hAB hcop a) = 1

PAG196::eq_lift.text:
theorem eq_lift {N : ℕ} (A B : ℕ) [NeZero A] [NeZero B] (hAB : A * B = N) (hcop : A.Coprime B)
    (hA : A ∣ N) (hB : B ∣ N) (x : ZMod N) (hx : ZMod.castHom hB (ZMod B) x = 1) :
    lift A B hAB hcop (ZMod.castHom hA (ZMod A) x) = x

PAG196::hall.text:
noncomputable def hall {N : ℕ} (A B : ℕ) [NeZero A] [NeZero B] (hAB : A * B = N)
    (hcop : A.Coprime B) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : DirichletCharacter ℂ A where
  toFun a := χ (lift A B hAB hcop a)
  map_one' := by
    show χ (lift A B hAB hcop 1) = 1
    have hA : A ∣ N := ⟨B, hAB.symm⟩
    have hB : B ∣ N := ⟨A, by rw [← hAB, mul_comm]⟩
    have h1 := eq_lift A B hAB hcop hA hB 1 (map_one _)
    rw [map_one] at h1
    rw [h1, map_one]
  map_mul' a b := by
    show χ (lift A B hAB hcop (a * b)) = χ (lift A B hAB hcop a) * χ (lift A B hAB hcop b)
    have hA : A ∣ N := ⟨B, hAB.symm⟩
    have hB : B ∣ N := ⟨A, by rw [← hAB, mul_comm]⟩
    have ha := lift_spec A B hAB hcop hA hB a
    have hb := lift_spec A B hAB hcop hA hB b
    have h1 := eq_lift A B hAB hcop hA hB (lift A B hAB hcop a * lift A B hAB hcop b)
      (by rw [map_mul, ha.2, hb.2, mul_one])
    rw [map_mul, ha.1, hb.1] at h1
    rw [h1, map_mul]
  map_nonunit' a ha := by
    apply MulChar.map_nonunit
    intro hu
    apply ha
    have hA : A ∣ N := ⟨B, hAB.symm⟩
    have hB : B ∣ N := ⟨A, by rw [← hAB, mul_comm]⟩
    have := hu.map (ZMod.castHom hA (ZMod A))
    rwa [(lift_spec A B hAB hcop hA hB a).1] at this

PAG196::hall_apply.text:
theorem hall_apply {N : ℕ} (A B : ℕ) [NeZero A] [NeZero B] (hAB : A * B = N) (hcop : A.Coprime B)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (a : ZMod A) : hall A B hAB hcop χ a = χ (lift A B hAB hcop a)

PAG196::hall_spec.text:
theorem hall_spec {N : ℕ} (A B : ℕ) [NeZero A] [NeZero B] (hAB : A * B = N) (hcop : A.Coprime B)
    (hA : A ∣ N) (hB : B ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (x : ZMod N)
    (hx : ZMod.castHom hB (ZMod B) x = 1) :
    hall A B hAB hcop χ (ZMod.castHom hA (ZMod A) x) = χ x

PAG196::hall_decomp.text:
theorem hall_decomp {N : ℕ} (A B : ℕ) [NeZero A] [NeZero B] (hAB : A * B = N) (hcop : A.Coprime B)
    (hA : A ∣ N) (hB : B ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (x : ZMod N) :
    χ x = hall A B hAB hcop χ (ZMod.castHom hA (ZMod A) x) *
      hall B A ((mul_comm B A).trans hAB) hcop.symm χ (ZMod.castHom hB (ZMod B) x)

PAG196::hall_mul_eq.text:
theorem hall_mul_eq (A B : ℕ) [NeZero A] [NeZero B] (hcop : A.Coprime B)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (A * B)) :
    χ = (hall A B rfl hcop χ).changeLevel (dvd_mul_right A B) *
      (hall B A (mul_comm B A) hcop.symm χ).changeLevel (dvd_mul_left B A)

PAG196::z_hall.text:
theorem z_hall {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (A B : ℕ) [NeZero A] [NeZero B] (hAB : A * B = N)
    (hcop : A.Coprime B) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    ∃ ζ : ℂ, (∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ ζ ^ K = 1) ∧
      zN χ = ζ * (zN (hall A B hAB hcop χ) * zN (hall B A ((mul_comm B A).trans hAB) hcop.symm χ))

PAG196::hall_isPrimitive.text:
theorem hall_isPrimitive {N : ℕ} (A B : ℕ) [NeZero A] [NeZero B] (hAB : A * B = N)
    (hcop : A.Coprime B) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (hall A B hAB hcop χ).IsPrimitive

PAG196::zN_level_one.text: theorem zN_level_one {L : ℕ} [NeZero L] (hL : L = 1) (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L) : zN φ = 1

PAG196::hall_hall.text:
theorem hall_hall {N A B Q C D : ℕ} [NeZero A] [NeZero B] [NeZero Q] [NeZero C] [NeZero D]
    (hAB : A * B = N) (hcopAB : A.Coprime B) (hQC : Q * C = A) (hcopQC : Q.Coprime C)
    (hQD : Q * D = N) (hcopQD : Q.Coprime D) (hCB : C * B = D) (hcopCB : C.Coprime B)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    hall Q C hQC hcopQC (hall A B hAB hcopAB χ) = hall Q D hQD hcopQD χ

PAG196::zN_hall_congr.text:
theorem zN_hall_congr {N A A' B B' : ℕ} [NeZero A] [NeZero A'] [NeZero B] [NeZero B']
    (hA : A = A') (hB : B = B') (hAB : A * B = N) (hA'B' : A' * B' = N) (hcop : A.Coprime B)
    (hcop' : A'.Coprime B') (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    zN (hall A B hAB hcop χ) = zN (hall A' B' hA'B' hcop' χ)

PAG196::pcomp_aux.text:
theorem pcomp_aux {q N : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (h : q ∣ N ∧ ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N) :
    0 < N / q ∧ q.Coprime (N / q)

PAG196::pcomp.text:
noncomputable def pcomp (q : ℕ) [hq : Fact q.Prime] {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    DirichletCharacter ℂ q :=
  if h : q ∣ N ∧ ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N then
    haveI : NeZero (N / q) := ⟨(pcomp_aux hq.out h).1.ne'⟩
    hall q (N / q) (Nat.mul_div_cancel' h.1) (pcomp_aux hq.out h).2 χ
  else 1

PAG196::pcomp_of.text:
theorem pcomp_of (q : ℕ) [hq : Fact q.Prime] {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N)
    (h : q ∣ N ∧ ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N) [NeZero (N / q)] :
    pcomp q χ = hall q (N / q) (Nat.mul_div_cancel' h.1) (pcomp_aux hq.out h).2 χ

PAG196::exists_generator.text:
theorem exists_generator (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    ∃ ω : DirichletCharacter ℂ p, orderOf ω = p - 1 ∧
      ∀ φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p, ∃ k : ℕ, φ = ω ^ k

PAG196::isIntegral_zN_sq.text:
theorem isIntegral_zN_sq {M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (hφ : φ.IsPrimitive) :
    zN φ ≠ 0 ∧ IsIntegral ℤ ((M : ℂ) * zN φ ^ 2) ∧ IsIntegral ℤ ((M : ℂ) * (zN φ ^ 2)⁻¹)

PAG196::pcomp_sq_eq_one_iff.text:
theorem pcomp_sq_eq_one_iff (q : ℕ) [hq : Fact q.Prime] {N : ℕ} [NeZero N]
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (h : q ∣ N ∧ ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N) :
    pcomp q χ ^ 2 = 1 ↔
      ∀ u : (ZMod N)ˣ, ZMod.unitsMap (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd h.1) u = 1 → χ u ^ 2 = 1

PAG196::root_iff_pcomp.text:
theorem root_iff_pcomp {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ zN χ ^ K = 1) ↔
      ∀ (q : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime], q ∣ N → ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N → orderOf (pcomp q χ) = 2

PAG197::family_regroup.text:
theorem family_regroup {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (ω : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) {κ : Type*}
    (s : Finset κ) (k : κ → ℕ) (hk : ∀ t ∈ s, ¬ orderOf ω ∣ k t) (b : κ → ℤ) :
    ∏ t ∈ s, zN (ω ^ k t) ^ b t =
      ∏ j ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf ω), zN (ω ^ j) ^ (∑ t ∈ s with k t % orderOf ω = j, b t)

PAG197::sep_family.text:
theorem sep_family {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ)
    (φ : κ → DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (hφ : ∀ t ∈ s, φ t ≠ 1) (b : κ → ℤ) (Y : ℂ) (L : ℕ)
    (hL : p.Coprime L) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hY1 : IsIntegral ℤ ((L : ℂ) * Y ^ m))
    (hY2 : IsIntegral ℤ ((L : ℂ) * (Y ^ m)⁻¹))
    (h : ∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ ((∏ t ∈ s, zN (φ t) ^ b t) * Y) ^ K = 1) :
    ∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (∏ t ∈ s, zN (φ t) ^ b t) ^ K = 1

PAG197::isIntegral_prod.text:
theorem isIntegral_prod {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (f : κ → ℂ) (hf : ∀ t ∈ s, IsIntegral ℤ (f t)) :
    IsIntegral ℤ (∏ t ∈ s, f t)

PAG197::isIntegral_natAbs_zpow.text:
theorem isIntegral_natAbs_zpow (M : ℕ) (w : ℂ) (h1 : IsIntegral ℤ ((M : ℂ) * w))
    (h2 : IsIntegral ℤ ((M : ℂ) * w⁻¹)) (a : ℤ) : IsIntegral ℤ ((M : ℂ) ^ a.natAbs * w ^ a)

PAG197::pow_two_zpow.text: theorem pow_two_zpow (w : ℂ) (a : ℤ) : (w ^ a) ^ 2 = (w ^ 2) ^ a

PAG197::isIntegral_prod_zN.text:
theorem isIntegral_prod_zN {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (M : κ → ℕ) [∀ t, NeZero (M t)]
    (ψ : ∀ t, DirichletCharacter ℂ (M t)) (hψ : ∀ t, (ψ t).IsPrimitive) (a : κ → ℤ) :
    (∏ t ∈ s, zN (ψ t) ^ a t) ≠ 0 ∧
    IsIntegral ℤ (((∏ t ∈ s, M t ^ (a t).natAbs : ℕ) : ℂ) * (∏ t ∈ s, zN (ψ t) ^ a t) ^ 2) ∧
    IsIntegral ℤ (((∏ t ∈ s, M t ^ (a t).natAbs : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((∏ t ∈ s, zN (ψ t) ^ a t) ^ 2)⁻¹)

PAG197::pcomp_hall.text:
theorem pcomp_hall {N A B : ℕ} [NeZero A] [NeZero B] (hAB : A * B = N) (hcop : A.Coprime B)
    (q : ℕ) [hq : Fact q.Prime] (hqA : q ∣ A) (hq2A : ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ A) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    pcomp q (hall A B hAB hcop χ) = pcomp q χ

PAG197::pow_dvd_iff_of_ne.text:
theorem pow_dvd_iff_of_ne {q p e M : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hp : p.Prime) (hqp : q ≠ p) (k : ℕ) :
    q ^ k ∣ p ^ e * M ↔ q ^ k ∣ M

PAG197::LocalCrit.text:
def LocalCrit {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → ℕ) (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N i))
    (a : ι → ℤ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime], ∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧
    (∏ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => q ∣ N i ∧ ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N i), zN (pcomp q (χ i)) ^ a i) ^ K = 1

PAG197::localProd_congr.text:
theorem localProd_congr {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → ℕ) (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N i))
    (a : ι → ℤ) {q q' : ℕ} (h : q = q') [Fact q.Prime] [Fact q'.Prime] :
    ∏ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => q ∣ N i ∧ ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N i), zN (pcomp q (χ i)) ^ a i =
      ∏ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => q' ∣ N i ∧ ¬ q' ^ 2 ∣ N i), zN (pcomp q' (χ i)) ^ a i

PAG197::prod_root_iff_aux.text:
theorem prod_root_iff_aux {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → ℤ) (D : ℕ) :
    ∀ (N : ι → ℕ) (_ : ∀ i, NeZero (N i)), ∏ i, N i = D →
      ∀ (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N i)), (∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive) →
        ((∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (∏ i, zN (χ i) ^ a i) ^ K = 1) ↔ LocalCrit N χ a)

PAG197::prod_root_iff_local.text:
theorem prod_root_iff_local {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → ℕ) [hN : ∀ i, NeZero (N i)]
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N i)) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive) (a : ι → ℤ) :
    (∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (∏ i, zN (χ i) ^ a i) ^ K = 1) ↔ LocalCrit N χ a

PAG197::local_root_iff.text:
theorem local_root_iff {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (ω : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hω : orderOf ω = q - 1)
    {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (k : κ → ℕ) (hk : ∀ t ∈ s, ¬ (q - 1) ∣ k t) (b : κ → ℤ) :
    (∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (∏ t ∈ s, zN (ω ^ k t) ^ b t) ^ K = 1) ↔
      ∀ c : ℕ, c.Coprime (q - 1) →
        ∑ t ∈ s, b t * (((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * k t % (q - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0

PAG197::prod_root_iff_stickelberger.text:
theorem prod_root_iff_stickelberger {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → ℕ) [∀ i, NeZero (N i)]
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N i)) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive) (a : ι → ℤ)
    (ω : ∀ q : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hω : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → orderOf (ω q) = q - 1)
    (k : ι → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hk : ∀ (q : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime] (i : ι), q ∣ N i → ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N i → pcomp q (χ i) = ω q ^ k i q) :
    (∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (∏ i, zN (χ i) ^ a i) ^ K = 1) ↔
      ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → ∀ c : ℕ, c.Coprime (q - 1) →
        ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => q ∣ N i ∧ ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N i),
          a i * (((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * k i q % (q - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0

PAG197::exists_stickelberger_data.text:
theorem exists_stickelberger_data {ι : Type*} (N : ι → ℕ) (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N i)) :
    ∃ (ω : ∀ q : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (k : ι → ℕ → ℕ),
      (∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → orderOf (ω q) = q - 1) ∧
      (∀ (q : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime] (i : ι), pcomp q (χ i) = ω q ^ k i q)

PAG198::gs.text: noncomputable def gs {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : ℂ := if χ (-1) = 1 then 1 else I

PAG198::rs.text:
noncomputable def rs {M N : ℕ} (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : ℂ :=
  if ψ (-1) = 1 then 1 else χ (-1)

PAG198::neg_one_sq_eq.text: theorem neg_one_sq_eq {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : χ (-1) = 1 ∨ χ (-1) = -1

PAG198::gs_combine.text:
theorem gs_combine (s₁ s₂ : ℂ) (h₁ : s₁ = 1 ∨ s₁ = -1) (h₂ : s₂ = 1 ∨ s₂ = -1) :
    (if s₁ * s₂ = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else I) =
      (if s₁ = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else s₂) * (if s₁ = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else I) * (if s₂ = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else I)

PAG198::rs_combine.text:
theorem rs_combine (t s₁ s₂ : ℂ) :
    (if t = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else s₁ * s₂) = (if t = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else s₁) * (if t = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else s₂)

PAG198::real_val_gen.text:
theorem real_val_gen {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (g : (ZMod p)ˣ) (hg : ∀ x : (ZMod p)ˣ, ∃ j : ℕ, g ^ j = x)
    (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (hφ : φ ≠ 1) (h2 : φ ^ 2 = 1) : φ g = -1

PAG198::real_char_eq_Lc.text:
theorem real_char_eq_Lc {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p)
    (hφ : φ ≠ 1) (h2 : φ ^ 2 = 1) : φ = PAG.Part119.Lc p

PAG198::legendre_values.text:
theorem legendre_values {r L : ℕ} [Fact r.Prime] (hr2 : r ≠ 2) (hL : L = r)
    (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L) (hφ : φ ≠ 1) (h2 : φ ^ 2 = 1) (a : ℤ) :
    φ (a : ZMod L) = (legendreSym r a : ℂ)

PAG198::odd_base_values.text:
theorem odd_base_values {r k : ℕ} [hr : Fact r.Prime] (hr2 : r ≠ 2) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (r ^ k)) (hφ : φ.IsPrimitive) (h2 : φ ^ 2 = 1) :
    k = 1 ∧ ∀ a : ℤ, φ (a : ZMod (r ^ k)) = (legendreSym r a : ℂ)

PAG198::level_two_trivial.text: theorem level_two_trivial {L : ℕ} (hL : L = 2) (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L) : φ = 1

PAG198::mod4_values.text:
theorem mod4_values {L : ℕ} (hL : L = 4) (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L) (hφ : φ.IsPrimitive) (a : ℤ) :
    φ (a : ZMod L) = ((ZMod.χ₄ (a : ZMod 4) : ℤ) : ℂ)

PAG198::mod8_values.text:
theorem mod8_values {L : ℕ} (hL : L = 8) (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L) (hφ : φ.IsPrimitive) :
    (φ (-1) = 1 ∧ ∀ a : ℤ, φ (a : ZMod L) = ((ZMod.χ₈ (a : ZMod 8) : ℤ) : ℂ)) ∨
    (φ (-1) = -1 ∧ ∀ a : ℤ, φ (a : ZMod L) = ((ZMod.χ₈' (a : ZMod 8) : ℤ) : ℂ))

PAG198::two_base_values.text:
theorem two_base_values {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ k)) (hφ : φ.IsPrimitive)
    (h2 : φ ^ 2 = 1) :
    (k = 2 ∧ φ (-1) = -1 ∧ ∀ a : ℤ, φ (a : ZMod (2 ^ k)) = ((ZMod.χ₄ (a : ZMod 4) : ℤ) : ℂ)) ∨
    (k = 3 ∧ φ (-1) = 1 ∧ ∀ a : ℤ, φ (a : ZMod (2 ^ k)) = ((ZMod.χ₈ (a : ZMod 8) : ℤ) : ℂ)) ∨
    (k = 3 ∧ φ (-1) = -1 ∧ ∀ a : ℤ, φ (a : ZMod (2 ^ k)) = ((ZMod.χ₈' (a : ZMod 8) : ℤ) : ℂ))

PAG198::odd_prime_z.text:
theorem odd_prime_z {r L : ℕ} [hr : Fact r.Prime] [NeZero L] (hr2 : r ≠ 2) (hL : L = r)
    (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L) (hφ : φ ≠ 1) (h2 : φ ^ 2 = 1) : zN φ = gs φ

PAG198::odd_base_z.text:
theorem odd_base_z {r k : ℕ} [hr : Fact r.Prime] (hr2 : r ≠ 2) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (r ^ k)) (hφ : φ.IsPrimitive) (h2 : φ ^ 2 = 1) : zN φ = gs φ

PAG198::mod4_z.text:
theorem mod4_z {L : ℕ} [NeZero L] (hL : L = 4) (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L) (hφ : φ.IsPrimitive) :
    zN φ = gs φ

PAG198::mod8_z.text:
theorem mod8_z {L : ℕ} [NeZero L] (hL : L = 8) (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L) (hφ : φ.IsPrimitive) :
    zN φ = gs φ

PAG198::two_base_z.text:
theorem two_base_z {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ k)) (hφ : φ.IsPrimitive)
    (h2 : φ ^ 2 = 1) : zN φ = gs φ

PAG198::base_z.text:
theorem base_z {r k : ℕ} [hr : Fact r.Prime] (hk : 1 ≤ k) (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (r ^ k))
    (hφ : φ.IsPrimitive) (h2 : φ ^ 2 = 1) : zN φ = gs φ

PAG198::rs_symm_val.text:
theorem rs_symm_val (s s' : ℂ) (hs : s = 1 ∨ s = -1) (hs' : s' = 1 ∨ s' = -1) :
    (if s = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else s') = (if s' = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else s)

PAG198::leg_pm_one.text:
theorem leg_pm_one {t : ℕ} [Fact t.Prime] {a : ℤ} (ha : (a : ZMod t) ≠ 0) :
    (legendreSym t a : ℂ) = 1 ∨ (legendreSym t a : ℂ) = -1

PAG198::leg_pow.text:
theorem leg_pow {t : ℕ} [Fact t.Prime] (a : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    (legendreSym t (a ^ k) : ℂ) = (legendreSym t a : ℂ) ^ k

PAG198::two_ne_zero_zmod.text: theorem two_ne_zero_zmod {t : ℕ} [ht : Fact t.Prime] (ht2 : t ≠ 2) : ((2 : ℤ) : ZMod t) ≠ 0

PAG198::neg_one_ne_zero_zmod.text: theorem neg_one_ne_zero_zmod {t : ℕ} [ht : Fact t.Prime] : ((-1 : ℤ) : ZMod t) ≠ 0

PAG198::two_odd_rec.text:
theorem two_odd_rec {t k : ℕ} [ht : Fact t.Prime] (ht2 : t ≠ 2) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (θ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ k)) (hθ : θ.IsPrimitive) (hθ2 : θ ^ 2 = 1) :
    θ ((t : ℤ) : ZMod (2 ^ k)) * (legendreSym t ((2 : ℤ) ^ k) : ℂ) =
      (if (legendreSym t (-1) : ℂ) = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else θ (-1))

PAG198::odd_odd_rec.text:
theorem odd_odd_rec {p q : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [hq : Fact q.Prime] (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (hq2 : q ≠ 2)
    (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    (legendreSym q p : ℂ) * (legendreSym p q : ℂ) =
