      (if (legendreSym q (-1) : ℂ) = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else (legendreSym p (-1) : ℂ))

PAG198::bb_rec.text:
theorem bb_rec {p q e f : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [hq : Fact q.Prime] (hpq : p ≠ q) (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (hf : 1 ≤ f) (φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ e)) (hφ : φ.IsPrimitive) (hφ2 : φ ^ 2 = 1)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ f)) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (hψ2 : ψ ^ 2 = 1) :
    ψ ((p ^ e : ℕ) : ZMod (q ^ f)) * φ ((q ^ f : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ e)) = rs ψ φ

PAG198::castHom_neg_one.text: theorem castHom_neg_one {m n : ℕ} (h : m ∣ n) : ZMod.castHom h (ZMod m) (-1) = -1

PAG198::gauss_sign_aux.text:
theorem gauss_sign_aux (N : ℕ) : ∀ (_ : NeZero N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N), χ.IsPrimitive →
    χ ^ 2 = 1 → zN χ = gs χ ∧
      ∀ (q f : ℕ) (_ : Fact q.Prime), 1 ≤ f → q.Coprime N →
        ∀ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ f), ψ.IsPrimitive → ψ ^ 2 = 1 →
          ψ ((N : ℕ) : ZMod (q ^ f)) * χ ((q ^ f : ℕ) : ZMod N) = rs ψ χ

PAG198::gauss_sign_real.text:
theorem gauss_sign_real (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (h2 : χ ^ 2 = 1) : zN χ = gs χ

PAG198::gaussSum_real.text:
theorem gaussSum_real (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (h2 : χ ^ 2 = 1) :
    (χ (-1) = 1 → gaussSum χ stdAddChar = ((Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    (χ (-1) = -1 → gaussSum χ stdAddChar = I * ((Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ))

PAG198::real_reciprocity.text:
theorem real_reciprocity {N₁ N₂ : ℕ} [NeZero N₁] [NeZero N₂] (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₁) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N₂) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (h₁2 : χ₁ ^ 2 = 1) (h₂2 : χ₂ ^ 2 = 1) :
    χ₁ (N₂ : ZMod N₁) * χ₂ (N₁ : ZMod N₂) = rs χ₁ χ₂

PAG199::memb.text:
noncomputable def memb (u M N : ℕ) (h : u * M = N) : ZMod M →+ ZMod N :=
  ZMod.lift M ⟨(u : ZMod N) • (Int.castAddHom (ZMod N)), by
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.smul_apply, Int.castAddHom, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk,
      Int.cast_natCast, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← Nat.cast_mul, h, ZMod.natCast_self]⟩

PAG199::neZero_of_mul.text: theorem neZero_of_mul {u M N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) : NeZero M

PAG199::pos_of_mul.text: theorem pos_of_mul {u M N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) : 0 < u

PAG199::memb_apply.text:
theorem memb_apply (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (y : ZMod M) :
    memb u M N h y = ((u * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod N)

PAG199::memb_val.text:
theorem memb_val (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (y : ZMod M) :
    (memb u M N h y).val = u * y.val

PAG199::memb_injective.text: theorem memb_injective (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) : Function.Injective (memb u M N h)

PAG199::exists_memb_iff.text:
theorem exists_memb_iff (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (x : ZMod N) :
    (∃ y, memb u M N h y = x) ↔ u ∣ x.val

PAG199::gket.text:
noncomputable def gket (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M) (χ : ZMod c → ℂ) :
    ZMod N → ℂ :=
  have : NeZero M := neZero_of_mul h
  (((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    PAG.Part17.push (memb u M N h) (χ ∘ (ZMod.castHom hc (ZMod c)).toAddMonoidHom)

PAG199::gket_memb.text:
theorem gket_memb (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M) (χ : ZMod c → ℂ)
    (y : ZMod M) :
    gket u M N h c hc χ (memb u M N h y)
      = (((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ (ZMod.castHom hc (ZMod c) y)

PAG199::gket_apply.text:
theorem gket_apply (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M) (χ : ZMod c → ℂ)
    (x : ZMod N) :
    gket u M N h c hc χ x =
      if u ∣ x.val then (((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ ((x.val / u : ℕ) : ZMod c) else 0

PAG199::sz_eq_totient.text:
theorem sz_eq_totient {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (K w : ℕ) (hw : w < K) :
    PAG.Part19.sz p K w = Nat.totient (p ^ (K - w))

PAG199::memb_eq_shellEmb.text:
theorem memb_eq_shellEmb {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (K w : ℕ) (hw : w ≤ K) :
    memb (p ^ w) (p ^ (K - w)) (p ^ K) (by rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hw])
      = PAG.Part17.shellEmb (p := p) K w hw

PAG199::gket_eq_ket.text:
theorem gket_eq_ket {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (K w c : ℕ) (hwc : w + c ≤ K) (hw : w < K)
    (χ : ZMod (p ^ c) → ℂ) :
    gket (p ^ w) (p ^ (K - w)) (p ^ K) (by rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hw.le]) (p ^ c)
      (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)) χ = PAG.Part21.ket K w c hwc χ

PAG199::cmul.text:
noncomputable def cmul {c₁ c₂ : ℕ} (X₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (X₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) :
    DirichletCharacter ℂ (c₁ * c₂) :=
  X₁.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right c₁ c₂) * X₂.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left c₂ c₁)

PAG199::cmul_apply.text:
theorem cmul_apply {c₁ c₂ : ℕ} [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] (X₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁)
    (X₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (x : ZMod (c₁ * c₂)) :
    cmul X₁ X₂ x = X₁ (ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right c₁ c₂) (ZMod c₁) x) *
      X₂ (ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_left c₂ c₁) (ZMod c₂) x)

PAG199::gket_crt.text:
theorem gket_crt (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N₁) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N₂)
    (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (X₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (X₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (x : ZMod (N₁ * N₂)) :
    X₁ (u₂ : ZMod c₁) * X₂ (u₁ : ZMod c₂) *
        gket (u₁ * u₂) (M₁ * M₂) (N₁ * N₂) (by rw [← h₁, ← h₂]; ring) (c₁ * c₂) (mul_dvd_mul hc₁ hc₂)
          (cmul X₁ X₂) x
      = gket u₁ M₁ N₁ h₁ c₁ hc₁ X₁ (ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right N₁ N₂) (ZMod N₁) x) *
        gket u₂ M₂ N₂ h₂ c₂ hc₂ X₂ (ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_left N₂ N₁) (ZMod N₂) x)

PAG199::chi_natCast_ne_zero.text:
theorem chi_natCast_ne_zero {d : ℕ} (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) (n : ℕ) (hn : n.Coprime d) :
    Ψ (n : ZMod d) ≠ 0

PAG199::changeLevel_natCast.text:
theorem changeLevel_natCast {d c : ℕ} (hd : d ∣ c) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : n.Coprime c) : Ψ.changeLevel hd (n : ZMod c) = Ψ (n : ZMod d)

PAG199::gauss_ratio_mul.text:
theorem gauss_ratio_mul {c₁ c₂ d₁ d₂ : ℕ} [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] [NeZero d₁] [NeZero d₂]
    (hcop : c₁.Coprime c₂)
    (hd₁ : d₁ ∣ c₁) (hd₂ : d₂ ∣ c₂)
    (A₁ B₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (A₂ B₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂)
    (Ψ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₁) (Ψ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₂)
    (hΨ₁ : A₁ * B₁ = Ψ₁.changeLevel hd₁) (hΨ₂ : A₂ * B₂ = Ψ₂.changeLevel hd₂) :
    gaussSum (cmul A₁ A₂) stdAddChar * gaussSum (cmul B₁ B₂) stdAddChar / gaussSum (cmul Ψ₁ Ψ₂) stdAddChar
      = Ψ₁ ((c₂ / d₂ : ℕ) : ZMod d₁) * Ψ₂ ((c₁ / d₁ : ℕ) : ZMod d₂) *
        (gaussSum A₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum B₁ stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ₁ stdAddChar) *
        (gaussSum A₂ stdAddChar * gaussSum B₂ stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ₂ stdAddChar)

PAG199::tens_smul_smul.text:
theorem tens_smul_smul {G H : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H]
    (a b : ℂ) (f : G → ℂ) (g : H → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part108.tens (a • f) (b • g) = (a * b) • PAG.Part108.tens f g

PAG199::prod_eq.text:
theorem prod_eq {u₁ u₂ M₁ M₂ N₁ N₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N₁) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N₂) :
    u₁ * u₂ * (M₁ * M₂) = N₁ * N₂

PAG199::gket_crt_fun.text:
theorem gket_crt_fun (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N₁) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N₂)
    (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂) (X₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (X₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) :
    (X₁ (u₂ : ZMod c₁) * X₂ (u₁ : ZMod c₂)) •
        gket (u₁ * u₂) (M₁ * M₂) (N₁ * N₂) (prod_eq h₁ h₂) (c₁ * c₂) (mul_dvd_mul hc₁ hc₂) (cmul X₁ X₂)
      = PAG.Part108.tens (gket u₁ M₁ N₁ h₁ c₁ hc₁ X₁) (gket u₂ M₂ N₂ h₂ c₂ hc₂ X₂) ∘
          (PAG.Part194.crt hcop).toAddEquiv

PAG199::thmA_mul_aux.text:
theorem thmA_mul_aux (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N₁) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N₂)
    (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂) {u₁' u₂' M₁' M₂' d₁ d₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁' : u₁' * M₁' = N₁) (h₂' : u₂' * M₂' = N₂) (hd₁ : d₁ ∣ M₁') (hd₂ : d₂ ∣ M₂')
    (hdc₁ : d₁ ∣ c₁) (hdc₂ : d₂ ∣ c₂) (hu₁' : u₁' = u₁ * (c₁ / d₁)) (hu₂' : u₂' = u₂ * (c₂ / d₂))
    (A₁ B₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (A₂ B₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂)
    (Ψ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₁) (Ψ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₂)
    (hΨ₁ : A₁ * B₁ = Ψ₁.changeLevel hdc₁) (hΨ₂ : A₂ * B₂ = Ψ₂.changeLevel hdc₂) (l₁ l₂ : ℂ)
    (H₁ : PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₁ M₁ N₁ h₁ c₁ hc₁ A₁) (gket u₁ M₁ N₁ h₁ c₁ hc₁ B₁)
      = l₁ • gket u₁' M₁' N₁ h₁' d₁ hd₁ Ψ₁)
    (H₂ : PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₂ M₂ N₂ h₂ c₂ hc₂ A₂) (gket u₂ M₂ N₂ h₂ c₂ hc₂ B₂)
      = l₂ • gket u₂' M₂' N₂ h₂' d₂ hd₂ Ψ₂) :
    PAG.Part15.conv
        (gket (u₁ * u₂) (M₁ * M₂) (N₁ * N₂) (prod_eq h₁ h₂) (c₁ * c₂) (mul_dvd_mul hc₁ hc₂) (cmul A₁ A₂))
        (gket (u₁ * u₂) (M₁ * M₂) (N₁ * N₂) (prod_eq h₁ h₂) (c₁ * c₂) (mul_dvd_mul hc₁ hc₂) (cmul B₁ B₂))
      = (Ψ₁ ((c₂ / d₂ : ℕ) : ZMod d₁) * Ψ₂ ((c₁ / d₁ : ℕ) : ZMod d₂) * l₁ * l₂) •
        gket (u₁' * u₂') (M₁' * M₂') (N₁ * N₂) (prod_eq h₁' h₂') (d₁ * d₂) (mul_dvd_mul hd₁ hd₂)
          (cmul Ψ₁ Ψ₂)

PAG199::thmAConst.text:
noncomputable def thmAConst (N u c d : ℕ) [NeZero c] [NeZero d] (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) : ℂ :=
  ((Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ) / (Nat.totient (u * c) : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    (gaussSum A stdAddChar * gaussSum B stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar) /
      ((Real.sqrt ((c * (c / d) : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)

PAG199::thmAConst_mul.text:
theorem thmAConst_mul {N₁ N₂ u₁ u₂ M₁ M₂ c₁ c₂ d₁ d₂ : ℕ} [NeZero N₁] [NeZero N₂]
    [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] [NeZero d₁] [NeZero d₂]
    (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N₁) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N₂) (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (hdc₁ : d₁ ∣ c₁) (hdc₂ : d₂ ∣ c₂)
    (A₁ B₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (A₂ B₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂)
    (Ψ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₁) (Ψ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₂)
    (hΨ₁ : A₁ * B₁ = Ψ₁.changeLevel hdc₁) (hΨ₂ : A₂ * B₂ = Ψ₂.changeLevel hdc₂) :
    Ψ₁ ((c₂ / d₂ : ℕ) : ZMod d₁) * Ψ₂ ((c₁ / d₁ : ℕ) : ZMod d₂) * thmAConst N₁ u₁ c₁ d₁ A₁ B₁ Ψ₁ *
        thmAConst N₂ u₂ c₂ d₂ A₂ B₂ Ψ₂
      = thmAConst (N₁ * N₂) (u₁ * u₂) (c₁ * c₂) (d₁ * d₂) (cmul A₁ A₂) (cmul B₁ B₂) (cmul Ψ₁ Ψ₂)

PAG199::ThmA.text:
def ThmA (N u M c d u' M' : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] [NeZero d] (h : u * M = N) (hc : c ∣ M)
    (h' : u' * M' = N) (hd : d ∣ M')
    (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) : Prop :=
  PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc A) (gket u M N h c hc B) = thmAConst N u c d A B Ψ • gket u' M' N h' d hd Ψ

PAG199::thmA_prime_power.text:
theorem thmA_prime_power {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (K w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : χ₁ * χ₂ = ψ.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v))) :
    ThmA (p ^ K) (p ^ w) (p ^ (K - w)) (p ^ (n + 1)) (p ^ (n + 1 - v)) (p ^ (w + v)) (p ^ (K - (w + v)))
      (pow_mul_pow_sub p (by omega)) (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)) (pow_mul_pow_sub p (by omega))
      (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)) χ₁ χ₂ ψ

PAG199::thmA_mul.text:
theorem thmA_mul {N₁ N₂ u₁ u₂ M₁ M₂ c₁ c₂ d₁ d₂ u₁' u₂' M₁' M₂' : ℕ} [NeZero N₁] [NeZero N₂]
    [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] [NeZero d₁] [NeZero d₂]
    (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N₁) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N₂) (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (h₁' : u₁' * M₁' = N₁) (h₂' : u₂' * M₂' = N₂) (hd₁ : d₁ ∣ M₁') (hd₂ : d₂ ∣ M₂')
    (hdc₁ : d₁ ∣ c₁) (hdc₂ : d₂ ∣ c₂) (hu₁' : u₁' = u₁ * (c₁ / d₁)) (hu₂' : u₂' = u₂ * (c₂ / d₂))
    (A₁ B₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (A₂ B₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂)
    (Ψ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₁) (Ψ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₂)
    (hΨ₁ : A₁ * B₁ = Ψ₁.changeLevel hdc₁) (hΨ₂ : A₂ * B₂ = Ψ₂.changeLevel hdc₂)
    (H₁ : ThmA N₁ u₁ M₁ c₁ d₁ u₁' M₁' h₁ hc₁ h₁' hd₁ A₁ B₁ Ψ₁)
    (H₂ : ThmA N₂ u₂ M₂ c₂ d₂ u₂' M₂' h₂ hc₂ h₂' hd₂ A₂ B₂ Ψ₂) :
    ThmA (N₁ * N₂) (u₁ * u₂) (M₁ * M₂) (c₁ * c₂) (d₁ * d₂) (u₁' * u₂') (M₁' * M₂')
      (prod_eq h₁ h₂) (mul_dvd_mul hc₁ hc₂) (prod_eq h₁' h₂') (mul_dvd_mul hd₁ hd₂)
      (cmul A₁ A₂) (cmul B₁ B₂) (cmul Ψ₁ Ψ₂)

PAG199::thmA_two_prime.text:
theorem thmA_two_prime {p q : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [hq : Fact q.Prime] (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (K w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (L w' m v' : ℕ) (hv' : v' ≤ m) (hL : w' + (m + 1) ≤ L)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : χ₁ * χ₂ = ψ.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)))
    (η₁ η₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (m + 1))) (g₁ : η₁.IsPrimitive) (g₂ : η₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (m + 1 - v'))) (hψ' : ψ'.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod' : η₁ * η₂ = ψ'.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow q (Nat.sub_le (m + 1) v'))) :
    ThmA (p ^ K * q ^ L) (p ^ w * q ^ w') (p ^ (K - w) * q ^ (L - w')) (p ^ (n + 1) * q ^ (m + 1))
      (p ^ (n + 1 - v) * q ^ (m + 1 - v')) (p ^ (w + v) * q ^ (w' + v'))
      (p ^ (K - (w + v)) * q ^ (L - (w' + v')))
      (prod_eq (pow_mul_pow_sub p (by omega)) (pow_mul_pow_sub q (by omega)))
      (mul_dvd_mul (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)) (pow_dvd_pow q (by omega)))
      (prod_eq (pow_mul_pow_sub p (by omega)) (pow_mul_pow_sub q (by omega)))
      (mul_dvd_mul (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)) (pow_dvd_pow q (by omega)))
      (cmul χ₁ η₁) (cmul χ₂ η₂) (cmul ψ ψ')

PAG199::normSq_chi_natCast.text:
theorem normSq_chi_natCast {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) (n : ℕ) (hn : n.Coprime d) :
    Complex.normSq (Ψ (n : ZMod d)) = 1

PAG199::normSq_gket_crt.text:
theorem normSq_gket_crt {N₁ N₂ u₁ u₂ M₁ M₂ c₁ c₂ : ℕ} [NeZero N₁] [NeZero N₂]
    (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N₁) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N₂)
    (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂) (X₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (X₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq
        (gket (u₁ * u₂) (M₁ * M₂) (N₁ * N₂) (prod_eq h₁ h₂) (c₁ * c₂) (mul_dvd_mul hc₁ hc₂) (cmul X₁ X₂) x)
      = (∑ x, Complex.normSq (gket u₁ M₁ N₁ h₁ c₁ hc₁ X₁ x)) *
        ∑ x, Complex.normSq (gket u₂ M₂ N₂ h₂ c₂ hc₂ X₂ x)

PAG199::norm_gket_two_prime.text:
theorem norm_gket_two_prime {p q : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [hq : Fact q.Prime] (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (L w' m : ℕ) (hL : w' + (m + 1) ≤ L)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (η : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (m + 1))) (hη : η.IsPrimitive) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (gket (p ^ w * q ^ w') (p ^ (K - w) * q ^ (L - w')) (p ^ K * q ^ L)
      (prod_eq (pow_mul_pow_sub p (by omega)) (pow_mul_pow_sub q (by omega))) (p ^ (n + 1) * q ^ (m + 1))
      (mul_dvd_mul (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)) (pow_dvd_pow q (by omega))) (cmul χ η) x) = 1

PAG200::exists_split.text: theorem exists_split {p x : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hx : x ≠ 0) : ∃ a x₂, ¬ p ∣ x₂ ∧ x = p ^ a * x₂

PAG200::not_dvd_mul'.text: theorem not_dvd_mul' {p x y : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hx : ¬ p ∣ x) (hy : ¬ p ∣ y) : ¬ p ∣ x * y

PAG200::split_eq.text:
theorem split_eq {p a b x y : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hx : ¬ p ∣ x) (hy : ¬ p ∣ y)
    (h : p ^ a * x = p ^ b * y) : a = b ∧ x = y

PAG200::split_dvd.text:
theorem split_dvd {p a b x y : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hx : ¬ p ∣ x) (hy : ¬ p ∣ y)
    (h : p ^ a * x ∣ p ^ b * y) : a ≤ b ∧ x ∣ y

PAG200::cmul_mul_cmul.text:
theorem cmul_mul_cmul {c₁ c₂ : ℕ} (A₁ B₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (A₂ B₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) :
    cmul A₁ A₂ * cmul B₁ B₂ = cmul (A₁ * B₁) (A₂ * B₂)

PAG200::prod_split.text:
theorem prod_split {c₁ c₂ d₁ d₂ : ℕ} [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] (hcop : c₁.Coprime c₂)
    (h₁ : d₁ ∣ c₁) (h₂ : d₂ ∣ c₂)
    (A₁ B₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (A₂ B₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂)
    (Ψ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₁) (Ψ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₂) (hdc : d₁ * d₂ ∣ c₁ * c₂)
    (h : cmul A₁ A₂ * cmul B₁ B₂ = (cmul Ψ₁ Ψ₂).changeLevel hdc) :
    A₁ * B₁ = Ψ₁.changeLevel h₁ ∧ A₂ * B₂ = Ψ₂.changeLevel h₂

PAG200::chi_level_one.text: theorem chi_level_one (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) (y : ZMod 1) : χ y = 1

PAG200::thmA_one.text:
theorem thmA_one (h : 1 * 1 = 1) (hc : 1 ∣ 1) (h' : 1 * 1 = 1) (hd : 1 ∣ 1)
    (A B Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) : ThmA 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 h hc h' hd A B Ψ

PAG200::thmA_pp.text:
theorem thmA_pp {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (K w b γ δ a' b' : ℕ) (hb : w + b = K) (hab' : a' + b' = K)
    (hδ : 1 ≤ δ) (hδγ : δ ≤ γ) (hγb : γ ≤ b) (ha' : a' = w + (γ - δ))
    (h : p ^ w * p ^ b = p ^ K) (hc : p ^ γ ∣ p ^ b) (h' : p ^ a' * p ^ b' = p ^ K) (hd : p ^ δ ∣ p ^ b')
    (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ γ)) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ δ))
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : A * B = Ψ.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow p hδγ)) :
    ThmA (p ^ K) (p ^ w) (p ^ b) (p ^ γ) (p ^ δ) (p ^ a') (p ^ b') h hc h' hd A B Ψ

PAG200::thmA_general_aux.text:
theorem thmA_general_aux (N : ℕ) : ∀ (_ : NeZero N) (u M c d u' M' : ℕ) (h : u * M = N) (hc : c ∣ M)
    (hdc : d ∣ c) (h' : u' * M' = N) (hd : d ∣ M') (_ : NeZero c) (_ : NeZero d),
    u' = u * (c / d) → (∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N → q ∣ d) →
    ∀ (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d),
      A.IsPrimitive → B.IsPrimitive → Ψ.IsPrimitive → A * B = Ψ.changeLevel hdc →
      ThmA N u M c d u' M' h hc h' hd A B Ψ

PAG200::thmA_general.text:
theorem thmA_general (N u M c d u' M' : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] [NeZero d] (h : u * M = N) (hc : c ∣ M)
    (hdc : d ∣ c) (h' : u' * M' = N) (hd : d ∣ M') (hu' : u' = u * (c / d))
    (hprimes : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N → q ∣ d)
    (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive) (hprod : A * B = Ψ.changeLevel hdc) :
    ThmA N u M c d u' M' h hc h' hd A B Ψ

PAG200::normSq_thmAConst.text:
theorem normSq_thmAConst (N u c d : ℕ) [NeZero c] [NeZero d] (hdc : d ∣ c)
    (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    Complex.normSq (thmAConst N u c d A B Ψ) = (N : ℝ) / (Nat.totient (u * c) : ℝ)

PAG200::sum_normSq_gket.text:
theorem sum_normSq_gket (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero M] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : ZMod c → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (gket u M N h c hc χ x)
      = ∑ y : ZMod M, Complex.normSq
          ((((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ (ZMod.castHom hc (ZMod c) y))

PAG200::norm_gket.text:
theorem norm_gket (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero M] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ M → q ∣ c) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (gket u M N h c hc χ x) = 1

PAG200::thmA_general_norm.text:
theorem thmA_general_norm (N u M c d u' M' : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] [NeZero d] (h : u * M = N)
    (hc : c ∣ M) (hdc : d ∣ c) (h' : u' * M' = N) (hd : d ∣ M') (hu' : u' = u * (c / d))
    (hprimes : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N → q ∣ d)
    (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive) (hprod : A * B = Ψ.changeLevel hdc) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc A) (gket u M N h c hc B) x)
      = (N : ℝ) / (Nat.totient (u * c) : ℝ)

PAG201::pull.text:
noncomputable def pull {N N' : ℕ} (h : N ∣ N') (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : ZMod N' → ℂ :=
  f ∘ (ZMod.castHom h (ZMod N)).toAddMonoidHom

PAG201::pull_apply.text:
theorem pull_apply {N N' : ℕ} (h : N ∣ N') (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (x : ZMod N') :
    pull h f x = f (ZMod.castHom h (ZMod N) x)

PAG201::pull_smul.text: theorem pull_smul {N N' : ℕ} (h : N ∣ N') (a : ℂ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : pull h (a • f) = a • pull h f

PAG201::card_ker_cast.text:
theorem card_ker_cast {N N' : ℕ} [NeZero N] [NeZero N'] (h : N ∣ N') :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun z : ZMod N' => (ZMod.castHom h (ZMod N)).toAddMonoidHom z = 0)).card : ℂ)
      * N = N'

PAG201::conv_pull.text:
theorem conv_pull {N N' : ℕ} [NeZero N] [NeZero N'] (h : N ∣ N') (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (pull h f) (pull h g) = ((N' : ℂ) / N) • pull h (PAG.Part15.conv f g)

PAG201::totient_mul_of_primes.text:
theorem totient_mul_of_primes (M : ℕ) : ∀ t : ℕ, (∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ t → q ∣ M) →
    Nat.totient (M * t) = Nat.totient M * t

PAG201::totient_ratio.text:
theorem totient_ratio {c M : ℕ} (hc : c ∣ M) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ M → q ∣ c) :
    Nat.totient M * c = Nat.totient c * M

PAG201::gket_pull.text:
theorem gket_pull (u M N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : ZMod c → ℂ) :
    pull (dvd_mul_right N t) (gket u M N h c hc χ)
      = ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (M * t)) / Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        gket u (M * t) (N * t) (by rw [← h, mul_assoc]) c (hc.trans (dvd_mul_right M t)) χ

PAG201::gket_pull_same.text:
theorem gket_pull_same (u M N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : ZMod c → ℂ) (ht : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ t → q ∣ M) :
    pull (dvd_mul_right N t) (gket u M N h c hc χ)
      = ((Real.sqrt t : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        gket u (M * t) (N * t) (by rw [← h, mul_assoc]) c (hc.trans (dvd_mul_right M t)) χ

PAG201::zket.text:
noncomputable def zket (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M) (χ : ZMod c → ℂ) :
    ZMod N → ℂ :=
  ((Real.sqrt N : ℝ) : ℂ) • gket u M N h c hc χ

PAG201::hconv.text:
noncomputable def hconv {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) : ZMod N → ℂ :=
  ((N : ℂ)⁻¹) • PAG.Part15.conv f g

PAG201::zket_pull.text:
theorem zket_pull (u M N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : ZMod c → ℂ) (ht : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ t → q ∣ M) :
    pull (dvd_mul_right N t) (zket u M N h c hc χ)
      = zket u (M * t) (N * t) (by rw [← h, mul_assoc]) c (hc.trans (dvd_mul_right M t)) χ

PAG201::hconv_pull.text:
theorem hconv_pull {N N' : ℕ} [NeZero N] [NeZero N'] (h : N ∣ N') (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    hconv (pull h f) (pull h g) = pull h (hconv f g)

PAG201::zket_apply.text:
theorem zket_apply (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M) (χ : ZMod c → ℂ)
    (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ M → q ∣ c) (x : ZMod N) :
    zket u M N h c hc χ x =
      if u ∣ x.val then ((Real.sqrt ((u * c : ℕ) / (Nat.totient c : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ ((x.val / u : ℕ) : ZMod c)
      else 0

PAG201::jt.text:
noncomputable def jt (c d : ℕ) [NeZero c] [NeZero d] (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) : ℂ :=
  gaussSum A stdAddChar * gaussSum B stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar /
    ((Real.sqrt ((c * (c / d) : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)

PAG201::thmAConst_eq.text:
theorem thmAConst_eq (N u c d : ℕ) [NeZero c] [NeZero d] (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) :
    thmAConst N u c d A B Ψ = ((Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ) / (Nat.totient (u * c) : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * jt c d A B Ψ

PAG201::thmA_haar.text:
theorem thmA_haar (N u M c d u' M' : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] [NeZero d] (h : u * M = N) (hc : c ∣ M)
    (hdc : d ∣ c) (h' : u' * M' = N) (hd : d ∣ M') (hu' : u' = u * (c / d))
    (hprimes : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N → q ∣ d)
    (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive) (hprod : A * B = Ψ.changeLevel hdc) :
    hconv (zket u M N h c hc A) (zket u M N h c hc B)
      = ((((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (u * c)))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * jt c d A B Ψ) • zket u' M' N h' d hd Ψ

PAG201::norm_zket.text:
theorem norm_zket (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero M] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ M → q ∣ c) :
    (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ x, Complex.normSq (zket u M N h c hc χ x) = 1

PAG201::hconv_zket_pull.text:
theorem hconv_zket_pull (u M N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : ZMod c → ℂ) (ht : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ t → q ∣ M) :
    hconv (zket u (M * t) (N * t) (by rw [← h, mul_assoc]) c (hc.trans (dvd_mul_right M t)) χ₁)
        (zket u (M * t) (N * t) (by rw [← h, mul_assoc]) c (hc.trans (dvd_mul_right M t)) χ₂)
      = pull (dvd_mul_right N t) (hconv (zket u M N h c hc χ₁) (zket u M N h c hc χ₂))

PAG202::push_memb_apply.text:
theorem push_memb_apply (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero M] (h : u * M = N) (g : ZMod M → ℂ) (x : ZMod N) :
    PAG.Part17.push (memb u M N h) g x = if u ∣ x.val then g ((x.val / u : ℕ) : ZMod M) else 0

PAG202::dft_push_memb.text:
theorem dft_push_memb (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero M] (h : u * M = N) (g : ZMod M → ℂ) (k : ZMod N) :
    𝓕 (PAG.Part17.push (memb u M N h) g) k = 𝓕 g (ZMod.castHom (Dvd.intro_left u h) (ZMod M) k)

PAG202::dft_pull.text:
theorem dft_pull (M c : ℕ) [NeZero M] [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M) (f : ZMod c → ℂ) :
    𝓕 (fun x => f (ZMod.castHom hc (ZMod c) x))
      = ((M / c : ℕ) : ℂ) • PAG.Part17.push (memb (M / c) c M (Nat.div_mul_cancel hc)) (𝓕 f)

PAG202::dual_eq.text: theorem dual_eq {u M N c : ℕ} (h : u * M = N) (hc : c ∣ M) : M / c * (u * c) = N

PAG202::dft_gket.text:
theorem dft_gket (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ)
      = (((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (u * c)) / Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((M / c : ℕ) : ℂ)
          * χ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum χ stdAddChar) •
        gket (M / c) (u * c) N (dual_eq h hc) c (dvd_mul_left c u) (χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)

PAG202::dft_gket_unitary.text:
theorem dft_gket_unitary (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hu : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c) (hM : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ M → q ∣ c) :
    (((Real.sqrt N)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • 𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ)
      = (χ⁻¹ (-1) * (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt c : ℝ) : ℂ))) •
        gket (M / c) (u * c) N (dual_eq h hc) c (dvd_mul_left c u) (χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)

PAG202::normSq_chi_unit.text:
theorem normSq_chi_unit {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) (a : (ZMod d)ˣ) :
    Complex.normSq (Ψ a) = 1

PAG202::dft_gket_apply.text:
theorem dft_gket_apply (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (k : ZMod N) :
    𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) k =
      if M / c ∣ k.val then
        ((((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((M / c : ℕ) : ℂ) * χ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum χ stdAddChar)
          * χ⁻¹ ((k.val / (M / c) : ℕ) : ZMod c)
      else 0

PAG202::normSq_dft_gket.text:
theorem normSq_dft_gket (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (k : ZMod N)
    (hk : 𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) k ≠ 0) :
    Complex.normSq (𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) k) = ((M / c : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * c / Nat.totient M

PAG202::normSq_dft_gket'.text:
theorem normSq_dft_gket' (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hu : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c) (hM : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ M → q ∣ c) (k : ZMod N)
    (hk : 𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) k ≠ 0) :
    Complex.normSq (𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) k) = (N : ℝ) / Nat.totient (u * c)

PAG202::pow_const_iff.text:
theorem pow_const_iff (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (m : ℕ) :
    (∀ k k' : ZMod N, 𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) k ≠ 0 → 𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) k' ≠ 0 →
      (𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) k) ^ m = (𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) k') ^ m) ↔ χ ^ m = 1

PAG202::fiber_of_power_sums.text:
theorem fiber_of_power_sums {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (T : Finset α) (F : α → ℂ) (t₀ : α) (o : ℕ)
    (ho : 0 < o) (hF0 : F t₀ ≠ 0) (hpow : ∀ t ∈ T, (F t / F t₀) ^ o = 1)
    (hsum : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j < o → ∑ t ∈ T, (F t / F t₀) ^ j = 0) (ξ : ℂ) (hξ : ξ ^ o = 1) :
    o * (T.filter (fun t => F t = F t₀ * ξ)).card = T.card

PAG202::sum_pow_chi_eq_zero.text:
theorem sum_pow_chi_eq_zero (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (j : ℕ) (hj0 : 0 < j) (hjo : j < orderOf χ) :
    ∑ k : ZMod N, (if M / c ∣ k.val then (χ⁻¹ ((k.val / (M / c) : ℕ) : ZMod c)) ^ j else 0) = 0

PAG202::gket_unif.text:
theorem gket_unif (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part122.Unif (Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ZMod N => 𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) k ≠ 0))
      (fun k => 𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) k)
      (((M / c * ((1 : (ZMod c)ˣ) : ZMod c).val : ℕ) : ZMod N)) (orderOf χ)

PAG202::gket_charpoly.text:
theorem gket_charpoly (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∏ t ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ZMod N => 𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) k ≠ 0),
        (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) t))
      = (Polynomial.X ^ orderOf χ - Polynomial.C ((𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ)
          (((M / c * ((1 : (ZMod c)ˣ) : ZMod c).val : ℕ) : ZMod N))) ^ orderOf χ)) ^
        ((Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ZMod N => 𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) k ≠ 0)).card / orderOf χ)

PAG203::rk.text:
noncomputable def rk {N : ℕ} (v d : ℕ) (Ψ : ZMod d → ℂ) : ZMod N → ℂ :=
  fun x => if v ∣ x.val then Ψ ((x.val / v : ℕ) : ZMod d) else 0

PAG203::rk_eq_gket.text:
theorem rk_eq_gket (v W N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : v * W = N) (d : ℕ) (hd : d ∣ W) (Ψ : ZMod d → ℂ) :
    rk (N := N) v d Ψ = ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient W) : ℝ) : ℂ) • gket v W N h d hd Ψ

PAG203::dft_rk.text:
theorem dft_rk (v W N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : v * W = N) (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (hd : d ∣ W)
    (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive) (ξ : ZMod N) :
    𝓕 (rk (N := N) v d Ψ) ξ =
      if W / d ∣ ξ.val then
        ((W / d : ℕ) : ℂ) * Ψ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar * Ψ⁻¹ ((ξ.val / (W / d) : ℕ) : ZMod d)
      else 0

PAG203::dft_conv_gket.text:
theorem dft_conv_gket (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) (ξ : ZMod N) :
    𝓕 (PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc A) (gket u M N h c hc B)) ξ =
      if M / c ∣ ξ.val then
        ((((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((M / c : ℕ) : ℂ) * A⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum A stdAddChar) *
        ((((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((M / c : ℕ) : ℂ) * B⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum B stdAddChar) *
          (A⁻¹ ((ξ.val / (M / c) : ℕ) : ZMod c) * B⁻¹ ((ξ.val / (M / c) : ℕ) : ZMod c))
      else 0

PAG203::sum_moebius_divisors.text:
theorem sum_moebius_divisors (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ e ∈ n.divisors, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) = if n = 1 then 1 else 0

PAG203::mobius_identity.text:
theorem mobius_identity (c d : ℕ) [NeZero c] [NeZero d] (hdc : d ∣ c) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) (t : ℕ) :
    ∑ e ∈ c.divisors.filter (fun e => e.Coprime d),
        (if e ∣ t then (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * (Ψ (e : ZMod d) * Ψ ((t / e : ℕ) : ZMod d)) else 0)
      = if t.Coprime c then Ψ (t : ZMod d) else 0

PAG203::inv_mul_inv_apply.text:
theorem inv_mul_inv_apply {c d : ℕ} (hdc : d ∣ c) (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) (hprod : A * B = Ψ.changeLevel hdc) (x : ZMod c) :
    A⁻¹ x * B⁻¹ x = (Ψ⁻¹).changeLevel hdc x

PAG203::conv_general.text:
theorem conv_general (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c d : ℕ) [NeZero c] [NeZero d]
    (hc : c ∣ M) (hdc : d ∣ c) (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive) (hprod : A * B = Ψ.changeLevel hdc) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc A) (gket u M N h c hc B) =
      (((M / c : ℕ) : ℂ) / (Nat.totient M : ℂ) *
          (gaussSum A stdAddChar * gaussSum B stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar)) •
        ∑ e ∈ c.divisors.filter (fun e => e.Coprime d),
          ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * Ψ⁻¹ (e : ZMod d) / (e : ℂ)) •
            rk (N := N) (u * (c / d) / e) d Ψ

PAG203::filter_coprime_eq_one.text:
theorem filter_coprime_eq_one (c d : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ c → q ∣ d) :
    c.divisors.filter (fun e => e.Coprime d) = {1}

PAG203::conv_general_single.text:
theorem conv_general_single (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c d : ℕ) [NeZero c] [NeZero d]
    (hc : c ∣ M) (hdc : d ∣ c) (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive) (hprod : A * B = Ψ.changeLevel hdc)
    (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ c → q ∣ d) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc A) (gket u M N h c hc B) =
      (((M / c : ℕ) : ℂ) / (Nat.totient M : ℂ) *
          (gaussSum A stdAddChar * gaussSum B stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar)) •
        rk (N := N) (u * (c / d)) d Ψ

PAG203::gaussSum_level_one.text: theorem gaussSum_level_one (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) : gaussSum χ stdAddChar = 1

PAG203::thmB_general.text:
theorem thmB_general (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hA : A.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc A) (gket u M N h c hc (A⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)) =
      (A (-1) * ((M : ℂ) / (Nat.totient M : ℂ))) •
        ∑ e ∈ c.divisors, ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) / (e : ℂ)) •
          rk (N := N) (u * c / e) 1 (fun _ => 1)

PAG204::lcm_mul_lcm_dvd.text:
theorem lcm_mul_lcm_dvd {N s₁ s₂ c₁ c₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : s₁ * c₁ ∣ N) (h₂ : s₂ * c₂ ∣ N)
    (hcop₁ : (Nat.lcm s₁ s₂ / s₁).Coprime c₁) (hcop₂ : (Nat.lcm s₁ s₂ / s₂).Coprime c₂) :
    Nat.lcm s₁ s₂ * Nat.lcm c₁ c₂ ∣ N

PAG204::div_mul_aux.text: theorem div_mul_aux {s S : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hsS : s ∣ S) (t : ℕ) : S * t / s = S / s * t

PAG204::dft_conv_mixed.text:
theorem dft_conv_mixed (u₁ M₁ u₂ M₂ N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N)
    (c₁ c₂ : ℕ) [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive)
    (ξ : ZMod N) :
    𝓕 (PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₁ M₁ N h₁ c₁ hc₁ A) (gket u₂ M₂ N h₂ c₂ hc₂ B)) ξ =
      if Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) ∣ ξ.val then
        ((((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M₁))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M₂))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          (((M₁ / c₁ : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((M₂ / c₂ : ℕ) : ℂ)) * (A⁻¹ (-1) * B⁻¹ (-1)) *
          (gaussSum A stdAddChar * gaussSum B stdAddChar) *
          (A⁻¹ ((Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₁ / c₁) : ℕ) : ZMod c₁) *
            B⁻¹ ((Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ZMod c₂)) *
          (A⁻¹ ((ξ.val / Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ZMod c₁) *
            B⁻¹ ((ξ.val / Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ZMod c₂))
      else 0

PAG204::changeLevel_neg_one.text:
theorem changeLevel_neg_one {d c : ℕ} (hd : d ∣ c) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) :
    Ψ.changeLevel hd (-1) = Ψ (-1)

PAG204::inv_mul_inv_neg_one.text:
theorem inv_mul_inv_neg_one {c₁ c₂ d : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ Nat.lcm c₁ c₂)
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hprod : A.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_lcm_left c₁ c₂) * B.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_lcm_right c₁ c₂) =
      Ψ.changeLevel hdL) :
    A⁻¹ (-1) * B⁻¹ (-1) = Ψ⁻¹ (-1)

PAG204::inv_mul_inv_mixed.text:
theorem inv_mul_inv_mixed {c₁ c₂ d : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ Nat.lcm c₁ c₂)
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hprod : A.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_lcm_left c₁ c₂) * B.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_lcm_right c₁ c₂) =
      Ψ.changeLevel hdL) (t : ℕ) :
    A⁻¹ (t : ZMod c₁) * B⁻¹ (t : ZMod c₂) =
      if t.Coprime (Nat.lcm c₁ c₂) then Ψ⁻¹ (t : ZMod d) else 0

PAG204::mixed_unit_factor_eq_zero.text:
theorem mixed_unit_factor_eq_zero {c₁ c₂ : ℕ} (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂)
    (a b : ℕ) (hnc : ¬ (a.Coprime c₁ ∧ b.Coprime c₂)) : A⁻¹ (a : ZMod c₁) * B⁻¹ (b : ZMod c₂) = 0

PAG204::conv_mixed_eq_zero.text:
theorem conv_mixed_eq_zero (u₁ M₁ u₂ M₂ N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N)
    (c₁ c₂ : ℕ) [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive)
    (hnc : ¬ ((Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₁ / c₁)).Coprime c₁ ∧
      (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₂ / c₂)).Coprime c₂)) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₁ M₁ N h₁ c₁ hc₁ A) (gket u₂ M₂ N h₂ c₂ hc₂ B) = 0

PAG204::conv_mixed_ne_zero.text:
theorem conv_mixed_ne_zero (u₁ M₁ u₂ M₂ N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N)
    (c₁ c₂ : ℕ) [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive)
    (hcop₁ : (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₁ / c₁)).Coprime c₁)
    (hcop₂ : (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₂ / c₂)).Coprime c₂) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₁ M₁ N h₁ c₁ hc₁ A) (gket u₂ M₂ N h₂ c₂ hc₂ B) ≠ 0

PAG204::conv_mixed_eq_zero_iff.text:
theorem conv_mixed_eq_zero_iff (u₁ M₁ u₂ M₂ N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N)
    (c₁ c₂ : ℕ) [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₁ M₁ N h₁ c₁ hc₁ A) (gket u₂ M₂ N h₂ c₂ hc₂ B) = 0 ↔
      ¬ ((Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₁ / c₁)).Coprime c₁ ∧
        (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₂ / c₂)).Coprime c₂)

PAG204::conv_mixed.text:
theorem conv_mixed (u₁ M₁ u₂ M₂ N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N)
    (c₁ c₂ d : ℕ) [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] [NeZero d] (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (hdL : d ∣ Nat.lcm c₁ c₂)
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : A.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_lcm_left c₁ c₂) * B.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_lcm_right c₁ c₂) =
      Ψ.changeLevel hdL) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₁ M₁ N h₁ c₁ hc₁ A) (gket u₂ M₂ N h₂ c₂ hc₂ B) =
      (((Nat.gcd (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ℂ) /
          ((Real.sqrt ((Nat.totient M₁ : ℝ) * (Nat.totient M₂ : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (A⁻¹ ((Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₁ / c₁) : ℕ) : ZMod c₁) *
          B⁻¹ ((Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ZMod c₂)) *
        (gaussSum A stdAddChar * gaussSum B stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar)) •
      ∑ e ∈ (Nat.lcm c₁ c₂).divisors.filter (fun e => e.Coprime d),
        ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * Ψ⁻¹ (e : ZMod d) / (e : ℂ)) •
          rk (N := N) (N / (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) * d * e)) d Ψ

PAG204::conv_ne_dual_zero.text:
theorem conv_ne_dual_zero (u₁ M₁ u₂ M₂ N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N)
    (c₁ c₂ : ℕ) [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive)
    (hprimes : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N → q ∣ c₁ ∧ q ∣ c₂) (hne : M₁ / c₁ ≠ M₂ / c₂) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₁ M₁ N h₁ c₁ hc₁ A) (gket u₂ M₂ N h₂ c₂ hc₂ B) = 0

PAG204::conv_same_dual.text:
theorem conv_same_dual (u₁ M₁ u₂ M₂ N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N)
    (c₁ c₂ d : ℕ) [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] [NeZero d] (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (hdL : d ∣ Nat.lcm c₁ c₂)
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : A.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_lcm_left c₁ c₂) * B.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_lcm_right c₁ c₂) =
      Ψ.changeLevel hdL) (hs : M₁ / c₁ = M₂ / c₂) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₁ M₁ N h₁ c₁ hc₁ A) (gket u₂ M₂ N h₂ c₂ hc₂ B) =
      (((M₁ / c₁ : ℕ) : ℂ) / ((Real.sqrt ((Nat.totient M₁ : ℝ) * (Nat.totient M₂ : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (gaussSum A stdAddChar * gaussSum B stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar)) •
      ∑ e ∈ (Nat.lcm c₁ c₂).divisors.filter (fun e => e.Coprime d),
        ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * Ψ⁻¹ (e : ZMod d) / (e : ℂ)) •
          rk (N := N) (N / (M₁ / c₁ * d * e)) d Ψ

PAG204::conv_mixed_single.text:
theorem conv_mixed_single (u₁ M₁ u₂ M₂ N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N)
    (c₁ c₂ d : ℕ) [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] [NeZero d] (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (hdL : d ∣ Nat.lcm c₁ c₂)
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : A.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_lcm_left c₁ c₂) * B.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_lcm_right c₁ c₂) =
      Ψ.changeLevel hdL) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ Nat.lcm c₁ c₂ → q ∣ d) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₁ M₁ N h₁ c₁ hc₁ A) (gket u₂ M₂ N h₂ c₂ hc₂ B) =
      (((Nat.gcd (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ℂ) /
          ((Real.sqrt ((Nat.totient M₁ : ℝ) * (Nat.totient M₂ : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (A⁻¹ ((Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₁ / c₁) : ℕ) : ZMod c₁) *
          B⁻¹ ((Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ZMod c₂)) *
        (gaussSum A stdAddChar * gaussSum B stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar)) •
      rk (N := N) (N / (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) * d)) d Ψ

PAG204::conv_mixed_ket.text:
theorem conv_mixed_ket (u₁ M₁ u₂ M₂ N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N)
    (c₁ c₂ d : ℕ) [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] [NeZero d] (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (hdL : d ∣ Nat.lcm c₁ c₂)
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : A.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_lcm_left c₁ c₂) * B.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_lcm_right c₁ c₂) =
      Ψ.changeLevel hdL) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ Nat.lcm c₁ c₂ → q ∣ d)
    (u' : ℕ) (h' : u' * (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) * d) = N) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₁ M₁ N h₁ c₁ hc₁ A) (gket u₂ M₂ N h₂ c₂ hc₂ B) =
      (((Nat.gcd (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ℂ) *
          ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) * d)) : ℝ) : ℂ) /
          ((Real.sqrt ((Nat.totient M₁ : ℝ) * (Nat.totient M₂ : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (A⁻¹ ((Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₁ / c₁) : ℕ) : ZMod c₁) *
          B⁻¹ ((Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ZMod c₂)) *
        (gaussSum A stdAddChar * gaussSum B stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar)) •
      gket u' (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) * d) N h' d (dvd_mul_left d _) Ψ

PAG204::normSq_mixed_coef.text:
theorem normSq_mixed_coef (M₁ M₂ c₁ c₂ d : ℕ) [NeZero M₁] [NeZero M₂] [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] [NeZero d]
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hcop₁ : (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₁ / c₁)).Coprime c₁)
    (hcop₂ : (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₂ / c₂)).Coprime c₂) :
    Complex.normSq ((((Nat.gcd (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ℂ) *
          ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) * d)) : ℝ) : ℂ) /
          ((Real.sqrt ((Nat.totient M₁ : ℝ) * (Nat.totient M₂ : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (A⁻¹ ((Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₁ / c₁) : ℕ) : ZMod c₁) *
          B⁻¹ ((Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ZMod c₂)) *
        (gaussSum A stdAddChar * gaussSum B stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar))) =
      (Nat.gcd (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Nat.totient (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) * d) : ℝ) *
          ((c₁ : ℝ) * c₂) / ((Nat.totient M₁ : ℝ) * Nat.totient M₂ * d)

PAG205::dind.text: noncomputable def dind (N s : ℕ) : ZMod N → ℂ := fun ξ => if Nat.gcd N ξ.val = s then 1 else 0

PAG205::geps.text: noncomputable def geps (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] : ZMod N → ℂ := 𝓕⁻ (dind N s)

PAG205::dft_geps.text: theorem dft_geps (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] : 𝓕 (geps N s) = dind N s

PAG205::dind_mul.text: theorem dind_mul (N s s' : ℕ) : dind N s * dind N s' = if s = s' then dind N s else 0

PAG205::geps_conv_geps.text:
theorem geps_conv_geps (N s s' : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (geps N s') = if s = s' then geps N s else 0

PAG205::sum_dind.text: theorem sum_dind (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : ∑ s ∈ N.divisors, dind N s = 1

PAG205::dft_delta.text: theorem dft_delta (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : 𝓕 (Pi.single (0 : ZMod N) (1 : ℂ)) = 1

PAG205::sum_geps.text: theorem sum_geps (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : ∑ s ∈ N.divisors, geps N s = Pi.single (0 : ZMod N) (1 : ℂ)

PAG205::sum_geps_conv.text:
theorem sum_geps_conv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ s ∈ N.divisors, PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f = f

PAG205::sum_moebius_dvd.text:
theorem sum_moebius_dvd (n y : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ∑ e ∈ n.divisors, (if e ∣ y then (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) else 0) =
      if Nat.gcd n y = 1 then 1 else 0

PAG205::dft_ball.text:
theorem dft_ball (v W N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : v * W = N) (ξ : ZMod N) :
    𝓕 (rk (N := N) v 1 (fun _ => 1)) ξ = if W ∣ ξ.val then (W : ℂ) else 0

PAG205::geps_eq_balls.text:
theorem geps_eq_balls (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) :
    geps N s = ∑ e ∈ (N / s).divisors,
      ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) / ((s * e : ℕ) : ℂ)) • rk (N := N) (N / (s * e)) 1 (fun _ => 1)

PAG205::card_dsh.text:
theorem card_dsh (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun ξ : ZMod N => Nat.gcd N ξ.val = s)).card = Nat.totient (N / s)

PAG205::geps_apply_zero.text:
theorem geps_apply_zero (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) :
    geps N s 0 = (Nat.totient (N / s) : ℂ) / N

PAG205::coprime_mul_of_rad.text:
theorem coprime_mul_of_rad {u c t : ℕ} (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c) (ht : t.Coprime c) :
    t.Coprime (u * c)

PAG205::gcd_dual_iff.text:
theorem gcd_dual_iff (u M N : ℕ) (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M) (hM : M ≠ 0)
    (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c) (t : ℕ) :
    Nat.gcd N (M / c * t) = M / c ↔ t.Coprime c

PAG205::dft_gket_ne_zero_iff.text:
theorem dft_gket_ne_zero_iff (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c)
    (ξ : ZMod N) :
    𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) ξ ≠ 0 ↔ Nat.gcd N ξ.val = M / c

PAG205::dft_gket_eq_dind_mul.text:
theorem dft_gket_eq_dind_mul (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c) :
    𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) = dind N (M / c) * 𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ)

PAG205::geps_conv_gket_self.text:
theorem geps_conv_gket_self (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (M / c)) (gket u M N h c hc χ) = gket u M N h c hc χ

PAG205::geps_conv_gket_ne.text:
theorem geps_conv_gket_ne (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : s ≠ M / c) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (gket u M N h c hc χ) = 0

PAG205::geps_conv_gket_spread.text:
theorem geps_conv_gket_spread (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (q : ℕ) (hq : q.Prime) (hqu : q ∣ u)
    (hqc : ¬ q ∣ c) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (q * (M / c))) (gket u M N h c hc χ) ≠ 0

PAG205::gket_mem_iff.text:
theorem gket_mem_iff (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (M / c)) (gket u M N h c hc χ) = gket u M N h c hc χ ↔
      ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c

PAG205::conj_mul_dft_gket.text:
theorem conj_mul_dft_gket (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c)
    (ξ : ZMod N) :
    starRingEnd ℂ (𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) ξ) * 𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) ξ =
      ((((M / c : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * c / Nat.totient M : ℝ) : ℂ) * dind N (M / c) ξ

PAG205::adjoint_mul_gket.text:
theorem adjoint_mul_gket (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c)
    (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (PAG.Part30.tilde (gket u M N h c hc χ)) (PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc χ) f) =
      ((((M / c : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * c / Nat.totient M : ℝ) : ℂ) • PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (M / c)) f

PAG205::norm_conv_gket_le.text:
theorem norm_conv_gket_le (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc χ) f x) ≤
      ((M / c : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * c / Nat.totient M * ∑ x, Complex.normSq (f x)

PAG205::norm_conv_gket_eq_of_mem.text:
theorem norm_conv_gket_eq_of_mem (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c)
    (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (M / c)) f = f) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc χ) f x) =
      ((M / c : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * c / Nat.totient M * ∑ x, Complex.normSq (f x)

PAG205::conv_gket_eq_zero_of_perp.text:
theorem conv_gket_eq_zero_of_perp (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c)
    (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (M / c)) f = 0) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc χ) f = 0

PAG205::thmB_geps.text:
theorem thmB_geps (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc A) (gket u M N h c hc (A⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)) =
      (A (-1) * ((((M / c : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * c / Nat.totient M : ℝ) : ℂ)) • geps N (M / c)

PAG206::dft_pull_apply.text:
theorem dft_pull_apply (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (ξ : ZMod (N * t)) :
    𝓕 (pull (dvd_mul_right N t) f) ξ =
      if t ∣ ξ.val then (t : ℂ) * 𝓕 f ((ξ.val / t : ℕ) : ZMod N) else 0

PAG206::pull_geps.text:
theorem pull_geps (N t s : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] :
    pull (dvd_mul_right N t) (geps N s) = (t : ℂ) • geps (N * t) (t * s)

PAG206::conv_smul_left.text:
theorem conv_smul_left {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a : ℂ) (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (a • f) g = a • PAG.Part15.conv f g

PAG206::geps_conv_pull.text:
theorem geps_conv_pull (N t s : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps (N * t) (t * s)) (pull (dvd_mul_right N t) f) =
      pull (dvd_mul_right N t) (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f)

PAG206::oldP.text:
noncomputable def oldP (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (f : ZMod (N * t) → ℂ) : ZMod (N * t) → ℂ :=
  ((t : ℂ)⁻¹) • PAG.Part15.conv (rk (N := N * t) N 1 (fun _ => 1)) f

PAG206::dft_oldP.text:
theorem dft_oldP (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (f : ZMod (N * t) → ℂ) (ξ : ZMod (N * t)) :
    𝓕 (oldP N t f) ξ = if t ∣ ξ.val then 𝓕 f ξ else 0

PAG206::oldP_idem.text:
theorem oldP_idem (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (f : ZMod (N * t) → ℂ) :
    oldP N t (oldP N t f) = oldP N t f

PAG206::sum_dind_dvd.text:
theorem sum_dind_dvd (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (ξ : ZMod (N * t)) :
    ∑ s ∈ (N * t).divisors.filter (fun s => t ∣ s), dind (N * t) s ξ = if t ∣ ξ.val then 1 else 0

PAG206::sum_dind_not_dvd.text:
theorem sum_dind_not_dvd (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (ξ : ZMod (N * t)) :
    ∑ s ∈ (N * t).divisors.filter (fun s => ¬ t ∣ s), dind (N * t) s ξ = if t ∣ ξ.val then 0 else 1

PAG206::oldP_eq_sum.text:
theorem oldP_eq_sum (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (f : ZMod (N * t) → ℂ) :
    oldP N t f = ∑ s ∈ (N * t).divisors.filter (fun s => t ∣ s), PAG.Part15.conv (geps (N * t) s) f

PAG206::sub_oldP_eq_sum.text:
theorem sub_oldP_eq_sum (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (f : ZMod (N * t) → ℂ) :
    f - oldP N t f =
      ∑ s ∈ (N * t).divisors.filter (fun s => ¬ t ∣ s), PAG.Part15.conv (geps (N * t) s) f

PAG206::oldP_selfAdjoint.text:
theorem oldP_selfAdjoint (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (f g : ZMod (N * t) → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (oldP N t f x) * g x = ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (f x) * oldP N t g x

PAG206::oldP_orth.text:
theorem oldP_orth (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (f g : ZMod (N * t) → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (oldP N t f x) * (g x - oldP N t g x) = 0

PAG206::oldP_pull.text:
theorem oldP_pull (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    oldP N t (pull (dvd_mul_right N t) f) = pull (dvd_mul_right N t) f

PAG206::pull_injective.text:
theorem pull_injective (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] :
    Function.Injective (pull (N' := N * t) (dvd_mul_right N t))

PAG206::exists_pull_of_oldP.text:
theorem exists_pull_of_oldP (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (g : ZMod (N * t) → ℂ)
    (hg : oldP N t g = g) : ∃ f : ZMod N → ℂ, pull (dvd_mul_right N t) f = g

PAG206::oldP_eq_self_iff.text:
theorem oldP_eq_self_iff (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (g : ZMod (N * t) → ℂ) :
    oldP N t g = g ↔ ∃ f : ZMod N → ℂ, pull (dvd_mul_right N t) f = g

PAG206::mem_geps_pull_iff.text:
theorem mem_geps_pull_iff (N t s : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (g : ZMod (N * t) → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps (N * t) (t * s)) g = g ↔
      ∃ f : ZMod N → ℂ, PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f = f ∧ pull (dvd_mul_right N t) f = g

PAG206::sum_totient_dvd.text:
theorem sum_totient_dvd (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] :
    ∑ s ∈ (N * t).divisors.filter (fun s => t ∣ s), Nat.totient (N * t / s) = N

PAG206::sum_totient_not_dvd.text:
theorem sum_totient_not_dvd (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] :
    ∑ s ∈ (N * t).divisors.filter (fun s => ¬ t ∣ s), Nat.totient (N * t / s) + N = N * t

PAG206::oldP_gket.text:
theorem oldP_gket (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (u M' : ℕ) (h : u * M' = N * t) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c]
    (hc : c ∣ M') (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    oldP N t (gket u M' (N * t) h c hc χ) =
      (((Nat.gcd t (M' / c) : ℕ) : ℂ) / ((t : ℂ) * ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M') : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
        χ⁻¹ ((Nat.lcm t (M' / c) / (M' / c) : ℕ) : ZMod c)) •
      rk (N := N * t) (N * t / (Nat.lcm t (M' / c) * c)) c χ

PAG206::oldP_gket_eq_zero_iff.text:
theorem oldP_gket_eq_zero_iff (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (u M' : ℕ) (h : u * M' = N * t) (c : ℕ)
    [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M') (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    oldP N t (gket u M' (N * t) h c hc χ) = 0 ↔ ¬ (Nat.lcm t (M' / c) / (M' / c)).Coprime c

PAG206::oldP_gket_of_dvd.text:
theorem oldP_gket_of_dvd (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (u M' : ℕ) (h : u * M' = N * t) (c : ℕ)
    [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M') (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (ht : t ∣ M' / c) :
    oldP N t (gket u M' (N * t) h c hc χ) = gket u M' (N * t) h c hc χ

PAG206::oldP_gket_ket.text:
theorem oldP_gket_ket (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (u M' : ℕ) (h : u * M' = N * t) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c]
    (hc : c ∣ M') (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (u' : ℕ) (h' : u' * (Nat.lcm t (M' / c) * c) = N * t) :
    oldP N t (gket u M' (N * t) h c hc χ) =
      (((Nat.gcd t (M' / c) : ℕ) : ℂ) / ((t : ℂ) * ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M') : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
        χ⁻¹ ((Nat.lcm t (M' / c) / (M' / c) : ℕ) : ZMod c) *
        ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (Nat.lcm t (M' / c) * c)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
      gket u' (Nat.lcm t (M' / c) * c) (N * t) h' c (dvd_mul_left c _) χ

PAG207::Radial.text: def Radial {N : ℕ} (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : Prop := ∀ (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (x : ZMod N), f ((a : ZMod N) * x) = f x

PAG207::gcd_val_unit_mul.text:
theorem gcd_val_unit_mul (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (x : ZMod N) :
    Nat.gcd N ((a : ZMod N) * x).val = Nat.gcd N x.val

PAG207::exists_unit_mul_gcd.text:
theorem exists_unit_mul_gcd (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ξ : ZMod N) :
    ∃ a : (ZMod N)ˣ, (a : ZMod N) * ((Nat.gcd N ξ.val : ℕ) : ZMod N) = ξ

PAG207::gcd_natCast_self.text: theorem gcd_natCast_self (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) : Nat.gcd N (s : ZMod N).val = s

PAG207::dft_radial.text: theorem dft_radial {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : Radial f) : Radial (𝓕 f)

PAG207::radial_of_dft_radial.text: theorem radial_of_dft_radial {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : Radial (𝓕 f)) : Radial f

PAG207::radial_iff_dft.text: theorem radial_iff_dft {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : Radial f ↔ Radial (𝓕 f)

PAG207::dind_radial.text: theorem dind_radial (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Radial (dind N s)

PAG207::geps_radial.text: theorem geps_radial (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Radial (geps N s)

PAG207::ball_radial.text: theorem ball_radial (v N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hv : v ∣ N) : Radial (rk (N := N) v 1 (fun _ => 1))

PAG207::radial_apply_gcd.text:
theorem radial_apply_gcd {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (F : ZMod N → ℂ) (hF : Radial F) (ξ : ZMod N) :
    F ξ = F ((Nat.gcd N ξ.val : ℕ) : ZMod N)

PAG207::radial_eq_sum_geps.text:
theorem radial_eq_sum_geps {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : Radial f) :
    f = ∑ s ∈ N.divisors, (𝓕 f (s : ZMod N)) • geps N s

PAG207::radial_iff.text:
theorem radial_iff {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    Radial f ↔ ∃ c : ℕ → ℂ, f = ∑ s ∈ N.divisors, c s • geps N s

PAG207::dind_self.text: theorem dind_self (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) : dind N s (s : ZMod N) = 1

PAG207::geps_ne_zero.text: theorem geps_ne_zero (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) : geps N s ≠ 0

PAG207::geps_linearIndependent.text:
theorem geps_linearIndependent (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (fun s : N.divisors => geps N (s : ℕ))

PAG207::finrank_span_geps.text:
theorem finrank_span_geps (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (fun s : N.divisors => geps N (s : ℕ)))) =
      N.divisors.card

PAG207::radial_conv.text:
theorem radial_conv {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : Radial f) (hg : Radial g) :
    Radial (PAG.Part15.conv f g)

PAG207::gket_conv_radial.text:
theorem gket_conv_radial (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c)
    (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : Radial f) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc χ) f = (𝓕 f ((M / c : ℕ) : ZMod N)) • gket u M N h c hc χ

PAG207::dft_gket_dual_ne_zero.text:
theorem dft_gket_dual_ne_zero (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) ((M / c : ℕ) : ZMod N) ≠ 0

PAG207::gket_eigen_iff.text:
theorem gket_eigen_iff (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (∀ f : ZMod N → ℂ, Radial f → ∃ μ : ℂ, PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc χ) f = μ • gket u M N h c hc χ) ↔
      ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c

PAG207::gket_conv_ball.text:
theorem gket_conv_ball (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c)
    (v W : ℕ) (hvW : v * W = N) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc χ) (rk (N := N) v 1 (fun _ => 1)) =
      (if W ∣ M / c then (W : ℂ) else 0) • gket u M N h c hc χ

PAG208::gbas.text:
noncomputable def gbas (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) : ZMod N → ℂ :=
  𝓕⁻ (fun ξ => if s ∣ ξ.val then ψ ((ξ.val / s : ℕ) : ZMod n) else 0)

PAG208::dft_gbas_apply.text:
theorem dft_gbas_apply (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) (ξ : ZMod N) :
    𝓕 (gbas s n N ψ) ξ = if s ∣ ξ.val then ψ ((ξ.val / s : ℕ) : ZMod n) else 0

PAG208::dft_gbas.text:
theorem dft_gbas (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero n] (h : s * n = N) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    𝓕 (gbas s n N ψ) = PAG.Part17.push (memb s n N h) ψ

PAG208::dft_gbas_memb.text:
theorem dft_gbas_memb (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) (y : ZMod n) :
    𝓕 (gbas s n N ψ) (memb s n N h y) = ψ y

PAG208::gcd_eq_iff_coprime.text:
theorem gcd_eq_iff_coprime (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (x : ℕ) (hd : s ∣ x) :
    Nat.gcd N x = s ↔ (x / s).Coprime n

PAG208::gcd_memb_eq_iff.text:
theorem gcd_memb_eq_iff (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (b : ZMod n) :
    Nat.gcd N (memb s n N h b).val = s ↔ IsUnit b

PAG208::dind_mul_dft_gbas.text:
theorem dind_mul_dft_gbas (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    dind N s * 𝓕 (gbas s n N ψ) = 𝓕 (gbas s n N ψ)

PAG208::geps_conv_gbas.text:
theorem geps_conv_gbas (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (gbas s n N ψ) = gbas s n N ψ

PAG208::inner_gbas_left.text:
theorem inner_gbas_left (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero n] (h : s * n = N) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n)
    (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ j, starRingEnd ℂ (gbas s n N ψ j) * f j =
      (N : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ b : ZMod n, ψ⁻¹ b * 𝓕 f (memb s n N h b)

PAG208::inner_gbas_self.text:
theorem inner_gbas_self (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    ∑ j, starRingEnd ℂ (gbas s n N ψ j) * gbas s n N ψ j = (Nat.totient n : ℂ) / N

PAG208::inner_gbas_of_ne.text:
theorem inner_gbas_of_ne (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (ψ ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ n)
    (hne : ψ ≠ ψ') : ∑ j, starRingEnd ℂ (gbas s n N ψ j) * gbas s n N ψ' j = 0

PAG208::inner_gbas.text:
open Classical in
theorem inner_gbas (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (ψ ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    ∑ j, starRingEnd ℂ (gbas s n N ψ j) * gbas s n N ψ' j =
      if ψ = ψ' then (Nat.totient n : ℂ) / N else 0

PAG208::gbas_ne_zero.text:
theorem gbas_ne_zero (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    gbas s n N ψ ≠ 0

PAG208::gbas_linearIndependent.text:
theorem gbas_linearIndependent (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (gbas s n N)

PAG208::finrank_span_gbas.text:
theorem finrank_span_gbas (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (gbas s n N))) = Nat.totient n

PAG208::gbas_one.text: theorem gbas_one (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) : gbas s n N 1 = geps N s

PAG208::inner_gbas_geps_conv.text:
theorem inner_gbas_geps_conv (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n)
    (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ j, starRingEnd ℂ (gbas s n N ψ j) * PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f j =
      ∑ j, starRingEnd ℂ (gbas s n N ψ j) * f j

PAG208::eq_sum_gbas.text:
theorem eq_sum_gbas (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (f : ZMod N → ℂ)
    (hf : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f = f) :
    f = ∑ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n,
      ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient n : ℂ) * ∑ j, starRingEnd ℂ (gbas s n N ψ j) * f j) • gbas s n N ψ

PAG208::Vs.text:
noncomputable def Vs (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  LinearMap.ker (PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) - LinearMap.id)

PAG208::mem_Vs.text:
theorem mem_Vs (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    f ∈ Vs N s ↔ PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f = f

PAG208::Vs_eq_span.text:
theorem Vs_eq_span (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) :
    Vs N s = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (gbas s n N))

PAG208::finrank_Vs.text:
theorem finrank_Vs (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Vs N s) = Nat.totient n

PAG208::dual_shell_eq.text: theorem dual_shell_eq {s n N c : ℕ} (h : s * n = N) (hcn : c ∣ n) : n / c * (s * c) = N

PAG208::geps_conv_gket.text:
theorem geps_conv_gket (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hcn : c ∣ n)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (gket (n / c) (s * c) N (dual_shell_eq h hcn) c (dvd_mul_left c s) χ) =
      ((((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (s * c)))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (s : ℂ) * χ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum χ stdAddChar) •
        gbas s n N ((χ⁻¹).changeLevel hcn)

PAG208::gket_eq_smul_gbas.text:
theorem gket_eq_smul_gbas (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hcn : c ∣ n)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ n / c → q ∣ c) :
    gket (n / c) (s * c) N (dual_shell_eq h hcn) c (dvd_mul_left c s) χ =
      ((((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (s * c)))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (s : ℂ) * χ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum χ stdAddChar) •
        gbas s n N ((χ⁻¹).changeLevel hcn)

PAG208::ket_coef_ne_zero.text:
theorem ket_coef_ne_zero (s c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hs : s ≠ 0) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (s * c)))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (s : ℂ) * χ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum χ stdAddChar ≠ 0

PAG208::geps_conv_gket_ne_zero.text:
theorem geps_conv_gket_ne_zero (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hcn : c ∣ n)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (gket (n / c) (s * c) N (dual_shell_eq h hcn) c (dvd_mul_left c s) χ) ≠ 0

PAG208::inner_smul_smul.text:
theorem inner_smul_smul {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a b : ℂ) (u v : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ j, starRingEnd ℂ ((a • u) j) * (b • v) j = starRingEnd ℂ a * b * ∑ j, starRingEnd ℂ (u j) * v j

PAG208::inner_geps_conv_gket.text:
theorem inner_geps_conv_gket (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N)
    (c₁ : ℕ) [NeZero c₁] (h₁ : c₁ ∣ n) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (c₂ : ℕ) [NeZero c₂] (h₂ : c₂ ∣ n) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (hne : (χ₁⁻¹).changeLevel h₁ ≠ (χ₂⁻¹).changeLevel h₂) :
    ∑ j, starRingEnd ℂ (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s)
        (gket (n / c₁) (s * c₁) N (dual_shell_eq h h₁) c₁ (dvd_mul_left c₁ s) χ₁) j) *
      PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (gket (n / c₂) (s * c₂) N (dual_shell_eq h h₂) c₂ (dvd_mul_left c₂ s) χ₂) j
        = 0

PAG208::conductor_changeLevel_inv.text:
theorem conductor_changeLevel_inv (n c : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hcn : c ∣ n) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : ((χ⁻¹).changeLevel hcn).conductor = c

PAG208::changeLevel_inv_injective.text:
theorem changeLevel_inv_injective (n c : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hcn : c ∣ n) (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (e : (χ₁⁻¹).changeLevel hcn = (χ₂⁻¹).changeLevel hcn) : χ₁ = χ₂

PAG208::exists_primitive_changeLevel.text:
theorem exists_primitive_changeLevel (n : ℕ) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    ∃ (c : ℕ) (hcn : c ∣ n) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c), χ.IsPrimitive ∧ (χ⁻¹).changeLevel hcn = ψ

PAG208::sum_card_primitive.text:
theorem sum_card_primitive (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    ∑ c ∈ n.divisors, Nat.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive} = Nat.totient n

PAG208::inner_gbas_ne.text:
theorem inner_gbas_ne (s n s' n' N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (h' : s' * n' = N) (hne : s ≠ s')
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) (ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ n') :
    ∑ j, starRingEnd ℂ (gbas s n N ψ j) * gbas s' n' N ψ' j = 0

PAG208::eq_sum_sum_gbas.text:
theorem eq_sum_sum_gbas (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    f = ∑ s ∈ N.divisors, ∑ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (N / s),
      ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (N / s) : ℂ) * ∑ j, starRingEnd ℂ (gbas s (N / s) N ψ j) * f j) •
        gbas s (N / s) N ψ

PAG208::sum_totient_div.text: theorem sum_totient_div (N : ℕ) : ∑ s ∈ N.divisors, Nat.totient (N / s) = N

PAG209::kcoef.text:
noncomputable def kcoef (M c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : ℂ :=
  (((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((M / c : ℕ) : ℂ) * χ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum χ stdAddChar

PAG209::dft_gket_apply'.text:
theorem dft_gket_apply' (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (ξ : ZMod N) :
    𝓕 (gket u M N h c hc χ) ξ =
      if M / c ∣ ξ.val then kcoef M c χ * χ⁻¹ ((ξ.val / (M / c) : ℕ) : ZMod c) else 0

PAG209::kcoef_ne_zero.text:
theorem kcoef_ne_zero (M c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hM : M ≠ 0) (hc : c ∣ M) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : kcoef M c χ ≠ 0

PAG209::normSq_kcoef.text:
theorem normSq_kcoef (M c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hM : M ≠ 0) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    Complex.normSq (kcoef M c χ) = ((M / c : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * c / Nat.totient M

PAG209::shell_eq.text:
theorem shell_eq {u M N c t : ℕ} [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (hc : c ∣ M) (ht : t ∣ u) :
    M / c * t * (u / t * c) = N

PAG209::fine_eq.text: theorem fine_eq {u M N t : ℕ} [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (ht : t ∣ u) : u / t * (M * t) = N

PAG209::geps_conv_gket_comp.text:
theorem geps_conv_gket_comp (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ∣ u) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (M / c * t)) (gket u M N h c hc χ) =
      (kcoef M c χ * χ⁻¹ (t : ZMod c)) •
        gbas (M / c * t) (u / t * c) N ((χ⁻¹).changeLevel (dvd_mul_left c (u / t)))

PAG209::geps_conv_gket_eq_zero.text:
theorem geps_conv_gket_eq_zero (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ t : ℕ, t ∣ u → t.Coprime c → s ≠ M / c * t) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (gket u M N h c hc χ) = 0

PAG209::geps_conv_gket_ne_zero_iff.text:
theorem geps_conv_gket_ne_zero_iff (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : ℕ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (gket u M N h c hc χ) ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ t, t ∣ u ∧ t.Coprime c ∧ s = M / c * t

PAG209::gket_eq_sum_geps_conv.text:
theorem gket_eq_sum_geps_conv (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    gket u M N h c hc χ = ∑ t ∈ u.divisors.filter (fun t => t.Coprime c),
      PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (M / c * t)) (gket u M N h c hc χ)

PAG209::gket_eq_sum_gbas.text:
theorem gket_eq_sum_gbas (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    gket u M N h c hc χ = ∑ t ∈ u.divisors.filter (fun t => t.Coprime c),
      (kcoef M c χ * χ⁻¹ (t : ZMod c)) •
        gbas (M / c * t) (u / t * c) N ((χ⁻¹).changeLevel (dvd_mul_left c (u / t)))

PAG209::card_shells.text:
open Classical in
theorem card_shells (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (N.divisors.filter (fun s => PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (gket u M N h c hc χ) ≠ 0)).card =
      (u.divisors.filter (fun t => t.Coprime c)).card

PAG209::inner_geps_conv_ne.text:
theorem inner_geps_conv_ne {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (s s' : ℕ) (hne : s ≠ s') (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f x) * PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s') g x = 0

PAG209::normSq_sum_orth.text:
theorem normSq_sum_orth {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {ι : Type*} (F : Finset ι) (v : ι → ZMod N → ℂ)
    (horth : ∀ i ∈ F, ∀ j ∈ F, i ≠ j → ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (v i x) * v j x = 0) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (∑ i ∈ F, v i x) = ∑ i ∈ F, ∑ x, Complex.normSq (v i x)

PAG209::normSq_comp.text:
theorem normSq_comp (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ∣ u) (htc : t.Coprime c) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (M / c * t)) (gket u M N h c hc χ) x) =
      ((M / c : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * c / Nat.totient M * (Nat.totient (u / t * c) / N)

PAG209::normSq_gket_eq_sum.text:
theorem normSq_gket_eq_sum (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (gket u M N h c hc χ x) = ∑ t ∈ u.divisors.filter (fun t => t.Coprime c),
      ∑ x, Complex.normSq (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (M / c * t)) (gket u M N h c hc χ) x)

PAG209::oldP_gbas.text:
theorem oldP_gbas (s n N T : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero T] (h : s * n = N * T) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    oldP N T (gbas s n (N * T) ψ) = if T ∣ s then gbas s n (N * T) ψ else 0

PAG209::oldP_sum_smul.text:
theorem oldP_sum_smul (N T : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero T] {ι : Type*} (F : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℂ)
    (f : ι → ZMod (N * T) → ℂ) :
    oldP N T (∑ i ∈ F, a i • f i) = ∑ i ∈ F, a i • oldP N T (f i)

PAG209::oldP_gket_eq_sum.text:
theorem oldP_gket_eq_sum (N T u M : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero T] (h : u * M = N * T) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c]
    (hc : c ∣ M) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    oldP N T (gket u M (N * T) h c hc χ) =
      ∑ t ∈ u.divisors.filter (fun t => t.Coprime c ∧ T ∣ M / c * t),
        (kcoef M c χ * χ⁻¹ (t : ZMod c)) •
          gbas (M / c * t) (u / t * c) (N * T) ((χ⁻¹).changeLevel (dvd_mul_left c (u / t)))

PAG209::sub_oldP_gket_eq_sum.text:
theorem sub_oldP_gket_eq_sum (N T u M : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero T] (h : u * M = N * T) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c]
    (hc : c ∣ M) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    gket u M (N * T) h c hc χ - oldP N T (gket u M (N * T) h c hc χ) =
      ∑ t ∈ u.divisors.filter (fun t => t.Coprime c ∧ ¬ T ∣ M / c * t),
        (kcoef M c χ * χ⁻¹ (t : ZMod c)) •
          gbas (M / c * t) (u / t * c) (N * T) ((χ⁻¹).changeLevel (dvd_mul_left c (u / t)))

PAG209::kcoef_div.text:
theorem kcoef_div (M c t : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hM : M ≠ 0) (hc : c ∣ M) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    kcoef M c χ / kcoef (M * t) c χ =
      ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (M * t)) / (Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M) * t) : ℝ) : ℂ)

PAG209::geps_conv_gket_ratio.text:
theorem geps_conv_gket_ratio (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ∣ u) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (M / c * t)) (gket u M N h c hc χ) =
      (kcoef M c χ * χ⁻¹ (t : ZMod c) / kcoef (M * t) c χ) •
        PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (M / c * t))
          (gket (u / t) (M * t) N (fine_eq h ht) c (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hc t) χ)

PAG209::geps_conv_gket_ratio'.text:
theorem geps_conv_gket_ratio' (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ∣ u) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (M / c * t)) (gket u M N h c hc χ) =
      (((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (M * t)) / (Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M) * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ⁻¹ (t : ZMod c)) •
        PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (M / c * t))
          (gket (u / t) (M * t) N (fine_eq h ht) c (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hc t) χ)

PAG210::liftc.text:
noncomputable def liftc {c : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (m : ℕ) : DirichletCharacter ℂ m :=
  if h : c ∣ m then χ.changeLevel h else 1

PAG210::liftc_of_dvd.text: theorem liftc_of_dvd {c m : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (h : c ∣ m) : liftc χ m = χ.changeLevel h

PAG210::gbas_congr.text:
theorem gbas_congr (s N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {n₁ n₂ c : ℕ} (e : n₁ = n₂) (h₁ : c ∣ n₁) (h₂ : c ∣ n₂)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : gbas s n₁ N (χ.changeLevel h₁) = gbas s n₂ N (χ.changeLevel h₂)

PAG210::conv_zero_right.text: theorem conv_zero_right {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : PAG.Part15.conv f 0 = 0

PAG210::conv_zero_left.text: theorem conv_zero_left {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (g : ZMod N → ℂ) : PAG.Part15.conv 0 g = 0

PAG210::shell_quot.text:
theorem shell_quot {u M N c s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (hc : c ∣ M) (hs0 : M / c ∣ s)
    (hsu : s / (M / c) ∣ u) :
    s * (u / (s / (M / c)) * c) = N ∧ N / s = u / (s / (M / c)) * c

PAG210::conv_gbas_same.text:
theorem conv_gbas_same (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ψ ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gbas s n N ψ) (gbas s n N ψ') = gbas s n N (ψ * ψ')

PAG210::conv_gbas_ne.text:
theorem conv_gbas_ne (s n s' n' N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (h' : s' * n' = N) (hne : s ≠ s')
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) (ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ n') :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gbas s n N ψ) (gbas s' n' N ψ') = 0

PAG210::sum_gbas_one.text:
theorem sum_gbas_one (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    ∑ s ∈ N.divisors, gbas s (N / s) N 1 = Pi.single (0 : ZMod N) (1 : ℂ)

PAG210::conv_eq_sum_shells.text:
theorem conv_eq_sum_shells {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv f g = ∑ s ∈ N.divisors,
      PAG.Part15.conv (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) g)

PAG210::conv_gket_gbas.text:
theorem conv_gket_gbas (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ∣ u)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (u / t * c)) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc χ) (gbas (M / c * t) (u / t * c) N ψ) =
      (kcoef M c χ * χ⁻¹ (t : ZMod c)) •
        gbas (M / c * t) (u / t * c) N ((χ⁻¹).changeLevel (dvd_mul_left c (u / t)) * ψ)

PAG210::conv_gket_gbas_eq_zero.text:
theorem conv_gket_gbas_eq_zero (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s n : ℕ) (hsn : s * n = N)
    (hs : ∀ t : ℕ, t ∣ u → s ≠ M / c * t) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc χ) (gbas s n N ψ) = 0

PAG210::geps_conv_gket_canon.text:
theorem geps_conv_gket_canon (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : ℕ) (hs0 : M / c ∣ s) (hsu : s / (M / c) ∣ u) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (gket u M N h c hc χ) =
      (kcoef M c χ * χ⁻¹ ((s / (M / c) : ℕ) : ZMod c)) • gbas s (N / s) N (liftc χ⁻¹ (N / s))

PAG210::conv_gket_gket.text:
theorem conv_gket_gket (u₁ M₁ u₂ M₂ N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N)
    (c₁ c₂ : ℕ) [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₁ M₁ N h₁ c₁ hc₁ χ₁) (gket u₂ M₂ N h₂ c₂ hc₂ χ₂) =
      ∑ s ∈ N.divisors.filter
          (fun s => M₁ / c₁ ∣ s ∧ s / (M₁ / c₁) ∣ u₁ ∧ M₂ / c₂ ∣ s ∧ s / (M₂ / c₂) ∣ u₂),
        (kcoef M₁ c₁ χ₁ * χ₁⁻¹ ((s / (M₁ / c₁) : ℕ) : ZMod c₁) *
          (kcoef M₂ c₂ χ₂ * χ₂⁻¹ ((s / (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ZMod c₂))) •
          gbas s (N / s) N (liftc χ₁⁻¹ (N / s) * liftc χ₂⁻¹ (N / s))

PAG210::kcoef_mul_kcoef_inv.text:
theorem kcoef_mul_kcoef_inv (M c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    kcoef M c χ * kcoef M c χ⁻¹ = χ (-1) * (((M / c : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ 2 * c / Nat.totient M)

PAG210::conv_gket_inv.text:
theorem conv_gket_inv (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc χ) (gket u M N h c hc (χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)) =
      (χ (-1) * (((M / c : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ 2 * c / Nat.totient M)) •
        ∑ s ∈ N.divisors.filter (fun s => M / c ∣ s ∧ s / (M / c) ∣ u ∧ (s / (M / c)).Coprime c), geps N s

PAG210::conv_gket_inv_rad.text:
theorem conv_gket_inv_rad (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ u → q ∣ c) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc χ) (gket u M N h c hc (χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)) =
      (χ (-1) * (((M / c : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ 2 * c / Nat.totient M)) • geps N (M / c)

PAG211::changeLevel_natCast_eq.text:
theorem changeLevel_natCast_eq {d n : ℕ} (hdn : d ∣ n) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) (m : ℕ) :
    Ψ.changeLevel hdn (m : ZMod n) = if m.Coprime n then Ψ (m : ZMod d) else 0

PAG211::sed_dvd.text:
theorem sed_dvd (s n N : ℕ) (h : s * n = N) {d e : ℕ} (hdn : d ∣ n)
    (he : e ∈ n.divisors.filter (fun e => e.Coprime d)) : s * e * d ∣ N

PAG211::dft_gbas_eq_rk.text:
theorem dft_gbas_eq_rk (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    𝓕 (gbas s n N ψ) = rk (N := N) s n ψ

PAG211::gbas_eq_invDFT_rk.text:
theorem gbas_eq_invDFT_rk (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    gbas s n N ψ = 𝓕⁻ (rk (N := N) s n ψ)

PAG211::rk_changeLevel.text:
theorem rk_changeLevel (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hs : s ≠ 0) (d : ℕ) (hdn : d ∣ n)
    (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) :
    rk (N := N) s n (Ψ.changeLevel hdn) =
      ∑ e ∈ n.divisors.filter (fun e => e.Coprime d),
        ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * Ψ (e : ZMod d)) • rk (N := N) (s * e) d Ψ

PAG211::dft_gbas_eq_sum_rk.text:
theorem dft_gbas_eq_sum_rk (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (d : ℕ) (hdn : d ∣ n)
    (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) :
    𝓕 (gbas s n N (Ψ.changeLevel hdn)) =
      ∑ e ∈ n.divisors.filter (fun e => e.Coprime d),
        ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * Ψ (e : ZMod d)) • rk (N := N) (s * e) d Ψ

PAG211::dft_rk_eq_smul.text:
