theorem dft_rk_eq_smul (v W N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : v * W = N) (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (hd : d ∣ W)
    (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    𝓕 (rk (N := N) v d Ψ) =
      (((W / d : ℕ) : ℂ) * Ψ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar) •
        rk (N := N) (W / d) d (Ψ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)

PAG211::rk_eq_smul_dft.text:
theorem rk_eq_smul_dft (w d N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero d] (hwd : w * d ∣ N) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    rk (N := N) w d Ψ = (gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar / ((w * d : ℕ) : ℂ)) •
      𝓕 (rk (N := N) (N / (w * d)) d (Ψ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d))

PAG211::invDFT_rk.text:
theorem invDFT_rk (w d N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero d] (hwd : w * d ∣ N) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    𝓕⁻ (rk (N := N) w d Ψ) = (gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar / ((w * d : ℕ) : ℂ)) •
      rk (N := N) (N / (w * d)) d (Ψ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)

PAG211::gbas_eq_sum_rk.text:
theorem gbas_eq_sum_rk (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (hdn : d ∣ n)
    (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    gbas s n N (Ψ.changeLevel hdn) =
      ∑ e ∈ n.divisors.filter (fun e => e.Coprime d),
        (gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar * ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * Ψ (e : ZMod d)) /
            ((s * e * d : ℕ) : ℂ)) •
          rk (N := N) (N / (s * e * d)) d (Ψ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)

PAG211::gbas_of_isPrimitive.text:
theorem gbas_of_isPrimitive (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero n] (h : s * n = N) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n)
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    gbas s n N ψ = (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar / (N : ℂ)) • rk (N := N) 1 n (ψ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n)

PAG211::gbas_of_isPrimitive_gket.text:
theorem gbas_of_isPrimitive_gket (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero n] (h : s * n = N)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    gbas s n N ψ = (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar * ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient N) : ℝ) : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) •
      gket 1 N N (one_mul N) n (Dvd.intro_left s h) (ψ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n)

PAG211::gbas_of_isPrimitive_apply.text:
theorem gbas_of_isPrimitive_apply (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero n] (h : s * n = N)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (x : ZMod N) :
    gbas s n N ψ x = gaussSum ψ stdAddChar / (N : ℂ) * ψ⁻¹ (x.val : ZMod n)

PAG211::geps_eq_balls_of_gbas.text:
theorem geps_eq_balls_of_gbas (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) :
    geps N s = ∑ e ∈ (N / s).divisors,
      ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) / ((s * e : ℕ) : ℂ)) • rk (N := N) (N / (s * e)) 1 (fun _ => 1)

PAG211::gbas_apply.text:
theorem gbas_apply (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero n] (h : s * n = N) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n)
    (x : ZMod N) :
    gbas s n N ψ x = (N : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ b : ZMod n, ψ b * stdAddChar (b * (x.val : ZMod n))

PAG211::gaussSum_changeLevel_apply.text:
theorem gaussSum_changeLevel_apply (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (hdn : d ∣ n)
    (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive) (x : ZMod n) :
    ∑ b : ZMod n, Ψ.changeLevel hdn b * stdAddChar (b * x) =
      gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar * ∑ e ∈ n.divisors.filter (fun e => e.Coprime d),
        (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * Ψ (e : ZMod d) * ((n : ℂ) / ((e * d : ℕ) : ℂ)) *
          rk (N := n) (n / (e * d)) d (Ψ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) x

PAG211::ramanujan_sum.text:
theorem ramanujan_sum (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (x : ZMod n) :
    ∑ b : ZMod n, (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) b * stdAddChar (b * x) =
      ∑ e ∈ n.divisors,
        (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * ((n / e : ℕ) : ℂ) * (if n / e ∣ x.val then 1 else 0)

PAG211::KetIdx.text:
abbrev KetIdx (N : ℕ) : Type :=
  Σ u : N.divisors, Σ c : (N / (u : ℕ)).divisors, {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive}

PAG211::ketFam.text:
noncomputable def ketFam (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (i : KetIdx N) : ZMod N → ℂ :=
  gket i.1 (N / i.1) N (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors i.1.2)) i.2.1
    (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors i.2.1.2) i.2.2.1

PAG211::gket_congr.text:
theorem gket_congr (u N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {M M' : ℕ} (e : M = M') (h : u * M = N) (h' : u * M' = N)
    (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M) (hc' : c ∣ M') (χ : ZMod c → ℂ) :
    gket u M N h c hc χ = gket u M' N h' c hc' χ

PAG211::rk_mem_span_ketFam.text:
theorem rk_mem_span_ketFam (v W N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : v * W = N) (d : ℕ) (hd : d ∣ W)
    (Φ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) (hΦ : Φ.IsPrimitive) :
    rk (N := N) v d Φ ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (ketFam N))

PAG211::gbas_mem_span_ketFam.text:
theorem gbas_mem_span_ketFam (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    gbas s n N ψ ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (ketFam N))

PAG211::span_ketFam.text: theorem span_ketFam (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (ketFam N))

PAG211::card_ketIdx.text: theorem card_ketIdx (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Nat.card (KetIdx N) = N

PAG211::ketFam_linearIndependent.text: theorem ketFam_linearIndependent (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : LinearIndependent ℂ (ketFam N)

PAG211::ketBasis.text:
noncomputable def ketBasis (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Module.Basis (KetIdx N) ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  Module.Basis.mk (ketFam_linearIndependent N) (span_ketFam N)

PAG211::ketBasis_apply.text: theorem ketBasis_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (i : KetIdx N) : ketBasis N i = ketFam N i

PAG211::ketFam_injective.text: theorem ketFam_injective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Function.Injective (ketFam N)

PAG212::inner_sum_smul_right.text:
theorem inner_sum_smul_right {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (v : ZMod N → ℂ) (b : ι → ℂ)
    (w : ι → ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (v x) * (∑ j ∈ S, b j • w j) x =
      ∑ j ∈ S, b j * ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (v x) * w j x

PAG212::inner_sum_smul_left.text:
theorem inner_sum_smul_left {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℂ) (v : ι → ZMod N → ℂ)
    (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ ((∑ s ∈ S, a s • v s) x) * f x =
      ∑ s ∈ S, starRingEnd ℂ (a s) * ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (v s x) * f x

PAG212::kcoef_inv.text:
theorem kcoef_inv (M c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hM : M ≠ 0) (hc : c ∣ M) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (kcoef M c χ)⁻¹ = gaussSum χ⁻¹ stdAddChar * ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M) : ℝ) : ℂ) / (M : ℂ)

PAG212::dvd_div_iff_dvd.text: theorem dvd_div_iff_dvd (s r e : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (he : e ∣ s * r) : s ∣ s * r / e ↔ e ∣ r

PAG212::mul_div_div_cancel.text: theorem mul_div_div_cancel (s r e : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (her : e ∣ r) : s * r / e / s = r / e

PAG212::sum_moebius_dvd_filter.text:
theorem sum_moebius_dvd_filter (s r : ℕ) (h0 : s * r ≠ 0) :
    ∑ e ∈ (s * r).divisors, (if e ∣ r then (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) else 0) =
      if r = 1 then 1 else 0

PAG212::kdual_shell_eq.text:
theorem kdual_shell_eq (N u c e : ℕ) (hu : u ∣ N) (hcu : c ∣ N / u) (he : e ∣ N / u / c) :
    N / u / c / e * (u * e * c) = N

PAG212::conductor_eq_of_liftc_eq.text:
theorem conductor_eq_of_liftc_eq (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] {c c' : ℕ} (hcn : c ∣ n) (hc'n : c' ∣ n)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c') (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive)
    (e : liftc χ⁻¹ n = liftc χ'⁻¹ n) : c = c'

PAG212::eq_of_liftc_eq.text:
theorem eq_of_liftc_eq (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] {c : ℕ} (hcn : c ∣ n) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (e : liftc χ⁻¹ n = liftc χ'⁻¹ n) : χ = χ'

PAG212::inner_gbas_gket.text:
open Classical in
theorem inner_gbas_gket (s n N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : s * n = N) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n)
    (u M : ℕ) (hM : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∑ j, starRingEnd ℂ (gbas s n N ψ j) * gket u M N hM c hc χ j =
      if M / c ∣ s ∧ s / (M / c) ∣ u then
        kcoef M c χ * χ⁻¹ ((s / (M / c) : ℕ) : ZMod c) *
          (if ψ = liftc χ⁻¹ n then (Nat.totient n : ℂ) / N else 0)
      else 0

PAG212::kdual.text:
noncomputable def kdual (N u c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : ZMod N → ℂ :=
  ∑ e ∈ (N / u / c).divisors,
    starRingEnd ℂ ((kcoef (N / u) c χ)⁻¹ * ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * χ⁻¹ (e : ZMod c)) *
        ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (N / (N / u / c / e)) : ℂ))) •
      gbas (N / u / c / e) (N / (N / u / c / e)) N (liftc χ⁻¹ (N / (N / u / c / e)))

PAG212::inner_kdual.text:
theorem inner_kdual (N u c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdual N u c χ x) * f x =
      ∑ e ∈ (N / u / c).divisors,
        (kcoef (N / u) c χ)⁻¹ * ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * χ⁻¹ (e : ZMod c)) *
          ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (N / (N / u / c / e)) : ℂ)) *
          ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gbas (N / u / c / e) (N / (N / u / c / e)) N
            (liftc χ⁻¹ (N / (N / u / c / e))) x) * f x

PAG212::inner_kdual_gket_same.text:
theorem inner_kdual_gket_same (N u c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hu : u ∣ N) (hcu : c ∣ N / u)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u' M' : ℕ) (h' : u' * M' = N) (hc' : c ∣ M') :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdual N u c χ x) * gket u' M' N h' c hc' χ x = if u = u' then 1 else 0

PAG212::inner_kdual_gket_of_ne_conductor.text:
theorem inner_kdual_gket_of_ne_conductor (N u c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hu : u ∣ N) (hcu : c ∣ N / u)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u' M' : ℕ) (h' : u' * M' = N) (c' : ℕ) [NeZero c']
    (hc' : c' ∣ M') (χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c') (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) (hne : c ≠ c') :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdual N u c χ x) * gket u' M' N h' c' hc' χ' x = 0

PAG212::inner_kdual_gket_of_ne.text:
theorem inner_kdual_gket_of_ne (N u c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hu : u ∣ N) (hcu : c ∣ N / u)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (u' M' : ℕ) (h' : u' * M' = N) (hc' : c ∣ M')
    (χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) (hne : χ ≠ χ') :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdual N u c χ x) * gket u' M' N h' c hc' χ' x = 0

PAG212::kdualI.text:
noncomputable def kdualI (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (i : KetIdx N) : ZMod N → ℂ :=
  @kdual N i.1 i.2.1 _ ⟨(Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors i.2.1.2).ne'⟩ i.2.2.1

PAG212::inner_kdualI_ketFam.text:
open Classical in
theorem inner_kdualI_ketFam (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (i j : KetIdx N) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdualI N i x) * ketFam N j x = if i = j then 1 else 0

PAG212::ketBasis_repr.text:
theorem ketBasis_repr (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (i : KetIdx N) :
    (ketBasis N).repr f i = ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdualI N i x) * f x

PAG212::eq_sum_kdualI.text:
theorem eq_sum_kdualI (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (KetIdx N)] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    f = ∑ i, (∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdualI N i x) * f x) • ketFam N i

PAG212::inner_kdual_explicit.text:
theorem inner_kdual_explicit (N u c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hu : u ∣ N) (hcu : c ∣ N / u)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdual N u c χ x) * f x =
      gaussSum χ⁻¹ stdAddChar * ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (N / u)) : ℝ) : ℂ) / ((N / u : ℕ) : ℂ) *
        ∑ e ∈ (N / u / c).divisors,
          (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * χ⁻¹ (e : ZMod c) *
            ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (N / (N / u / c / e)) : ℂ)) *
            ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gbas (N / u / c / e) (N / (N / u / c / e)) N
              (liftc χ⁻¹ (N / (N / u / c / e))) x) * f x

PAG212::inner_gket_of_ne_conductor.text:
theorem inner_gket_of_ne_conductor (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u' M' : ℕ) (h' : u' * M' = N) (c' : ℕ) [NeZero c']
    (hc' : c' ∣ M') (χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c') (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) (hne : c ≠ c') :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gket u M N h c hc χ x) * gket u' M' N h' c' hc' χ' x = 0

PAG212::inner_gket_of_ne.text:
theorem inner_gket_of_ne (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u' M' : ℕ) (h' : u' * M' = N) (hc' : c ∣ M')
    (χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) (hne : χ ≠ χ') :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gket u M N h c hc χ x) * gket u' M' N h' c hc' χ' x = 0

PAG212::ketClass.text: def ketClass {N : ℕ} (i : KetIdx N) : Σ c : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ c := ⟨i.2.1, i.2.2.1⟩

PAG212::inner_ketFam_of_ketClass_ne.text:
theorem inner_ketFam_of_ketClass_ne (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (i j : KetIdx N) (hne : ketClass i ≠ ketClass j) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (ketFam N i x) * ketFam N j x = 0

PAG213::conj_inv_apply.text:
theorem conj_inv_apply {c : ℕ} [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (x : ZMod c) :
    starRingEnd ℂ (χ⁻¹ x) = χ x

PAG213::sum_normSq_char.text:
theorem sum_normSq_char (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    ∑ z : ZMod c, (Complex.normSq (χ z) : ℂ) = (Nat.totient c : ℂ)

PAG213::sum_normSq_char_comp.text:
theorem sum_normSq_char_comp (c M : ℕ) [NeZero c] [NeZero M] (hc : c ∣ M) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    ∑ y : ZMod M, (Complex.normSq (χ (ZMod.castHom hc (ZMod c) y)) : ℂ) =
      ((M / c : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Nat.totient c : ℂ)

PAG213::normSq_gket_eq.text:
theorem normSq_gket_eq (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (gket u M N h c hc χ x) = ((M / c : ℕ) : ℝ) * Nat.totient c / Nat.totient M

PAG213::sum_totient_coprime.text:
theorem sum_totient_coprime (u c : ℕ) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ∑ t ∈ u.divisors.filter (fun t => t.Coprime c), Nat.totient (u / t * c) = u * Nat.totient c

PAG213::inner_gket_block.text:
theorem inner_gket_block (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u' M' : ℕ) (h' : u' * M' = N) (hc' : c ∣ M') :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gket u M N h c hc χ x) * gket u' M' N h' c hc' χ x =
      ∑ t ∈ u.divisors.filter (fun t => t.Coprime c),
        starRingEnd ℂ (kcoef M c χ * χ⁻¹ (t : ZMod c)) *
          (if M' / c ∣ M / c * t ∧ M / c * t / (M' / c) ∣ u' then
            kcoef M' c χ * χ⁻¹ ((M / c * t / (M' / c) : ℕ) : ZMod c) *
              ((Nat.totient (u / t * c) : ℂ) / N)
          else 0)

PAG213::inner_gket_block_gcd.text:
theorem inner_gket_block_gcd (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u' M' : ℕ) (h' : u' * M' = N) (hc' : c ∣ M') :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gket u M N h c hc χ x) * gket u' M' N h' c hc' χ x =
      starRingEnd ℂ (kcoef M c χ) * kcoef M' c χ / N *
        ∑ v ∈ (Nat.gcd u u').divisors,
          χ ((u / v : ℕ) : ZMod c) * χ⁻¹ ((u' / v : ℕ) : ZMod c) * (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ)

PAG213::inner_gket_ball.text:
theorem inner_gket_ball (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (u' M' : ℕ) (h' : u' * M' = N) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gket u M N h 1 (one_dvd M) (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) x) *
        gket u' M' N h' 1 (one_dvd M') (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) x =
      (M : ℂ) * M' * (Nat.gcd u u' : ℂ) /
        (((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M') : ℝ) : ℂ) * N)

PAG213::mem_block_iff.text:
theorem mem_block_iff (N u c : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    (u ∈ N.divisors ∧ c ∈ (N / u).divisors) ↔ (c ∈ N.divisors ∧ u ∈ (N / c).divisors)

PAG213::sum_card_primitive_mul_card_divi.text:
theorem sum_card_primitive_mul_card_divisors (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    ∑ c ∈ N.divisors, Nat.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive} * (N / c).divisors.card = N

PAG213::blockX.text:
noncomputable def blockX (L c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : Matrix L.divisors L.divisors ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun u v => if (v : ℕ) ∣ u then χ (((u : ℕ) / v : ℕ) : ZMod c) else 0

PAG213::blockA.text:
noncomputable def blockA (L c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : Matrix L.divisors L.divisors ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun u u' => ∑ v ∈ (Nat.gcd (u : ℕ) u').divisors,
    χ (((u : ℕ) / v : ℕ) : ZMod c) * χ⁻¹ (((u' : ℕ) / v : ℕ) : ZMod c) * (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ)

PAG213::blockA_eq.text:
theorem blockA_eq (L c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hL : L ≠ 0) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    blockA L c χ = blockX L c χ * Matrix.diagonal (fun v : L.divisors => (Nat.totient ((v : ℕ) * c) : ℂ)) *
      (blockX L c χ).conjTranspose

PAG213::det_blockX.text: theorem det_blockX (L c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : (blockX L c χ).det = 1

PAG213::det_blockA.text:
theorem det_blockA (L c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hL : L ≠ 0) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    (blockA L c χ).det = ∏ v ∈ L.divisors, (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ)

PAG213::smith_det.text:
theorem smith_det (L : ℕ) (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    (Matrix.of fun u u' : L.divisors => (Nat.gcd (u : ℕ) u' : ℂ)).det = ∏ v ∈ L.divisors, (Nat.totient v : ℂ)

PAG213::block_dvd.text: theorem block_dvd {N c u : ℕ} (hcN : c ∣ N) (hu : u ∣ N / c) : u ∣ N ∧ c ∣ N / u

PAG213::blockGram.text:
noncomputable def blockGram (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    Matrix (N / c).divisors (N / c).divisors ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun u u' =>
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gket u (N / u) N (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (block_dvd hcN (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u.2)).1) c
        (block_dvd hcN (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u.2)).2 χ x) *
      gket u' (N / u') N (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (block_dvd hcN (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u'.2)).1) c
        (block_dvd hcN (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u'.2)).2 χ x

PAG213::blockGram_eq.text:
theorem blockGram_eq (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    blockGram N c hcN χ =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun u : (N / c).divisors => starRingEnd ℂ (kcoef (N / u) c χ) / N) *
        blockA (N / c) c χ * Matrix.diagonal (fun u : (N / c).divisors => kcoef (N / u) c χ)

PAG213::det_blockGram.text:
theorem det_blockGram (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (blockGram N c hcN χ).det =
      (∏ u : (N / c).divisors, starRingEnd ℂ (kcoef (N / u) c χ) * kcoef (N / u) c χ / N) *
        ∏ v ∈ (N / c).divisors, (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ)

PAG214::sum_divisors_filter_dvd.text:
theorem sum_divisors_filter_dvd {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] (u w : ℕ) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hw : w ∣ u)
    (f : ℕ → R) :
    ∑ v ∈ u.divisors.filter (fun v => w ∣ v), f (v / w) = ∑ m ∈ (u / w).divisors, f m

PAG214::div_mul_div_of_dvd.text:
theorem div_mul_div_of_dvd {u v w : ℕ} (hv : 0 < v) (hw : 0 < w) (hvu : v ∣ u) (hwv : w ∣ v) :
    u / v * (v / w) = u / w

PAG214::blockXmu.text:
noncomputable def blockXmu (L c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : Matrix L.divisors L.divisors ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun u v => if (v : ℕ) ∣ u then
    (ArithmeticFunction.moebius ((u : ℕ) / v) : ℂ) * χ (((u : ℕ) / v : ℕ) : ZMod c) else 0

PAG214::blockX_mul_blockXmu.text:
theorem blockX_mul_blockXmu (L c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hL : L ≠ 0) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    blockX L c χ * blockXmu L c χ = 1

PAG214::blockXmu_mul_blockX.text:
theorem blockXmu_mul_blockX (L c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hL : L ≠ 0) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    blockXmu L c χ * blockX L c χ = 1

PAG214::blockX_inv.text:
theorem blockX_inv (L c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hL : L ≠ 0) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    (blockX L c χ)⁻¹ = blockXmu L c χ

PAG214::kblock.text:
noncomputable def kblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : ZMod c → ℂ) (w : ℕ) : ZMod N → ℂ :=
  if h : w ∣ N ∧ c ∣ N / w then gket w (N / w) N (Nat.mul_div_cancel' h.1) c h.2 χ else 0

PAG214::gblock.text:
noncomputable def gblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (v : ℕ) : ZMod N → ℂ :=
  gbas (N / (v * c)) (v * c) N (liftc χ⁻¹ (v * c))

PAG214::kblock_of_dvd.text:
theorem kblock_of_dvd (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : ZMod c → ℂ) {w : ℕ} (hw : w ∣ N) (hc : c ∣ N / w) :
    kblock N c χ w = gket w (N / w) N (Nat.mul_div_cancel' hw) c hc χ

PAG214::kblock_eq_sum.text:
theorem kblock_eq_sum (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u : ℕ) (hu : u ∣ N / c) :
    kblock N c χ u = kcoef (N / u) c χ • ∑ v ∈ u.divisors, χ⁻¹ ((u / v : ℕ) : ZMod c) • gblock N c χ v

PAG214::gblock_eq_sum.text:
theorem gblock_eq_sum (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (v : ℕ) (hv : v ∣ N / c) :
    gblock N c χ v = ∑ w ∈ v.divisors,
      ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius (v / w) : ℂ) * χ⁻¹ ((v / w : ℕ) : ZMod c) * (kcoef (N / w) c χ)⁻¹) •
        kblock N c χ w

PAG214::card_isUnit_castHom.text:
theorem card_isUnit_castHom (s c : ℕ) [NeZero s] [NeZero c] :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod (s * c) =>
        IsUnit (ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_left c s) (ZMod c) x))).card : ℂ) = (s : ℂ) * Nat.totient c

PAG214::card_isUnit.text:
theorem card_isUnit (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod n => IsUnit x)).card : ℂ) = Nat.totient n

PAG214::totient_mul_eq_iff.text:
theorem totient_mul_eq_iff (s c : ℕ) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    Nat.totient (s * c) = s * Nat.totient c ↔ ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ s → p ∣ c

PAG214::normSq_gket_eq_one_iff.text:
theorem normSq_gket_eq_one_iff (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (gket u M N h c hc χ x) = 1 ↔ ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ M / c → p ∣ c

PAG214::totient_mul_eq_iff'.text:
theorem totient_mul_eq_iff' (M t : ℕ) (hM : M ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    Nat.totient (M * t) = Nat.totient M * t ↔ ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ t → q ∣ M

PAG214::normSq_gket_eq_one_iff'.text:
theorem normSq_gket_eq_one_iff' (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (gket u M N h c hc χ x) = 1 ↔ ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ M → q ∣ c

PAG214::blockAinv.text:
noncomputable def blockAinv (L c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : Matrix L.divisors L.divisors ℂ :=
  (blockXmu L c χ).conjTranspose *
    Matrix.diagonal (fun v : L.divisors => ((Nat.totient ((v : ℕ) * c) : ℂ))⁻¹) * blockXmu L c χ

PAG214::blockA_mul_blockAinv.text:
theorem blockA_mul_blockAinv (L c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hL : L ≠ 0) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    blockA L c χ * blockAinv L c χ = 1

PAG214::blockA_inv.text:
theorem blockA_inv (L c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hL : L ≠ 0) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    (blockA L c χ)⁻¹ = blockAinv L c χ

PAG214::blockAinv_apply.text:
theorem blockAinv_apply (L c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (u u' : L.divisors) :
    blockAinv L c χ u u' = ∑ v ∈ L.divisors.filter (fun v => (u : ℕ) ∣ v ∧ (u' : ℕ) ∣ v),
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (v / u) : ℂ) * χ⁻¹ ((v / u : ℕ) : ZMod c) *
        ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius (v / u') : ℂ) * χ ((v / u' : ℕ) : ZMod c)) / (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ)

PAG214::smith_inv.text:
theorem smith_inv (L : ℕ) (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    (Matrix.of fun u u' : L.divisors => (Nat.gcd (u : ℕ) u' : ℂ))⁻¹ =
      Matrix.of fun u u' : L.divisors => ∑ v ∈ L.divisors.filter (fun v => (u : ℕ) ∣ v ∧ (u' : ℕ) ∣ v),
        (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (v / u) : ℂ) * ArithmeticFunction.moebius (v / u') / (Nat.totient v : ℂ)

PAG214::blockGramInv.text:
noncomputable def blockGramInv (N c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    Matrix (N / c).divisors (N / c).divisors ℂ :=
  Matrix.diagonal (fun u : (N / c).divisors => (kcoef (N / u) c χ)⁻¹) * blockAinv (N / c) c χ *
    Matrix.diagonal (fun u : (N / c).divisors => (N : ℂ) / starRingEnd ℂ (kcoef (N / u) c χ))

PAG214::blockGram_mul_blockGramInv.text:
theorem blockGram_mul_blockGramInv (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : blockGram N c hcN χ * blockGramInv N c χ = 1

PAG214::blockGram_inv.text:
theorem blockGram_inv (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : (blockGram N c hcN χ)⁻¹ = blockGramInv N c χ

PAG215::div_ne_zero_of_dvd.text: theorem div_ne_zero_of_dvd {N u : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (hu : u ∣ N) : N / u ≠ 0

PAG215::inner_conj_symm.text:
theorem inner_conj_symm {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a b : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (a x) * b x = starRingEnd ℂ (∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (b x) * a x)

PAG215::eq_of_inner_ketFam_eq.text:
theorem eq_of_inner_ketFam_eq (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (D E : ZMod N → ℂ)
    (h : ∀ j : KetIdx N,
      ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (D x) * ketFam N j x = ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (E x) * ketFam N j x) :
    D = E

PAG215::div_shell_aux.text:
theorem div_shell_aux {N c U m k : ℕ} (hcN : c ∣ N) (hU : 0 < U) (hc : 0 < c) (hk : N / c = U * m * k)
    (hL0 : N / c ≠ 0) : N / c / U / m = k ∧ N / k = U * m * c ∧ N / (U * m * c) = k

PAG215::blockIdx.text:
def blockIdx (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (u : (N / c).divisors) : KetIdx N :=
  ⟨⟨u, Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨(block_dvd hcN (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u.2)).1, NeZero.ne N⟩⟩,
    ⟨c, Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨(block_dvd hcN (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u.2)).2,
      div_ne_zero_of_dvd (NeZero.ne N) (block_dvd hcN (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u.2)).1⟩⟩, ⟨χ, hχ⟩⟩

PAG215::ketFam_blockIdx.text:
theorem ketFam_blockIdx (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (u : (N / c).divisors) : ketFam N (blockIdx N c hcN χ hχ u) = kblock N c χ u

PAG215::kdualI_blockIdx.text:
theorem kdualI_blockIdx (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u : (N / c).divisors) : kdualI N (blockIdx N c hcN χ hχ u) = kdual N u c χ

PAG215::inner_kblock.text:
theorem inner_kblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (u u' : (N / c).divisors) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kblock N c χ u x) * kblock N c χ u' x = blockGram N c hcN χ u u'

PAG215::blockGramInv_mul_blockGram.text:
theorem blockGramInv_mul_blockGram (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : blockGramInv N c χ * blockGram N c hcN χ = 1

PAG215::blockGramInv_apply.text:
theorem blockGramInv_apply (N c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (u u' : (N / c).divisors) :
    blockGramInv N c χ u u' =
      (kcoef (N / u) c χ)⁻¹ * blockAinv (N / c) c χ u u' * ((N : ℂ) / starRingEnd ℂ (kcoef (N / u') c χ))

PAG215::kdualB.text:
noncomputable def kdualB (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (u : (N / c).divisors) :
    ZMod N → ℂ :=
  ∑ u' : (N / c).divisors, starRingEnd ℂ (blockGramInv N c χ u u') • kblock N c χ u'

PAG215::inner_kdualB_kblock.text:
theorem inner_kdualB_kblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u w : (N / c).divisors) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdualB N c χ u x) * kblock N c χ w x = if u = w then 1 else 0

PAG215::inner_kdualB_ketFam_of_ne.text:
theorem inner_kdualB_ketFam_of_ne (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u : (N / c).divisors) (j : KetIdx N) (hne : ketClass j ≠ ⟨c, χ⟩) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdualB N c χ u x) * ketFam N j x = 0

PAG215::inner_kdualB_ketFam.text:
open Classical in
theorem inner_kdualB_ketFam (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u : (N / c).divisors) (j : KetIdx N) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdualB N c χ u x) * ketFam N j x = if blockIdx N c hcN χ hχ u = j then 1 else 0

PAG215::kdual_eq_kdualB.text:
theorem kdual_eq_kdualB (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u : (N / c).divisors) :
    kdual N u c χ = kdualB N c χ u

PAG215::inner_kdual_eq_sum.text:
theorem inner_kdual_eq_sum (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u : (N / c).divisors) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdual N u c χ x) * f x =
      ∑ u' : (N / c).divisors, blockGramInv N c χ u u' * ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kblock N c χ u' x) * f x

PAG215::ketBasis_repr_blockIdx.text:
theorem ketBasis_repr_blockIdx (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u : (N / c).divisors) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    (ketBasis N).repr f (blockIdx N c hcN χ hχ u) =
      ∑ u' : (N / c).divisors, blockGramInv N c χ u u' * ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kblock N c χ u' x) * f x

PAG215::kdual_mem_span.text:
theorem kdual_mem_span (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u : (N / c).divisors) :
    kdual N u c χ ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun w : (N / c).divisors => kblock N c χ w)

PAG215::inner_kdual_kdual.text:
theorem inner_kdual_kdual (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u w : (N / c).divisors) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdual N u c χ x) * kdual N w c χ x = blockGramInv N c χ u w

PAG215::normSq_kdual.text:
theorem normSq_kdual (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u : (N / c).divisors) :
    ((∑ x, Complex.normSq (kdual N u c χ x) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      (N : ℂ) / (Complex.normSq (kcoef (N / u) c χ) : ℂ) *
        ∑ v ∈ (N / c).divisors.filter (fun v => (u : ℕ) ∣ v),
          (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (v / u) : ℂ) ^ 2 * (Complex.normSq (χ ((v / u : ℕ) : ZMod c)) : ℂ) /
            (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ)

PAG215::kdual_eq_sum_gblock.text:
theorem kdual_eq_sum_gblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (u : (N / c).divisors) :
    kdual N u c χ = ∑ v ∈ (N / c).divisors.filter (fun v => (u : ℕ) ∣ v),
      starRingEnd ℂ ((kcoef (N / u) c χ)⁻¹ * ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius (v / u) : ℂ) * χ⁻¹ ((v / u : ℕ) : ZMod c)) *
        ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ))) • gblock N c χ v

PAG215::span_kblock_eq_span_gblock.text:
theorem span_kblock_eq_span_gblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun u : (N / c).divisors => kblock N c χ u) =
      Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun v : (N / c).divisors => gblock N c χ v)

PAG215::chi_eq_zero_of_rad.text:
theorem chi_eq_zero_of_rad {L c x : ℕ} [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hrad : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ L → p ∣ c) (hx : x ∣ L) (hx1 : x ≠ 1) : χ (x : ZMod c) = 0

PAG215::blockA_of_rad.text:
theorem blockA_of_rad (L c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hrad : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ L → p ∣ c) (u u' : L.divisors) :
    blockA L c χ u u' = if u = u' then (Nat.totient ((u : ℕ) * c) : ℂ) else 0

PAG215::blockGram_offDiag_iff.text:
theorem blockGram_offDiag_iff (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (∀ u u' : (N / c).divisors, u ≠ u' → blockGram N c hcN χ u u' = 0) ↔
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ N / c → p ∣ c

PAG215::blockGram_eq_one_of_rad.text:
theorem blockGram_eq_one_of_rad (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ N / c → p ∣ c) : blockGram N c hcN χ = 1

PAG215::kdual_eq_kblock_of_rad.text:
theorem kdual_eq_kblock_of_rad (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ N / c → p ∣ c) (u : (N / c).divisors) :
    kdual N u c χ = kblock N c χ u

PAG215::blockProj.text:
noncomputable def blockProj (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ZMod N → ℂ :=
  ∑ u : (N / c).divisors, (∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdual N u c χ x) * f x) • kblock N c χ u

PAG215::blockProj_mem_span.text:
theorem blockProj_mem_span (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    blockProj N c χ f ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun w : (N / c).divisors => kblock N c χ w)

PAG215::inner_kblock_blockProj.text:
theorem inner_kblock_blockProj (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (w : (N / c).divisors) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kblock N c χ w x) * blockProj N c χ f x =
      ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kblock N c χ w x) * f x

PAG215::inner_ketFam_blockProj_of_ne.text:
theorem inner_ketFam_blockProj_of_ne (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (j : KetIdx N) (hne : ketClass j ≠ ⟨c, χ⟩) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (ketFam N j x) * blockProj N c χ f x = 0

PAG215::blockProj_kblock.text:
theorem blockProj_kblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (w : (N / c).divisors) : blockProj N c χ (kblock N c χ w) = kblock N c χ w

PAG215::blockProj_ketFam_of_ne.text:
theorem blockProj_ketFam_of_ne (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (j : KetIdx N) (hne : ketClass j ≠ ⟨c, χ⟩) : blockProj N c χ (ketFam N j) = 0

PAG215::blockProj_blockProj.text:
theorem blockProj_blockProj (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : blockProj N c χ (blockProj N c χ f) = blockProj N c χ f

PAG215::inner_span_blockProj.text:
theorem inner_span_blockProj (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (d : (N / c).divisors → ℂ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ ((∑ u : (N / c).divisors, d u • kblock N c χ u) x) * blockProj N c χ f x =
      ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ ((∑ u : (N / c).divisors, d u • kblock N c χ u) x) * f x

PAG215::inner_blockProj_comm.text:
theorem inner_blockProj_comm (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (blockProj N c χ f x) * g x = ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (f x) * blockProj N c χ g x

PAG215::inner_blockProj_of_ne.text:
theorem inner_blockProj_of_ne (N c c' : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] [NeZero c'] (hcN : c ∣ N) (hc'N : c' ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c') (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive)
    (hne : (⟨c, χ⟩ : Σ c : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ c) ≠ ⟨c', χ'⟩) (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (blockProj N c χ f x) * blockProj N c' χ' g x = 0

PAG215::BlockIdx.text:
abbrev BlockIdx (N : ℕ) : Type :=
  Σ c : N.divisors, {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive}

PAG215::blockProjI.text:
noncomputable def blockProjI (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (b : BlockIdx N) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : ZMod N → ℂ :=
  @blockProj N b.1 _ ⟨(Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors b.1.2).ne'⟩ b.2.1 f

PAG215::blockEquiv.text:
def blockEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : (Σ b : BlockIdx N, (N / (b.1 : ℕ)).divisors) ≃ KetIdx N where
  toFun p := blockIdx N p.1.1 (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors p.1.1.2) p.1.2.1 p.1.2.2 p.2
  invFun i := ⟨⟨⟨i.2.1, ((mem_block_iff N i.1 i.2.1 (NeZero.ne N)).mp ⟨i.1.2, i.2.1.2⟩).1⟩, i.2.2⟩,
    ⟨i.1, ((mem_block_iff N i.1 i.2.1 (NeZero.ne N)).mp ⟨i.1.2, i.2.1.2⟩).2⟩⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

PAG215::sum_blockProjI.text:
theorem sum_blockProjI (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    f = ∑ b : BlockIdx N, blockProjI N b f

PAG216::gblock_shell.text: theorem gblock_shell {N c v : ℕ} (hcN : c ∣ N) (hv : v ∣ N / c) : N / (v * c) * (v * c) = N

PAG216::gblock_shell_inj.text:
theorem gblock_shell_inj {N c v w : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hc : 0 < c) (hcN : c ∣ N) (hv : v ∣ N / c)
    (hw : w ∣ N / c) (e : N / (v * c) = N / (w * c)) : v = w

PAG216::inner_gblock.text:
theorem inner_gblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    {v w : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) (hw : w ∣ N / c) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ v x) * gblock N c χ w x =
      if v = w then (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ) / N else 0

PAG216::inner_geps_conv_comm.text:
theorem inner_geps_conv_comm (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f x) * g x =
      ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (f x) * PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) g x

PAG216::inner_gblock_geps_conv.text:
theorem inner_gblock_geps_conv (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) {v : ℕ}
    (hv : v ∣ N / c) (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ v x) * PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f x =
      if s = N / (v * c) then ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ v x) * f x else 0

PAG216::conv_sum_smul.text:
theorem conv_sum_smul {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (h : ZMod N → ℂ) {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℂ)
    (F : ι → ZMod N → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv h (∑ v ∈ S, a v • F v) = ∑ v ∈ S, a v • PAG.Part15.conv h (F v)

PAG216::ketIdx_cases.text:
theorem ketIdx_cases (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (j : KetIdx N) :
    (∃ w : (N / c).divisors, ketFam N j = kblock N c χ w) ∨ ketClass j ≠ ⟨c, χ⟩

PAG216::blockProjG.text:
noncomputable def blockProjG (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : ZMod N → ℂ :=
  ∑ v ∈ (N / c).divisors,
    ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ) * ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ v x) * f x) • gblock N c χ v

PAG216::inner_gblock_blockProjG.text:
theorem inner_gblock_blockProjG (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    {w : ℕ} (hw : w ∣ N / c) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ w x) * blockProjG N c χ f x =
      ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ w x) * f x

PAG216::inner_ketFam_gblock_of_ne.text:
theorem inner_ketFam_gblock_of_ne (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) (j : KetIdx N) (hne : ketClass j ≠ ⟨c, χ⟩) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (ketFam N j x) * gblock N c χ v x = 0

PAG216::inner_ketFam_blockProjG_of_ne.text:
theorem inner_ketFam_blockProjG_of_ne (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (j : KetIdx N)
    (hne : ketClass j ≠ ⟨c, χ⟩) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (ketFam N j x) * blockProjG N c χ f x = 0

PAG216::inner_kblock_blockProjG.text:
theorem inner_kblock_blockProjG (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (w : (N / c).divisors) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kblock N c χ w x) * blockProjG N c χ f x =
      ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kblock N c χ w x) * f x

PAG216::blockProj_eq_blockProjG.text:
theorem blockProj_eq_blockProjG (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : blockProj N c χ f = blockProjG N c χ f

PAG216::geps_conv_blockProj.text:
theorem geps_conv_blockProj (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (blockProj N c χ f) = blockProj N c χ (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f)

PAG216::geps_conv_blockProj_gblock.text:
theorem geps_conv_blockProj_gblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (N / (v * c))) (blockProj N c χ f) =
      ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ) * ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ v x) * f x) • gblock N c χ v

PAG216::geps_conv_blockProj_eq_zero.text:
theorem geps_conv_blockProj_eq_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ (N / c).divisors, s ≠ N / (v * c)) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (blockProj N c χ f) = 0

PAG216::eq_smul_gblock_of_mem.text:
theorem eq_smul_gblock_of_mem (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) (f : ZMod N → ℂ)
    (hs : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (N / (v * c))) f = f) (hP : blockProj N c χ f = f) :
    f = ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ) * ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ v x) * f x) • gblock N c χ v

PAG216::eq_zero_of_mem.text:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : ℕ) (hs : ∀ v ∈ (N / c).divisors, s ≠ N / (v * c)) (f : ZMod N → ℂ)
    (hfs : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f = f) (hP : blockProj N c χ f = f) : f = 0

PAG216::blockProj_gblock.text:
theorem blockProj_gblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) : blockProj N c χ (gblock N c χ v) = gblock N c χ v

PAG216::blockProj_gblock_of_ne.text:
theorem blockProj_gblock_of_ne (N c c' : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] [NeZero c'] (hcN : c ∣ N) (hc'N : c' ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c') (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive)
    (hne : (⟨c', χ'⟩ : Σ c : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ c) ≠ ⟨c, χ⟩) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) :
    blockProj N c' χ' (gblock N c χ v) = 0

PAG216::blockProjGI.text:
noncomputable def blockProjGI (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (b : BlockIdx N) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : ZMod N → ℂ :=
  blockProjG N b.1 b.2.1 f

PAG216::sum_blockProjGI.text:
theorem sum_blockProjGI (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    f = ∑ b : BlockIdx N, blockProjGI N b f

PAG217::div_div_swap.text: theorem div_div_swap (N c u : ℕ) : N / u / c = N / c / u

PAG217::div_dual_eq.text: theorem div_dual_eq {N c u : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hcN : c ∣ N) (hu : u ∣ N / c) : N / (N / c / u) = u * c

PAG217::gket_congr2.text:
theorem gket_congr2 (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {u u' M M' : ℕ} (eu : u = u') (eM : M = M') (h : u * M = N)
    (h' : u' * M' = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M) (hc' : c ∣ M') (χ : ZMod c → ℂ) :
    gket u M N h c hc χ = gket u' M' N h' c hc' χ

PAG217::inner_smul_left'.text:
theorem inner_smul_left' {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (r : ℂ) (a b : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ ((r • a) x) * b x = starRingEnd ℂ r * ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (a x) * b x

PAG217::inner_kblock_blockProj'.text:
theorem inner_kblock_blockProj' (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {w : ℕ} (hw : w ∣ N / c) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kblock N c χ w x) * blockProj N c χ f x = ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kblock N c χ w x) * f x

PAG217::fcoef.text:
noncomputable def fcoef (N c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (u : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (u * c)) / Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (N / u)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((N / u / c : ℕ) : ℂ) *
    χ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum χ stdAddChar

PAG217::fcoef_ne_zero.text:
theorem fcoef_ne_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {u : ℕ} (hu : u ∣ N / c) : fcoef N c χ u ≠ 0

PAG217::dft_kblock.text:
theorem dft_kblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {u : ℕ} (hu : u ∣ N / c) :
    𝓕 (kblock N c χ u) =
      fcoef N c χ u • kblock N c ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : ZMod c → ℂ) (N / c / u)

PAG217::kblock_inv_eq_dft.text:
theorem kblock_inv_eq_dft (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {w : ℕ} (hw : w ∣ N / c) :
    kblock N c ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : ZMod c → ℂ) w =
      𝓕 ((fcoef N c χ (N / c / w))⁻¹ • kblock N c χ (N / c / w))

PAG217::eq_blockProj_of_inner.text:
theorem eq_blockProj_of_inner (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (d : ℕ → ℂ) (g : ZMod N → ℂ)
    (h : ∀ w : (N / c).divisors,
      ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kblock N c χ w x) * (∑ u ∈ (N / c).divisors, d u • kblock N c χ u) x =
        ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kblock N c χ w x) * g x) :
    ∑ u ∈ (N / c).divisors, d u • kblock N c χ u = blockProj N c χ g

PAG217::dft_blockProj_eq_sum.text:
theorem dft_blockProj_eq_sum (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    𝓕 (blockProj N c χ f) = ∑ u ∈ (N / c).divisors,
      ((∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kdual N (N / c / u) c χ x) * f x) * fcoef N c χ (N / c / u)) •
        kblock N c ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : ZMod c → ℂ) u

PAG217::dft_blockProj.text:
theorem dft_blockProj (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    𝓕 (blockProj N c χ f) = blockProj N c χ⁻¹ (𝓕 f)

PAG217::dind_mul_blockProj.text:
theorem dind_mul_blockProj (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    dind N s * blockProj N c χ f = blockProj N c χ (dind N s * f)

PAG217::blockProj_dind_mul_kblock.text:
theorem blockProj_dind_mul_kblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : ℕ) (w : (N / c).divisors) :
    blockProj N c χ (dind N s * kblock N c χ w) = dind N s * kblock N c χ w

PAG217::geps_conv_kblock_iff_normSq_dual.text:
theorem geps_conv_kblock_iff_normSq_dual (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {u : ℕ} (hu : u ∣ N / c) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N (N / u / c)) (kblock N c χ u) = kblock N c χ u ↔
      ∑ x, Complex.normSq (kblock N c ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : ZMod c → ℂ) (N / c / u) x) = 1

PAG217::normSq_kblock_iff_geps_conv_dual.text:
theorem normSq_kblock_iff_geps_conv_dual (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {u : ℕ} (hu : u ∣ N / c) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (kblock N c χ u x) = 1 ↔
      PAG.Part15.conv (geps N u) (kblock N c ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : ZMod c → ℂ) (N / c / u)) =
        kblock N c ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : ZMod c → ℂ) (N / c / u)

PAG217::blockProj_dft_gblock.text:
theorem blockProj_dft_gblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) :
    blockProj N c χ⁻¹ (𝓕 (gblock N c χ v)) = 𝓕 (gblock N c χ v)

PAG217::inner_dft_gblock.text:
theorem inner_dft_gblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    {v w : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) (hw : w ∣ N / c) :
    ∑ k, starRingEnd ℂ (𝓕 (gblock N c χ v) k) * 𝓕 (gblock N c χ w) k =
      if v = w then (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ) else 0

PAG217::blockProj_eq_sum_dft_gblock.text:
theorem blockProj_eq_sum_dft_gblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    blockProj N c χ f = ∑ v ∈ (N / c).divisors,
      ((Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, starRingEnd ℂ (𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ v) k) * f k) •
        𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ v)

PAG217::dind_mul_blockProj_dft_gblock.text:
theorem dind_mul_blockProj_dft_gblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    dind N (N / (v * c)) * blockProj N c χ f =
      ((Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, starRingEnd ℂ (𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ v) k) * f k) •
        𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ v)

PAG218::sum_units_char.text:
open Classical in
theorem sum_units_char (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    ∑ a : (ZMod N)ˣ, ψ (a : ZMod N) = if ψ = 1 then (Nat.totient N : ℂ) else 0

PAG218::liftc_inv.text:
theorem liftc_inv (N : ℕ) {c : ℕ} (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    liftc χ⁻¹ N = (liftc χ N)⁻¹

PAG218::liftc_mul_liftc_inv.text:
theorem liftc_mul_liftc_inv (N : ℕ) {c : ℕ} (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) :
    liftc χ N (a : ZMod N) * liftc χ⁻¹ N (a : ZMod N) = 1

PAG218::mul_memb.text:
theorem mul_memb (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (b : ZMod N) (y : ZMod M) :
    b * memb u M N h y = memb u M N h (ZMod.castHom (Dvd.intro_left u h) (ZMod M) b * y)

PAG218::dil.text:
def dil {N : ℕ} (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  LinearMap.funLeft ℂ ℂ (fun x => (a : ZMod N) * x)

PAG218::dil_apply.text:
theorem dil_apply {N : ℕ} (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (x : ZMod N) :
    dil a f x = f ((a : ZMod N) * x)

PAG218::dil_one.text: theorem dil_one {N : ℕ} (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : dil (1 : (ZMod N)ˣ) f = f

PAG218::dil_dil.text: theorem dil_dil {N : ℕ} (a b : (ZMod N)ˣ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : dil a (dil b f) = dil (a * b) f

PAG218::inner_dil.text:
theorem inner_dil {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (dil a f x) * dil a g x = ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (f x) * g x

PAG218::gket_unit_mul.text:
theorem gket_unit_mul (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (x : ZMod N) :
    gket u M N h c hc χ ((a : ZMod N) * x) = liftc χ N (a : ZMod N) * gket u M N h c hc χ x

PAG218::dil_gket.text:
theorem dil_gket (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) :
    dil a (gket u M N h c hc χ) = liftc χ N (a : ZMod N) • gket u M N h c hc χ

PAG218::dil_ketFam.text:
theorem dil_ketFam (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (j : KetIdx N) (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) :
    dil a (ketFam N j) = liftc j.2.2.1 N (a : ZMod N) • ketFam N j

PAG218::dil_kblock.text:
theorem dil_kblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (w : ℕ) (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) :
    dil a (kblock N c χ w) = liftc χ N (a : ZMod N) • kblock N c χ w

PAG218::dil_of_mem_span.text:
theorem dil_of_mem_span (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (a : (ZMod N)ˣ)
    {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun w : (N / c).divisors => kblock N c χ w)) :
    dil a f = liftc χ N (a : ZMod N) • f

PAG218::blockProjL.text:
noncomputable def blockProjL (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun := blockProj N c χ
  map_add' f g := by
    simp only [blockProj, Pi.add_apply, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_smul]
  map_smul' r f := by
    simp only [blockProj, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => by ring)

PAG218::blockProjL_apply.text:
theorem blockProjL_apply (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    blockProjL N c χ f = blockProj N c χ f

PAG218::liftc_mul_eq_one_iff.text:
theorem liftc_mul_eq_one_iff (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (j : KetIdx N) :
    liftc χ⁻¹ N * liftc j.2.2.1 N = 1 ↔ ketClass j = ⟨c, χ⟩

PAG218::sum_dil_ketFam.text:
open Classical in
theorem sum_dil_ketFam (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (j : KetIdx N) :
    ∑ a : (ZMod N)ˣ, liftc χ⁻¹ N (a : ZMod N) • dil a (ketFam N j) =
      (if ketClass j = ⟨c, χ⟩ then (Nat.totient N : ℂ) else 0) • ketFam N j

PAG218::blockProjL_eq_sum_dil.text:
theorem blockProjL_eq_sum_dil (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    blockProjL N c χ = ((Nat.totient N : ℂ))⁻¹ • ∑ a : (ZMod N)ˣ, liftc χ⁻¹ N (a : ZMod N) • dil a

PAG218::blockProj_eq_sum_dil.text:
theorem blockProj_eq_sum_dil (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    blockProj N c χ f = ((Nat.totient N : ℂ))⁻¹ • ∑ a : (ZMod N)ˣ, liftc χ⁻¹ N (a : ZMod N) • dil a f

PAG218::dil_blockProj.text:
theorem dil_blockProj (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (a : (ZMod N)ˣ)
    (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : dil a (blockProj N c χ f) = liftc χ N (a : ZMod N) • blockProj N c χ f

PAG218::blockProj_dil.text:
theorem blockProj_dil (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    blockProj N c χ (dil a f) = dil a (blockProj N c χ f)

PAG218::comm_blockProj.text:
theorem comm_blockProj (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (T : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hT : ∀ (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (g : ZMod N → ℂ), T (dil a g) = dil a (T g)) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    T (blockProj N c χ f) = blockProj N c χ (T f)

PAG218::mem_span_iff_dil.text:
theorem mem_span_iff_dil (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    f ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun w : (N / c).divisors => kblock N c χ w) ↔
      ∀ a : (ZMod N)ˣ, dil a f = liftc χ N (a : ZMod N) • f

PAG218::dil_radial_mul.text:
theorem dil_radial_mul {N : ℕ} (r : ZMod N → ℂ) (hr : Radial r) (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    dil a (r * f) = r * dil a f

PAG218::dil_radial_conv.text:
theorem dil_radial_conv {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (r : ZMod N → ℂ) (hr : Radial r) (a : (ZMod N)ˣ)
    (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : dil a (PAG.Part15.conv r f) = PAG.Part15.conv r (dil a f)

PAG218::radial_mul_blockProj.text:
theorem radial_mul_blockProj (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (r : ZMod N → ℂ) (hr : Radial r) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    r * blockProj N c χ f = blockProj N c χ (r * f)

PAG218::radial_conv_blockProj.text:
theorem radial_conv_blockProj (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (r : ZMod N → ℂ) (hr : Radial r) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv r (blockProj N c χ f) = blockProj N c χ (PAG.Part15.conv r f)

PAG218::dft_dil.text: theorem dft_dil {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : 𝓕 (dil a f) = dil a⁻¹ (𝓕 f)

PAG218::radial_iff_dil.text: theorem radial_iff_dil {N : ℕ} (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : Radial f ↔ ∀ a : (ZMod N)ˣ, dil a f = f

PAG218::radial_iff_mem_span.text:
theorem radial_iff_mem_span (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    Radial f ↔ f ∈ Submodule.span ℂ
      (Set.range fun w : (N / 1).divisors => kblock N 1 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) w)

PAG218::shellAlg.text:
noncomputable def shellAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :=
  Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (fun s : ℕ => PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s)) ∪
    Set.range (fun s : ℕ => LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N s)))

PAG218::shellAlg_comm_dil.text:
theorem shellAlg_comm_dil (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hT : T ∈ shellAlg N)
    (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : T (dil a f) = dil a (T f)

PAG218::shellAlg_comm_blockProj.text:
theorem shellAlg_comm_blockProj (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hT : T ∈ shellAlg N) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    T (blockProj N c χ f) = blockProj N c χ (T f)

PAG218::dind_mul_gket_of_rad.text:
theorem dind_mul_gket_of_rad (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ M → q ∣ c) (s : ℕ) :
    dind N s * gket u M N h c hc χ = if s = u then gket u M N h c hc χ else 0

PAG218::dind_mul_kblock_of_rad.text:
theorem dind_mul_kblock_of_rad (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N / c → q ∣ c) {u : ℕ} (hu : u ∣ N / c) (s : ℕ) :
    dind N s * kblock N c χ u = if s = u then kblock N c χ u else 0

PAG218::geps_conv_kblock_of_rad.text:
theorem geps_conv_kblock_of_rad (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N / c → q ∣ c) {u : ℕ} (hu : u ∣ N / c) (s : ℕ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (kblock N c χ u) = if s = N / c / u then kblock N c χ u else 0

PAG218::kblock_ne_zero.text:
theorem kblock_ne_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) {u : ℕ}
    (hu : u ∣ N / c) : kblock N c χ u ≠ 0

PAG218::shellAlg_eigen_of_rad.text:
theorem shellAlg_eigen_of_rad (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N / c → q ∣ c) {u : ℕ} (hu : u ∣ N / c)
    {T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hT : T ∈ shellAlg N) :
    ∃ μ : ℂ, T (kblock N c χ u) = μ • kblock N c χ u

PAG218::shellAlg_ne_of_rad.text:
theorem shellAlg_ne_of_rad (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hrad : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N / c → q ∣ c) (hL : 1 < N / c)
    {T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hT : T ∈ shellAlg N) : T (kblock N c χ 1) ≠ kblock N c χ (N / c)

PAG218::trace_blockProjL.text:
theorem trace_blockProjL (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    LinearMap.trace ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) (blockProjL N c χ) = ((N / c).divisors.card : ℂ)

PAG218::trace_dil.text:
theorem trace_dil {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) :
    LinearMap.trace ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) (dil a) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod N => (a : ZMod N) * x = x)).card : ℂ)

PAG218::sum_liftc_card_fix.text:
theorem sum_liftc_card_fix (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∑ a : (ZMod N)ˣ, liftc χ⁻¹ N (a : ZMod N) *
        ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod N => (a : ZMod N) * x = x)).card : ℂ) =
      (Nat.totient N : ℂ) * ((N / c).divisors.card : ℂ)

PAG218::card_fix_eq_gcd.text:
theorem card_fix_eq_gcd (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a : ZMod N) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod N => a * x = x)).card = Nat.gcd N (a - 1).val

PAG218::menon_char.text:
theorem menon_char (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∑ a : (ZMod N)ˣ, liftc χ⁻¹ N (a : ZMod N) * (Nat.gcd N ((a : ZMod N) - 1).val : ℂ) =
      (Nat.totient N : ℂ) * ((N / c).divisors.card : ℂ)

PAG218::menon.text:
theorem menon (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    ∑ a : (ZMod N)ˣ, Nat.gcd N ((a : ZMod N) - 1).val = Nat.totient N * N.divisors.card

PAG219::blockSpan.text:
noncomputable def blockSpan (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun w : (N / c).divisors => kblock N c χ w)

PAG219::blockProj_of_mem.text:
theorem blockProj_of_mem (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ) : blockProj N c χ f = f

PAG219::gblock_mem.text:
theorem gblock_mem (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) : gblock N c χ v ∈ blockSpan N c χ

PAG219::blockProj_dft_gblock_inv.text:
theorem blockProj_dft_gblock_inv (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {w : ℕ} (hw : w ∣ N / c) :
    blockProj N c χ (𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ w)) = 𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ w)

PAG219::dft_gblock_mem.text:
theorem dft_gblock_mem (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {w : ℕ} (hw : w ∣ N / c) : 𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ w) ∈ blockSpan N c χ

PAG219::gblock_ne_zero.text:
theorem gblock_ne_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) {v : ℕ}
    (hv : v ∣ N / c) : gblock N c χ v ≠ 0

PAG219::gblock_one.text: theorem gblock_one (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : gblock N c χ 1 = gbas (N / c) c N χ⁻¹

PAG219::not_dvd_of_chi_ne_zero.text:
theorem not_dvd_of_chi_ne_zero {c : ℕ} (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpc : p ∣ c)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : ψ (m : ZMod c) ≠ 0) : ¬ p ∣ m

PAG219::sum_changeLevel_mul_conj.text:
theorem sum_changeLevel_mul_conj {c : ℕ} [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (m : ℕ) [NeZero m]
    (hdvd : c ∣ m) :
    ∑ y : ZMod m, χ.changeLevel hdvd y * starRingEnd ℂ (χ ((y.val : ℕ) : ZMod c)) = Nat.totient m

PAG219::inner_gblock_one_dft.text:
theorem inner_gblock_one_dft (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {w : ℕ} (hw : w ∣ N / c) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ 1 x) * 𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ w) x =
      starRingEnd ℂ (gaussSum χ⁻¹ stdAddChar) / N * starRingEnd ℂ (χ ((N / (w * c) : ℕ) : ZMod c)) *
        Nat.totient (w * c)

PAG219::inner_gblock_one_dft_ne_zero.text:
theorem inner_gblock_one_dft_ne_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {w : ℕ} (hw : w ∣ N / c)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime (N / (w * c)) c) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ 1 x) * 𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ w) x ≠ 0

PAG219::inner_dft_gblock_one_ne_zero.text:
theorem inner_dft_gblock_one_ne_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {w : ℕ} (hw : w ∣ N / c)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime (N / (w * c)) c) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ w) x) * gblock N c χ 1 x ≠ 0

PAG219::ShellInvariant.text:
def ShellInvariant {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (W : Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ s : ℕ, ∀ f ∈ W, PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f ∈ W ∧ dind N s * f ∈ W

PAG219::BlockIrreducible.text:
def BlockIrreducible (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : Prop :=
  ∀ W : Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ), ShellInvariant W → W ≤ blockSpan N c χ → W = ⊥ ∨ W = blockSpan N c χ

PAG219::coprime_shell.text:
theorem coprime_shell (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (hcop : Nat.Coprime c (N / c))
    {w : ℕ} (hw : w ∣ N / c) : Nat.Coprime (N / (w * c)) c

PAG219::blockIrreducible_of_coprime.text:
theorem blockIrreducible_of_coprime (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hcop : Nat.Coprime c (N / c)) : BlockIrreducible N c χ

PAG219::gblock_support.text:
theorem gblock_support (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpc : p ∣ c) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) (x : ZMod N)
    (hx : gblock N c χ v x ≠ 0) : p ∣ x.val ↔ p ∣ v

PAG219::pPart.text:
noncomputable def pPart (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (p : ℕ) :
    Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  carrier := {f | f ∈ blockSpan N c χ ∧ ∀ x : ZMod N, p ∣ x.val → f x = 0}
  add_mem' := fun ha hb => ⟨add_mem ha.1 hb.1, fun x hx => by
    rw [Pi.add_apply, ha.2 x hx, hb.2 x hx, add_zero]⟩
  zero_mem' := ⟨zero_mem _, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  smul_mem' := fun r {f} hf => ⟨Submodule.smul_mem _ r hf.1, fun x hx => by
    rw [Pi.smul_apply, hf.2 x hx, smul_zero]⟩

PAG219::mem_pPart.text:
theorem mem_pPart (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (p : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    f ∈ pPart N c χ p ↔ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ ∧ ∀ x : ZMod N, p ∣ x.val → f x = 0

PAG219::pPart_shellInvariant.text:
theorem pPart_shellInvariant (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpc : p ∣ c) : ShellInvariant (pPart N c χ p)

PAG219::gblock_one_mem_pPart.text:
theorem gblock_one_mem_pPart (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpc : p ∣ c) : gblock N c χ 1 ∈ pPart N c χ p

PAG219::gblock_not_mem_pPart.text:
theorem gblock_not_mem_pPart (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpc : p ∣ c) (hpL : p ∣ N / c) :
    gblock N c χ p ∉ pPart N c χ p

PAG219::pPart_ne_bot.text:
theorem pPart_ne_bot (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpc : p ∣ c) : pPart N c χ p ≠ ⊥

PAG219::pPart_ne_top.text:
theorem pPart_ne_top (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpc : p ∣ c) (hpL : p ∣ N / c) :
    pPart N c χ p ≠ blockSpan N c χ

PAG219::not_blockIrreducible_of_dvd.text:
theorem not_blockIrreducible_of_dvd (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpc : p ∣ c) (hpL : p ∣ N / c) :
    ¬ BlockIrreducible N c χ

PAG219::blockIrreducible_iff.text:
theorem blockIrreducible_iff (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : BlockIrreducible N c χ ↔ Nat.Coprime c (N / c)

PAG219::shellInvariant_iff.text:
theorem shellInvariant_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (W : Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    ShellInvariant W ↔ ∀ T ∈ shellAlg N, ∀ f ∈ W, T f ∈ W

PAG219::commute_scalar_of_coprime.text:
theorem commute_scalar_of_coprime (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hcop : Nat.Coprime c (N / c)) (T : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hTE : ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), T (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T f))
    (hTD : ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), T (dind N s * f) = dind N s * T f)
    (hTP : ∀ f : ZMod N → ℂ, T (blockProj N c χ f) = blockProj N c χ (T f)) :
    ∃ μ : ℂ, ∀ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ, T f = μ • f

PAG219::exists_shellAlg_apply_eq.text:
theorem exists_shellAlg_apply_eq (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hcop : Nat.Coprime c (N / c)) {f g : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ)
    (hg : g ∈ blockSpan N c χ) (hf0 : f ≠ 0) : ∃ T ∈ shellAlg N, T f = g

PAG219::shellAlg_apply_ne_of_dvd.text:
theorem shellAlg_apply_ne_of_dvd (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpc : p ∣ c) (hpL : p ∣ N / c)
    {T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hT : T ∈ shellAlg N) : T (gblock N c χ 1) ≠ gblock N c χ p

PAG219::transitive_iff.text:
theorem transitive_iff (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (∀ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ, ∀ g ∈ blockSpan N c χ, f ≠ 0 → ∃ T ∈ shellAlg N, T f = g) ↔
      Nat.Coprime c (N / c)

PAG220::RadDvd.text: abbrev RadDvd (d c : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ d → q ∣ c

PAG220::InLayer.text: abbrev InLayer (c d n : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ e : ℕ, n = d * e ∧ Nat.Coprime e c

PAG220::coprime_of_radDvd.text: theorem coprime_of_radDvd {d c e : ℕ} (hd : RadDvd d c) (he : Nat.Coprime e c) : Nat.Coprime d e

PAG220::coprime_of_chi_ne_zero.text:
theorem coprime_of_chi_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) {m : ℕ} (h : ψ (m : ZMod n) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.Coprime m n

PAG220::layer_unique.text:
theorem layer_unique {c d d' n : ℕ} (hd : RadDvd d c) (hd' : RadDvd d' c) (h : InLayer c d n)
    (h' : InLayer c d' n) : d = d'

PAG220::exists_layer.text: theorem exists_layer (c : ℕ) : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 → ∃ d, RadDvd d c ∧ InLayer c d n

PAG220::layerIdx.text:
open Classical in
noncomputable def layerIdx (c L : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := L.divisors.filter (fun d => RadDvd d c)

PAG220::mem_layerIdx.text: theorem mem_layerIdx (c L d : ℕ) : d ∈ layerIdx c L ↔ d ∈ L.divisors ∧ RadDvd d c

PAG220::card_layerIdx.text:
theorem card_layerIdx (c L : ℕ) (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    (layerIdx c L).card = ∏ p ∈ (Nat.gcd c L).primeFactors, (L.factorization p + 1)

PAG220::kblock_layer.text:
theorem kblock_layer (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) {d : ℕ} (x : ZMod N)
    (hx : kblock N c χ d x ≠ 0) : InLayer c d x.val

PAG220::gblock_layer.text:
theorem gblock_layer (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {v d : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c) (hvd : InLayer c d v) (x : ZMod N)
    (hx : gblock N c χ v x ≠ 0) : InLayer c d x.val

PAG220::layer_of_dft_gblock.text:
theorem layer_of_dft_gblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    {w d : ℕ} (hw : w ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c) (hd0 : 0 < d) (x : ZMod N)
    (hx : 𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ w) x ≠ 0) (hxd : InLayer c d x.val) : InLayer c d (N / (w * c))

PAG220::gblock_eq_smul_kblock.text:
theorem gblock_eq_smul_kblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c) :
    gblock N c χ d = (kcoef (N / d) c χ)⁻¹ • kblock N c χ d

PAG220::inner_kblock_dft_gblock.text:
theorem inner_kblock_dft_gblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    {d w e : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) (hw : w ∣ N / c) (hde : N / (w * c) = d * e) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (kblock N c χ d x) * 𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ w) x =
      (((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (N / d)))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * starRingEnd ℂ (χ (e : ZMod c)) * Nat.totient (w * c)

PAG220::inner_gblock_dft_ne_zero.text:
theorem inner_gblock_dft_ne_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d w : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c) (hw : w ∣ N / c)
    (hl : InLayer c d (N / (w * c))) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ d x) * 𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ w) x ≠ 0

PAG220::layerPart.text:
noncomputable def layerPart (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (d : ℕ) :
    Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  carrier := {f | f ∈ blockSpan N c χ ∧ ∀ x : ZMod N, ¬ InLayer c d x.val → f x = 0}
  add_mem' := fun ha hb => ⟨add_mem ha.1 hb.1, fun x hx => by
    rw [Pi.add_apply, ha.2 x hx, hb.2 x hx, add_zero]⟩
  zero_mem' := ⟨zero_mem _, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  smul_mem' := fun r {f} hf => ⟨Submodule.smul_mem _ r hf.1, fun x hx => by
    rw [Pi.smul_apply, hf.2 x hx, smul_zero]⟩

PAG220::mem_layerPart.text:
theorem mem_layerPart (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (d : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    f ∈ layerPart N c χ d ↔ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ ∧ ∀ x : ZMod N, ¬ InLayer c d x.val → f x = 0

PAG220::gblock_mem_layerPart.text:
theorem gblock_mem_layerPart (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {v d : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c) (hvd : InLayer c d v) :
    gblock N c χ v ∈ layerPart N c χ d

PAG220::kblock_mem_layerPart.text:
theorem kblock_mem_layerPart (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    {u d : ℕ} (hu : u ∣ N / c) (hud : InLayer c d u) : kblock N c χ u ∈ layerPart N c χ d

PAG220::layerPart_shellInvariant.text:
theorem layerPart_shellInvariant (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hd : RadDvd d c) : ShellInvariant (layerPart N c χ d)

PAG220::layerPart_ne_bot.text:
theorem layerPart_ne_bot (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    {d : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) : layerPart N c χ d ≠ ⊥

PAG220::layerPart_irreducible.text:
theorem layerPart_irreducible (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c) (W : Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hW : ShellInvariant W) (hWd : W ≤ layerPart N c χ d) : W = ⊥ ∨ W = layerPart N c χ d

PAG220::layerPart_iSupIndep.text:
theorem layerPart_iSupIndep (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    iSupIndep (fun d : layerIdx c (N / c) => layerPart N c χ (d : ℕ))

PAG220::iSup_layerPart.text:
theorem iSup_layerPart (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    (⨆ d ∈ layerIdx c (N / c), layerPart N c χ d) = blockSpan N c χ

PAG220::block_decomposition.text:
theorem block_decomposition (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    iSupIndep (fun d : layerIdx c (N / c) => layerPart N c χ (d : ℕ)) ∧
      (⨆ d ∈ layerIdx c (N / c), layerPart N c χ d) = blockSpan N c χ ∧
      (∀ d ∈ layerIdx c (N / c), layerPart N c χ d ≠ ⊥ ∧ ShellInvariant (layerPart N c χ d) ∧
        ∀ W : Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ), ShellInvariant W → W ≤ layerPart N c χ d →
          W = ⊥ ∨ W = layerPart N c χ d) ∧
      (layerIdx c (N / c)).card = ∏ p ∈ (Nat.gcd c (N / c)).primeFactors, ((N / c).factorization p + 1)

PAG220::commute_shellAlg.text:
theorem commute_shellAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hTE : ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), T (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T f))
    (hTD : ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), T (dind N s * f) = dind N s * T f)
    {S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hS : S ∈ shellAlg N) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : T (S f) = S (T f)

PAG220::layerPart_hom_eq_zero.text:
theorem layerPart_hom_eq_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d d' : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c) (hd' : RadDvd d' c) (hne : d ≠ d')
    (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hTE : ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), T (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T f))
    (hTD : ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), T (dind N s * f) = dind N s * T f)
    (hT : ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T f ∈ layerPart N c χ d') :
    ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T f = 0

PAG220::layerPart_commute_scalar.text:
theorem layerPart_commute_scalar (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c) (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hTE : ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), T (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T f))
    (hTD : ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), T (dind N s * f) = dind N s * T f)
    (hT : ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T f ∈ layerPart N c χ d) :
    ∃ μ : ℂ, ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T f = μ • f

PAG221::layerInd.text:
open Classical in
noncomputable def layerInd (N c d : ℕ) : ZMod N → ℂ := fun x => if InLayer c d x.val then 1 else 0

PAG221::layerInd_mul_of_inLayer.text:
theorem layerInd_mul_of_inLayer (N c d : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) {x : ZMod N} (hx : InLayer c d x.val) :
    (layerInd N c d * f) x = f x

PAG221::layerInd_mul_of_not_inLayer.text:
theorem layerInd_mul_of_not_inLayer (N c d : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) {x : ZMod N} (hx : ¬ InLayer c d x.val) :
    (layerInd N c d * f) x = 0

PAG221::layerInd_mul_mem.text:
theorem layerInd_mul_mem (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    {d : ℕ} (hd : RadDvd d c) {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ) :
    layerInd N c d * f ∈ layerPart N c χ d

PAG221::sum_layerInd_mul.text:
theorem sum_layerInd_mul (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ) :
    ∑ d ∈ layerIdx c (N / c), layerInd N c d * f = f

PAG221::layerInd_mul_geps_conv.text:
theorem layerInd_mul_geps_conv (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hd : RadDvd d c) (s : ℕ) {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ) :
    layerInd N c d * PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (layerInd N c d * f)

PAG221::layerDivs.text:
open Classical in
noncomputable def layerDivs (c d L : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := L.divisors.filter (fun v => InLayer c d v)

PAG221::mem_layerDivs.text: theorem mem_layerDivs (c d L v : ℕ) : v ∈ layerDivs c d L ↔ v ∈ L.divisors ∧ InLayer c d v

PAG221::inner_gblock_eq_zero_of_not_inLa.text:
theorem inner_gblock_eq_zero_of_not_inLayer (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {v d : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c)
    (hvd : ¬ InLayer c d v) {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ layerPart N c χ d) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ v x) * f x = 0

PAG221::gblock_linearIndependent.text:
theorem gblock_linearIndependent (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (fun v : (N / c).divisors => gblock N c χ v)

PAG221::layerPart_eq_span.text:
theorem layerPart_eq_span (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hd : RadDvd d c) :
    layerPart N c χ d = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun v : layerDivs c d (N / c) => gblock N c χ v)

PAG221::finrank_layerPart.text:
theorem finrank_layerPart (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hd : RadDvd d c) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (layerPart N c χ d) = (layerDivs c d (N / c)).card

PAG221::blockSpan_eq_span_gblock.text:
theorem blockSpan_eq_span_gblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    blockSpan N c χ = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun v : (N / c).divisors => gblock N c χ v)

PAG221::finrank_blockSpan.text:
theorem finrank_blockSpan (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : Module.finrank ℂ (blockSpan N c χ) = (N / c).divisors.card

PAG221::sum_finrank_layerPart.text:
theorem sum_finrank_layerPart (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∑ d ∈ layerIdx c (N / c), Module.finrank ℂ (layerPart N c χ d) = Module.finrank ℂ (blockSpan N c χ)

PAG221::finrank_eigenspace_dil.text:
theorem finrank_eigenspace_dil (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (W : Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hW : ∀ f, f ∈ W ↔ ∀ a : (ZMod N)ˣ, dil a f = liftc χ N (a : ZMod N) • f) :
    Module.finrank ℂ W = (N / c).divisors.card

PAG221::commute_shellAlg_on.text:
theorem commute_shellAlg_on (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {W : Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hW : ShellInvariant W)
    (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hTE : ∀ (s : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ W, T (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T f))
    (hTD : ∀ (s : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ W, T (dind N s * f) = dind N s * T f)
    {S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hS : S ∈ shellAlg N) : ∀ f ∈ W, T (S f) = S (T f)

PAG221::layerPart_smul_of_commute.text:
theorem layerPart_smul_of_commute (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c) (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hTE : ∀ (s : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d,
      T (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T f))
    (hTD : ∀ (s : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T (dind N s * f) = dind N s * T f)
    (hTV : ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T f ∈ blockSpan N c χ) :
    ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T f = ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (d * c) : ℂ) *
      ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ d x) * T (gblock N c χ d) x) • f

PAG221::layerPart_hom_eq_zero_of_commute.text:
theorem layerPart_hom_eq_zero_of_commute (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d d' : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c)
    (hd' : RadDvd d' c) (hne : d ≠ d') (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hTE : ∀ (s : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d,
      T (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T f))
    (hTD : ∀ (s : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T (dind N s * f) = dind N s * T f)
    (hT : ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T f ∈ layerPart N c χ d') :
    ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T f = 0

PAG221::commute_eq_sum_layerInd.text:
theorem commute_eq_sum_layerInd (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hTE : ∀ (s : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
      T (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T f))
    (hTD : ∀ (s : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ, T (dind N s * f) = dind N s * T f)
    (hTV : ∀ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ, T f ∈ blockSpan N c χ) :
    ∀ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ, T f = ∑ d ∈ layerIdx c (N / c), ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (d * c) : ℂ) *
      ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ d x) * T (gblock N c χ d) x) • (layerInd N c d * f)

PAG221::blockSpan_shellInvariant.text:
theorem blockSpan_shellInvariant (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : ShellInvariant (blockSpan N c χ)

PAG221::blockComm.text:
noncomputable def blockComm (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    Submodule ℂ (Module.End ℂ (blockSpan N c χ)) where
  carrier := {T | ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ),
    (∀ h : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
      (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ h : dind N s * f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
      (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = dind N s * (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ))}
  add_mem' := by
    intro T₁ T₂ h₁ h₂
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    intro s f hf
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_add, (h₁ s f hf).1 h,
