        (h₂ s f hf).1 h, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_add]
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_add, (h₁ s f hf).2 h,
        (h₂ s f hf).2 h, mul_add]
  zero_mem' := by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    intro s f hf
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_zero]
    · rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero, mul_zero]
  smul_mem' := by
    intro r T hT
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hT ⊢
    intro s f hf
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, Submodule.coe_smul, (hT s f hf).1 h,
        ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_smul]
    · rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, Submodule.coe_smul, (hT s f hf).2 h,
        mul_smul_comm]

PAG221::mem_blockComm.text:
theorem mem_blockComm (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (T : Module.End ℂ (blockSpan N c χ)) :
    T ∈ blockComm N c χ ↔ ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ),
      (∀ h : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
        (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ h : dind N s * f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
        (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = dind N s * (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ))

PAG221::blockProjL_mem.text:
theorem blockProjL_mem (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    blockProjL N c χ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ

PAG221::blockExt.text:
noncomputable def blockExt (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (T : Module.End ℂ (blockSpan N c χ)) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  (blockSpan N c χ).subtype ∘ₗ T ∘ₗ LinearMap.codRestrict (blockSpan N c χ) (blockProjL N c χ) (blockProjL_mem N c χ)

PAG221::blockExt_apply.text:
theorem blockExt_apply (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (T : Module.End ℂ (blockSpan N c χ)) {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ) :
    blockExt N c χ T f = (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ)

PAG221::layerProjV.text:
noncomputable def layerProjV (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (d : layerIdx c (N / c)) : Module.End ℂ (blockSpan N c χ) :=
  (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (layerInd N c d)).restrict (fun _ hf =>
    ((mem_layerPart N c χ d _).mp (layerInd_mul_mem N c hcN χ ((mem_layerIdx c (N / c) d).mp d.2).2 hf)).1)

PAG221::layerProjV_apply.text:
theorem layerProjV_apply (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (d : layerIdx c (N / c)) (f : blockSpan N c χ) :
    (layerProjV N c hcN χ d f : ZMod N → ℂ) = layerInd N c d * f

PAG221::layerProjV_mem_blockComm.text:
theorem layerProjV_mem_blockComm (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (d : layerIdx c (N / c)) : layerProjV N c hcN χ d ∈ blockComm N c χ

PAG221::layerProjV_linearIndependent.text:
theorem layerProjV_linearIndependent (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : LinearIndependent ℂ (layerProjV N c hcN χ)

PAG221::blockComm_apply.text:
theorem blockComm_apply (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {T : Module.End ℂ (blockSpan N c χ)} (hT : T ∈ blockComm N c χ)
    (f : blockSpan N c χ) :
    (T f : ZMod N → ℂ) = ∑ d ∈ layerIdx c (N / c), ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (d * c) : ℂ) *
      ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ d x) * blockExt N c χ T (gblock N c χ d) x) • (layerInd N c d * f)

PAG221::blockComm_eq_span.text:
theorem blockComm_eq_span (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : blockComm N c χ = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (layerProjV N c hcN χ))

PAG221::finrank_blockComm.text:
theorem finrank_blockComm (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : Module.finrank ℂ (blockComm N c χ) = (layerIdx c (N / c)).card

PAG221::finrank_blockComm_eq_prod.text:
theorem finrank_blockComm_eq_prod (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (blockComm N c χ) =
      ∏ p ∈ (Nat.gcd c (N / c)).primeFactors, ((N / c).factorization p + 1)

PAG221::layerPart_linearMap_eq_zero.text:
theorem layerPart_linearMap_eq_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d d' : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c) (hd' : RadDvd d' c) (hne : d ≠ d')
    (ψ : layerPart N c χ d →ₗ[ℂ] layerPart N c χ d')
    (hψE : ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ layerPart N c χ d)
      (h : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f ∈ layerPart N c χ d),
      (ψ ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (ψ ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hψD : ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ layerPart N c χ d) (h : dind N s * f ∈ layerPart N c χ d),
      (ψ ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = dind N s * (ψ ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ)) : ψ = 0

PAG221::layerPart_linearMap_eq_smul.text:
theorem layerPart_linearMap_eq_smul (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c)
    (ψ : layerPart N c χ d →ₗ[ℂ] layerPart N c χ d)
    (hψE : ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ layerPart N c χ d)
      (h : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f ∈ layerPart N c χ d),
      (ψ ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (ψ ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hψD : ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ layerPart N c χ d) (h : dind N s * f ∈ layerPart N c χ d),
      (ψ ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = dind N s * (ψ ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    ∃ μ : ℂ, ψ = μ • LinearMap.id

PAG222::twistFn.text:
noncomputable def twistFn (N c : ℕ) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : ZMod N → ℂ :=
  fun x => ∑ d ∈ layerIdx c (N / c), layerInd N c d x * (χ' * χ⁻¹) ((x.val / d : ℕ) : ZMod c)

PAG222::layerInd_apply_of_inLayer.text: theorem layerInd_apply_of_inLayer (N c d : ℕ) {x : ZMod N} (hx : InLayer c d x.val) : layerInd N c d x = 1

PAG222::layerInd_apply_of_not_inLayer.text:
theorem layerInd_apply_of_not_inLayer (N c d : ℕ) {x : ZMod N} (hx : ¬ InLayer c d x.val) :
    layerInd N c d x = 0

PAG222::twistFn_apply.text:
theorem twistFn_apply (N c : ℕ) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) {d : ℕ} (hdI : d ∈ layerIdx c (N / c))
    {x : ZMod N} (hx : InLayer c d x.val) :
    twistFn N c χ χ' x = (χ' * χ⁻¹) ((x.val / d : ℕ) : ZMod c)

PAG222::twistFn_mul_kblock.text:
theorem twistFn_mul_kblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    {u d : ℕ} (hu : u ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c) (hud : InLayer c d u) :
    twistFn N c χ χ' * kblock N c χ u = (χ' * χ⁻¹) ((u / d : ℕ) : ZMod c) • kblock N c χ' u

PAG222::twistFn_mul_mem.text:
theorem twistFn_mul_mem (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ) : twistFn N c χ χ' * f ∈ blockSpan N c χ'

PAG222::twistFn_mul_twistFn.text:
theorem twistFn_mul_twistFn (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ) :
    twistFn N c χ' χ * (twistFn N c χ χ' * f) = f

PAG222::twistFn_mul_mem_layerPart.text:
theorem twistFn_mul_mem_layerPart (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    {d : ℕ} {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ layerPart N c χ d) : twistFn N c χ χ' * f ∈ layerPart N c χ' d

PAG222::twistConst.text:
noncomputable def twistConst {c : ℕ} [NeZero c] (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : ℂ :=
  (χ'⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum χ' stdAddChar) / (χ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum χ stdAddChar)

PAG222::kcoef_twist.text:
theorem kcoef_twist (M c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hM : M ≠ 0) (hc : c ∣ M) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : kcoef M c χ' = twistConst χ χ' * kcoef M c χ

PAG222::twistConst_ne_zero.text:
theorem twistConst_ne_zero (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) : twistConst χ χ' ≠ 0

PAG222::twist_scalar_aux.text:
theorem twist_scalar_aux (μ a B κ ψ x : ℂ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    μ * a * B⁻¹ * ψ = κ * (ψ * (x * a)) * (μ * x⁻¹ * (κ * B)⁻¹)

PAG222::twistFn_mul_gblock.text:
theorem twistFn_mul_gblock (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) {v d : ℕ} (hv : v ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c)
    (hvd : InLayer c d v) :
    twistFn N c χ χ' * gblock N c χ v = (twistConst χ χ' * (χ' * χ⁻¹) ((v / d : ℕ) : ZMod c)) • gblock N c χ' v

PAG222::twistFn_mul_geps_conv.text:
theorem twistFn_mul_geps_conv (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) (s : ℕ) {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ) :
    twistFn N c χ χ' * PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (twistFn N c χ χ' * f)

PAG222::block_twist_iso.text:
theorem block_twist_iso (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) :
    (∀ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ, twistFn N c χ χ' * f ∈ blockSpan N c χ') ∧
    (∀ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ, twistFn N c χ' χ * (twistFn N c χ χ' * f) = f) ∧
    (∀ g ∈ blockSpan N c χ', twistFn N c χ χ' * (twistFn N c χ' χ * g) = g) ∧
    (∀ (s : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ, twistFn N c χ χ' * PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f =
      PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (twistFn N c χ χ' * f)) ∧
    (∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), twistFn N c χ χ' * (dind N s * f) = dind N s * (twistFn N c χ χ' * f)) ∧
    (∀ (d : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, twistFn N c χ χ' * f ∈ layerPart N c χ' d)

PAG222::blockHom.text:
noncomputable def blockHom (N c c' : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c') :
    Submodule ℂ (blockSpan N c χ →ₗ[ℂ] blockSpan N c' χ') where
  carrier := {T | ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ),
    (∀ h : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
      (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ h : dind N s * f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
      (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = dind N s * (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ))}
  add_mem' := by
    intro T₁ T₂ h₁ h₂
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    intro s f hf
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_add, (h₁ s f hf).1 h,
        (h₂ s f hf).1 h, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_add]
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_add, (h₁ s f hf).2 h,
        (h₂ s f hf).2 h, mul_add]
  zero_mem' := by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    intro s f hf
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_zero]
    · rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero, mul_zero]
  smul_mem' := by
    intro r T hT
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hT ⊢
    intro s f hf
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, Submodule.coe_smul, (hT s f hf).1 h,
        ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_smul]
    · rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, Submodule.coe_smul, (hT s f hf).2 h,
        mul_smul_comm]

PAG222::mem_blockHom.text:
theorem mem_blockHom (N c c' : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c')
    (T : blockSpan N c χ →ₗ[ℂ] blockSpan N c' χ') :
    T ∈ blockHom N c c' χ χ' ↔ ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ),
      (∀ h : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
        (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ h : dind N s * f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
        (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = dind N s * (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ))

PAG222::twistV.text:
noncomputable def twistV (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    blockSpan N c χ →ₗ[ℂ] blockSpan N c χ' :=
  (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (twistFn N c χ χ')).restrict (fun _ hf => twistFn_mul_mem N c hcN χ χ' hf)

PAG222::twistV_apply.text:
theorem twistV_apply (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (f : blockSpan N c χ) : (twistV N c hcN χ χ' f : ZMod N → ℂ) = twistFn N c χ χ' * f

PAG222::twistV_comp_mem_blockHom.text:
theorem twistV_comp_mem_blockHom (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) {S : Module.End ℂ (blockSpan N c χ)} (hS : S ∈ blockComm N c χ) :
    twistV N c hcN χ χ' ∘ₗ S ∈ blockHom N c c χ χ'

PAG222::finrank_blockHom.text:
theorem finrank_blockHom (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (blockHom N c c χ χ') = (layerIdx c (N / c)).card

PAG222::finrank_blockHom_eq_prod.text:
theorem finrank_blockHom_eq_prod (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (blockHom N c c χ χ') =
      ∏ p ∈ (Nat.gcd c (N / c)).primeFactors, ((N / c).factorization p + 1)

PAG223::exists_of_geps_conv_ne_zero.text:
theorem exists_of_geps_conv_ne_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hd : RadDvd d c) {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ layerPart N c χ d) (s : ℕ)
    (hs : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ v : ℕ, v ∣ N / c ∧ InLayer c d v ∧ s = N / (v * c)

PAG223::layer_of_inner_dft_gblock_ne_zer.text:
theorem layer_of_inner_dft_gblock_ne_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) {d w : ℕ} (hd : RadDvd d c) (hd0 : 0 < d) (hw : w ∣ N / c)
    {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ layerPart N c χ d)
    (h : ∑ k, starRingEnd ℂ (𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ w) k) * f k ≠ 0) : InLayer c d (N / (w * c))

PAG223::exists_of_dind_mul_ne_zero.text:
theorem exists_of_dind_mul_ne_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hd : RadDvd d c) (hd0 : 0 < d) {f : ZMod N → ℂ}
    (hf : f ∈ layerPart N c χ d) (s : ℕ) (hs : dind N s * f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ w : ℕ, w ∣ N / c ∧ InLayer c d (N / (w * c)) ∧ s = N / (w * c)

PAG223::div_shell_hub.text:
theorem div_shell_hub {N c d : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (hc0 : 0 < c) (hcN : c ∣ N) (hdL : d ∣ N / c) :
    N / (N / c / d * c) = d

PAG223::dft_gblock_mem_layerPart_hub.text:
theorem dft_gblock_mem_layerPart_hub (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) : 𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ (N / c / d)) ∈ layerPart N c χ d

PAG223::dind_mul_dft_gblock_hub.text:
theorem dind_mul_dft_gblock_hub (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    {d : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) :
    dind N d * 𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ (N / c / d)) = 𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ (N / c / d))

PAG223::dft_gblock_ne_zero.text:
theorem dft_gblock_ne_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) {w : ℕ}
    (hw : w ∣ N / c) : 𝓕 (gblock N c χ⁻¹ w) ≠ 0

PAG223::layerPart_exists_apply_of_ne_zer.text:
theorem layerPart_exists_apply_of_ne_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c)
    {g : ZMod N → ℂ} (hg : g ∈ layerPart N c χ d) (hg0 : g ≠ 0) {f : ZMod N → ℂ}
    (hf : f ∈ layerPart N c χ d) : ∃ S ∈ shellAlg N, S g = f

PAG223::layerPart_eq_zero_of_apply_eq_ze.text:
theorem layerPart_eq_zero_of_apply_eq_zero (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c)
    (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hTE : ∀ (s : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d,
      T (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T f))
    (hTD : ∀ (s : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T (dind N s * f) = dind N s * T f)
    {g : ZMod N → ℂ} (hg : g ∈ layerPart N c χ d) (hg0 : g ≠ 0) (hTg : T g = 0) :
    ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T f = 0

PAG223::layerPart_surj_of_commute.text:
theorem layerPart_surj_of_commute (N c c' : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] [NeZero c'] (hcN : c ∣ N) (hc'N : c' ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c') (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive)
    {d d' : ℕ} (hd : RadDvd d c) (hd'L : d' ∣ N / c') (hd' : RadDvd d' c') (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hTE : ∀ (s : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d,
      T (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T f))
    (hTD : ∀ (s : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T (dind N s * f) = dind N s * T f)
    (hT : ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T f ∈ layerPart N c' χ' d')
    (hne : ∃ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T f ≠ 0) :
    ∀ g ∈ layerPart N c' χ' d', ∃ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, T f = g

PAG223::eq_of_inLayer_inLayer.text:

PAG223::blockHomExt.text:

PAG223::blockHom_eq_bot_of_ne.text:

PAG223::finrank_blockHom_eq_ite.text:
theorem finrank_blockHom_eq_ite (N c c' : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] [NeZero c'] (hcN : c ∣ N) (hc'N : c' ∣ N)

    Module.finrank ℂ (blockHom N c c' χ χ') =
      if c = c' then ∏ p ∈ (Nat.gcd c (N / c)).primeFactors, ((N / c).factorization p + 1) else 0

PAG224::linearMap_apply_congr.text:

PAG224::linearMap_apply_eq_zero.text:

PAG224::fullComm.text:
noncomputable def fullComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Submodule ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) where
  carrier := {T | ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ),
    T (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T f) ∧ T (dind N s * f) = dind N s * T f}
  add_mem' := by
    intro T₁ T₂ h₁ h₂
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    intro s f
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, (h₁ s f).1, (h₂ s f).1, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply,
        ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_add]
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, (h₁ s f).2, (h₂ s f).2, mul_add]
  zero_mem' := by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    intro s f
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_zero]
    · rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero]
  smul_mem' := by
    intro r T hT
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hT ⊢
    intro s f
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, (hT s f).1, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply,
        ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_smul]
    · rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, (hT s f).2, mul_smul_comm]

PAG224::mem_fullComm.text:
theorem mem_fullComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    T ∈ fullComm N ↔ ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ),
      T (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T f) ∧ T (dind N s * f) = dind N s * T f

PAG224::commBlock.text:
noncomputable def commBlock (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (b b' : BlockIdx N) (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    blockSpan N b.1 b.2.1 →ₗ[ℂ] blockSpan N b'.1 b'.2.1 :=
  LinearMap.codRestrict (blockSpan N b'.1 b'.2.1) (blockProjL N b'.1 b'.2.1 ∘ₗ T ∘ₗ (blockSpan N b.1 b.2.1).subtype)
    (fun _ => blockProjL_mem N b'.1 b'.2.1 _)

PAG224::commBlock_apply.text:
theorem commBlock_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (b b' : BlockIdx N) (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (f : blockSpan N b.1 b.2.1) : (commBlock N b b' T f : ZMod N → ℂ) = blockProj N b'.1 b'.2.1 (T f)

PAG224::commBlock_mem.text:
theorem commBlock_mem (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (b b' : BlockIdx N) {T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)}
    (hT : T ∈ fullComm N) : commBlock N b b' T ∈ blockHom N b.1 b'.1 b.2.1 b'.2.1

PAG224::blockHomExt_apply_proj.text:
theorem blockHomExt_apply_proj (N c c' : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c') (X : blockSpan N c χ →ₗ[ℂ] blockSpan N c' χ') (g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    blockHomExt N c c' χ χ' X g = (X ⟨blockProjL N c χ g, blockProjL_mem N c χ g⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ)

PAG224::commSum.text:
noncomputable def commSum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)]
    (X : (p : BlockIdx N × BlockIdx N) → blockHom N p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.2.1) :
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  ∑ p : BlockIdx N × BlockIdx N, blockHomExt N p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.2.1 (X p).1

PAG224::commSum_mem.text:
theorem commSum_mem (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)]
    (X : (p : BlockIdx N × BlockIdx N) → blockHom N p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.2.1) : commSum N X ∈ fullComm N

PAG224::commToFamily.text:
noncomputable def commToFamily (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    fullComm N →ₗ[ℂ] ((p : BlockIdx N × BlockIdx N) → blockHom N p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.2.1) where
  toFun T p := ⟨commBlock N p.1 p.2 T, commBlock_mem N p.1 p.2 T.2⟩
  map_add' T₁ T₂ := by
    funext p
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply Subtype.ext
    show blockProjL N p.2.1 p.2.2.1 (((T₁ + T₂ : fullComm N) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f) =
      blockProjL N p.2.1 p.2.2.1 ((T₁ : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f) +
        blockProjL N p.2.1 p.2.2.1 ((T₂ : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f)
    rw [Submodule.coe_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add]
  map_smul' r T := by
    funext p
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply Subtype.ext
    show blockProjL N p.2.1 p.2.2.1 (((r • T : fullComm N) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f) =
      r • blockProjL N p.2.1 p.2.2.1 ((T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f)
    rw [Submodule.coe_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]

PAG224::familyToComm.text:
noncomputable def familyToComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    ((p : BlockIdx N × BlockIdx N) → blockHom N p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.2.1) →ₗ[ℂ] fullComm N where
  toFun X := ⟨commSum N X, commSum_mem N X⟩
  map_add' X₁ X₂ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show commSum N (X₁ + X₂) = commSum N X₁ + commSum N X₂
    unfold commSum
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ => ?_)
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro g
    rfl
  map_smul' r X := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show commSum N (r • X) = r • commSum N X
    unfold commSum
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ => ?_)
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro g
    rfl

PAG224::commBlock_commSum.text:
theorem commBlock_commSum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)]
    (X : (p : BlockIdx N × BlockIdx N) → blockHom N p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.2.1) (b₀ b₀' : BlockIdx N)
    {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N b₀.1 b₀.2.1) :
    blockProj N b₀'.1 b₀'.2.1 (commSum N X f) = ((X (b₀, b₀')).1 ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ)

PAG224::commToFamily_comp_familyToComm.text:
theorem commToFamily_comp_familyToComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    (commToFamily N).comp (familyToComm N) = LinearMap.id

PAG224::familyToComm_comp_commToFamily.text:
theorem familyToComm_comp_commToFamily (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    (familyToComm N).comp (commToFamily N) = LinearMap.id

PAG224::commEquiv.text:
noncomputable def commEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    fullComm N ≃ₗ[ℂ] ((p : BlockIdx N × BlockIdx N) → blockHom N p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.2.1) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofLinearMap (commToFamily N) (familyToComm N) (commToFamily_comp_familyToComm N)
    (familyToComm_comp_commToFamily N)

PAG224::blockHom_free.text:
instance blockHom_free (N c c' : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c') :
    Module.Free ℂ (blockHom N c c' χ χ') :=
  @Module.Free.of_divisionRing ℂ (blockHom N c c' χ χ') _
    (@Submodule.addCommGroup ℂ _ _ LinearMap.addCommGroup LinearMap.module (blockHom N c c' χ χ'))
    (Submodule.module _)

PAG224::finrank_fullComm_eq_sum_finrank.text:
theorem finrank_fullComm_eq_sum_finrank (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullComm N) =
      ∑ p : BlockIdx N × BlockIdx N, Module.finrank ℂ (blockHom N p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.2.1)

PAG224::finrank_fullComm_eq_sum.text:
theorem finrank_fullComm_eq_sum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullComm N) = ∑ p : BlockIdx N × BlockIdx N,
      if (p.1.1 : ℕ) = p.2.1 then
        ∏ q ∈ (Nat.gcd p.1.1 (N / p.1.1)).primeFactors, ((N / p.1.1).factorization q + 1) else 0

PAG224::sum_blockIdx.text:
theorem sum_blockIdx (N : ℕ) [∀ c : N.divisors, Fintype {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive}]
    (g : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∑ b : BlockIdx N, g b.1 = ∑ c ∈ N.divisors, Nat.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive} * g c

PAG224::finrank_fullComm.text:
theorem finrank_fullComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullComm N) = ∑ c ∈ N.divisors, Nat.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive} ^ 2 *
      ∏ q ∈ (Nat.gcd c (N / c)).primeFactors, ((N / c).factorization q + 1)

PAG224::top_shellInvariant.text: theorem top_shellInvariant (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : ShellInvariant (⊤ : Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))

PAG224::mem_fullComm_iff_commute.text:
theorem mem_fullComm_iff_commute (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    T ∈ fullComm N ↔ ∀ S ∈ shellAlg N, Commute T S

PAG224::dilCommute.text:
noncomputable def dilCommute (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Submodule ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) where
  carrier := {T | ∀ (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), T (dil a f) = dil a (T f)}
  add_mem' := by
    intro T₁ T₂ h₁ h₂
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    intro a f
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁ a f, h₂ a f, map_add]
  zero_mem' := by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    intro a f
    rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
  smul_mem' := by
    intro r T hT
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hT ⊢
    intro a f
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hT a f, map_smul]

PAG224::mem_dilCommute.text:
theorem mem_dilCommute (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    T ∈ dilCommute N ↔ ∀ (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), T (dil a f) = dil a (T f)

PAG224::dilComm.text:
noncomputable def dilComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Submodule ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :=
  fullComm N ⊓ dilCommute N

PAG224::mem_dilComm.text:
theorem mem_dilComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    T ∈ dilComm N ↔ T ∈ fullComm N ∧ T ∈ dilCommute N

PAG224::blockHomExt_mem_dilCommute.text:
theorem blockHomExt_mem_dilCommute (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (Y : blockSpan N c χ →ₗ[ℂ] blockSpan N c χ) : blockHomExt N c c χ χ Y ∈ dilCommute N

PAG224::diagSum.text:
noncomputable def diagSum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)]
    (Y : (b : BlockIdx N) → blockHom N b.1 b.1 b.2.1 b.2.1) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  ∑ b : BlockIdx N, blockHomExt N b.1 b.1 b.2.1 b.2.1 (Y b).1

PAG224::diagSum_mem.text:
theorem diagSum_mem (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)]
    (Y : (b : BlockIdx N) → blockHom N b.1 b.1 b.2.1 b.2.1) : diagSum N Y ∈ dilComm N

PAG224::dilCommToFamily.text:
noncomputable def dilCommToFamily (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    dilComm N →ₗ[ℂ] ((b : BlockIdx N) → blockHom N b.1 b.1 b.2.1 b.2.1) where
  toFun T b := ⟨commBlock N b b T, commBlock_mem N b b ((mem_dilComm N T).mp T.2).1⟩
  map_add' T₁ T₂ := by
    funext b
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply Subtype.ext
    show blockProjL N b.1 b.2.1 (((T₁ + T₂ : dilComm N) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f) =
      blockProjL N b.1 b.2.1 ((T₁ : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f) +
        blockProjL N b.1 b.2.1 ((T₂ : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f)
    rw [Submodule.coe_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add]
  map_smul' r T := by
    funext b
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply Subtype.ext
    show blockProjL N b.1 b.2.1 (((r • T : dilComm N) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f) =
      r • blockProjL N b.1 b.2.1 ((T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f)
    rw [Submodule.coe_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]

PAG224::familyToDilComm.text:
noncomputable def familyToDilComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    ((b : BlockIdx N) → blockHom N b.1 b.1 b.2.1 b.2.1) →ₗ[ℂ] dilComm N where
  toFun Y := ⟨diagSum N Y, diagSum_mem N Y⟩
  map_add' Y₁ Y₂ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show diagSum N (Y₁ + Y₂) = diagSum N Y₁ + diagSum N Y₂
    unfold diagSum
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro g
    rfl
  map_smul' r Y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show diagSum N (r • Y) = r • diagSum N Y
    unfold diagSum
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro g
    rfl

PAG224::commBlock_diagSum.text:
theorem commBlock_diagSum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)]
    (Y : (b : BlockIdx N) → blockHom N b.1 b.1 b.2.1 b.2.1) (b₀ : BlockIdx N) {f : ZMod N → ℂ}
    (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N b₀.1 b₀.2.1) :

noncomputable def blockCommAlg (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)

PAG225::layerAlgHom.text:
noncomputable def layerAlgHom (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : (layerIdx c (N / c) → ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] blockCommAlg N c hcN χ hχ :=
  AlgHom.ofLinearMap
    { toFun := fun a => ⟨∑ d, a d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d,
        (mem_blockCommAlg N c hcN χ hχ _).mpr (Submodule.sum_mem _ (fun d _ =>
          Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (layerProjV_mem_blockComm N c hcN χ hχ d)))⟩
      map_add' := fun a b => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show ∑ d, (a + b) d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d =
          ∑ d, a d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d + ∑ d, b d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := fun r a => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show ∑ d, (r • a) d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d = r • ∑ d, a d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, Finset.smul_sum] }
    (by
      apply Subtype.ext
      show ∑ d, (1 : layerIdx c (N / c) → ℂ) d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d = 1
      simp only [Pi.one_apply, one_smul]
      exact sum_layerProjV N c hcN χ)
    (fun a b => by
      apply Subtype.ext
      show ∑ d, (a * b) d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d =
        (∑ d, a d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d) * ∑ d, b d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      simp only [smul_mul_smul_comm, layerProjV_mul, smul_ite, smul_zero]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
      simp)

PAG225::layerAlgHom_apply.text:
theorem layerAlgHom_apply (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (a : layerIdx c (N / c) → ℂ) :
    (layerAlgHom N c hcN χ hχ a : Module.End ℂ (blockSpan N c χ)) = ∑ d, a d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d

noncomputable def blockCommAlgEquiv (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)

PAG226::centralElt.text:
noncomputable def centralElt (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] (c d : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  ∑ b : BlockIdx N, if (b.1 : ℕ) = c then LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (layerInd N c d) ∘ₗ blockProjL N b.1 b.2.1 else 0

PAG226::centralElt_apply.text:
theorem centralElt_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] (c d : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    centralElt N c d f =
      ∑ b : BlockIdx N, if (b.1 : ℕ) = c then layerInd N c d * blockProj N b.1 b.2.1 f else 0

PAG226::centralElt_apply_of_mem'.text:
theorem centralElt_apply_of_mem' (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] {c : ℕ} (hc : c ∈ N.divisors)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {c' d : ℕ} {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ) :
    centralElt N c' d f = if c = c' then layerInd N c' d * f else 0

theorem centralElt_apply_fullComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] (c d : ℕ)

    (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N b.1 b.2.1) :
    centralElt N c d (T f) = if (b.1 : ℕ) = c then layerInd N c d * T f else 0

    {T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hT : T ∈ fullComm N) : Commute (centralElt N c d) T

PAG226::fullCommCenter.text:
noncomputable def fullCommCenter (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Submodule ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) where
  carrier := {Z | Z ∈ fullComm N ∧ ∀ T ∈ fullComm N, Commute Z T}
  add_mem' := by
    intro Z₁ Z₂ h₁ h₂
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    exact ⟨Submodule.add_mem _ h₁.1 h₂.1, fun T hT => (h₁.2 T hT).add_left (h₂.2 T hT)⟩
  zero_mem' := by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    exact ⟨Submodule.zero_mem _, fun T _ => Commute.zero_left T⟩
  smul_mem' := by
    intro r Z h
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h ⊢
    exact ⟨Submodule.smul_mem _ r h.1, fun T hT => (h.2 T hT).smul_left r⟩

PAG226::mem_fullCommCenter.text:
theorem mem_fullCommCenter (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (Z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    Z ∈ fullCommCenter N ↔ Z ∈ fullComm N ∧ ∀ T ∈ fullComm N, Commute Z T

PAG226::centralElt_mem_center.text:
theorem centralElt_mem_center (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] (c d : ℕ) (hd : RadDvd d c) :

PAG226::layerScalar.text:
noncomputable def layerScalar (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (d : ℕ)
    (Z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) : ℂ :=
  (N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (d * c) : ℂ) * ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ d x) * Z (gblock N c χ d) x

PAG226::center_smul_layerPart.text:
theorem center_smul_layerPart (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c) {Z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)}
    (hZ : Z ∈ fullCommCenter N) {g : ZMod N → ℂ} (hg : g ∈ layerPart N c χ d) :
    Z g = layerScalar N c χ d Z • g

PAG226::layerScalar_eq_of_center.text:
theorem layerScalar_eq_of_center (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) {d : ℕ} (hdL : d ∣ N / c) (hd : RadDvd d c)

PAG226::centerIdx.text:
noncomputable def centerIdx (N : ℕ) : Finset (Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) :=
  (N.divisors.filter (fun c => 0 < Nat.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive})).sigma
    (fun c => layerIdx c (N / c))

PAG226::mem_centerIdx.text:
theorem mem_centerIdx (N : ℕ) (p : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) : p ∈ centerIdx N ↔
    p.1 ∈ N.divisors ∧ 0 < Nat.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p.1 // χ.IsPrimitive} ∧
      p.2 ∈ layerIdx p.1 (N / p.1)

PAG226::sum_centralElt_apply.text:
theorem sum_centralElt_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] (a : centerIdx N → ℂ)
    (i : centerIdx N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ i.1.1) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {g : ZMod N → ℂ}
    (hg : g ∈ layerPart N i.1.1 χ i.1.2) :
    (∑ j : centerIdx N, a j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2) g = a i • g

PAG226::center_eq_zero.text:
theorem center_eq_zero (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {Z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hZ : Z ∈ fullCommCenter N)
    (h0 : ∀ p ∈ centerIdx N, ∃ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p.1, χ.IsPrimitive ∧
      ∀ g ∈ layerPart N p.1 χ p.2, Z g = 0) : Z = 0

PAG226::centralElt_linearIndependent.text:
theorem centralElt_linearIndependent (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (fun j : centerIdx N => centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2)

PAG226::centerCoef.text:
noncomputable def centerCoef (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (Z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) (p : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) : ℂ :=
  if h : 0 < Nat.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p.1 // χ.IsPrimitive} then
    layerScalar N p.1 (Classical.choice (Nat.card_pos_iff.mp h).1).1 p.2 Z else 0

PAG226::center_eq_span.text:
theorem center_eq_span (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    fullCommCenter N = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (fun j : centerIdx N => centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2))

PAG226::finrank_fullCommCenter.text:
theorem finrank_fullCommCenter (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommCenter N) =
      ∑ c ∈ N.divisors.filter (fun c => 0 < Nat.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive}),
        ∏ q ∈ (Nat.gcd c (N / c)).primeFactors, ((N / c).factorization q + 1)

PAG226::fullComm_mul_mem.text:
theorem fullComm_mul_mem (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {T T' : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hT : T ∈ fullComm N)
    (hT' : T' ∈ fullComm N) : T * T' ∈ fullComm N

PAG226::one_mem_fullComm.text: theorem one_mem_fullComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : (1 : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) ∈ fullComm N

PAG226::fullCommAlg.text:
noncomputable def fullCommAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :=
  (fullComm N).toSubalgebra (one_mem_fullComm N) (fun _ _ hT hT' => fullComm_mul_mem N hT hT')

PAG226::mem_fullCommAlg.text:
theorem mem_fullCommAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    T ∈ fullCommAlg N ↔ T ∈ fullComm N

PAG226::center_mul_mem.text:
theorem center_mul_mem (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {Z Z' : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hZ : Z ∈ fullCommCenter N)
    (hZ' : Z' ∈ fullCommCenter N) : Z * Z' ∈ fullCommCenter N

PAG226::one_mem_center.text: theorem one_mem_center (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : (1 : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) ∈ fullCommCenter N

PAG226::centerAlg.text:
noncomputable def centerAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :=
  (fullCommCenter N).toSubalgebra (one_mem_center N) (fun _ _ hZ hZ' => center_mul_mem N hZ hZ')

PAG226::mem_centerAlg.text:
theorem mem_centerAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (Z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    Z ∈ centerAlg N ↔ Z ∈ fullCommCenter N

PAG226::mem_center_fullCommAlg.text:
theorem mem_center_fullCommAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (Z : fullCommAlg N) :
    Z ∈ Subalgebra.center ℂ (fullCommAlg N) ↔ (Z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) ∈ fullCommCenter N

PAG226::centralElt_mul.text:
theorem centralElt_mul (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] (p q : centerIdx N) :
    centralElt N p.1.1 p.1.2 * centralElt N q.1.1 q.1.2 = if p = q then centralElt N p.1.1 p.1.2 else 0

PAG226::sum_centralElt.text:
theorem sum_centralElt (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    ∑ j : centerIdx N, centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2 = 1

PAG226::sum_smul_centralElt_mem.text:
theorem sum_smul_centralElt_mem (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] (a : centerIdx N → ℂ) :
    ∑ j : centerIdx N, a j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2 ∈ fullCommCenter N

PAG226::centerAlgHom.text:
noncomputable def centerAlgHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    (centerIdx N → ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] centerAlg N :=
  AlgHom.ofLinearMap
    { toFun := fun a => ⟨∑ j, a j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2, (mem_centerAlg N _).mpr (sum_smul_centralElt_mem N a)⟩
      map_add' := fun a b => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show ∑ j, (a + b) j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2 =
          ∑ j, a j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2 + ∑ j, b j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := fun r a => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show ∑ j, (r • a) j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2 = r • ∑ j, a j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, Finset.smul_sum] }
    (by
      apply Subtype.ext
      show ∑ j, (1 : centerIdx N → ℂ) j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2 = 1
      simp only [Pi.one_apply, one_smul]
      exact sum_centralElt N)
    (fun a b => by
      apply Subtype.ext
      show ∑ j, (a * b) j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2 =
        (∑ j, a j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2) * ∑ j, b j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      simp only [smul_mul_smul_comm, centralElt_mul, smul_ite, smul_zero]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
      simp)

PAG226::centerAlgHom_apply.text:
theorem centerAlgHom_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] (a : centerIdx N → ℂ) :
    (centerAlgHom N a : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) = ∑ j, a j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2

PAG226::centerAlgHom_bijective.text:
theorem centerAlgHom_bijective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    Function.Bijective (centerAlgHom N)

PAG226::centerAlgEquiv.text:
noncomputable def centerAlgEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    (centerIdx N → ℂ) ≃ₐ[ℂ] centerAlg N :=
  AlgEquiv.ofBijective (centerAlgHom N) (centerAlgHom_bijective N)

PAG226::centerMathlibEquiv.text:
noncomputable def centerMathlibEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Subalgebra.center ℂ (fullCommAlg N) ≃ₐ[ℂ] centerAlg N where
  toFun Z := ⟨Z.1.1, (mem_centerAlg N _).mpr ((mem_center_fullCommAlg N Z.1).mp Z.2)⟩
  invFun Z := ⟨⟨Z.1, (mem_fullCommAlg N _).mpr ((mem_fullCommCenter N _).mp ((mem_centerAlg N _).mp Z.2)).1⟩,
    (mem_center_fullCommAlg N _).mpr ((mem_centerAlg N _).mp Z.2)⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_mul' _ _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  commutes' _ := rfl

PAG226::centerEquivPi.text:
noncomputable def centerEquivPi (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    (centerIdx N → ℂ) ≃ₐ[ℂ] Subalgebra.center ℂ (fullCommAlg N) :=
  (centerAlgEquiv N).trans (centerMathlibEquiv N).symm

PAG226::centerLinearEquiv.text:
noncomputable def centerLinearEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Subalgebra.center ℂ (fullCommAlg N) ≃ₗ[ℂ] fullCommCenter N where
  toFun Z := ⟨Z.1.1, (mem_center_fullCommAlg N Z.1).mp Z.2⟩
  invFun Z := ⟨⟨Z.1, (mem_fullCommAlg N _).mpr ((mem_fullCommCenter N _).mp Z.2).1⟩,
    (mem_center_fullCommAlg N _).mpr Z.2⟩
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

PAG226::finrank_center_fullCommAlg.text:
theorem finrank_center_fullCommAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Subalgebra.center ℂ (fullCommAlg N)) =
      ∑ c ∈ N.divisors.filter (fun c => 0 < Nat.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive}),
        ∏ q ∈ (Nat.gcd c (N / c)).primeFactors, ((N / c).factorization q + 1)

PAG227::twistFn_mul_twistFn_eq.text:
theorem twistFn_mul_twistFn_eq (N c : ℕ) (χ χ' χ'' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    twistFn N c χ' χ'' * twistFn N c χ χ' = twistFn N c χ χ''

PAG227::twistFn_self_mul_layerInd.text:
theorem twistFn_self_mul_layerInd (N c : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) {d : ℕ}
    (hdI : d ∈ layerIdx c (N / c)) : twistFn N c χ χ * layerInd N c d = layerInd N c d

PAG227::layerInd_mul_layerInd.text:
theorem layerInd_mul_layerInd (N c : ℕ) {d d' : ℕ} (hd : RadDvd d c) (hd' : RadDvd d' c) :
    layerInd N c d * layerInd N c d' = if d = d' then layerInd N c d else 0

PAG227::matUnit.text:
noncomputable def matUnit (N c d : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (twistFn N c χ χ' * layerInd N c d) ∘ₗ blockProjL N c χ

PAG227::matUnit_apply.text:
theorem matUnit_apply (N c d : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    matUnit N c d χ χ' f = twistFn N c χ χ' * (layerInd N c d * blockProj N c χ f)

PAG227::matUnit_mem_layerPart.text:
theorem matUnit_mem_layerPart (N c d : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hd : RadDvd d c) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : matUnit N c d χ χ' f ∈ layerPart N c χ' d

PAG227::matUnit_mem_blockSpan.text:
theorem matUnit_mem_blockSpan (N c d : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hd : RadDvd d c) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : matUnit N c d χ χ' f ∈ blockSpan N c χ'

PAG227::matUnit_mem_fullComm.text:
theorem matUnit_mem_fullComm (N c d : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) (hd : RadDvd d c) : matUnit N c d χ χ' ∈ fullComm N

PAG227::matUnit_apply_of_mem_self.text:
theorem matUnit_apply_of_mem_self (N c d : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ) :
    matUnit N c d χ χ' f = twistFn N c χ χ' * (layerInd N c d * f)

PAG227::matUnit_apply_of_mem_ne.text:
theorem matUnit_apply_of_mem_ne (N c d : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (χ χ' ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (h : χ ≠ ψ)
    {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c ψ) : matUnit N c d χ χ' f = 0

PAG227::matUnit_apply_of_mem_of_ne.text:
theorem matUnit_apply_of_mem_of_ne (N c c' d : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] [NeZero c'] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (hc'N : c' ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c') (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (hcc : c ≠ c') {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c' ψ) :
    matUnit N c d χ χ' f = 0

PAG227::matUnit_mul_self.text:
theorem matUnit_mul_self (N c d : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (hd : RadDvd d c)
    (χ χ' χ'' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) :
    matUnit N c d χ' χ'' * matUnit N c d χ χ' = matUnit N c d χ χ''

PAG227::matUnit_mul_of_ne_char.text:
theorem matUnit_mul_of_ne_char (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (d d' : ℕ) (hd' : RadDvd d' c)
    (ψ χ'' χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) (h : ψ ≠ χ') :
    matUnit N c d ψ χ'' * matUnit N c d' χ χ' = 0

PAG227::matUnit_mul_of_ne_cond.text:
theorem matUnit_mul_of_ne_cond (N c c' d d' : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] [NeZero c'] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (hc'N : c' ∣ N) (hcc : c ≠ c') (ψ χ'' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c')
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) (hd' : RadDvd d' c') :
    matUnit N c d ψ χ'' * matUnit N c' d' χ χ' = 0

PAG227::matUnit_mul_of_ne_layer.text:
theorem matUnit_mul_of_ne_layer (N c c' d d' : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] [NeZero c'] (hcN : c ∣ N)
    (hc'N : c' ∣ N) (hdd : d ≠ d') (ψ χ'' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c')
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) (hd : RadDvd d c) (hd' : RadDvd d' c') :
    matUnit N c d ψ χ'' * matUnit N c' d' χ χ' = 0

PAG227::matUnit_ne_zero.text:
theorem matUnit_ne_zero (N c d : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) (hdI : d ∈ layerIdx c (N / c)) : matUnit N c d χ χ' ≠ 0

PAG227::Prim.text: abbrev Prim (c : ℕ) : Type := {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive}

PAG227::fintypePrim.text: noncomputable instance fintypePrim (c : ℕ) : Fintype (Prim c) := Fintype.ofFinite _

PAG227::decEqPrim.text: noncomputable instance decEqPrim (c : ℕ) : DecidableEq (Prim c) := Classical.decEq _

PAG227::neZero_centerIdx.text:
instance neZero_centerIdx (N : ℕ) (p : centerIdx N) : NeZero p.1.1 :=
  ⟨(Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors ((mem_centerIdx N p.1).mp p.2).1).ne'⟩

PAG227::sum_matUnit_self.text:
theorem sum_matUnit_self (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hc : c ∈ N.divisors) {d : ℕ}
    (hdI : d ∈ layerIdx c (N / c)) : ∑ i : Prim c, matUnit N c d i.1 i.1 = centralElt N c d

PAG227::sum_sum_matUnit_self.text:
theorem sum_sum_matUnit_self (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    ∑ p : centerIdx N, ∑ i : Prim p.1.1, matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 i.1 i.1 = 1

PAG227::matUnit_mul_of_ne_idx.text:
theorem matUnit_mul_of_ne_idx (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {p q : centerIdx N} (hpq : p ≠ q) (i j : Prim p.1.1)
    (k l : Prim q.1.1) : matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 j.1 i.1 * matUnit N q.1.1 q.1.2 l.1 k.1 = 0

PAG227::matSum.text:
noncomputable def matSum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) :
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  ∑ p : centerIdx N, ∑ i : Prim p.1.1, ∑ j : Prim p.1.1, M p i j • matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 j.1 i.1

PAG227::matSum_mem_fullComm.text:
theorem matSum_mem_fullComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) :
    matSum N M ∈ fullComm N

PAG227::matSum_add.text:
theorem matSum_add (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M M' : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) :
    matSum N (M + M') = matSum N M + matSum N M'

PAG227::matSum_smul.text:
theorem matSum_smul (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (r : ℂ) (M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) :
    matSum N (r • M) = r • matSum N M

PAG227::matSumL.text:
noncomputable def matSumL (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun := matSum N
  map_add' := matSum_add N
  map_smul' := matSum_smul N

PAG227::matSum_mul_eq.text:
theorem matSum_mul_eq (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
    (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    matSum N M * T = ∑ p : centerIdx N, ∑ i : Prim p.1.1, ∑ j : Prim p.1.1,
      M p i j • (matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 j.1 i.1 * T)

PAG227::matUnit_mul_matSum.text:
theorem matUnit_mul_matSum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
    (p : centerIdx N) (i j : Prim p.1.1) :
    matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 j.1 i.1 * matSum N M = ∑ l : Prim p.1.1, M p j l • matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 l.1 i.1

PAG227::matSum_mul.text:
theorem matSum_mul (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M M' : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) :
    matSum N (M * M') = matSum N M * matSum N M'

PAG227::matSum_one.text: theorem matSum_one (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : matSum N 1 = 1

PAG227::matUnit_mul_matSum_mul_matUnit.text:
theorem matUnit_mul_matSum_mul_matUnit (N : ℕ) [NeZero N]
    (M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) (p : centerIdx N) (i j : Prim p.1.1) :
    matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 i.1 i.1 * matSum N M * matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 j.1 j.1 =
      M p i j • matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 j.1 i.1

PAG227::matSum_eq_zero.text:
theorem matSum_eq_zero (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ}
    (h : matSum N M = 0) : M = 0

PAG227::matAlgHom.text:
noncomputable def matAlgHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] fullCommAlg N :=
  AlgHom.ofLinearMap
    { toFun := fun M => ⟨matSum N M, (mem_fullCommAlg N _).mpr (matSum_mem_fullComm N M)⟩
      map_add' := fun M M' => Subtype.ext (by
        show matSum N (M + M') = matSum N M + matSum N M'
        exact matSum_add N M M')
      map_smul' := fun r M => Subtype.ext (by
        show matSum N (r • M) = r • matSum N M
        exact matSum_smul N r M) }
    (Subtype.ext (by
      show matSum N 1 = 1
      exact matSum_one N))
    (fun M M' => Subtype.ext (by
      show matSum N (M * M') = matSum N M * matSum N M'
      exact matSum_mul N M M'))

PAG227::matAlgHom_apply.text:
theorem matAlgHom_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) :
    (matAlgHom N M : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) = matSum N M

PAG227::matAlgHom_injective.text: theorem matAlgHom_injective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Function.Injective (matAlgHom N)

PAG227::fullCommAlgLinearEquiv.text:
noncomputable def fullCommAlgLinearEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : fullCommAlg N ≃ₗ[ℂ] fullComm N where
  toFun T := ⟨T.1, (mem_fullCommAlg N _).mp T.2⟩
  invFun T := ⟨T.1, (mem_fullCommAlg N _).mpr T.2⟩
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

PAG227::finrank_fullCommAlg.text:
theorem finrank_fullCommAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommAlg N) = ∑ c ∈ N.divisors, Nat.card (Prim c) ^ 2 *
      ∏ q ∈ (Nat.gcd c (N / c)).primeFactors, ((N / c).factorization q + 1)

PAG227::finrank_matrixPi.text:
theorem finrank_matrixPi (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) =
      ∑ c ∈ N.divisors, Nat.card (Prim c) ^ 2 *
        ∏ q ∈ (Nat.gcd c (N / c)).primeFactors, ((N / c).factorization q + 1)

PAG227::matLin.text:
noncomputable def matLin (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] fullCommAlg N where
  toFun M := ⟨matSum N M, (mem_fullCommAlg N _).mpr (matSum_mem_fullComm N M)⟩
  map_add' M M' := Subtype.ext (by
    show matSum N (M + M') = matSum N M + matSum N M'
    exact matSum_add N M M')
  map_smul' r M := Subtype.ext (by
    show matSum N (r • M) = r • matSum N M
    exact matSum_smul N r M)

PAG227::matAlgHom_bijective.text: theorem matAlgHom_bijective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Function.Bijective (matAlgHom N)

PAG227::fullCommMatrixEquiv.text:
noncomputable def fullCommMatrixEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) ≃ₐ[ℂ] fullCommAlg N :=
  AlgEquiv.ofBijective (matAlgHom N) (matAlgHom_bijective N)

PAG227::matSum_single_one.text:
theorem matSum_single_one (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : centerIdx N) :
    matSum N (Pi.single p 1) = centralElt N p.1.1 p.1.2

PAG228::doubleComm.text:
noncomputable def doubleComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :=
  Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (fullComm N : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)))

PAG228::mem_doubleComm.text:
theorem mem_doubleComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    T ∈ doubleComm N ↔ ∀ S ∈ fullComm N, Commute T S

PAG228::shellAlg_le_doubleComm.text: theorem shellAlg_le_doubleComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : shellAlg N ≤ doubleComm N

PAG228::mem_doubleComm_iff_matUnit.text:
theorem mem_doubleComm_iff_matUnit (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    T ∈ doubleComm N ↔ ∀ (p : centerIdx N) (i j : Prim p.1.1), Commute T (matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 i.1 j.1)

PAG228::refChar.text:
noncomputable def refChar (N : ℕ) (p : centerIdx N) : Prim p.1.1 :=
  Classical.choice (Nat.card_pos_iff.mp ((mem_centerIdx N p.1).mp p.2).2.1).1

PAG228::refLayer.text:
noncomputable def refLayer (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : centerIdx N) : Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  layerPart N p.1.1 (refChar N p).1 p.1.2

PAG228::refProj.text:
noncomputable def refProj (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : centerIdx N) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 (refChar N p).1 (refChar N p).1

PAG228::refProj_mem.text: theorem refProj_mem (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : centerIdx N) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : refProj N p f ∈ refLayer N p

PAG228::refProj_apply_of_mem.text:
theorem refProj_apply_of_mem (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : centerIdx N) {g : ZMod N → ℂ} (hg : g ∈ refLayer N p) :
    refProj N p g = g

PAG228::doubleComm_mapsTo.text:
theorem doubleComm_mapsTo (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hT : T ∈ doubleComm N)
    (p : centerIdx N) {g : ZMod N → ℂ} (hg : g ∈ refLayer N p) : T g ∈ refLayer N p

PAG228::restrictHom.text:
noncomputable def restrictHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    doubleComm N →ₐ[ℂ] Π p : centerIdx N, Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p) :=
  AlgHom.ofLinearMap
    { toFun := fun T p => (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)).restrict (fun _ hg => doubleComm_mapsTo N T.2 p hg)
      map_add' := fun _ _ => funext fun _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => Subtype.ext rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => funext fun _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => Subtype.ext rfl }
    (funext fun _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => Subtype.ext rfl)
    (fun _ _ => funext fun _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => Subtype.ext rfl)

PAG228::restrictHom_apply.text:
theorem restrictHom_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : doubleComm N) (p : centerIdx N) (g : refLayer N p) :
    (restrictHom N T p g : ZMod N → ℂ) = (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) g

PAG228::extOp.text:
noncomputable def extOp (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : centerIdx N) (S : Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p)) :
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  (refLayer N p).subtype ∘ₗ S ∘ₗ LinearMap.codRestrict (refLayer N p) (refProj N p) (refProj_mem N p)

PAG228::extOp_apply.text:
theorem extOp_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : centerIdx N) (S : Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p)) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    extOp N p S f = (S ⟨refProj N p f, refProj_mem N p f⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ)

PAG228::extOp_restrictHom.text:
theorem extOp_restrictHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : doubleComm N) (p : centerIdx N) :
    extOp N p (restrictHom N T p) = (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) * refProj N p

PAG228::refProj_mul_extOp.text:
theorem refProj_mul_extOp (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : centerIdx N) (S : Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p)) :
    refProj N p * extOp N p S = extOp N p S

PAG228::liftOp.text:
noncomputable def liftOp (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Π p : centerIdx N, Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p)) :
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  ∑ p : centerIdx N, ∑ χ : Prim p.1.1,
    matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 (refChar N p).1 χ.1 * extOp N p (S p) * matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 χ.1 (refChar N p).1

PAG228::matUnit_mul_liftOp.text:
theorem matUnit_mul_liftOp (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Π p : centerIdx N, Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p))
    (q : centerIdx N) (i j : Prim q.1.1) :
    matUnit N q.1.1 q.1.2 i.1 j.1 * liftOp N S =
      matUnit N q.1.1 q.1.2 (refChar N q).1 j.1 * extOp N q (S q) * matUnit N q.1.1 q.1.2 i.1 (refChar N q).1

PAG228::liftOp_mul_matUnit.text:
theorem liftOp_mul_matUnit (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Π p : centerIdx N, Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p))
    (q : centerIdx N) (i j : Prim q.1.1) :
    liftOp N S * matUnit N q.1.1 q.1.2 i.1 j.1 =
      matUnit N q.1.1 q.1.2 (refChar N q).1 j.1 * extOp N q (S q) * matUnit N q.1.1 q.1.2 i.1 (refChar N q).1

PAG228::liftOp_mem.text:
theorem liftOp_mem (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Π p : centerIdx N, Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p)) :
    liftOp N S ∈ doubleComm N

PAG228::restrictHom_liftOp.text:
theorem restrictHom_liftOp (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Π p : centerIdx N, Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p)) :
    restrictHom N ⟨liftOp N S, liftOp_mem N S⟩ = S

PAG228::liftOp_restrictHom.text:
theorem liftOp_restrictHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : doubleComm N) :
    liftOp N (restrictHom N T) = T

PAG228::restrictHom_injective.text: theorem restrictHom_injective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Function.Injective (restrictHom N)

PAG228::restrictHom_surjective.text: theorem restrictHom_surjective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Function.Surjective (restrictHom N)

PAG228::doubleCommEquiv.text:
noncomputable def doubleCommEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    doubleComm N ≃ₐ[ℂ] Π p : centerIdx N, Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p) :=
  AlgEquiv.ofBijective (restrictHom N) ⟨restrictHom_injective N, restrictHom_surjective N⟩

PAG228::doubleCommMatrixEquiv.text:
noncomputable def doubleCommMatrixEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    doubleComm N ≃ₐ[ℂ] Π p : centerIdx N,
      Matrix (Fin (Module.finrank ℂ (refLayer N p))) (Fin (Module.finrank ℂ (refLayer N p))) ℂ :=
  (doubleCommEquiv N).trans
    (AlgEquiv.piCongrRight (fun p => LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv (Module.finBasis ℂ (refLayer N p))))

PAG228::doubleCommLinearEquiv.text:
noncomputable def doubleCommLinearEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    doubleComm N ≃ₗ[ℂ] Π p : centerIdx N, Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p) where
  toFun T := restrictHom N T
  invFun S := ⟨liftOp N S, liftOp_mem N S⟩
  map_add' T T' := map_add (restrictHom N) T T'
  map_smul' r T := map_smul (restrictHom N) r T
  left_inv T := Subtype.ext (liftOp_restrictHom N T)
  right_inv S := restrictHom_liftOp N S

PAG228::finrank_refLayer.text:
theorem finrank_refLayer (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : centerIdx N) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (refLayer N p) = (layerDivs p.1.1 p.1.2 (N / p.1.1)).card

PAG228::finrank_piEnd.text:
theorem finrank_piEnd (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Π p : centerIdx N, Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p)) =
      ∑ p : centerIdx N, (layerDivs p.1.1 p.1.2 (N / p.1.1)).card ^ 2

PAG228::finrank_doubleComm.text:
theorem finrank_doubleComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (doubleComm N) = ∑ p : centerIdx N, (layerDivs p.1.1 p.1.2 (N / p.1.1)).card ^ 2

PAG228::finrank_shellAlg_le.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg_le (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg N) ≤ ∑ p : centerIdx N, (layerDivs p.1.1 p.1.2 (N / p.1.1)).card ^ 2

PAG229::herm.text: noncomputable def herm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) : ℂ := ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (f x) * g x

PAG229::herm_conj.text: theorem herm_conj (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) : starRingEnd ℂ (herm N f g) = herm N g f

PAG229::herm_add_left.text:
theorem herm_add_left (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f f' g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    herm N (f + f') g = herm N f g + herm N f' g

PAG229::herm_add_right.text:
theorem herm_add_right (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f g g' : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    herm N f (g + g') = herm N f g + herm N f g'

PAG229::herm_smul_left.text:
theorem herm_smul_left (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : ℂ) (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    herm N (c • f) g = starRingEnd ℂ c * herm N f g

PAG229::herm_smul_right.text:
theorem herm_smul_right (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : ℂ) (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    herm N f (c • g) = c * herm N f g

PAG229::herm_self_eq_zero.text: theorem herm_self_eq_zero (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (h : herm N f f = 0) : f = 0

PAG229::herm_sub_right.text:
theorem herm_sub_right (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f g g' : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    herm N f (g - g') = herm N f g - herm N f g'

PAG229::herm_ext.text: theorem herm_ext (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {u v : ZMod N → ℂ} (h : ∀ f, herm N f u = herm N f v) : u = v

PAG229::conj_dind.text: theorem conj_dind (N s : ℕ) (x : ZMod N) : starRingEnd ℂ (dind N s x) = dind N s x

PAG229::conj_geps.text: theorem conj_geps (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (x : ZMod N) : starRingEnd ℂ (geps N s x) = geps N s (-x)

PAG229::pairEquiv.text:
def pairEquiv (N : ℕ) : ZMod N × ZMod N ≃ ZMod N × ZMod N where
  toFun p := (p.1 - p.2, -p.2)
  invFun p := (p.1 - p.2, -p.2)
  left_inv p := by ext <;> simp
  right_inv p := by ext <;> simp

PAG229::herm_conv.text:
theorem herm_conv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b f g : ZMod N → ℂ) (hab : ∀ y, b y = starRingEnd ℂ (a (-y))) :
    herm N (PAG.Part15.conv a f) g = herm N f (PAG.Part15.conv b g)

PAG229::herm_geps_conv.text:
theorem herm_geps_conv (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    herm N (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) g = herm N f (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) g)

PAG229::herm_dind_mul.text:
theorem herm_dind_mul (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    herm N (dind N s * f) g = herm N f (dind N s * g)

PAG229::AdjClosed.text:
def AdjClosed (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))) : Prop :=
  ∀ T ∈ B, ∃ T' ∈ B, ∀ f g, herm N (T f) g = herm N f (T' g)

PAG229::shellAlg_adjClosed.text: theorem shellAlg_adjClosed (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : AdjClosed N (shellAlg N)

PAG229::apply_eq_sum_single.text:
theorem apply_eq_sum_single (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (x : ZMod N) :
    T f x = ∑ y, f y * T (Pi.single y 1) x

PAG229::adjOp.text:
noncomputable def adjOp (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun g y := ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (T (Pi.single y 1) x) * g x
  map_add' g g' := by
    funext y
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' c g := by
    funext y
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
    ring

PAG229::herm_adjOp.text:
theorem herm_adjOp (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    herm N (T f) g = herm N f (adjOp N T g)

PAG229::adjOp_mem_fullComm.text:
theorem adjOp_mem_fullComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hT : T ∈ fullComm N) :
    adjOp N T ∈ fullComm N

PAG229::fullCommAlg_adjClosed.text: theorem fullCommAlg_adjClosed (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : AdjClosed N (fullCommAlg N)

PAG229::algebraMap_sub_smul.text:
theorem algebraMap_sub_smul (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))) (c : ℂ)
    (m : ZMod N → ℂ) : (algebraMap ℂ B c) • m = c • m

PAG229::perpSub.text:
noncomputable def perpSub (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))}
    (hB : AdjClosed N B) (K : Submodule B (ZMod N → ℂ)) : Submodule B (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  carrier := {g | ∀ k ∈ K, herm N k g = 0}
  add_mem' := fun {g g'} hg hg' k hk => by rw [herm_add_right, hg k hk, hg' k hk, add_zero]
  zero_mem' := fun k _ => by unfold herm; simp
  smul_mem' := fun a g hg k hk => by
    obtain ⟨a', ha', e⟩ := hB a.1 a.2
    have hk' : (⟨a', ha'⟩ : B) • k ∈ K := K.smul_mem _ hk
    show herm N k ((a : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) g) = 0
    rw [← herm_conj, e, herm_conj]
    exact hg _ hk'

PAG229::herm_eq_inner.text:
theorem herm_eq_inner (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    herm N f g = inner ℂ (WithLp.toLp 2 f : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ZMod N)) (WithLp.toLp 2 g)

PAG229::toEuclid.text:
noncomputable def toEuclid (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))}
    (K : Submodule B (ZMod N → ℂ)) : Submodule ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ (ZMod N)) where
  carrier := {x | WithLp.ofLp x ∈ K}
  add_mem' := fun {x y} hx hy => by
    show WithLp.ofLp (x + y) ∈ K
    rw [WithLp.ofLp_add]; exact K.add_mem hx hy
  zero_mem' := by
    show WithLp.ofLp (0 : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ZMod N)) ∈ K
    rw [WithLp.ofLp_zero]; exact K.zero_mem
  smul_mem' := fun c x hx => by
    show WithLp.ofLp (c • x) ∈ K
    rw [WithLp.ofLp_smul, ← algebraMap_sub_smul N B]
    exact K.smul_mem _ hx

PAG229::isCompl_perpSub.text:
theorem isCompl_perpSub (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))}
    (hB : AdjClosed N B) (K : Submodule B (ZMod N → ℂ)) : IsCompl K (perpSub N hB K)

PAG229::isSemisimpleModule_of_adjClosed.text:
theorem isSemisimpleModule_of_adjClosed (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))}
    (hB : AdjClosed N B) : IsSemisimpleModule B (ZMod N → ℂ)

PAG229::isSemisimpleRing_of_adjClosed.text:
theorem isSemisimpleRing_of_adjClosed (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))}
    (hB : AdjClosed N B) : IsSemisimpleRing B

PAG229::shellAlg_isSemisimpleModule.text: theorem shellAlg_isSemisimpleModule (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : IsSemisimpleModule (shellAlg N) (ZMod N → ℂ)

PAG229::shellAlg_isSemisimpleRing.text: theorem shellAlg_isSemisimpleRing (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : IsSemisimpleRing (shellAlg N)

PAG229::fullCommAlg_isSemisimpleRing.text: theorem fullCommAlg_isSemisimpleRing (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : IsSemisimpleRing (fullCommAlg N)

PAG229::endToComplex.text:
noncomputable def endToComplex (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (φ : Module.End (shellAlg N) (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun := φ
  map_add' := φ.map_add
  map_smul' c m := by
    rw [RingHom.id_apply, ← algebraMap_sub_smul N (shellAlg N), φ.map_smul, algebraMap_sub_smul N (shellAlg N)]

PAG229::endToComplex_mem_fullComm.text:
theorem endToComplex_mem_fullComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (φ : Module.End (shellAlg N) (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    endToComplex N φ ∈ fullComm N

PAG229::doubleComm_le_shellAlg.text: theorem doubleComm_le_shellAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : doubleComm N ≤ shellAlg N

PAG229::shellAlg_eq_doubleComm.text: theorem shellAlg_eq_doubleComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : shellAlg N = doubleComm N

PAG229::finrank_shellAlg.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg N) = ∑ p : centerIdx N, (layerDivs p.1.1 p.1.2 (N / p.1.1)).card ^ 2

PAG229::shellAlgEquiv.text:
noncomputable def shellAlgEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    shellAlg N ≃ₐ[ℂ] Π p : centerIdx N, Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p) :=
  (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ (shellAlg_eq_doubleComm N)).trans (doubleCommEquiv N)

PAG229::shellAlgMatrixEquiv.text:
noncomputable def shellAlgMatrixEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    shellAlg N ≃ₐ[ℂ] Π p : centerIdx N,
      Matrix (Fin (Module.finrank ℂ (refLayer N p))) (Fin (Module.finrank ℂ (refLayer N p))) ℂ :=
  (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ (shellAlg_eq_doubleComm N)).trans (doubleCommMatrixEquiv N)

PAG229::mem_shellAlg_iff_commute.text:
theorem mem_shellAlg_iff_commute (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    T ∈ shellAlg N ↔ ∀ S ∈ fullComm N, Commute T S

PAG229::mem_fullCommCenter_iff.text:
theorem mem_fullCommCenter_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (Z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    Z ∈ fullCommCenter N ↔ Z ∈ shellAlg N ∧ Z ∈ fullComm N

PAG229::centralElt_mem_shellAlg.text:
theorem centralElt_mem_shellAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] (c d : ℕ) (hd : RadDvd d c) :
    centralElt N c d ∈ shellAlg N

PAG229::mem_center_shellAlg.text:
theorem mem_center_shellAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (Z : shellAlg N) :
    Z ∈ Subalgebra.center ℂ (shellAlg N) ↔ (Z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) ∈ fullCommCenter N

PAG229::centerShellMathlibEquiv.text:
noncomputable def centerShellMathlibEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Subalgebra.center ℂ (shellAlg N) ≃ₐ[ℂ] centerAlg N where
  toFun Z := ⟨Z.1.1, (mem_centerAlg N _).mpr ((mem_center_shellAlg N Z.1).mp Z.2)⟩
  invFun Z := ⟨⟨Z.1, ((mem_fullCommCenter_iff N _).mp ((mem_centerAlg N _).mp Z.2)).1⟩,
    (mem_center_shellAlg N _).mpr ((mem_centerAlg N _).mp Z.2)⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_mul' _ _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  commutes' _ := rfl

PAG229::centerShellEquivPi.text:
noncomputable def centerShellEquivPi (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    (centerIdx N → ℂ) ≃ₐ[ℂ] Subalgebra.center ℂ (shellAlg N) :=
  (centerAlgEquiv N).trans (centerShellMathlibEquiv N).symm

PAG229::centerShellLinearEquiv.text:
noncomputable def centerShellLinearEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Subalgebra.center ℂ (shellAlg N) ≃ₗ[ℂ] fullCommCenter N where
  toFun Z := ⟨Z.1.1, (mem_center_shellAlg N Z.1).mp Z.2⟩
  invFun Z := ⟨⟨Z.1, ((mem_fullCommCenter_iff N _).mp Z.2).1⟩, (mem_center_shellAlg N _).mpr Z.2⟩
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

PAG229::finrank_center_shellAlg.text:
theorem finrank_center_shellAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Subalgebra.center ℂ (shellAlg N)) =
      ∑ c ∈ N.divisors.filter (fun c => 0 < Nat.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive}),
        ∏ q ∈ (Nat.gcd c (N / c)).primeFactors, ((N / c).factorization q + 1)

PAG230::primCount.text: noncomputable def primCount (c : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive}

PAG230::totientAF.text: noncomputable def totientAF : ArithmeticFunction ℤ := ⟨fun n => (Nat.totient n : ℤ), by simp⟩

PAG230::totientAF_apply.text: theorem totientAF_apply (n : ℕ) : totientAF n = (Nat.totient n : ℤ)

PAG230::primCount_eq_moebius_mul.text:
theorem primCount_eq_moebius_mul (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (primCount n : ℤ) = (ArithmeticFunction.moebius * totientAF) n

PAG230::primCount_mul.text: theorem primCount_mul {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) : primCount (a * b) = primCount a * primCount b

PAG230::primCount_eq_prod.text:
theorem primCount_eq_prod {c : ℕ} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    primCount c = ∏ q ∈ c.primeFactors, primCount (q ^ c.factorization q)

PAG230::primCount_eq_prod_of_dvd.text:
theorem primCount_eq_prod_of_dvd {c N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (hcN : c ∣ N) :
    primCount c = ∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors, primCount (q ^ c.factorization q)

PAG230::primCount_prime_pow_succ_add.text:
theorem primCount_prime_pow_succ_add {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (k : ℕ) :
    primCount (p ^ (k + 1)) + Nat.totient (p ^ k) = Nat.totient (p ^ (k + 1))

PAG230::primCount_prime.text: theorem primCount_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : primCount p = p - 2

PAG230::primCount_prime_pow.text:
theorem primCount_prime_pow {p k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    primCount (p ^ k) = p ^ (k - 2) * (p - 1) ^ 2

PAG230::primCount_prime_pow_pos_iff.text:
theorem primCount_prime_pow_pos_iff {p k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    0 < primCount (p ^ k) ↔ ¬ (p = 2 ∧ k = 1)

PAG230::primCount_pos_iff.text: theorem primCount_pos_iff {c : ℕ} (hc : c ≠ 0) : 0 < primCount c ↔ c.factorization 2 ≠ 1

PAG230::factorization_two_eq_one_iff.text: theorem factorization_two_eq_one_iff {c : ℕ} (hc : c ≠ 0) : c.factorization 2 = 1 ↔ c % 4 = 2

PAG230::card_layerDivs.text:
theorem card_layerDivs {c L d : ℕ} (hL : L ≠ 0) (hd : d ∈ layerIdx c L) :
    (layerDivs c d L).card = ∏ q ∈ L.primeFactors.filter (fun q => ¬ q ∣ c), (L.factorization q + 1)

PAG230::sum_card_layerDivs.text:
theorem sum_card_layerDivs {c L : ℕ} (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    ∑ d ∈ layerIdx c L, (layerDivs c d L).card = L.divisors.card

PAG230::sum_centerIdx_card_mul_primCount.text:
theorem sum_centerIdx_card_mul_primCount (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    ∑ p : centerIdx N, (layerDivs p.1.1 p.1.2 (N / p.1.1)).card * primCount p.1.1 = N

PAG230::factorization_prod_pow_subtype.text:
theorem factorization_prod_pow_subtype {s : Finset ℕ} (hs : ∀ q ∈ s, q.Prime) (x : s → ℕ) (r : s) :
    (∏ q : s, (q : ℕ) ^ x q).factorization r = x r

PAG230::prod_primeFactors_pow_factorizat.text:
theorem prod_primeFactors_pow_factorization {c N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (hcN : c ∣ N) :
    ∏ q : N.primeFactors, (q : ℕ) ^ c.factorization q = c

PAG230::sum_divisors_prod_factorization.text:
theorem sum_divisors_prod_factorization {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (w : ℕ → ℕ → R) :
    ∑ c ∈ N.divisors, ∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors, w q (c.factorization q) =
      ∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors, ∑ γ ∈ Finset.range (N.factorization q + 1), w q γ

PAG230::ind_primCount_pos_eq_prod.text:
theorem ind_primCount_pos_eq_prod {c N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (hcN : c ∣ N) :
    (if 0 < primCount c then 1 else 0 : ℕ) =
      ∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors, (if 0 < primCount (q ^ c.factorization q) then 1 else 0 : ℕ)

PAG230::card_layerIdx_eq_prod.text:
theorem card_layerIdx_eq_prod {c N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (hcN : c ∣ N) :
    (layerIdx c (N / c)).card = ∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors,
      (if c.factorization q = 0 then 1 else N.factorization q + 1 - c.factorization q)

PAG230::layerSize_eq_prod.text:
theorem layerSize_eq_prod {c N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (hcN : c ∣ N) :
    ∏ q ∈ (N / c).primeFactors.filter (fun q => ¬ q ∣ c), ((N / c).factorization q + 1) =
      ∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors, (if c.factorization q = 0 then N.factorization q + 1 else 1)

PAG230::sum_range_eq_add_sum_Icc.text:
theorem sum_range_eq_add_sum_Icc {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ γ ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), f γ = f 0 + ∑ γ ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, f γ

PAG230::finrank_shellAlg_eq_prod_sum.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg_eq_prod_sum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg N) = ∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors,
      ((N.factorization q + 1) ^ 2 + ∑ γ ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (N.factorization q),
        (if 0 < primCount (q ^ γ) then N.factorization q + 1 - γ else 0))

PAG230::two_mul_sum_Icc_sub.text: theorem two_mul_sum_Icc_sub (k : ℕ) : 2 * ∑ γ ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, (k + 1 - γ) = k * (k + 1)

PAG230::sum_Icc_primCount_pos.text:
theorem sum_Icc_primCount_pos {q k : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) :
    ∑ γ ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, (if 0 < primCount (q ^ γ) then k + 1 - γ else 0) =
      k * (k + 1) / 2 - (if q = 2 then k else 0)

PAG230::finrank_shellAlg_eq_prod.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg_eq_prod (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg N) = ∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors,
      ((N.factorization q + 1) ^ 2 + N.factorization q * (N.factorization q + 1) / 2 -
        (if q = 2 then N.factorization q else 0))

PAG230::card_part214.text:
theorem card_part214 (p k : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.range k ×ˢ Finset.range k).filter (fun st : ℕ × ℕ =>
      st.1 + st.2 ≤ k - 1 ∧ 0 < primCount (p ^ (k - st.1 - st.2)))).card =
      ∑ γ ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, (if 0 < primCount (p ^ γ) then k + 1 - γ else 0)

PAG230::finrank_shellAlg_eq_part214.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg_eq_part214 (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg N) = ∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors, ((N.factorization q + 1) ^ 2 +
      ((Finset.range (N.factorization q) ×ˢ Finset.range (N.factorization q)).filter (fun st : ℕ × ℕ =>
        st.1 + st.2 ≤ N.factorization q - 1 ∧
          0 < primCount (q ^ (N.factorization q - st.1 - st.2)))).card)

PAG230::finrank_fullComm_eq_prod.text:
theorem finrank_fullComm_eq_prod (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullComm N) = ∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors,
      (1 + ∑ γ ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (N.factorization q), primCount (q ^ γ) ^ 2 * (N.factorization q + 1 - γ))

PAG230::finrank_fullCommCenter_eq_prod_s.text:
theorem finrank_fullCommCenter_eq_prod_sum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommCenter N) = ∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors,
      (1 + ∑ γ ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (N.factorization q),
        (if 0 < primCount (q ^ γ) then N.factorization q + 1 - γ else 0))

PAG230::finrank_fullCommCenter_eq_prod.text:
theorem finrank_fullCommCenter_eq_prod (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommCenter N) = ∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors,
      (1 + N.factorization q * (N.factorization q + 1) / 2 - (if q = 2 then N.factorization q else 0))

PAG230::finrank_center_shellAlg_eq_prod.text:
theorem finrank_center_shellAlg_eq_prod (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Subalgebra.center ℂ (shellAlg N)) = ∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors,
      (1 + N.factorization q * (N.factorization q + 1) / 2 - (if q = 2 then N.factorization q else 0))

PAG230::prod_primeFactors_mul_of_coprime.text:
theorem prod_primeFactors_mul_of_coprime {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∏ q ∈ (a * b).primeFactors, f q ((a * b).factorization q) =
      (∏ q ∈ a.primeFactors, f q (a.factorization q)) * ∏ q ∈ b.primeFactors, f q (b.factorization q)

PAG230::finrank_shellAlg_mul.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg_mul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg (a * b)) = Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg a) * Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg b)

PAG230::finrank_fullComm_mul.text:
theorem finrank_fullComm_mul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullComm (a * b)) = Module.finrank ℂ (fullComm a) * Module.finrank ℂ (fullComm b)

PAG230::finrank_fullCommCenter_mul.text:
theorem finrank_fullCommCenter_mul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommCenter (a * b)) =
      Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommCenter a) * Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommCenter b)

PAG231::bimodSpace.text: abbrev bimodSpace (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Type := Π p : centerIdx N, Prim p.1.1 → refLayer N p

PAG231::matUnit_mem_refLayer.text:
theorem matUnit_mem_refLayer (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : centerIdx N) (χ : Prim p.1.1) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 χ.1 (refChar N p).1 f ∈ refLayer N p

PAG231::bimodMap.text:
noncomputable def bimodMap (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : bimodSpace N →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun w := ∑ p : centerIdx N, ∑ χ : Prim p.1.1,
    matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 (refChar N p).1 χ.1 (w p χ : ZMod N → ℂ)
  map_add' w w' := by
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add, map_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' r w := by
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, map_smul, Finset.smul_sum, RingHom.id_apply]

PAG231::bimodMap_apply.text:
theorem bimodMap_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (w : bimodSpace N) :
    bimodMap N w = ∑ p : centerIdx N, ∑ χ : Prim p.1.1,
      matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 (refChar N p).1 χ.1 (w p χ : ZMod N → ℂ)

PAG231::matUnit_bimodMap.text:
theorem matUnit_bimodMap (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : centerIdx N) (i j : Prim q.1.1) (w : bimodSpace N) :
    matUnit N q.1.1 q.1.2 j.1 i.1 (bimodMap N w) =
      matUnit N q.1.1 q.1.2 (refChar N q).1 i.1 (w q j : ZMod N → ℂ)

PAG231::bimodInv.text:
noncomputable def bimodInv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] bimodSpace N where
  toFun f p χ := ⟨matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 χ.1 (refChar N p).1 f, matUnit_mem_refLayer N p χ f⟩
  map_add' f g := by
    funext p χ
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [map_add, Pi.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add]
  map_smul' r f := by
    funext p χ
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [map_smul, Pi.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, RingHom.id_apply]

PAG231::bimodInv_apply.text:
theorem bimodInv_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (p : centerIdx N) (χ : Prim p.1.1) :
    (bimodInv N f p χ : ZMod N → ℂ) = matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 χ.1 (refChar N p).1 f

PAG231::bimodInv_bimodMap.text: theorem bimodInv_bimodMap (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (w : bimodSpace N) : bimodInv N (bimodMap N w) = w

PAG231::bimodMap_bimodInv.text: theorem bimodMap_bimodInv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : bimodMap N (bimodInv N f) = f

PAG231::bimodEquiv.text:
noncomputable def bimodEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : bimodSpace N ≃ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  { bimodMap N with
    invFun := bimodInv N
    left_inv := bimodInv_bimodMap N
    right_inv := bimodMap_bimodInv N }

PAG231::finrank_bimodSpace.text:
theorem finrank_bimodSpace (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (bimodSpace N) = ∑ p : centerIdx N,
      PAG.Part230.primCount p.1.1 * (layerDivs p.1.1 p.1.2 (N / p.1.1)).card

PAG231::sum_primCount_mul_card_layerDivs.text:
theorem sum_primCount_mul_card_layerDivs (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    ∑ p : centerIdx N, PAG.Part230.primCount p.1.1 * (layerDivs p.1.1 p.1.2 (N / p.1.1)).card = N

PAG231::bimodMap_restrictHom.text:
theorem bimodMap_restrictHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : doubleComm N) (w : bimodSpace N) :
    bimodMap N (fun p χ => restrictHom N T p (w p χ)) = (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) (bimodMap N w)

PAG231::shellAlg_apply_bimodMap.text:
