theorem shellAlg_apply_bimodMap (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : shellAlg N) (w : bimodSpace N) :
    (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) (bimodMap N w) = bimodMap N (fun p χ => shellAlgEquiv N T p (w p χ))

PAG231::matSum_bimodMap.text:
theorem matSum_bimodMap (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
    (w : bimodSpace N) :
    matSum N M (bimodMap N w) = bimodMap N (fun p i => ∑ j : Prim p.1.1, M p i j • w p j)

PAG231::fullComm_apply_bimodMap.text:
theorem fullComm_apply_bimodMap (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hS : S ∈ fullComm N) :
    ∃ M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ, ∀ w : bimodSpace N,
      S (bimodMap N w) = bimodMap N (fun p i => ∑ j : Prim p.1.1, M p i j • w p j)

PAG231::bimodInv_shellAlg_apply.text:
theorem bimodInv_shellAlg_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : shellAlg N) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    bimodInv N ((T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f) = fun p χ => shellAlgEquiv N T p (bimodInv N f p χ)

PAG231::bimodInv_matSum_apply.text:
theorem bimodInv_matSum_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
    (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    bimodInv N (matSum N M f) = fun p i => ∑ j : Prim p.1.1, M p i j • bimodInv N f p j

PAG231::dil_bimodMap.text:
theorem dil_bimodMap (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (w : bimodSpace N) :
    dil a (bimodMap N w) = bimodMap N (fun p χ => liftc χ.1 N (a : ZMod N) • w p χ)

PAG231::dil_eq_matSum.text:
theorem dil_eq_matSum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) :
    dil a = matSum N (fun p => Matrix.diagonal (fun χ : Prim p.1.1 => liftc χ.1 N (a : ZMod N)))

PAG231::exists_unit_liftc_ne.text:
theorem exists_unit_liftc_ne (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hcN : c ∣ N) {χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c} (h : χ ≠ χ') :
    ∃ a : (ZMod N)ˣ, liftc χ N (a : ZMod N) ≠ liftc χ' N (a : ZMod N)

PAG231::exists_ne_zero_refLayer.text: theorem exists_ne_zero_refLayer (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : centerIdx N) : ∃ w : refLayer N p, w ≠ 0

PAG231::matSum_mem_dilCommute_iff.text:
theorem matSum_mem_dilCommute_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N]
    (M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) :
    matSum N M ∈ dilCommute N ↔ ∀ (p : centerIdx N) (i j : Prim p.1.1), i ≠ j → M p i j = 0

PAG231::mem_dilComm_iff_matSum.text:
theorem mem_dilComm_iff_matSum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    S ∈ dilComm N ↔ ∃ M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ,
      matSum N M = S ∧ ∀ (p : centerIdx N) (i j : Prim p.1.1), i ≠ j → M p i j = 0

PAG231::bimodInv_dil_apply.text:
theorem bimodInv_dil_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    bimodInv N (dil a f) = fun p χ => liftc χ.1 N (a : ZMod N) • bimodInv N f p χ

PAG231::tensorFunEquiv.text:
noncomputable def tensorFunEquiv (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι] : TensorProduct ℂ W (ι → ℂ) ≃ₗ[ℂ] (ι → W) :=
  (TensorProduct.congr (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ W) (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite ℂ ℂ ι).symm) ≪≫ₗ
    TensorProduct.finsuppScalarRight ℂ ℂ W ι ≪≫ₗ Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite ℂ W ι

PAG231::tensorFunEquiv_tmul.text:
theorem tensorFunEquiv_tmul (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι] (w : W) (v : ι → ℂ) (i : ι) :
    tensorFunEquiv W ι (w ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v) i = v i • w

PAG231::bimodTensorEquiv.text:
noncomputable def bimodTensorEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (Π p : centerIdx N, TensorProduct ℂ (refLayer N p) (Prim p.1.1 → ℂ)) ≃ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  LinearEquiv.piCongrRight (fun p => tensorFunEquiv (refLayer N p) (Prim p.1.1)) ≪≫ₗ bimodEquiv N

PAG231::bimodTensorEquiv_apply.text:
theorem bimodTensorEquiv_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (t : Π p : centerIdx N, TensorProduct ℂ (refLayer N p) (Prim p.1.1 → ℂ)) :
    bimodTensorEquiv N t = ∑ p : centerIdx N, ∑ χ : Prim p.1.1,
      matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 (refChar N p).1 χ.1 (tensorFunEquiv (refLayer N p) (Prim p.1.1) (t p) χ : ZMod N → ℂ)

PAG231::bimodTensorEquiv_tmul.text:
theorem bimodTensorEquiv_tmul (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (w : Π p : centerIdx N, refLayer N p)
    (v : Π p : centerIdx N, Prim p.1.1 → ℂ) :
    bimodTensorEquiv N (fun p => w p ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v p) = ∑ p : centerIdx N, ∑ χ : Prim p.1.1,
      v p χ • matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 (refChar N p).1 χ.1 (w p : ZMod N → ℂ)

PAG231::finrank_bimodTensor.text:
theorem finrank_bimodTensor (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Π p : centerIdx N, TensorProduct ℂ (refLayer N p) (Prim p.1.1 → ℂ)) = N

PAG232::crt_fst_val.text:
theorem crt_fst_val {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (x : ZMod (a * b)) :
    (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).1.val = x.val % a

PAG232::crt_snd_val.text:
theorem crt_snd_val {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (x : ZMod (a * b)) :
    (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).2.val = x.val % b

PAG232::gcd_crt.text:
theorem gcd_crt {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (x : ZMod (a * b)) :
    Nat.gcd (a * b) x.val =
      Nat.gcd a (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).1.val * Nat.gcd b (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).2.val

PAG232::mul_eq_mul_iff_of_coprime.text:
theorem mul_eq_mul_iff_of_coprime {a b ga gb sa sb : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hga : ga ∣ a) (hgb : gb ∣ b)
    (hsa : sa ∣ a) (hsb : sb ∣ b) : ga * gb = sa * sb ↔ ga = sa ∧ gb = sb

PAG232::dind_crt.text:
theorem dind_crt {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {sa sb : ℕ} (hsa : sa ∣ a) (hsb : sb ∣ b)
    (x : ZMod (a * b)) :
    dind (a * b) (sa * sb) x = dind a sa (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).1 * dind b sb (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).2

PAG232::sum_divisors_mul_of_coprime.text:
theorem sum_divisors_mul_of_coprime {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {A B : ℕ} (hA : A ≠ 0) (hB : B ≠ 0)
    (hAB : Nat.Coprime A B) (F : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ e ∈ (A * B).divisors, F e = ∑ x ∈ A.divisors, ∑ y ∈ B.divisors, F (x * y)

PAG232::geps_apply_eq_sum.text:
theorem geps_apply_eq_sum (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) (x : ZMod N) :
    geps N s x = ∑ e ∈ (N / s).divisors,
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) / ((s * e : ℕ) : ℂ) * (if N / (s * e) ∣ x.val then 1 else 0)

PAG232::ite_dvd_mul_of_coprime.text:
theorem ite_dvd_mul_of_coprime {a b va vb n : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hva : va ∣ a) (hvb : vb ∣ b) :
    (if va * vb ∣ n then (1 : ℂ) else 0) =
      (if va ∣ n % a then (1 : ℂ) else 0) * (if vb ∣ n % b then (1 : ℂ) else 0)

PAG232::geps_crt.text:
theorem geps_crt {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {sa sb : ℕ} (hsa : sa ∣ a) (hsb : sb ∣ b)
    (x : ZMod (a * b)) :
    geps (a * b) (sa * sb) x = geps a sa (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).1 * geps b sb (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).2

PAG232::crtLin.text:
noncomputable def crtLin {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) : (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ) ≃ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) :=
  LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft ℂ ℂ (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab).symm.toEquiv

PAG232::crtLin_apply.text:
theorem crtLin_apply {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (f : ZMod (a * b) → ℂ) (p : ZMod a × ZMod b) :
    crtLin hab f p = f ((ZMod.chineseRemainder hab).symm p)

PAG232::crtLin_symm_apply.text:
theorem crtLin_symm_apply {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (F : ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) (x : ZMod (a * b)) :
    (crtLin hab).symm F x = F (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x)

PAG232::crtConj.text:
noncomputable def crtConj {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ) ≃ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) :=
  (crtLin hab).conjAlgEquiv ℂ

PAG232::crtConj_apply.text:
theorem crtConj_apply {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ))
    (F : ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) : crtConj hab T F = crtLin hab (T ((crtLin hab).symm F))

PAG232::leftOp.text:
noncomputable def leftOp {a : ℕ} (b : ℕ) (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) where
  toFun F p := S (fun x => F (x, p.2)) p.1
  map_add' F G := by
    funext p
    show S ((fun x => F (x, p.2)) + (fun x => G (x, p.2))) p.1 = _
    rw [map_add]
    rfl
  map_smul' c F := by
    funext p
    show S (c • (fun x => F (x, p.2))) p.1 = _
    rw [map_smul]
    rfl

PAG232::rightOp.text:
noncomputable def rightOp (a : ℕ) {b : ℕ} (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) where
  toFun F p := T (fun y => F (p.1, y)) p.2
  map_add' F G := by
    funext p
    show T ((fun y => F (p.1, y)) + (fun y => G (p.1, y))) p.2 = _
    rw [map_add]
    rfl
  map_smul' c F := by
    funext p
    show T (c • (fun y => F (p.1, y))) p.2 = _
    rw [map_smul]
    rfl

PAG232::leftOp_apply.text:
theorem leftOp_apply {a : ℕ} (b : ℕ) (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) (F : ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) (p : ZMod a × ZMod b) :
    leftOp b S F p = S (fun x => F (x, p.2)) p.1

PAG232::rightOp_apply.text:
theorem rightOp_apply (a : ℕ) {b : ℕ} (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)) (F : ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) (p : ZMod a × ZMod b) :
    rightOp a T F p = T (fun y => F (p.1, y)) p.2

PAG232::leftHom.text:
noncomputable def leftHom (a b : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) :=
  AlgHom.ofLinearMap
    { toFun := leftOp b
      map_add' := fun _ _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl }
    (LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl)
    (fun _ _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl)

PAG232::rightHom.text:
noncomputable def rightHom (a b : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) :=
  AlgHom.ofLinearMap
    { toFun := rightOp a
      map_add' := fun _ _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl }
    (LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl)
    (fun _ _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl)

PAG232::leftHom_apply.text: theorem leftHom_apply (a b : ℕ) (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) : leftHom a b S = leftOp b S

PAG232::rightHom_apply.text: theorem rightHom_apply (a b : ℕ) (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)) : rightHom a b T = rightOp a T

PAG232::leftOp_commute_rightOp.text:
theorem leftOp_commute_rightOp {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ))
    (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)) : Commute (leftOp b S) (rightOp a T)

PAG232::leftHom_injective.text: theorem leftHom_injective (a b : ℕ) [NeZero b] : Function.Injective (leftHom a b)

PAG232::rightHom_injective.text: theorem rightHom_injective (a b : ℕ) [NeZero a] : Function.Injective (rightHom a b)

PAG232::crtConj_dind.text:
theorem crtConj_dind {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {sa sb : ℕ} (hsa : sa ∣ a)
    (hsb : sb ∣ b) :
    crtConj hab (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind (a * b) (sa * sb))) =
      leftOp b (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind a sa)) * rightOp a (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind b sb))

PAG232::crtConj_geps.text:
theorem crtConj_geps {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {sa sb : ℕ} (hsa : sa ∣ a)
    (hsb : sb ∣ b) :
    crtConj hab (PAG.Part15.convL (geps (a * b) (sa * sb))) =
      leftOp b (PAG.Part15.convL (geps a sa)) * rightOp a (PAG.Part15.convL (geps b sb))

PAG232::dind_eq_zero_of_not_dvd.text: theorem dind_eq_zero_of_not_dvd {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : ¬ s ∣ N) : dind N s = 0

PAG232::geps_eq_zero_of_not_dvd.text: theorem geps_eq_zero_of_not_dvd {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : ¬ s ∣ N) : geps N s = 0

PAG232::sum_convL_geps.text: theorem sum_convL_geps (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : ∑ s ∈ N.divisors, PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) = 1

PAG232::sum_mulLeft_dind.text: theorem sum_mulLeft_dind (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : ∑ s ∈ N.divisors, LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N s) = 1

PAG232::shellAlg_eq_adjoin.text:
theorem shellAlg_eq_adjoin (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : shellAlg N = Algebra.adjoin ℂ
    (Set.range (fun s : ℕ => PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s)) ∪ Set.range (fun s : ℕ => LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N s)))

PAG232::convL_geps_mem.text: theorem convL_geps_mem (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] : PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) ∈ shellAlg N

PAG232::mulLeft_dind_mem.text: theorem mulLeft_dind_mem (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] : LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N s) ∈ shellAlg N

PAG232::map_leftHom_le.text:
theorem map_leftHom_le {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (shellAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ≤ (shellAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom

PAG232::map_rightHom_le.text:
theorem map_rightHom_le {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (shellAlg b).map (rightHom a b) ≤ (shellAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom

PAG232::map_crtConj_le.text:
theorem map_crtConj_le {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (shellAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom ≤ (shellAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (shellAlg b).map (rightHom a b)

PAG232::map_crtConj_shellAlg.text:
theorem map_crtConj_shellAlg {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (shellAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom = (shellAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (shellAlg b).map (rightHom a b)

PAG232::mem_shellAlg_mul_iff.text:
theorem mem_shellAlg_mul_iff {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) :
    T ∈ shellAlg (a * b) ↔ crtConj hab T ∈ (shellAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (shellAlg b).map (rightHom a b)

PAG232::finrank_map_crtConj.text:
theorem finrank_map_crtConj {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ((shellAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom) = Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg (a * b))

PAG232::finrank_sup_leftHom_rightHom.text:
theorem finrank_sup_leftHom_rightHom {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥((shellAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (shellAlg b).map (rightHom a b)) =
      Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg a) * Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg b)

PAG232::tensLift.text:
noncomputable def tensLift (a b : ℕ) [NeZero a] [NeZero b] :
    TensorProduct ℂ (shellAlg a) (shellAlg b) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) :=
  Algebra.TensorProduct.lift ((leftHom a b).comp (shellAlg a).val) ((rightHom a b).comp (shellAlg b).val)
    (fun x y => leftOp_commute_rightOp (x : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) (y : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)))

PAG232::tensLift_tmul.text:
theorem tensLift_tmul (a b : ℕ) [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (S : shellAlg a) (T : shellAlg b) :
    tensLift a b (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) = leftOp b (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) * rightOp a (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))

PAG232::range_tensLift.text:
theorem range_tensLift {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (tensLift a b).range = (shellAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom

PAG232::finrank_tensor_shellAlg.text:
theorem finrank_tensor_shellAlg {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (TensorProduct ℂ (shellAlg a) (shellAlg b)) = Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg (a * b))

PAG232::tensLift_injective.text:
theorem tensLift_injective {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    Function.Injective (tensLift a b)

PAG232::shellAlgTensorEquiv.text:
noncomputable def shellAlgTensorEquiv {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    TensorProduct ℂ (shellAlg a) (shellAlg b) ≃ₐ[ℂ] shellAlg (a * b) :=
  ((AlgEquiv.ofInjective (tensLift a b) (tensLift_injective hab)).trans
    (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ (range_tensLift hab))).trans
    (Subalgebra.equivMapOfInjective (shellAlg (a * b)) (crtConj hab).toAlgHom (crtConj hab).injective).symm

PAG232::crtConj_shellAlgTensorEquiv.text:
theorem crtConj_shellAlgTensorEquiv {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (z : TensorProduct ℂ (shellAlg a) (shellAlg b)) :
    crtConj hab (shellAlgTensorEquiv hab z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) = tensLift a b z

PAG232::crtConj_shellAlgTensorEquiv_tmul.text:
theorem crtConj_shellAlgTensorEquiv_tmul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (S : shellAlg a) (T : shellAlg b) :
    crtConj hab (shellAlgTensorEquiv hab (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) =
      leftOp b (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) * rightOp a (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))

PAG232::shellAlgTensorEquiv_geps.text:
theorem shellAlgTensorEquiv_geps {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {sa sb : ℕ}
    (hsa : sa ∣ a) (hsb : sb ∣ b) :
    (shellAlgTensorEquiv hab (⟨_, convL_geps_mem a sa⟩ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ⟨_, convL_geps_mem b sb⟩) :
      Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) = PAG.Part15.convL (geps (a * b) (sa * sb))

PAG232::shellAlgTensorEquiv_dind.text:
theorem shellAlgTensorEquiv_dind {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {sa sb : ℕ}
    (hsa : sa ∣ a) (hsb : sb ∣ b) :
    (shellAlgTensorEquiv hab (⟨_, mulLeft_dind_mem a sa⟩ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ⟨_, mulLeft_dind_mem b sb⟩) :
      Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) = LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind (a * b) (sa * sb))

PAG233::leftOp_mul_rightOp_apply_prod.text:
theorem leftOp_mul_rightOp_apply_prod {a b : ℕ} (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))
    (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (h : ZMod b → ℂ) (x : ZMod a) (y : ZMod b) :
    (leftOp b S * rightOp a T) (fun q => f q.1 * h q.2) (x, y) = S f x * T h y

PAG233::linearIndependent_leftOp_mul_rig.text:
theorem linearIndependent_leftOp_mul_rightOp {a b : ℕ} {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {u : ι → Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)} {v : κ → Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)}
    (hu : LinearIndependent ℂ u) (hv : LinearIndependent ℂ v) :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (fun p : ι × κ => leftOp b (u p.1) * rightOp a (v p.2))

PAG233::tensLiftGen.text:
noncomputable def tensLiftGen {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))
    (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) :
    TensorProduct ℂ B B' →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) :=
  Algebra.TensorProduct.lift ((leftHom a b).comp B.val) ((rightHom a b).comp B'.val)
    (fun x y => leftOp_commute_rightOp (x : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) (y : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)))

PAG233::tensLiftGen_tmul.text:
theorem tensLiftGen_tmul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))
    (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) (S : B) (T : B') :
    tensLiftGen B B' (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) =
      leftOp b (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) * rightOp a (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))

PAG233::range_tensLiftGen.text:
theorem range_tensLiftGen {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))
    (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) :
    (tensLiftGen B B').range = B.map (leftHom a b) ⊔ B'.map (rightHom a b)

PAG233::finrank_tensorGen.text:
theorem finrank_tensorGen {a b : ℕ} (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))
    (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (TensorProduct ℂ B B') = Module.finrank ℂ B * Module.finrank ℂ B'

PAG233::subalgSpan.text:
noncomputable def subalgSpan {X : Type*} (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (X → ℂ))) :
    Submodule ℂ (Module.End ℂ (X → ℂ)) where
  carrier := B
  add_mem' hx hy := B.add_mem hx hy
  zero_mem' := B.zero_mem
  smul_mem' c _ hx := B.smul_mem hx c

PAG233::mem_subalgSpan.text:
theorem mem_subalgSpan {X : Type*} (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (X → ℂ))) (T : Module.End ℂ (X → ℂ)) :
    T ∈ subalgSpan B ↔ T ∈ B

PAG233::subalgSpanEquiv.text:
noncomputable def subalgSpanEquiv {X : Type*} (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (X → ℂ))) :
    subalgSpan B ≃ₗ[ℂ] B where
  toFun x := ⟨x.1, x.2⟩
  invFun x := ⟨x.1, x.2⟩
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

PAG233::finrank_subalgSpan.text:
theorem finrank_subalgSpan {X : Type*} (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (X → ℂ))) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (subalgSpan B) = Module.finrank ℂ B

PAG233::exists_linearIndependent_subalg.text:
theorem exists_linearIndependent_subalg {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (X → ℂ))) :
    ∃ u : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ B) → Module.End ℂ (X → ℂ), LinearIndependent ℂ u ∧ ∀ i, u i ∈ B

PAG233::finrank_mul_le_finrank_sup.text:
theorem finrank_mul_le_finrank_sup {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))
    (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) :
    Module.finrank ℂ B * Module.finrank ℂ B' ≤
      Module.finrank ℂ ↥(B.map (leftHom a b) ⊔ B'.map (rightHom a b))

PAG233::finrank_sup_map.text:
theorem finrank_sup_map {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))
    (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(B.map (leftHom a b) ⊔ B'.map (rightHom a b)) = Module.finrank ℂ B * Module.finrank ℂ B'

PAG233::tensLiftGen_injective.text:
theorem tensLiftGen_injective {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))
    (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) : Function.Injective (tensLiftGen B B')

PAG233::tensorSupEquiv.text:
noncomputable def tensorSupEquiv {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))
    (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) :
    TensorProduct ℂ B B' ≃ₐ[ℂ] ↥(B.map (leftHom a b) ⊔ B'.map (rightHom a b)) :=
  (AlgEquiv.ofInjective (tensLiftGen B B') (tensLiftGen_injective B B')).trans
    (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ (range_tensLiftGen B B'))

PAG233::tensorSupEquiv_tmul.text:
theorem tensorSupEquiv_tmul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))
    (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) (S : B) (T : B') :
    (tensorSupEquiv B B' (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ)) =
      leftOp b (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) * rightOp a (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))

PAG233::finrank_map_crtConj_gen.text:
theorem finrank_map_crtConj_gen {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (X : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ))) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(X.map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom) = Module.finrank ℂ X

PAG233::mem_map_crtConj_iff.text:
theorem mem_map_crtConj_iff {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (X : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)))
    (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) : crtConj hab T ∈ X.map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom ↔ T ∈ X

PAG233::crtTensorEquiv.text:
noncomputable def crtTensorEquiv {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ))) (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)))
    (X : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)))
    (h : X.map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom = B.map (leftHom a b) ⊔ B'.map (rightHom a b)) :
    TensorProduct ℂ B B' ≃ₐ[ℂ] X :=
  ((tensorSupEquiv B B').trans (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ h.symm)).trans
    (Subalgebra.equivMapOfInjective X (crtConj hab).toAlgHom (crtConj hab).injective).symm

PAG233::crtConj_crtTensorEquiv_tmul.text:
theorem crtConj_crtTensorEquiv_tmul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ))) (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)))
    (X : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)))
    (h : X.map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom = B.map (leftHom a b) ⊔ B'.map (rightHom a b)) (S : B) (T : B') :
    crtConj hab (crtTensorEquiv hab B B' X h (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) =
      leftOp b (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) * rightOp a (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))

PAG233::tensLift_eq_tensLiftGen.text:
theorem tensLift_eq_tensLiftGen (a b : ℕ) [NeZero a] [NeZero b] :
    tensLift a b = tensLiftGen (shellAlg a) (shellAlg b)

PAG233::tensLift_injective_gen.text: theorem tensLift_injective_gen {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] : Function.Injective (tensLift a b)

PAG233::finrank_shellAlg_mul_of_crt.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg_mul_of_crt {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg (a * b)) = Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg a) * Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg b)

PAG233::commute_of_mem_sup.text:
theorem commute_of_mem_sup {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (X : A) {B₁ B₂ : Subalgebra ℂ A}
    (h₁ : ∀ Y ∈ B₁, Commute X Y) (h₂ : ∀ Y ∈ B₂, Commute X Y) : ∀ Y ∈ B₁ ⊔ B₂, Commute X Y

PAG233::crtConj_commute_iff.text:
theorem crtConj_commute_iff {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (T S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) :
    Commute (crtConj hab T) (crtConj hab S) ↔ Commute T S

PAG233::mem_fullComm_mul_iff.text:
theorem mem_fullComm_mul_iff {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) :
    T ∈ fullComm (a * b) ↔ ∀ Y ∈ (shellAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (shellAlg b).map (rightHom a b),
      Commute (crtConj hab T) Y

PAG233::symm_leftOp_mem_fullComm.text:
theorem symm_leftOp_mem_fullComm {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    {S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)} (hS : S ∈ fullComm a) :
    (crtConj hab).symm (leftOp b S) ∈ fullComm (a * b)

PAG233::symm_rightOp_mem_fullComm.text:
theorem symm_rightOp_mem_fullComm {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    {T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)} (hT : T ∈ fullComm b) :
    (crtConj hab).symm (rightOp a T) ∈ fullComm (a * b)

PAG233::map_leftHom_fullComm_le.text:
theorem map_leftHom_fullComm_le {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (fullCommAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ≤ (fullCommAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom

PAG233::map_rightHom_fullComm_le.text:
theorem map_rightHom_fullComm_le {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (fullCommAlg b).map (rightHom a b) ≤ (fullCommAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom

PAG233::finrank_fullCommAlg_eq.text:
theorem finrank_fullCommAlg_eq (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommAlg N) = Module.finrank ℂ (fullComm N)

PAG233::map_crtConj_fullComm.text:
theorem map_crtConj_fullComm {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (fullCommAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom =
      (fullCommAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (fullCommAlg b).map (rightHom a b)

PAG233::mem_fullComm_mul_iff_sup.text:
theorem mem_fullComm_mul_iff_sup {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) :
    T ∈ fullComm (a * b) ↔ crtConj hab T ∈ (fullCommAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (fullCommAlg b).map (rightHom a b)

PAG233::fullCommTensorEquiv.text:
noncomputable def fullCommTensorEquiv {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    TensorProduct ℂ (fullCommAlg a) (fullCommAlg b) ≃ₐ[ℂ] fullCommAlg (a * b) :=
  crtTensorEquiv hab _ _ _ (map_crtConj_fullComm hab)

PAG233::crtConj_fullCommTensorEquiv_tmul.text:
theorem crtConj_fullCommTensorEquiv_tmul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (S : fullCommAlg a) (T : fullCommAlg b) :
    crtConj hab (fullCommTensorEquiv hab (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) =
      leftOp b (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) * rightOp a (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))

PAG233::mem_centerAlg_iff_and.text:
theorem mem_centerAlg_iff_and (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (Z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    Z ∈ centerAlg N ↔ Z ∈ shellAlg N ∧ Z ∈ fullComm N

PAG233::symm_leftOp_mem_center.text:
theorem symm_leftOp_mem_center {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    {Z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)} (hZ : Z ∈ centerAlg a) :
    (crtConj hab).symm (leftOp b Z) ∈ centerAlg (a * b)

PAG233::symm_rightOp_mem_center.text:
theorem symm_rightOp_mem_center {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    {Z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)} (hZ : Z ∈ centerAlg b) :
    (crtConj hab).symm (rightOp a Z) ∈ centerAlg (a * b)

PAG233::map_leftHom_center_le.text:
theorem map_leftHom_center_le {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (centerAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ≤ (centerAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom

PAG233::map_rightHom_center_le.text:
theorem map_rightHom_center_le {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (centerAlg b).map (rightHom a b) ≤ (centerAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom

PAG233::finrank_centerAlg_eq.text:
theorem finrank_centerAlg_eq (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (centerAlg N) = Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommCenter N)

PAG233::map_crtConj_center.text:
theorem map_crtConj_center {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (centerAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom =
      (centerAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (centerAlg b).map (rightHom a b)

PAG233::mem_center_mul_iff.text:
theorem mem_center_mul_iff {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (Z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) :
    Z ∈ centerAlg (a * b) ↔ crtConj hab Z ∈ (centerAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (centerAlg b).map (rightHom a b)

PAG233::centerTensorEquiv.text:
noncomputable def centerTensorEquiv {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    TensorProduct ℂ (centerAlg a) (centerAlg b) ≃ₐ[ℂ] centerAlg (a * b) :=
  crtTensorEquiv hab _ _ _ (map_crtConj_center hab)

PAG233::crtConj_centerTensorEquiv_tmul.text:
theorem crtConj_centerTensorEquiv_tmul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (S : centerAlg a) (T : centerAlg b) :
    crtConj hab (centerTensorEquiv hab (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) =
      leftOp b (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) * rightOp a (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))

PAG233::radDvd_mul.text: theorem radDvd_mul {d₁ c₁ d₂ c₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : RadDvd d₁ c₁) (h₂ : RadDvd d₂ c₂) : RadDvd (d₁ * d₂) (c₁ * c₂)

PAG233::radDvd_gcd.text: theorem radDvd_gcd {d c : ℕ} (h : RadDvd d c) (a : ℕ) : RadDvd (Nat.gcd d a) (Nat.gcd c a)

PAG233::mem_centerIdx_iff_dvd.text:
theorem mem_centerIdx_iff_dvd (N c d : ℕ) : (⟨c, d⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx N ↔
    c ∣ N ∧ N ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < primCount c ∧ d ∣ N / c ∧ RadDvd d c

PAG233::idxMul.text: def idxMul (p q : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ := ⟨p.1 * q.1, p.2 * q.2⟩

PAG233::idxSplit.text:
def idxSplit (a b : ℕ) (r : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) : (Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) × (Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) :=
  (⟨Nat.gcd r.1 a, Nat.gcd r.2 a⟩, ⟨Nat.gcd r.1 b, Nat.gcd r.2 b⟩)

PAG233::gcd_mul_left_of_dvd.text:
theorem gcd_mul_left_of_dvd {a b x y : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hx : x ∣ a) (hy : y ∣ b) :
    Nat.gcd (x * y) a = x

PAG233::gcd_mul_right_of_dvd.text:
theorem gcd_mul_right_of_dvd {a b x y : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hx : x ∣ a) (hy : y ∣ b) :
    Nat.gcd (x * y) b = y

PAG233::eq_gcd_mul_gcd.text: theorem eq_gcd_mul_gcd {a b n : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hn : n ∣ a * b) : n = Nat.gcd n a * Nat.gcd n b

PAG233::idxSplit_mem.text:
theorem idxSplit_mem {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {c d : ℕ} (hr : (⟨c, d⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx (a * b)) :
    (idxSplit a b ⟨c, d⟩).1 ∈ centerIdx a ∧ (idxSplit a b ⟨c, d⟩).2 ∈ centerIdx b

PAG233::card_centerIdx_mul.text:
theorem card_centerIdx_mul {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (centerIdx (a * b)).card = (centerIdx a).card * (centerIdx b).card

PAG233::mem_centerIdx_mul_iff.text:
theorem mem_centerIdx_mul_iff {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (r : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) :
    r ∈ centerIdx (a * b) ↔ ∃ p ∈ centerIdx a, ∃ q ∈ centerIdx b, idxMul p q = r

PAG233::card_layerDivs_idxMul.text:
theorem card_layerDivs_idxMul {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ}
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b) :
    (layerDivs (ca * cb) (da * db) (a * b / (ca * cb))).card =
      (layerDivs ca da (a / ca)).card * (layerDivs cb db (b / cb)).card

PAG234::matE.text:
noncomputable def matE {b : ℕ} (p : ZMod b × ZMod b) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ) where
  toFun h y'' := if y'' = p.1 then h p.2 else 0
  map_add' h k := by
    funext y''
    by_cases hy : y'' = p.1 <;> simp [hy]
  map_smul' c h := by
    funext y''
    by_cases hy : y'' = p.1 <;> simp [hy]

PAG234::matE_apply.text:
theorem matE_apply {b : ℕ} (p : ZMod b × ZMod b) (h : ZMod b → ℂ) (y'' : ZMod b) :
    matE p h y'' = if y'' = p.1 then h p.2 else 0

PAG234::inclY.text:
noncomputable def inclY {a b : ℕ} (y' : ZMod b) : (ZMod a → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) where
  toFun f q := if q.2 = y' then f q.1 else 0
  map_add' f g := by
    funext q
    by_cases hq : q.2 = y' <;> simp [hq]
  map_smul' c f := by
    funext q
    by_cases hq : q.2 = y' <;> simp [hq]

PAG234::inclY_apply.text:
theorem inclY_apply {a b : ℕ} (y' : ZMod b) (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (q : ZMod a × ZMod b) :
    inclY y' f q = if q.2 = y' then f q.1 else 0

PAG234::restrY.text:
noncomputable def restrY {a b : ℕ} (y : ZMod b) : (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod a → ℂ) where
  toFun F x := F (x, y)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

PAG234::restrY_apply.text:
theorem restrY_apply {a b : ℕ} (y : ZMod b) (F : ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) (x : ZMod a) :
    restrY y F x = F (x, y)

PAG234::blockEnt.text:
noncomputable def blockEnt {a b : ℕ} (Φ : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ)) (p : ZMod b × ZMod b) :
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ) :=
  (restrY p.1).comp (Φ.comp (inclY p.2))

PAG234::blockEnt_apply.text:
theorem blockEnt_apply {a b : ℕ} (Φ : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ)) (p : ZMod b × ZMod b)
    (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (x : ZMod a) : blockEnt Φ p f x = Φ (inclY p.2 f) (x, p.1)

PAG234::sum_inclY.text:
theorem sum_inclY {a b : ℕ} [NeZero b] (F : ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) :
    ∑ y' : ZMod b, inclY y' (fun x => F (x, y')) = F

PAG234::sum_blockEnt.text:
theorem sum_blockEnt {a b : ℕ} [NeZero b] (Φ : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ)) :
    ∑ p : ZMod b × ZMod b, leftOp b (blockEnt Φ p) * rightOp a (matE p) = Φ

PAG234::inclY_leftOp.text:
theorem inclY_leftOp {a b : ℕ} (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) (y' : ZMod b) (f : ZMod a → ℂ) :
    inclY y' (S f) = leftOp b S (inclY y' f)

PAG234::restrY_leftOp.text:
theorem restrY_leftOp {a b : ℕ} (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) (y : ZMod b) (F : ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) :
    restrY y (leftOp b S F) = S (restrY y F)

PAG234::blockEnt_commute.text:
theorem blockEnt_commute {a b : ℕ} {Φ : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ)} {S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)}
    (h : Commute Φ (leftOp b S)) (p : ZMod b × ZMod b) : Commute (blockEnt Φ p) S

PAG234::eq_zero_of_sum_leftOp_mul_rightO.text:
theorem eq_zero_of_sum_leftOp_mul_rightOp {a b : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {u : ι → Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)} (hu : LinearIndependent ℂ u) (w : ι → Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))
    (h : ∑ i, leftOp b (u i) * rightOp a (w i) = 0) (i : ι) : w i = 0

PAG234::exists_basis_subalg.text:
theorem exists_basis_subalg {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (X → ℂ))) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (u : Fin n → Module.End ℂ (X → ℂ)), LinearIndependent ℂ u ∧ (∀ i, u i ∈ B) ∧
      ∀ T ∈ B, ∃ c : Fin n → ℂ, T = ∑ i, c i • u i

PAG234::leftOp_sum_smul.text:
theorem leftOp_sum_smul {a b : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (c : ι → ℂ) (u : ι → Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) :
    leftOp b (∑ i, c i • u i) = ∑ i, c i • leftOp b (u i)

PAG234::rightOp_sum_smul.text:
theorem rightOp_sum_smul {a b : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (c : ι → ℂ) (v : ι → Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)) :
    rightOp a (∑ i, c i • v i) = ∑ i, c i • rightOp a (v i)

PAG234::centralizer_sup_map.text:
theorem centralizer_sup_map {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))
    (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) :
    Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ ((B.map (leftHom a b) ⊔ B'.map (rightHom a b) :
        Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ))) : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ))) =
      (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (B : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))).map (leftHom a b) ⊔
        (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (B' : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)))).map (rightHom a b)

PAG234::centralizer_centralizer_sup_map.text:
theorem centralizer_centralizer_sup_map {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b]
    (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ))) (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) :
    Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ ((B.map (leftHom a b) ⊔ B'.map (rightHom a b) :
        Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ))) : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ))) :
        Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ))) =
      (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (B : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ))) :
        Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))).map (leftHom a b) ⊔
        (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (B' : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) :
          Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)))).map (rightHom a b)

PAG234::finrank_centralizer_sup_map.text:
theorem finrank_centralizer_sup_map {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))
    (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ ((B.map (leftHom a b) ⊔ B'.map (rightHom a b) :
        Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ))) : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ)))) =
      Module.finrank ℂ (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (B : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))) *
        Module.finrank ℂ (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (B' : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))))

PAG234::centralizer_bot_eq_top.text:
theorem centralizer_bot_eq_top {X : Type*} :
    Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ ((⊥ : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (X → ℂ))) : Set (Module.End ℂ (X → ℂ))) = ⊤

PAG234::centralizer_map_leftHom.text:
theorem centralizer_map_leftHom {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ))) :
    Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ ((B.map (leftHom a b) : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ))) :
      Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ))) =
      (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (B : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))).map (leftHom a b) ⊔
        (⊤ : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))).map (rightHom a b)

PAG234::centralizer_map_rightHom.text:
theorem centralizer_map_rightHom {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) :
    Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ ((B'.map (rightHom a b) : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ))) :
      Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ))) =
      (⊤ : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ))).map (leftHom a b) ⊔
        (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (B' : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)))).map (rightHom a b)

PAG234::fullCommAlg_eq_centralizer.text:
theorem fullCommAlg_eq_centralizer (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    fullCommAlg N = Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (shellAlg N : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)))

PAG234::centerAlg_eq_centralizer.text:
theorem centerAlg_eq_centralizer (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    centerAlg N = Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ ((shellAlg N ⊔ fullCommAlg N : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))) :
      Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)))

PAG234::map_crtConj_centralizer.text:
theorem map_crtConj_centralizer {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (X : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ))) :
    (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (X : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)))).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom =
      Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ ((X.map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ))) :
        Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ)))

PAG234::map_crtConj_fullComm_of_centrali.text:
theorem map_crtConj_fullComm_of_centralizer {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (fullCommAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom =
      (fullCommAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (fullCommAlg b).map (rightHom a b)

PAG234::finrank_fullComm_mul_of_crt.text:
theorem finrank_fullComm_mul_of_crt {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullComm (a * b)) = Module.finrank ℂ (fullComm a) * Module.finrank ℂ (fullComm b)

PAG234::map_crtConj_center_of_centralize.text:
theorem map_crtConj_center_of_centralizer {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (centerAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom =
      (centerAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (centerAlg b).map (rightHom a b)

PAG234::finrank_center_mul_of_crt.text:
theorem finrank_center_mul_of_crt {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommCenter (a * b)) =
      Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommCenter a) * Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommCenter b)

PAG235::mulPull.text: def mulPull {N : ℕ} (r : ZMod N) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) := LinearMap.funLeft ℂ ℂ (fun x => r * x)

PAG235::mulPull_apply.text: theorem mulPull_apply {N : ℕ} (r : ZMod N) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (x : ZMod N) : mulPull r f x = f (r * x)

PAG235::dil_eq_mulPull.text: theorem dil_eq_mulPull {N : ℕ} (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) : (dil u : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) = mulPull (u : ZMod N)

PAG235::mulPull_one.text: theorem mulPull_one {N : ℕ} : (mulPull (1 : ZMod N) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) = 1

PAG235::crtConj_mulPull.text:
theorem crtConj_mulPull {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (r : ZMod (a * b)) :
    crtConj hab (mulPull r) = leftOp b (mulPull (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab r).1) *
      rightOp a (mulPull (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab r).2)

PAG235::unitFst.text:
noncomputable def unitFst {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (u : (ZMod (a * b))ˣ) : (ZMod a)ˣ :=
  Units.map ((RingHom.fst (ZMod a) (ZMod b)).comp (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab).toRingHom).toMonoidHom u

PAG235::unitSnd.text:
noncomputable def unitSnd {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (u : (ZMod (a * b))ˣ) : (ZMod b)ˣ :=
  Units.map ((RingHom.snd (ZMod a) (ZMod b)).comp (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab).toRingHom).toMonoidHom u

PAG235::unitFst_val.text:
theorem unitFst_val {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (u : (ZMod (a * b))ˣ) :
    ((unitFst hab u : (ZMod a)ˣ) : ZMod a) = (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab (u : ZMod (a * b))).1

PAG235::unitSnd_val.text:
theorem unitSnd_val {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (u : (ZMod (a * b))ˣ) :
    ((unitSnd hab u : (ZMod b)ˣ) : ZMod b) = (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab (u : ZMod (a * b))).2

PAG235::unitLeft.text:
noncomputable def unitLeft {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (v : (ZMod a)ˣ) : (ZMod (a * b))ˣ where
  val := (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab).symm ((v : ZMod a), 1)
  inv := (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab).symm (((v⁻¹ : (ZMod a)ˣ) : ZMod a), 1)
  val_inv := by
    rw [← map_mul, Prod.mk_mul_mk, Units.mul_inv, mul_one]
    exact map_one _
  inv_val := by
    rw [← map_mul, Prod.mk_mul_mk, Units.inv_mul, mul_one]
    exact map_one _

PAG235::unitRight.text:
noncomputable def unitRight {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (w : (ZMod b)ˣ) : (ZMod (a * b))ˣ where
  val := (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab).symm (1, (w : ZMod b))
  inv := (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab).symm (1, ((w⁻¹ : (ZMod b)ˣ) : ZMod b))
  val_inv := by
    rw [← map_mul, Prod.mk_mul_mk, Units.mul_inv, mul_one]
    exact map_one _
  inv_val := by
    rw [← map_mul, Prod.mk_mul_mk, Units.inv_mul, mul_one]
    exact map_one _

PAG235::crt_unitLeft.text:
theorem crt_unitLeft {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (v : (ZMod a)ˣ) :
    ZMod.chineseRemainder hab (unitLeft hab v : ZMod (a * b)) = ((v : ZMod a), 1)

PAG235::crt_unitRight.text:
theorem crt_unitRight {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (w : (ZMod b)ˣ) :
    ZMod.chineseRemainder hab (unitRight hab w : ZMod (a * b)) = (1, (w : ZMod b))

PAG235::crtConj_dil.text:
theorem crtConj_dil {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (u : (ZMod (a * b))ˣ) :
    crtConj hab (dil u) = leftOp b (dil (unitFst hab u)) * rightOp a (dil (unitSnd hab u))

PAG235::crtConj_dil_unitLeft.text:
theorem crtConj_dil_unitLeft {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (v : (ZMod a)ˣ) :
    crtConj hab (dil (unitLeft hab v)) = leftOp b (dil v)

PAG235::crtConj_dil_unitRight.text:
theorem crtConj_dil_unitRight {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (w : (ZMod b)ˣ) :
    crtConj hab (dil (unitRight hab w)) = rightOp a (dil w)

PAG235::dilAlg.text:
noncomputable def dilAlg (N : ℕ) : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :=
  Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (fun u : (ZMod N)ˣ => (dil u : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))))

PAG235::dil_mem_dilAlg.text: theorem dil_mem_dilAlg (N : ℕ) (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) : (dil u : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) ∈ dilAlg N

PAG235::dil_commute.text:
theorem dil_commute {N : ℕ} (u v : (ZMod N)ˣ) :
    Commute (dil u : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) (dil v : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))

PAG235::map_crtConj_dilAlg.text:
theorem map_crtConj_dilAlg {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (dilAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom = (dilAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (dilAlg b).map (rightHom a b)

PAG235::map_crtConj_shellDilAlg.text:
theorem map_crtConj_shellDilAlg {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (shellAlg (a * b) ⊔ dilAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom =
      (shellAlg a ⊔ dilAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (shellAlg b ⊔ dilAlg b).map (rightHom a b)

PAG235::map_crtConj_dilAlg_centralizer.text:
theorem map_crtConj_dilAlg_centralizer {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (dilAlg (a * b) : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)))).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom =
      (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (dilAlg a : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))).map (leftHom a b) ⊔
        (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (dilAlg b : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)))).map (rightHom a b)

PAG235::dilCommAlg.text:
noncomputable def dilCommAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :=
  Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ ((shellAlg N ⊔ dilAlg N : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))) :
    Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)))

PAG235::dilAlg_le_centralizer.text:
theorem dilAlg_le_centralizer {N : ℕ} {T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)}
    (h : ∀ u : (ZMod N)ˣ, Commute T (dil u)) : dilAlg N ≤ Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ {T}

PAG235::mem_dilCommAlg_iff.text:
theorem mem_dilCommAlg_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    T ∈ dilCommAlg N ↔ T ∈ dilComm N

PAG235::dilCommAlgLinearEquiv.text:
noncomputable def dilCommAlgLinearEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : dilCommAlg N ≃ₗ[ℂ] dilComm N where
  toFun T := ⟨T.1, (mem_dilCommAlg_iff N _).mp T.2⟩
  invFun T := ⟨T.1, (mem_dilCommAlg_iff N _).mpr T.2⟩
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

PAG235::finrank_dilCommAlg.text: theorem finrank_dilCommAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Module.finrank ℂ (dilCommAlg N) = Module.finrank ℂ (dilComm N)

PAG235::map_crtConj_dilComm.text:
theorem map_crtConj_dilComm {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (dilCommAlg (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom =
      (dilCommAlg a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (dilCommAlg b).map (rightHom a b)

PAG235::finrank_dilComm_mul.text:
theorem finrank_dilComm_mul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (dilComm (a * b)) = Module.finrank ℂ (dilComm a) * Module.finrank ℂ (dilComm b)

PAG235::dilCommTensorEquiv.text:
noncomputable def dilCommTensorEquiv {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    TensorProduct ℂ (dilCommAlg a) (dilCommAlg b) ≃ₐ[ℂ] dilCommAlg (a * b) :=
  crtTensorEquiv hab _ _ _ (map_crtConj_dilComm hab)

PAG235::crtConj_dilCommTensorEquiv_tmul.text:
theorem crtConj_dilCommTensorEquiv_tmul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (S : dilCommAlg a) (T : dilCommAlg b) :
    crtConj hab (dilCommTensorEquiv hab (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) =
      leftOp b (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) * rightOp a (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))

PAG235::map_crtConj_dilComm_centralizer.text:
theorem map_crtConj_dilComm_centralizer {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (dilCommAlg (a * b) : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)))).map
        (crtConj hab).toAlgHom =
      (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (dilCommAlg a : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))).map (leftHom a b) ⊔
        (Subalgebra.centralizer ℂ (dilCommAlg b : Set (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)))).map (rightHom a b)

PAG235::inLayer_iff_dvd.text: theorem inLayer_iff_dvd {c d n : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) : InLayer c d n ↔ d ∣ n ∧ Nat.Coprime (n / d) c

PAG235::coprime_mod_div_iff.text:
theorem coprime_mod_div_iff {a c d n : ℕ} (hda : d ∣ a) (hdn : d ∣ n) (hc : c ∣ a / d) :
    Nat.Coprime (n % a / d) c ↔ Nat.Coprime (n / d) c

PAG235::inLayer_mul_iff.text:
theorem inLayer_mul_iff {a b ca da cb db n : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (ha : ca * da ∣ a) (hb : cb * db ∣ b)
    (hda : 0 < da) (hdb : 0 < db) :
    InLayer (ca * cb) (da * db) n ↔ InLayer ca da (n % a) ∧ InLayer cb db (n % b)

PAG235::layerInd_crt.text:
theorem layerInd_crt {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ}
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b) (x : ZMod (a * b)) :
    layerInd (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db) x =
      layerInd a ca da (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).1 * layerInd b cb db (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).2

PAG235::crtConj_layerInd.text:
theorem crtConj_layerInd {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ}
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b) :
    crtConj hab (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (layerInd (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db))) =
      leftOp b (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (layerInd a ca da)) * rightOp a (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (layerInd b cb db))

PAG236::charMul.text:
noncomputable def charMul {m n : ℕ} (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    DirichletCharacter ℂ (m * n) :=
  DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right m n) χ₁ * DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left n m) χ₂

PAG236::changeLevel_charMul.text:
theorem changeLevel_charMul {m n N : ℕ} (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n)
    (h : m * n ∣ N) :
    DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h (charMul χ₁ χ₂) =
      DirichletCharacter.changeLevel ((dvd_mul_right m n).trans h) χ₁ *
        DirichletCharacter.changeLevel ((dvd_mul_left n m).trans h) χ₂

PAG236::charMul_apply_unit.text:
theorem charMul_apply_unit {m n : ℕ} (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n)
    (u : (ZMod (m * n))ˣ) :
    charMul χ₁ χ₂ (u : ZMod (m * n)) =
      χ₁ (ZMod.cast (u : ZMod (m * n))) * χ₂ (ZMod.cast (u : ZMod (m * n)))

PAG236::charMul_apply.text:
theorem charMul_apply {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) (x : ZMod (m * n)) :
    charMul χ₁ χ₂ x = χ₁ (ZMod.cast x) * χ₂ (ZMod.cast x)

PAG236::charMul_mul.text:
theorem charMul_mul {m n : ℕ} (χ₁ ψ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (χ₂ ψ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    charMul (χ₁ * ψ₁) (χ₂ * ψ₂) = charMul χ₁ χ₂ * charMul ψ₁ ψ₂

PAG236::charMul_inv.text:
theorem charMul_inv {m n : ℕ} (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    charMul χ₁⁻¹ χ₂⁻¹ = (charMul χ₁ χ₂)⁻¹

PAG236::dvd_conductor_of_eq_mul.text:
theorem dvd_conductor_of_eq_mul {N k l : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hk : k ∣ N) (hl : l ∣ N)
    (ψ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ k) (ψ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ l) (hψ₁ : ψ₁.IsPrimitive) (hkl : Nat.Coprime k l)
    (h : χ = DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hk ψ₁ * DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hl ψ₂) :
    k ∣ χ.conductor

PAG236::isPrimitive_charMul.text:
theorem isPrimitive_charMul {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (hmn : Nat.Coprime m n)
    {χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m} {χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n} (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    (charMul χ₁ χ₂).IsPrimitive

PAG236::primMul.text:
noncomputable def primMul {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (hmn : Nat.Coprime m n) (p : Prim m × Prim n) :
    Prim (m * n) :=
  ⟨charMul p.1.1 p.2.1, isPrimitive_charMul hmn p.1.2 p.2.2⟩

PAG236::primMul_injective.text:
theorem primMul_injective {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (hmn : Nat.Coprime m n) :
    Function.Injective (primMul hmn)

PAG236::primMul_bijective.text:
theorem primMul_bijective {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (hmn : Nat.Coprime m n) :
    Function.Bijective (primMul hmn)

PAG236::primEquiv.text:
noncomputable def primEquiv {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (hmn : Nat.Coprime m n) :
    Prim m × Prim n ≃ Prim (m * n) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (primMul hmn) (primMul_bijective hmn)

PAG236::exists_charMul_eq.text:
theorem exists_charMul_eq {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (hmn : Nat.Coprime m n)
    {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (m * n)} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m, ∃ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n,
      χ₁.IsPrimitive ∧ χ₂.IsPrimitive ∧ charMul χ₁ χ₂ = χ

PAG236::cast_crt_fst.text:
theorem cast_crt_fst {a b c : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hc : c ∣ a) (x : ZMod (a * b)) :
    (ZMod.cast (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).1 : ZMod c) = ZMod.cast x

PAG236::cast_crt_snd.text:
theorem cast_crt_snd {a b c : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hc : c ∣ b) (x : ZMod (a * b)) :
    (ZMod.cast (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).2 : ZMod c) = ZMod.cast x

PAG236::liftc_charMul.text:
theorem liftc_charMul {a b ca cb : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hca : ca ∣ a) (hcb : cb ∣ b)
    (χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) (u : (ZMod (a * b))ˣ) :
    liftc (charMul χa χb) (a * b) (u : ZMod (a * b)) =
      liftc χa a (unitFst hab u : ZMod a) * liftc χb b (unitSnd hab u : ZMod b)

PAG236::tens.text: def tens {a b : ℕ} (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (g : ZMod b → ℂ) : ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ := fun p => f p.1 * g p.2

PAG236::tens_apply.text:
theorem tens_apply {a b : ℕ} (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (g : ZMod b → ℂ) (p : ZMod a × ZMod b) :
    tens f g p = f p.1 * g p.2

PAG236::tens_zero_left.text: theorem tens_zero_left {a b : ℕ} (g : ZMod b → ℂ) : tens (0 : ZMod a → ℂ) g = 0

PAG236::tens_zero_right.text: theorem tens_zero_right {a b : ℕ} (f : ZMod a → ℂ) : tens f (0 : ZMod b → ℂ) = 0

PAG236::tens_sum_left.text:
theorem tens_sum_left {a b : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ZMod a → ℂ) (g : ZMod b → ℂ) :
    tens (∑ i ∈ s, f i) g = ∑ i ∈ s, tens (f i) g

PAG236::tens_sum_right.text:
theorem tens_sum_right {a b : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (g : ι → ZMod b → ℂ) :
    tens f (∑ i ∈ s, g i) = ∑ i ∈ s, tens f (g i)

PAG236::leftOp_tens.text:
theorem leftOp_tens {a : ℕ} (b : ℕ) (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (g : ZMod b → ℂ) :
    leftOp b S (tens f g) = tens (S f) g

PAG236::rightOp_tens.text:
theorem rightOp_tens (a : ℕ) {b : ℕ} (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)) (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (g : ZMod b → ℂ) :
    rightOp a T (tens f g) = tens f (T g)

PAG236::leftOp_mul.text:
theorem leftOp_mul {a : ℕ} (b : ℕ) (S S' : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) :
    leftOp b (S * S') = leftOp b S * leftOp b S'

PAG236::rightOp_mul.text:
theorem rightOp_mul (a : ℕ) {b : ℕ} (T T' : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)) :
    rightOp a (T * T') = rightOp a T * rightOp a T'

PAG236::single_eq_tens.text:
theorem single_eq_tens {a b : ℕ} (p : ZMod a × ZMod b) :
    (Pi.single p 1 : ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) = tens (Pi.single p.1 1) (Pi.single p.2 1)

PAG236::ext_tens.text:
theorem ext_tens {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] {M₁ M₂ : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ)}
    (h : ∀ (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (g : ZMod b → ℂ), M₁ (tens f g) = M₂ (tens f g)) : M₁ = M₂

PAG236::ext_tens_block.text:
theorem ext_tens_block {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)] [Fintype (BlockIdx b)]
    {M₁ M₂ : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ)}
    (h : ∀ (p : BlockIdx a) (q : BlockIdx b) (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (g : ZMod b → ℂ),
      f ∈ blockSpan a p.1 p.2.1 → g ∈ blockSpan b q.1 q.2.1 → M₁ (tens f g) = M₂ (tens f g)) :
    M₁ = M₂

PAG236::crtProd.text:
noncomputable def crtProd {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (g : ZMod b → ℂ) :
    ZMod (a * b) → ℂ :=
  (crtLin hab).symm (tens f g)

PAG236::crtProd_apply.text:
theorem crtProd_apply {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (g : ZMod b → ℂ) (x : ZMod (a * b)) :
    crtProd hab f g x = f (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).1 * g (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).2

PAG236::crtLin_crtProd.text:
theorem crtLin_crtProd {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (g : ZMod b → ℂ) :
    crtLin hab (crtProd hab f g) = tens f g

PAG236::crtConj_apply_tens.text:
theorem crtConj_apply_tens {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ))
    (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (g : ZMod b → ℂ) : crtConj hab T (tens f g) = crtLin hab (T (crtProd hab f g))

PAG236::crtProd_smul_smul.text:
theorem crtProd_smul_smul {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (r s : ℂ) (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (g : ZMod b → ℂ) :
    crtProd hab (r • f) (s • g) = (r * s) • crtProd hab f g

PAG236::dil_crtProd.text:
theorem dil_crtProd {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (u : (ZMod (a * b))ˣ) (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (g : ZMod b → ℂ) :
    dil u (crtProd hab f g) = crtProd hab (dil (unitFst hab u) f) (dil (unitSnd hab u) g)

PAG236::crtProd_mem_layerPart.text:
theorem crtProd_mem_layerPart {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ}
    [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    {χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca} {χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb} (hχa : χa.IsPrimitive) (hχb : χb.IsPrimitive)
    {f : ZMod a → ℂ} {g : ZMod b → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ layerPart a ca χa da) (hg : g ∈ layerPart b cb χb db) :
    crtProd hab f g ∈ layerPart (a * b) (ca * cb) (charMul χa χb) (da * db)

PAG236::blockProj_eq_ite.text:
open Classical in
theorem blockProj_eq_ite {N c c' : ℕ} [NeZero N] [NeZero c] [NeZero c'] (hcN : c ∣ N) (hc'N : c' ∣ N)
    {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c} {χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c'} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive)
    {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ) :
    blockProj N c' χ' f = if (⟨c, χ⟩ : Σ c : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ c) = ⟨c', χ'⟩ then f else 0

PAG236::sigma_charMul_eq_iff.text:
theorem sigma_charMul_eq_iff {a b ca cb ca' cb' : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb] [NeZero ca'] [NeZero cb']
    (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hca : ca ∣ a) (hcb : cb ∣ b) (hca' : ca' ∣ a) (hcb' : cb' ∣ b)
    (χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) (χa' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca')
    (χb' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb') :
    (⟨ca' * cb', charMul χa' χb'⟩ : Σ c : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ c) = ⟨ca * cb, charMul χa χb⟩ ↔
      (⟨ca', χa'⟩ : Σ c : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ c) = ⟨ca, χa⟩ ∧
        (⟨cb', χb'⟩ : Σ c : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ c) = ⟨cb, χb⟩

PAG236::crtConj_blockProjL.text:
theorem crtConj_blockProjL {a b ca cb : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    [Fintype (BlockIdx a)] [Fintype (BlockIdx b)] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hca : ca ∣ a) (hcb : cb ∣ b)
    {χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca} {χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb} (hχa : χa.IsPrimitive) (hχb : χb.IsPrimitive) :
    crtConj hab (blockProjL (a * b) (ca * cb) (charMul χa χb)) =
      leftOp b (blockProjL a ca χa) * rightOp a (blockProjL b cb χb)

PAG236::crtConj_blockProjL_exists.text:
theorem crtConj_blockProjL_exists {a b ca cb : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    [Fintype (BlockIdx a)] [Fintype (BlockIdx b)] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hca : ca ∣ a) (hcb : cb ∣ b)
    {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (ca * cb)} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca, ∃ χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb, χa.IsPrimitive ∧ χb.IsPrimitive ∧
      charMul χa χb = χ ∧
        crtConj hab (blockProjL (a * b) (ca * cb) χ) =
          leftOp b (blockProjL a ca χa) * rightOp a (blockProjL b cb χb)

PAG236::crtConj_centralElt.text:
theorem crtConj_centralElt {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)] [Fintype (BlockIdx b)]
    [Fintype (BlockIdx (a * b))] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ}
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b) :
    crtConj hab (centralElt (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db)) =
      leftOp b (centralElt a ca da) * rightOp a (centralElt b cb db)

PAG236::crtConj_centralElt_split.text:
theorem crtConj_centralElt_split {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)] [Fintype (BlockIdx b)]
    [Fintype (BlockIdx (a * b))] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {c d : ℕ}
    (hr : (⟨c, d⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx (a * b)) :
    crtConj hab (centralElt (a * b) c d) =
      leftOp b (centralElt a (Nat.gcd c a) (Nat.gcd d a)) * rightOp a (centralElt b (Nat.gcd c b) (Nat.gcd d b))

PAG236::crtConj_layerBlockProj.text:
theorem crtConj_layerBlockProj {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)] [Fintype (BlockIdx b)]
    (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    {χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca} {χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb} (hχa : χa.IsPrimitive) (hχb : χb.IsPrimitive) :
    crtConj hab (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (layerInd (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db)) *
        blockProjL (a * b) (ca * cb) (charMul χa χb)) =
      leftOp b (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (layerInd a ca da) * blockProjL a ca χa) *
        rightOp a (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (layerInd b cb db) * blockProjL b cb χb)

PAG236::crtConj_matUnit_self.text:
theorem crtConj_matUnit_self {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)] [Fintype (BlockIdx b)]
    (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    {χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca} {χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb} (hχa : χa.IsPrimitive) (hχb : χb.IsPrimitive) :
    crtConj hab (matUnit (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db) (charMul χa χb) (charMul χa χb)) =
      leftOp b (matUnit a ca da χa χa) * rightOp a (matUnit b cb db χb χb)

PAG237::mod_div_eq_div_mod.text: theorem mod_div_eq_div_mod {n a d : ℕ} (hda : d ∣ a) : n % a / d = n / d % (a / d)

PAG237::crt_fst_div_cast.text:
theorem crt_fst_div_cast {a b ca da db : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hda : da ∣ a)
    (hca : ca ∣ a / da) (hdb : 0 < db) {x : ZMod (a * b)} (hx : da * db ∣ x.val) :
    (((ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).1.val / da : ℕ) : ZMod ca) =
      (db : ZMod ca) * ((x.val / (da * db) : ℕ) : ZMod ca)

PAG237::crt_snd_div_cast.text:
theorem crt_snd_div_cast {a b cb da db : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hdb : db ∣ b)
    (hcb : cb ∣ b / db) (hda : 0 < da) {x : ZMod (a * b)} (hx : da * db ∣ x.val) :
    (((ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).2.val / db : ℕ) : ZMod cb) =
      (da : ZMod cb) * ((x.val / (da * db) : ℕ) : ZMod cb)

PAG237::isUnit_cast_of_dvd.text:
theorem isUnit_cast_of_dvd {a b ca db : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hca : ca ∣ a) (hdb : db ∣ b) :
    IsUnit (db : ZMod ca)

PAG237::phase_ne_zero.text:
theorem phase_ne_zero {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} (hca : ca ∣ a) (hcb : cb ∣ b)
    (hda : da ∣ a) (hdb : db ∣ b) (ψa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (ψb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) :
    ψa (db : ZMod ca) * ψb (da : ZMod cb) ≠ 0

PAG237::twist_mul_layerInd_crt.text:
theorem twist_mul_layerInd_crt {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ}
    [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    (χa χa' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb χb' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) (x : ZMod (a * b)) :
    (χa' * χa⁻¹) (db : ZMod ca) * (χb' * χb⁻¹) (da : ZMod cb) *
        (twistFn (a * b) (ca * cb) (charMul χa χb) (charMul χa' χb') * layerInd (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db)) x =
      (twistFn a ca χa χa' * layerInd a ca da) (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).1 *
        (twistFn b cb χb χb' * layerInd b cb db) (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).2

PAG237::smul_crtConj_mulLeft.text:
theorem smul_crtConj_mulLeft {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (r : ℂ) (F : ZMod (a * b) → ℂ) (Ga : ZMod a → ℂ)
    (Gb : ZMod b → ℂ)
    (h : ∀ x, r * F x = Ga (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).1 * Gb (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).2) :
    r • crtConj hab (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ F) =
      leftOp b (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ Ga) * rightOp a (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ Gb)

PAG237::smul_crtConj_twistLayer.text:
theorem smul_crtConj_twistLayer {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ}
    [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    (χa χa' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb χb' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) :
    ((χa' * χa⁻¹) (db : ZMod ca) * (χb' * χb⁻¹) (da : ZMod cb)) •
        crtConj hab (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ
          (twistFn (a * b) (ca * cb) (charMul χa χb) (charMul χa' χb') * layerInd (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db))) =
      leftOp b (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (twistFn a ca χa χa' * layerInd a ca da)) *
        rightOp a (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (twistFn b cb χb χb' * layerInd b cb db))

PAG237::matUnit_eq_mul.text:
theorem matUnit_eq_mul (N c d : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    matUnit N c d χ χ' = LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (twistFn N c χ χ' * layerInd N c d) * blockProjL N c χ

PAG237::smul_crtConj_matUnit.text:
theorem smul_crtConj_matUnit {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)] [Fintype (BlockIdx b)]
    (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    {χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca} {χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb} (hχa : χa.IsPrimitive) (hχb : χb.IsPrimitive)
    (χa' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) :
    ((χa' * χa⁻¹) (db : ZMod ca) * (χb' * χb⁻¹) (da : ZMod cb)) •
        crtConj hab (matUnit (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db) (charMul χa χb) (charMul χa' χb')) =
      leftOp b (matUnit a ca da χa χa') * rightOp a (matUnit b cb db χb χb')

PAG237::crtConj_matUnit.text:
theorem crtConj_matUnit {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)] [Fintype (BlockIdx b)]
    (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    {χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca} {χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb} (hχa : χa.IsPrimitive) (hχb : χb.IsPrimitive)
    (χa' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) :
    crtConj hab (matUnit (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db) (charMul χa χb) (charMul χa' χb')) =
      ((χa' * χa⁻¹) (db : ZMod ca) * (χb' * χb⁻¹) (da : ZMod cb))⁻¹ •
        (leftOp b (matUnit a ca da χa χa') * rightOp a (matUnit b cb db χb χb'))

PAG237::gaugeFactor.text:
noncomputable def gaugeFactor {ca cb : ℕ} (da db : ℕ) (χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) :
    ℂ :=
  χa (db : ZMod ca) * χb (da : ZMod cb)

PAG237::gaugeFactor_ne_zero.text:
theorem gaugeFactor_ne_zero {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} (hca : ca ∣ a) (hcb : cb ∣ b)
    (hda : da ∣ a) (hdb : db ∣ b) (χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) :
    gaugeFactor da db χa χb ≠ 0

PAG237::phase_eq_div.text:
theorem phase_eq_div {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} (hca : ca ∣ a) (hcb : cb ∣ b)
    (hda : da ∣ a) (hdb : db ∣ b) (χa χa' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb χb' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) :
    (χa' * χa⁻¹) (db : ZMod ca) * (χb' * χb⁻¹) (da : ZMod cb) =
      gaugeFactor da db χa' χb' / gaugeFactor da db χa χb

PAG237::gauge_crtConj_matUnit.text:
theorem gauge_crtConj_matUnit {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)] [Fintype (BlockIdx b)]
    (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    {χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca} {χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb} (hχa : χa.IsPrimitive) (hχb : χb.IsPrimitive)
    (χa' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) :
    gaugeFactor da db χa' χb' • crtConj hab (matUnit (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db) (charMul χa χb) (charMul χa' χb')) =
      gaugeFactor da db χa χb • (leftOp b (matUnit a ca da χa χa') * rightOp a (matUnit b cb db χb χb'))

PAG237::exists_gauge_crtConj_matUnit.text:
theorem exists_gauge_crtConj_matUnit {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)]
    [Fintype (BlockIdx b)] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    {χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (ca * cb)} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ χa χa' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca, ∃ χb χb' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb,
      χa.IsPrimitive ∧ χa'.IsPrimitive ∧ χb.IsPrimitive ∧ χb'.IsPrimitive ∧
        charMul χa χb = χ ∧ charMul χa' χb' = χ' ∧
          gaugeFactor da db χa' χb' • crtConj hab (matUnit (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db) χ χ') =
            gaugeFactor da db χa χb • (leftOp b (matUnit a ca da χa χa') * rightOp a (matUnit b cb db χb χb'))

PAG237::gaugeUnit.text:
noncomputable def gaugeUnit (a b ca da cb db : ℕ) [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    (χa χa' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb χb' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ) :=
  (gaugeFactor da db χa' χb' / gaugeFactor da db χa χb) •
    matUnit (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db) (charMul χa χb) (charMul χa' χb')

PAG237::crtConj_gaugeUnit.text:
theorem crtConj_gaugeUnit {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)] [Fintype (BlockIdx b)]
    (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    {χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca} {χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb} (hχa : χa.IsPrimitive) (hχb : χb.IsPrimitive)
    (χa' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) :
    crtConj hab (gaugeUnit a b ca da cb db χa χa' χb χb') =
      leftOp b (matUnit a ca da χa χa') * rightOp a (matUnit b cb db χb χb')

PAG237::crtConj_symm_tensor_matUnit.text:
theorem crtConj_symm_tensor_matUnit {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)]
    [Fintype (BlockIdx b)] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    {χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca} {χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb} (hχa : χa.IsPrimitive) (hχb : χb.IsPrimitive)
    (χa' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) :
    (crtConj hab).symm (leftOp b (matUnit a ca da χa χa') * rightOp a (matUnit b cb db χb χb')) =
      gaugeUnit a b ca da cb db χa χa' χb χb'

PAG237::gaugeUnit_self.text:
theorem gaugeUnit_self {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} [NeZero ca]
    [NeZero cb] (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    (χa : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) :
    gaugeUnit a b ca da cb db χa χa χb χb = matUnit (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db) (charMul χa χb) (charMul χa χb)

PAG237::gaugeUnit_mul.text:
theorem gaugeUnit_mul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} [NeZero ca]
    [NeZero cb] (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    (χa χa' χa'' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb χb' χb'' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb)
    (hχa' : χa'.IsPrimitive) (hχb' : χb'.IsPrimitive) :
    gaugeUnit a b ca da cb db χa' χa'' χb' χb'' * gaugeUnit a b ca da cb db χa χa' χb χb' =
      gaugeUnit a b ca da cb db χa χa'' χb χb''

PAG237::gaugeUnit_mul_of_ne.text:
theorem gaugeUnit_mul_of_ne {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ}
    [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb] (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a)
    (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    (ψa χa'' χa χa' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (ψb χb'' χb χb' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb)
    (hψa : ψa.IsPrimitive) (hψb : ψb.IsPrimitive) (hχa' : χa'.IsPrimitive) (hχb' : χb'.IsPrimitive)
    (h : ¬ (ψa = χa' ∧ ψb = χb')) :
    gaugeUnit a b ca da cb db ψa χa'' ψb χb'' * gaugeUnit a b ca da cb db χa χa' χb χb' = 0

PAG238::blockSum.text:
noncomputable def blockSum (N c d : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (A : Matrix (Prim c) (Prim c) ℂ) :
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  ∑ i : Prim c, ∑ j : Prim c, A i j • matUnit N c d j.1 i.1

PAG238::matSum_eq_sum_blockSum.text:
theorem matSum_eq_sum_blockSum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) :
    matSum N M = ∑ p : centerIdx N, blockSum N p.1.1 p.1.2 (M p)

PAG238::blockSum_cast.text:
theorem blockSum_cast {N c c' d d' : ℕ} [NeZero N] [NeZero c] [NeZero c'] (hc : c = c') (hd : d = d')
    (A : Matrix (Prim c') (Prim c') ℂ) :
    blockSum N c d (A.submatrix (Equiv.cast (congrArg Prim hc)) (Equiv.cast (congrArg Prim hc))) =
      blockSum N c' d' A

PAG238::gaugeP.text: noncomputable def gaugeP {ca cb : ℕ} (da db : ℕ) (x : Prim ca × Prim cb) : ℂ := gaugeFactor da db x.1.1 x.2.1

PAG238::primEquiv_apply_val.text:
theorem primEquiv_apply_val {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (hmn : Nat.Coprime m n) (x : Prim m × Prim n) :
    ((primEquiv hmn x : Prim (m * n)) : DirichletCharacter ℂ (m * n)) = charMul x.1.1 x.2.1

PAG238::kronG.text:
noncomputable def kronG {ca cb : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb] (hcop : Nat.Coprime ca cb) (da db : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix (Prim ca) (Prim ca) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Prim cb) (Prim cb) ℂ) :
    Matrix (Prim (ca * cb)) (Prim (ca * cb)) ℂ :=
  fun χ χ' => (gaugeP da db ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ) / gaugeP da db ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ')) *
    (A ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ).1 ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ').1 *
      B ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ).2 ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ').2)

PAG238::kronG_apply.text:
theorem kronG_apply {ca cb : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb] (hcop : Nat.Coprime ca cb) (da db : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix (Prim ca) (Prim ca) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Prim cb) (Prim cb) ℂ) (x y : Prim ca × Prim cb) :
    kronG hcop da db A B (primEquiv hcop x) (primEquiv hcop y) =
      (gaugeP da db x / gaugeP da db y) * (A x.1 y.1 * B x.2 y.2)

PAG238::kronG_eq.text:
theorem kronG_eq {ca cb : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb] (hcop : Nat.Coprime ca cb) (da db : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix (Prim ca) (Prim ca) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Prim cb) (Prim cb) ℂ) :
    kronG hcop da db A B = Matrix.diagonal (fun χ => gaugeP da db ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ)) *
      Matrix.reindex (primEquiv hcop) (primEquiv hcop) (Matrix.kroneckerMap (· * ·) A B) *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun χ => (gaugeP da db ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ))⁻¹)

PAG238::kronG_mul.text:
theorem kronG_mul {ca cb : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb] (hcop : Nat.Coprime ca cb) (da db : ℕ)
    (hg : ∀ x : Prim ca × Prim cb, gaugeP da db x ≠ 0)
    (A A' : Matrix (Prim ca) (Prim ca) ℂ) (B B' : Matrix (Prim cb) (Prim cb) ℂ) :
    kronG hcop da db A B * kronG hcop da db A' B' = kronG hcop da db (A * A') (B * B')

PAG238::kronG_one.text:
theorem kronG_one {ca cb : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb] (hcop : Nat.Coprime ca cb) (da db : ℕ)
    (hg : ∀ x : Prim ca × Prim cb, gaugeP da db x ≠ 0) :
    kronG hcop da db (1 : Matrix (Prim ca) (Prim ca) ℂ) (1 : Matrix (Prim cb) (Prim cb) ℂ) = 1

PAG238::crtConj_blockSum.text:
theorem crtConj_blockSum {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)] [Fintype (BlockIdx b)]
    (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb] (hcop : Nat.Coprime ca cb)
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    (A : Matrix (Prim ca) (Prim ca) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Prim cb) (Prim cb) ℂ) :
    crtConj hab (blockSum (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db) (kronG hcop da db A B)) =
      leftOp b (blockSum a ca da A) * rightOp a (blockSum b cb db B)

PAG238::coprime_of_mem_centerIdx.text:
theorem coprime_of_mem_centerIdx {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {p q : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ} (hp : p ∈ centerIdx a)
    (hq : q ∈ centerIdx b) : Nat.Coprime p.1 q.1

PAG238::centerIdxEquiv.text:
noncomputable def centerIdxEquiv {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) : centerIdx (a * b) ≃ centerIdx a × centerIdx b where
  toFun r := (⟨(idxSplit a b r.1).1, (idxSplit_mem hab (c := r.1.1) (d := r.1.2) r.2).1⟩,
    ⟨(idxSplit a b r.1).2, (idxSplit_mem hab (c := r.1.1) (d := r.1.2) r.2).2⟩)
  invFun pq := ⟨idxMul pq.1.1 pq.2.1,
    idxMul_mem_centerIdx hab (ca := pq.1.1.1) (da := pq.1.1.2) (cb := pq.2.1.1) (db := pq.2.1.2) pq.1.2 pq.2.2⟩
  left_inv r := Subtype.ext (idxMul_idxSplit hab (c := r.1.1) (d := r.1.2) r.2)
  right_inv pq := by
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨ca, da⟩, hp⟩, ⟨⟨cb, db⟩, hq⟩⟩ := pq
    have h := idxSplit_idxMul hab hp hq
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.fst h)) (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.snd h))

PAG238::centerIdxEquiv_apply_fst.text:
theorem centerIdxEquiv_apply_fst {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (r : centerIdx (a * b)) :
    ((centerIdxEquiv hab r).1 : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) = ⟨Nat.gcd r.1.1 a, Nat.gcd r.1.2 a⟩

PAG238::centerIdxEquiv_apply_snd.text:
theorem centerIdxEquiv_apply_snd {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (r : centerIdx (a * b)) :
    ((centerIdxEquiv hab r).2 : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) = ⟨Nat.gcd r.1.1 b, Nat.gcd r.1.2 b⟩

PAG238::centerIdxEquiv_symm_apply.text:
theorem centerIdxEquiv_symm_apply {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (pq : centerIdx a × centerIdx b) :
    (((centerIdxEquiv hab).symm pq : centerIdx (a * b)) : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) = idxMul pq.1.1 pq.2.1

PAG238::centerIdxEquiv_fst_mul.text:
theorem centerIdxEquiv_fst_mul {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (r : centerIdx (a * b)) :
    r.1.1 = (centerIdxEquiv hab r).1.1.1 * (centerIdxEquiv hab r).2.1.1

PAG238::centerIdxEquiv_snd_mul.text:
theorem centerIdxEquiv_snd_mul {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (r : centerIdx (a * b)) :
    r.1.2 = (centerIdxEquiv hab r).1.1.2 * (centerIdxEquiv hab r).2.1.2

PAG238::tensorFamily.text:
noncomputable def tensorFamily {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (Ma : Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
    (Mb : Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) :
    Π r : centerIdx (a * b), Matrix (Prim r.1.1) (Prim r.1.1) ℂ :=
  fun r => (kronG (coprime_of_mem_centerIdx hab (centerIdxEquiv hab r).1.2 (centerIdxEquiv hab r).2.2)
      (centerIdxEquiv hab r).1.1.2 (centerIdxEquiv hab r).2.1.2
      (Ma (centerIdxEquiv hab r).1) (Mb (centerIdxEquiv hab r).2)).submatrix
    (Equiv.cast (congrArg Prim (centerIdxEquiv_fst_mul hab r)))
    (Equiv.cast (congrArg Prim (centerIdxEquiv_fst_mul hab r)))

PAG238::tensorFamily_mul.text:
theorem tensorFamily_mul {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (Ma Ma' : Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
    (Mb Mb' : Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) :
    tensorFamily hab (Ma * Ma') (Mb * Mb') = tensorFamily hab Ma Mb * tensorFamily hab Ma' Mb'

PAG238::tensorFamily_one.text:
theorem tensorFamily_one {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    tensorFamily hab (1 : Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
      (1 : Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) = 1

PAG238::crtConj_matSum_tensorFamily.text:
theorem crtConj_matSum_tensorFamily {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)] [Fintype (BlockIdx b)]
    (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (Ma : Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
    (Mb : Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) :
    crtConj hab (matSum (a * b) (tensorFamily hab Ma Mb)) = leftOp b (matSum a Ma) * rightOp a (matSum b Mb)

PAG238::crtConj_fullCommMatrixEquiv.text:
theorem crtConj_fullCommMatrixEquiv {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)]
    [Fintype (BlockIdx b)] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (Ma : Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
    (Mb : Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) :
    crtConj hab (fullCommMatrixEquiv (a * b) (tensorFamily hab Ma Mb) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ)) =
      leftOp b (fullCommMatrixEquiv a Ma : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) *
        rightOp a (fullCommMatrixEquiv b Mb : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))

PAG239::matTensorEquiv.text:
noncomputable def matTensorEquiv {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) ⊗[ℂ]
        (Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) ≃ₐ[ℂ]
      (Π r : centerIdx (a * b), Matrix (Prim r.1.1) (Prim r.1.1) ℂ) :=
  (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (fullCommMatrixEquiv a) (fullCommMatrixEquiv b)).trans
    ((fullCommTensorEquiv hab).trans (fullCommMatrixEquiv (a * b)).symm)

PAG239::fullCommMatrixEquiv_coe.text:
theorem fullCommMatrixEquiv_coe (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) :
    (fullCommMatrixEquiv N M : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) = matSum N M

PAG239::fullCommMatrixEquiv_matTensorEqu.text:
theorem fullCommMatrixEquiv_matTensorEquiv {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (x : (Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) ⊗[ℂ]
      (Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ)) :
    fullCommMatrixEquiv (a * b) (matTensorEquiv hab x) =
      fullCommTensorEquiv hab (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (fullCommMatrixEquiv a) (fullCommMatrixEquiv b) x)

PAG239::matTensorEquiv_tmul.text:
theorem matTensorEquiv_tmul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (Ma : Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
