    (Mb : Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) :
    matTensorEquiv hab (Ma ⊗ₜ[ℂ] Mb) = tensorFamily hab Ma Mb

PAG239::tensorFamily_add_left.text:
theorem tensorFamily_add_left {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (Ma Ma' : Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
    (Mb : Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) :
    tensorFamily hab (Ma + Ma') Mb = tensorFamily hab Ma Mb + tensorFamily hab Ma' Mb

PAG239::tensorFamily_add_right.text:
theorem tensorFamily_add_right {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (Ma : Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
    (Mb Mb' : Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) :
    tensorFamily hab Ma (Mb + Mb') = tensorFamily hab Ma Mb + tensorFamily hab Ma Mb'

PAG239::tensorFamily_smul_left.text:
theorem tensorFamily_smul_left {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (c : ℂ)
    (Ma : Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
    (Mb : Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) :
    tensorFamily hab (c • Ma) Mb = c • tensorFamily hab Ma Mb

PAG239::tensorFamily_smul_right.text:
theorem tensorFamily_smul_right {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (c : ℂ)
    (Ma : Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
    (Mb : Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) :
    tensorFamily hab Ma (c • Mb) = c • tensorFamily hab Ma Mb

PAG239::span_tensorFamily_eq_top.text:
theorem span_tensorFamily_eq_top {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun x : (Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) ×
        (Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) => tensorFamily hab x.1 x.2) = ⊤

PAG239::finrank_matrixPi_mul.text:
theorem finrank_matrixPi_mul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Π r : centerIdx (a * b), Matrix (Prim r.1.1) (Prim r.1.1) ℂ) =
      Module.finrank ℂ (Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) *
        Module.finrank ℂ (Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ)

PAG239::sum_card_prim_sq_mul.text:
theorem sum_card_prim_sq_mul {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    ∑ r : centerIdx (a * b), Fintype.card (Prim r.1.1) ^ 2 =
      (∑ p : centerIdx a, Fintype.card (Prim p.1.1) ^ 2) * ∑ q : centerIdx b, Fintype.card (Prim q.1.1) ^ 2

PAG239::leftMatHom.text:
noncomputable def leftMatHom (a b : ℕ) [NeZero a] :
    (Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) :=
  (leftHom a b).comp ((fullCommAlg a).val.comp (fullCommMatrixEquiv a).toAlgHom)

PAG239::rightMatHom.text:
noncomputable def rightMatHom (a b : ℕ) [NeZero b] :
    (Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) :=
  (rightHom a b).comp ((fullCommAlg b).val.comp (fullCommMatrixEquiv b).toAlgHom)

PAG239::leftMatHom_apply.text:
theorem leftMatHom_apply (a b : ℕ) [NeZero a] (Ma : Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) :
    leftMatHom a b Ma = leftOp b (matSum a Ma)

PAG239::rightMatHom_apply.text:
theorem rightMatHom_apply (a b : ℕ) [NeZero b] (Mb : Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) :
    rightMatHom a b Mb = rightOp a (matSum b Mb)

PAG239::leftMatHom_commute_rightMatHom.text:
theorem leftMatHom_commute_rightMatHom (a b : ℕ) [NeZero a] [NeZero b]
    (Ma : Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
    (Mb : Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) :
    Commute (leftMatHom a b Ma) (rightMatHom a b Mb)

PAG239::crtConj_matTensorEquiv.text:
theorem crtConj_matTensorEquiv {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    (crtConj hab).toAlgHom.comp ((fullCommAlg (a * b)).val.comp
        ((fullCommMatrixEquiv (a * b)).toAlgHom.comp (matTensorEquiv hab).toAlgHom)) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (leftMatHom a b) (rightMatHom a b) (leftMatHom_commute_rightMatHom a b)

PAG239::crtConj_matTensorEquiv_apply.text:
theorem crtConj_matTensorEquiv_apply {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (x : (Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) ⊗[ℂ]
      (Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ)) :
    crtConj hab (matSum (a * b) (matTensorEquiv hab x)) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (leftMatHom a b) (rightMatHom a b) (leftMatHom_commute_rightMatHom a b) x

PAG239::matTensorEquiv_single_one.text:
theorem matTensorEquiv_single_one {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (p : centerIdx a)
    (q : centerIdx b) :
    matTensorEquiv hab ((Pi.single p 1 : Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
        (Pi.single q 1 : Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ)) =
      Pi.single ((centerIdxEquiv hab).symm (p, q)) 1

PAG240::prodList.text:
@[implicit_reducible] def prodList : List ℕ+ → ℕ
  | [] => 1
  | a :: l => (a : ℕ) * prodList l

PAG240::prodList_cons.text: theorem prodList_cons (a : ℕ+) (l : List ℕ+) : prodList (a :: l) = (a : ℕ) * prodList l

PAG240::prodList_pos.text:
theorem prodList_pos : ∀ l : List ℕ+, 0 < prodList l
  | [] => Nat.one_pos
  | a :: l => Nat.mul_pos a.pos (prodList_pos l)

PAG240::neZero_prodList.text: instance neZero_prodList (l : List ℕ+) : NeZero (prodList l) := ⟨(prodList_pos l).ne'⟩

PAG240::prodList_eq_prod.text:
theorem prodList_eq_prod : ∀ l : List ℕ+, prodList l = (l.map (fun a : ℕ+ => (a : ℕ))).prod
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => by rw [prodList_cons, prodList_eq_prod l, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]

PAG240::CoprimeList.text: def CoprimeList (l : List ℕ+) : Prop := l.Pairwise (fun a b : ℕ+ => Nat.Coprime (a : ℕ) (b : ℕ))

PAG240::coprime_prodList.text:
theorem coprime_prodList {a : ℕ+} : ∀ {l : List ℕ+}, (∀ b ∈ l, Nat.Coprime (a : ℕ) (b : ℕ)) →
    Nat.Coprime (a : ℕ) (prodList l)
  | [], _ => Nat.coprime_one_right _
  | b :: l, h => Nat.Coprime.mul_right (h b (by simp)) (coprime_prodList fun c hc => h c (by simp [hc]))

PAG240::CoprimeList.head.text:
theorem CoprimeList.head {a : ℕ+} {l : List ℕ+} (h : CoprimeList (a :: l)) :
    Nat.Coprime (a : ℕ) (prodList l)

PAG240::CoprimeList.tail.text: theorem CoprimeList.tail {a : ℕ+} {l : List ℕ+} (h : CoprimeList (a :: l)) : CoprimeList l

PAG240::get_dvd_prodList.text:
theorem get_dvd_prodList : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (k : Fin l.length), ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) ∣ prodList l
  | _ :: _, ⟨0, _⟩ => dvd_mul_right _ _
  | b :: l, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ => dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (get_dvd_prodList l ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk⟩) (b : ℕ)

PAG240::locHom.text:
noncomputable def locHom : (l : List ℕ+) → CoprimeList l → (k : Fin l.length) →
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) → ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod (prodList l) → ℂ)
  | a :: l, h, ⟨0, _⟩ => (crtConj h.head).symm.toAlgHom.comp (leftHom (a : ℕ) (prodList l))
  | a :: l, h, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ => (crtConj h.head).symm.toAlgHom.comp
      ((rightHom (a : ℕ) (prodList l)).comp (locHom l h.tail ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk⟩))

PAG240::locHom_zero.text:
theorem locHom_zero (a : ℕ+) (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList (a :: l)) (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a : ℕ) → ℂ)) :
    locHom (a :: l) h 0 S = (crtConj h.head).symm (leftOp (prodList l) S)

PAG240::locHom_succ.text:
theorem locHom_succ (a : ℕ+) (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList (a :: l)) (k : Fin l.length)
    (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) → ℂ)) :
    locHom (a :: l) h k.succ T = (crtConj h.head).symm (rightOp (a : ℕ) (locHom l h.tail k T))

PAG240::locHom_injective.text:
theorem locHom_injective : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (k : Fin l.length),
    Function.Injective (locHom l h k)
  | a :: l, h, ⟨0, _⟩ => by
    intro S T hST
    exact leftHom_injective (a : ℕ) (prodList l) ((crtConj h.head).symm.injective hST)
  | a :: l, h, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ => by
    intro S T hST
    exact locHom_injective l h.tail ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk⟩
      (rightHom_injective (a : ℕ) (prodList l) ((crtConj h.head).symm.injective hST))

PAG240::locHom_commute.text:
theorem locHom_commute : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) {j k : Fin l.length} (_ : j ≠ k)
    (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((l.get j : ℕ+) : ℕ) → ℂ)) (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) → ℂ)),
    Commute (locHom l h j S) (locHom l h k T)
  | _ :: _, _, ⟨0, _⟩, ⟨0, _⟩, hjk, _, _ => (hjk rfl).elim
  | a :: l, h, ⟨0, _⟩, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩, _, S, T => by
    exact (leftOp_commute_rightOp S (locHom l h.tail ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk⟩ T)).map (crtConj h.head).symm
  | a :: l, h, ⟨j + 1, hj⟩, ⟨0, _⟩, _, S, T => by
    exact ((leftOp_commute_rightOp T (locHom l h.tail ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩ S)).map
      (crtConj h.head).symm).symm
  | a :: l, h, ⟨j + 1, hj⟩, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩, hjk, S, T => by
    have hne : (⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩ : Fin l.length) ≠ ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk⟩

PAG240::crt_fst_eq_castHom.text:
theorem crt_fst_eq_castHom {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (x : ZMod (a * b)) :
    (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).1 = ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right a b) (ZMod a) x

PAG240::castHom_crt_snd.text:
theorem castHom_crt_snd {a b c : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hc : c ∣ b) (x : ZMod (a * b)) :
    ZMod.castHom hc (ZMod c) (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab x).2 =
      ZMod.castHom (dvd_trans hc (dvd_mul_left b a)) (ZMod c) x

PAG240::locHom_mulLeft.text:
theorem locHom_mulLeft : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (k : Fin l.length)
    (g : ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) → ℂ),
    locHom l h k (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ g) =
      LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (fun x => g (ZMod.castHom (get_dvd_prodList l k) _ x))
  | a :: l, h, ⟨0, _⟩, g => by
    show (crtConj h.head).symm (leftOp (prodList l) (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (g : ZMod (a : ℕ) → ℂ))) =
      LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (fun x => g (ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right (a : ℕ) (prodList l)) (ZMod (a : ℕ)) x))
    rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro F
    funext p
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩

PAG240::liftL.text:
def liftL : (l : List ℕ+) → CoprimeList l → (k : Fin l.length) → ZMod (prodList l) →
    ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) → ZMod (prodList l)
  | _ :: _, h, ⟨0, _⟩, x, y => (ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head).symm (y, (ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head x).2)
  | _ :: l, h, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩, x, y => (ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head).symm
      ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head x).1,
        liftL l h.tail ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk⟩ (ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head x).2 y)

PAG240::locHom_apply.text:
theorem locHom_apply : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (k : Fin l.length)
    (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) → ℂ)) (F : ZMod (prodList l) → ℂ) (x : ZMod (prodList l)),
    locHom l h k S F x = S (fun y => F (liftL l h k x y)) (ZMod.castHom (get_dvd_prodList l k) _ x)
  | a :: l, h, ⟨0, _⟩, S, F, x => by
    show S (fun u => F ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head).symm (u, (ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head x).2)))
        (ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head x).1 =
      S (fun y => F ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head).symm (y, (ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head x).2)))
        (ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right (a : ℕ) (prodList l)) (ZMod (a : ℕ)) x)
    rw [crt_fst_eq_castHom h.head]
  | a :: l, h, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩, S, F, x => by
    have hk' : k < l.length

PAG240::castHom_liftL.text:
theorem castHom_liftL : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (k : Fin l.length) (x : ZMod (prodList l))
    (y : ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)), ZMod.castHom (get_dvd_prodList l k) _ (liftL l h k x y) = y
  | a :: l, h, ⟨0, _⟩, x, y => by
    show ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right (a : ℕ) (prodList l)) (ZMod (a : ℕ))
      ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head).symm (y, (ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head x).2)) = y
    rw [← crt_fst_eq_castHom h.head, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  | a :: l, h, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩, x, y => by
    have hk' : k < l.length

PAG240::castHom_liftL_of_ne.text:
theorem castHom_liftL_of_ne : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) {j k : Fin l.length} (_ : j ≠ k)
    (x : ZMod (prodList l)) (y : ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)),
    ZMod.castHom (get_dvd_prodList l j) (ZMod ((l.get j : ℕ+) : ℕ)) (liftL l h k x y) =
      ZMod.castHom (get_dvd_prodList l j) (ZMod ((l.get j : ℕ+) : ℕ)) x
  | _ :: _, _, ⟨0, _⟩, ⟨0, _⟩, hjk, _, _ => (hjk rfl).elim
  | a :: l, h, ⟨0, _⟩, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩, _, x, y => by
    show ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right (a : ℕ) (prodList l)) (ZMod (a : ℕ))
      ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head).symm ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head x).1,
        liftL l h.tail ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk⟩ (ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head x).2 y)) =
      ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right (a : ℕ) (prodList l)) (ZMod (a : ℕ)) x
    rw [← crt_fst_eq_castHom h.head, ← crt_fst_eq_castHom h.head, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  | a :: l, h, ⟨j + 1, hj⟩, ⟨0, _⟩, _, x, y => by
    have hj' : j < l.length

PAG240::eq_of_castHom_eq.text:
theorem eq_of_castHom_eq : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (_ : CoprimeList l) (u v : ZMod (prodList l)),
    (∀ k : Fin l.length, ZMod.castHom (get_dvd_prodList l k) (ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)) u =
      ZMod.castHom (get_dvd_prodList l k) (ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)) v) →
      u = v
  | [], _, u, v, _ => by
    have h1 : u.val < 1

PAG240::map_symm_map_crtConj.text:
theorem map_symm_map_crtConj {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (Y : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ))) :
    (Y.map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom).map (crtConj hab).symm.toAlgHom = Y

PAG240::eq_bot_of_one.text: theorem eq_bot_of_one (S : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod 1 → ℂ))) : S = ⊥

PAG240::map_locHom_le.text:
theorem map_locHom_le (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ))) (hX : CRTMul X) :
    ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (k : Fin l.length),
    (X ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)).map (locHom l h k) ≤ X (prodList l)
  | a :: l, h, ⟨0, _⟩ => by
    have key

PAG240::eq_iSup_map_locHom.text:
theorem eq_iSup_map_locHom (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ)))
    (hX : CRTMul X) : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l),
    X (prodList l) = ⨆ k : Fin l.length, (X ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)).map (locHom l h k)
  | [], _ => by
    refine (eq_bot_of_one _).trans (iSup_eq_bot.mpr fun k => ?_).symm
    exact Fin.elim0 k
  | a :: l, h => by
    refine le_antisymm ?_ (iSup_le fun k => map_locHom_le X hX (a :: l) h k)
    have key

PAG240::finrank_prodList.text:
theorem finrank_prodList (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ)))
    (hX : CRTMul X) : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (_ : CoprimeList l),
    Module.finrank ℂ (X (prodList l)) = (l.map (fun a : ℕ+ => Module.finrank ℂ (X (a : ℕ)))).prod
  | [], _ => by
    show Module.finrank ℂ (X 1) = 1
    rw [eq_bot_of_one (X 1), Subalgebra.finrank_bot]
  | a :: l, h => by
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, ← finrank_prodList X hX l h.tail]
    show Module.finrank ℂ (X ((a : ℕ) * prodList l)) = _
    rw [← finrank_map_crtConj_gen h.head (X ((a : ℕ) * prodList l)), hX (a : ℕ) (prodList l) h.head,
      finrank_sup_map]

PAG240::BundledAlg.text:
structure BundledAlg where
  
  carrier : Type
  [instSemiring : Semiring carrier]
  [instAlgebra : Algebra ℂ carrier]

attribute [instance] BundledAlg.instSemiring BundledAlg.instAlgebra

PAG240::tensAlg.text:
noncomputable def tensAlg (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ))) :
    List ℕ+ → BundledAlg
  | [] => ⟨ℂ⟩
  | a :: l => ⟨TensorProduct ℂ (X (a : ℕ)) (tensAlg X l).carrier⟩

PAG240::tensEquiv.text:
noncomputable def tensEquiv (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ)))
    (hX : CRTMul X) : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (_ : CoprimeList l), (tensAlg X l).carrier ≃ₐ[ℂ] X (prodList l)
  | [], _ => (Algebra.botEquiv ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod 1 → ℂ))).symm.trans
      (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ (eq_bot_of_one (X 1)).symm)
  | a :: l, h => (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr AlgEquiv.refl (tensEquiv X hX l h.tail)).trans
      (crtTensorEquiv h.head (X (a : ℕ)) (X (prodList l)) (X ((a : ℕ) * prodList l))
        (hX (a : ℕ) (prodList l) h.head))

PAG240::tensEquiv_tmul.text:
theorem tensEquiv_tmul (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ)))
    (hX : CRTMul X) (a : ℕ+) (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList (a :: l)) (S : X (a : ℕ))
    (z : (tensAlg X l).carrier) :
    ((tensEquiv X hX (a :: l) h (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] z : TensorProduct ℂ (X (a : ℕ)) (tensAlg X l).carrier) :
        X (prodList (a :: l))) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (prodList (a :: l)) → ℂ)) =
      locHom (a :: l) h 0 (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a : ℕ) → ℂ)) *
        @id (Module.End ℂ (ZMod (prodList (a :: l)) → ℂ)) ((crtConj h.head).symm (rightOp (a : ℕ)
          ((tensEquiv X hX l h.tail z : X (prodList l)) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (prodList l) → ℂ))))

PAG240::tprodL.text:
noncomputable def tprodL (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ))) :
    ∀ (l : List ℕ+), (∀ k : Fin l.length, X ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)) → (tensAlg X l).carrier
  | [], _ => 1
  | a :: l, S => (S ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] tprodL X l (fun k => S ⟨k.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ k.isLt⟩) :
      TensorProduct ℂ (X (a : ℕ)) (tensAlg X l).carrier)

PAG240::tensEquiv_tprodL.text:
theorem tensEquiv_tprodL (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ)))
    (hX : CRTMul X) : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (S : ∀ k : Fin l.length, X ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)),
    (tensEquiv X hX l h (tprodL X l S) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (prodList l) → ℂ)) =
      (List.ofFn (fun k => locHom l h k (S k : Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) → ℂ)))).prod
  | [], h, S => by
    rw [List.ofFn_zero, List.prod_nil, show tprodL X [] S = 1 from rfl, map_one]
    rfl
  | a :: l, h, S => by
    rw [List.ofFn_succ, List.prod_cons]
    show (tensEquiv X hX (a :: l) h (S ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩ ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
      tprodL X l (fun k => S ⟨k.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ k.isLt⟩) :
        TensorProduct ℂ (X (a : ℕ)) (tensAlg X l).carrier) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (prodList (a :: l)) → ℂ)) = _
    rw [tensEquiv_tmul, tensEquiv_tprodL X hX l h.tail (fun k => S ⟨k.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ k.isLt⟩)]
    have hφ

PAG240::topAlg.text: def topAlg (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ)) := ⊤

PAG240::neZero_ordProj.text: instance neZero_ordProj (N p : ℕ) : NeZero (p ^ N.factorization p) := ⟨(Nat.ordProj_pos N p).ne'⟩

PAG240::ppow.text: def ppow (N p : ℕ) : ℕ+ := ⟨p ^ N.factorization p, Nat.ordProj_pos N p⟩

PAG240::ppow_coe.text: theorem ppow_coe (N p : ℕ) : (ppow N p : ℕ) = p ^ N.factorization p

PAG240::ppList.text: noncomputable def ppList (N : ℕ) : List ℕ+ := (N.primeFactors.sort (· ≤ ·)).map (ppow N)

PAG240::prodList_ppList.text: theorem prodList_ppList (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : prodList (ppList N) = N

PAG240::substEquiv.text:
noncomputable def substEquiv (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ)))
    {M N : ℕ} [NeZero M] [NeZero N] (h : M = N) : X M ≃ₐ[ℂ] X N := by
  subst h
  exact AlgEquiv.refl

PAG240::ppEquiv.text:
noncomputable def ppEquiv (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ)))
    (hX : CRTMul X) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : (tensAlg X (ppList N)).carrier ≃ₐ[ℂ] X N :=
  (tensEquiv X hX (ppList N) (coprimeList_ppList N)).trans (substEquiv X (prodList_ppList N))

PAG240::finrank_eq_prod_primeFactors.text:
theorem finrank_eq_prod_primeFactors (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ)))
    (hX : CRTMul X) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (X N) = ∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors, Module.finrank ℂ (X (p ^ N.factorization p))

PAG240::endPPEquiv.text:
noncomputable def endPPEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (tensAlg topAlg (ppList N)).carrier ≃ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  (ppEquiv topAlg crtMul_topAlg N).trans Subalgebra.topEquiv

PAG240::finrank_shellAlg_eq_prod.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg_eq_prod (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg N) = ∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors, Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg (p ^ N.factorization p))

PAG240::finrank_fullCommAlg_eq_prod.text:
theorem finrank_fullCommAlg_eq_prod (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommAlg N) =
      ∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors, Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommAlg (p ^ N.factorization p))

PAG240::finrank_centerAlg_eq_prod.text:
theorem finrank_centerAlg_eq_prod (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (centerAlg N) = ∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors, Module.finrank ℂ (centerAlg (p ^ N.factorization p))

PAG240::finrank_dilCommAlg_eq_prod.text:
theorem finrank_dilCommAlg_eq_prod (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (dilCommAlg N) =
      ∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors, Module.finrank ℂ (dilCommAlg (p ^ N.factorization p))

PAG241::pwComm.text:
theorem pwComm {κ M : Type*} [Monoid M] {f : κ → M} (h : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Commute (f i) (f j))
    (s : Finset κ) : (s : Set κ).Pairwise (Function.onFun Commute f)

PAG241::CommFam.text:
def CommFam (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ (x : A i) (y : A j), Commute (φ i x) (φ j y)

PAG241::tpProd.text:
noncomputable def tpProd (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) (x : ∀ i, A i) : B :=
  Finset.univ.noncommProd (fun i => φ i (x i)) (pwComm (fun i j hij => hφ i j hij (x i) (x j)) _)

PAG241::tpProd_eq_mul_erase.text:
theorem tpProd_eq_mul_erase [DecidableEq ι] (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ)
    (x : ∀ i, A i) (i : ι) :
    tpProd φ hφ x = φ i (x i) * (Finset.univ.erase i).noncommProd (fun j => φ j (x j))
      (pwComm (fun j k hjk => hφ j k hjk (x j) (x k)) _)

PAG241::tpProd_update.text:
theorem tpProd_update [DecidableEq ι] (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) (m : ∀ i, A i)
    (i : ι) (v : A i) :
    tpProd φ hφ (Function.update m i v) = φ i v * (Finset.univ.erase i).noncommProd
      (fun j => φ j (m j)) (pwComm (fun j k hjk => hφ j k hjk (m j) (m k)) _)

PAG241::tpProdML.text:
noncomputable def tpProdML (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) : MultilinearMap ℂ A B where
  toFun := tpProd φ hφ
  map_update_add' m i x y := by
    rw [tpProd_update, tpProd_update, tpProd_update, map_add, add_mul]
  map_update_smul' m i c x := by
    rw [tpProd_update, tpProd_update, map_smul, smul_mul_assoc]

PAG241::tpProd_one.text: theorem tpProd_one (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) : tpProd φ hφ 1 = 1

PAG241::tpProd_mul.text:
theorem tpProd_mul (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) (x y : ∀ i, A i) :
    tpProd φ hφ (x * y) = tpProd φ hφ x * tpProd φ hφ y

PAG241::tpProdML_one.text: theorem tpProdML_one (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) : tpProdML φ hφ 1 = 1

PAG241::tpProdML_mul.text:
theorem tpProdML_mul (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) (x y : ∀ i, A i) :
    tpProdML φ hφ (x * y) = tpProdML φ hφ x * tpProdML φ hφ y

PAG241::tpLift.text:
noncomputable def tpLift (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) : (⨂[ℂ] i, A i) →ₐ[ℂ] B :=
  PiTensorProduct.liftAlgHom (tpProdML φ hφ) (tpProdML_one φ hφ) (tpProdML_mul φ hφ)

PAG241::tpLift_tprod.text:
theorem tpLift_tprod (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) (x : ∀ i, A i) :
    tpLift φ hφ (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℂ x) = tpProd φ hφ x

PAG241::tpLift_single.text:
theorem tpLift_single [DecidableEq ι] (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) (i : ι) (a : A i) :
    tpLift φ hφ (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom i a) = φ i a

PAG241::eq_tpLift.text:
theorem eq_tpLift [DecidableEq ι] (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ)
    (F : (⨂[ℂ] i, A i) →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hF : ∀ i (a : A i), F (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom i a) = φ i a) :
    F = tpLift φ hφ

PAG241::range_tpLift.text:
theorem range_tpLift (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) :
    (tpLift φ hφ).range = ⨆ i, (φ i).range

PAG241::finiteDimensional_tp.text:
instance finiteDimensional_tp [∀ i, FiniteDimensional ℂ (A i)] :
    FiniteDimensional ℂ (⨂[ℂ] i, A i) :=
  Module.Finite.of_basis (Basis.piTensorProduct fun i => Module.finBasis ℂ (A i))

PAG241::finrank_tp.text:
theorem finrank_tp [∀ i, FiniteDimensional ℂ (A i)] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (⨂[ℂ] i, A i) = ∏ i, Module.finrank ℂ (A i)

PAG241::tpLift_rangeRestrict_bijective.text:
theorem tpLift_rangeRestrict_bijective [∀ i, FiniteDimensional ℂ (A i)] [FiniteDimensional ℂ B]
    (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℂ (tpLift φ hφ).range = ∏ i, Module.finrank ℂ (A i)) :
    Function.Bijective (tpLift φ hφ).rangeRestrict

PAG241::tpEquiv.text:
noncomputable def tpEquiv [∀ i, FiniteDimensional ℂ (A i)] [FiniteDimensional ℂ B]
    (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) (T : Subalgebra ℂ B) (hT : T = ⨆ i, (φ i).range)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℂ T = ∏ i, Module.finrank ℂ (A i)) : (⨂[ℂ] i, A i) ≃ₐ[ℂ] T :=
  (AlgEquiv.ofBijective (tpLift φ hφ).rangeRestrict
    (tpLift_rangeRestrict_bijective φ hφ (by rw [range_tpLift, ← hT]; exact hdim))).trans
    (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ ((range_tpLift φ hφ).trans hT.symm))

PAG241::tpEquiv_tprod.text:
theorem tpEquiv_tprod [∀ i, FiniteDimensional ℂ (A i)] [FiniteDimensional ℂ B]
    (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) (T : Subalgebra ℂ B) (hT : T = ⨆ i, (φ i).range)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℂ T = ∏ i, Module.finrank ℂ (A i)) (x : ∀ i, A i) :
    (tpEquiv φ hφ T hT hdim (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℂ x) : B) = tpProd φ hφ x

PAG241::tpEquiv_single.text:
theorem tpEquiv_single [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional ℂ (A i)] [FiniteDimensional ℂ B]
    (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) (T : Subalgebra ℂ B) (hT : T = ⨆ i, (φ i).range)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℂ T = ∏ i, Module.finrank ℂ (A i)) (i : ι) (a : A i) :
    (tpEquiv φ hφ T hT hdim (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom i a) : B) = φ i a

PAG241::endCongr.text:
noncomputable def endCongr {M N : ℕ} (h : M = N) :
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod M → ℂ) ≃ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) := by
  subst h; exact AlgEquiv.refl

PAG241::endCongr_rfl.text: theorem endCongr_rfl (M : ℕ) (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod M → ℂ)) : endCongr (rfl : M = M) T = T

PAG241::crtE.text:
noncomputable def crtE (N a : ℕ) (hd : a ∣ N) (hc : Nat.Coprime a (N / a)) :
    ZMod N ≃+* ZMod a × ZMod (N / a) :=
  (ZMod.ringEquivCongr (Nat.mul_div_cancel' hd).symm).trans (ZMod.chineseRemainder hc)

PAG241::crtE_fst.text:
theorem crtE_fst (N a : ℕ) (hd : a ∣ N) (hc : Nat.Coprime a (N / a)) (x : ZMod N) :
    (crtE N a hd hc x).1 = ZMod.castHom hd (ZMod a) x

PAG241::castHom_crtE_snd.text:
theorem castHom_crtE_snd (N a c : ℕ) (hd : a ∣ N) (hc : Nat.Coprime a (N / a)) (hcd : c ∣ N / a)
    (x : ZMod N) : ZMod.castHom hcd (ZMod c) (crtE N a hd hc x).2 =
      ZMod.castHom (dvd_trans hcd (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hd)) (ZMod c) x

PAG241::liftF.text:
noncomputable def liftF (N a : ℕ) (hd : a ∣ N) (hc : Nat.Coprime a (N / a)) (x : ZMod N)
    (y : ZMod a) : ZMod N :=
  (crtE N a hd hc).symm (y, (crtE N a hd hc x).2)

PAG241::castHom_liftF.text:
theorem castHom_liftF (N a : ℕ) (hd : a ∣ N) (hc : Nat.Coprime a (N / a)) (x : ZMod N)
    (y : ZMod a) : ZMod.castHom hd (ZMod a) (liftF N a hd hc x y) = y

PAG241::castHom_liftF_of_dvd.text:
theorem castHom_liftF_of_dvd (N a c : ℕ) (hd : a ∣ N) (hc : Nat.Coprime a (N / a))
    (hcd : c ∣ N / a) (x : ZMod N) (y : ZMod a) :
    ZMod.castHom (dvd_trans hcd (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hd)) (ZMod c) (liftF N a hd hc x y) =
      ZMod.castHom (dvd_trans hcd (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hd)) (ZMod c) x

PAG241::crtLinN.text:
noncomputable def crtLinN (N a : ℕ) (hd : a ∣ N) (hc : Nat.Coprime a (N / a)) :
    (ZMod N → ℂ) ≃ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod a × ZMod (N / a) → ℂ) :=
  LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft ℂ ℂ (crtE N a hd hc).symm.toEquiv

PAG241::locOp.text:
noncomputable def locOp (N a : ℕ) (hd : a ∣ N) (hc : Nat.Coprime a (N / a)) :
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  ((crtLinN N a hd hc).conjAlgEquiv ℂ).symm.toAlgHom.comp (leftHom a (N / a))

PAG241::locOp_apply.text:
theorem locOp_apply (N a : ℕ) (hd : a ∣ N) (hc : Nat.Coprime a (N / a))
    (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) (F : ZMod N → ℂ) (x : ZMod N) :
    locOp N a hd hc S F x = S (fun y => F (liftF N a hd hc x y)) (ZMod.castHom hd (ZMod a) x)

PAG241::endCongr_locOp.text:
theorem endCongr_locOp {M N a b : ℕ} (hMN : M = N) (hab : a = b) (hd : a ∣ M)
    (hc : Nat.Coprime a (M / a)) (hd' : b ∣ N) (hc' : Nat.Coprime b (N / b))
    (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) :
    endCongr hMN (locOp M a hd hc S) = locOp N b hd' hc' (endCongr hab S)

PAG241::coprime_get_div.text:
theorem coprime_get_div : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (_ : CoprimeList l) (k : Fin l.length),
    Nat.Coprime ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) (prodList l / ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ))
  | a :: l, h, ⟨0, _⟩ => by
    show Nat.Coprime (a : ℕ) ((a : ℕ) * prodList l / (a : ℕ))
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ a.pos]
    exact h.head
  | b :: l, h, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ => by
    have hk' : k < l.length

PAG241::coprime_get_get.text:
theorem coprime_get_get (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) {j k : Fin l.length} (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    Nat.Coprime ((l.get j : ℕ+) : ℕ) ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)

PAG241::get_dvd_div.text:
theorem get_dvd_div (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) {j k : Fin l.length} (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    ((l.get j : ℕ+) : ℕ) ∣ prodList l / ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)

PAG241::liftL_eq_liftF.text:
theorem liftL_eq_liftF (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (k : Fin l.length) (x : ZMod (prodList l))
    (y : ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)) :
    liftL l h k x y = liftF (prodList l) ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) (get_dvd_prodList l k)
      (coprime_get_div l h k) x y

PAG241::locHom_eq_locOp.text:
theorem locHom_eq_locOp (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (k : Fin l.length) :
    locHom l h k = locOp (prodList l) ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) (get_dvd_prodList l k)
      (coprime_get_div l h k)

PAG241::prodList_perm.text: theorem prodList_perm {l l' : List ℕ+} (h : l.Perm l') : prodList l = prodList l'

PAG241::locHom_congr.text:
theorem locHom_congr (l l' : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (h' : CoprimeList l') (k : Fin l.length)
    (k' : Fin l'.length) (hN : prodList l = prodList l')
    (hk : ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) = ((l'.get k' : ℕ+) : ℕ))
    (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) → ℂ)) :
    endCongr hN (locHom l h k S) = locHom l' h' k' (endCongr hk S)

PAG241::locFam.text:
noncomputable def locFam (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (k : Fin l.length) :
    ↥(X ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod (prodList l) → ℂ) :=
  (locHom l h k).comp (X ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)).val

PAG241::commFam_locFam.text: theorem commFam_locFam (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) : CommFam (locFam X l h)

PAG241::range_locFam.text:
theorem range_locFam (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (k : Fin l.length) :
    (locFam X l h k).range = (X ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)).map (locHom l h k)

PAG241::piTensEquiv.text:
noncomputable def piTensEquiv (hX : CRTMul X) (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) :
    (⨂[ℂ] k : Fin l.length, ↥(X ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ))) ≃ₐ[ℂ] ↥(X (prodList l)) :=
  tpEquiv (A := fun k => ↥(X ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ))) (B := Module.End ℂ (ZMod (prodList l) → ℂ))
    (locFam X l h) (by exact commFam_locFam X l h) (X (prodList l))
    (by simp only [range_locFam]; exact eq_iSup_map_locHom X hX l h)
    (by rw [finrank_prodList X hX l h, ← Fin.prod_univ_fun_getElem]; rfl)

PAG241::piTensEquiv_tprod.text:
theorem piTensEquiv_tprod (hX : CRTMul X) (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l)
    (S : ∀ k : Fin l.length, ↥(X ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ))) :
    (piTensEquiv X hX l h (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℂ S) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (prodList l) → ℂ)) =
      Finset.univ.noncommProd (fun k => locHom l h k (S k))
        (pwComm (fun _ _ hjk => locHom_commute l h hjk _ _) _)

PAG241::piTensEquiv_single.text:
theorem piTensEquiv_single (hX : CRTMul X) (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (k : Fin l.length)
    (s : ↥(X ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ))) :
    (piTensEquiv X hX l h (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom k s) :
      Module.End ℂ (ZMod (prodList l) → ℂ)) = locHom l h k s

PAG241::coprime_ordProj.text:
theorem coprime_ordProj (N : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ N.primeFactors) :
    Nat.Coprime (p ^ N.factorization p) (N / p ^ N.factorization p)

PAG241::mem_ppList.text: theorem mem_ppList (N : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ N.primeFactors) : ppow N p ∈ ppList N

PAG241::exists_of_mem_ppList.text:
theorem exists_of_mem_ppList (N : ℕ) {a : ℕ+} (ha : a ∈ ppList N) :
    ∃ p ∈ N.primeFactors, ppow N p = a

PAG241::map_locOp_congr.text:
theorem map_locOp_congr {N a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : a = b) (hd : a ∣ N)
    (hc : Nat.Coprime a (N / a)) (hd' : b ∣ N) (hc' : Nat.Coprime b (N / b)) :
    (X a).map (locOp N a hd hc) = (X b).map (locOp N b hd' hc')

PAG241::iSup_map_locOp_transport.text:
theorem iSup_map_locOp_transport {M N : ℕ} [NeZero M] [NeZero N] (hMN : M = N) {κ : Type*}
    (a : κ → ℕ) [∀ k, NeZero (a k)] (hd : ∀ k, a k ∣ M) (hc : ∀ k, Nat.Coprime (a k) (M / a k))
    (hd' : ∀ k, a k ∣ N) (hc' : ∀ k, Nat.Coprime (a k) (N / a k))
    (H : X M = ⨆ k, (X (a k)).map (locOp M (a k) (hd k) (hc k))) :
    X N = ⨆ k, (X (a k)).map (locOp N (a k) (hd' k) (hc' k))

PAG241::commute_locOp_transport.text:
theorem commute_locOp_transport {M N a b a' b' : ℕ} (hMN : M = N) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b')
    (hda : a ∣ M) (hca : Nat.Coprime a (M / a)) (hdb : b ∣ M) (hcb : Nat.Coprime b (M / b))
    (hda' : a' ∣ N) (hca' : Nat.Coprime a' (N / a')) (hdb' : b' ∣ N)
    (hcb' : Nat.Coprime b' (N / b'))
    (H : ∀ S T, Commute (locOp M a hda hca S) (locOp M b hdb hcb T)) :
    ∀ S T, Commute (locOp N a' hda' hca' S) (locOp N b' hdb' hcb' T)

PAG241::commute_locOp_of_list.text:
theorem commute_locOp_of_list (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) {N : ℕ} (hN : prodList l = N)
    {j k : Fin l.length} (hjk : j ≠ k) {a b : ℕ} (ha : ((l.get j : ℕ+) : ℕ) = a)
    (hb : ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) = b) (hda : a ∣ N) (hca : Nat.Coprime a (N / a)) (hdb : b ∣ N)
    (hcb : Nat.Coprime b (N / b)) (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ))
    (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)) :
    Commute (locOp N a hda hca S) (locOp N b hdb hcb T)

PAG241::commute_locOp.text:
theorem commute_locOp (N a b : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hda : a ∣ N) (hca : Nat.Coprime a (N / a))
    (hdb : b ∣ N) (hcb : Nat.Coprime b (N / b)) (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)) :
    Commute (locOp N a hda hca S) (locOp N b hdb hcb T)

PAG241::commute_locOp_pp.text:
theorem commute_locOp_pp (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {p q : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ N.primeFactors)
    (hq : q ∈ N.primeFactors) (hpq : p ≠ q) (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (p ^ N.factorization p) → ℂ))
    (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (q ^ N.factorization q) → ℂ)) :
    Commute (locOp N (p ^ N.factorization p) (Nat.ordProj_dvd N p) (coprime_ordProj N hp) S)
      (locOp N (q ^ N.factorization q) (Nat.ordProj_dvd N q) (coprime_ordProj N hq) T)

PAG241::ppFam.text:
noncomputable def ppFam (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : N.primeFactors) :
    ↥(X ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p)) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  (locOp N ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p) (Nat.ordProj_dvd N p) (coprime_ordProj N p.2)).comp
    (X ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p)).val

PAG241::commFam_ppFam.text: theorem commFam_ppFam (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : CommFam (ppFam X N)

PAG241::range_ppFam.text:
theorem range_ppFam (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : N.primeFactors) :
    (ppFam X N p).range = (X ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p)).map
      (locOp N ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p) (Nat.ordProj_dvd N p) (coprime_ordProj N p.2))

PAG241::eq_iSup_ppFam.text: theorem eq_iSup_ppFam (hX : CRTMul X) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : X N = ⨆ p, (ppFam X N p).range

PAG241::finrank_pp.text:
theorem finrank_pp (hX : CRTMul X) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (X N) =
      ∏ p : N.primeFactors, Module.finrank ℂ (X ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))

PAG241::piPrimeEquiv.text:
noncomputable def piPrimeEquiv (hX : CRTMul X) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (⨂[ℂ] p : N.primeFactors, ↥(X ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))) ≃ₐ[ℂ] ↥(X N) :=
  tpEquiv (A := fun p : N.primeFactors => ↥(X ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p)))
    (B := Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) (ppFam X N) (by exact commFam_ppFam X N) (X N)
    (by exact eq_iSup_ppFam X hX N) (by exact finrank_pp X hX N)

PAG241::piPrimeEquiv_tprod.text:
theorem piPrimeEquiv_tprod (hX : CRTMul X) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N]
    (S : ∀ p : N.primeFactors, ↥(X ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))) :
    (piPrimeEquiv X hX N (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℂ S) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) =
      Finset.univ.noncommProd (fun p : N.primeFactors => locOp N ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p)
        (Nat.ordProj_dvd N p) (coprime_ordProj N p.2) (S p))
        (pwComm (fun p q hpq => commute_locOp_pp N p.2 q.2 (fun e => hpq (Subtype.ext e)) _ _) _)

PAG241::piPrimeEquiv_single.text:
theorem piPrimeEquiv_single (hX : CRTMul X) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : N.primeFactors)
    (s : ↥(X ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))) :
    (piPrimeEquiv X hX N (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom p s) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) =
      locOp N ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p) (Nat.ordProj_dvd N p) (coprime_ordProj N p.2) s

PAG241::piPrimeEquiv_unique.text:
theorem piPrimeEquiv_unique (hX : CRTMul X) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N]
    (F : (⨂[ℂ] p : N.primeFactors, ↥(X ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))) →ₐ[ℂ]
      Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (hF : ∀ (p : N.primeFactors) (s : ↥(X ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))),
      F (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom p s) =
        locOp N ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p) (Nat.ordProj_dvd N p) (coprime_ordProj N p.2) s)
    (z : ⨂[ℂ] p : N.primeFactors, ↥(X ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))) :
    F z = (piPrimeEquiv X hX N z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))

PAG241::ppBasis.text:
noncomputable def ppBasis (hX : CRTMul X) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {κ : N.primeFactors → Type*}
    (b : ∀ p : N.primeFactors, Module.Basis (κ p) ℂ ↥(X ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))) :
    Module.Basis (∀ p, κ p) ℂ ↥(X N) :=
  (Basis.piTensorProduct b).map (piPrimeEquiv X hX N).toLinearEquiv

PAG241::ppBasis_apply.text:
theorem ppBasis_apply (hX : CRTMul X) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {κ : N.primeFactors → Type*}
    (b : ∀ p : N.primeFactors, Module.Basis (κ p) ℂ ↥(X ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p)))
    (q : ∀ p, κ p) :
    (ppBasis X hX N b q : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) =
      Finset.univ.noncommProd (fun p : N.primeFactors => locOp N ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p)
        (Nat.ordProj_dvd N p) (coprime_ordProj N p.2) (b p (q p)))
        (pwComm (fun p p' hpp' => commute_locOp_pp N p.2 p'.2 (fun e => hpp' (Subtype.ext e)) _ _) _)

PAG241::shellAlgPiEquiv.text:
noncomputable def shellAlgPiEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (⨂[ℂ] p : N.primeFactors, ↥(shellAlg ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))) ≃ₐ[ℂ] ↥(shellAlg N) :=
  piPrimeEquiv shellAlg crtMul_shellAlg N

PAG241::fullCommAlgPiEquiv.text:
noncomputable def fullCommAlgPiEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (⨂[ℂ] p : N.primeFactors, ↥(fullCommAlg ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))) ≃ₐ[ℂ]
      ↥(fullCommAlg N) :=
  piPrimeEquiv fullCommAlg crtMul_fullCommAlg N

PAG241::centerAlgPiEquiv.text:
noncomputable def centerAlgPiEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (⨂[ℂ] p : N.primeFactors, ↥(centerAlg ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))) ≃ₐ[ℂ] ↥(centerAlg N) :=
  piPrimeEquiv centerAlg crtMul_centerAlg N

PAG241::dilCommAlgPiEquiv.text:
noncomputable def dilCommAlgPiEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (⨂[ℂ] p : N.primeFactors, ↥(dilCommAlg ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))) ≃ₐ[ℂ]
      ↥(dilCommAlg N) :=
  piPrimeEquiv dilCommAlg crtMul_dilCommAlg N

PAG241::endPiEquiv.text:
noncomputable def endPiEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (⨂[ℂ] p : N.primeFactors, ↥(topAlg ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))) ≃ₐ[ℂ]
      Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  (piPrimeEquiv topAlg crtMul_topAlg N).trans Subalgebra.topEquiv

PAG241::endPiEquiv_tprod.text:
theorem endPiEquiv_tprod (N : ℕ) [NeZero N]
    (S : ∀ p : N.primeFactors, ↥(topAlg ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))) :
    endPiEquiv N (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℂ S) =
      Finset.univ.noncommProd (fun p : N.primeFactors => locOp N ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p)
        (Nat.ordProj_dvd N p) (coprime_ordProj N p.2) (S p))
        (pwComm (fun p q hpq => commute_locOp_pp N p.2 q.2 (fun e => hpq (Subtype.ext e)) _ _) _)

PAG242::piSplitAlgEquiv.text:
def piSplitAlgEquiv {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (i₀ : ι) (B : ι → Type*) [∀ i, Semiring (B i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra ℂ (B i)] : (Π i, B i) ≃ₐ[ℂ] B i₀ × Π i : {i // i ≠ i₀}, B i :=
  { Equiv.piSplitAt i₀ B with
    map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl
    map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
    commutes' := fun _ => rfl }

PAG242::piSplitAlgEquiv_apply.text:
theorem piSplitAlgEquiv_apply {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (i₀ : ι) (B : ι → Type*) [∀ i, Semiring (B i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra ℂ (B i)] (f : Π i, B i) :
    piSplitAlgEquiv i₀ B f = (f i₀, fun j : {i // i ≠ i₀} => f j)

PAG242::matUniqueEquiv.text:
noncomputable def matUniqueEquiv (m : Type*) [Unique m] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] :
    Matrix m m ℂ ≃ₐ[ℂ] ℂ :=
  AlgEquiv.ofLinearEquiv
    { toFun := fun M => M default default
      invFun := fun r => Matrix.of fun _ _ => r
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl
      left_inv := fun M => by
        ext i j
        rw [Subsingleton.elim i default, Subsingleton.elim j default]
        rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
    (Matrix.one_apply_eq default)
    (fun M M' => by
      show (M * M') default default = M default default * M' default default
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_unique])

PAG242::matUniqueEquiv_apply.text:
theorem matUniqueEquiv_apply (m : Type*) [Unique m] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (M : Matrix m m ℂ) :
    matUniqueEquiv m M = M default default

PAG242::commute_singleAlgHom.text:
theorem commute_singleAlgHom {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (x : A i) (y : A j) :
    Commute (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom (R := ℂ) (A := A) i x) (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom j y)

PAG242::commFam_single_equiv.text:
theorem commFam_single_equiv (e : ∀ i, A i ≃ₐ[ℂ] B i) :
    CommFam (fun i => (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom (R := ℂ) (A := B) i).comp (e i).toAlgHom)

PAG242::tpCongr.text:
noncomputable def tpCongr (e : ∀ i, A i ≃ₐ[ℂ] B i) : (⨂[ℂ] i, A i) ≃ₐ[ℂ] ⨂[ℂ] i, B i :=
  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom
    (tpLift (fun i => (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom i).comp (e i).toAlgHom) (commFam_single_equiv e))
    (tpLift (fun i => (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom i).comp (e i).symm.toAlgHom)
      (commFam_single_equiv fun i => (e i).symm))
    (PiTensorProduct.algHom_ext fun i => AlgHom.ext fun b => by
      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, tpLift_single]
      exact congrArg _ ((e i).apply_symm_apply b))
    (PiTensorProduct.algHom_ext fun i => AlgHom.ext fun a => by
      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, tpLift_single]
      exact congrArg _ ((e i).symm_apply_apply a))

PAG242::tpCongr_tprod.text:
theorem tpCongr_tprod (e : ∀ i, A i ≃ₐ[ℂ] B i) (x : ∀ i, A i) :
    tpCongr e (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℂ x) = PiTensorProduct.tprod ℂ (fun i => e i (x i))

PAG242::tpCongr_single.text:
theorem tpCongr_single (e : ∀ i, A i ≃ₐ[ℂ] B i) (i : ι) (a : A i) :
    tpCongr e (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom i a) = PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom i (e i a)

PAG242::one_mem_centerIdx.text: theorem one_mem_centerIdx (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : (⟨1, 1⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx N

PAG242::baseIdx.text: def baseIdx (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : centerIdx N := ⟨⟨1, 1⟩, one_mem_centerIdx N⟩

PAG242::restIdx.text: abbrev restIdx (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Type := {p : centerIdx N // p ≠ baseIdx N}

PAG242::layerDivs_one_one.text: theorem layerDivs_one_one (L : ℕ) : layerDivs 1 1 L = L.divisors

PAG242::finrank_refLayer_base.text:
theorem finrank_refLayer_base (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (refLayer N (baseIdx N)) = N.divisors.card

PAG242::mem_layerPart_one_one.text:
theorem mem_layerPart_one_one (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    f ∈ layerPart N 1 χ 1 ↔ Radial f

PAG242::mem_refLayer_base_iff.text:
theorem mem_refLayer_base_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    f ∈ refLayer N (baseIdx N) ↔ Radial f

PAG242::radialHom.text:
noncomputable def radialHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    shellAlg N →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (refLayer N (baseIdx N)) :=
  (Pi.evalAlgHom ℂ (fun p : centerIdx N => Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p)) (baseIdx N)).comp
    (shellAlgEquiv N).toAlgHom

PAG242::radialHom_apply.text:
theorem radialHom_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : shellAlg N) (g : refLayer N (baseIdx N)) :
    (radialHom N T g : ZMod N → ℂ) = (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) g

PAG242::radialHom_surjective.text: theorem radialHom_surjective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Function.Surjective (radialHom N)

PAG242::mem_centerIdx_primePow.text:
theorem mem_centerIdx_primePow {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (k : ℕ) (p : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) :
    p ∈ centerIdx (q ^ k) ↔ (p.1 = 1 ∧ p.2 = 1) ∨
      ∃ γ δ : ℕ, 1 ≤ γ ∧ γ + δ ≤ k ∧ ¬ (q = 2 ∧ γ = 1) ∧ p.1 = q ^ γ ∧ p.2 = q ^ δ

PAG242::snd_eq_one_of_fst_eq_one.text:
theorem snd_eq_one_of_fst_eq_one {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (k : ℕ) {p : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ centerIdx (q ^ k)) (h1 : p.1 = 1) : p.2 = 1

PAG242::card_centerIdx_primePow.text:
theorem card_centerIdx_primePow {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (centerIdx (q ^ k)).card = 1 + k * (k + 1) / 2 - (if q = 2 then k else 0)

PAG242::finrank_refLayer_base_primePow.text:
theorem finrank_refLayer_base_primePow {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (k : ℕ) [NeZero (q ^ k)] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (refLayer (q ^ k) (baseIdx (q ^ k))) = k + 1

PAG242::finrank_refLayer_rest.text:
theorem finrank_refLayer_rest {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (k : ℕ) [NeZero (q ^ k)] (p : restIdx (q ^ k)) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (refLayer (q ^ k) p.1) = 1

PAG242::card_restIdx_primePow.text:
theorem card_restIdx_primePow {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) [NeZero (q ^ k)] :
    Fintype.card (restIdx (q ^ k)) = k * (k + 1) / 2 - (if q = 2 then k else 0)

PAG242::uniquePrimOne.text:
noncomputable instance uniquePrimOne : Unique (Prim 1) where
  default := ⟨1, DirichletCharacter.isPrimitive_one_level_one⟩
  uniq χ := Subtype.ext (DirichletCharacter.level_one χ.1)

PAG242::shellAlgPrimePowEquiv.text:
noncomputable def shellAlgPrimePowEquiv {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (k : ℕ) [NeZero (q ^ k)] :
    shellAlg (q ^ k) ≃ₐ[ℂ] Matrix (Fin (k + 1)) (Fin (k + 1)) ℂ × (restIdx (q ^ k) → ℂ) :=
  (shellAlgMatrixEquiv (q ^ k)).trans <|
    (piSplitAlgEquiv (baseIdx (q ^ k)) _).trans <|
      AlgEquiv.prodCongr
        (Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv ℂ ℂ (finCongr (finrank_refLayer_base_primePow hq k)))
        (AlgEquiv.piCongrRight fun p =>
          (Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv ℂ ℂ (finCongr (finrank_refLayer_rest hq k p))).trans
            (matUniqueEquiv (Fin 1)))

PAG242::fullCommSplitEquiv.text:
noncomputable def fullCommSplitEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    fullCommAlg N ≃ₐ[ℂ] ℂ × (Π p : restIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1.1) (Prim p.1.1.1) ℂ) :=
  (fullCommMatrixEquiv N).symm.trans <|
    (piSplitAlgEquiv (baseIdx N) _).trans <|
      AlgEquiv.prodCongr (matUniqueEquiv (Prim 1)) AlgEquiv.refl

PAG242::finrank_shellAlg_primePow.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg_primePow {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (k : ℕ) [NeZero (q ^ k)] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg (q ^ k)) = (k + 1) ^ 2 + Fintype.card (restIdx (q ^ k))

PAG242::finrank_fullComm_split.text:
theorem finrank_fullComm_split (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (fullCommAlg N) = 1 + ∑ p : restIdx N, Fintype.card (Prim p.1.1.1) ^ 2

PAG242::shellAlgPrimeTensorEquiv.text:
noncomputable def shellAlgPrimeTensorEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    shellAlg N ≃ₐ[ℂ] ⨂[ℂ] p : N.primeFactors,
      (Matrix (Fin (N.factorization p + 1)) (Fin (N.factorization p + 1)) ℂ ×
        (restIdx ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p) → ℂ)) :=
  (piPrimeEquiv shellAlg crtMul_shellAlg N).symm.trans
    (tpCongr fun p => shellAlgPrimePowEquiv (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors p.2) (N.factorization p))

PAG242::fullCommPrimeTensorEquiv.text:
noncomputable def fullCommPrimeTensorEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    fullCommAlg N ≃ₐ[ℂ] ⨂[ℂ] p : N.primeFactors,
      (ℂ × (Π r : restIdx ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p), Matrix (Prim r.1.1.1) (Prim r.1.1.1) ℂ)) :=
  (piPrimeEquiv fullCommAlg crtMul_fullCommAlg N).symm.trans
    (tpCongr fun p => fullCommSplitEquiv ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p))

PAG242::centerAlgPrimeTensorEquiv.text:
noncomputable def centerAlgPrimeTensorEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    centerAlg N ≃ₐ[ℂ] ⨂[ℂ] p : N.primeFactors, (centerIdx ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p) → ℂ) :=
  (piPrimeEquiv centerAlg crtMul_centerAlg N).symm.trans
    (tpCongr fun p => (centerAlgEquiv ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p)).symm)

PAG242::endTensorEquiv.text:
noncomputable def endTensorEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (⨂[ℂ] p : N.primeFactors, Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p) → ℂ)) ≃ₐ[ℂ]
      Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  (tpCongr fun p : N.primeFactors =>
    (Subalgebra.topEquiv (R := ℂ) (A := Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p) → ℂ))).symm).trans
    (endPiEquiv N)

PAG242::endTensorEquiv_tprod.text:
theorem endTensorEquiv_tprod (N : ℕ) [NeZero N]
    (S : ∀ p : N.primeFactors, Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p) → ℂ)) :
    endTensorEquiv N (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℂ S) =
      Finset.univ.noncommProd (fun p : N.primeFactors => locOp N ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p)
        (Nat.ordProj_dvd N p) (coprime_ordProj N p.2) (S p))
        (pwComm (fun p q hpq => commute_locOp_pp N p.2 q.2 (fun e => hpq (Subtype.ext e)) _ _) _)

PAG242::shellAlgPrimeTensorEquiv_symm_tp.text:
theorem shellAlgPrimeTensorEquiv_symm_tprod (N : ℕ) [NeZero N]
    (x : ∀ p : N.primeFactors, Matrix (Fin (N.factorization p + 1)) (Fin (N.factorization p + 1)) ℂ ×
      (restIdx ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p) → ℂ)) :
    ((shellAlgPrimeTensorEquiv N).symm (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℂ x) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) =
      Finset.univ.noncommProd (fun p : N.primeFactors => locOp N ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p)
        (Nat.ordProj_dvd N p) (coprime_ordProj N p.2)
        ((shellAlgPrimePowEquiv (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors p.2) (N.factorization p)).symm (x p)))
        (pwComm (fun p q hpq => commute_locOp_pp N p.2 q.2 (fun e => hpq (Subtype.ext e)) _ _) _)

PAG243::gcd_val_natCast_of_dvd.text: theorem gcd_val_natCast_of_dvd {N u : ℕ} (hu : u ∣ N) : Nat.gcd N (u : ZMod N).val = u

PAG243::dind_natCast.text: theorem dind_natCast {N u : ℕ} (t : ℕ) (hu : u ∣ N) : dind N t (u : ZMod N) = if u = t then 1 else 0

PAG243::radial_apply_eq.text:
theorem radial_apply_eq {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : Radial f) (ξ : ZMod N) :
    f ξ = f ((Nat.gcd N ξ.val : ℕ) : ZMod N)

PAG243::radial_eq_sum.text:
theorem radial_eq_sum {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : Radial f) :
    f = ∑ t ∈ N.divisors, f (t : ZMod N) • dind N t

PAG243::dind_mem_base.text: theorem dind_mem_base (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (t : ℕ) : dind N t ∈ refLayer N (baseIdx N)

PAG243::radialCoord.text:
noncomputable def radialCoord (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : refLayer N (baseIdx N) ≃ₗ[ℂ] (N.divisors → ℂ) where
  toFun f t := (f : ZMod N → ℂ) ((t : ℕ) : ZMod N)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  invFun c := ⟨∑ t : N.divisors, c t • dind N t,
    Submodule.sum_mem _ (fun t _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (dind_mem_base N t))⟩
  left_inv f := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show ∑ t : N.divisors, (f : ZMod N → ℂ) ((t : ℕ) : ZMod N) • dind N t = f
    rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort N.divisors (fun t => (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (t : ZMod N) • dind N t)]
    exact (radial_eq_sum ((mem_refLayer_base_iff N _).mp f.2)).symm
  right_inv c := by
    funext u
    show (∑ t : N.divisors, c t • dind N t) ((u : ℕ) : ZMod N) = c u
    rw [Finset.sum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single u]
    · rw [Pi.smul_apply, dind_natCast _ (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u.2), ite_eq_left rfl, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    · intro t _ htu
      rw [Pi.smul_apply, dind_natCast _ (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u.2),
        ite_eq_right (fun h => htu (Subtype.ext h.symm)), smul_zero]
    · intro h
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ u) h

PAG243::radialBasis.text:
noncomputable def radialBasis (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Module.Basis N.divisors ℂ (refLayer N (baseIdx N)) :=
  Module.Basis.ofEquivFun (radialCoord N)

PAG243::radialBasis_apply.text:
theorem radialBasis_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (t : N.divisors) :
    (radialBasis N t : ZMod N → ℂ) = dind N t

PAG243::radialBasis_repr.text:
theorem radialBasis_repr (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : refLayer N (baseIdx N)) (t : N.divisors) :
    (radialBasis N).repr f t = (f : ZMod N → ℂ) ((t : ℕ) : ZMod N)

PAG243::toMatrix_radialHom.text:
theorem toMatrix_radialHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : shellAlg N) (u t : N.divisors) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N) (radialHom N T) u t =
      (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) (dind N t) ((u : ℕ) : ZMod N)

PAG243::geps_neg.text: theorem geps_neg (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ξ : ZMod N) : geps N t (-ξ) = geps N t ξ

PAG243::dft_dind.text: theorem dft_dind (N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] : 𝓕 (dind N t) = (N : ℂ) • geps N t

PAG243::conv_geps_dind.text:
theorem conv_geps_dind (N s t : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (dind N t) = ((N : ℂ) * geps N t (s : ZMod N)) • geps N s

PAG243::toMatrix_D.text:
theorem toMatrix_D (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s : N.divisors) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N)
      (radialHom N ⟨LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N s), PAG.Part232.mulLeft_dind_mem N s⟩) =
      Matrix.single s s 1

PAG243::toMatrix_E.text:
theorem toMatrix_E (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s u t : N.divisors) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N)
      (radialHom N ⟨PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s), PAG.Part232.convL_geps_mem N s⟩) u t =
      (N : ℂ) * geps N t ((s : ℕ) : ZMod N) * geps N s ((u : ℕ) : ZMod N)

PAG243::geps_self.text: theorem geps_self (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (x : ZMod N) : geps N N x = (N : ℂ)⁻¹

PAG243::conv_geps_self.text:
theorem conv_geps_self (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N N) g = fun _ => (N : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ y, g y

PAG243::toMatrix_E_self.text:
theorem toMatrix_E_self (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (u t : N.divisors) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N)
      (radialHom N ⟨PAG.Part15.convL (geps N N), PAG.Part232.convL_geps_mem N N⟩) u t =
      (Nat.totient (N / t) : ℂ) / N

PAG243::shellTrans.text:
noncomputable def shellTrans (N s t : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (N / t) : ℂ)) •
    (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N s) * PAG.Part15.convL (geps N N) * LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N t))

PAG243::shellTrans_mem.text: theorem shellTrans_mem (N s t : ℕ) [NeZero N] : shellTrans N s t ∈ shellAlg N

PAG243::shellTrans_apply.text:
theorem shellTrans_apply (N s t : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    shellTrans N s t f = ((∑ y, dind N t y * f y) / (Nat.totient (N / t) : ℂ)) • dind N s

PAG243::sum_dind_mul_dind.text:
theorem sum_dind_mul_dind (N t r : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ht : t ∣ N) :
    ∑ y, dind N t y * dind N r y = if t = r then (Nat.totient (N / t) : ℂ) else 0

PAG243::shellTrans_dind.text:
theorem shellTrans_dind (N s t r : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ht : t ∣ N) :
    shellTrans N s t (dind N r) = if t = r then dind N s else 0

PAG243::shellTrans_mul.text:
theorem shellTrans_mul (N s t t' r : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ht : t ∣ N) :
    shellTrans N s t * shellTrans N t' r = if t = t' then shellTrans N s r else 0

PAG243::toMatrix_shellTrans.text:
theorem toMatrix_shellTrans (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s t : N.divisors) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N) (radialHom N ⟨shellTrans N s t, shellTrans_mem N s t⟩) =
      Matrix.single s t 1

PAG243::shellTrans_mul_div.text:
theorem shellTrans_mul_div (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s t t' r : N.divisors) :
    shellTrans N s t * shellTrans N t' r = if t = t' then shellTrans N s r else 0

PAG243::radialMatOp.text:
noncomputable def radialMatOp (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) :
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  ∑ s : N.divisors, ∑ t : N.divisors, M s t • shellTrans N s t

PAG243::radialMatOp_mem.text:
theorem radialMatOp_mem (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) :
    radialMatOp N M ∈ shellAlg N

PAG243::radialMatOp_mul.text:
theorem radialMatOp_mul (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M M' : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) :
    radialMatOp N (M * M') = radialMatOp N M * radialMatOp N M'

PAG243::radialMatOp_one.text: theorem radialMatOp_one (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : radialMatOp N 1 = ∑ s : N.divisors, shellTrans N s s

PAG243::toMatrix_radialHom_radialMatOp.text:
theorem toMatrix_radialHom_radialMatOp (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N)
      (radialHom N ⟨radialMatOp N M, radialMatOp_mem N M⟩) = M

PAG243::radialMatOp_injective.text: theorem radialMatOp_injective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Function.Injective (radialMatOp N)

PAG243::radialMatHom.text:
noncomputable def radialMatHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ →ₙₐ[ℂ] shellAlg N where
  toFun M := ⟨radialMatOp N M, radialMatOp_mem N M⟩
  map_smul' c M := Subtype.ext (show radialMatOp N (c • M) = c • radialMatOp N M by
    simp only [radialMatOp, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, Finset.smul_sum])
  map_zero' := Subtype.ext (show radialMatOp N 0 = 0 by
    simp only [radialMatOp, Matrix.zero_apply, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero])
  map_add' M M' := Subtype.ext (show radialMatOp N (M + M') = radialMatOp N M + radialMatOp N M' by
    simp only [radialMatOp, Matrix.add_apply, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib])
  map_mul' M M' := Subtype.ext (radialMatOp_mul N M M')

PAG243::radialMatHom_injective.text: theorem radialMatHom_injective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Function.Injective (radialMatHom N)

PAG243::radialSection.text:
noncomputable def radialSection (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Module.End ℂ (refLayer N (baseIdx N))) : shellAlg N :=
  radialMatHom N (LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N) S)

PAG243::radialHom_radialSection.text:
theorem radialHom_radialSection (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Module.End ℂ (refLayer N (baseIdx N))) :
    radialHom N (radialSection N S) = S

PAG243::diagAvgAlg.text:
noncomputable def diagAvgAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :=
  Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (fun s : ℕ => LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N s)) ∪ {PAG.Part15.convL (geps N N)})

PAG243::diagAvgAlg_le.text: theorem diagAvgAlg_le (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : diagAvgAlg N ≤ shellAlg N

PAG243::radialMatOp_mem_diagAvg.text:
theorem radialMatOp_mem_diagAvg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) :
    radialMatOp N M ∈ diagAvgAlg N

PAG243::radialHom_diagAvg_surjective.text:
theorem radialHom_diagAvg_surjective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Module.End ℂ (refLayer N (baseIdx N))) :
    ∃ T : shellAlg N, (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) ∈ diagAvgAlg N ∧ radialHom N T = S

PAG243::sum_dind_mul_radial.text:
theorem sum_dind_mul_radial {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : Radial f) (s : ℕ) (hs : s ∣ N) :
    ∑ y, dind N s y * f y = (Nat.totient (N / s) : ℂ) * f (s : ZMod N)

PAG243::shellTrans_self_radial.text:
theorem shellTrans_self_radial {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : Radial f) (s : ℕ) (hs : s ∣ N) :
    shellTrans N s s f = f (s : ZMod N) • dind N s

PAG243::sum_shellTrans_self_radial.text:
theorem sum_shellTrans_self_radial {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : Radial f) :
    ∑ s ∈ N.divisors, shellTrans N s s f = f

PAG243::ramMat.text:
noncomputable def ramMat (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun u t => (N : ℂ) * geps N t ((u : ℕ) : ZMod N)

PAG243::natCast_mul_geps.text:
theorem natCast_mul_geps {N t : ℕ} [NeZero N] (ht : t ∣ N) (u : ℕ) :
    (N : ℂ) * geps N t (u : ZMod N) = ∑ e ∈ (N / t).divisors,
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * ((N / (t * e) : ℕ) : ℂ) * (if N / (t * e) ∣ u then 1 else 0)

PAG243::ramMat_apply.text:
theorem ramMat_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (u t : N.divisors) :
    ramMat N u t = ∑ e ∈ (N / t).divisors,
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * ((N / (t * e) : ℕ) : ℂ) * (if N / (t * e) ∣ (u : ℕ) then 1 else 0)

PAG243::radialDFT.text:
noncomputable def radialDFT (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Module.End ℂ (refLayer N (baseIdx N)) :=
  (ZMod.dft (N := N) (E := ℂ)).toLinearMap.restrict (fun f hf =>
    (mem_refLayer_base_iff N _).mpr (dft_radial f ((mem_refLayer_base_iff N f).mp hf)))

PAG243::toMatrix_radialDFT.text:
theorem toMatrix_radialDFT (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N) (radialDFT N) = ramMat N

PAG243::radialDFT_mul_self.text: theorem radialDFT_mul_self (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : radialDFT N * radialDFT N = (N : ℂ) • 1

PAG243::ramMat_mul_self.text: theorem ramMat_mul_self (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : ramMat N * ramMat N = (N : ℂ) • 1

PAG243::dft_conv_geps.text:
theorem dft_conv_geps (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    𝓕 (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) = dind N s * 𝓕 f

PAG243::ramMat_mul_toMatrix_E.text:
theorem ramMat_mul_toMatrix_E (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s : N.divisors) :
    ramMat N * LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N)
      (radialHom N ⟨PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s), PAG.Part232.convL_geps_mem N s⟩) =
    LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N)
      (radialHom N ⟨LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N s), PAG.Part232.mulLeft_dind_mem N s⟩) * ramMat N

PAG243::toMatrix_E_eq_ramMat.text:
theorem toMatrix_E_eq_ramMat (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s u t : N.divisors) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N)
      (radialHom N ⟨PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s), PAG.Part232.convL_geps_mem N s⟩) u t =
      ramMat N s t * ramMat N u s / N

PAG243::ramMat_apply_col_self.text:
theorem ramMat_apply_col_self (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (u : N.divisors) :
    ramMat N u ⟨N, Nat.mem_divisors_self N (NeZero.ne N)⟩ = 1

PAG243::ramMat_apply_row_self.text:
theorem ramMat_apply_row_self (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (t : N.divisors) :
    ramMat N ⟨N, Nat.mem_divisors_self N (NeZero.ne N)⟩ t = Nat.totient (N / t)

PAG243::sum_divisors_primePow_moebius.text:
theorem sum_divisors_primePow_moebius {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (g : ℕ → ℂ) :
    ∑ e ∈ (q ^ n).divisors, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * g e = g 1 - g q

PAG243::ramMat_primePow.text:
theorem ramMat_primePow {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) {k i j : ℕ} [NeZero (q ^ k)] (hj : j ≤ k) :
    ((q ^ k : ℕ) : ℂ) * geps (q ^ k) (q ^ j) ((q ^ i : ℕ) : ZMod (q ^ k)) =
      if j = k then 1 else
        (if k - j ≤ i then ((q ^ (k - j) : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0) -
          (if k - j - 1 ≤ i then ((q ^ (k - j - 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0)

PAG243::ramMat_mul_coprime.text:
theorem ramMat_mul_coprime {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ua ta ub tb : ℕ}
    (hua : ua ∣ a) (hta : ta ∣ a) (hub : ub ∣ b) (htb : tb ∣ b) :
    ((a * b : ℕ) : ℂ) * geps (a * b) (ta * tb) ((ua * ub : ℕ) : ZMod (a * b)) =
      ((a : ℂ) * geps a ta (ua : ZMod a)) * ((b : ℂ) * geps b tb (ub : ZMod b))

PAG244::card_fiber_eq.text:
theorem card_fiber_eq {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (x y : ZMod N) (h : Nat.gcd N y.val = Nat.gcd N x.val) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun a : (ZMod N)ˣ => (a : ZMod N) * x = y)).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun a : (ZMod N)ˣ => (a : ZMod N) * x = x)).card

PAG244::sum_units_mul.text:
theorem sum_units_mul {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (F : ZMod N → ℂ) (x : ZMod N) :
    ∑ a : (ZMod N)ˣ, F ((a : ZMod N) * x) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun a : (ZMod N)ˣ => (a : ZMod N) * x = x)).card : ℂ) *
        ∑ y, dind N (Nat.gcd N x.val) y * F y

PAG244::card_stab_mul_totient.text:
theorem card_stab_mul_totient {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (x : ZMod N) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun a : (ZMod N)ˣ => (a : ZMod N) * x = x)).card : ℂ) *
      (Nat.totient (N / Nat.gcd N x.val) : ℂ) = Nat.totient N

PAG244::unitAvg.text:
noncomputable def unitAvg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  ((Nat.totient N : ℂ))⁻¹ • ∑ a : (ZMod N)ˣ, dil a

PAG244::unitAvg_apply.text:
theorem unitAvg_apply {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (x : ZMod N) :
    unitAvg N f x = (∑ y, dind N (Nat.gcd N x.val) y * f y) / (Nat.totient (N / Nat.gcd N x.val) : ℂ)

PAG244::shellAvg.text: noncomputable def shellAvg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) := ∑ s ∈ N.divisors, shellTrans N s s

PAG244::shellAvg_apply.text:
theorem shellAvg_apply {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (x : ZMod N) :
    shellAvg N f x = (∑ y, dind N (Nat.gcd N x.val) y * f y) / (Nat.totient (N / Nat.gcd N x.val) : ℂ)

PAG244::shellAvg_eq_unitAvg.text: theorem shellAvg_eq_unitAvg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : shellAvg N = unitAvg N

PAG244::shellAvg_mem.text: theorem shellAvg_mem (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : shellAvg N ∈ shellAlg N

PAG244::radialMatOp_one_eq.text: theorem radialMatOp_one_eq (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : radialMatOp N 1 = shellAvg N

PAG244::shellAvg_mul_self.text: theorem shellAvg_mul_self (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : shellAvg N * shellAvg N = shellAvg N

PAG244::radial_apply_of_mem.text:
theorem radial_apply_of_mem {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hT : T ∈ shellAlg N)
    {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : Radial f) : Radial (T f)

PAG244::commute_shellAvg.text:
theorem commute_shellAvg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hT : T ∈ shellAlg N) :
    T * shellAvg N = shellAvg N * T

PAG244::shellAvg_mem_center.text:
theorem shellAvg_mem_center (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (⟨shellAvg N, shellAvg_mem N⟩ : shellAlg N) ∈ Subalgebra.center ℂ (shellAlg N)

PAG244::shellAvg_mul_eq.text:
theorem shellAvg_mul_eq (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : shellAlg N) :
    shellAvg N * T = radialMatOp N (LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N) (radialHom N T))

PAG244::mul_shellAvg_eq.text:
theorem mul_shellAvg_eq (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : shellAlg N) :
    (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) * shellAvg N =
      radialMatOp N (LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N) (radialHom N T))

PAG244::shellAvg_mul_radialMatOp.text:
theorem shellAvg_mul_radialMatOp (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) :
    shellAvg N * radialMatOp N M = radialMatOp N M

PAG244::radialHom_eq_zero_iff.text:
theorem radialHom_eq_zero_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : shellAlg N) :
    radialHom N T = 0 ↔ shellAvg N * T = 0

PAG244::radial_shellAvg_apply.text: theorem radial_shellAvg_apply {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : Radial (shellAvg N f)

PAG244::shellAvg_apply_of_radial.text: theorem shellAvg_apply_of_radial {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : Radial f) : shellAvg N f = f

PAG244::dvdWeight.text: noncomputable def dvdWeight (n : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℤ := ⟨fun d => if d ∣ n then (d : ℤ) else 0, by simp⟩

PAG244::dvdWeight_apply.text: theorem dvdWeight_apply (n d : ℕ) : dvdWeight n d = if d ∣ n then (d : ℤ) else 0

PAG244::ramSum.text: noncomputable def ramSum (n : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℤ := ArithmeticFunction.moebius * dvdWeight n

PAG244::ramSum_apply.text:
theorem ramSum_apply (n q : ℕ) :
    ramSum n q = ∑ e ∈ q.divisors,
      ArithmeticFunction.moebius e * (if q / e ∣ n then ((q / e : ℕ) : ℤ) else 0)

PAG244::natCast_mul_geps_eq_ramSum.text:
theorem natCast_mul_geps_eq_ramSum {N t : ℕ} [NeZero N] (ht : t ∣ N) (u : ℕ) :
    (N : ℂ) * geps N t (u : ZMod N) = (ramSum u (N / t) : ℂ)

PAG244::ramMat_eq_ramSum.text:
theorem ramMat_eq_ramSum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (u t : N.divisors) :
    ramMat N u t = (ramSum u (N / t) : ℂ)

PAG244::sum_divisors_primePow_moebius_in.text:
theorem sum_divisors_primePow_moebius_int {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (g : ℕ → ℤ) :
    ∑ e ∈ (q ^ n).divisors, ArithmeticFunction.moebius e * g e = g 1 - g q

PAG244::ramSum_primePow.text:
theorem ramSum_primePow {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (n : ℕ) :
    ramSum n (p ^ k) = (if p ^ k ∣ n then ((p ^ k : ℕ) : ℤ) else 0) -
      (if p ^ (k - 1) ∣ n then ((p ^ (k - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) else 0)

PAG244::ramSum_one.text: theorem ramSum_one (q : ℕ) : ramSum 1 q = ArithmeticFunction.moebius q

PAG244::ramSum_primePow_ne_zero.text:
theorem ramSum_primePow_ne_zero {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {n : ℕ} (h : p ^ (k - 1) ∣ n) :
    ramSum n (p ^ k) ≠ 0

PAG244::ramSum_ne_zero.text:
theorem ramSum_ne_zero {q n : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (h : ∀ p ∈ q.primeFactors, p ^ (q.factorization p - 1) ∣ n) :
    ramSum n q ≠ 0

PAG244::ramSum_ne_zero_iff.text:
theorem ramSum_ne_zero_iff {q n : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    ramSum n q ≠ 0 ↔ ∀ p ∈ q.primeFactors, p ^ (q.factorization p - 1) ∣ n

PAG244::ramSum_ne_zero_of_squarefree.text: theorem ramSum_ne_zero_of_squarefree {q : ℕ} (hq : Squarefree q) (u : ℕ) : ramSum u q ≠ 0

PAG244::ramSum_div_ne_zero.text:
theorem ramSum_div_ne_zero {N s t : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (hs : s ∣ N) (ht : t ∣ N) (hsq : Squarefree (N / s)) :
    ramSum s (N / t) ≠ 0

PAG244::toMatrix_E_ne_zero.text:
theorem toMatrix_E_ne_zero (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s : N.divisors) (hsq : Squarefree (N / s)) (u t : N.divisors) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N)
      (radialHom N ⟨PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s), PAG.Part232.convL_geps_mem N s⟩) u t ≠ 0

PAG244::oneEAlg.text:
noncomputable def oneEAlg (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :=
  Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (fun u : ℕ => LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N u)) ∪ {PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s)})

PAG244::oneEAlg_le.text: theorem oneEAlg_le (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] : oneEAlg N s ≤ shellAlg N

PAG244::oneETrans.text:
noncomputable def oneETrans (N s u t : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  ((N : ℂ) * geps N t (s : ZMod N) * geps N s (u : ZMod N))⁻¹ •
    (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N u) * PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) * LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N t))

PAG244::oneETrans_mem.text: theorem oneETrans_mem (N s u t : ℕ) [NeZero N] : oneETrans N s u t ∈ oneEAlg N s

PAG244::oneETrans_dind.text:
theorem oneETrans_dind (N s u t r : ℕ) [NeZero N]
    (hne : (N : ℂ) * geps N t (s : ZMod N) * geps N s (u : ZMod N) ≠ 0) :
    oneETrans N s u t (dind N r) = if t = r then dind N u else 0

PAG244::toMatrix_oneETrans.text:
theorem toMatrix_oneETrans (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s u t : N.divisors)
    (hne : (N : ℂ) * geps N t (s : ZMod N) * geps N s (u : ZMod N) ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N)
      (radialHom N ⟨oneETrans N s u t, oneEAlg_le N s (oneETrans_mem N s u t)⟩) = Matrix.single u t 1

PAG244::radialHom_oneE_surjective.text:
theorem radialHom_oneE_surjective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s : N.divisors) (hsq : Squarefree (N / s))
    (S : Module.End ℂ (refLayer N (baseIdx N))) :
    ∃ T : shellAlg N, (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) ∈ oneEAlg N s ∧ radialHom N T = S

PAG244::oneEAlg_apply_one_eq_zero.text:
theorem oneEAlg_apply_one_eq_zero (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s : ℕ) (hs : s ∣ N) (hsq : ¬ Squarefree (N / s))
    {T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hT : T ∈ oneEAlg N s) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≠ 1) :
    T (dind N t) ((1 : ℕ) : ZMod N) = 0

PAG244::not_radialHom_oneE_surjective.text:
theorem not_radialHom_oneE_surjective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s : N.divisors) (hsq : ¬ Squarefree (N / s)) :
    ¬ ∀ S : Module.End ℂ (refLayer N (baseIdx N)),
      ∃ T : shellAlg N, (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) ∈ oneEAlg N s ∧ radialHom N T = S

PAG244::radialHom_oneE_surjective_iff.text:
theorem radialHom_oneE_surjective_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s : N.divisors) :
    (∀ S : Module.End ℂ (refLayer N (baseIdx N)),
      ∃ T : shellAlg N, (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) ∈ oneEAlg N s ∧ radialHom N T = S) ↔
      Squarefree (N / s)

PAG245::ramSum_gcd.text: theorem ramSum_gcd (n q : ℕ) : ramSum n q = ramSum (Nat.gcd q n) q

PAG245::ramSum_mod.text: theorem ramSum_mod (n q : ℕ) : ramSum (n % q) q = ramSum n q

PAG245::ramSum_of_coprime.text: theorem ramSum_of_coprime {q n : ℕ} (h : Nat.Coprime q n) : ramSum n q = ArithmeticFunction.moebius q

PAG245::totientDivGcd.text:
noncomputable def totientDivGcd (n : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℤ :=
  ⟨fun q => (Nat.totient (q / Nat.gcd q n) : ℤ), by simp⟩

PAG245::moebiusDivGcd.text:
noncomputable def moebiusDivGcd (n : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℤ :=
  ⟨fun q => ArithmeticFunction.moebius (q / Nat.gcd q n), by simp⟩

PAG245::totientDivGcd_apply.text: theorem totientDivGcd_apply (n q : ℕ) : totientDivGcd n q = (Nat.totient (q / Nat.gcd q n) : ℤ)

PAG245::moebiusDivGcd_apply.text:
theorem moebiusDivGcd_apply (n q : ℕ) :
    moebiusDivGcd n q = ArithmeticFunction.moebius (q / Nat.gcd q n)

PAG245::gcd_mul_of_coprime.text:
theorem gcd_mul_of_coprime {a b : ℕ} (h : Nat.Coprime a b) (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.gcd (a * b) n = Nat.gcd a n * Nat.gcd b n

PAG245::mul_div_gcd_of_coprime.text:
theorem mul_div_gcd_of_coprime {a b : ℕ} (h : Nat.Coprime a b) (n : ℕ) :
    a * b / Nat.gcd (a * b) n = (a / Nat.gcd a n) * (b / Nat.gcd b n)

PAG245::coprime_div_gcd_of_coprime.text:
theorem coprime_div_gcd_of_coprime {a b : ℕ} (h : Nat.Coprime a b) (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.Coprime (a / Nat.gcd a n) (b / Nat.gcd b n)

PAG245::ramSum_mul_totient_primePow.text:
theorem ramSum_mul_totient_primePow {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (i n : ℕ) :
    ramSum n (p ^ i) * (Nat.totient (p ^ i / Nat.gcd (p ^ i) n) : ℤ) =
      ArithmeticFunction.moebius (p ^ i / Nat.gcd (p ^ i) n) * (Nat.totient (p ^ i) : ℤ)

PAG245::ramSum_mul_totient.text:
theorem ramSum_mul_totient (n q : ℕ) :
    ramSum n q * (Nat.totient (q / Nat.gcd q n) : ℤ) =
      ArithmeticFunction.moebius (q / Nat.gcd q n) * (Nat.totient q : ℤ)

PAG245::div_gcd_pos.text: theorem div_gcd_pos {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) : 0 < q / Nat.gcd q n

PAG245::ramSum_eq_div.text:
theorem ramSum_eq_div {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    (ramSum n q : ℂ) = (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (q / Nat.gcd q n) : ℂ) * (Nat.totient q : ℂ) /
      (Nat.totient (q / Nat.gcd q n) : ℂ)

PAG245::ramSum_ne_zero_iff_squarefree.text:
theorem ramSum_ne_zero_iff_squarefree {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    ramSum n q ≠ 0 ↔ Squarefree (q / Nat.gcd q n)

PAG245::ramSum_of_dvd.text: theorem ramSum_of_dvd {q n : ℕ} (h : q ∣ n) : ramSum n q = (Nat.totient q : ℤ)

PAG245::ramMat_eq_closed.text:
theorem ramMat_eq_closed (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (u t : N.divisors) :
    ramMat N u t = (ArithmeticFunction.moebius ((N / t) / Nat.gcd (N / t) u) : ℂ) * (Nat.totient (N / t) : ℂ) /
      (Nat.totient ((N / t) / Nat.gcd (N / t) u) : ℂ)

PAG245::radialMatOp_add.text:
theorem radialMatOp_add (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M M' : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) :
    radialMatOp N (M + M') = radialMatOp N M + radialMatOp N M'

PAG245::radialMatOp_smul.text:
theorem radialMatOp_smul (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : ℂ) (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) :
    radialMatOp N (c • M) = c • radialMatOp N M

PAG245::radialMatOp_zero.text: theorem radialMatOp_zero (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : radialMatOp N 0 = 0

PAG245::radialMatOp_single.text:
theorem radialMatOp_single (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s t : N.divisors) (c : ℂ) :
    radialMatOp N (Matrix.single s t c) = c • shellTrans N s t

PAG245::convL_geps_self_eq.text:
theorem convL_geps_self_eq (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps N N) = radialMatOp N (LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N)
      (radialHom N ⟨PAG.Part15.convL (geps N N), PAG.Part232.convL_geps_mem N N⟩))

PAG245::shellDev.text:
noncomputable def shellDev (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N s) - shellTrans N s s

PAG245::shellDev_apply.text:
theorem shellDev_apply (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    shellDev N s f = dind N s * f - ((∑ y, dind N s y * f y) / (Nat.totient (N / s) : ℂ)) • dind N s

PAG245::mulLeft_dind_mul_shellTrans.text:
theorem mulLeft_dind_mul_shellTrans (N s u v : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N s) * shellTrans N u v = if s = u then shellTrans N s v else 0

PAG245::shellTrans_mul_mulLeft_dind.text:
theorem shellTrans_mul_mulLeft_dind (N u v s : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    shellTrans N u v * LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N s) = if v = s then shellTrans N u v else 0

PAG245::shellDev_mul_shellTrans.text:
theorem shellDev_mul_shellTrans (N s u v : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) :
    shellDev N s * shellTrans N u v = 0

PAG245::shellTrans_mul_shellDev.text:
theorem shellTrans_mul_shellDev (N u v s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hv : v ∣ N) :
    shellTrans N u v * shellDev N s = 0

PAG245::shellDev_mul_shellDev.text:
theorem shellDev_mul_shellDev (N s t : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) :
    shellDev N s * shellDev N t = if s = t then shellDev N s else 0

PAG245::shellDev_single_apply.text:
theorem shellDev_single_apply (N t s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) :
    shellDev N t (Pi.single (s : ZMod N) 1) (s : ZMod N) =
      if s = t then 1 - ((Nat.totient (N / s) : ℂ))⁻¹ else 0

PAG245::shellDev_eq_zero_iff.text:
theorem shellDev_eq_zero_iff (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) :
    shellDev N s = 0 ↔ Nat.totient (N / s) = 1

PAG245::devSet.text: def devSet (N : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := N.divisors.filter (fun s => Nat.totient (N / s) ≠ 1)

PAG245::dvd_of_mem_devSet.text: theorem dvd_of_mem_devSet {N : ℕ} (s : devSet N) : (s : ℕ) ∣ N

PAG245::card_filter_totient_eq_one.text:
theorem card_filter_totient_eq_one (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (N.divisors.filter (fun s => Nat.totient (N / s) = 1)).card = 1 + if 2 ∣ N then 1 else 0

PAG245::card_devSet.text:
theorem card_devSet (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (devSet N).card + 1 + (if 2 ∣ N then 1 else 0) = N.divisors.card

PAG245::sum_devSet_shellDev.text:
theorem sum_devSet_shellDev (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    ∑ s : devSet N, shellDev N s = ∑ s ∈ N.divisors, shellDev N s

PAG245::shellAvg_add_sum_shellDev.text:
theorem shellAvg_add_sum_shellDev (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    shellAvg N + ∑ s : devSet N, shellDev N s = 1

PAG245::radialMatOp_mul_shellDev.text:
theorem radialMatOp_mul_shellDev (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) (s : ℕ) :
    radialMatOp N M * shellDev N s = 0

PAG245::shellDev_mul_radialMatOp.text:
theorem shellDev_mul_radialMatOp (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) {s : ℕ} (hs : s ∣ N) :
    shellDev N s * radialMatOp N M = 0

PAG245::shellDev_mul_shellDev_devSet.text:
theorem shellDev_mul_shellDev_devSet (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s t : devSet N) :
    shellDev N s * shellDev N t = if s = t then shellDev N s else 0

PAG245::wholeMap.text:
noncomputable def wholeMap (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ × (devSet N → ℂ)) →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun p := radialMatOp N p.1 + ∑ s : devSet N, p.2 s • shellDev N s
  map_add' p q := by
    simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Pi.add_apply, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, radialMatOp_add]
    abel
  map_smul' c p := by
    simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, ← Finset.smul_sum,
      radialMatOp_smul, RingHom.id_apply, smul_add]

PAG245::wholeMap_apply.text:
theorem wholeMap_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ × (devSet N → ℂ)) :
    wholeMap N p = radialMatOp N p.1 + ∑ s : devSet N, p.2 s • shellDev N s

PAG245::wholeMap_one.text: theorem wholeMap_one (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : wholeMap N 1 = 1

PAG245::wholeMap_mul.text:
theorem wholeMap_mul (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p q : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ × (devSet N → ℂ)) :
    wholeMap N (p * q) = wholeMap N p * wholeMap N q

PAG245::wholeHom.text:
noncomputable def wholeHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ × (devSet N → ℂ)) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  AlgHom.ofLinearMap (wholeMap N) (wholeMap_one N) (wholeMap_mul N)

PAG245::wholeHom_apply.text:
theorem wholeHom_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ × (devSet N → ℂ)) :
    wholeHom N p = wholeMap N p

PAG245::shellAvg_mul_wholeMap.text:
theorem shellAvg_mul_wholeMap (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ × (devSet N → ℂ)) :
    shellAvg N * wholeMap N p = radialMatOp N p.1

PAG245::wholeMap_injective.text: theorem wholeMap_injective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Function.Injective (wholeMap N)

PAG245::shellTrans_mem_oneEAlg.text: theorem shellTrans_mem_oneEAlg (N s t : ℕ) [NeZero N] : shellTrans N s t ∈ oneEAlg N N

PAG245::radialMatOp_mem_oneEAlg.text:
theorem radialMatOp_mem_oneEAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) :
    radialMatOp N M ∈ oneEAlg N N

PAG245::shellDev_mem_oneEAlg.text: theorem shellDev_mem_oneEAlg (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] : shellDev N s ∈ oneEAlg N N

PAG245::radialMatOp_mem_range.text:
theorem radialMatOp_mem_range (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) :
    radialMatOp N M ∈ (wholeHom N).range

PAG245::shellDev_mem_range.text: theorem shellDev_mem_range (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) : shellDev N s ∈ (wholeHom N).range

PAG245::mulLeft_dind_mem_range.text: theorem mulLeft_dind_mem_range (N u : ℕ) [NeZero N] : LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N u) ∈ (wholeHom N).range

PAG245::range_wholeHom.text: theorem range_wholeHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : (wholeHom N).range = oneEAlg N N

PAG245::wholeAlgEquiv.text:
noncomputable def wholeAlgEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ × (devSet N → ℂ)) ≃ₐ[ℂ] oneEAlg N N :=
  (AlgEquiv.ofInjective (wholeHom N) (wholeMap_injective N)).trans
    (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ (range_wholeHom N))

PAG245::wholeAlgEquiv_apply.text:
theorem wholeAlgEquiv_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ × (devSet N → ℂ)) :
    (wholeAlgEquiv N p : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) = wholeMap N p

PAG245::toSubmodule_oneEAlg_self.text:
