theorem toSubmodule_oneEAlg_self (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Subalgebra.toSubmodule (oneEAlg N N) = LinearMap.range (wholeMap N)

PAG245::finrank_oneEAlg_self.text:
theorem finrank_oneEAlg_self (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (oneEAlg N N) = N.divisors.card ^ 2 + (devSet N).card

PAG245::finrank_oneEAlg_self_add.text:
theorem finrank_oneEAlg_self_add (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (oneEAlg N N) + 1 + (if 2 ∣ N then 1 else 0) = N.divisors.card ^ 2 + N.divisors.card

PAG245::finrank_oneEAlg_self_sub.text:
theorem finrank_oneEAlg_self_sub (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (oneEAlg N N) = N.divisors.card ^ 2 + N.divisors.card - 1 - (if 2 ∣ N then 1 else 0)

PAG245::wholeMap_smul_one.text:
theorem wholeMap_smul_one (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : ℂ) (b : devSet N → ℂ) :
    wholeMap N (c • 1, b) = c • shellAvg N + ∑ s : devSet N, b s • shellDev N s

PAG245::mem_center_oneEAlg_iff.text:
theorem mem_center_oneEAlg_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : oneEAlg N N) :
    T ∈ Subalgebra.center ℂ (oneEAlg N N) ↔
      ∃ (c : ℂ) (b : devSet N → ℂ),
        (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) = c • shellAvg N + ∑ s : devSet N, b s • shellDev N s

PAG245::centerMap.text:
noncomputable def centerMap (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : (ℂ × (devSet N → ℂ)) →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  (wholeMap N).comp
    (LinearMap.prodMap (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ _ (1 : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ)) LinearMap.id)

PAG245::centerMap_apply.text:
theorem centerMap_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : ℂ) (b : devSet N → ℂ) :
    centerMap N (c, b) = c • shellAvg N + ∑ s : devSet N, b s • shellDev N s

PAG245::centerMap_injective.text: theorem centerMap_injective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Function.Injective (centerMap N)

PAG245::mem_center_oneEAlg_iff_range.text:
theorem mem_center_oneEAlg_iff_range (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : oneEAlg N N) :
    T ∈ Subalgebra.center ℂ (oneEAlg N N) ↔ (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) ∈ LinearMap.range (centerMap N)

PAG245::finrank_range_centerMap.text:
theorem finrank_range_centerMap (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range (centerMap N)) = 1 + (devSet N).card

PAG245::finrank_range_centerMap_add.text:
theorem finrank_range_centerMap_add (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range (centerMap N)) + (if 2 ∣ N then 1 else 0) = N.divisors.card

PAG246::eq_of_gcd_eq.text:
theorem eq_of_gcd_eq {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) (hφ : Nat.totient (N / s) = 1) {x y : ZMod N}
    (hx : Nat.gcd N x.val = s) (hy : Nat.gcd N y.val = s) : x = y

PAG246::radial_dind_mul.text:
theorem radial_dind_mul {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) (hφ : Nat.totient (N / s) = 1) (g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    Radial (dind N s * g)

PAG246::radial_conv_geps.text:
theorem radial_conv_geps {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) (hφ : Nat.totient (N / s) = 1) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    Radial (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f)

PAG246::convL_geps_eq_radialMatOp.text:
theorem convL_geps_eq_radialMatOp {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) (hφ : Nat.totient (N / s) = 1) :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) = radialMatOp N (LinearMap.toMatrix (radialBasis N) (radialBasis N)
      (radialHom N ⟨PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s), PAG.Part232.convL_geps_mem N s⟩))

PAG246::convL_geps_mem_oneEAlg.text:
theorem convL_geps_mem_oneEAlg {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) (hφ : Nat.totient (N / s) = 1) :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) ∈ oneEAlg N N

PAG246::convL_geps_half_mem_oneEAlg.text:
theorem convL_geps_half_mem_oneEAlg {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (h2 : 2 ∣ N) :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps N (N / 2)) ∈ oneEAlg N N

PAG246::shellAlg_le_oneEAlg_of_forall_me.text:
theorem shellAlg_le_oneEAlg_of_forall_mem (N : ℕ) [NeZero N]
    (h : ∀ s ∈ N.divisors, s ≠ 1 → PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) ∈ oneEAlg N N) : shellAlg N ≤ oneEAlg N N

PAG246::shellAlg_eq_oneEAlg_of_forall.text:
theorem shellAlg_eq_oneEAlg_of_forall (N : ℕ) [NeZero N]
    (h : ∀ s ∈ N.divisors, s ≠ 1 → Nat.totient (N / s) = 1) : shellAlg N = oneEAlg N N

PAG246::forall_totient_eq_one_iff.text:
theorem forall_totient_eq_one_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (∀ s ∈ N.divisors, s ≠ 1 → Nat.totient (N / s) = 1) ↔ N = 1 ∨ N = 4 ∨ N.Prime

PAG246::finrank_oneEAlg_le.text:
theorem finrank_oneEAlg_le (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (oneEAlg N N) ≤ Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg N)

PAG246::card_divisors_primePow.text: theorem card_divisors_primePow {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (k : ℕ) : (p ^ k).divisors.card = k + 1

PAG246::finrank_shellAlg_primePow.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg_primePow {p k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hk : k ≠ 0) [NeZero (p ^ k)] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg (p ^ k)) = (k + 1) ^ 2 + k * (k + 1) / 2 - (if p = 2 then k else 0)

PAG246::two_dvd_primePow_iff.text: theorem two_dvd_primePow_iff {p k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hk : k ≠ 0) : 2 ∣ p ^ k ↔ p = 2

PAG246::finrank_oneEAlg_primePow_add.text:
theorem finrank_oneEAlg_primePow_add {p k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hk : k ≠ 0) [NeZero (p ^ k)] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (oneEAlg (p ^ k) (p ^ k)) + 1 + (if p = 2 then 1 else 0) = (k + 1) ^ 2 + (k + 1)

PAG246::half_mul_succ.text: theorem half_mul_succ (k : ℕ) : k * (k + 1) / 2 = k + k * (k - 1) / 2

PAG246::finrank_shellAlg_primePow_odd.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg_primePow_odd {p k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (hk : k ≠ 0) [NeZero (p ^ k)] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg (p ^ k)) = Module.finrank ℂ (oneEAlg (p ^ k) (p ^ k)) + k * (k - 1) / 2

PAG246::finrank_shellAlg_two_pow.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg_two_pow {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) [NeZero (2 ^ k)] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg (2 ^ k)) = Module.finrank ℂ (oneEAlg (2 ^ k) (2 ^ k)) + (k - 1) * (k - 2) / 2

PAG246::finrank_lt_of_eq_primePow_odd.text:
theorem finrank_lt_of_eq_primePow_odd {n p k : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n = p ^ k) (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : p ≠ 2)
    (hk : 2 ≤ k) : Module.finrank ℂ (oneEAlg n n) < Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg n)

PAG246::finrank_lt_of_eq_two_pow.text:
theorem finrank_lt_of_eq_two_pow {n k : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n = 2 ^ k) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (oneEAlg n n) < Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg n)

PAG246::finrank_lt_of_eq_mul.text:
theorem finrank_lt_of_eq_mul {n a b : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n = a * b) (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (ha : Odd a)
    (ha1 : 1 < a) (hb1 : 1 < b) : Module.finrank ℂ (oneEAlg n n) < Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg n)

PAG246::finrank_oneEAlg_lt_shellAlg.text:
theorem finrank_oneEAlg_lt_shellAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h1 : N ≠ 1) (h4 : N ≠ 4) (hpr : ¬ N.Prime) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (oneEAlg N N) < Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg N)

PAG246::shellAlg_eq_oneEAlg_iff.text:
theorem shellAlg_eq_oneEAlg_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    shellAlg N = oneEAlg N N ↔ N = 1 ∨ N = 4 ∨ N.Prime

PAG246::shellAlg_eq_oneEAlg_iff_forall.text:
theorem shellAlg_eq_oneEAlg_iff_forall (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    shellAlg N = oneEAlg N N ↔ ∀ s ∈ N.divisors, s ≠ 1 → Nat.totient (N / s) = 1

PAG246::finrank_shellAlg_eq_iff.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg_eq_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg N) = Module.finrank ℂ (oneEAlg N N) ↔ N = 1 ∨ N = 4 ∨ N.Prime

PAG246::prod_eq_iff.text:
theorem prod_eq_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors, ((N.factorization q + 1) ^ 2 + N.factorization q * (N.factorization q + 1) / 2 -
        (if q = 2 then N.factorization q else 0))) =
      N.divisors.card ^ 2 + N.divisors.card - 1 - (if 2 ∣ N then 1 else 0) ↔ N = 1 ∨ N = 4 ∨ N.Prime

PAG246::shellAlgEquivOfMem.text:
noncomputable def shellAlgEquivOfMem (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hN : N = 1 ∨ N = 4 ∨ N.Prime) :
    (Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ × (devSet N → ℂ)) ≃ₐ[ℂ] shellAlg N :=
  (wholeAlgEquiv N).trans (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ ((shellAlg_eq_oneEAlg_iff N).mpr hN).symm)

PAG246::shellAlgEquivOfMem_apply.text:
theorem shellAlgEquivOfMem_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hN : N = 1 ∨ N = 4 ∨ N.Prime)
    (p : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ × (devSet N → ℂ)) :
    (shellAlgEquivOfMem N hN p : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) = wholeMap N p

PAG246::exists_convL_geps_not_mem.text:
theorem exists_convL_geps_not_mem (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hN : ¬ (N = 1 ∨ N = 4 ∨ N.Prime)) :
    ∃ s ∈ N.divisors, s ≠ 1 ∧ Nat.totient (N / s) ≠ 1 ∧ PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) ∉ oneEAlg N N

PAG246::conv_dft_dft.text:
theorem conv_dft_dft (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (𝓕 f) (𝓕 g) = (N : ℂ) • 𝓕 (f * g)

PAG246::fourierConj.text:
noncomputable def fourierConj (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) ≃ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  LinearEquiv.conjAlgEquiv ℂ (ZMod.dft : (ZMod N → ℂ) ≃ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ))

PAG246::fourierConj_convL_geps.text:
theorem fourierConj_convL_geps (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    fourierConj N (PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s)) = LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N s)

PAG246::fourierConj_mulLeft_dind.text:
theorem fourierConj_mulLeft_dind (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    fourierConj N (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N s)) = PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s)

PAG246::dualOneEAlg.text:
noncomputable def dualOneEAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :=
  Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (fun u : ℕ => PAG.Part15.convL (geps N u)) ∪ {LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N N)})

PAG246::map_fourierConj_shellAlg.text:
theorem map_fourierConj_shellAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (shellAlg N).map (fourierConj N : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) = shellAlg N

PAG246::map_fourierConj_oneEAlg.text:
theorem map_fourierConj_oneEAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (oneEAlg N N).map (fourierConj N : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) =
      dualOneEAlg N

PAG246::finrank_dualOneEAlg.text:
theorem finrank_dualOneEAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (dualOneEAlg N) = Module.finrank ℂ (oneEAlg N N)

PAG246::shellAlg_eq_dualOneEAlg_iff.text:
theorem shellAlg_eq_dualOneEAlg_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    shellAlg N = dualOneEAlg N ↔ N = 1 ∨ N = 4 ∨ N.Prime

PAG247::ramSum_eq_totient_iff.text:
theorem ramSum_eq_totient_iff {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    ramSum n q = (Nat.totient q : ℤ) ↔ q ∣ n

PAG247::sum_dind_mul_eq_zero.text:
theorem sum_dind_mul_eq_zero {N t : ℕ} [NeZero N] (ht : t ∣ N) {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : shellAvg N f = 0) :
    ∑ y, dind N t y * f y = 0

PAG247::radialMatOp_apply_eq_zero.text:
theorem radialMatOp_apply_eq_zero {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) {f : ZMod N → ℂ}
    (hf : shellAvg N f = 0) : radialMatOp N M f = 0

PAG247::shellDev_apply_of_shellAvg_eq_ze.text:
theorem shellDev_apply_of_shellAvg_eq_zero {N t : ℕ} [NeZero N] (ht : t ∣ N) {f : ZMod N → ℂ}
    (hf : shellAvg N f = 0) : shellDev N t f = dind N t * f

PAG247::exists_apply_of_mem_oneEAlg.text:
theorem exists_apply_of_mem_oneEAlg {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {X : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hX : X ∈ oneEAlg N N) :
    ∃ b : devSet N → ℂ, ∀ f : ZMod N → ℂ, shellAvg N f = 0 → X f = ∑ t : devSet N, b t • (dind N t * f)

PAG247::apply_eq_zero_of_mem_oneEAlg.text:
theorem apply_eq_zero_of_mem_oneEAlg {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {X : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)} (hX : X ∈ oneEAlg N N)
    {f : ZMod N → ℂ} (hf : shellAvg N f = 0) {z : ZMod N} (hz : f z = 0) : X f z = 0

PAG247::mulLeft_dind_mul_shellAvg.text:
theorem mulLeft_dind_mul_shellAvg {N t : ℕ} [NeZero N] (ht : t ∣ N) :
    LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N t) * shellAvg N = shellTrans N t t

PAG247::mem_oneEAlg_iff.text:
theorem mem_oneEAlg_iff {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (X : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    X ∈ oneEAlg N N ↔ X ∈ shellAlg N ∧
      ∃ b : devSet N → ℂ, ∀ f : ZMod N → ℂ, shellAvg N f = 0 → X f = ∑ t : devSet N, b t • (dind N t * f)

PAG247::testFn.text: noncomputable def testFn (N : ℕ) : ZMod N → ℂ := Pi.single (1 : ZMod N) (1 : ℂ) - Pi.single (-1 : ZMod N) (1 : ℂ)

PAG247::sum_mul_single.text:
theorem sum_mul_single {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (g : ZMod N → ℂ) (a : ZMod N) :
    ∑ y, g y * (Pi.single a (1 : ℂ) : ZMod N → ℂ) y = g a

PAG247::shellAvg_testFn.text: theorem shellAvg_testFn (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : shellAvg N (testFn N) = 0

PAG247::conv_single_apply.text:
theorem conv_single_apply {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (g : ZMod N → ℂ) (a z : ZMod N) :
    PAG.Part15.conv g (Pi.single a (1 : ℂ)) z = g (z - a)

PAG247::conv_geps_testFn_apply.text:
theorem conv_geps_testFn_apply (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (z : ZMod N) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (testFn N) z = geps N s (z - 1) - geps N s (z + 1)

PAG247::three_le_div.text: theorem three_le_div {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) (hφ : Nat.totient (N / s) ≠ 1) : 3 ≤ N / s

PAG247::conv_geps_testFn_ne_zero.text:
theorem conv_geps_testFn_ne_zero {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) (hφ : Nat.totient (N / s) ≠ 1) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (testFn N) ((1 + N / s : ℕ) : ZMod N) ≠ 0

PAG247::testFn_apply_eq_zero.text:
theorem testFn_apply_eq_zero {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) (h1 : s ≠ 1) (hφ : Nat.totient (N / s) ≠ 1) :
    testFn N ((1 + N / s : ℕ) : ZMod N) = 0

PAG247::convL_geps_not_mem_oneEAlg.text:
theorem convL_geps_not_mem_oneEAlg {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) (h1 : s ≠ 1)
    (hφ : Nat.totient (N / s) ≠ 1) : PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) ∉ oneEAlg N N

PAG247::convL_geps_mem_oneEAlg_iff.text:
theorem convL_geps_mem_oneEAlg_iff {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) (h1 : s ≠ 1) :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) ∈ oneEAlg N N ↔ Nat.totient (N / s) = 1

PAG247::convL_geps_mem_oneEAlg_iff_eq.text:
theorem convL_geps_mem_oneEAlg_iff_eq {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) (h1 : s ≠ 1) :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) ∈ oneEAlg N N ↔ s = N ∨ 2 * s = N

PAG247::mulLeft_dind_mem_dualOneEAlg_iff.text:
theorem mulLeft_dind_mem_dualOneEAlg_iff {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) (h1 : s ≠ 1) :
    LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N s) ∈ dualOneEAlg N ↔ Nat.totient (N / s) = 1

PAG247::abs_ramSum_primePow_le.text:
theorem abs_ramSum_primePow_le {p k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (n : ℕ) :
    |ramSum n (p ^ k)| ≤ (p : ℤ) ^ k - (p : ℤ) ^ (k - 1)

PAG247::ramSum_mul_eq.text:
theorem ramSum_mul_eq {p k M : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hpM : ¬ p ∣ M) :
    ramSum (p ^ (k - 1) * M) (p ^ k * M) = -((p ^ (k - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) * (Nat.totient M : ℤ)

PAG247::ramSum_mul_add_two.text:
theorem ramSum_mul_add_two {p k M : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpM : ¬ p ∣ M) :
    ramSum (p ^ (k - 1) * M + 2) (p ^ k * M) = ramSum (p ^ (k - 1) * M + 2) (p ^ k) * ramSum 2 M

PAG247::ramSum_div_minFac_ne.text:
theorem ramSum_div_minFac_ne {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (h1 : N ≠ 1) (h4 : N ≠ 4) (hpr : ¬ N.Prime) :
    ramSum (N / N.minFac) N ≠ ramSum (N / N.minFac + 2) N

PAG247::convL_geps_one_not_mem_oneEAlg.text:
theorem convL_geps_one_not_mem_oneEAlg {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (h1 : N ≠ 1) (h4 : N ≠ 4) (hpr : ¬ N.Prime) :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps N 1) ∉ oneEAlg N N

PAG247::convL_geps_one_mem_oneEAlg_iff.text:
theorem convL_geps_one_mem_oneEAlg_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps N 1) ∈ oneEAlg N N ↔ N = 1 ∨ N = 4 ∨ N.Prime

PAG247::convL_geps_mem_oneEAlg_iff_all.text:
theorem convL_geps_mem_oneEAlg_iff_all {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : s ∣ N) :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) ∈ oneEAlg N N ↔
      (s ≠ 1 ∧ Nat.totient (N / s) = 1) ∨ (s = 1 ∧ (N = 1 ∨ N = 4 ∨ N.Prime))

PAG247::mulLeft_dind_one_mem_dualOneEAlg.text:
theorem mulLeft_dind_one_mem_dualOneEAlg_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N 1) ∈ dualOneEAlg N ↔ N = 1 ∨ N = 4 ∨ N.Prime

PAG248::fourierConj_apply.text:
theorem fourierConj_apply {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) (h : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    fourierConj N T h = 𝓕 (T (ZMod.dft.symm h))

PAG248::dft_shellAvg.text: theorem dft_shellAvg {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : 𝓕 (shellAvg N f) = shellAvg N (𝓕 f)

PAG248::dft_symm_shellAvg.text:
theorem dft_symm_shellAvg {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    ZMod.dft.symm (shellAvg N f) = shellAvg N (ZMod.dft.symm f)

PAG248::fourierConj_shellAvg.text: theorem fourierConj_shellAvg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : fourierConj N (shellAvg N) = shellAvg N

PAG248::shellAvg_dft_symm_eq_zero.text:
theorem shellAvg_dft_symm_eq_zero {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {h : ZMod N → ℂ} (hh : shellAvg N h = 0) :
    shellAvg N (ZMod.dft.symm h) = 0

PAG248::shellAvg_dind_mul.text:
theorem shellAvg_dind_mul {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (t : ℕ) (g : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    shellAvg N (dind N t * g) = dind N t * shellAvg N g

PAG248::shellAvg_convL_geps.text:
theorem shellAvg_convL_geps {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (s : ℕ) (h : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    shellAvg N (PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) h) = PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) (shellAvg N h)

PAG248::pairFn.text: noncomputable def pairFn (N : ℕ) (a : ZMod N) : ZMod N → ℂ := Pi.single a (1 : ℂ) - Pi.single (-a) (1 : ℂ)

PAG248::shellAvg_pairFn.text: theorem shellAvg_pairFn (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a : ZMod N) : shellAvg N (pairFn N a) = 0

PAG248::convL_geps_pairFn_apply.text:
theorem convL_geps_pairFn_apply (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a : ZMod N) :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) (pairFn N a) a = geps N s 0 - geps N s (a + a)

PAG248::not_dvd_two_mul.text: theorem not_dvd_two_mul {N t : ℕ} [NeZero N] (ht : t ∣ N) (hφ : Nat.totient (N / t) ≠ 1) : ¬ N ∣ 2 * t

PAG248::convL_geps_one_pairFn_ne_zero.text:
theorem convL_geps_one_pairFn_ne_zero {N t : ℕ} [NeZero N] (ht : t ∣ N) (hφ : Nat.totient (N / t) ≠ 1) :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps N 1) (pairFn N (t : ZMod N)) (t : ZMod N) ≠ 0

PAG248::radialMatOp_mul_shellAvg.text:
theorem radialMatOp_mul_shellAvg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) :
    radialMatOp N M * shellAvg N = radialMatOp N M

PAG248::shellAvg_mem_dualOneEAlg.text: theorem shellAvg_mem_dualOneEAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : shellAvg N ∈ dualOneEAlg N

PAG248::radialMatOp_mem_dualOneEAlg.text:
theorem radialMatOp_mem_dualOneEAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) :
    radialMatOp N M ∈ dualOneEAlg N

PAG248::radialMatOp_add_smul_mem_inf.text:
theorem radialMatOp_add_smul_mem_inf (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) (c : ℂ) :
    radialMatOp N M + c • (1 - shellAvg N) ∈ oneEAlg N N ⊓ dualOneEAlg N

PAG248::sum_smul_shellDev.text:
theorem sum_smul_shellDev (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : ℂ) :
    ∑ s : devSet N, c • shellDev N s = c • (1 - shellAvg N)

PAG248::mem_inf_iff.text:
theorem mem_inf_iff {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (X : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    X ∈ oneEAlg N N ⊓ dualOneEAlg N ↔
      ∃ (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) (c : ℂ), X = radialMatOp N M + c • (1 - shellAvg N)

PAG248::mem_inf_iff_one.text:
theorem mem_inf_iff_one {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (X : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :
    X ∈ oneEAlg N N ⊓ dualOneEAlg N ↔
      ∃ (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) (c : ℂ), X = radialMatOp N M + c • 1

PAG248::one_mem_devSet.text: theorem one_mem_devSet {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : 3 ≤ N) : 1 ∈ devSet N

PAG248::interHom.text:
noncomputable def interHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ × ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=
  (wholeHom N).comp ((AlgHom.id ℂ (Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ)).prodMap (Algebra.ofId ℂ (devSet N → ℂ)))

PAG248::interHom_apply.text:
theorem interHom_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) (c : ℂ) :
    interHom N (M, c) = radialMatOp N M + c • (1 - shellAvg N)

PAG248::range_interHom.text: theorem range_interHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : (interHom N).range = oneEAlg N N ⊓ dualOneEAlg N

PAG248::interHom_injective.text: theorem interHom_injective {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : 3 ≤ N) : Function.Injective (interHom N)

PAG248::interAlgEquiv.text:
noncomputable def interAlgEquiv {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : 3 ≤ N) :
    (Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ × ℂ) ≃ₐ[ℂ] ↥(oneEAlg N N ⊓ dualOneEAlg N) :=
  (AlgEquiv.ofInjective (interHom N) (interHom_injective hN)).trans (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ (range_interHom N))

PAG248::interAlgEquiv_apply.text:
theorem interAlgEquiv_apply {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : 3 ≤ N) (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) (c : ℂ) :
    (interAlgEquiv hN (M, c) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) = radialMatOp N M + c • (1 - shellAvg N)

PAG248::finrank_inf.text:
theorem finrank_inf {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : 3 ≤ N) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(oneEAlg N N ⊓ dualOneEAlg N) = N.divisors.card ^ 2 + 1

PAG248::totient_div_eq_one_of_le_two.text:
theorem totient_div_eq_one_of_le_two {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : N ≤ 2) (hs : s ∣ N) :
    Nat.totient (N / s) = 1

PAG248::inf_eq_oneEAlg_of_le_two.text:
theorem inf_eq_oneEAlg_of_le_two {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : N ≤ 2) :
    oneEAlg N N ⊓ dualOneEAlg N = oneEAlg N N

PAG248::finrank_inf_eq.text:
theorem finrank_inf_eq (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(oneEAlg N N ⊓ dualOneEAlg N) = N.divisors.card ^ 2 + (if 3 ≤ N then 1 else 0)

PAG248::toSubmodule_inf.text:
theorem toSubmodule_inf {N : ℕ} (S T : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))) :
    Subalgebra.toSubmodule (S ⊓ T) = Subalgebra.toSubmodule S ⊓ Subalgebra.toSubmodule T

PAG248::finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf.text:
theorem finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(Subalgebra.toSubmodule (oneEAlg N N) ⊔ Subalgebra.toSubmodule (dualOneEAlg N)) +
      Module.finrank ℂ ↥(oneEAlg N N ⊓ dualOneEAlg N) = 2 * Module.finrank ℂ ↥(oneEAlg N N)

PAG248::finrank_sup_add_one.text:
theorem finrank_sup_add_one {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : 3 ≤ N) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(Subalgebra.toSubmodule (oneEAlg N N) ⊔ Subalgebra.toSubmodule (dualOneEAlg N)) + 1 =
      N.divisors.card ^ 2 + 2 * (devSet N).card

PAG248::fourierConj_radialMatOp_mem_inf.text:
theorem fourierConj_radialMatOp_mem_inf (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (M : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ) :
    fourierConj N (radialMatOp N M) ∈ oneEAlg N N ⊓ dualOneEAlg N

PAG248::map_fourierConj_inf.text:
theorem map_fourierConj_inf (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (oneEAlg N N ⊓ dualOneEAlg N).map (fourierConj N : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) =
      oneEAlg N N ⊓ dualOneEAlg N

PAG249::sumSub.text:
noncomputable def sumSub (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Submodule ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :=
  Subalgebra.toSubmodule (oneEAlg N N) ⊔ Subalgebra.toSubmodule (dualOneEAlg N)

PAG249::dualOneEAlg_le.text: theorem dualOneEAlg_le (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : dualOneEAlg N ≤ shellAlg N

PAG249::sumSub_le.text: theorem sumSub_le (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : sumSub N ≤ Subalgebra.toSubmodule (shellAlg N)

PAG249::finrank_sumSub_le.text:
theorem finrank_sumSub_le (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (sumSub N) ≤ Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg N)

PAG249::sumSub_eq_iff_finrank.text:
theorem sumSub_eq_iff_finrank (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    sumSub N = Subalgebra.toSubmodule (shellAlg N) ↔
      Module.finrank ℂ (sumSub N) = Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg N)

PAG249::finrank_sumSub_add.text:
theorem finrank_sumSub_add {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : 3 ≤ N) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (sumSub N) + 3 + 2 * (if 2 ∣ N then 1 else 0) =
      N.divisors.card ^ 2 + 2 * N.divisors.card

PAG249::finrank_sumSub_eq_of_shellAlg_eq.text:
theorem finrank_sumSub_eq_of_shellAlg_eq {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (h : shellAlg N = oneEAlg N N) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (sumSub N) = Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg N)

PAG249::half_mul_succ_add_one.text: theorem half_mul_succ_add_one {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : k * (k + 1) / 2 + 1 = 2 * k + (k - 1) * (k - 2) / 2

PAG249::half_mul_succ_add_three.text: theorem half_mul_succ_add_three {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) : k * (k + 1) / 2 + 3 = 3 * k + (k - 2) * (k - 3) / 2

PAG249::finrank_sumSub_primePow_add.text:
theorem finrank_sumSub_primePow_add {p k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hk : k ≠ 0) (h3 : 3 ≤ p ^ k) [NeZero (p ^ k)] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (sumSub (p ^ k)) + 3 + 2 * (if p = 2 then 1 else 0) = (k + 1) ^ 2 + 2 * (k + 1)

PAG249::finrank_shellAlg_primePow_odd_su.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg_primePow_odd_sum {p k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (hk : k ≠ 0) [NeZero (p ^ k)] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg (p ^ k)) = Module.finrank ℂ (sumSub (p ^ k)) + (k - 1) * (k - 2) / 2

PAG249::finrank_shellAlg_two_pow_sum.text:
theorem finrank_shellAlg_two_pow_sum {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) [NeZero (2 ^ k)] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg (2 ^ k)) = Module.finrank ℂ (sumSub (2 ^ k)) + (k - 2) * (k - 3) / 2

PAG249::finrank_sumSub_lt_of_eq_primePow.text:
theorem finrank_sumSub_lt_of_eq_primePow_odd {n p k : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n = p ^ k) (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : p ≠ 2)
    (hk : 3 ≤ k) : Module.finrank ℂ (sumSub n) < Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg n)

PAG249::finrank_sumSub_lt_of_eq_two_pow.text:
theorem finrank_sumSub_lt_of_eq_two_pow {n k : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n = 2 ^ k) (hk : 4 ≤ k) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (sumSub n) < Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg n)

PAG249::finrank_sumSub_eq_of_eq_sq.text:
theorem finrank_sumSub_eq_of_eq_sq {n p : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n = p ^ 2) (hp : p.Prime) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (sumSub n) = Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg n)

PAG249::finrank_sumSub_eq_two_pow_three.text:
theorem finrank_sumSub_eq_two_pow_three [NeZero (2 ^ 3)] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (sumSub (2 ^ 3)) = Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg (2 ^ 3))

PAG249::ineq_odd.text: theorem ineq_odd {x y : ℕ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hy : 2 ≤ y) : 2 * (x * y) + x ^ 2 + 1 < x ^ 2 * y + y ^ 2 + y + 2

PAG249::ineq_two.text: theorem ineq_two {x y : ℕ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hy : 2 ≤ y) : 2 * (x * y) + x ^ 2 ≤ x ^ 2 * y + 4

PAG249::finrank_sumSub_lt_of_eq_mul.text:
theorem finrank_sumSub_lt_of_eq_mul {n p k M : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n = p ^ k * M) (hp : p.Prime) (hk : k ≠ 0)
    (hM1 : 1 < M) (hcop : Nat.Coprime (p ^ k) M) (hM2 : ¬ 2 ∣ M) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (sumSub n) < Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg n)

PAG249::finrank_sumSub_lt_shellAlg.text:
theorem finrank_sumSub_lt_shellAlg (N : ℕ) [NeZero N]
    (hN : ¬ (N = 1 ∨ N = 8 ∨ ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ (N = q ∨ N = q ^ 2))) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (sumSub N) < Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg N)

PAG249::sumSub_eq_shellAlg_iff.text:
theorem sumSub_eq_shellAlg_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    sumSub N = Subalgebra.toSubmodule (shellAlg N) ↔
      N = 1 ∨ N = 8 ∨ ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ (N = p ∨ N = p ^ 2)

PAG249::finrank_sumSub_eq_iff.text:
theorem finrank_sumSub_eq_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (sumSub N) = Module.finrank ℂ (shellAlg N) ↔
      N = 1 ∨ N = 8 ∨ ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ (N = p ∨ N = p ^ 2)

PAG249::prod_eq_sum_iff.text:
theorem prod_eq_sum_iff {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : 3 ≤ N) :
    (∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors, ((N.factorization q + 1) ^ 2 + N.factorization q * (N.factorization q + 1) / 2 -
        (if q = 2 then N.factorization q else 0))) =
      N.divisors.card ^ 2 + 2 * N.divisors.card - 3 - 2 * (if 2 ∣ N then 1 else 0) ↔
      N = 8 ∨ ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ (N = p ∨ N = p ^ 2)

PAG249::sumSub_eq_and_ne_iff.text:
theorem sumSub_eq_and_ne_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (sumSub N = Subalgebra.toSubmodule (shellAlg N) ∧ shellAlg N ≠ oneEAlg N N) ↔
      N = 8 ∨ ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p ≠ 2 ∧ N = p ^ 2

PAG250::addEAlg.text:
noncomputable def addEAlg (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) :=
  Algebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (fun u : ℕ => LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N u)) ∪
    {PAG.Part15.convL (geps N N), PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s)})

PAG250::convL_geps_mem_addEAlg.text: theorem convL_geps_mem_addEAlg (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] : PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) ∈ addEAlg N s

PAG250::oneEAlg_le_addEAlg'.text: theorem oneEAlg_le_addEAlg' (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] : oneEAlg N s ≤ addEAlg N s

PAG250::addEAlg_eq_oneEAlg.text: theorem addEAlg_eq_oneEAlg {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hs : s ∉ devSet N) : addEAlg N s = oneEAlg N N

PAG250::exists_apply_of_mem_addEAlg.text:
theorem exists_apply_of_mem_addEAlg {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] {X : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)}
    (hX : X ∈ addEAlg N s) :
    ∃ b : devSet N → ℂ, ∀ f : ZMod N → ℂ, shellAvg N f = 0 →
      (∀ u, PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) (dind N u * f) = 0) → X f = ∑ t : devSet N, b t • (dind N t * f)

PAG250::exists_apply_eq_smul_of_mem_addE.text:
theorem exists_apply_eq_smul_of_mem_addEAlg {N s : ℕ} [NeZero N] {X : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)}

    (hE : ∀ u, PAG.Part15.convL (geps N s) (dind N u * f) = 0) {a : ℕ} (ha : dind N a * f = f) :

PAG251::convL_geps_mul_self.text:
theorem convL_geps_mul_self (N s : ℕ) [NeZero N] :

PAG251::convL_geps_self_mul_mulLeft_dind.text:
theorem convL_geps_self_mul_mulLeft_dind_self (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps N N) * LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind N N) * PAG.Part15.convL (geps N N) =

PAG251::convL_geps_one_add_self_of_prime.text:
theorem convL_geps_one_add_self_of_prime {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (hq : q.Prime) :

PAG251::level_identity.text:
theorem level_identity {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (hq : q.Prime) :
    (1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps q 1)) * LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind q q) * PAG.Part15.convL (geps q 1) *
      LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind q q) * (1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps q 1)) =
      (((q : ℂ) - 1) / (q : ℂ) ^ 2) • PAG.Part15.convL (geps q q)

PAG251::two_level_identity.text:
theorem two_level_identity :
    (4 : ℂ) • ((1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps 2 2)) * LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind 2 2) * PAG.Part15.convL (geps 2 2) *
      LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind 2 2) * (1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps 2 2))) = 1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps 2 2)

theorem leftOp_mul' {a : ℕ} (b : ℕ) (S T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) :

theorem leftOp_sub' {a : ℕ} (b : ℕ) (S T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) :

PAG251::leftOp_one'.text: theorem leftOp_one' {a : ℕ} (b : ℕ) : PAG.Part232.leftOp b (1 : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) = 1

PAG251::rightOp_one'.text: theorem rightOp_one' (a : ℕ) {b : ℕ} : PAG.Part232.rightOp a (1 : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)) = 1

    PAG.Part232.rightOp a (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, PAG.Part232.rightOp a (f i)

PAG251::sandwich.text:
theorem sandwich {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (c P : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) (z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))
    (hz : z * z = z) :
    (1 - PAG.Part232.leftOp b c * PAG.Part232.rightOp a z) * PAG.Part232.leftOp b P *
      (PAG.Part232.leftOp b c * PAG.Part232.rightOp a z) * PAG.Part232.leftOp b P *
      (1 - PAG.Part232.leftOp b c * PAG.Part232.rightOp a z) =
      PAG.Part232.leftOp b ((1 - c) * P * c * P * (1 - c)) * PAG.Part232.rightOp a z

PAG251::crtConj_sum_dind.text:
theorem crtConj_sum_dind {q M : ℕ} [NeZero q] [NeZero M] (hqM : q.Coprime M) :
    PAG.Part232.crtConj hqM (∑ v ∈ M.divisors, LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind (q * M) (q * v))) =
      PAG.Part232.leftOp M (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind q q))

PAG251::convL_geps_prime_mul_aux.text:
theorem convL_geps_prime_mul_aux {q M t : ℕ} [NeZero q] [NeZero M] (hq : q.Prime) (hqM : q.Coprime M) (ht : t ∣ M) :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps (q * M) (q * t)) =
      ((q : ℂ) ^ 2 / ((q : ℂ) - 1)) • ((1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps (q * M) t)) *
        (∑ v ∈ M.divisors, LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind (q * M) (q * v))) * PAG.Part15.convL (geps (q * M) t) *
        (∑ v ∈ M.divisors, LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind (q * M) (q * v))) * (1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps (q * M) t)))

PAG251::convL_geps_prime_mul.text:
theorem convL_geps_prime_mul {n q M t : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n = q * M) (hq : q.Prime) (hqM : q.Coprime M)
    (ht : t ∣ M) :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps n (q * t)) =
      ((q : ℂ) ^ 2 / ((q : ℂ) - 1)) • ((1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps n t)) *
        (∑ v ∈ M.divisors, LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind n (q * v))) * PAG.Part15.convL (geps n t) *
        (∑ v ∈ M.divisors, LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind n (q * v))) * (1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps n t)))

PAG251::convL_geps_of_two_mul_aux.text:
theorem convL_geps_of_two_mul_aux {M t : ℕ} [NeZero M] (hM : Nat.Coprime 2 M) (ht : t ∣ M) :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps (2 * M) t) =
      (4 : ℂ) • ((1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps (2 * M) (2 * t))) *
        (∑ v ∈ M.divisors, LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind (2 * M) (2 * v))) * PAG.Part15.convL (geps (2 * M) (2 * t)) *
        (∑ v ∈ M.divisors, LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind (2 * M) (2 * v))) *
        (1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps (2 * M) (2 * t))))

PAG251::convL_geps_of_two_mul.text:
theorem convL_geps_of_two_mul {n M t : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n = 2 * M) (hM : Nat.Coprime 2 M) (ht : t ∣ M) :
    PAG.Part15.convL (geps n t) =
      (4 : ℂ) • ((1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps n (2 * t))) *
        (∑ v ∈ M.divisors, LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind n (2 * v))) * PAG.Part15.convL (geps n (2 * t)) *
        (∑ v ∈ M.divisors, LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind n (2 * v))) * (1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps n (2 * t))))

PAG253::transl_mul.text:
theorem transl_mul {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] (g h : G) :
    PAG.transl (g * h) = PAG.transl g ∘ₗ PAG.transl h

PAG253::commSubmonoid.text:
def commSubmonoid {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] (U : (G → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (G → ℂ)) : Submonoid G where
  carrier := {g | U ∘ₗ PAG.transl g = PAG.transl g ∘ₗ U}
  one_mem' := by
    show U ∘ₗ PAG.transl 1 = PAG.transl 1 ∘ₗ U
    rw [transl_one, LinearMap.comp_id, LinearMap.id_comp]
  mul_mem' := by
    intro g h hg hh
    have hg' : U ∘ₗ PAG.transl g = PAG.transl g ∘ₗ U := hg
    have hh' : U ∘ₗ PAG.transl h = PAG.transl h ∘ₗ U := hh
    show U ∘ₗ PAG.transl (g * h) = PAG.transl (g * h) ∘ₗ U
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro f
    have e1 := LinearMap.congr_fun hg' (PAG.transl h f)
    have e2 := LinearMap.congr_fun hh' f
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at e1 e2
    simp only [transl_mul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [e1, e2]

PAG253::commute_transl_of_prime.text:
theorem commute_transl_of_prime {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (U : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ))
    (hU : ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpN : p.Coprime N),
      U ∘ₗ PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) = PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) ∘ₗ U)
    (g : (ZMod N)ˣ) : U ∘ₗ PAG.transl g = PAG.transl g ∘ₗ U

PAG253::eigen_of_commute_prime.text:
theorem eigen_of_commute_prime {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (U : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ))
    (hU : ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpN : p.Coprime N),
      U ∘ₗ PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) = PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) ∘ₗ U)
    (χ : (ZMod N)ˣ →* ℂˣ) : ∃ c : ℂ, U (PAG.charFun χ) = c • PAG.charFun χ

PAG253::eigenFun_of_commute_prime.text:
theorem eigenFun_of_commute_prime {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (U : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ))
    (hU : ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpN : p.Coprime N),
      U ∘ₗ PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) = PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) ∘ₗ U) :
    ∃ c : ((ZMod N)ˣ →* ℂˣ) → ℂ, (∀ χ, U (PAG.charFun χ) = c χ • PAG.charFun χ) ∧
      ((∀ χ, ‖c χ‖ = 1) → (∀ χ, c χ⁻¹ = starRingEnd ℂ (c χ)) → ∀ χ, χ⁻¹ = χ → c χ = 1 ∨ c χ = -1)

PAG253::exists_cls_near.text:
theorem exists_cls_near {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (t : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (m n : ℕ) (hm : m.Coprime N) (hn : n.Coprime N), 0 < m ∧ 0 < n ∧
      kUnit m hm * (kUnit n hn)⁻¹ = a ∧ |Real.log n - Real.log m - t| < ε

PAG253::exists_cls_near_of_dvd.text:
