    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (m n : ℕ) (hm : m.Coprime M) (hn : n.Coprime M), 0 < m ∧ 0 < n ∧
      kUnit m (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right hNM hm) * (kUnit n (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right hNM hn))⁻¹ = a ∧
      |Real.log n - Real.log m - t| < ε

PAG253::invariant_kUnit.text:
theorem invariant_kUnit {N M : ℕ} (hNM : N ∣ M) (f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ)
    (hinv : ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpM : p.Coprime M) (k : (ZMod N)ˣ) (u : ℝ),
      f (k * kUnit p (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right hNM hpM)) (u - Real.log p) = f k u) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : n.Coprime M), 0 < n → ∀ (k : (ZMod N)ˣ) (u : ℝ),
      f (k * kUnit n (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right hNM hn)) (u - Real.log n) = f k u

PAG253::invariant_cls.text:
theorem invariant_cls {N M : ℕ} (hNM : N ∣ M) (f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ)
    (hinv : ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpM : p.Coprime M) (k : (ZMod N)ˣ) (u : ℝ),
      f (k * kUnit p (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right hNM hpM)) (u - Real.log p) = f k u)
    {m n : ℕ} (hm : m.Coprime M) (hn : n.Coprime M) (hm0 : 0 < m) (hn0 : 0 < n) (k : (ZMod N)ˣ) (u : ℝ) :
    f (k * (kUnit m (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right hNM hm) * (kUnit n (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right hNM hn))⁻¹))
      (u + (Real.log n - Real.log m)) = f k u

PAG253::eq_of_prime_invariant.text:
theorem eq_of_prime_invariant {N M : ℕ} [NeZero N] [NeZero M] (hNM : N ∣ M) (f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ)
    (hf : ∀ k, Continuous (f k))
    (hinv : ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpM : p.Coprime M) (k : (ZMod N)ˣ) (u : ℝ),
      f (k * kUnit p (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right hNM hpM)) (u - Real.log p) = f k u)
    (k₁ k₂ : (ZMod N)ˣ) (u₁ u₂ : ℝ) : f k₁ u₁ = f k₂ u₂

PAG253::eq_of_prime_invariant'.text:
theorem eq_of_prime_invariant' {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ) (hf : ∀ k, Continuous (f k))
    (hinv : ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpN : p.Coprime N) (k : (ZMod N)ˣ) (u : ℝ),
      f (k * kUnit p hpN) (u - Real.log p) = f k u)
    (k₁ k₂ : (ZMod N)ˣ) (u₁ u₂ : ℝ) : f k₁ u₁ = f k₂ u₂

PAG253::eq_of_euler.text:
theorem eq_of_euler {N M : ℕ} [NeZero N] [NeZero M] (hNM : N ∣ M) (χ₁ χ₂ : (ZMod N)ˣ →* ℂˣ) (l₁ l₂ : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpM : p.Coprime M),
      (χ₁ (kUnit p (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right hNM hpM)) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (-((l₁ * Real.log p : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
        (χ₂ (kUnit p (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right hNM hpM)) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (-((l₂ * Real.log p : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :
    χ₁ = χ₂ ∧ l₁ = l₂

PAG253::primeShift.text:
noncomputable def primeShift {N : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Coprime N) (F : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ) : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ :=
  fun k u => F (k * kUnit p hp) (u - Real.log p)

PAG253::primeShiftInv.text:
noncomputable def primeShiftInv {N : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Coprime N) (F : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ) : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ :=
  fun k u => F (k * (kUnit p hp)⁻¹) (u + Real.log p)

PAG253::globalInv.text: def globalInv {N : ℕ} (F : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ) : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ := fun k u => F k⁻¹ (-u)

PAG253::scaleShift.text: def scaleShift {N : ℕ} (s : ℝ) (F : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ) : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ := fun k u => F k (u + s)

PAG253::unitShift.text: def unitShift {N : ℕ} (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (F : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ) : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ := fun k u => F (k * a) u

PAG253::primeShift_eq.text:
theorem primeShift_eq {N : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Coprime N) (F : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ) :
    primeShift p hp F = unitShift (kUnit p hp) (scaleShift (-Real.log p) F)

PAG253::unitShift_scaleShift.text:
theorem unitShift_scaleShift {N : ℕ} (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (s : ℝ) (F : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ) :
    unitShift a (scaleShift s F) = scaleShift s (unitShift a F)

PAG253::primeShift_primeShiftInv.text:
theorem primeShift_primeShiftInv {N : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Coprime N) (F : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ) :
    primeShift p hp (primeShiftInv p hp F) = F

PAG253::globalInv_globalInv.text: theorem globalInv_globalInv {N : ℕ} (F : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ) : globalInv (globalInv F) = F

PAG253::globalInv_primeShift_globalInv.text:
theorem globalInv_primeShift_globalInv {N : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Coprime N) (F : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ) :
    globalInv (primeShift p hp (globalInv F)) = primeShiftInv p hp F

PAG253::globalInv_scaleShift_globalInv.text:
theorem globalInv_scaleShift_globalInv {N : ℕ} (s : ℝ) (F : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ) :
    globalInv (scaleShift s (globalInv F)) = scaleShift (-s) F

PAG253::primeShift_scaleShift.text:
theorem primeShift_scaleShift {N : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Coprime N) (s : ℝ) (F : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ) :
    primeShift p hp (scaleShift s F) = scaleShift s (primeShift p hp F)

PAG253::ipG.text: noncomputable def ipG {G : Type*} [Fintype G] (f g : G → ℂ) : ℂ := ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (f x) * g x

PAG253::ipG_smul_left.text:
theorem ipG_smul_left {G : Type*} [Fintype G] (a : ℂ) (f g : G → ℂ) :
    ipG (a • f) g = starRingEnd ℂ a * ipG f g

PAG253::ipG_smul_right.text:
theorem ipG_smul_right {G : Type*} [Fintype G] (a : ℂ) (f g : G → ℂ) :
    ipG f (a • g) = a * ipG f g

PAG253::ipG_charFun_self_ne_zero.text:
theorem ipG_charFun_self_ne_zero {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] [Fintype G] (χ : G →* ℂˣ) :
    ipG (PAG.charFun χ) (PAG.charFun χ) ≠ 0

PAG253::conj_eigen_of_adjoint.text:
theorem conj_eigen_of_adjoint {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] [Fintype G] (U : (G → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (G → ℂ))
    (hadj : ∀ f g, ipG (PAG.rev (U (PAG.rev f))) g = ipG f (U g)) (c : (G →* ℂˣ) → ℂ)
    (hc : ∀ χ, U (PAG.charFun χ) = c χ • PAG.charFun χ) (χ : G →* ℂˣ) :
    c χ⁻¹ = starRingEnd ℂ (c χ)

PAG253::thm26_full_of_commute.text:
theorem thm26_full_of_commute {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] [Fintype G] (U : (G → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (G → ℂ))
    (hU : ∀ h, U ∘ₗ PAG.transl h = PAG.transl h ∘ₗ U)
    (hiso : ∀ f g, ipG (U f) (U g) = ipG f g)
    (hadj : ∀ f g, ipG (PAG.rev (U (PAG.rev f))) g = ipG f (U g)) :
    ∃ c : (G →* ℂˣ) → ℂ, (∀ χ, U (PAG.charFun χ) = c χ • PAG.charFun χ) ∧ (∀ χ, ‖c χ‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ χ, c χ⁻¹ = starRingEnd ℂ (c χ)) ∧ (∀ χ, χ⁻¹ = χ → c χ = 1 ∨ c χ = -1)

PAG253::thm26_full.text:
theorem thm26_full {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (U : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ))
    (hU : ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpN : p.Coprime N),
      U ∘ₗ PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) = PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) ∘ₗ U)
    (hiso : ∀ f g, ipG (U f) (U g) = ipG f g)
    (hadj : ∀ f g, ipG (PAG.rev (U (PAG.rev f))) g = ipG f (U g)) :
    ∃ c : ((ZMod N)ˣ →* ℂˣ) → ℂ, (∀ χ, U (PAG.charFun χ) = c χ • PAG.charFun χ) ∧ (∀ χ, ‖c χ‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ χ, c χ⁻¹ = starRingEnd ℂ (c χ)) ∧ (∀ χ, χ⁻¹ = χ → c χ = 1 ∨ c χ = -1)

PAG253::transl_isometry.text:
theorem transl_isometry {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] [Fintype G] (h : G) (f g : G → ℂ) :
    ipG (PAG.transl h f) (PAG.transl h g) = ipG f g

PAG253::transl_adjoint.text:
theorem transl_adjoint {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] [Fintype G] (h : G) (f g : G → ℂ) :
    ipG (PAG.rev (PAG.transl h (PAG.rev f))) g = ipG f (PAG.transl h g)

PAG253::thm26_full_hyp_transl.text:
theorem thm26_full_hyp_transl {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (h : (ZMod N)ˣ) :
    (∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpN : p.Coprime N),
      PAG.transl h ∘ₗ PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) = PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) ∘ₗ PAG.transl h) ∧
    (∀ f g, ipG (PAG.transl h f) (PAG.transl h g) = ipG f g) ∧
    (∀ f g, ipG (PAG.rev (PAG.transl h (PAG.rev f))) g = ipG f (PAG.transl h g))

PAG253::transl_charFun.text:
theorem transl_charFun {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] (h : G) (χ : G →* ℂˣ) :
    PAG.transl h (PAG.charFun χ) = ((χ h : ℂˣ) : ℂ) • PAG.charFun χ

PAG253::thm26_needs_adjoint.text:
theorem thm26_needs_adjoint {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] :
    (∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpN : p.Coprime N),
      (Complex.I • LinearMap.id : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ)) ∘ₗ PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) =
        PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) ∘ₗ (Complex.I • LinearMap.id)) ∧
    (∀ f g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ, ipG ((Complex.I • LinearMap.id : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ)) f)
        ((Complex.I • LinearMap.id : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ)) g) = ipG f g) ∧
    ¬ ∃ c : ((ZMod N)ˣ →* ℂˣ) → ℂ,
      (∀ χ, (Complex.I • LinearMap.id : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ)) (PAG.charFun χ) =
        c χ • PAG.charFun χ) ∧ (∀ χ, c χ⁻¹ = starRingEnd ℂ (c χ))

PAG253::thm26_needs_isometry.text:
theorem thm26_needs_isometry {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] :
    (∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpN : p.Coprime N),
      ((2 : ℂ) • LinearMap.id : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ)) ∘ₗ PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) =
        PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) ∘ₗ ((2 : ℂ) • LinearMap.id)) ∧
    (∀ f g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ,
      ipG (PAG.rev (((2 : ℂ) • LinearMap.id : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ)) (PAG.rev f))) g =
        ipG f (((2 : ℂ) • LinearMap.id : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ)) g)) ∧
    ¬ ∃ c : ((ZMod N)ˣ →* ℂˣ) → ℂ,
      (∀ χ, ((2 : ℂ) • LinearMap.id : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ)) (PAG.charFun χ) =
        c χ • PAG.charFun χ) ∧ (∀ χ, ‖c χ‖ = 1)

PAG253::shift_invariant_of_prime_invaria.text:
theorem shift_invariant_of_prime_invariant {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (F : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℝ → ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ k, Continuous (F k))
    (hinv : ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpN : p.Coprime N), primeShift p hpN F = F)
    (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (s : ℝ) : unitShift a F = F ∧ scaleShift s F = F

PAG253::signMul.text:
noncomputable def signMul {G : Type*} [Group G] [DecidableEq G] : (G → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (G → ℂ) where
  toFun f g := (if g = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else -1) * f g
  map_add' f g := by
    funext x
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    ring
  map_smul' c f := by
    funext x
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
    ring

PAG253::signMul_apply.text:
theorem signMul_apply {G : Type*} [Group G] [DecidableEq G] (f : G → ℂ) (g : G) :
    signMul f g = (if g = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else -1) * f g

PAG253::signMul_isometry.text:
theorem signMul_isometry {G : Type*} [Group G] [DecidableEq G] [Fintype G] (f g : G → ℂ) :
    ipG (signMul f) (signMul g) = ipG f g

PAG253::signMul_adjoint.text:
theorem signMul_adjoint {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] [DecidableEq G] [Fintype G] (f g : G → ℂ) :
    ipG (PAG.rev (signMul (PAG.rev f))) g = ipG f (signMul g)

PAG253::thm26_needs_commute.text:
theorem thm26_needs_commute {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : 3 ≤ N) :
    (∀ f g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ, ipG (signMul f) (signMul g) = ipG f g) ∧
    (∀ f g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ, ipG (PAG.rev (signMul (PAG.rev f))) g = ipG f (signMul g)) ∧
    ¬ ∃ c : ((ZMod N)ˣ →* ℂˣ) → ℂ, ∀ χ, signMul (PAG.charFun χ) = c χ • PAG.charFun χ

PAG253::signMul_not_commute.text:
theorem signMul_not_commute {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : 3 ≤ N) :
    ¬ ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpN : p.Coprime N),
      (signMul : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ)) ∘ₗ PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) =
        PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) ∘ₗ signMul

PAG254::logSet.text: def logSet : Set ℝ := {x | ∃ q : ℚ, 0 < q ∧ x = Real.log q}

PAG254::log_inj.text: theorem log_inj {q r : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) (h : Real.log q = Real.log r) : q = r

PAG254::not_Icc_subset_logSet.text: theorem not_Icc_subset_logSet {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) : ¬ Set.Icc a b ⊆ logSet

PAG254::subsingleton_of_isPreconnected.text:
theorem subsingleton_of_isPreconnected {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsPreconnected S) (hSL : S ⊆ logSet) :
    S.Subsingleton

PAG254::chainIn.text:
def chainIn {α : Type*} (S : Set α) (d : α → α → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (x y : α) : Prop :=
  ∃ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → α), c 0 = x ∧ c n = y ∧ (∀ i, i ≤ n → c i ∈ S) ∧ ∀ i, i < n → d (c i) (c (i + 1)) < ε

PAG254::chainIn_refl.text:
theorem chainIn_refl {α : Type*} {S : Set α} (d : α → α → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) {x : α} (hx : x ∈ S) :
    chainIn S d ε x x

PAG254::chainIn_mono.text:
theorem chainIn_mono {α : Type*} {S : Set α} {d : α → α → ℝ} {ε ε' : ℝ} (h : ε ≤ ε') {x y : α}
    (hc : chainIn S d ε x y) : chainIn S d ε' x y

PAG254::chainIn_of_lt.text:
theorem chainIn_of_lt {α : Type*} {S : Set α} {d : α → α → ℝ} {ε : ℝ} {x y : α} (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S)
    (h : d x y < ε) : chainIn S d ε x y

PAG254::chainIn_invariant.text:
theorem chainIn_invariant {α β : Type*} {S : Set α} {d : α → α → ℝ} {ε : ℝ} (f : α → β)
    (hf : ∀ x y, x ∈ S → y ∈ S → d x y < ε → f x = f y) {x y : α} (hc : chainIn S d ε x y) :
    f x = f y

PAG254::dInf.text: noncomputable def dInf (q r : ℚ) : ℝ := |Real.log q - Real.log r|

PAG254::dInf_mul_left.text:
theorem dInf_mul_left {s q r : ℚ} (hs : 0 < s) (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) :
    dInf (s * q) (s * r) = dInf q r

PAG254::abs_log_sub_log_le.text:
theorem abs_log_sub_log_le {x y m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hx : m ≤ x) (hy : m ≤ y) :
    |Real.log x - Real.log y| ≤ |x - y| / m

PAG254::chainIn_dInf.text:
theorem chainIn_dInf {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {q r : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) :
    chainIn posRat dInf ε q r

PAG254::primePow.text: def primePow (p : ℕ) : Set ℚ := {q | ∃ k : ℤ, q = (p : ℚ) ^ k}

PAG254::dInf_zpow.text:
theorem dInf_zpow {p : ℕ} (a b : ℤ) :
    dInf ((p : ℚ) ^ a) ((p : ℚ) ^ b) = |((a - b : ℤ) : ℝ)| * |Real.log p|

PAG254::eq_of_chainIn_primePow.text:
theorem eq_of_chainIn_primePow {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) {ε : ℝ} (hε : ε ≤ Real.log p) {x y : ℚ}
    (hc : chainIn (primePow p) dInf ε x y) : x = y

PAG254::dense_closure_log_two_three.text:
theorem dense_closure_log_two_three :
    Dense ((AddSubgroup.closure ({Real.log 2, Real.log 3} : Set ℝ) : AddSubgroup ℝ) : Set ℝ)

PAG254::dP.text: noncomputable def dP (p : ℕ) (q r : ℚ) : ℝ := |((padicValRat p q - padicValRat p r : ℤ) : ℝ)|

PAG254::dP_mul_left.text:
theorem dP_mul_left (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] {s q r : ℚ} (hs : s ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    dP p (s * q) (s * r) = dP p q r

PAG254::dP_lt_one_iff.text: theorem dP_lt_one_iff (p : ℕ) (q r : ℚ) : dP p q r < 1 ↔ padicValRat p q = padicValRat p r

PAG254::padicValRat_eq_of_chainIn.text:
theorem padicValRat_eq_of_chainIn (p : ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : ε ≤ 1) {q r : ℚ}
    (hc : chainIn posRat (dP p) ε q r) : padicValRat p q = padicValRat p r

PAG254::chainIn_dP_iff.text:
theorem chainIn_dP_iff (p : ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε : ε ≤ 1) {q r : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) :
    chainIn posRat (dP p) ε q r ↔ padicValRat p q = padicValRat p r

PAG254::exists_padicValRat_eq.text:
theorem exists_padicValRat_eq (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℤ) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, 0 < q ∧ padicValRat p q = k

PAG254::chainIn_dP_of_one_lt.text:
theorem chainIn_dP_of_one_lt (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] {ε : ℝ} (hε : 1 < ε) {q r : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) :
    chainIn posRat (dP p) ε q r

PAG254::chainIn_dP_classification.text:
theorem chainIn_dP_classification (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) {q r : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) :
    chainIn posRat (dP p) ε q r ↔ (ε ≤ 1 → padicValRat p q = padicValRat p r)

PAG254::emergence_contrast.text:
theorem emergence_contrast :
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ q r : ℚ, 0 < q → 0 < r → chainIn posRat dInf ε q r) ∧
    (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ¬ chainIn posRat (dP p) 1 1 (p : ℚ))

PAG254::dense_logSet_coprime.text:
theorem dense_logSet_coprime {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (t : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (m n : ℕ), 0 < m ∧ 0 < n ∧ m.Coprime N ∧ n.Coprime N ∧ |Real.log n - Real.log m - t| < ε

PAG254::dInf_eq_dist.text: theorem dInf_eq_dist (q r : ℚ) : dInf q r = dist (Real.log q) (Real.log r)

PAG254::dP_eq_dist.text:
theorem dP_eq_dist (p : ℕ) (q r : ℚ) :
    dP p q r = dist ((padicValRat p q : ℤ) : ℝ) ((padicValRat p r : ℤ) : ℝ)

PAG254::half_le_abs_padicValRat_sub_half.text:
theorem half_le_abs_padicValRat_sub_half (p : ℕ) (q : ℚ) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ |((padicValRat p q : ℤ) : ℝ) - 1 / 2|

PAG254::not_forall_chainIn_dP.text:
theorem not_forall_chainIn_dP (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    ¬ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ q r : ℚ, 0 < q → 0 < r → chainIn posRat (dP p) ε q r

PAG255::pow_dvd_pow_factorial.text:
theorem pow_dvd_pow_factorial {p a M' N K : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hN : N = p ^ a * M') (hN0 : 0 < N)
    (hK : N ≤ K) : p ^ a ∣ p ^ K !

PAG255::pow_factorial_modEq_one.text:
theorem pow_factorial_modEq_one {p a M' N K : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hN : N = p ^ a * M') (hpM : ¬ p ∣ M')
    (hN0 : 0 < N) (hK : N ≤ K) : p ^ K ! ≡ 1 [MOD M']

PAG255::pow_factorial_modEq.text:
theorem pow_factorial_modEq {p N K : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hN0 : 0 < N) (hK : N ≤ K) :
    p ^ K ! ≡ p ^ N ! [MOD N]

PAG255::wNat.text: def wNat (p N : ℕ) : ℕ := 1 + p ^ N ! * (p - 1)

PAG255::wNat_coprime.text: theorem wNat_coprime {p N : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hN0 : 0 < N) : (wNat p N).Coprime N

PAG255::wNat_cast_eq.text:
theorem wNat_cast_eq {p N K : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hN0 : 0 < N) (hK : N ≤ K) :
    ((wNat p K : ℕ) : ZMod N) = ((wNat p N : ℕ) : ZMod N)

PAG255::wNat_cast_of_coprime.text:
theorem wNat_cast_of_coprime {p N : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hN0 : 0 < N) (hpN : p.Coprime N) :
    ((wNat p N : ℕ) : ZMod N) = (p : ZMod N)

PAG255::kUnit_congr.text:
theorem kUnit_congr {N : ℕ} {m n : ℕ} (hm : m.Coprime N) (hn : n.Coprime N)
    (h : (m : ZMod N) = (n : ZMod N)) : kUnit m hm = kUnit n hn

PAG255::unitSys.text:
def unitSys : Subgroup (∀ N : ℕ+, (ZMod (N : ℕ))ˣ) where
  carrier := {a | ∀ (N M : ℕ+) (h : (N : ℕ) ∣ (M : ℕ)), ZMod.unitsMap h (a M) = a N}
  mul_mem' := by
    intro a b ha hb N M h
    rw [Pi.mul_apply, map_mul, ha N M h, hb N M h, Pi.mul_apply]
  one_mem' := by
    intro N M h
    rw [Pi.one_apply, map_one, Pi.one_apply]
  inv_mem' := by
    intro a ha N M h
    rw [Pi.inv_apply, map_inv, ha N M h, Pi.inv_apply]

PAG255::primeCls.text:
def primeCls (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (N : ℕ+) : (ZMod (N : ℕ))ˣ :=
  kUnit (wNat p N) (wNat_coprime hp N.pos)

PAG255::primeCls_of_coprime.text:
theorem primeCls_of_coprime (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (N : ℕ+) (hpN : p.Coprime N) :
    primeCls p hp N = kUnit p hpN

PAG255::primeCls_mem.text: theorem primeCls_mem (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : (fun N => primeCls p hp N) ∈ unitSys

PAG255::primeSys.text: def primeSys (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : unitSys := ⟨fun N => primeCls p hp N, primeCls_mem p hp⟩

PAG255::unitsMap_primeCls_pow.text:
theorem unitsMap_primeCls_pow (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (N : ℕ+) {a : ℕ} (h : p ^ a ∣ (N : ℕ)) :
    ZMod.unitsMap h (primeCls p hp N) = 1

PAG255::primeGens.text:
noncomputable def primeGens (L : ℕ) : Set (unitSys × Multiplicative ℝ) :=
  {g | ∃ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime), ¬ p ∣ L ∧ g = (primeSys p hp, Multiplicative.ofAdd (-Real.log p))}

PAG255::exists_mem_closure_level.text:
theorem exists_mem_closure_level {L : ℕ} (N : ℕ+) (hL : L ∣ (N : ℕ)) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ), 0 < m → ∀ (hm : m.Coprime N), ∃ g ∈ Subgroup.closure (primeGens L),
      (g.1 : ∀ N : ℕ+, (ZMod (N : ℕ))ˣ) N = kUnit m hm ∧ g.2 = Multiplicative.ofAdd (-Real.log m)

PAG255::exists_level.text:
theorem exists_level {u : Set unitSys} (hu : IsOpen u) {a : unitSys} (ha : a ∈ u) :
    ∃ N : ℕ+, ∀ b : unitSys, (b : ∀ N : ℕ+, (ZMod (N : ℕ))ˣ) N = (a : ∀ N : ℕ+, (ZMod (N : ℕ))ˣ) N → b ∈ u

PAG255::dense_closure_primeGens.text:
theorem dense_closure_primeGens (L : ℕ+) :
    Dense ((Subgroup.closure (primeGens L) : Subgroup (unitSys × Multiplicative ℝ)) :
      Set (unitSys × Multiplicative ℝ))

PAG255::dense_closure_allPrimes.text:
theorem dense_closure_allPrimes :
    Dense ((Subgroup.closure (primeGens 1) : Subgroup (unitSys × Multiplicative ℝ)) :
      Set (unitSys × Multiplicative ℝ))

PAG255::units_eq_of_coprime_parts.text:
theorem units_eq_of_coprime_parts {N A B : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : N = A * B) (hAB : A.Coprime B)
    (hA : A ∣ N) (hB : B ∣ N) (b c : (ZMod N)ˣ)
    (h1 : ZMod.unitsMap hA b = ZMod.unitsMap hA c) (h2 : ZMod.unitsMap hB b = ZMod.unitsMap hB c) :
    b = c

PAG255::primeSys_unique.text:
theorem primeSys_unique (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (a : unitSys)
    (h1 : ∀ (N : ℕ+) (hpN : p.Coprime N), (a : ∀ N : ℕ+, (ZMod (N : ℕ))ˣ) N = kUnit p hpN)
    (h2 : ∀ (N : ℕ+) (k : ℕ) (h : p ^ k ∣ (N : ℕ)),
      ZMod.unitsMap h ((a : ∀ N : ℕ+, (ZMod (N : ℕ))ˣ) N) = 1) :
    a = primeSys p hp

PAG256::casKer.text:
noncomputable def casKer (t : ZMod N) : ℂ :=
  ((Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * t.val / N) + Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * t.val / N) : ℝ) : ℂ)

PAG256::hartley.text:
noncomputable def hartley (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (y : ZMod N) : ℂ :=
  ∑ x : ZMod N, f x * casKer (x * y)

PAG256::casKer_eq.text:
theorem casKer_eq (t : ZMod N) :
    casKer t = ((1 - I) * stdAddChar t + (1 + I) * stdAddChar (-t)) / 2

PAG256::parFac.text: noncomputable def parFac (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : ℂ := ((1 - I) + (1 + I) * χ (-1)) / 2

PAG256::parFac_of_even.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
theorem parFac_of_even {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (h : χ.Even) : parFac χ = 1

PAG256::parFac_of_odd.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
theorem parFac_of_odd {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (h : χ.Odd) : parFac χ = -I

PAG256::inv_apply_neg_one.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
theorem inv_apply_neg_one (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : χ⁻¹ (-1) = χ (-1)

PAG256::sum_mul_stdAddChar.text:
theorem sum_mul_stdAddChar (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (y : ZMod N) :
    ∑ x : ZMod N, χ x * stdAddChar (x * y) = gaussSum χ (stdAddChar.mulShift y)

PAG256::hartley_eq_of_isPrimitive.text:
theorem hartley_eq_of_isPrimitive {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (y : ZMod N) :
    hartley (χ : ZMod N → ℂ) y = parFac χ * gaussSum χ stdAddChar * χ⁻¹ y

PAG256::hartley_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit.text:
theorem hartley_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    {y : ZMod N} (hy : ¬IsUnit y) : hartley (χ : ZMod N → ℂ) y = 0

PAG256::rootNum.text:
open Classical in
noncomputable def rootNum (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : ℂ :=
  gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((if χ.Even then (1 : ℂ) else I) * (Real.sqrt N : ℂ))

PAG256::rootNum_eq.text:
theorem rootNum_eq (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    rootNum χ = parFac χ * gaussSum χ stdAddChar / (Real.sqrt N : ℂ)

PAG256::JH.text:
noncomputable def JH (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) : ℂ :=
  hartley f ((u⁻¹ : (ZMod N)ˣ) : ZMod N) / (Real.sqrt N : ℂ)

PAG256::inv_apply_units_inv.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
theorem inv_apply_units_inv (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) :
    χ⁻¹ ((u⁻¹ : (ZMod N)ˣ) : ZMod N) = χ u

PAG256::JH_eq_rootNum_mul.text:
theorem JH_eq_rootNum_mul {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) :
    JH (χ : ZMod N → ℂ) u = rootNum χ * χ u

PAG256::normSq_rootNum.text:
theorem normSq_rootNum {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    Complex.normSq (rootNum χ) = 1

PAG256::hartley_units_inv.text:
theorem hartley_units_inv (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) :
    hartley (χ : ZMod N → ℂ) ((u⁻¹ : (ZMod N)ˣ) : ZMod N) = χ u * hartley (χ : ZMod N → ℂ) 1

PAG256::neg_one_mul_self.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
theorem neg_one_mul_self (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : χ (-1) * χ (-1) = 1

PAG256::sum_mul_stdAddChar_neg.text:
theorem sum_mul_stdAddChar_neg (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    ∑ x : ZMod N, χ x * stdAddChar (-x) = χ (-1) * gaussSum χ stdAddChar

PAG256::hartley_one.text:
theorem hartley_one (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    hartley (χ : ZMod N → ℂ) 1 = parFac χ * gaussSum χ stdAddChar

PAG256::JH_eq_rootNum_mul_any.text:
theorem JH_eq_rootNum_mul_any (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) :
    JH (χ : ZMod N → ℂ) u = rootNum χ * χ u

PAG256::isPrimitive_of_prime_of_ne_one.text:
theorem isPrimitive_of_prime_of_ne_one {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p}
    (h : χ ≠ 1) : χ.IsPrimitive

PAG256::exists_primitive_odd_three.text: theorem exists_primitive_odd_three : ∃ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 3, χ.IsPrimitive ∧ χ.Odd

PAG256::exists_primitive_even_five.text:
theorem exists_primitive_even_five :
    ∃ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 5, χ.IsPrimitive ∧ χ.Even ∧ χ ≠ 1

PAG256::removal_counterexample.text:
theorem removal_counterexample :
    ¬(1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 2).IsPrimitive ∧ ¬IsUnit (0 : ZMod 2) ∧
      hartley ((1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 2) : ZMod 2 → ℂ) 0 = 1

PAG256::removal_counterexample_four.text:
theorem removal_counterexample_four :
    (∃ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ 2), χ.IsPrimitive) ∧
    ¬(1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 4).IsPrimitive ∧ ¬IsUnit (2 : ZMod 4) ∧
      hartley ((1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 4) : ZMod 4 → ℂ) 2 = -2 ∧
      Complex.normSq (rootNum (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 4)) = 0

PAG257::extL.text:
open Classical in
noncomputable def extL : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun g x := if h : IsUnit x then g h.unit else 0
  map_add' f g := by
    funext x
    by_cases h : IsUnit x <;> simp [h]
  map_smul' c f := by
    funext x
    by_cases h : IsUnit x <;> simp [h]

PAG257::extL_apply.text:
open Classical in
theorem extL_apply (g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) (x : ZMod N) :
    extL g x = if h : IsUnit x then g h.unit else 0

PAG257::JHL.text:
noncomputable def JHL : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) where
  toFun f := JH f
  map_add' f g := by
    funext u
    show JH (f + g) u = JH f u + JH g u
    unfold JH hartley
    rw [← add_div, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => by rw [Pi.add_apply, add_mul])
  map_smul' c f := by
    funext u
    show JH (c • f) u = c * JH f u
    unfold JH hartley
    rw [mul_div_assoc', Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => by rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc])

PAG257::TopL.text: noncomputable def TopL : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) := JHL.comp extL

PAG257::charU.text: def charU (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ := fun u => χ u

PAG257::extL_charU.text: theorem extL_charU (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : extL (charU χ) = (χ : ZMod N → ℂ)

PAG257::TopL_charU.text: theorem TopL_charU (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : TopL (charU χ) = rootNum χ • charU χ

PAG257::ip.text: noncomputable def ip (f g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) : ℂ := ∑ u, (starRingEnd ℂ) (f u) * g u

PAG257::ip_smul_smul.text:
theorem ip_smul_smul (a b : ℂ) (f g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) :
    ip (a • f) (b • g) = (starRingEnd ℂ) a * b * ip f g

PAG257::ip_sum_sum.text:
theorem ip_sum_sum {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (a : ι → ℂ) (v : ι → (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ)
    (b : κ → ℂ) (w : κ → (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) :
    ip (N := N) (∑ i, a i • v i) (∑ j, b j • w j) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (starRingEnd ℂ) (a i) * b j * ip (v i) (w j)

PAG257::ip_charU.text:
open Classical in
theorem ip_charU (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    ip (charU χ) (charU ψ) = if χ = ψ then (Nat.totient N : ℂ) else 0

PAG257::Vprim.text:
noncomputable def Vprim (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Submodule ℂ ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) :=
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun χ : {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N // χ.IsPrimitive} => charU χ.1)

PAG257::Vimprim.text:
noncomputable def Vimprim (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Submodule ℂ ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) :=
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun χ : {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N // ¬χ.IsPrimitive} => charU χ.1)

PAG257::TopL_mem_Vprim.text: theorem TopL_mem_Vprim {f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ Vprim N) : TopL f ∈ Vprim N

PAG257::TopL_mem_Vimprim.text: theorem TopL_mem_Vimprim {f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ Vimprim N) : TopL f ∈ Vimprim N

PAG257::rootNum_ne_zero.text: theorem rootNum_ne_zero {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : rootNum χ ≠ 0

PAG257::map_TopL_Vprim.text: theorem map_TopL_Vprim : (Vprim N).map TopL = Vprim N

PAG257::ip_TopL_charU_prim.text:
theorem ip_TopL_charU_prim {χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    ip (TopL (charU χ)) (TopL (charU ψ)) = ip (charU χ) (charU ψ)

PAG257::ip_TopL_of_mem_Vprim.text:
theorem ip_TopL_of_mem_Vprim {f g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ Vprim N) (hg : g ∈ Vprim N) :
    ip (TopL f) (TopL g) = ip f g

PAG257::TopL_eq_of_A1.text:
theorem TopL_eq_of_A1 (U : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ))
    (hU : ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N, χ.IsPrimitive → U (charU χ) = rootNum χ • charU χ)
    {f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ Vprim N) : U f = TopL f

PAG257::ip_Vprim_Vimprim.text:
theorem ip_Vprim_Vimprim {f g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ Vprim N) (hg : g ∈ Vimprim N) :
    ip f g = 0

PAG257::ip_sum_right.text:
theorem ip_sum_right {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) (b : κ → ℂ)
    (w : κ → (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) : ip (N := N) f (∑ j, b j • w j) = ∑ j, b j * ip f (w j)

PAG257::linearIndependent_charU.text:
theorem linearIndependent_charU :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N => charU χ)

PAG257::span_charU_eq_top.text:
theorem span_charU_eq_top :
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N => charU χ) = ⊤

PAG257::Vprim_sup_Vimprim.text: theorem Vprim_sup_Vimprim : Vprim N ⊔ Vimprim N = ⊤

PAG257::eq_zero_of_ip_self.text: theorem eq_zero_of_ip_self (f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) (h : ip f f = 0) : f = 0

PAG257::Vprim_inf_Vimprim.text: theorem Vprim_inf_Vimprim : Vprim N ⊓ Vimprim N = ⊥

PAG257::not_isometry_Vimprim_two.text: theorem not_isometry_Vimprim_two : ∃ f ∈ Vimprim 2, ip (TopL f) (TopL f) ≠ ip f f

PAG257::TopL_charU_one_four.text:
theorem TopL_charU_one_four :
    TopL (charU (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 4)) = 0 ∧ charU (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 4) ≠ 0

PAG257::unitary_Vprim.text:
theorem unitary_Vprim : ∃ e : Vprim N ≃ₗ[ℂ] Vprim N,
    (∀ f : Vprim N, ((e f : Vprim N) : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) = TopL (f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ)) ∧
    ∀ f g : Vprim N, ip ((e f : Vprim N) : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) ((e g : Vprim N) : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) =
      ip (f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) (g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ)

PAG257::gaussSum_one_prime.text:
theorem gaussSum_one_prime (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    gaussSum (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) (stdAddChar (N := p)) = -1

PAG257::normSq_rootNum_one_prime.text:
theorem normSq_rootNum_one_prime (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    Complex.normSq (rootNum (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ p)) = 1 / p

PAG257::not_isPrimitive_one_prime.text:
theorem not_isPrimitive_one_prime (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    ¬(1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ p).IsPrimitive

PAG257::not_isometry_Vimprim_prime.text:
theorem not_isometry_Vimprim_prime (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    ∃ f ∈ Vimprim p, ip (TopL f) (TopL f) ≠ ip f f

PAG257::Vprim_ne_bot_prime.text: theorem Vprim_ne_bot_prime (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (h3 : 3 ≤ p) : Vprim p ≠ ⊥

PAG257::not_isPrimitive_one_of_two_le.text: theorem not_isPrimitive_one_of_two_le (hN : 2 ≤ N) : ¬(1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ N).IsPrimitive

PAG257::charU_one_mem_Vimprim.text: theorem charU_one_mem_Vimprim (hN : 2 ≤ N) : charU (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) ∈ Vimprim N

PAG258::conductor_neZero.text:
instance conductor_neZero (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : NeZero χ.conductor :=
  ⟨conductor_ne_zero (χ := χ)⟩

PAG258::phaseA1.text: noncomputable def phaseA1 (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : ℂ := rootNum χ.primitiveCharacter

PAG258::rootNum_congr.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
theorem rootNum_congr {d₁ d₂ : ℕ} [NeZero d₁] [NeZero d₂] (h : d₁ = d₂)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₁) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₂)
    (hχ : ∀ a : ℤ, χ₁ a = χ₂ a) : rootNum χ₁ = rootNum χ₂

PAG258::phaseA1_of_isPrimitive.text:
theorem phaseA1_of_isPrimitive {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    phaseA1 χ = rootNum χ

PAG258::normSq_phaseA1.text: theorem normSq_phaseA1 (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : Complex.normSq (phaseA1 χ) = 1

PAG258::phaseA1_changeLevel.text:
theorem phaseA1_changeLevel {M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (hNM : N ∣ M) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    phaseA1 (changeLevel hNM χ) = phaseA1 χ

PAG258::rootNum_one_of_eq_one.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
theorem rootNum_one_of_eq_one {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (hd : d = 1) :
    rootNum (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) = 1

PAG258::phaseA1_one.text: theorem phaseA1_one : phaseA1 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) = 1

PAG258::ip_add_right.text: theorem ip_add_right (f g h : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) : ip f (g + h) = ip f g + ip f h

PAG258::ip_smul_right.text: theorem ip_smul_right (f g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) : ip f (c • g) = c * ip f g

PAG258::UA1.text:
noncomputable def UA1 : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) where
  toFun f := ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N,
    (phaseA1 χ * ip (charU χ) f / (Nat.totient N : ℂ)) • charU χ
  map_add' f g := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => ?_)
    rw [ip_add_right, mul_add, add_div, add_smul]
  map_smul' c f := by
    rw [RingHom.id_apply, Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => ?_)
    rw [ip_smul_right, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    ring

PAG258::UA1_charU.text: theorem UA1_charU (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : UA1 (charU χ) = phaseA1 χ • charU χ

PAG258::ip_UA1.text: theorem ip_UA1 (f g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) : ip (UA1 f) (UA1 g) = ip f g

PAG258::UA1_eq_TopL_of_mem_Vprim.text: theorem UA1_eq_TopL_of_mem_Vprim {f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ Vprim N) : UA1 f = TopL f

PAG258::pullL.text:
noncomputable def pullL {M : ℕ} (hNM : N ∣ M) : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod M)ˣ → ℂ) where
  toFun f u := f (ZMod.unitsMap hNM u)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

PAG258::pullL_charU.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
theorem pullL_charU {M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (hNM : N ∣ M) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    pullL hNM (charU χ) = charU (changeLevel hNM χ)

PAG258::UA1_charU_eq_pull_TopL.text:
theorem UA1_charU_eq_pull_TopL (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    UA1 (charU χ) = pullL χ.conductor_dvd_level (TopL (charU χ.primitiveCharacter))

PAG258::UA1_unique.text:
theorem UA1_unique (U : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ))
    (hU : ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N,
      U (charU χ) = pullL χ.conductor_dvd_level (TopL (charU χ.primitiveCharacter))) :
    U = UA1

PAG258::UA1_comp_pullL.text:
theorem UA1_comp_pullL {M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (hNM : N ∣ M) (f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) :
    UA1 (pullL hNM f) = pullL hNM (UA1 f)

PAG258::TopL_not_compat.text:
theorem TopL_not_compat :
    ∃ f : (ZMod 1)ˣ → ℂ, TopL (pullL (one_dvd 2) f) ≠ pullL (one_dvd 2) (TopL f)

PAG258::UA1_ne_TopL_prime.text:
theorem UA1_ne_TopL_prime (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    charU (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) ∈ Vimprim p ∧
      UA1 (charU (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ p)) ≠ TopL (charU (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ p))

PAG258::UA1_mem_Vprim.text: theorem UA1_mem_Vprim {f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ Vprim N) : UA1 f ∈ Vprim N

PAG258::UA1_mem_Vimprim.text: theorem UA1_mem_Vimprim {f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ Vimprim N) : UA1 f ∈ Vimprim N

PAG258::UA1_comp_TopL.text: theorem UA1_comp_TopL (f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) : UA1 (TopL f) = TopL (UA1 f)

PAG258::rootNum_one_prime.text:
theorem rootNum_one_prime (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    rootNum (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) = -(((Real.sqrt p)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)

PAG258::TopL_not_compat_prime.text:
theorem TopL_not_compat_prime (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    ∃ f : (ZMod 1)ˣ → ℂ, TopL (pullL (one_dvd p) f) ≠ pullL (one_dvd p) (TopL f)

PAG258::gaussSum_inv.text:
theorem gaussSum_inv (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    gaussSum χ⁻¹ (stdAddChar (N := N)) = χ (-1) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (gaussSum χ stdAddChar)

PAG258::rootNum_inv.text:
theorem rootNum_inv (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    rootNum χ⁻¹ = (starRingEnd ℂ) (rootNum χ)

PAG258::primitiveCharacter_inv_apply.text:
theorem primitiveCharacter_inv_apply (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (a : ℤ) :
    (χ⁻¹).primitiveCharacter a = (χ.primitiveCharacter)⁻¹ a

PAG258::phaseA1_inv.text:
theorem phaseA1_inv (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    phaseA1 χ⁻¹ = (starRingEnd ℂ) (phaseA1 χ)

PAG258::UA1_star.text:
theorem UA1_star (f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) :
    UA1 (fun u => (starRingEnd ℂ) (f u)) = fun u => (starRingEnd ℂ) (UA1 f u)

PAG258::pullL_injective.text:
omit [NeZero N] in
theorem pullL_injective {M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (hNM : N ∣ M) : Function.Injective (pullL hNM)

PAG258::sum_units_unitsMap.text:
theorem sum_units_unitsMap {M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (hNM : N ∣ M) (F : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) :
    (Nat.totient N : ℂ) * ∑ u : (ZMod M)ˣ, F (ZMod.unitsMap hNM u) =
      (Nat.totient M : ℂ) * ∑ v : (ZMod N)ˣ, F v

PAG258::ip_pullL.text:
theorem ip_pullL {M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (hNM : N ∣ M) (f g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) :
    (Nat.totient N : ℂ) * ip (pullL hNM f) (pullL hNM g) = (Nat.totient M : ℂ) * ip f g

PAG258::Lvl.text:
structure Lvl where
  
  val : ℕ
  pos : 0 < val
deriving DecidableEq

PAG258::.text:
instance : DirectedSystem Gsp (fun a b h => (pullSys a b h : Gsp a → Gsp b)) where
  map_self a f := by
    funext u
    show f (ZMod.unitsMap (dvd_refl a.val) u) = f u
    rw [ZMod.unitsMap_self]
    rfl
  map_map c b a hab hbc f := by
    funext u
    show f (ZMod.unitsMap hab (ZMod.unitsMap hbc u)) = f (ZMod.unitsMap (dvd_trans hab hbc) u)
    rw [← ZMod.unitsMap_comp hab hbc]
    rfl

PAG258::Gsp.text: abbrev Gsp (a : Lvl) : Type := (ZMod a.val)ˣ → ℂ

PAG258::pullSys.text:
noncomputable def pullSys (a b : Lvl) (h : a ≤ b) : Gsp a →ₗ[ℂ] Gsp b :=
  pullL (N := a.val) (M := b.val) h

PAG258::UA1_family_unique.text:
theorem UA1_family_unique (U : ∀ a : Lvl, Gsp a →ₗ[ℂ] Gsp a)
    (hT : ∀ (a : Lvl) (f : Gsp a), f ∈ Vprim a.val → U a f = TopL f)
    (hc : ∀ (a b : Lvl) (h : a ≤ b) (f : Gsp a), U b (pullSys a b h f) = pullSys a b h (U a f))
    (a : Lvl) : U a = UA1

PAG258::Lim.text: abbrev Lim : Type := Module.DirectLimit Gsp pullSys

PAG258::ofL.text: noncomputable abbrev ofL (a : Lvl) : Gsp a →ₗ[ℂ] Lim := Module.DirectLimit.of ℂ Lvl Gsp pullSys a

PAG258::Uinf.text:
noncomputable def Uinf : Lim →ₗ[ℂ] Lim :=
  Module.DirectLimit.map (fun a => UA1 (N := a.val)) (fun a b h => by
    refine LinearMap.ext (fun f => ?_)
    exact UA1_comp_pullL (N := a.val) (M := b.val) h f)

PAG258::Uinf_ofL.text: theorem Uinf_ofL (a : Lvl) (f : Gsp a) : Uinf (ofL a f) = ofL a (UA1 f)

PAG258::Uinf_unique.text:
theorem Uinf_unique (V : Lim →ₗ[ℂ] Lim) (hV : ∀ a (f : Gsp a), V (ofL a f) = ofL a (UA1 f)) :
    V = Uinf

PAG258::Uinf_ofL_of_mem_Vprim.text:
theorem Uinf_ofL_of_mem_Vprim (q : Lvl) {f : Gsp q} (hf : f ∈ Vprim q.val) :
    Uinf (ofL q f) = ofL q (TopL f)

PAG258::ofL_charU.text:
theorem ofL_charU (a : Lvl) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ a.val) :
    ofL a (charU χ) =
      ofL ⟨χ.conductor, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (conductor_ne_zero χ)⟩ (charU χ.primitiveCharacter)

PAG258::span_ofL_Vprim.text: theorem span_ofL_Vprim : Submodule.span ℂ (⋃ q : Lvl, ofL q '' (Vprim q.val : Set (Gsp q))) = ⊤

PAG258::Uinf_unique_TopL.text:
theorem Uinf_unique_TopL (V : Lim →ₗ[ℂ] Lim)
    (hV : ∀ q (f : Gsp q), f ∈ Vprim q.val → V (ofL q f) = ofL q (TopL f)) : V = Uinf

PAG258::ipn.text: noncomputable def ipn {a : Lvl} (f g : Gsp a) : ℂ := ip f g / (Nat.totient a.val : ℂ)

PAG258::ipn_pullSys.text:
theorem ipn_pullSys {a b : Lvl} (h : a ≤ b) (f g : Gsp a) :
    ipn (pullSys a b h f) (pullSys a b h g) = ipn f g

PAG258::ipn_eq_of_ofL_eq.text:
theorem ipn_eq_of_ofL_eq {a b : Lvl} {f g : Gsp a} {f' g' : Gsp b}
    (hf : ofL a f = ofL b f') (hg : ofL a g = ofL b g') : ipn f g = ipn f' g'

PAG258::ipLim.text:
noncomputable def ipLim (z w : Lim) : ℂ :=
  ipn (Module.DirectLimit.exists_of₂ z w).choose_spec.choose
    (Module.DirectLimit.exists_of₂ z w).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose

PAG258::ipLim_ofL.text: theorem ipLim_ofL (a : Lvl) (f g : Gsp a) : ipLim (ofL a f) (ofL a g) = ipn f g

PAG258::ipLim_Uinf.text: theorem ipLim_Uinf (z w : Lim) : ipLim (Uinf z) (Uinf w) = ipLim z w

PAG258::ipLim_add_right.text: theorem ipLim_add_right (z w w' : Lim) : ipLim z (w + w') = ipLim z w + ipLim z w'

PAG258::ipLim_smul_right.text: theorem ipLim_smul_right (z w : Lim) (r : ℂ) : ipLim z (r • w) = r * ipLim z w

PAG258::ipLim_conj.text: theorem ipLim_conj (z w : Lim) : ipLim w z = (starRingEnd ℂ) (ipLim z w)

PAG258::eq_zero_of_ipLim_self.text: theorem eq_zero_of_ipLim_self (z : Lim) (h : ipLim z z = 0) : z = 0

PAG258::ipLim_self_nonneg.text: theorem ipLim_self_nonneg (z : Lim) : ∃ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r ∧ ipLim z z = r

PAG258::UA1_pullL_of_mem_Vprim.text:
theorem UA1_pullL_of_mem_Vprim {M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (hNM : N ∣ M) {g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ}
    (hg : g ∈ Vprim N) : UA1 (pullL hNM g) = pullL hNM (TopL g)

PAG258::condPart.text:
noncomputable def condPart (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) :=
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun χ : {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N // χ.conductor = q} => charU χ.1)

PAG258::condPart_eq_map.text:
theorem condPart_eq_map {M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (hNM : N ∣ M) :
    condPart M N = (Vprim N).map (pullL hNM)

PAG258::ip_condPart.text:
theorem ip_condPart {q q' : ℕ} (hqq : q ≠ q') {f g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ}
    (hf : f ∈ condPart N q) (hg : g ∈ condPart N q') : ip f g = 0

PAG258::iSup_condPart.text: theorem iSup_condPart : ⨆ q, condPart N q = ⊤

PAG258::ipR.text:
noncomputable def ipR (f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ where
  toFun := ip f
  map_add' := ip_add_right f
  map_smul' c g := by rw [ip_smul_right, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]

PAG258::UA1_mem_condPart.text:
theorem UA1_mem_condPart {q : ℕ} {f : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ condPart N q) :
    UA1 f ∈ condPart N q

PAG258::ipLim_ofL_Vprim.text:
theorem ipLim_ofL_Vprim {q q' : Lvl} (hqq : q.val ≠ q'.val) {f : Gsp q} {g : Gsp q'}
    (hf : f ∈ Vprim q.val) (hg : g ∈ Vprim q'.val) : ipLim (ofL q f) (ofL q' g) = 0

PAG259::padicValRat_prime_ne.text:
theorem padicValRat_prime_ne {s p : ℕ} (hs : s.Prime) (hp : p.Prime) (hne : s ≠ p) :
    padicValRat s (p : ℚ) = 0

PAG259::padicValRat_prime_zpow.text:
theorem padicValRat_prime_zpow {s p : ℕ} (hs : s.Prime) (hp : p.Prime) (k : ℤ) :
    padicValRat s ((p : ℚ) ^ k) = if s = p then k else 0

PAG259::eq_of_padicValRat_eq.text:
theorem eq_of_padicValRat_eq {q r : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r)
    (h : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → padicValRat p q = padicValRat p r) : q = r

PAG259::eq_one_of_padicValRat_eq_zero.text:
theorem eq_one_of_padicValRat_eq_zero {q : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (h : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → padicValRat p q = 0) : q = 1

PAG259::one_le_abs_intCast_sub.text: theorem one_le_abs_intCast_sub {a b : ℤ} (hne : a ≠ b) : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |((a - b : ℤ) : ℝ)|

PAG259::exists_prime_one_le_abs.text:
theorem exists_prime_one_le_abs {q r : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) (hne : q ≠ r) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ (1 : ℝ) ≤ |((padicValRat p q - padicValRat p r : ℤ) : ℝ)|

PAG259::eq_prod_of_support.text:
theorem eq_prod_of_support (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ s ∈ S, s.Prime) {q : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsupp : ∀ t : ℕ, t.Prime → t ∉ S → padicValRat t q = 0) :
    q = ∏ s ∈ S, (s : ℚ) ^ (padicValRat s q)

PAG259::log_eq_sum_of_support.text:
theorem log_eq_sum_of_support (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ s ∈ S, s.Prime) {q : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsupp : ∀ t : ℕ, t.Prime → t ∉ S → padicValRat t q = 0) :
    Real.log q = ∑ s ∈ S, (padicValRat s q : ℝ) * Real.log s

PAG259::exists_padicValRat_eq.text:
theorem exists_padicValRat_eq (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ s ∈ S, s.Prime) (k : ℕ → ℤ) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, 0 < q ∧ (∀ s ∈ S, padicValRat s q = k s) ∧
      (∀ t : ℕ, t.Prime → t ∉ S → padicValRat t q = 0)

PAG259::dense_closure_log_primes.text:
theorem dense_closure_log_primes {p r : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime) (hne : p ≠ r) :
    Dense ((AddSubgroup.closure ({Real.log p, Real.log r} : Set ℝ) : AddSubgroup ℝ) : Set ℝ)

PAG259::exists_zpow_near.text:
theorem exists_zpow_near {p r : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime) (hne : p ≠ r) (x : ℝ) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ a b : ℤ, |(a : ℝ) * Real.log p + (b : ℝ) * Real.log r - x| < ε

PAG259::irrational_log_div_log.text:
theorem irrational_log_div_log {p r : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime) (hne : p ≠ r) :
    Irrational (Real.log r / Real.log p)

PAG259::padicValRat_mul_zpow_zpow.text:
theorem padicValRat_mul_zpow_zpow {p r t : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime) (ht : t.Prime)
    {q₀ : ℚ} (hq₀ : q₀ ≠ 0) (a b : ℤ) :
    padicValRat t (q₀ * (p : ℚ) ^ a * (r : ℚ) ^ b) =
      padicValRat t q₀ + (if t = p then a else 0) + (if t = r then b else 0)

PAG259::log_mul_zpow_zpow.text:
theorem log_mul_zpow_zpow {p r : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime) {q₀ : ℚ} (hq₀ : 0 < q₀)
    (a b : ℤ) :
    Real.log ((q₀ * (p : ℚ) ^ a * (r : ℚ) ^ b : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      Real.log q₀ + (a : ℝ) * Real.log p + (b : ℝ) * Real.log r

PAG259::exists_near_of_two_unmeasured.text:
theorem exists_near_of_two_unmeasured {p r : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime) (hne : p ≠ r)
    {q₀ : ℚ} (hq₀ : 0 < q₀) (x : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, 0 < q ∧ (∀ t : ℕ, t.Prime → t ≠ p → t ≠ r → padicValRat t q = padicValRat t q₀) ∧
      |Real.log q - x| < ε

PAG259::exists_near_measured.text:
theorem exists_near_measured {p r : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime) (hne : p ≠ r)
    (M : Finset ℕ) (hpM : p ∉ M) (hrM : r ∉ M) {q₀ : ℚ} (hq₀ : 0 < q₀) (x : ℝ) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, 0 < q ∧ (∀ s ∈ M, s.Prime → padicValRat s q = padicValRat s q₀) ∧
      |Real.log q - x| < ε

PAG259::eq_mul_zpow_of_agree.text:
theorem eq_mul_zpow_of_agree {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {q q' : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q) (hq' : 0 < q')
    (h : ∀ t : ℕ, t.Prime → t ≠ p → padicValRat t q' = padicValRat t q) :
    q' = q * (p : ℚ) ^ (padicValRat p q' - padicValRat p q)

PAG259::log_sep_of_agree.text:
theorem log_sep_of_agree {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {q q' : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q) (hq' : 0 < q')
    (h : ∀ t : ℕ, t.Prime → t ≠ p → padicValRat t q' = padicValRat t q) :
    q' = q ∨ Real.log p ≤ |Real.log q' - Real.log q|

PAG259::exists_mem_one_le_abs_of_support.text:
theorem exists_mem_one_le_abs_of_support (S : Finset ℕ) {q r : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hqS : ∀ t : ℕ, t.Prime → t ∉ S → padicValRat t q = 0)
    (hrS : ∀ t : ℕ, t.Prime → t ∉ S → padicValRat t r = 0) (hne : q ≠ r) :
    ∃ p ∈ S, p.Prime ∧ (1 : ℝ) ≤ |((padicValRat p q - padicValRat p r : ℤ) : ℝ)|

PAG259::log_sep_one_unmeasured.text:
theorem log_sep_one_unmeasured (S : Finset ℕ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {q q' : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hq' : 0 < q') (hqS : ∀ t : ℕ, t.Prime → t ∉ S → padicValRat t q = 0)
    (hq'S : ∀ t : ℕ, t.Prime → t ∉ S → padicValRat t q' = 0)
    (h : ∀ t ∈ S, t.Prime → t ≠ p → padicValRat t q' = padicValRat t q) :
    q' = q ∨ Real.log p ≤ |Real.log q' - Real.log q|

PAG259::exists_near_in_subgroup.text:
theorem exists_near_in_subgroup (S : Finset ℕ) {p r : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime)
    (hne : p ≠ r) (hpS : p ∈ S) (hrS : r ∈ S) (T : Finset ℕ) (hpT : p ∉ T) (hrT : r ∉ T)
    {q₀ : ℚ} (hq₀ : 0 < q₀) (hq₀S : ∀ t : ℕ, t.Prime → t ∉ S → padicValRat t q₀ = 0) (x : ℝ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, 0 < q ∧ (∀ t : ℕ, t.Prime → t ∉ S → padicValRat t q = 0) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ T, s.Prime → padicValRat s q = padicValRat s q₀) ∧ |Real.log q - x| < ε

PAG259::fiber_sep.text:
theorem fiber_sep (S T : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ s ∈ S, s.Prime)
    (h1 : ∀ p r : ℕ, p ∈ S → r ∈ S → p ∉ T → r ∉ T → p = r) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q q' : ℚ, 0 < q → 0 < q' →
      (∀ t : ℕ, t.Prime → t ∉ S → padicValRat t q = 0) →
      (∀ t : ℕ, t.Prime → t ∉ S → padicValRat t q' = 0) →
      (∀ t ∈ T, padicValRat t q' = padicValRat t q) →
      q' = q ∨ c ≤ |Real.log q' - Real.log q|

PAG259::threshold_iff.text:
theorem threshold_iff (S T : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ s ∈ S, s.Prime) (hTS : T ⊆ S) :
    (∃ k : T → ℤ, ∀ x : ℝ, (x, k) ∈ closure (imgST S T)) ↔
      ∃ p r : ℕ, p ≠ r ∧ p ∈ S ∧ r ∈ S ∧ p ∉ T ∧ r ∉ T

PAG259::isClosed_and_discrete_of_subsing.text:
theorem isClosed_and_discrete_of_subsingleton {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T1Space X]
    {A : Set X} (h : ∀ z : X, ∃ U ∈ nhds z, (U ∩ A).Subsingleton) :
    IsClosed A ∧ DiscreteTopology A

PAG259::dense_imgST_iff.text:
theorem dense_imgST_iff (S T : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ s ∈ S, s.Prime) (hTS : T ⊆ S) :
    Dense (imgST S T) ↔ ∃ p r : ℕ, p ≠ r ∧ p ∈ S ∧ r ∈ S ∧ p ∉ T ∧ r ∉ T

PAG259::isClosed_discrete_imgST.text:
theorem isClosed_discrete_imgST (S T : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ s ∈ S, s.Prime)
    (h1 : ∀ p r : ℕ, p ∈ S → r ∈ S → p ∉ T → r ∉ T → p = r) :
    IsClosed (imgST S T) ∧ DiscreteTopology (imgST S T)

PAG259::rho.text: noncomputable def rho (q : ℚ) : ℝ × (Nat.Primes → ℤ) := (Real.log q, fun p => padicValRat p q)

PAG259::exists_two_primes_not_mem.text:
theorem exists_two_primes_not_mem (I : Set Nat.Primes) (hI : I.Finite) :
    ∃ p r : Nat.Primes, p ∉ I ∧ r ∉ I ∧ (p : ℕ) ≠ (r : ℕ)

PAG259::val_ne_of_mem_of_not_mem.text:
theorem val_ne_of_mem_of_not_mem {I : Set Nat.Primes} {i p : Nat.Primes} (hi : i ∈ I)
    (hp : p ∉ I) : (i : ℕ) ≠ p

PAG259::mem_closure_line_prod.text:
theorem mem_closure_line_prod (x : ℝ) :
    (x, (0 : Nat.Primes → ℤ)) ∈ closure (rho '' {q : ℚ | 0 < q})

PAG259::rho_one_mem_closure_ne_one.text:
theorem rho_one_mem_closure_ne_one :
    rho 1 ∈ closure (rho '' {q : ℚ | 0 < q ∧ q ≠ 1})

PAG259::rho_sep.text:
theorem rho_sep {q r : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) (hne : q ≠ r) :
    ∃ p : Nat.Primes, (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(((rho q).2 p - (rho r).2 p : ℤ) : ℝ)|

PAG259::rhoBox.text: noncomputable def rhoBox (q : ℚ) : ℝ × BoxCoord := (Real.log q, fun p => padicValRat p q)

PAG259::isClosed_discrete_rhoBox_image.text:
theorem isClosed_discrete_rhoBox_image :
    IsClosed (rhoBox '' {q : ℚ | 0 < q}) ∧ DiscreteTopology (rhoBox '' {q : ℚ | 0 < q})

PAG259::finite_support_padicValRat.text:
theorem finite_support_padicValRat {q : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    {p : ℕ | p.Prime ∧ padicValRat p q ≠ 0}.Finite

PAG259::eq_prod_support.text:
theorem eq_prod_support {q : ℚ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    q = ∏ s ∈ (finite_support_padicValRat hq).toFinset, (s : ℚ) ^ (padicValRat s q)

PAG259::sep_of_mem_zmultiples.text:
theorem sep_of_mem_zmultiples {c x y : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hx : ∃ m : ℤ, x = m * c)
    (hy : ∃ n : ℤ, y = n * c) (hne : x ≠ y) : c ≤ |x - y|

PAG259::mem_zmultiples_of_commensurable.text:
theorem mem_zmultiples_of_commensurable {L₁ L₂ : ℝ} {m : ℤ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (h : (n : ℝ) * L₂ = m * L₁) (a b : ℤ) :
    (a : ℝ) * L₁ + b * L₂ = ((a * n + b * m : ℤ) : ℝ) * (L₁ / n)

PAG259::sep_of_commensurable.text:
theorem sep_of_commensurable {L₁ L₂ : ℝ} (hL₁ : 0 < L₁) {m : ℤ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (h : (n : ℝ) * L₂ = m * L₁) (a b a' b' : ℤ)
    (hne : (a : ℝ) * L₁ + b * L₂ ≠ a' * L₁ + b' * L₂) :
    L₁ / n ≤ |((a : ℝ) * L₁ + b * L₂) - (a' * L₁ + b' * L₂)|

PAG259::zpow_ge_of_one_lt.text:
theorem zpow_ge_of_one_lt {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {k : ℤ} (hk : 1 < (p : ℝ) ^ k) :
    (p : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ k

PAG260::prodChar.text:
noncomputable def prodChar (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    DirichletCharacter ℂ (M * N) :=
  changeLevel (dvd_mul_right M N) χ₁ * changeLevel (dvd_mul_left N M) χ₂

PAG260::crtMap.text:
def crtMap (M N : ℕ) [NeZero M] [NeZero N] (x : ZMod M × ZMod N) : ZMod (M * N) :=
  ((x.1.val * N + x.2.val * M : ℕ) : ZMod (M * N))

PAG260::cast_crtMap_fst.text:
theorem cast_crtMap_fst (x : ZMod M × ZMod N) :
    ((crtMap M N x : ZMod (M * N)).cast : ZMod M) = x.1 * (N : ZMod M)

PAG260::cast_crtMap_snd.text:
theorem cast_crtMap_snd (x : ZMod M × ZMod N) :
    ((crtMap M N x : ZMod (M * N)).cast : ZMod N) = x.2 * (M : ZMod N)

PAG260::crtMap_bijective.text: theorem crtMap_bijective (h : M.Coprime N) : Function.Bijective (crtMap M N)

PAG260::stdAddChar_crtMap.text:
theorem stdAddChar_crtMap (x : ZMod M × ZMod N) :
    stdAddChar (crtMap M N x) = stdAddChar x.1 * stdAddChar x.2

PAG260::prodChar_apply.text:
theorem prodChar_apply (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N)
    (a : ZMod (M * N)) :
    prodChar χ₁ χ₂ a = χ₁ (a.cast : ZMod M) * χ₂ (a.cast : ZMod N)

PAG260::gaussSum_prodChar.text:
theorem gaussSum_prodChar (h : M.Coprime N) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    gaussSum (prodChar χ₁ χ₂) stdAddChar =
      χ₁ (N : ZMod M) * χ₂ (M : ZMod N) * gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar

PAG260::prodChar_neg_one.text:
theorem prodChar_neg_one (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    prodChar χ₁ χ₂ (-1) = χ₁ (-1) * χ₂ (-1)

PAG260::crossSign.text:
open Classical in
noncomputable def crossSign (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : ℂ :=
  if χ₁.Odd ∧ χ₂.Odd then -1 else 1

PAG260::crossSign_of_even_left.text:
omit [NeZero M] [NeZero N] in
theorem crossSign_of_even_left {χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M} (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N)
    (h1 : χ₁.Even) : crossSign χ₁ χ₂ = 1

PAG260::parFac_prodChar.text:
theorem parFac_prodChar (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    PAG.Part256.parFac (prodChar χ₁ χ₂) =
      crossSign χ₁ χ₂ * PAG.Part256.parFac χ₁ * PAG.Part256.parFac χ₂

PAG260::rootNum_prodChar.text:
theorem rootNum_prodChar (h : M.Coprime N) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    PAG.Part256.rootNum (prodChar χ₁ χ₂) =
      crossSign χ₁ χ₂ * (χ₁ (N : ZMod M) * χ₂ (M : ZMod N)) *
        (PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₁ * PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₂)

PAG260::phaseA1_prodChar.text:
theorem phaseA1_prodChar (h : M.Coprime N) {χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M}
    {χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (h1 : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h2 : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part258.phaseA1 (prodChar χ₁ χ₂) =
      crossSign χ₁ χ₂ * (χ₁ (N : ZMod M) * χ₂ (M : ZMod N)) *
        (PAG.Part258.phaseA1 χ₁ * PAG.Part258.phaseA1 χ₂)

PAG260::UA1_charU_prodChar.text:
theorem UA1_charU_prodChar (h : M.Coprime N) {χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M}
    {χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (h1 : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h2 : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part258.UA1 (PAG.Part257.charU (prodChar χ₁ χ₂)) =
      (crossSign χ₁ χ₂ * (χ₁ (N : ZMod M) * χ₂ (M : ZMod N)) *
        (PAG.Part258.phaseA1 χ₁ * PAG.Part258.phaseA1 χ₂)) •
        PAG.Part257.charU (prodChar χ₁ χ₂)

PAG260::cross_eq_sign_of_rootNum_one.text:
theorem cross_eq_sign_of_rootNum_one (h : M.Coprime N) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (w1 : PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₁ = 1)
    (w2 : PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₂ = 1) (w12 : PAG.Part256.rootNum (prodChar χ₁ χ₂) = 1) :
    crossSign χ₁ χ₂ * (χ₁ (N : ZMod M) * χ₂ (M : ZMod N)) = 1

PAG260::exists_primitive_odd_five.text: theorem exists_primitive_odd_five : ∃ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 5, χ.IsPrimitive ∧ χ.Odd

PAG260::rootNum_prodChar_ne_mul.text:
theorem rootNum_prodChar_ne_mul :
    ∃ (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 3) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 5), χ₁.IsPrimitive ∧ χ₂.IsPrimitive ∧
      χ₁.Odd ∧ χ₂.Odd ∧
      PAG.Part256.rootNum (prodChar χ₁ χ₂) ≠ PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₁ * PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₂

PAG260::rootNum_prodChar_eq_neg_mul.text:
theorem rootNum_prodChar_eq_neg_mul :
    ∃ (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 3) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 13), χ₁.IsPrimitive ∧
      χ₂.IsPrimitive ∧ χ₁.Odd ∧ χ₂.Odd ∧ χ₁ ((13 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) * χ₂ ((3 : ℕ) : ZMod 13) = 1 ∧
      PAG.Part256.rootNum (prodChar χ₁ χ₂) =
        -(PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₁ * PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₂) ∧
      PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₁ * PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₂ ≠ 0

PAG260::phaseA1_prodChar_ne_mul.text:
theorem phaseA1_prodChar_ne_mul :
    ∃ (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 3) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 5), χ₁.IsPrimitive ∧ χ₂.IsPrimitive ∧
      PAG.Part258.phaseA1 (prodChar χ₁ χ₂) ≠ PAG.Part258.phaseA1 χ₁ * PAG.Part258.phaseA1 χ₂

PAG260::norm_char_unit.text: theorem norm_char_unit {n : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) (a : (ZMod n)ˣ) : ‖χ a‖ = 1

PAG260::norm_cross.text:
omit [NeZero M] [NeZero N] in
theorem norm_cross (h : M.Coprime N) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    ‖χ₁ (N : ZMod M) * χ₂ (M : ZMod N)‖ = 1

PAG260::charU_prodChar.text:
theorem charU_prodChar (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N)
    (u : (ZMod (M * N))ˣ) :
    PAG.Part257.charU (prodChar χ₁ χ₂) u =
      PAG.Part257.charU χ₁ (ZMod.unitsMap (dvd_mul_right M N) u) *
        PAG.Part257.charU χ₂ (ZMod.unitsMap (dvd_mul_left N M) u)
